title: SCOPD: Sparse-Context On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient Vision-Language Models
summary: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) process images and videos as long sequences of visual tokens, making inference expensive. Training-free token pruning reduces this cost, but aggressive compression can sharply degrade performance, often attributed to irreversible loss of task-relevant visual information. We show that this explanation is incomplete. In a fixed-context Pass@K analysis, repeated sampling from the same pruned visual representation recovers many examples missed by greedy decoding, indicating that useful visual evidence can remain accessible but be used unreliably. We call this the representation-utilization gap. Motivated by this observation, we introduce SCOPD, a sparse-context on-policy self-distillation framework in which a student generates reasoning trajectories from pruned visual tokens while a privileged full-context teacher supervises the same on-policy prefixes. SCOPD requires no ground-truth responses, architectural changes, or additional inference-time computation. We further introduce SCOPD+, which uses a small visual-budget intervention to identify visually sensitive response positions and selectively distill them. At 10% visual-token retention, the Vanilla model retains 86.37% of its unpruned performance across 13 benchmarks. SCOPD raises this to 90.49%, while SCOPD+ further improves it to 92.43%. Across token budgets, benchmarks, and pruning operators, our results show that efficient reasoning depends not only on which visual information survives pruning, but also on how reliably the model learns to use it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"表征-利用鸿沟"概念，指出视觉token剪枝导致的性能下降不仅是信息丢失，还在于模型对保留信息的利用不可靠；据此提出免真值、免改架构的在线自蒸馏框架SCOPD及SCOPD+，在10%保留率下将性能恢复率从86.37%提升至92.43%。
AI.motivation: 推理型视觉语言模型将图像/视频处理为长视觉token序列，推理成本高；免训练的token剪枝虽降低成本，但激进压缩会显著损害性能。通常将其归因于任务相关视觉信息的不可逆丢失，但作者通过固定上下文的Pass@K分析发现，同一剪枝表征重复采样可恢复贪心解码遗漏的样本，说明有用视觉证据仍可获取、只是被不可靠地使用，即"表征-利用鸿沟"，这为改进提供了新方向。
AI.method: 作者提出SCOPD——稀疏上下文在线策略自蒸馏框架：学生在剪枝视觉token上生成推理轨迹，特权全上下文教师对相同的在线策略前缀进行监督；无需真值回答、架构改动或额外推理开销。进一步提出SCOPD+，通过小视觉预算干预识别视觉敏感的响应位置并对其选择性蒸馏。
AI.result: 在10%视觉token保留率、13个基准上，Vanilla模型保留未剪枝性能的86.37%；SCOPD提升至90.49%，SCOPD+进一步提升至92.43%。跨token预算、基准与剪枝算子均验证了该结论。
AI.conclusion: 高效推理不仅取决于哪些视觉信息在剪枝后得以保留，还取决于模型能否可靠地学会利用这些信息。

authors: Jose Luis Garcia del Castillo y Lopez
title: ARCH-B: Architectural Representation, Comprehension and Hierarchy Benchmark
summary: Multimodal models increasingly interpret visual environments, but their ability to recognize the same building across photographs, floor plans, elevations, sections, and renderings remains poorly characterized. We introduce ARCH-B, a benchmark of 354 four-choice questions across 11 cross-representational archetypes, constructed from a building-linked corpus of 3.9 million architectural images using visually similar distractors, model-guided difficulty screening, and manual validation. We evaluate 25 multimodal models and collect 5,830 responses from non-expert human participants. Model accuracy ranges from 10.45% to 83.90%, compared with a human baseline of 35.35%. Models perform comparatively well on mixed-representation outlier detection and photograph matching, but remain weaker on floorplan-to-photograph correspondence. Human and model difficulty across archetypes is only weakly correlated (Spearman's (ρ=0.33)). Held-out evaluation confirms that the difficulty identified during screening generalizes beyond the curation models. ARCH-B provides a diagnostic evaluation of visual correspondence and representation transfer across architectural media.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ARCH-B 基准，用 354 道四选一题目、11 类跨表现型原型，系统评测多模态模型在建筑多种图纸/影像间识别同一建筑的能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型越来越多地用于理解视觉环境，但其在照片、平面图、立面图、剖面图和效果图等建筑表示之间识别同一建筑的能力尚缺乏系统刻画。
AI.method: 构建建筑关联语料库（390 万张建筑图像）；采用视觉相似干扰项、模型引导的难度筛选和人工验证，形成 ARCH-B 基准（354 道四选一题，覆盖 11 类跨表示原型）；评测 25 个多模态模型并收集 5,830 份非专家人类作答。
AI.result: 模型准确率介于 10.45% 至 83.90%，人类基线为 35.35%；模型在混合表示异常检测和照片匹配上相对较好，在平面图到照片对应上较弱；人类与模型的难度相关性弱（Spearman ρ=0.33）；留出评估表明筛选阶段识别的难度可推广到筛选模型之外。
AI.conclusion: ARCH-B 为跨建筑媒介的视觉对应与表示迁移提供了诊断性评测基准。

title: Steering Language Model Goals with Value Transplant
summary: Reasoning models often act as if they pursue goals, but their efforts are not always directed toward what users intend, sometimes leading them to pursue unintended outcomes. Previous work has examined how models may internally track their progress toward their goals through a "value axis." We study whether changing such a signal can retarget the model's search toward a different goal. We test value transplant: at each token, we shift the host model's activation along a candidate value axis by the donor-host difference in value coordinates (multiplied by a large scalar), aiming to redirect the host toward the donor's goal. We study this intervention in Qwen3-8B and GPT-OSS-20B models fine-tuned into honest and cheating variants. We test several candidate value axes, including a self-rating axis constructed from activations preceding high versus low elicited self-ratings of progress. The intervention works in both directions, with an honest donor reducing test-gaming in a cheating host and a cheating donor increasing test-gaming in an honest host, showing that this signal can influence which strategy the model follows. On solvable coding tasks, transplant from an honest donor also improves the cheating host's hidden-test performance. Value transplant also works across model families, providing preliminary evidence for the intervention in a setting relevant to model control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"价值移植"干预：通过沿候选价值轴平移宿主模型激活（幅度为供体-宿主价值坐标差乘以大标量），可将模型的搜索目标重定向至供体目标；在诚实/作弊微调变体上双向生效并跨模型族泛化。
AI.motivation: 推理模型常表现得像在追求目标，但其努力未必指向用户意图，可能导向非预期结果。已有工作发现模型内部通过"价值轴"追踪自身目标进展，本文探究改变该信号能否将模型搜索重定向至另一目标。
AI.method: 价值移植（value transplant）：在每个token处，将宿主模型激活沿候选价值轴平移，位移量等于供体与宿主的价值坐标之差乘以一个大标量，从而将宿主导向供体目标。实验对象为Qwen3-8B与GPT-OSS-20B微调成的诚实与作弊变体；候选价值轴包括由高/低自评进展激活构建的"自评轴"。
AI.result: 干预双向有效：诚实供体降低作弊宿主的测试作弊行为，作弊供体增加诚实宿主的测试作弊行为，说明该信号可影响模型采用的策略。在可解编码任务上，诚实供体移植还提升了作弊宿主的隐藏测试性能。价值移植亦可跨模型族生效。
AI.conclusion: 改变内部价值信号能够重定向模型的目标搜索方向，表明该信号对策略选择具有因果影响；跨模型族的成功为模型控制相关场景提供了初步证据。

title: Quantile Head for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with action heads for robot control. Common action heads have distinct limitations: point regression provides only a point estimate of the action distribution, while standard flow-matching samplers require costly iterative sampling. To address these limitations, we unify regression and flow matching under a shared objective and extend it to derive a quantile objective. This quantile objective guides the design of our Quantile Head, which predicts a median and positive gaps to form ordered marginal action quantiles in one forward pass. These quantiles support multiple sampling strategies without retraining and are jointly supervised to train the default median policy. Our local analysis of this joint supervision shows that, with calibrated nearby quantiles, fixed gaps, and matched correction speed, direct median updates have lower variance than under median-only supervision. Experiments show that this jointly supervised median policy achieves the highest average success rates among the compared methods on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and two real-robot tasks, together with the shortest mean episode time among matched LIBERO baselines; code is available at https://github.com/xwangrs/Quantile-Head-for-VLA.

AI.tldr: 该论文将回归与流匹配统一到一个共同目标下，并推导出分位数目标，据此设计了Quantile Head，一次前向即可预测中位数与正间隙形成有序边际动作分位数，支持多种采样策略并经联合监督训练默认中位数策略，在多基准与真实机器人任务上取得最高平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型的常见动作头存在明显局限：点回归仅给出动作分布的点估计，而标准流匹配采样器需要昂贵的迭代采样。为同时克服这两类缺陷，作者希望统一回归与流匹配的目标并拓展出可支撑多样采样的表示形式。
AI.method: 将回归与流匹配统一在共享目标下，并扩展导出分位数目标；基于该目标设计Quantile Head，在一次前向中预测中位数及正间隙，构成有序边际动作分位数；这些分位数无需重训即可支持多种采样策略，并被联合监督以训练默认中位数策略；同时对联合监督做局部分析，考察校准的邻近分位数、固定间隙与匹配的纠正速度等条件下的方差表现。
AI.result: 局部分析表明，在邻近分位数校准、间隙固定且纠正速度匹配时，直接的中位数更新比仅中位数监督具有更低的方差。实验中，该联合监督的中位数策略在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro及两个真实机器人任务上取得所比较方法中最高的平均成功率，并在匹配的LIBERO基线中具有最短的平均回合时间。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过统一回归与流匹配并引入分位数目标，提出单次前向预测有序分位数的Quantile Head，兼顾低采样成本与多样采样灵活性；联合监督的中位数策略在成功率与推理效率上均具优势，验证了该设计的有效性。代码已开源于 https://github.com/xwangrs/Quantile-Head-for-VLA。

title: Counterexamples to Local Reconstruction Gain as a Proxy for Final Fidelity in Residual Completion
summary: Residual completion augments query-aware sparse attention by estimating the contribution of tokens omitted from the exact sparse computation. We ask whether improving a layer's attention-output reconstruction on the same incoming Q/K/V and selected support necessarily improves the fidelity of the final model output. We study training-free RESA and learned Top-K+$φ$ with frozen backbone language models. A prespecified single-layer screen yields two Qwen3-0.6B/Multi-LexSum interventions for which direct-runtime measurements show positive prespecified request-aggregate local reconstruction gain but worse final KL fidelity than the corresponding all-abstain Exact Top-K baseline on both discovery and prompt-token-disjoint holdout requests. Exact restoration at the same layer instead improves final fidelity, showing that the reversal is specific to approximate completion in these cases. In complementary multi-layer experiments, a task-independent local diagnostic often repairs the tested completion estimators, although the repaired models do not consistently outperform Exact Top-K. Together, these results show that better local reconstruction need not translate into better final-model fidelity.

AI.tldr: 在冻结主干语言模型上，局部注意力输出重建质量的提升并不必然带来最终模型输出保真度的提升，甚至可能出现局部指标变好而最终KL保真度变差的"反转"现象。
AI.motivation: 残留补全（residual completion）通过估计被稀疏计算遗漏token的贡献来增强查询感知稀疏注意力，通常假设更好的局部重建能带来更好的最终输出。本文质疑该假设：在相同输入Q/K/V与选定支持集下，改善某层的注意力输出重建是否必然提升最终模型输出的保真度。
AI.method: 研究无训练的RESA与可学习的Top-K+φ，均基于冻结主干语言模型。采用预设的单层筛选，在Qwen3-0.6B/Multi-LexSum上得到两个干预配置，用直接运行时测量局部重建增益；并在发现集与提示token不相交的留出集上比较最终KL保真度。设置全弃权Exact Top-K基线及同层精确恢复对照。另做多层实验，采用任务无关的局部诊断修复完成估计器。
AI.result: 两个干预在预设的请求聚合局部重建指标上均有正增益，但最终KL保真度在发现集和留出集上均劣于全弃权的Exact Top-K基线。同层精确恢复反而提升最终保真度，说明反转是近似补全特有的。多层实验中，任务无关局部诊断常能修复所测完成估计器，但修复后模型未稳定优于Exact Top-K。
AI.conclusion: 更好的局部重建不必然转化为更好的最终模型保真度，局部重建指标与最终输出保真度之间存在可分离性；评估稀疏注意力补全方法时不应仅依赖局部重建指标。

title: Who Gets a Token, and What Does It Carry? Unequal Name Support and Concept Access in Large Language Models
summary: Names are personal identifiers, but they also carry social meaning and are widely used to evaluate how language models treat different people. Such evaluations typically assume that matched names are comparable model inputs. We show that this assumption often fails at the lexical interface: matched names are not necessarily matched inputs. Some names receive direct single-token access, while others are assembled from multiple subwords, creating unequal name-surface support. Across nearly half a million first names and 12 LLM-associated tokenizers, direct lexical access is highly selective, model dependent, and uneven across race- and gender-associated name metadata. We introduce NameTrace, a model-native, fine-grained, pre-behavioral framework for measuring whether unequal name-surface support remains a vocabulary property or becomes visible in task-relevant internal representations. NameTrace measures concept accessibility from the model's own probabilities over task-specific adjective axes with continuous task-aligned weights. On matched atomic and short-fragmented names within the same race/ethnicity--gender-associated strata, support predicts systematic differences in concept accessibility across fellowship, hiring, clinical assessment, and lending. These differences persist across all eight matched strata, extend across model families, and transfer to unseen names. Hidden-state interventions further show that the measured task directions have downstream leverage, shifting later constrained choices. Unequal lexical support is therefore demographically structured at the input and remains visible in task-relevant model computation. NameTrace makes lexical comparability measurable, supporting a broader principle: behavioral comparability begins with lexical comparability.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示"匹配姓名"假设在词元层面不成立：姓名在分词器中的单token/多子词支持不均，且这种不均与种族、性别元数据系统性相关。作者提出NameTrace框架，从模型自身概率出发测量概念可及性，证明词表层面的不平等会传导至任务相关内部表征，并进一步影响下游决策。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM是否区别对待不同人群的评估，通常假设"匹配姓名即匹配输入"。但作者指出该假设在词汇接口处就常被打破：部分姓名被分词器作为单一token直接访问，另一些则需由多个子词拼装，形成不平等的"姓名-表层支持"（name-surface support）。若输入本身不可比，则基于姓名的行为评估结论可能失真，因此需要先建立词汇层面的可比性度量。
AI.method: 1) 对近50万个名（first names）与12个LLM相关分词器进行大规模统计，考察直接单token访问的选择性、模型依赖性，及其与种族/性别关联元数据的关系。2) 提出NameTrace：一种模型原生、细粒度、行为前（pre-behavioral）的框架，通过模型自身在任务特定形容词轴上的概率、结合连续的任务对齐权重，度量概念可及性。3) 在同一"种族/族裔—性别"分层的原子姓名与短碎片化姓名间进行匹配比较，覆盖奖学金、招聘、临床评估、借贷四类任务；并配合隐藏状态干预实验，检验所测任务方向的下游影响力。
AI.result: 直接词汇访问高度选择性、依赖具体模型，且在种族与性别关联的姓名元数据上分布不均。在八个匹配分层中，表层支持系统性地预测概念可及性差异，且该差异跨全部八个分层、跨模型家族、并可迁移到未见姓名。隐藏状态干预显示，所测任务方向具有下游杠杆作用，能够改变后续受约束的选择结果。
AI.conclusion: 词汇支持的不平等在输入端即具有人口统计学结构，并持续显现在任务相关的模型计算中。NameTrace使词汇可比性变得可测量，支持一个更普遍的原则：行为可比性始于词汇可比性。

title: SNaP: One-Step Posterior Sampling for Noisy Inverse Problems
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching models can produce high-quality posterior samples for inverse problems, but typically require tens to thousands of network evaluations per draw. MeanFlow enables one-step generation, yet applying it to inverse problems leaves no intermediate steps at which to enforce measurement consistency. We introduce SNaP, a one-step MeanFlow posterior sampler for linear inverse problems with Gaussian noise. Its central innovation is a measurement-adapted source: a Gaussian distribution whose mean and anisotropic covariance are determined by the measurement operator, observation, and noise level. The source anchors well-measured directions while preserving variation where the measurements are weak or uninformative. We show that the exact conditional flow transports this source to the true posterior. Across natural-image restoration and multi-coil MRI, SNaP produces diverse, high-quality samples with one network evaluation per draw, 30 to 2250 $\times$ faster than iterative samplers.

AI.tldr: SNaP提出一种面向线性逆问题的一步MeanFlow后验采样器，核心是构造由测量算子、观测值与噪声水平决定的"测量自适应源分布"，单次网络评估即可生成后验样本。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型与流匹配模型能为逆问题生成高质量后验样本，但每次采样通常需数十至数千次网络评估，计算代价高；MeanFlow虽支持一步生成，却缺少中间步骤，无法在采样过程中施加测量一致性约束，因而难以直接用于逆问题。
AI.method: 提出SNaP，面向高斯噪声下的线性逆问题的一步MeanFlow后验采样器。其关键设计是"测量自适应源"（measurement-adapted source）：一个高斯分布，其均值与各向异性协方差由测量算子、观测值和噪声水平共同决定；该源在测量充分的 directions 上锚定（保持与测量一致），在测量薄弱或信息不足的方向上保留变化。文中证明精确的条件流可将该源输运到真实后验分布。
AI.result: 在自然图像复原任务与多线圈MRI重建任务上，SNaP每次采样仅需一次网络评估，即可生成多样且高质量的后验样本，速度比迭代式采样器快30至2250倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将测量信息编码进源分布，SNaP绕开了MeanFlow缺乏中间步骤导致无法施加测量一致性的瓶颈，实现了线性高斯逆问题的高效一步后验采样，兼顾样本质量、多样性与显著的计算加速。

title: WhiteCon: Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation Regression Through Whitening Transform and Dual Consistency
summary: Domain adaptation is crucial for addressing distributional shifts that degrade model performance across domains. While most existing research has centered on classification, semi-supervised domain adaptation regression (SSDAR) for continuous-output tasks remains largely unexplored, particularly in practical scenarios with limited labeled target data. To address this gap, we propose semi-supervised domain adaptation regression through whitening transform and dual consistency (WhiteCon), which combines domain-specific whitening transform (DWT) and dual consistency regularization to enhance training stability and domain adaptation. DWT reduces the variance of the model parameters by transforming the feature covariance matrix into an identity matrix, thus stabilizing training under ordinary least squares assumptions. In addition, variance consistency regularization, as part of dual consistency regularization, aligns the variances of weak, strong, and mixup-augmented features to improve resilience against augmentation-induced perturbations. Empirical evaluations on various benchmark datasets under SSDAR settings demonstrate that the proposed WhiteCon achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing methods, effectively addressing domain shifts in regression tasks. The code for WhiteCon is available at https://github.com/sejin-sim/WhiteCon.

AI.tldr: 提出WhiteCon方法，结合域特定白化变换与双重一致性正则化，用于半监督域适应回归(SSDAR)，在多个基准数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 域适应对缓解跨域分布偏移至关重要，但现有研究多聚焦分类任务，针对连续输出任务的半监督域适应回归(SSDAR)研究不足，尤其在标注目标数据有限的现实场景下更为空白。
AI.method: WhiteCon由两部分组成：1) 域特定白化变换(DWT)，将特征协方差矩阵变换为单位矩阵，在普通最小二乘假设下降低模型参数方差，稳定训练；2) 双重一致性正则化，其中方差一致性正则化对齐弱增强、强增强及mixup增强特征的方差，提升对增强扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多种基准数据集的SSDAR设置下，WhiteCon相较现有方法取得state-of-the-art性能，有效应对回归任务中的域偏移。
AI.conclusion: WhiteCon通过白化变换与双重一致性正则化的结合，有效解决半监督域适应回归问题，代码已开源。

title: K-OPSD: Verifiable On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Vision-Language Models on AEC Drawings
summary: Interpreting architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) drawings is hard for general Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce K-OPSD, a VLM post-training methodology for improving AEC drawing understanding. Building on On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) with verifiable supervision, we construct a teacher from the model's own best-of-N generations, certified by a process-level verifier, and rescue failed prompts by resampling under a hint that exposes the verified answer. We then perform an on-policy model update by training on verified completions with a cross-entropy inner-loss, outperforming the bounded token-wise generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) used by on-policy distillation. Using K-OPSD, we fine-tune Qwen3-VL models on the AECV-Bench dataset. The resulting models attain the top average judge score (0.819) and combined accuracy (0.738), achieving competitive results against open-source baseline models. The recipe transfers to the out-of-domain ArchCAD dataset, where the 8B model gains most. We present the verifier suite and the continual learning and self-improving pipeline, our results provide preliminary evidence that verifier-guided self-distillation is a promising route toward more reliable machine reading of architecture drawings.

AI.tldr: 提出K-OPSD，一种基于可验证的过程级监督与在线自蒸馏的VLM后训练方法，用于提升AEC建筑图纸理解能力，在AECV-Bench上取得领先评分并能迁移至域外ArchCAD数据集。
AI.motivation: AEC（建筑、工程与施工）图纸的解读对通用多模态大模型与视觉语言模型而言难度较大，缺乏针对该专业领域的可靠理解能力，因此需要一种能够利用可验证监督信号进行后训练的方法来提升模型对建筑图纸的机器阅读可靠性。
AI.method: 在On-Policy Self-Distillation（OPSD）与可验证监督的基础上构建K-OPSD：从模型自身的最佳N次（best-of-N）生成中构造教师信号，由过程级验证器（process-level verifier）进行认证；对被判定失败的提示，通过暴露已验证答案的提示（hint）进行重采样以挽救；随后采用交叉熵内层损失在已验证的完成样本上做在线策略更新，替代在线策略蒸馏中使用的有界逐token广义Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）。基于该方法在AECV-Bench数据集上微调Qwen3-VL模型，并给出验证器套件及持续学习、自我改进流水线。
AI.result: 微调后的Qwen3-VL模型在AECV-Bench上取得最高平均评判分数0.819与综合准确率0.738，与开源基线模型相比具有竞争力；该训练配方可迁移至域外ArchCAD数据集，其中8B模型提升最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 验证器引导的自蒸馏是通向更可靠的建筑图纸机器阅读的一条有前景的路径，结果为该方向提供了初步证据。

title: AD-E2E-JEPA: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture For End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving requires \textit{world models} that can understand the physical world, reason and plan, and operate safely. In this paper, we first systematically evaluate existing action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models, including LeWM, DINO-WM, and JEPA-WM for end-to-end autonomous driving (E2EAD). To isolate world-model quality from policy learning, we employ a goal-conditioned zero-shot planning setting that evaluates these models using ground-truth future observations as goals, without training any driving policy. We find that existing JEPA-based world models are either accurate for driving but computationally expensive, or computationally efficient but insufficient for planning. To address this trade-off, we propose \textbf{AD-E2E-JEPA}, which introduces a SIGReg-regularized learnable projector applied to projected patch embeddings. The projector reduces the number of planning patches by $16\times$ and the embedding dimension by $4\times$, achieving a $100\times$ inference speedup while retaining planning performance, with a 0.8-second runtime for an 8-frame rollout over 256 candidate trajectories. \textit{Without} training any driving policy, the world model itself reaches the goals located 20 meters away on average within the displacement of respectively 4.0/2.8 meters, using world-model rollouts over trajectory vocabularies of respectively 256/8,192 candidates. On the NAVSIMv2 benchmark, it achieves 67.3/72.9 EPDMS with multiplicative safety metrics and 84.1/86.5 EPDMS$^{\dagger}$ without them in goal-conditioned zero-shot planning. Experiments further show that the self-supervised pretrained projector improves downstream imitation learning performance from 80.2 to 85.4 EPDMS. The source code is available at https://github.com/HaoranZhuExplorer/AD-E2E-JEPA

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了现有JEPA世界模型在端到端自动驾驶中的表现，并提出AD-E2E-JEPA，通过SIGReg正则化的可学习投影器将规划patch减少16倍、嵌入维度减少4倍，实现100倍推理加速并保持规划性能。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需要能理解物理世界、进行推理规划并安全运行的world model。现有动作条件化JEPA世界模型（LeWM、DINO-WM、JEPA-WM）存在两难：要么规划准确但计算昂贵，要么计算高效但不足以支撑规划。作者希望解决这一权衡问题。
AI.method: 采用目标条件零样本规划设置，以真实未来观测作为目标，不训练任何驾驶策略，从而将世界模型质量与策略学习解耦。提出AD-E2E-JEPA，在投影后的patch嵌入上引入SIGReg正则化的可学习投影器，将规划patch数量减少16倍、嵌入维度减少4倍。
AI.result: 实现100倍推理加速，8帧rollout对256条候选轨迹仅需0.8秒。在不训练驾驶策略的情况下，世界模型对平均20米外目标的位移误差为4.0/2.8米（分别对应256/8192候选轨迹词表）。NAVISv2基准上，带乘法安全指标达67.3/72.9 EPDMS，不带则达84.1/86.5 EPDMS†。自监督预训练投影器将下游模仿学习性能从80.2提升至85.4 EPDMS。
AI.conclusion: AD-E2E-JEPA有效缓解了现有JEPA世界模型在准确性与计算效率之间的权衡，在零样本目标条件规划中表现优异，且预训练投影器能提升下游模仿学习性能。

title: Evaluating Machine Unlearning in ASR
summary: Machine unlearning (MU) offers a path to compliance with "right to be forgotten" regulations. While MU has received increasing attention for speech tasks, it remains largely unexplored for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR). In this work, we investigate whether existing MU algorithms and evaluation tools are suitable for ASR. We apply several MU techniques to an ASR model, evaluating privacy-utility trade-offs for single-subject unlearning, then assess the best algorithm under sequential and simultaneous unlearning. Results show that gradient ascent-based algorithms achieve strong utility-privacy trade-offs, whereas more complex approaches over-unlearn samples, making them easier to identify as unlearned. This suggests standard privacy evaluations based on simple Membership Inference attacks are insufficient to reliably assess unlearning success, motivating improved evaluation methods for MU in ASR. Finally, we show that both sequential and simultaneous unlearning yield worse privacy and utility than single-subject unlearning, underscoring the need for unlearning constructions better suited to these settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器遗忘（MU）算法与评测工具是否适用于自动语音识别（ASR），发现梯度上升类算法在隐私-效用权衡上表现最佳，而复杂方法存在过度遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 为满足"被遗忘权"法规的合规需求，MU已在语音任务中受到关注，但在ASR领域仍缺乏探索，因此需评估现有MU算法与评测工具在ASR上的适用性。
AI.method: 将多种MU技术应用于一个ASR模型，评估单主体遗忘下的隐私-效用权衡，并在最优算法基础上进一步考察序贯遗忘与同时遗忘两种设定。
AI.result: 基于梯度上升的算法能取得较强的效用-隐私权衡；更复杂的方法会过度遗忘样本，使其更易被识别为已遗忘数据；这表明仅基于简单成员推理攻击的标准隐私评测不足以可靠衡量遗忘效果。序贯与同时遗忘的隐私与效用均劣于单主体遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 现有MU评测方法在ASR上存在不足，需改进评估手段，并设计更适合序贯与同时遗忘场景的遗忘构造方案。

title: Advancing Wildlife Conservation through Multimodal Animal Re-Identification with Environmental Metadata
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables; v2: added references
summary: Identifying individual animals is crucial for effective wildlife monitoring and conservation efforts. Recent advancements in computer vision have shown promise in animal re-identification (Animal ReID) by leveraging data from camera traps. However, existing Animal ReID datasets rely exclusively on visual data, overlooking environmental metadata that ecologists have identified as highly correlated with animal behavior and identity, such as temperature and circadian rhythms. Meanwhile, modern vision-language models (VLMs) offer rich multimodal reasoning capabilities, but existing resources underutilize their text-processing potential. To address these limitations, we propose MetaWild, a multimodal Animal ReID dataset comprising 20,890 images across six species, paired with environmental metadata extracted from embedded camera trap overlays and scene contexts. Additionally, to facilitate the use of metadata in existing ReID methods, we propose the Meta-Feature Adapter (MFA), a lightweight module that can be incorporated into existing VLM-based ReID methods, allowing ReID models to leverage both environmental metadata and visual information to improve ReID performance. Experiments on MetaWild show that combining baseline ReID models with MFA to incorporate metadata consistently improves performance compared to using visual information alone, validating the effectiveness of incorporating metadata in re-identification.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaWild多模态动物重识别数据集（6物种、20,890张图像，含环境元数据），并设计轻量级Meta-Feature Adapter（MFA）模块，使现有VLM重识别方法能融合环境元数据与视觉信息，实验证明性能一致提升。
AI.motivation: 个体动物识别对野生动物监测与保护至关重要。现有基于相机陷阱的动物重识别（Animal ReID）数据集仅依赖视觉数据，忽略了生态学家认为与动物行为和身份高度相关的环境元数据（如温度、昼夜节律）；同时，现有视觉语言模型（VLM）资源未充分利用其文本处理能力。作者旨在弥补这两方面不足。
AI.method: 1) 构建MetaWild数据集：包含6个物种、20,890张图像，配对环境元数据（从相机陷阱嵌入叠加信息和场景上下文中提取）。2) 提出Meta-Feature Adapter（MFA）：一种可插入现有VLM重识别方法的轻量级模块，使模型能同时利用环境元数据与视觉信息。
AI.result: 在MetaWild上的实验表明，将基线ReID模型与MFA结合以引入元数据后，相比仅使用视觉信息，性能得到一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 在动物重识别中融入环境元数据是有效的，MetaWild数据集与MFA模块为多模态Animal ReID提供了新资源与方法，验证了元数据对提升重识别性能的价值。

title: The Devil is in the Spectrum Bias: Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching for Robust Representation Distillation
summary: Large visual foundation models have demonstrated remarkable transferability across a wide range of downstream tasks. To deploy such models efficiently, feature matching has become a popular knowledge distillation approach that transfers teacher representations to smaller student models without requiring labeled data. However, we show that the conventional feature matching objective with L2-distance is inherently biased toward reconstructing dominant spectral directions of the teacher representation, while under-optimizing low-variance directions that often contain task-relevant information. To address this, we propose Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching, SpecMatch, a simple objective that adaptively emphasizes under-optimized spectral directions while preserving the relative importance of dominant directions. SpecMatch is easy to implement and introduces negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments on image recognition demonstrate that SpecMatch consistently improves downstream adaptation across diverse tasks, including image classification, anomaly detection, medical image analysis, and domain generalization. In particular, SpecMatch outperforms conventional feature matching in 40 of 42 teacher--student and training-setting combinations, while consistently improving over the original student model in all settings. We further demonstrate that the proposed objective generalizes beyond vision, improving downstream performance across six protein understanding tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpecMatch，一种频谱平衡的特征匹配蒸馏目标，通过自适应强调被欠优化的频谱方向，提升学生模型在下游任务上的适配性能。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉基础模型迁移能力强，但部署成本高，因此常用无标签的特征匹配蒸馏把教师表征迁移到小模型。然而传统基于 L2 距离的特征匹配目标存在固有偏差：倾向于重建教师表征的主导频谱方向，而低估常含任务相关信息的低方差方向。
AI.method: 提出 Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching（SpecMatch）目标：在保留主导方向相对重要性的同时，自适应地强调被欠优化的频谱方向。实现简单，计算开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在图像识别上广泛实验表明，SpecMatch 在图像分类、异常检测、医学图像分析和域泛化等多种下游任务中持续提升适配性能；在 42 种教师—学生与训练设置组合中有 40 种优于传统特征匹配，且在所有设置中均优于原始学生模型。此外，该目标可推广到视觉之外，在六项蛋白质理解任务上提升下游性能。
AI.conclusion: L2 特征匹配的频谱偏差会损害蒸馏效果；SpecMatch 通过频谱平衡校正该偏差，是一种简单、通用且有效的蒸馏目标，适用于视觉及非视觉领域。

title: SpecRegMatch: Robust Semi-Supervised Regression for Vehicle Interior Noise Prediction
comment: Published in IEEE Access, vol. 12, pp. 60-72, 2024
summary: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has observed increased application in predicting vehicle interior noise levels within the automotive industry. However, the collection of labeled data for training models in this context involves significant costs. Previous studies in semi-supervised regression (SSR) have effectively mitigated the reliance on labeled data by incorporating unlabeled data. Nonetheless, these approaches often introduce a high computational cost due to the training of multiple models and data sampling. This study introduces SpecRegMatch, a novel SSR method aimed at addressing the computational cost associated with training by leveraging a single model, thus eliminating the need for multiple data samplings. SpecRegMatch integrates consistency regularization and information maximization to robustly train the model, achieved through various augmentations applied to both the embedding vectors and predicted values. Experimental results demonstrate that SpecRegMatch achieves state-of-the-art performance across various scenarios, even when using a single model. It attains a remarkable performance, as indicated by an R^2 score of 0.434. This is especially noteworthy in scenarios where labeled data is scarce. You can access the code for our proposed method at https://github.com/sejin-sim/SpecRegMatch.

AI.tldr: SpecRegMatch是一种单模型半监督回归方法，通过一致性正则化与信息最大化减少训练计算成本，在标注数据稀缺场景下实现SOTA性能（R²=0.434）。
AI.motivation: 汽车行业预测车内噪声依赖AI模型，但标注数据采集成本高；现有半监督回归方法虽能利用无标注数据降低依赖，却因训练多个模型和数据采样导致计算开销大。
AI.method: 提出SpecRegMatch，仅用单一模型，无需多数据采样；融合一致性正则化与信息最大化，对嵌入向量和预测值施加多种数据增强以稳健训练。
AI.result: 在多场景下达到SOTA性能，即便单模型也表现优异，R²达0.434，在标注数据稀缺场景尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: SpecRegMatch有效降低半监督回归计算成本，并在标注数据稀缺时保持强预测能力，代码已开源。

title: Unknown is not normal: separating language-model extraction from rule-based decision logic for clinical risk scores
comment: 14 pages (7 of main text), 5 figures, 2 tables, appendix included; full supplementary material in the code repository. Code: https://github.com/nicoveraz/calc-bounds (archived: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23004726)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to compute clinical risk scores from free-text notes. Notes are often incomplete, and treating undocumented findings as normal can silently misclassify patients. We test whether separating three-state extraction (present, absent or unknown, by an LLM) from decision logic (deterministic code computing score bounds over unknown inputs) lets a system ask only questions that can change the decision. On 1,200 synthetic emergency cases across six calculators (HEART, CURB-65, qSOFA, PERC, Wells, Cockcroft-Gault), with a simulated clinician answering questions, we compared this bounds policy with asking for every missing input, a missing-equals-normal schema, and an end-to-end LLM agent (Claude Opus 5.5). With Claude Haiku 4.5 as extractor, the bounds policy matched ask-all accuracy (99.4% vs 99.4%) with half the questions (0.92 vs 1.78 per case) and no irrelevant ones. Treating missing as normal dropped accuracy to 91.2% and under-triaged 8.5% of patients (95% CI 7.1-10.2), and under-triage persisted under messy notes and a noisy clinician. The agent was equally accurate under ideal conditions (99.6%) but 9.5% of its questions were irrelevant; with a noisy clinician it was less accurate than the bounds policy (83.5% vs 87.0%, p<0.001) and committed prematurely in 2.7% of cases (bounds: 0%). A 9B local model as extractor reached oracle-level accuracy (99.8%). In 584 real case reports from MedCalc-Bench, only 52% contained enough information to determine the category (HEART 13%). Routing decisions through code that reasons explicitly about unknowns avoids premature commitment and irrelevant questions, halves the questions asked, and works with small local models.

AI.tldr: 将三态抽取（存在/缺失/未知）与确定性决策逻辑分离，仅在未知输入可能改变决策时才提问，可在病例数不变的前提下将提问量减半、避免过早结论，且可搭配小型本地模型。
AI.motivation: 临床自由文本记录常不完整，而把未记录项默认视为"正常"会造成静默误分类。需要一种机制，明确区分"未知"与"正常"，并只就真正影响决策的缺失信息提问，以降低误诊与不必要提问。
AI.method: 在1200个合成急诊病例、6个评分工具（HEART、CURB-65、qSOFA、PERC、Wells、Cockcroft-Gault）上，用模拟临床医生应答，比较四种策略：①基于界的提问策略（LLM三态抽取 + 确定性代码对未知输入计算分值上下界，仅当未知可改变结论时提问）；②询问所有缺失项；③缺失即正常；④端到端LLM代理。抽取器分别用Claude Haiku 4.5、Claude Opus 5.5及一个9B本地模型，并测试杂乱文本与"噪声医生"场景。另在MedCalc-Bench的584份真实病例报告中评估信息充分性。
AI.result: 在Haiku 4.5抽取下，界策略与"问全部"准确率相当（99.4% vs 99.4%），提问数减半（0.92 vs 1.78次/例）且无无关提问。"缺失即正常"准确率降至91.2%，8.5%（95%CI 7.1–10.2）患者被低估分诊，且在杂乱文本与噪声医生下持续存在。端到端代理在理想条件下准确率相当（99.6%），但9.5%提问无关；在噪声医生下准确率低于界策略（83.5% vs 87.0%，p<0.001），2.7%病例过早结论（界策略为0%）。9B本地模型作抽取器达到oracle级准确率（99.8%）。真实数据中仅52%病例信息足以判定分类，HEART仅13%。
AI.conclusion: 把决策路由到显式处理未知的确定性代码，可避免过早结论与无关提问、将提问量减半，并可与小型本地模型配合使用，为临床风险评分提供更安全、更高效的方案；真实病例记录的普遍信息缺失也凸显了显式建模"未知"的必要性。

title: SpatialSkill: Self-Evolving Skills for Cross-View Spatial Reasoning
summary: Cross-view spatial reasoning requires a model to align different viewpoints into a coherent spatial representation, yet this ability remains challenging for vision-language models despite being natural to humans. Existing methods typically improve spatial reasoning by updating model weights, which keeps the acquired knowledge implicit and tied to a specific backbone. We propose \textit{SpatialSkill}, a weight-update-free framework that enables a frozen vision-language model to accumulate explicit natural-language reasoning skills from offline trajectories. Unlike symbolic tasks, perceptual skills cannot be reliably verified simply by executing them: a plausible spatial rule may lack visual support or require transformations that the frozen model cannot perform. SpatialSkill therefore admits candidate skills only after visual-grounding and executability checks, constrains manual evolution to prevent harmful regressions, and routes skills by spatial-reasoning category to reduce negative transfer. On CityCube, across four frozen executors, SpatialSkill yields consistent gains, and a 9B executor equipped with SpatialSkill surpasses the strongest closed-source reference in our evaluation. The skills are stored in a versioned natural-language manual, making the reasoning strategies explicit and auditable without modifying model parameters. Code at https://github.com/vindahi/SpatialSkill.

AI.tldr: 提出免权重更新的 SpatialSkill 框架，使冻结的视觉语言模型能从离线轨迹中积累显式自然语言推理技能，在 CityCube 上一致提升跨视角空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 跨视角空间推理要求模型将不同视角对齐为一致的空间表征，但现有视觉语言模型仍难以做到。已有方法多依赖更新模型权重，导致知识隐式化且绑定特定骨干；作者希望在不改参数的前提下让模型获得显式、可积累的空间推理技能。
AI.method: SpatialSkill 面向冻结的视觉语言模型，从离线轨迹中提炼自然语言技能。与符号任务不同，感知技能无法仅靠执行验证，因此仅接受通过视觉基础校验与可执行性校验的候选技能；限制人工演化以避免有害回退；按空间推理类别路由技能以减少负迁移。技能存储在带版本的自然语言手册中。
AI.result: 在 CityCube 上，对四种冻结执行器均获得一致增益；配备 SpatialSkill 的 9B 执行器在该评测中超过最强闭源参考模型。
AI.conclusion: SpatialSkill 证明无需修改模型参数即可积累可审计的显式空间推理技能，为跨视角空间推理提供了可迁移、可解释的技能积累范式。

title: Understanding Clinical Cognitive Dialogues Using Large Language Models
summary: In-person cognitive assessment is both a test and an interaction. Clinicians explain tasks, repair misunderstandings, and adapt to patient responses, while patients may hesitate, seek clarification, or disengage. Yet clinical dialogue resources rarely label the interaction structure needed to study these behaviors at scale. We present an de-identified corpus of 33 cognitive assessment conversations with 8,250 utterances annotated for three speaker roles and 56 dialogue acts. We use this corpus to benchmark large language models on fine-grained dialogue-act classification and next-patient-utterance generation. We also test whether out-of-domain instruction data and explanation-augmented training transfer to this clinical setting. Instruction tuning produces the strongest patient-utterance reference matching and improves classification accuracy. Reasoning-aware fine-tuning produces the strongest classification results among the LLaMA-3.1-8B variants. However, even the best models struggle to separate closely related dialogue acts, showing that broad conversational intent is easier to recognize than fine-grained communicative function. The corpus and benchmark make interaction structure measurable in cognitive assessments and support follow-up work on conversational markers, clinician education, and carefully validated simulated patients. This work does not make diagnostic claims. Instead, it provides the data and evaluation framework needed to study these applications.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了一个包含33段认知评估对话、8,250条话语的脱敏语料库，标注了3类说话人角色与56种对话行为，并基于此对大语言模型进行细粒度对话行为分类和下一患者话语生成的基准测试。
AI.motivation: 面对面认知评估既是测试也是互动：临床医生需解释任务、修正误解并适应患者反应，患者则可能犹豫、寻求澄清或脱离互动。然而临床对话资源很少标注研究这些行为所需的互动结构，导致大规模研究困难。
AI.method: 构建脱敏语料库（33段对话、8,250条话语、3类说话人角色、56种对话行为标注），用于基准测试大语言模型在细粒度对话行为分类与下一患者话语生成任务上的表现；并测试域外指令数据与解释增强训练向临床场景的迁移效果。
AI.result: 指令微调在患者话语参考匹配上表现最佳并提升分类准确率；推理感知微调在LLaMA-3.1-8B各变体中分类效果最优。但即便最优模型也难以区分相近对话行为，表明宽泛对话意图比细粒度交际功能更易识别。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库与基准使认知评估中的互动结构可被量化，支持对话标记、临床医生教育及经严格验证的模拟患者等后续研究。本工作不作诊断性声明，而是提供研究这些应用所需的数据与评估框架。

title: Training and Inference Dynamics of PLDR-LLMs: Row-Map Collapse, Renormalization, and Predictive Reduction
summary: This monograph develops a unified account of training and inference in Power Law Decoder Representation language models (PLDR-LLMs). Exact finite work identities decompose changes in the absolute energy of the row-centered learned map into parameter contributions, signed interactions, and numerical observation defects. Positive affine blocking retains restarts at the row-constant face, while the augmented AdamW state supplies the complete dynamical description. Predictive renormalization acts on the complete conditional training law for a single pass over distinct corpus target blocks, retaining optimizer memory, remaining data, schedule, and numerical policy. Autonomous reductions require closure; approximate reductions carry successor and emission errors. Finite-population covariance, matched physical clocks, matrix fluxes, and signed temporal energy connect row dynamics to model-wide observations. Absolute row collapse, relative row concentration, operator stabilization, and predictive accuracy are distinguished. Experiments reveal observer and optimizer dependence, reject the tested autonomous row-state candidates, and support finite conditional prediction and state-specific operator reduction. Independent single-pass families exhibit moving finite fluctuation regions without establishing a thermodynamic critical class. Conditional symmetry, head limits, covariance flows, and readout error budgets specify assumptions needed to transfer scaling laws to inference. The theory separates exact identities, conditional dynamical claims, and finite empirical findings, with proofs, selected formal checks, and compact numerical evidence.

AI.tldr: 本专著为Power Law Decoder Representation语言模型（PLDR-LLMs）建立了训练与推理的统一理论：通过有限工作恒等式、正仿射阻塞、增广AdamW动力学与预测重整化，区分精确恒等式、条件性动力学命题与有限实证发现，证明有限条件预测与状态特定算子约简的可行性，并给出将缩放律迁移至推理所需的假设条件。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型理论多将训练动力学与推理行为割裂处理，缺乏同时刻画二者的统一框架；同时"缩放律可迁移至推理"这一常见假设缺少明确的数学条件。本文旨在给出一个可审计的形式化体系，明确界定哪些结论是精确恒等式、哪些是条件性动力学断言、哪些仅为有限实证发现，从而厘清自主约简、算子稳定性与预测精度之间的关系。
AI.method: 构建PLDR-LLM统一理论：以精确有限工作恒等式将行中心化学习映射的绝对能量变化分解为参数贡献、带符号交互与数值观测缺陷；采用正仿射阻塞保留行常数面上的重启，并用增广AdamW状态提供完整动力学描述；提出预测重整化，作用于单次遍历不同语料目标块的完整条件训练律，保留优化器记忆、剩余数据、调度与数值策略；引入有限总体协方差、匹配物理时钟、矩阵通量与带符号时间能量连接行动力学与模型级观测；区分绝对行坍缩、相对行集中、算子稳定化与预测精度；自主约简要求闭合性，近似约简携带后继与发射误差；辅以证明、形式化检验与紧凑数值实验，包括独立单次遍历族的移动有限涨落区域分析。
AI.result: 实验揭示模型行为对观测者与优化器的依赖性；所检验的自主行状态候选被否定；有限条件预测与状态特定算子约简获得支持；独立单次遍历族呈现移动的有限涨落区域，但未能确立热力学临界类；条件对称性、头极限、协方差流与读出误差预算给出了缩放律向推理迁移所需的假设。
AI.conclusion: 该理论将精确恒等式、条件性动力学断言与有限实证发现严格分层，为PLDR-LLM的训练—推理解析提供了统一框架。其核心结论是：自主约简需闭合条件，缩放律迁移需显式假设；有限条件预测与状态特定算子约简可行，但经典临界类结论在当前证据下不成立。

title: PrefLUT: Reusable and Refinable Personalized Color Editing from Pairwise Preferences
summary: Photographic color editing is inherently personal: the same image can appear too warm, too muted, or already satisfactory to different users. Most lookup table (LUT) and reference-guided methods target a specified appearance rather than model persistent preferences from repeated user choices. To address this gap, we introduce PrefLUT, a reusable and refinable user-preference modeling framework for deployable 3D LUTs, encoding ordered preferred/non-preferred image pairs into a lightweight Reusable User Profile that is reused across queries and refined using additional user preference pairs, without per-user optimization. A Query-Conditioned LUT Predictor combines this profile with each image to predict a LUT latent vector and edit strength. An Identity-Residual LUT Decoder and Edit-Strength Controller then produce an exportable 3D LUT. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate effective personalized editing and general-purpose enhancement. Each quantized profile requires only 260 bytes, and editing takes 1.365 ms/image on an RTX 5090 GPU. We also introduce the Preference-Conditioning Verification Protocol (PCVP), an evaluation protocol to verify whether personalized image edits depend on user preferences and the query image through controlled changes to user profiles, preference orders, pair correspondences, and query images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PrefLUT，一种可复用、可细化的用户偏好建模框架，将有序偏好/非偏好图像对编码为轻量级可复用用户画像，并结合查询条件化 LUT 预测器生成可导出的 3D LUT，实现个性化照片调色。
AI.motivation: 照片色彩编辑具有高度个人化特征：同一张图像对不同的用户而言，可能显得偏暖、偏灰，或已足够满意。现有 LUT 和参考引导方法大多针对某一指定外观，而非从用户反复选择中建模其持续性偏好，因此难以实现真正的个性化。为填补这一空白，本文提出 PrefLUT。
AI.method: PrefLUT 将有序的偏好/非偏好图像对编码为轻量级可复用用户画像，该画像可在不同查询间复用，并可通过新增偏好对进一步细化，无需按用户逐一优化。框架包含三部分：（1）查询条件化 LUT 预测器，将用户画像与输入图像结合，预测 LUT 隐向量与编辑强度；（2）身份残差 LUT 解码器；（3）编辑强度控制器，最终生成可导出的 3D LUT。此外，作者提出偏好条件化验证协议（PCVP），通过控制改变用户画像、偏好顺序、配对对应关系和查询图像，验证个性化编辑是否确实依赖于用户偏好与查询图像。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法能有效实现个性化编辑，同时具备通用增强能力。量化后的用户画像仅需 260 字节，在 RTX 5090 GPU 上编辑耗时 1.365 ms/图像。PCVP 协议进一步验证了个性化编辑对用户偏好和查询图像的依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: PrefLUT 通过可复用、可细化的用户画像与查询条件化 3D LUT 生成，实现了轻量、可部署且无需逐用户优化的个性化照片调色，并配以 PCVP 验证协议，为个性化图像编辑的评估提供了可控手段。

title: Word Similarity Datasets for Indian Languages: Annotation and Baseline Systems
summary: With the advent of word representations, word similarity tasks are becoming increasing popular as an evaluation metric for the quality of the representations. In this paper, we present manually annotated monolingual word similarity datasets of six Indian languages - Urdu, Telugu, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil and Gujarati. These languages are most spoken Indian languages worldwide after Hindi and Bengali. For the construction of these datasets, our approach relies on translation and re-annotation of word similarity datasets of English. We also present baseline scores for word representation models using state-of-the-art techniques for Urdu, Telugu and Marathi by evaluating them on newly created word similarity datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了乌尔都语、泰卢固语、马拉地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语和古吉拉特语六种印度语言的人工标注单语词相似度数据集，并对部分语言给出词表示模型的基线评分。
AI.motivation: 随着词表示的发展，词相似度任务日益成为评估词表示质量的重要指标，但印度语言缺乏此类人工标注数据集。
AI.method: 基于英语词相似度数据集，通过翻译与重新标注的方式构建六种印度语言的单语词相似度数据集；并在新数据集上以先进技术评估乌尔都语、泰卢固语和马拉地语的词表示模型。
AI.result: 构建了六种印度语言（乌尔都语、泰卢固语、马拉地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语、古吉拉特语）的人工标注词相似度数据集，并给出乌尔都语、泰卢固语和马拉地语词表示模型的基线评分。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为六种使用人口众多的印度语言提供了词相似度评估资源，并为其中三种语言建立了词表示模型的基线。

title: Analytical and Convolutional Neural Network-Based Motion-Vector Propagation for Efficient Video Object Detection
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, This work has been submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: Continuous video analytics requires accurate localization at low latency within embedded power budgets. This paper presents a hardware-software design methodology that reuses codec motion vectors (MVs) between detector invocations. Two alternative models support translation and scale changes: analytical motion-vector propagation (Analytical-MV) and learned propagation using a convolutional neural network (CNN) (CNN-MV). The learned model uses convolutional operations and independent object updates suited to parallel execution on an edge graphics processing unit (GPU). Analytical-MV combines a harmonic-mean precision-recall score (F1) of 0.909 with a mean end-to-end latency of 9.03 ms and an energy consumption of 0.177 J per frame, yielding the lowest latency and energy among the evaluated configurations. Relative to detection on every frame, it reduces mean latency by 25.9% and energy per frame by 36.4%. CNN-MV offers a different trade-off: its fastest configuration raises recall from 0.871 for Analytical-MV to 0.890 and lowers mean power from 19.64 to 17.32 W, while achieving a latency of 18.42 ms and an energy consumption of 0.319 J per frame. It is therefore useful when recall or operating power is more important than minimum latency and energy. Execution on a deep learning accelerator (DLA) further reduces time-averaged GPU utilization relative to GPU execution. Host-processing optimization substantially improves both latency and energy, demonstrating the value of jointly designing temporal models and their execution pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种硬件-软件协同设计方法，通过在检测器调用之间复用编解码器运动矢量（MV）实现低延迟、低功耗的连续视频分析，包含解析式MV传播（Analytical-MV）与学习式MV传播（CNN-MV）两种模型。
AI.motivation: 连续视频分析在嵌入式功耗预算下需要低延迟的准确定位，而逐帧检测开销大，因此需要利用帧间冗余（如编解码器运动矢量）来降低检测频率与计算成本。
AI.method: 在检测器调用之间复用编解码器运动矢量，提出两种支持平移与尺度变化的传播模型：Analytical-MV（解析式运动矢量传播）和CNN-MV（基于卷积神经网络的学得传播）。CNN-MV采用卷积操作与独立目标更新，适合边缘GPU并行执行；并对执行流水线（含DLA与主机处理）进行优化。
AI.result: Analytical-MV取得F1为0.909、平均端到端延迟9.03 ms、每帧能耗0.177 J，为所评估配置中延迟与能耗最低；相比逐帧检测，平均延迟降低25.9%，每帧能耗降低36.4%。CNN-MV最快配置将召回率从0.871（Analytical-MV）提升至0.890，平均功耗从19.64 W降至17.32 W，延迟18.42 ms、每帧能耗0.319 J。在DLA上执行可进一步降低时间平均GPU利用率。
AI.conclusion: 两种模型提供不同权衡：Analytical-MV适合追求最低延迟与能耗的场景，CNN-MV适合更看重召回率或运行功耗的场景；主机处理优化显著改善延迟与能耗，表明联合设计时序模型及其执行流水线具有重要价值。

title: Beyond Geometry: Benchmarking and Consistency Reasoning for 3D Logical Anomaly Detection
summary: Existing 3D industrial anomaly detection mainly targets local geometric deviations. In contrast, many industrial anomalies violate object-level design or assembly rules, which we define as 3D logical anomalies. To address these challenges, we introduce the Industrial Logical Anomaly Detection Dataset (ILGAD), the first scalable benchmark dedicated to logical anomalies in industrial point clouds. ILGAD contains 2,774 samples from 15 categories with point-level annotations and covers existence, specification, pose, and assembly-state errors. To detect such 3D logical anomalies, we propose a consistency reasoning framework that assesses whether local geometry, structure coverage, and spatial relations conform to the normal design. The framework detects geometric changes, unsupported expected structures, and abnormal local arrangements. Experiments on ILGAD, Anomaly-ShapeNet, and IEC3D demonstrate superior object-level detection and point-level localization, showing that the framework effectively detects logical anomalies and generalizes to conventional geometric defects.

AI.tldr: 论文提出3D逻辑异常概念，构建首个面向工业点云逻辑异常的可扩展基准ILGAD（15类、2774样本、点级标注，覆盖存在性、规格、位姿、装配状态错误），并提出一致性推理框架，通过几何、结构覆盖与空间关系一致性检测逻辑异常，在ILGAD、Anomaly-ShapeNet、IEC3D上取得优异的对象级检测与点级定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3D工业异常检测主要针对局部几何偏差，而许多工业异常实际违反对象级设计或装配规则（即3D逻辑异常），此类异常缺乏专门的数据基准与检测方法，导致现有方法难以覆盖。
AI.method: 构建ILGAD数据集（含点级标注，涵盖存在性、规格、位姿、装配状态四类逻辑错误）；提出一致性推理框架，评估局部几何、结构覆盖与空间关系是否符合正常设计，具体检测几何变化、缺失的应有结构以及异常局部排布。
AI.result: 在ILGAD、Anomaly-ShapeNet与IEC3D上实验表明，该方法在对象级检测与点级定位上均优于对比方法，既能有效检测逻辑异常，也能泛化到传统几何缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 3D逻辑异常是一类此前被忽视的重要工业异常，专用基准与一致性推理框架可有效弥补现有局部几何偏差检测的不足，并具备向常规几何异常泛化的能力。

title: CAST: Reconstruction-Coupled Acceleration of Interactive World Models
summary: Interactive world models must respond quickly to controls while preserving scene consistency. Existing acceleration methods can miss heterogeneous control responses and spatial transport when recovering skipped features. We observe that interaction-induced feature changes correlate with approximation error, while low-frequency interpolation errors are phase-sensitive and show more predictable phase progression. These findings motivate CAST, a reconstruction-coupled inference framework. CAST selects anchors by interaction sensitivity and cross-layer coverage, reconstructs skipped residuals with frequency- and confidence-aware Phase-Aware Reconstruction (PAR), and coordinates historical KV routing according to downstream reconstruction responsibility. On Matrix-Game 3.0 and HY-World 1.5, CAST achieves 2.15x and 3.48x speedups, respectively, while maintaining visual quality close to Native (Figure 1). It also attains the highest VBench scores among compared methods and leads non-native baselines on seven and six of thirteen WorldMark dimensions, demonstrating a balance of generation speed, visual quality, and interactive responsiveness under real-time control. Code is available at https://github.com/lokiniuniu/CAST.

AI.tldr: CAST：一种与重建耦合的推理加速框架，依据交互敏感度与跨层覆盖选取锚点，用频域-置信度感知的相位重建恢复被跳过的残差，并按下游重建责任协调历史KV路由，在保持视觉质量的同时实现实时交互。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型需在保持场景一致性的同时快速响应控制信号。现有加速方法在恢复被跳过的特征时，容易忽略异质的控制响应以及空间上的传输关系，导致加速后质量与交互响应性受损。
AI.method: 作者观察到两点：交互引起的特征变化与近似误差相关；低频插值误差对相位敏感，且其相位演进更可预测。基于此提出CAST：1）按交互敏感度与跨层覆盖度选取锚点；2）用频域与置信度感知的相位重建（PAR）恢复被跳过的残差；3）依据下游重建责任对历史KV进行路由协调。
AI.result: 在Matrix-Game 3.0与HY-World 1.5上分别取得2.15倍与3.48倍加速，视觉质量接近Native（图1）；在对比方法中取得最高VBench分数；在WorldMark的13个维度中分别有7个和6个维度领先非Native基线。
AI.conclusion: CAST证明可利用交互敏感性与相位演进规律来指导特征重建与KV路由，从而在实时控制下兼顾生成速度、视觉质量与交互响应性。代码已开源。

title: Geometric Encoding for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are far more reliable at recognizing what appears in a video than at reasoning about its spatial and temporal properties, such as metric distances, object dimensions, and consistent object identities across frames. We present Geometric Code, a perception-to-geometry pipeline that computes explicit spatial structure from video and supplies it to VLMs as context to augment reasoning. A perception layer segments and classifies objects and recovers depth, camera pose, and intrinsics from monocular RGB video. A deterministic geometric engine then back-projects, merges, and cleans these outputs into a spatial code, including per-object positions, dimensions, counts, inter-object distances, appearance order, and room geometry. The code is serialized into VLMs' prompts, either alongside the video or replacing it entirely. Specifically, there is no component trained or fine-tuned in our approach. On VSI-Bench, augmenting 2B and 4B open models with the spatial code improves average accuracy by +4.1 points over the frames-only baseline, with the largest gains on numeric estimation tasks such as absolute distance (+24.1 points). The results suggest that explicitly computed geometry, delivered through the language channel, recovers spatial competence that small VLMs cannot extract from pixels alone.

AI.tldr: 提出 Geometric Code，一条"感知到几何"的免训练流水线：从单目 RGB 视频恢复显式空间结构（物体位姿、尺寸、计数、间距、出现顺序、房间几何），序列化为文本提示注入视觉语言模型（VLM），在 VSI-Bench 上显著提升空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型擅长识别视频中"有什么"，但在空间与时间属性推理上表现很差，例如度量距离、物体尺寸以及跨帧一致的目标身份。这类几何与度量信息难以从像素中直接可靠提取。
AI.method: 采用两阶段、无训练的感知到几何流水线。感知层对单目 RGB 视频做目标分割与分类，并恢复深度、相机位姿与内参；随后由确定性几何引擎对上述输出进行反投影、融合与清洗，生成显式空间代码，包含逐物体位置、尺寸、计数、物体间距离、出现顺序及房间几何。该代码序列化后写入 VLM 提示词，可与视频并列输入或完全替代视频。整条流水线不含任何训练或微调组件。
AI.result: 在 VSI-Bench 上，为 2B 与 4B 开源模型注入空间代码后，平均准确率较仅用帧的基线提升 +4.1 个点；在数值估计类任务上增益最大，例如绝对距离任务提升 +24.1 个点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过语言通道传递显式计算得到的几何信息，能够恢复小规模 VLM 无法仅由像素获得的空间能力，为提升 VLM 空间推理提供了一条免训练、模型无关的有效路径。

title: Functional Hand Type Prior for 3D Hand Pose Estimation and Action Recognition from Egocentric View Monocular Videos
summary: Current methods for egocentric view action recognition often face challenges in perceiving dynamic hand movements relying solely on geometrical or physical information. In this work, we effectively address this problem by gaining insights into the correlation between functional hand configurations and objects, which improves the detailed interpretation of real-world scenarios. To this end, we introduce a practical taxonomy of hand types based on the functioning perspective and utilize it for per-frame hand type labeling on existing datasets. We also propose a novel hand action recognition framework considering semantic details of the hand type as prior. This approach boosts the network's understanding of the continuous hand interaction throughout the action sequence. Our whole pipeline consists of three main modules: (1) Feature Extraction, (2) Egocentric Knowledge Module, which estimates 3D hand pose, object category, and hand type leveraging short-term cues, and (2) Egocentric Action Module, which aggregates per-frame knowledge, including text embeddings of hand type, over a longer time. In our extensive experiments with large-scale benchmarks, FPHA and H2O, our model outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating its superior performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对第一人称视角动作识别中仅依赖几何或物理信息难以感知动态手部动作的问题，提出基于功能性手部配置与物体关联的手型分类体系，并构建融合手型语义先验的识别框架，在FPHA和H2O基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有第一人称视角动作识别方法仅依赖几何或物理信息，难以感知动态手部运动；通过理解功能性手部配置与物体之间的关联，可提升对真实场景的细粒度解读能力。
AI.method: 整套流程包含三个模块：（1）特征提取；（2）Egocentric Knowledge Module，利用短时线索估计3D手部姿态、物体类别与手型；（3）Egocentric Action Module，在较长时间跨度上聚合逐帧知识，包括手型的文本嵌入。同时提出基于功能视角的实用手型分类体系，并对现有数据集进行逐帧手型标注，将手型语义细节作为先验融入识别网络。
AI.result: 在FPHA和H2O两个大规模基准上的大量实验表明，该模型优于当前最先进方法，展现出更优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: 引入手型语义先验及功能性手型分类，有助于网络理解动作序列中连续的手部交互，为第一人称动作识别提供了有效的新思路。

title: Quantitative Measurement of Language Distance among Closely Related Indo-European Languages Using Pretrained Language Models: A Case Study on the North Germanic Branch
summary: Among closely related North Germanic languages, the quantification of language distance has traditionally relied on qualitative methods, lacking a unified multi-dimensional computational framework. Multilingual pretrained models based on the Transformer architecture can map texts from different languages into a shared vector space, enabling quantitative measurement of language distance. This paper focuses on the three North Germanic languages---Danish, Norwegian (Bokmål), and Swedish---and proposes a three-metric quantitative framework based on pretrained language models: (1)~sentence-level semantic distance, computed as cosine similarity between LaBSE and mBERT encodings of parallel sentences; (2)~orthographic fragmentation rate, measuring subword tokenization efficiency when cross-applying monolingual BERT vocabularies to parallel texts; (3)~MLM predictability, comparing prediction confidence and entropy in masked language modeling using mBERT across languages. Using 150 trilingual parallel sentence triplets from the Tatoeba corpus as controlled samples, we obtain consistent distance rankings on two independent models: LaBSE: da--no $0.012 < $ no--sv $0.016 < $ da--sv $0.020$; mBERT: da--no $0.016 < $ no--sv $0.045 \approx $ da--sv $0.046$. This ranking is consistent with the historical linguistic conclusion that ``400 years of Danish rule over Norway (1380--1814) led to highly cognate written languages.'' The three metrics---semantic, orthographic, and predictability---converge on the same conclusion, providing a reproducible computational framework for the quantitative study of distance among closely related languages, extensible in principle to more branches of the Indo-European language family, pending validation on additional language groups.

AI.tldr: 本文基于预训练多语模型，提出语义距离、正字法碎片化率与MLM可预测性三维框架，量化丹麦语、挪威语（书面语）与瑞典语的语言距离，得到 da–no < no–sv < da–sv 的一致排序，与历史语言学结论吻合。
AI.motivation: 北日耳曼语支语言间距离研究长期依赖定性方法，缺乏统一的多维计算框架，因此需要可复现的量化手段。
AI.method: 以LaBSE与mBERT对平行句编码计算余弦相似度得句级语义距离；交叉应用单语BERT词表统计平行文本的子词切分效率，得正字法碎片化率；用mBERT做掩码语言建模，比较跨语言的预测置信度与熵。样本为Tatoeba中150组三语平行句三元组。
AI.result: 两个独立模型给出一致的距离排序。LaBSE：da–no 0.012 < no–sv 0.016 < da–sv 0.020；mBERT：da–no 0.016 < no–sv 0.045 ≈ da–sv 0.046。
AI.conclusion: 语义、正字法、可预测性三类指标收敛于同一结论，与“丹麦对挪威的长期统治导致书面语高度同源”的历史语言学判断一致；该框架可复现，原则上可扩展到印欧语系其他语支，但仍需在更多语群上验证。

title: Toward a Graded Measure of Belief Stability in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people access and reason with information, yet factual reliability is usually evaluated one judgment at a time. We introduce graded belief stability, a relational measure of how well a belief persists within an LLM's broader belief system. Unlike individual belief probability, it asks whether support for a claim persists when that claim is considered alongside the model's other epistemic commitments. We operationalize this idea with a Direct Conditional estimator that uses internal model representations to estimate conditional belief probabilities. Across 12 LLMs and three domains, lower-stability beliefs exhibit greater mean behavioral movement under conversational challenge in 83.3% of model-domain settings after matching on individual belief probability. Graded belief stability therefore extends reliability assessment beyond how strongly an LLM supports a claim to how robustly that belief is supported within its broader system of beliefs.

AI.tldr: 提出"分级信念稳定性"（graded belief stability），一种衡量LLM信念在其整体信念体系中能否持续存在的关系性指标，并用直接条件估计器（Direct Conditional estimator）加以量化。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM事实可靠性评估通常逐条判断，仅关注模型对单一主张的支持强度，忽视了该信念能否与模型其他认知承诺共存，因此评估维度不完整。
AI.method: 以关系性度量定义分级信念稳定性：不测量单个信念概率，而考察某主张与其模型其他认知承诺并置时支持是否持续；通过Direct Conditional estimator，利用模型内部表示估计条件信念概率；在12个LLM、三个领域进行实验，并在匹配个体信念概率的条件下，检验稳定性与对话挑战下行为变化的关系。
AI.result: 低稳定性信念在83.3%的模型—领域设置中，于对话挑战下表现出更大的平均行为位移（在匹配个体信念概率后仍然成立）。
AI.conclusion: 分级信念稳定性将可靠性评估从"模型对该主张支持多强"拓展到"该信念在其整体信念体系中受支持多稳固"，为LLM事实可靠性提供了体系层面的新评估维度。

title: WorldGraph: Graph-Native World Modeling
summary: World models infer latent states of an environment to capture its underlying dynamics and predict future evolution. Many real-world environments, however, are inherently relational and observed as evolving graphs, where entities, relations, and their properties change over time. Prior graph-related world models use graph structures to organize internal states or support task-specific reasoning, rather than treating an evolving graph itself as the modeled world. We instead study graph world modeling (GWM), where graph evolution itself constitutes the world dynamics. We formulate graph world modeling over observed graph evolution, latent graph states, and heterogeneous graph-transition predictions. Based on this formulation, we construct GWM-Zero, a benchmark covering node-, edge-, and graph-level transitions over eight temporal graph datasets. We propose WorldGraph, which combines a state-aware graph transformer for multi-granularity structural and transition-conditioned evolution modeling with transition-aware GRPO using dynamic grouping and structure-aware verifiable rewards. Extensive experiments on GWM-Zero show that WorldGraph consistently outperforms representative graph representation, temporal graph learning, graph pretraining, and graph world-model baselines across all three transition granularities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"图世界建模"(GWM)新范式，将演化图本身视为被建模的世界；构建GWM-Zero基准并提出WorldGraph模型，在三种转移粒度上全面超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有图相关世界模型只是用图结构组织内部状态或支持特定任务推理，而非把演化图当作被建模的世界本身。然而许多真实环境本质上是关系型的，并表现为实体、关系及其属性随时间变化的演化图，因此需要重新定义建模范式。
AI.method: 作者将GWM形式化为对观测图演化、潜在图状态与异构图转移预测的建模；据此构建GWM-Zero基准，覆盖8个时序图数据集上的节点级、边级和图级转移；并提出WorldGraph模型，结合状态感知图Transformer（进行多粒度结构与转移条件演化建模）与转移感知GRPO（动态分组与结构感知可验证奖励）。
AI.result: 在GWM-Zero上的大量实验表明，WorldGraph在节点级、边级、图级三种转移粒度上均稳定优于代表性的图表示学习、时序图学习、图预训练及图世界模型基线。
AI.conclusion: 将演化图直接作为被建模世界的GWM范式是可行且有效的，WorldGraph与GWM-Zero为后续图世界建模研究提供了统一的建模框架、评测基准与强基线。

title: Natural Image Autoencoder-Based fMRI Representations for Trait and State Prediction
summary: Foundation models pre-trained on large-scale fMRI datasets have shown strong downstream performance, but at substantial data and computation cost. To investigate how much fMRI-specific pre-training is actually needed for such performance, we introduce FReD, which derives fMRI representations from a frozen Deep Compression AutoEncoder (DCAE) pre-trained exclusively on natural images and pairs them with a task specific readout. For trait prediction, FReD summarizes frame-wise representations by their temporal mean and log-standard deviation and applies linear probing, with late fusion across two normalization schemes. For state prediction, it represents each frame as a single token and models temporal dependencies with a shallow Transformer. Across four resting-state datasets spanning six trait-prediction targets, linear probes on frozen DCAE features generally outperform those on fMRI foundation model representations and remain competitive with fully fine-tuned fMRI foundation models. On three task-fMRI state-prediction tasks, a temporal readout on DCAE features performs comparably to the strongest foundation models evaluated. A Gaussian injection analysis further shows that localized signal changes are recovered more accurately from the frozen DCAE features than from the evaluated foundation-model representations. Together, these results show that strong performance on current fMRI benchmarks is possible without fMRI-specific representation pre-training, making frozen natural-image features as a useful baseline for assessing its added value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FReD，利用仅在自然图像上预训练的冻结 DCAE 提取 fMRI 表征，不做 fMRI 专属预训练，在下游任务上反而优于或媲美 fMRI 基础模型。
AI.motivation: fMRI 基础模型虽下游表现强，但预训练代价高昂；作者质疑 fMRI 专属预训练的增益究竟有多大，探索能否用自然图像预训练特征替代。
AI.method: 基于冻结的图像预训练 DCAE 提取 fMRI 表征：特质预测用帧级表征的时序均值与对数标准差汇总并线性探测，两种归一化方案做后融合；状态预测将每帧表示为单 token，用浅层 Transformer 建模时序依赖。
AI.result: 在 4 个静息态数据集、6 个特质预测目标上，冻结 DCAE 特征的线性探测普遍优于 fMRI 基础模型表征，并与全微调 fMRI 基础模型相当；在 3 个任务态状态预测任务上表现与最强基础模型比肩；高斯注入分析显示其恢复局部信号变化更准确。
AI.conclusion: 当前 fMRI 基准的强性能并不依赖 fMRI 专属表征预训练；冻结自然图像特征可作为评估 fMRI 预训练附加价值的有效基线。

title: AGILE-GS: Anchor-Guided Fast Next-Best-View Selection for Active 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Radiance fields need hundreds of views, and their placement matters as much as their number. Next-best-view (NBV) selection for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) usually scores every candidate in the pool and keeps one. Searching for information and choosing a camera, however, are separable problems. We present AGILE-GS, an anchor-guided NBV method that separates the two. A virtual anchor pose is optimized on SE(3) by Riemannian gradient ascent on expected information gain. It need not be reachable or in the pool; it marks where the model is most uncertain. Candidates are scored against the anchor's viewing geometry, and a greedy ridge-leverage step distills the pool into a small, non-redundant shortlist without rendering any candidate. The shortlist can be used in two ways. AGILE-GS takes the first view on it as the next view, so no Fisher information is computed for any candidate. AGILE-GS+ computes the Fisher information gain of each shortlisted view and picks the best, so the expensive evaluation runs on a handful of views rather than the whole pool. On standard benchmarks and in closed-loop embodied acquisition, both match or exceed existing baselines while cutting selection latency by one to two orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 提出AGILE-GS，将"搜索信息"与"选择相机"解耦：先在SE(3)上优化虚拟锚点姿态（基于期望信息增益的黎曼梯度上升），再用贪心岭杠杆将候选池蒸馏为非冗余短名单，避免渲染候选。AGILE-GS直接取短名单首视图；AGILE-GS+仅对少量短名单视图计算Fisher信息增益选最优。在标准基准与闭环具身采集中匹配或超越基线，选择延迟降低1–2个数量级。
AI.motivation: 辐射场重建需要数百个视角，且视角的布局与数量同等重要。现有3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的下一最佳视角（NBV）选择方法通常对候选池中每个候选逐一无差别打分并保留一个，代价高昂且将"信息搜索"与"相机选择"混为一体。本文认为二者是可分离的子问题，据此设计高效方法以降低选择延迟。
AI.method: 1) 在SE(3)上以期望信息增益为目标，用黎曼梯度上升优化一个虚拟锚点姿态；该锚点无需可达或属于候选池，仅表征模型不确定性最高的观看几何。2) 候选视角针对锚点的观看几何进行打分，并通过贪心岭杠杆（greedy ridge-leverage）步骤将候选池蒸馏为规模小、非冗余的短名单，过程中不渲染任何候选。3) 两种使用方式：AGILE-GS取短名单首个视图作为下一视角，不计算任何候选的Fisher信息；AGILE-GS+仅对短名单中的少量视图计算Fisher信息增益并选最优，将昂贵评估限制在少数视角上。
AI.result: 在标准基准与闭环具身采集任务中，AGILE-GS与AGILE-GS+均匹配或超越现有基线方法，同时将选择延迟降低一至两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 将NBV中的信息搜索与相机选择解耦是有效且高效的设计：通过锚点引导的几何打分与非冗余短名单筛选，可在几乎不损失重建/选择质量的前提下大幅削减昂贵评估的候选数量，显著降低选择延迟，兼顾精度与效率。

title: Enhanced Video Text Editing with Trajectory-Aligned Glyph Rendering
summary: Video text editing aims to replace or add text in a video while keeping the rest of the video unchanged, which requires the edited text to be correct in every frame and to move coherently with the scene. Despite the remarkable progress of video diffusion models, they struggle to reproduce exact stroke structures and often produce garbled or wrong characters, especially for characters with complex strokes. To address this, we propose a trajectory-aligned glyph rendering reference that provides explicit per-frame glyph guidance following the position and perspective of the text, and a depth-normalized recognizer feature supervision that supervises the generated text on multi-depth features of a frozen text recognizer with per-depth normalized errors, targeting stroke errors overlooked by the diffusion loss. We further build VTEdit, a benchmark of 288 real-scene clips with 440 annotated text trajectories covering text replacement and text addition, which will be publicly released to facilitate future research. Experiments on VTEdit show that our method outperforms image text editing methods, video editing methods, and commercial models in text accuracy and background preservation, achieving a sentence accuracy of 0.9408, and receives the highest preference in a user study.

AI.tldr: 提出轨迹对齐字形渲染参考与深度归一化识别器特征监督，解决视频文本编辑中笔画结构失真问题，并构建VTEdit基准，实现0.9408句准确率。
AI.motivation: 视频文本编辑要求每帧文字正确且随场景一致运动。现有视频扩散模型难以复现精确笔画结构，复杂笔画字符常出现乱码或错字。
AI.method: 一、轨迹对齐字形渲染参考：按文本位置与透视提供逐帧显式字形引导；二、深度归一化识别器特征监督：以冻结文本识别器的多深度特征、按深度归一化误差监督生成文本，针对扩散损失忽略的笔画错误。
AI.result: 构建VTEdit基准：288个真实场景片段、440条标注文本轨迹，涵盖文本替换与添加。实验显示在文本准确性与背景保持上优于图像文本编辑方法、视频编辑方法及商用模型，句准确率达0.9408，用户研究获最高偏好。
AI.conclusion: 显式字形引导结合识别器特征监督可有效提升视频文本编辑的笔画保真度；VTEdit基准将公开以促进后续研究。

title: RAGWarrant: Evidence-Preserving Governance for RAG Policy Promotion Under Quality, Cost, Latency, and Risk Constraints
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Preprint v0.1.1-rc1. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/RAGWarrant/ragwarrant-governance
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation systems are extensively instrumented with metrics, benchmarks, traces, and automated judges, but these tools do not decide whether a proposed policy change is safe to release. We present RAGWarrant, an open-source promotion-control framework that treats deployment as a constrained evidence decision rather than a leaderboard choice. RAGWarrant normalizes evaluator outputs and operational telemetry, applies predeclared quality and hard-risk gates, assigns evidence-class claim ceilings, preserves negative outcomes, and emits auditable PROMOTE, BLOCK, REJECT, or INCONCLUSIVE decisions. We evaluate the framework across T2-RAGBench, MultiHop-RAG, CRAG, HotpotQA, synthetic reproduction, and bounded local generative experiments. On HotpotQA, operational savings were blocked because answer quality fell beyond the declared margin. A bounded CRAG study selected a lower-cost quality-tied policy, but related generative gains were unstable and a held-out guardrail failed closed. We claim an auditable promotion-control abstraction, not optimizer superiority, human validation, or production readiness. The tagged artifact reproduces from a fresh clone, runs as a hardened Docker job, accepts external evaluator exports, and verifies artifact integrity.

AI.tldr: RAGWarrant是一个开源的上线管控框架，将RAG部署视为受约束的证据决策而非排行榜选择：它归一化评估器输出与运维遥测，施加预声明的质量与硬性风险门控，赋予证据等级声明上限，保留负面结果，并输出可审计的PROMOTE/BLOCK/REJECT/INCONCLUSIVE决策。
AI.motivation: RAG系统虽配备大量指标、基准、trace和自动评判器，但这些工具无法判断某项策略变更是否可安全发布，缺少可审计、受约束的发布决策机制。
AI.method: RAGWarrant将部署建模为受约束的证据决策：归一化评估器输出与运维遥测；应用预声明的质量门与硬性风险门；按证据等级设定声明上限；保留负面结果；生成可审计的四类决策（PROMOTE、BLOCK、REJECT、INCONCLUSIVE）。评估覆盖T2-RAGBench、MultiHop-RAG、CRAG、HotpotQA、合成复现及有界本地生成实验。
AI.result: HotpotQA上因答案质量下降超出声明容差，运维节省方案被阻止；有界CRAG研究选中了成本更低且质量持平策略，但相关生成增益不稳定，且留出集防护机制以失败关闭（fail closed）方式触发。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张的贡献是可审计的上线管控抽象，而非优化器优越性、人工验证或生产就绪性。带标签的工件可从全新克隆复现，作为加固Docker任务运行，支持外部评估器导出，并可验证工件完整性。

title: Decision Readouts for Text-Mediated Video Anomaly Detection: An Exploratory Evaluation of Jev and Qwen
summary: How much does the decision readout matter when video-derived textual evidence is held fixed? We evaluate Jev typed decisions and three Qwen readouts on a sparse development sample of 40 videos and 400 target anchors from UCF-Crime and XD-Violence, each presented as a summary and ordered captions. Each dataset contributes 20 source groups and 200 anchors, including only 10 and 37 positives, respectively. The original five-backend pilot requested 4,000 predictions; Jev Choice returned 776 valid responses out of 800 under the study's strict numerical policy, blocking its full-coverage quality comparison. On XD captions, Jev Noul achieved 75.99% average precision versus 48.47% for Qwen generated probability and 57.81% for the stronger local ordinal-likelihood expectation. The latter paired difference was 18.18 percentage points (95% source-group bootstrap interval 5.53-31.50). UCF did not show a corresponding advantage: caption ROC-AUC was 52.26% for Noul and 65.95% for ordinal likelihood. Both probability readouts had higher, hence worse, UCF Brier scores than the evaluation-prevalence reference of 0.0475. We additionally audit historical LAVAD scores at exactly matched anchors and distinguish response structure from numerical consistency. A binary-likelihood control is missing. These exploratory offline results characterize ranking, probability quality and interface failures; they establish neither a causal typed-interface benefit nor general superiority, calibration or end-to-end acceleration.

AI.tldr: 在固定视频文本证据条件下，比较Jev类型化决策与三种Qwen读出接口的排序与概率质量，结果仅具探索性。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在回答"当视频衍生的文本证据固定时，决策读出方式本身有多重要"，即区分接口/读出设计的影响与证据提取的影响，并检验类型化接口是否带来收益。
AI.method: 在UCF-Crime与XD-Violence上构建稀疏开发样本：各40视频、400目标锚点（每数据集20个源组、200个锚点，分别含10与37个正例），以摘要与有序字幕两种形式呈现。评估Jev类型化决策与三种Qwen读出；原五后端试点计划4,000次预测，Jev Choice在严格数值策略下仅返回800中776条有效响应。另在精确匹配锚点上审计历史LAVAD分数，并区分响应结构与数值一致性；缺少二值似然对照。
AI.result: XD字幕上，Jev Noul平均精度75.99%，高于Qwen生成概率48.47%与更强的局部序数似然期望57.81%，后者配对差18.18个百分点（95%源组自助区间5.53–31.50）。UCF无对应优势：Noul的ROC-AUC为52.26%，序数似然为65.95%；两者Brier分数均高于评估流行率参考值0.0475（即更差）。
AI.conclusion: 这些离线探索性结果刻画了排序、概率质量与接口失效，但既未确立类型化接口的因果收益，也未证明其普遍优越性、校准性或端到端加速。

title: CRF Loss is How Networks Should Learn Boundaries in Weakly Supervised Segmentation
summary: Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS) learns pixel-level predictions from image-level tags. Recent work focuses on improving coarse CAMs extracted from large vision-language models (commonly CLIP), but does little to improve their accuracy along segment boundaries. That job is instead delegated to a post-processing method like DenseCRF. However, because DenseCRF relies on low-level colour cues, it can flip correct labels to incorrect ones when neighbouring pixels share similar colours. SAM has recently been adopted as a natural alternative, yet it simply takes on DenseCRF's role as an intermediate "refinement" step that outputs one-hot pseudo-labels in prior work. By discarding the valuable uncertainty in CAMs, these one-hot pseudo-labels turn borderline errors into confidently wrong targets. Our key insight is that CAMs should supervise training alongside SAM boundaries, each through its own loss, rather than being fused together into a single hard target. Inspired by CRF potentials, we propose a framework that disentangles soft pseudo-labels as unary supervision and binary edge maps as pairwise supervision. We realize our framework in a single-stage model, DS-CRF, using CAMs from dino.txt and boundaries from SAM. DS-CRF sets a new state-of-the-art of 56.5% mIoU on MS COCO.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DS-CRF单阶段框架，将CAM软伪标签作为一元监督、SAM边界作为成对监督，避免硬标签融合导致的自信错误，在MS COCO上取得56.5% mIoU的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有WSSS方法多关注从大规模视觉语言模型（如CLIP）提取粗糙CAM，但未改善分割边界精度；边界处理依赖DenseCRF等后处理，而DenseCRF依赖低层颜色线索，在相邻像素颜色相近时会翻转正确标签。SAM虽被引入，但仅充当中继式"细化"步骤并输出one-hot伪标签，丢弃了CAM中的不确定性，使边缘性错误变成自信的错误目标。
AI.method: 核心思想：CAM应与SAM边界并行监督训练，各自使用独立损失，而非融合为单一硬目标。受CRF势函数启发，提出解耦框架，将软伪标签作为一元监督（unary supervision），将二值边缘图作为成对监督（pairwise supervision）。在单阶段模型DS-CRF中实现，使用dino.txt产生的CAM和SAM产生的边界。
AI.result: DS-CRF在MS COCO数据集上达到56.5% mIoU，创下新state-of-the-art。
AI.conclusion: 将CAM的软标签与SAM边界解耦为不同损失进行监督，优于将二者融合为硬伪标签的既有做法，验证了保留CAM不确定性的价值，并刷新了WSSS性能上限。

title: LLMs are not stochastic parrots: Evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction from conlang-like tasks
comment: Presented as a poster at ISC Summer School 2026; related work presented at IC2S2 2026; a synthesis of this project and related work presented at SLSA/ 4S 2026
summary: The strong version of the stochastic parrot argument claims that, although large language models (LLMs) may exceed rote regurgitation, they cannot move beyond statistical pattern matching into abstraction or reasoning, remaining ontologically near the lower bound of pattern reuse despite producing alluringly fluent text. We test this hypothesis using conlang-like tasks. Several LLMs are given only natural-language descriptions of fictional languages that subvert prominent superficial patterns in training data by combining statistically uncommon and unattested features. Crucially, no example outputs are given. We argue that if the models exhibit rule-following behaviour, they cannot be relying solely on superficial statistical patterns; such patterns often work against the correct output. Instead, successful performance requires representations of the constraints specified in the prompt. Across three complementary task families, models systematically move in the meaning-predicted direction: they distinguish prompt exposure from instructed use, alter semantic relationships in response to novel constraints, and sometimes produce exact matches to complex translation answer keys. Although performance varies across the spectrum of models used, these results provide evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction in LLMs and refute the strong stochastic parrot hypothesis. Our work shows that, under appropriate architectural and contextual constraints, statistical learning can produce meaning-mediated abstractions, although generation remains strongly constrained by superficial plausibility. We discuss implications for model development and for understanding how increasingly abstract representations may emerge from plausible-text-generation objectives.

AI.tldr: 通过虚构语言（conlang-like）任务检验"强随机鹦鹉假说"，发现LLM能依据提示中的意义约束进行规则遵循，而非仅依赖表层统计模式，为该假说提供了反驳证据。
AI.motivation: 强随机鹦鹉假说认为LLM虽能超越死记硬背，但无法进入抽象或推理层面，本质上仍停留在模式复用的下限。作者希望用实验直接检验这一本体论主张，探讨统计学习能否产生意义中介的抽象。
AI.method: 设计三类互补的虚构语言任务：仅提供自然语言描述的虚构语言规则，且刻意组合训练数据中罕见或未出现的特征，以颠覆表层统计模式；关键是不给出任何示例输出，迫使模型依赖提示中约束的表示而非模仿。
AI.result: 在三个任务族中模型系统性地朝"意义预测方向"移动：能区分"提示中出现的模式"与"被指示使用的模式"；能根据新约束改变语义关系；有时能精确匹配复杂的翻译参考答案。性能随模型谱系有所差异。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持LLM存在意义中介的抽象，反驳强随机鹦鹉假说；表明在适当的架构与上下文约束下，统计学习可产生意义中介的抽象，但生成仍强烈受表层合理性约束。研究对模型开发及理解抽象表征如何从"生成合理文本"目标中涌现具有启示。

title: MotionSpaceFlow: Representation-Aware Flow Matching in Direct Motion Space
summary: Recent advances in diffusion and flow models have substantially improved text-driven human motion generation. Yet most methods generate in low-dimensional, temporally downsampled latent spaces learned primarily for reconstruction, a bottleneck that can limit generation quality and preclude direct manipulation of individual frames and joints. We introduce MotionSpaceFlow (MSFlow), a representation-aware flow-matching framework that predicts clean motion directly in continuous motion space without a learned encoder or decoder. To account for the anisotropic structure of direct motion representations, we propose representation-aware noise scaling and show how the initial Gaussian source scale governs the covariance of intermediate probability-path marginals. We further introduce a Representation-Aware Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (RA-MMDiT), which jointly updates token-level language and full-resolution motion features through joint attention while adapting temporal information flow to the motion representation: causal attention for incremental features defined by frame-to-frame changes, and bidirectional attention for global features such as absolute joint coordinates. Across different datasets and motion representations, MSFlow achieves state-of-the-art text-to-motion performance. Its global representation variant additionally enables zero-shot, inference-time control over any joint or frame through projection sampling without control-conditioned training, delivering leading motion quality with exact constraint satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 提出 MotionSpaceFlow (MSFlow)，一种直接在连续运动空间进行流匹配的文本驱动人体运动生成框架，无需学习式编码器/解码器，配合表示感知噪声缩放与 RA-MMDiT 架构，实现 SOTA 性能并支持零样本关节/帧级控制。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散与流模型多在低维、时间下采样的隐空间生成，隐空间主要为重建而学习，构成瓶颈，限制生成质量，且无法直接对单帧或单关节进行操作与控制。
AI.method: 提出 MSFlow 表示感知流匹配框架，直接在连续运动空间预测干净运动，摒弃学习式编解码器；针对直接运动表示的异向结构（各向异性），设计表示感知噪声缩放，并分析初始高斯源尺度如何决定中间概率路径边缘分布的协方差；构建表示感知多模态扩散 Transformer (RA-MMDiT)，通过联合注意力同步更新 token 级语言特征与全分辨率运动特征，并按表示类型适配时序信息流：对帧间变化等增量特征采用因果注意力，对绝对关节坐标等全局特征采用双向注意力。
AI.result: 在不同数据集与运动表示上，MSFlow 均取得 SOTA 的文本到运动生成性能；其全局表示变体在无需控制条件训练的前提下，通过投影采样实现推理时的零样本任意关节或帧控制，在精确满足约束的同时保持领先的运动质量。
AI.conclusion: 直接在连续运动空间进行表示感知的流匹配建模，可突破隐空间瓶颈，兼顾生成质量与可控性，为文本驱动人体运动生成提供了无需编解码器、支持细粒度零样本控制的统一方案。

title: PainterBench: A Figural Divergent-Thinking Benchmark for Tool-Using Language Models
summary: Figural divergent thinking is the ability to develop a given shape fragment into an original drawing. In humans, this ability is assessed with incomplete-drawing tasks. We introduce PainterBench, a benchmark that ports the incomplete-drawing task to the agentic setting. The agent draws on a canvas through tool calls and observes the result after every turn. The canvas includes a starting shape which cannot be erased, and the agent's goal is to incorporate this shape into the most original drawing it can produce. The task is open-ended, and the agent itself decides when the drawing is finished. The benchmark tests incremental visual planning over a short horizon and the transfer of creative ability from pretraining to multi-turn tool use. We evaluate 14 multimodal language models from small to frontier scale. Across the primary study and six sensitivity analyses, we collect 2,700 drawings and crowdsource creativity and recognizability ratings for every drawing and for 300 human reference drawings. We also present ViDrA-adapted, an automated scorer that predicts human creativity ratings of agent drawings (r = 0.85 on random held-out test split). Figural divergent thinking varies widely across the 14 models, and GPT-6 Astra produces the most creative drawings. Relative to the human drawings, the agent drawings score higher in creativity but lower in recognizability. We release the final drawings, per-round canvas snapshots, tool call traces, stimulus bank, benchmark harness, crowdsourced ratings (N = 72,000), and ViDrA checkpoint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PainterBench 基准，将人类的不完整绘画任务迁移到智能体场景，用工具调用在含不可擦除起始形状的画布上创作最原创的图画，以评估多模态语言模型的图形发散思维能力。
AI.motivation: 图形发散思维（将给定形状片段发展为原创图画）在人类中通过不完整绘画任务评估，但缺乏面向智能体、多轮工具使用的评测基准；同时需要检验从预训练到多轮工具使用的创造力迁移以及短时程增量视觉规划能力。
AI.method: 构建 PainterBench：智能体通过工具调用在画布上绘画，每轮观察结果，画布含不可擦除的起始形状，任务开放式、由智能体自行决定何时结束。评测 14 个从小型到前沿规模的多模态语言模型；开展主实验与 6 项敏感性分析，共收集 2,700 幅智能体绘画及 300 幅人类参考绘画，并众包创造力与可识别性评分；同时提出自动评分器 ViDrA-adapted。
AI.result: 图形发散思维在 14 个模型间差异显著，GPT-6 Astra 的绘画最具创造力；ViDrA-adapted 在随机留出测试集上预测人类创造力评分达 r = 0.85；相较人类绘画，智能体绘画创造力更高但可识别性更低。
AI.conclusion: PainterBench 为智能体图形发散思维提供了可复现的评测框架，揭示了当前多模态模型在创造力与可识别性之间的权衡，并公开最终绘画、逐轮画布快照、工具调用轨迹、刺激库、基准框架、众包评分（N = 72,000）及 ViDrA 检查点。

title: ConvCue: Complementary Visual Inductive Biases for Vision-Language Models
summary: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance across a broad range of multimodal tasks, yet still struggle with visual questions that require fine-grained discrimination and spatial understanding. These limitations motivate investigating whether supplementary visual representations can improve existing VLMs without replacing their native visual encoders. Pretrained convolutional networks offer a candidate feature source, motivated by their local connectivity and spatial weight sharing. We introduce CONVCUE, which augments the native visual representations of a pretrained VLM with final-stage features from a parallel, frozen pretrained CNN. A learnable adapter maps convolutional features to the native visual feature dimension, while gated cross-attention allows the original visual tokens to retrieve information from the CNN features. The enhanced tokens are passed through the original visual-to-language projector, and the model is adapted through a two-stage training procedure. We evaluate CONVCUE on Qwen3-VL-2B, Qwen3-VL-4B, and LLaVA-OneVision-7B across 13 multimodal benchmarks covering visual question answering, document and chart understanding, and multimodal reasoning. CONVCUE improves average benchmark performance over both the original models and matched two-stage fine-tuning controls on all three backbones.
