On Qwen3-VL-4B, it improves over the original model on all 13 benchmarks and raises the average score from 75.00 to 78.82 relative to the matched fine-tuning control. These results show that pretrained convolutional representations, when integrated through learned adaptation and fusion, can improve the visual understanding of existing VLMs without replacing their original visual encoders.

AI.tldr: CONVCUE 通过冻结预训练 CNN 的末层特征，经可学习适配器与门控交叉注意力融合，增强 VLM 原生视觉表征，在不替换原视觉编码器的前提下提升细粒度与空间理解性能。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉语言模型在多模态任务上表现强劲，但在需要细粒度判别和空间理解的视觉问题上仍存在不足。作者希望探究能否通过补充视觉表征来改进现有 VLM，而非替换其原生视觉编码器；预训练卷积网络的局部连接性与空间权重共享特性使其成为候选特征来源。
AI.method: 提出 CONVCUE：用并行、冻结的预训练 CNN 的末阶段特征增强 VLM 原生视觉表征。可学习适配器将卷积特征映射到原生视觉特征维度，门控交叉注意力使原始视觉 token 从 CNN 特征中检索信息；增强后的 token 经原有视觉到语言投影器处理，并通过两阶段训练流程进行适配。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL-2B、Qwen3-VL-4B 和 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 三个骨干上，跨 13 个多模态基准（涵盖 VQA、文档与图表理解、多模态推理）评测，CONVCUE 的平均性能均优于原始模型和匹配的两阶段微调对照组。在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上，全部 13 个基准均有提升，平均分相对匹配微调对照组由 75.00 升至 78.82。
AI.conclusion: 预训练卷积表征在通过学习式适配与融合集成后，能够在不替换原有视觉编码器的情况下提升现有 VLM 的视觉理解能力。

title: WorldGuide: Learning Success-Failure Boundaries in Latent World Models for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Latent world models offer a promising way to improve Vision-Language-Action policies by capturing the consequences of actions. However, models trained primarily on expert demonstrations have limited exposure to failure outcomes and may struggle to distinguish visually similar successful and failed interactions. We propose \textbf{WorldGuide}, a framework that learns these distinctions in latent space and uses them to guide policy training. WorldGuide combines predictive pretraining on successful and failed trajectories with contrastive learning on matched success--failure pairs. The learned predictor then provides a differentiable reward to guide joint optimization of the policy and visual encoder. The predictor is discarded after training, so deployment requires no additional world-model inference. Extensive experiments show that WorldGuide substantially improves VLA reliability and achieves state of the art performance on LIBERO 100 and SimplerEnv, reaching \textbf{96.8\%} and \textbf{72.0\%}, respectively. Code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出WorldGuide框架：在潜空间学习区分成功/失败交互，用可微奖励引导VLA策略与视觉编码器联合训练，推理时丢弃预测器。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型能刻画动作后果，有望提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略；但仅用专家演示训练的模型对失败结果暴露不足，难以区分视觉上相似的成功与失败交互。
AI.method: WorldGuide结合成功与失败轨迹上的预测式预训练，并对匹配的成功-失败样本对进行对比学习；学习到的预测器提供可微奖励，引导策略与视觉编码器的联合优化。训练完成后丢弃该预测器。
AI.result: 大量实验表明WorldGuide显著提升VLA可靠性，在LIBERO 100和SimplerEnv上分别达到96.8%和72.0%，取得SOTA性能。代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过在潜空间显式建模成功-失败差异并作为训练期奖励信号，可在不增加部署开销的前提下显著增强VLA策略的可靠性与性能。

title: X-MoD: Practical Scaling Laws for Sparse-Depth Routing Beyond Mixture-of-Depths
summary: Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) enables conditional computation across Transformer depth by routing only a subset of tokens through selected layers, but its original one-sparse--one-dense alternation tightly couples total capacity to active capacity and limits sparse-depth scaling. We introduce X-MoD, a scalable sparse-depth architecture that decouples token sparsity from anchor stride, allowing total parameter count to grow while keeping active-equivalent capacity nearly fixed. To make deep sparse routing trainable, X-MoD combines dense anchors with variance-scaled layer-wise gating and depth-wise token balancing. To make this regime analyzable and usable, we formulate sparse-depth routing as a conditional architecture-design problem: given compute, context length, and active-equivalent backbone size, how should the routing configuration be chosen? We develop a practical scaling-law framework by fitting X-MoD relative to FLOP-matched dense baselines, yielding an interpretable law that decomposes performance into sparse-capacity gain, sparse-context correction, and anchor-stride interaction. The law predicts validation loss across routing configurations and reveals how context length, model scale, and anchor stride shape sparse-depth performance. We validate the architecture and law through pretraining sweeps, held-out scaling-law prediction, ablations, downstream evaluations, and comparisons with Dense, MoD, and representative MoE baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 X-MoD，一种可扩展的稀疏深度架构，将 token 稀疏性与 anchor 步长解耦，使总参数量增长而活跃等效容量近似固定；并将稀疏深度路由形式化为条件架构设计问题，拟合出可解释的缩放律。
AI.motivation: 原始 Mixture-of-Depths（MoD）采用 one-sparse--one-dense 交替结构，导致总容量与活跃容量紧耦合，限制了稀疏深度的扩展能力。作者希望在保持活跃等效容量近似不变的前提下扩展总参数量，并让深层稀疏路由可训练、可分析。
AI.method: 1) 架构：X-MoD 将 token 稀疏性与 anchor 步长解耦；用密集 anchor 配合方差缩放的逐层门控与深度方向 token 平衡，使深层稀疏路由可训练。2) 理论：将稀疏深度路由表述为条件架构设计问题（给定 compute、context length、active-equivalent backbone size，如何选择路由配置）。3) 缩放律：以 FLOP-matched 密集基线为参照拟合 X-MoD，得到可解释的缩放律，将性能分解为稀疏容量增益、稀疏上下文修正与 anchor 步长交互三项。
AI.result: 拟合出的缩放律可跨路由配置预测验证损失，并揭示上下文长度、模型规模与 anchor 步长如何影响稀疏深度性能。通过预训练扫描、留出缩放律预测、消融实验、下游评估，以及与 Dense、MoD、代表性 MoE 基线的对比，验证了架构与缩放律的有效性。
AI.conclusion: X-MoD 通过解耦 token 稀疏性与 anchor 步长，实现了稀疏深度的可扩展化，并提供可解释、可预测的缩放律框架，为在给定算力与上下文条件下选择路由配置提供了实用指导。

title: Explainable and Generalisable LLM-based Cognitive Decline Detection with Spontaneous Speech
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) and mild cognitive impairment (MCI), which may precede AD, manifest early through subtle linguistic and acoustic alterations. Traditional diagnostics, however, are often resource-intensive and lack scalability for mass screening. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel bilingual speech large language model framework for automated, explainable cognitive screening. Unlike conventional pipelines that rely on error-prone automatic speech recognition, our system directly processes raw speech to learn joint acoustic-semantic representations, preserving critical prosodic cues often lost in transcription. Utilising our newly collected PUTH-AD dataset alongside multiple open-source corpora, we implemented a multi-task learning objective that simultaneously performs cognitive status classification and generates clinician-understandable natural language explanations. Our system achieved the highest average accuracy and AUROC across six dataset/task conditions, comparing three representative baselines. The system demonstrated cross-task transfer to held-out PUTH-AD task subsets, maintaining classification accuracy on an entirely unseen cognitive task without task-specific fine-tuning. Furthermore, clinician evaluation confirms that the generated explanations are both clinically relevant and largely consistent with the underlying speech evidence, supporting their potential utility in clinical interpretation. This study provides a scalable, objective, and explainable framework for speech-based cognitive screening, combining cognitive status classification with natural language explanations that clinicians can assess and verify, bridging the gap between advanced AI and clinical utility.

AI.tldr: 提出双语语音大模型框架，直接处理原始语音学习声学-语义联合表征，实现可解释的认知筛查。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）及轻度认知障碍（MCI）早期表现为细微的语言与声学变化，但传统诊断资源消耗大、难以规模化用于大规模筛查；同时现有流程依赖易出错的自动语音识别，会丢失关键的韵律线索。
AI.method: 构建双语语音大语言模型框架，绕过自动语音识别直接处理原始语音以学习声学-语义联合表征；基于新采集的 PUTH-AD 数据集及多个开源语料库，采用多任务学习目标，同时进行认知状态分类并生成临床医生可理解的自然语言解释。
AI.result: 在六种数据集/任务条件下取得最高平均准确率与 AUROC（对比三种代表性基线）；在未见过的 PUTH-AD 任务子集上实现跨任务迁移，无需任务特定微调即保持分类准确率；临床医生评估表明生成的解释具有临床相关性，且与底层语音证据基本一致。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了可扩展、客观且可解释的语音认知筛查框架，将认知状态分类与可被临床医生评估和验证的自然语言解释相结合，弥合了先进 AI 与临床应用之间的差距。

title: Loop Dropout: Regularizing Shared Updates in Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models separate computational depth from parameter count by repeatedly applying the same transformer block. Adapting these models requires a shared update that remains effective as hidden states evolve throughout the recurrent computation. Our empirical analysis reveals a pronounced late-loop bias in standard low-rank adaptation (LoRA): the shared update provides limited adaptation at early loop positions. This imbalance motivates training shared updates under varying combinations of their applications. Randomly omitting adapter applications alone, however, does not improve task performance; it reduces expected update strength during training while leaving inference unchanged. We introduce Loop Dropout, which couples stochastic masking of adapter applications with inverse-survival rescaling to preserve expected update strength and promote effective adaptation across loops. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved mathematical reasoning across model sizes, adapter ranks and training recipes, with benefits extending to general instruction tuning and code generation. Loop Dropout outperforms existing LoRA variants and adapter regularizers, while further analysis shows stronger early-loop adaptation. Every backbone loop remains active, and inference applies the adapter at all loops using standard LoRA without additional trainable parameters or inference computation. Code is available at https://github.com/NUS-HPC-AI-Lab/loop-dropout .

AI.tldr: 本文针对循环语言模型（Looped LM）中标准 LoRA 共享更新存在"后期循环偏置"的问题，提出 Loop Dropout：通过对适配器应用施加随机掩码并配合逆生存概率重缩放，保持期望更新强度，从而促进跨循环的有效适配。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型通过重复应用同一 transformer 块，将计算深度与参数量解耦，但适配此类模型需要一个在隐藏状态随递归计算不断演化时仍然有效的共享更新。作者的经验分析发现标准低秩适配（LoRA）存在明显的后期循环偏置：共享更新在早期循环位置提供的适配能力有限，这种不平衡促使作者思考如何在应用组合变化的条件下训练共享更新。
AI.method: 作者首先观察到单纯随机省略适配器应用并不能提升任务表现——它降低了训练时的期望更新强度，而推理阶段却保持不变。为此提出 Loop Dropout，将适配器应用的随机掩码与逆生存概率重缩放（inverse-survival rescaling）相耦合，以保持期望更新强度，并促进跨循环的有效适配。推理时每个骨干循环仍保持激活，并在所有循环上以标准 LoRA 方式应用适配器，不增加额外可训练参数或推理计算。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在不同模型规模、适配器秩和训练配方下，Loop Dropout 均提升了数学推理能力，其收益还扩展到通用指令微调与代码生成任务。Loop Dropout 优于现有 LoRA 变体与适配器正则化方法。进一步分析显示其带来了更强的早期循环适配能力。
AI.conclusion: Loop Dropout 通过随机掩码加逆生存概率重缩放，缓解了标准 LoRA 在循环语言模型中的后期循环偏置，在不改变推理路径、不增加参数与计算的前提下实现了更均衡、更有效的跨循环适配，并在多类任务上超越现有方法。

title: mmHRI: Towards Privacy-Preserving Human-Robot Interaction with Millimeter-Wave Radar
summary: Assistive robots increasingly operate in many human-centered environments and perform various human-robot interaction (HRI) tasks, such as object delivery. However, most existing HRI systems rely on RGB cameras that continuously observe humans to respond to non-verbal commands, such as hand gestures. This raises privacy concerns in privacy- critical environments, such as hospital wards or restaurants, where direct camera observation of humans is restricted. To develop privacy-preserving HRI, we leverage millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar, which can sense human motion through privacy barriers without identifiable imagery. We propose mmHRI, the first multi-modal robot manipulation framework that achieves mmWave radar-guided privacy-preserving HRI. mmHRI introduces two key designs to mitigate the sparsity and temporal inconsistency of radar data in cluttered robot manipulation environments. First, we propose a dual-stream architecture that jointly learns from unfiltered raw radar tensors and radar point clouds to estimate both human actions and 3D poses. To mitigate signal inconsistency, mmHRI further incorporates a memory-based state-space model (MSSM) that retains historical radar features to reduce abrupt changes in pose/action. These estimated human states are then converted into structured textual robot instructions, which control a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for closed-loop robot manipulation and human-aware reactions. Our evaluation covers human action recognition and closed-loop delivery and retrieval. In the privacy-preserving curtain setting, mmHRI achieves 85.09% action-recognition accuracy, outperforming existing radar-based alternatives. Robot trials further demonstrate successful delivery and retrieval under visual occlusion, with stable task performance across unseen subjects, clutter configurations, and environments.

AI.tldr: 提出mmHRI，首个利用毫米波雷达实现隐私保护人机交互的多模态机器人操作框架，在视觉遮挡下完成物体递送与取回。
AI.motivation: 现有HRI系统多依赖RGB相机持续观测人类以响应手势等非语言指令，在医院病房、餐厅等隐私敏感环境中，直接摄像观测受限，存在隐私问题。作者希望在不使用可识别影像的前提下实现隐私保护的人机交互。
AI.method: 采用毫米波雷达通过隐私屏障感知人体运动。为缓解杂乱机器人操作环境中雷达数据的稀疏性与时序不一致性，设计两点：1）双流架构，从未滤波的原始雷达张量与雷达点云联合学习，估计人体动作与3D姿态；2）基于记忆的状态空间模型（MSSM），保留历史雷达特征以减少姿态/动作的突变。将估计的人体状态转换为结构化文本机器人指令，控制视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，实现闭环机器人操作与人体感知响应。
AI.result: 评估涵盖人体动作识别与闭环递送和取回任务。在隐私保护帘幕设置下，mmHRI动作识别准确率达85.09%，优于现有基于雷达的替代方案。机器人试验进一步证明在视觉遮挡下可成功完成递送与取回，并在未见过的被试、杂乱配置和环境间保持稳定任务性能。
AI.conclusion: mmHRI验证了毫米波雷达引导的隐私保护HRI可行性，可在视觉遮挡条件下实现稳定的动作识别与机器人操作，兼具隐私性与跨场景鲁棒性。

title: WorldWeave: Growing Persistent Geometric Worlds for Video Generation
comment: Project page: https://laiyindagm.github.io/WorldWeave/ . Code repository: https://github.com/laiyindagm/WorldWeave (implementation coming soon)
summary: Despite rapid progress, world models still lack explicit, persistent structural memory, making it difficult to preserve consistent world structure during continual scene expansion and cross-view revisits. To address this limitation, we present WorldWeave, a world generation framework that decouples world-state maintenance from visual rendering. Specifically, WorldWeave combines continual elevation-map generation with agent-guided scene organization and stitching to build an expandable explicit 3D world that incrementally extends structural memory while preserving existing structure. First, its terrain module uses diffusion-based image outpainting to generate continuous metric elevation maps under neighborhood conditioning and boundary constraints. Next, an agent integrates user intent, terrain evidence, and cross-region connectivity constraints to construct scenes through hierarchical semantic planning, deterministic geometry compilation, and local revision. Finally, during visual generation, planned camera trajectories query world geometry through a read-only interface, producing depth sequences that guide video synthesis without writing the generated results back into the world state. As a result, structural memory remains independent of short-window video generation, enabling continual expansion without predefined map boundaries and providing a consistent geometric basis for observations across trajectories and repeated visits.

AI.tldr: WorldWeave 将世界状态维护与视觉渲染解耦，通过持续生成高程图与智能体场景编排构建可扩展的显式 3D 世界，实现无边界持续扩展与跨视角一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型缺乏显式、持久的结构化记忆，在持续场景扩展与跨视角重访时难以保持世界结构一致。为解决该局限，作者提出将世界状态维护与视觉渲染解耦的思路。
AI.method: WorldWeave 框架包含三部分：(1) 地形模块用基于扩散的图像外推，在邻域条件与边界约束下生成连续的公制高程图；(2) 智能体融合用户意图、地形证据与跨区域连通性约束，通过层级语义规划、确定性几何编译与局部修正来构建场景；(3) 视觉生成阶段，规划好的相机轨迹通过只读接口查询世界几何，产出深度序列引导视频合成，且不将生成结果写回世界状态。
AI.result: 结构记忆与短窗口视频生成相互独立，支持无预定义地图边界的持续扩展，并为跨轨迹与重复访问的观测提供一致的几何基础。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦世界状态与渲染，可构建可增量扩展的显式 3D 世界，在保持既有结构的同时实现持续扩展与跨视角几何一致性。

title: Uncovering Ordinal-Matching Bias in Audio-Visual LLMs
summary: This work aims to improve how audio-visual large language models (AVLLMs) associate speech with the correct visible speaker in multi-speaker scenes. We find that current AVLLMs frequently fail at this task, and analyze the nature of these failures. To this end, we construct a synthetic diagnostic dataset in which multiple visible speakers each utter a single word. Analysis on this corpus reveals a consistent error pattern across three recent open-source AVLLMs: models attribute utterances by simply matching the order of spoken sentences with the left-to-right, top-to-bottom arrangement of visible faces, rather than relying on audio-visual cues such as lip synchronization. We term this behavior \emph{ordinal-matching bias}. We further show that this bias can be substantially mitigated through a simple remedy, Ordinal-Decoupled Fine-Tuning (OD-FT), in which models are fine-tuned on synthetic videos where spatial positions of speakers and speaking order are independently randomized. Despite using only 400 synthetic training videos, OD-FT not only suppresses ordinal-matching bias but also improves audio-visual understanding on real-world videos, yielding average gains of 8.27\% for Qwen2.5-Omni and 2.57\% for video-SALMONN2+ across three audio-visual benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了音视频大语言模型（AVLLMs）在多说话人场景中普遍存在"顺序匹配偏差"，并提出仅需400个合成视频的Ordinal-Decoupled Fine-Tuning（OD-FT）微调方法即可显著缓解该偏差并提升真实场景表现。
AI.motivation: 当前音视频大语言模型在多说话人场景中将语音关联到正确可见说话人这一任务上频繁失败。作者希望探究其失败根源，并找到有效的改进方案。
AI.method: 1）构建合成诊断数据集，多个可见说话人各自说出单个词；2）在三个近期开源AVLLMs上分析错误模式，发现"顺序匹配偏差"——模型按语音顺序与面部从左到右、从上到下的排列顺序对应，而非依赖唇同步等音视频线索；3）提出Ordinal-Decoupled Fine-Tuning（OD-FT），在说话人空间位置与说话顺序被独立随机化的合成视频上微调。
AI.result: OD-FT仅使用400个合成训练视频，不仅抑制了顺序匹配偏差，还提升了真实视频上的音视频理解能力，在三个音视频基准上Qwen2.5-Omni平均提升8.27%，video-SALMONN2+平均提升2.57%。
AI.conclusion: AVLLMs的说话人关联失败源于序数启发式（顺序匹配偏差）而非真正依赖音视频对齐线索；通过解耦空间位置与说话顺序的合成数据微调，可低成本、有效地纠正该偏差并泛化到真实场景。

title: USA: Update-aware SAM for Cross-domain On-Policy Disitllation of Language Agents
summary: On-policy distillation instils multi-turn agentic reasoning through dense token-level supervision on the student's own trajectories, but a single domain saturates early, so further supervision has to be drawn from other domains. Multi-domain data mixing is the most direct way of incorporating them, at the cost of conflicts between their data distributions and of retraining the entire model whenever one domain is revised. Model merging avoids both by distilling every domain independently and fusing the resulting task vectors afterwards. We find instead that the benefit polarizes across domain pairs: on those exhibiting negative transfer, every merging operator we evaluate falls below the single-domain reference. We attribute this to cross-domain update coupling, where a substantial fraction of coordinates is updated comparably by both domains and a merge can therefore displace them by as much as their own updates. To overcome this limitation, we propose USA, which converts per-parameter update magnitudes measured during a brief warm-up into per-coordinate perturbation radii, reducing curvature precisely on the coordinates that carry most of the merging displacement. Experiments across mathematics, science and code at two student scales show USA strongest in all six transfer directions, ahead of the single-domain reference by more than four points on average, and reverse the negative transfer of the conflicting pairs.

AI.tldr: 提出 USA 方法，通过预热阶段估计的参数更新幅度构造逐坐标扰动半径，降低合并位移最大处的曲率，从而在多领域 on-policy 蒸馏中避免负迁移，六个迁移方向均优于单领域基线。
AI.motivation: 单领域 on-policy 蒸馏早期即饱和，需引入其他领域监督。多领域数据混合会带来分布冲突并需整体重训；模型合并虽避免这两点，但作者发现其收益在领域对上呈现两极分化：存在负迁移的领域对上，所有合并算子均低于单领域参考。作者将其归因于跨领域更新耦合——相当比例的坐标被两个领域以相近幅度更新，合并可将这些坐标位移推至与各自更新量相当的程度。
AI.method: 提出 USA：用短暂预热阶段测得的逐参数更新幅度，转化为逐坐标扰动半径，从而在承载大部分合并位移的坐标上精确降低曲率，抑制跨领域更新耦合造成的位移。
AI.result: 在数学、科学、代码三个领域、两种学生模型规模上，USA 在全部六个迁移方向上均为最强，平均超过单领域参考 4 分以上，并逆转了冲突领域对的负迁移。
AI.conclusion: 模型合并中的负迁移源于跨领域更新耦合导致的坐标级位移，USA 通过更新幅度引导的逐坐标曲率抑制有效缓解该问题，实现跨领域 on-policy 蒸馏的稳定增益。

title: When Does Selection Replace Extraction? A Pre-Registered Test of Agent Memory with a Typed Decision Model
comment: 21 pages, 9 figures. Pre-registered: plan doi:10.5281/zenodo.22970745, amendment doi:10.5281/zenodo.22977848. Preprint also at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22985242. Code and data: https://github.com/ris3abh/Engram
summary: Does conversational memory need LLM-extracted facts, or is selecting the right raw turns enough? Published results disagree. Extraction-based systems report gains from distilled facts. Recent studies find raw history with good ranking does as well, but disagree about whether ranking matters. We ran a pre-registered study on held-out LoCoMo conversations and LongMemEval. At a tight budget on LoCoMo, raw turns selected by a single call to Jev, a typed decision model, are non-inferior to an LLM-extraction memory (one-sided 95% bound -3.0 points against a -5-point margin). Blind human grading narrows the margin but does not change the result. Raw turns cost 3,061 times less to write, and the result holds with a second answer model. Within this study, reranking's gain shrinks as the budget grows. It adds 17.4 points on LoCoMo and 9.1 on LongMemEval when three of 30 candidates are kept. At generous budgets it adds 1.5 and 1.1, and extraction systems are more accurate. This suggests why published results disagree. At matched context, Jev selects as accurately as an LLM reranker (non-inferiority bound -2.0) at a third of the latency, and more accurately than a multi-call graph traversal. Reranking lowers correct abstention. Plans, code and graded answers are released.

AI.tldr: 预注册研究在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval 上比较，发现紧预算下按 Jev 单次调用选择的原始对话轮次不劣于 LLM 抽取式记忆，且写入成本极低；重排序收益随预算增大而衰减，解释了文献结论分歧。
AI.motivation: 对话记忆是否需要 LLM 抽取事实，还是选对原始轮次就足够？已有结论互相矛盾：抽取式系统报告蒸馏事实带来增益，近期研究认为排序良好的原始历史同样有效，但对排序是否重要存在分歧。作者希望通过预注册、留出集实验厘清分歧来源。
AI.method: 在留出的 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval 对话上进行预注册实验。以单次调用 Jev（一种类型化决策模型）选择原始轮次，与 LLM 抽取式记忆对比；采用非劣性检验（LoCoMo 紧预算下为单侧 95% 界 -3.0 分，边界 -5 分）。辅以盲评人工打分、更换第二个回答模型、与 LLM 重排器及多调用图遍历对比，并考察不同候选保留数（30 选 3 对比宽松预算）下重排序增益的变化。
AI.result: LoCoMo 紧预算下，Jev 选择的原始轮次对 LLM 抽取式记忆非劣（单侧 95% 界 -3.0 分，边界 -5 分）；盲评缩小差距但不改变结论。原始轮次写入成本低 3,061 倍，且在第二回答模型下结论成立。重排序增益随预算增加而缩小：保留 30 选 3 时 LoCoMo +17.4、LongMemEval +9.1；宽松预算下仅 +1.5 与 +1.1，且此时抽取式系统更准。相同上下文下，Jev 与 LLM 重排器精度非劣（界 -2.0），延迟仅为其三分之一，且优于多调用图遍历。重排序降低正确弃答率。
AI.conclusion: 在本文研究范围内，紧预算下选择原始轮次即可达到 LLM 抽取式记忆的效果，且成本与延迟显著更低，因而无需依赖事实抽取；重排序的收益高度依赖预算，预算宽裕时抽取式系统更优。这一预算依赖性可解释已发表结论的分歧。计划、代码与评分答案已公开。

title: ReGDiff: Guided Diffusion in Regulated Latent Space for Exploring Metamaterial Voxel Geometry
summary: Metamaterials are artificially engineered structures whose mechanical and physical behaviors are strongly shaped by geometry rather than composition. Voxel representation provides a unified format for metamaterial geometry generation, as it can express diverse classes such as truss, shell, and porous structures within a single cubic discretization. However, voxel-based generation faces a plausibility-novelty trade-off: staying close to known geometries helps preserve geometric regularities, while moving away from them is necessary for novelty but may produce degenerate geometries. To address this challenge, we propose REGDIFF, a generative framework that couples voxel representation with latent space regulation and guided diffusion. REGDIFF introduces a repel-and-sink (RAS) mechanism to smooth the latent distribution of plausible geometries, and short-range repulsion (SRR) guidance to discourage generation overly close to known samples while maintaining geometric plausibility. We further contribute a voxel-based benchmark covering truss- and shell-type metamaterial geometries, together with an evaluation module for geometric plausibility, novelty, and diversity. Experiments show that REGDIFF outperforms voxel-based generative baselines, achieving +8.9% in geometric plausibility, +46.4% in novelty, and +128.6% in diversity on average across two datasets. These results suggest that REGDIFF is a strong geometry candidate generator for downstream evaluation. Our code is provided at https://github.com/wzhan24/ReGDiff.

AI.tldr: 提出REGDIFF生成框架，将体素表示与潜在空间正则化及引导扩散耦合，解决超材料几何生成中的合理性-新颖性权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 体素表示可为桁架、壳、多孔等多种超材料提供统一几何生成格式，但体素生成面临"合理性-新颖性"权衡：贴近已知几何可保持几何规律性，远离已知几何虽可提升新颖性却可能产生退化几何。该矛盾亟需解决。
AI.method: REGDIFF包含三个核心设计：（1）体素表示与潜在空间正则化、引导扩散相结合的统一生成框架；（2）repel-and-sink（RAS）机制，用于平滑合理几何的潜在分布；（3）short-range repulsion（SRR）引导，抑制生成样本过度接近已知样本，同时维持几何合理性。此外构建了覆盖桁架型与壳型超材料的体素基准及几何合理性、新颖性、多样性评估模块。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上平均超越基于体素的生成基线：几何合理性+8.9%，新颖性+46.4%，多样性+128.6%。
AI.conclusion: REGDIFF是面向下游评估的强几何候选生成器；代码已开源于 https://github.com/wzhan24/ReGDiff。

title: Trustworthy synthetic visual media: Evidence across the media lifecycle
summary: Images and videos have long helped people understand what happened and how a work came into being. Generative systems complicate that role. Realistic media can now be produced and revised without leaving a stable history, so appearance no longer reveals whether a scene was captured, synthesized, or altered along the way. Trust must instead come from evidence that explains the path an asset has taken and the circumstances in which it was used. Some of this evidence can be recovered from the media, while some must be recorded during production and preserved as the asset circulates. This review brings those approaches together and asks when their claims remain meaningful after ordinary processing or deliberate manipulation. We argue that trustworthy media do not depend on one universal marker of authenticity. The evidence must suit the question at hand, reach the person making the judgment, and remain open to correction when better information emerges. The larger goal is to keep the history of media intelligible even as the media itself continues to change.

AI.tldr: 生成式系统使媒体外观不再能揭示其来源，可信度须转而依赖"证据"。本文综述了两类证据路径：从媒体本身可恢复的痕迹，以及须在生产时记录并随资产流通保存的元数据/溯源信息，并追问这些主张经普通处理或蓄意操纵后是否仍有意义。
AI.motivation: 图像与视频长期帮助人们理解事件经过与作品产生过程，但生成式系统削弱了外观与真实之间的对应关系：逼真媒体可被生成和修改而不留稳定历史，因此无法凭外观判断场景是被拍摄、合成还是被篡改。信任因此必须由能够解释资产来源路径及其使用情境的证据来支撑。
AI.method: 综述性研究。作者整合两条证据获取路径：一是从媒体内容中事后恢复的取证痕迹（被动式/内容内证据），二是生产阶段须主动记录并随资产流通而保存的溯源信息（主动式/元数据证据），并系统评估这些证据主张在经历常规处理或蓄意操纵后的有效性边界。
AI.result: 论文的核心论断是：可信媒体不依赖单一、普适的"真实性标记"。证据必须与所要回答的具体问题相匹配，必须能够到达作出判断的人手中，并且必须在出现更好信息时保持可修正性。
AI.conclusion: 总体目标是让媒体的历史在其本身不断变化的同时仍保持可理解性。可信性判定应被视为情境化、面向问题且可纠错的过程，而非依赖统一的真实性认证。

title: MAS-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) split a task across specialized roles and are promising on complex tasks, yet a prevailing approach relies on inference-time orchestration alone. General-purpose APIs are costly and hard to customize, while small models with role prompts rarely develop stable role competence or reliable collaboration, so post-training a MAS jointly is central. Most attempts use reinforcement learning, whose team-level reward leaves undetermined which step of which agent brought about the outcome, while local rewards need redesigning per task. On-policy distillation (OPD) gives token-level teacher supervision on trajectories the student samples, a denser signal needing no local reward, yet is underexplored for the interdependent agents of a MAS. Two difficulties arise: building complementary specialization from a judgement of which role a behavior belongs to while preserving the knowledge all roles need, and turning cross-agent collaborative information into supervision OPD can exploit. We present MAS-OPD, where Role-Advantage Specialization defines the role advantage as the difference between the teacher signals under target and non-target role conditions, and Privileged Attribution for Coordination attributes an interaction conflict to its source and supplies it to the teacher alone as privileged information. Extensive experiments on code and mathematics benchmarks show that MAS-OPD attains the highest mean score at both student scales and leads the agents to develop clearer role specialization and more effective collaborative behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出MAS-OPD，用角色优势专门化与特权归因协调实现多智能体系统的联合在线策略蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统多依赖推理期编排，通用API昂贵难定制，小模型加角色提示难以形成稳定角色能力与可靠协作，因此MAS的联合后训练很关键。现有强化学习方法中团队级奖励无法归因到具体智能体的具体步骤，局部奖励又需按任务重新设计；在线策略蒸馏（OPD）提供无需局部奖励的token级稠密监督，但在相互依赖的多智能体场景中尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出MAS-OPD框架，包含两个机制：Role-Advantage Specialization将角色优势定义为目标角色条件与非目标角色条件下教师信号之差，以在保留全体角色所需知识的同时构建互补专门化；Privileged Attribution for Coordination将交互冲突归因到其来源，并仅作为特权信息提供给教师模型。
AI.result: 在代码与数学基准上的大量实验表明，MAS-OPD在两个学生模型规模上均取得最高平均分，并促使智能体形成更清晰的角色专门化和更有效的协作行为。
AI.conclusion: MAS-OPD证明在线策略蒸馏可有效用于多智能体系统的联合后训练，通过角色优势专门化与特权归因协调解决角色专精与跨智能体协作监督的难题。

title: SegBanana: Steering Unified Multimodal Models into Medical Segmenters
summary: Medical image segmentation remains challenging in practical deployment, as models often struggle to generalize beyond the distributions covered by their training data and high-quality pixel-level annotations are typically unavailable for adaptation. Inspired by the cross-task transferability of large language models, we investigate whether unified multimodal models (UMMs) can transfer their pretrained visual understanding, reasoning, and generation capabilities to medical image segmentation without task-specific post-training. By recasting segmentation as structured visual generation, we find that frontier UMMs (e.g., Nano Banana) already exhibit basic segmentation capabilities across diverse clinical scenarios, but still struggle with challenging tasks requiring specialized anatomical or domain-specific knowledge. We further show that these limitations can be effectively mitigated by incorporating visual anatomical knowledge from in-context exemplars, expanding candidate solutions through repeated sampling, and refining suboptimal predictions via targeted editing.Motivated by these observations, we propose SegBanana, to our knowledge, the first agentic visual generation framework for training-free medical image segmentation. SegBanana builds on a frozen UMM as the core generative model, augmented with Anatomy-Aware Knowledge Retrieval and Comparative Quality Critique to unlock its potential segmentation capability. A State-Aware Multimodal Controller maintains structured state and iteratively orchestrates these tools, repeatedly refining intermediate predictions toward higher-quality masks. Across eight medical segmentation datasets, SegBanana achieves an average mDice of 77.45%, outperforming representative generalist (SAM3 and SegGPT) and medical-specific (BiomedParse and MedSAM3) baselines by at least 14.93 points, while remaining robust to out-of-domain visual supports.

AI.tldr: 提出SegBanana，首个面向免训练医学图像分割的智能体式视觉生成框架。基于冻结的统一多模态模型，通过解剖知识检索与对比质量评判等工具迭代优化掩码，在八个数据集上平均mDice达77.45%，超越通用与医学专用基线至少14.93分。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割实际部署困难：模型难以泛化到训练分布之外，且适配时往往缺乏高质量像素级标注。受大语言模型跨任务迁移能力启发，探索统一多模态模型能否在无需任务特定后训练的情况下迁移其预训练的视觉理解、推理与生成能力至医学分割。
AI.method: 将分割重构为结构化视觉生成，发现前沿UMM已具基本分割能力但缺专业知识。据此提出SegBanana：冻结UMM为核心生成模型，加入解剖感知知识检索与对比质量评判；由状态感知多模态控制器维护结构化状态并迭代调度工具，通过上下文示例引入视觉解剖知识、重复采样扩展候选解、定向编辑精炼次优预测。
AI.result: 在八个医学分割数据集上平均mDice为77.45%，较代表性通用基线（SAM3、SegGPT）与医学专用基线（BiomedParse、MedSAM3）至少高出14.93分，且对域外视觉支持保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 验证了统一多模态模型的预训练能力可迁移至医学分割，且通过智能体式工具编排可在免训练条件下显著提升性能，为免训练医学分割提供新范式。

title: DecFlowEdit: Self-Localized Flow-based Image Editing via Guidance Decoupling
summary: Flow-based image editing (FlowEdit) enables inversion-free semantic changes through the difference between source and target velocities. In this paper, we observe that FlowEdit's default classifier-free guidance (CFG) configuration, with asymmetric source and target scales, causes substantial background leakage. Matching these guidance scales, for example by removing CFG, improves edit-relevant localization but severely degrades editability. To get the best of both worlds, we propose DecFlowEdit, which decouples the optimal guidance scales for localization and for editing in flow-based generative models. In particular, DecFlowEdit first extracts an edit-relevant prior by temporally aggregating velocity differences evaluated without CFG, and then uses this prior to reweight the original updates under default CFG. Our method remains training-free and inversion-free, requiring neither external spatial masks nor attention manipulation. Experiments on PIE-Bench across FLUX, SD3, and SD3.5 show that DecFlowEdit improves background preservation, reducing structure distance by approximately 61 to 73 percent and background LPIPS by 68 to 80 percent relative to FlowEdit at comparable editing fidelity.

AI.tldr: DecFlowEdit 通过解耦局部化与编辑所需的最优引导尺度，在保持可编辑性的同时显著改善背景保持，无需训练、反演或外部掩码。
AI.motivation: FlowEdit 默认的无分类器引导（CFG）配置采用非对称的源与目标引导尺度，导致严重的背景泄漏；若将引导尺度匹配（例如去掉 CFG），虽能提升编辑相关区域的局部化能力，却严重损害可编辑性。
AI.method: DecFlowEdit 将局部化与编辑的引导尺度解耦：先通过时间聚合在无 CFG 条件下评估的速度差，提取编辑相关的先验；再用该先验对默认 CFG 下的原始更新进行重加权。方法保持免训练、免反演，且不需要外部空间掩码或注意力操纵。
AI.result: 在 PIE-Bench 上对 FLUX、SD3、SD3.5 的实验表明：在编辑保真度相当的情况下，DecFlowEdit 相较 FlowEdit 改善背景保持，结构距离降低约 61% 至 73%，背景 LPIPS 降低 68% 至 80%。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦引导尺度，DecFlowEdit 兼顾了编辑相关区域的局部化与整体可编辑性，在多种流式生成模型上实现了更优的背景保持，同时维持免训练、免反演且无需额外掩码或注意力干预的简洁性。

title: Coherence-Aware Distributional Evaluation of Open-Ended Text Generation
summary: Existing open-ended generation metrics measure likelihood, lexical diversity, or distributional similarity in generic representation space, yet can miss fundamental dimensions of quality. A prominent blind spot is global coherence: a generated passage may be locally fluent while remaining globally contradictory, causally inconsistent, or topically disconnected. We identify representation as a central bottleneck in detecting these failures and introduce CHORD (Coherence-aware Hidden-state Open-generation Reference Distance), a coherence-sensitive distributional metric. CHORD encodes generated and human-written corpora in the hidden-state space of a frozen LLM using a coherence-eliciting prompt, and compares the resulting distributions using RBF-MMD. To test coherence sensitivity and selectivity, we construct a counterfactual evaluation suite pairing graded coherence-degrading perturbations with meaning-preserving controls. CHORD selectively detects relation, discourse, structural, and mixture failures that perplexity, entropy, MAUVE, FBD, and MMD-based baselines either miss or cannot separate from benign rewriting. Factorial ablations show that representation is the primary source of coherence sensitivity, while RBF-MMD improves sample efficiency. Larger backbones capture finer-grained distinctions, but coherence prompting improves selectivity only when the backbone can follow the prompt. On unconditional generation and prefix continuation, CHORD yields model rankings that strongly align with human judgments of whether outputs make sense and appear human-written. Together, these results establish representation design as central to reliable distributional evaluation. Code: https://github.com/MAPS-research/CHORD. Experiments: https://github.com/MAPS-research/CHORD-Experiment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CHORD，一种在冻结LLM隐状态空间中以连贯性诱导提示编码文本并用RBF-MMD比较分布的连贯性敏感分布度量，用于检测开放式生成中的全局连贯性失败。
AI.motivation: 现有开放式生成指标仅衡量似然、词汇多样性或通用表示空间中的分布相似性，遗漏了质量的基本维度，尤其是全局连贯性：生成文本可局部流畅却全局矛盾、因果不一致或主题脱节。作者认为表示是检测此类失败的核心瓶颈。
AI.method: CHORD在冻结LLM的隐状态空间中编码生成语料与人类撰写语料，使用连贯性诱导提示，并通过RBF-MMD比较所得分布。为检验连贯性敏感性与选择性，构建反事实评估套件，将分级连贯性退化扰动与保持语义的对照配对；并进行因子消融实验。
AI.result: CHORD能选择性检测关系、篇章、结构和混合型失败，而困惑度、熵、MAUVE、FBD及基于MMD的基线或漏检，或无法与良性改写区分。因子消融表明表示是连贯性敏感性的主要来源，RBF-MMD提升样本效率；更大骨干可捕捉更细粒度差异，但连贯性提示仅在骨干能遵循提示时提升选择性。在无条件生成与前缀续写上，CHORD的模型排序与人类对输出是否合理、是否像人写的判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立表示设计是可靠分布式评估的核心，CHORD为开放式生成质量评估提供了连贯性敏感的度量方案。

title: SALMONN-duo: Adaptive Dual-System Coordination for Full-Duplex Voice Agents
summary: Full-duplex speech large language models (LLMs) enable low-latency, natural voice interaction. However, real-world agents must also use tools and perform deliberative reasoning-operations whose variable latency and computational cost conflict with the stringent timing requirements of real-time conversation. To reconcile these demands, we propose SALMONN-duo, an adaptive dual-system voice agent inspired by dual-process theories of cognition. SALMONN-duo separates real-time interaction from deliberative computation by pairing an always-on, fast-thinking full-duplex speech LLM (system 1) with a powerful asynchronous slow-thinking LLM agent (system 2). Beyond handling real-time interaction, system 1 learns when to answer directly and when to delegate, remaining responsive during backend execution and seamlessly integrating returned information into the ongoing dialogue without exposing tool traces or losing conversational context. Evaluations on single-turn spoken question answering (QA) and multi-turn conversations demonstrate that adaptive delegation substantially improves accuracy on knowledge-intensive and multi-hop reasoning questions, while knowledge-boundary-aware training avoids unnecessary system 2 invocations. On a customized version of $τ$-Voice, SALMONN-duo further demonstrates its ability to complete environment-grounded, policy-constrained tasks through multi-turn interactions in realistic business scenarios. Finally, cost-aware reinforcement learning further enhances the trade-off between task performance and backend usage across the QA and conversation tasks, while improving task success and response safety on $τ$-Voice with an acceptable increase in the delegation rate.

AI.tldr: 提出SALMONN-duo双系统语音智能体：系统1为全双工语音LLM负责实时交互与自适应委托，系统2为异步慢思考LLM智能体负责工具调用与深思推理，实现低延迟对话与复杂推理的兼顾。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音大模型支持低延迟自然交互，但真实场景下智能体还需调用工具并进行深思推理，这些操作的延迟与算力开销可变，与实时对话的严格时序要求相冲突，需要一种机制来协调实时响应与计算密集型推理。
AI.method: 受双过程认知理论启发，设计自适应双系统语音智能体SALMONN-duo：系统1为常开、快思考的全双工语音LLM，负责实时交互并学习何时直接作答、何时委托；系统2为强大的异步慢思考LLM智能体，负责后端深思计算。系统1在后端执行期间保持响应，并将返回信息无缝融入对话而不暴露工具痕迹、不丢失上下文。采用知识边界感知训练避免不必要的系统2调用，并用成本感知强化学习优化性能与后端使用量的权衡。
AI.result: 在单轮口语问答与多轮对话上，自适应委托显著提升知识密集型与多跳推理问题的准确率，知识边界感知训练避免了多余的系统2调用。在定制版τ-Voice上，模型通过多轮交互完成环境落地、策略约束的真实业务任务。成本感知强化学习进一步改善问答与对话任务中性能与后端调用量的权衡，并在τ-Voice上提升任务成功率与响应安全性，委托率仅可接受地小幅上升。
AI.conclusion: SALMONN-duo通过双系统架构与自适应委托、知识边界感知训练和成本感知强化学习，在不牺牲实时交互的前提下有效融合工具调用与深思推理，兼顾响应延迟、任务性能与计算成本。

title: DreamingGoose: Staged Distillation from Autoregressive Transformers to Bidirectional Recurrent Diffusion Language Models
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Companion to arXiv:2609.16183. Code and result data at https://github.com/JIBSIL/dualgoose
summary: Pretrained autoregressive Transformers represent a large sunk investment in compute. Existing conversion methods reuse that investment by changing either the architecture (attention to recurrence) or the objective (next-token prediction to denoising), never both. We convert Qwen3 teachers at 1.7B and 8B into attention-free, bidirectional, gated-delta-rule diffusion students in three stages, so that each capability can be traced to the stage that kept or lost it. Language modeling transfers only partially and in-distribution; in-context retrieval does not transfer. On a multi-query recall probe where the teachers score 0.34-0.58, both converted students score 0.000, and diffusion pretraining alone does not restore retrieval. A retrieval curriculum in the final stage, which gradually lengthens the gap between a key-value table and the queries that address it, restores it only stochastically: on a fixed schedule, one seed in three learns to retrieve. Advancing the gap only while a running accuracy estimate stays above a threshold works for all three of those seeds, holds on real text, and carries unchanged to 8B, where two of three seeds succeed. The third had not learned within its fixed 16k-step budget: retrieval switches on abruptly at a seed-dependent step (6.5k and 11k in the other two), so a fixed budget can cut a late run off. One boundary survives every intervention: every model that learns retrieval scores 0.000 on tokens that never appeared in a retrieval episode, and an arm that resamples the key and value tokens every batch shows this is a coverage limit, not memorization of particular bindings. Separately, we convert a 7B code model into a 3:1 recurrent-attention block-diffusion hybrid over 85k steps and report two negative training results.

AI.tldr: 将Qwen3自回归教师（1.7B、8B）三阶段转换为无注意力、双向、门控delta规则扩散学生，发现语言建模仅部分迁移、上下文检索不迁移；采用随运行准确率自适应延长键值-查询间隔的检索课程可随机恢复检索能力，但未见过token覆盖率始终为0，另报告两项负训练结果。
AI.motivation: 预训练自回归Transformer是巨大的算力沉没成本，现有转换方法只改架构（注意力→循环）或只改目标（下一token预测→去噪），从未两者同时改变。作者希望同时进行架构与目标的转换，并通过分阶段设计使每种能力的保留或丢失可归因到具体阶段，从而系统研究能力迁移的边界。
AI.method: 1）三阶段转换Qwen3 1.7B与8B教师为无注意力、双向、门控delta规则（gated-delta-rule）扩散学生，每阶段分别对应一项能力的变化。2）设计多查询召回探针评估检索能力。3）在末阶段引入检索课程：逐步拉大键值表与其查询之间的间隔；对比固定调度与自适应调度（仅当运行准确率估计高于阈值时才推进间隔）。4）通过每批次重采样键和值token的对照实验区分覆盖限制与特定绑定记忆。5）另将7B代码模型转换为3:1循环-注意力块扩散混合体，训练85k步。
AI.result: 语言建模仅部分迁移且限于分布内，上下文检索完全不迁移：教师召回探针得分0.34–0.58，两个转换学生均为0.000，仅靠扩散预训练无法恢复。固定调度的检索课程仅3个随机种子中1个学会；自适应阈值调度使3个种子全部成功，在真实文本上成立，并原样迁移到8B（3个种子中2个成功）；第3个种子在固定16k步预算内未学会，检索能力在种子相关步数（另两个为6.5k和11k）突然启用，固定预算可能截断晚期成功。所有学会检索的模型对从未出现在检索片段中的token得分均为0.000，重采样实验表明这是覆盖限制而非对特定绑定的记忆。7B代码模型混合转换报告两项负训练结果。
AI.conclusion: 架构与目标同时改变会导致检索能力难以迁移，需要通过课程学习才能部分恢复，且恢复具有随机性并依赖自适应调度；存在不可逾越的覆盖边界（未见token无法泛化检索）。分阶段转换设计可有效定位能力的保留/丢失来源，为大规模预训练模型的再利用与能力迁移研究提供了诊断框架与负面证据。

title: Recursive LLM Degradation in Biomedical Question Answering: A Cross-Generation Study
summary: Repeatedly training language models on their own generated data may create a synthetic-data feedback loop in which errors and distributional biases are reintroduced into subsequent training datasets. This paper studies that process in biomedical question answering (QA) using PubMedQA and two Qwen2.5 model sizes, 0.5B and 3B parameters. The study compares a recursive synthetic-data condition, in which generation G(k+1) is trained on answers produced by G(k), against a Human-Control condition that repeatedly uses the original human training data. The study evaluates across four generations from G0-G3 with two random seeds (42 and 123) and a fixed evaluation set of 1,000 expert-labeled samples. The evaluation includes disease and chemical entity F1, context-supported rate, lexical and semantic similarity, answer length, repetition rate, and other evaluation metrics. The Recursive condition for both model sizes and both seeds showed larger declines than the Human-Control condition in disease entity F1, chemical entity F1, context-supported rate, ROUGE-L, and cosine similarity. Under the fixed no-repeat 3-gram decoding constraint, the main observed behavioral change was increased answer length, while the measured 3-gram repetition rate did not increase. The magnitude of the difference-in-change was larger for the 3B model than for the 0.5B model. This difference was particularly apparent in disease F1, context-supported rate, cosine similarity, and answer length. These results show domain-specific changes associated with using recursive synthetic-data training in biomedical QA, but do not establish clinical hallucination rates or universal model collapse.

AI.tldr: 在PubMedQA上用Qwen2.5-0.5B/3B比较递归合成数据与人工数据训练的4代迭代（G0-G3，2个随机种子），发现递归条件下疾病/化学实体F1、上下文支持率、ROUGE-L和余弦相似度下降更明显，3B模型差异更大；主要行为变化是答案变长而非3-gram重复率上升，但未证实临床幻觉率或普遍模型崩溃。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在自身生成数据上反复训练可能形成合成数据反馈回路，使错误和分布偏差回流到后续训练集。本文旨在以生物医学问答为具体领域，检验这种递归训练是否带来可测量的性能与分布退化，并与使用原始人工数据的对照组区分开。
AI.method: 在PubMedQA数据集上使用Qwen2.5的0.5B和3B两种规模模型。设置两类条件：递归合成数据条件（G(k+1)训练于G(k)生成的答案）与人工对照条件（重复使用原始人工训练数据）。迭代4代（G0-G3），采用两个随机种子（42、123），固定1,000条专家标注评估集。评价指标包括疾病与化学实体F1、上下文支持率、词汇与语义相似度、答案长度、重复率等。解码时施加固定的no-repeat 3-gram约束。
AI.result: 递归条件在两种模型规模和两个种子下，疾病实体F1、化学实体F1、上下文支持率、ROUGE-L和余弦相似度的下降均大于人工对照。在no-repeat 3-gram解码约束下，主要行为变化是答案长度增加，而测得的3-gram重复率并未上升。3B模型的变化差值幅度大于0.5B模型，尤其在疾病F1、上下文支持率、余弦相似度和答案长度上更明显。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明在生物医学问答中使用递归合成数据训练会带来领域特定的变化，但该研究并未确立临床幻觉率，也未证明存在普遍的模型崩溃。

title: Scaling Versatile 3D Assets Editing with a Million-Scale Dataset
summary: Although recent 3D generative models produce increasingly realistic assets, controllable 3D asset editing remains challenging. Existing methods are limited by scarce training data, insufficient source-aware modeling, and a lack of practical evaluation protocols. To address these limitations, we present Alchemy3D, a unified framework for training and evaluating versatile 3D asset editors that covers data construction, model architecture, and benchmark evaluation. Specifically, we curate Alchemy3D-1M, a large-scale 3D editing dataset containing 1.25M assets and 1.38M editing pairs across seven editing types. On this data, we train a family of generative flow models for general-purpose 3D asset editing. The model family supports image- and text-conditioned editing, few-step inference, and transfer to multi-view 3D part segmentation. We further introduce GEdit3D-Bench, a large-scale, open-world benchmark with a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol. Across existing and newly introduced benchmarks, our method outperforms prior methods on most metrics of editing fidelity, source preservation, and visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出Alchemy3D统一框架，涵盖数据构建（Alchemy3D-1M，125万资产、138万编辑对、7类编辑）、生成流模型家族与GEdit3D-Bench基准，支持图像/文本条件编辑、少步推理及多视图部件分割迁移，在多数编辑保真度、源保持与视觉质量指标上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有可控3D资产编辑方法受限于三方面：训练数据稀缺、源感知建模不足、缺乏实用的评测协议。作者希望从数据、模型架构到基准评测一体化地解决这些问题。
AI.method: 1）构建大规模3D编辑数据集Alchemy3D-1M，含1.25M资产与1.38M编辑对，覆盖七种编辑类型；2）在该数据上训练一族生成流（generative flow）模型，支持图像与文本条件编辑、少步推理，并可迁移至多视图3D部件分割；3）提出开放世界大规模基准GEdit3D-Bench及多维度评测协议。
AI.result: 在已有及新提出的基准上，该方法在编辑保真度、源保持和视觉质量的大部分指标上优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: Alchemy3D为通用3D资产编辑提供了集数据、模型与评测于一体的统一方案，验证了大规模数据与流模型结合的有效性，并推动了可控3D编辑的标准化评估。

title: BIABench: Evaluating AI agents on real-world bioimage analysis tasks
summary: Artificial-intelligence (AI) agents hold promise for automating bioimage analysis, yet no benchmark evaluates whether they can carry out real-world analyses end to end. Such analyses are hard for agents because 2D images, 3D volumes and time-lapse sequences are often too large to read as context, so an agent must choose and run an analysis through code, specialized software and rendered views. Published studies make this capability testable, because each pairs raw images with a peer-reviewed result. We introduce BIABench, a benchmark of 16 tasks reconstructed from published biological studies that retain their scientific questions, imaging data and ground truth. The tasks span eleven analysis subtasks and modalities from H&E histology to single-molecule localization microscopy. Each submission receives an outcome score, which compares the output files with the ground truth using field-standard metrics, and a process score, in which a vision-language model judges method choice and quality control against an expert-written rubric. We evaluated general-purpose and biology-specific agents across several language models, with repeated runs of every task. Routine two-dimensional tasks were solved well, but on some tasks that added a third dimension or a time axis no agent scored above 0.19. Neither biological specialization, stronger models nor detailed expert instructions closed this gap. The agents were also unreliable, with scores varying more between repeated runs of one agent than between different agents, and without ground truth a correct run could not be told from a wrong one by its process score or by the time spent. Released openly with its data and code, BIABench provides a verifiable framework for evaluating, and eventually training, agents for reliable long-horizon bioimage analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BIABench——首个端到端评估AI智能体进行真实生物图像分析的基准，包含16个从已发表生物学研究重建的任务，涵盖11类分析子任务与多种成像模态，采用结果分数与过程分数双重评价体系；评估发现常规2D任务表现良好，但涉及三维或时间轴的任务得分极低（不高于0.19），且智能体运行重复性差。
AI.motivation: AI智能体有望实现生物图像分析的自动化，但现有基准无法评估其能否端到端完成真实世界的完整分析流程。这类分析对智能体极难，因为2D图像、3D体数据和延时序列往往过大，无法直接作为上下文读入，智能体必须通过代码、专用软件和渲染视图来选择并执行分析。而已发表研究将原始图像与同行评审结果配对，为测试这一能力提供了可验证的依据。
AI.method: 作者构建了BIABench基准，从已发表的生物学研究中重建16个任务，保留其科学问题、成像数据与真值（ground truth）。任务覆盖11种分析子任务及从H&E组织学到单分子定位显微镜等多种模态。每个提交获得两类评分：结果分数（用领域标准指标将输出文件与真值比较）和过程分数（由视觉语言模型依据专家编写的评分量表评判方法选择与质量控制）。并对通用型与生物学专用智能体、多种语言模型、每任务多次重复运行进行评估。
AI.result: 常规二维任务解决得较好；但在引入第三维或时间轴的部分任务上，没有任何智能体得分超过0.19。生物学专业化、更强的模型以及详细的专家指令都未能缩小这一差距。智能体还表现出不可靠性：同一智能体重复运行之间的分数差异大于不同智能体之间的差异；且在无真值的情况下，无法通过过程分数或所耗时间区分一次正确运行与错误运行。
AI.conclusion: BIABench随数据与代码公开发布，为评估并最终训练能够在长时程生物图像分析中可靠工作的智能体提供了一个可验证的框架。

title: See, Measure, and Reason: Learning Visually Grounded Reasoning in Pathology
summary: Pathological assessment relies on recognizing fine-grained visual details in histological images. Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly support pathology interpretation, yet their ability to perceive these details remains inadequate. This weakness leads to inaccurate cellular observations that can persist even when final answers are correct. In this paper, we propose ASPECT to improve visually grounded reasoning through explicit supervision of cellular appearance and abundance. ASPECT trains intermediate visual tokens through pathology feature reconstruction, cell feature alignment, and count supervision. Three-stage supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to perceive, generate visual tokens, and reason, followed by reinforcement learning that rewards answer correctness and consistency with reported measurements. We also introduce PathoVernier, a benchmark of 759 expert-reviewed questions from five pathology datasets covering four cellular composition tasks. It evaluates both final answers and intermediate measurements to expose errors hidden by answer accuracy. On PathoVernier, ASPECT achieves relative accuracy gains of approximately 19.2% over the strongest baseline, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and 99.3% over its Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, while reducing RAWR, which measures counting errors within correct responses, by 28.1% and 42.7%, respectively. ASPECT also improves over its backbone on three external pathology benchmarks covering classification and question answering beyond cellular composition tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ASPECT，通过显式监督细胞外观与数量来提升病理视觉语言模型的细粒度视觉推理能力，并发布 PathoVernier 基准以评估中间测量结果。
AI.motivation: 病理评估依赖对组织学图像细粒度视觉细节的识别，而现有视觉语言模型虽逐步支持病理判读，却难以准确感知这些细节，导致细胞层面的观察不准确，且这种错误即使最终答案正确也可能持续存在。
AI.method: ASPECT 对中间视觉 token 施加显式监督，包括病理特征重构、细胞特征对齐与计数监督；采用三阶段监督微调使模型依次学习感知、生成视觉 token 与推理；随后通过强化学习奖励答案正确性及与所报测量结果的一致性。
AI.result: 在 PathoVernier 上，ASPECT 相较最强基线 Gemini-3.1-Pro 取得约 19.2% 的相对准确率提升，相较其 Qwen3-VL-8B 主干提升 99.3%；同时将衡量正确回答中计数误差的 RAWR 分别降低 28.1% 与 42.7%。此外，在三个涵盖分类与问答的外部病理基准上亦优于其主干。
AI.conclusion: 显式监督细胞外观与数量可有效提升病理视觉语言模型的视觉 grounding 推理能力，PathoVernier 揭示出被答案准确率掩盖的中间测量错误，ASPECT 在细胞组成任务与更广泛病理任务上均表现优异。

title: MoSPR: Histology-to-Gene Expression Prediction with Morpho-Spatial Macrostates and Low-Rank Molecular Programs
summary: Predicting molecular profiles from histopathology remains challenging because whole-slide images contain spatially organized, heterogeneous tissue patterns, while gene expression comprises thousands of correlated targets. We introduce MoSPR (Morpho-Spatial Program Regression), a linear framework that couples an adjacency-informed histology representation with a low-rank molecular basis. MoSPR clusters frozen patch embeddings into morphology microstates, aggregates their spatial adjacencies across the training cohort, and groups microstates with similar adjacency patterns into shared macrostates. Each slide is then represented by global morphology and macrostate-specific deviations, which are linearly mapped to coefficients of a training-derived low-rank gene-expression basis. Across three cancer cohorts from The Cancer Genome Atlas, MoSPR achieves the highest mean gene-expression prediction scores among all evaluated methods. Without pathway-level supervision, pathway scores derived from its predicted expression profiles rank first in eight of nine comparisons across three pathway collections. Ablation studies on the breast cancer cohort show complementary gains from adjacency-derived macrostate representation and low-rank molecular prediction. Moreover, with half of the training data on this cohort, MoSPR exceeds the full-data gene-prediction score of the strongest competing baseline. Finally, its linear formulation enables exact decomposition of each predicted expression profile into global and macrostate-specific molecular contributions, providing an interpretable link between spatially coherent macrostate regions and their associated molecular programs. Our code is available at https://github.com/Radisen-Panthera/MoSPR.

AI.tldr: MoSPR是一个线性框架，通过将相邻性感知的组织学表征与低秩分子基耦合，从全切片病理图像预测基因表达图谱。
AI.motivation: 全切片图像包含空间组织化的异质组织模式，而基因表达涉及数千个相关靶标，从组织病理学预测分子图谱仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 将冻结的patch嵌入聚类为形态微状态，聚合训练队列中的空间相邻性，再将具有相似相邻模式的微状态分组为共享宏状态；每个切片用全局形态和宏状态特异性偏差表示，线性映射到训练所得低秩基因表达基的系数。
AI.result: 在TCGA三个癌症队列中取得最高平均基因表达预测分数；无通路级监督下，其预测表达的通路分数在三个通路集合的九次比较中八次排名第一；消融实验显示相邻性宏状态表征与低秩分子预测有互补增益；使用半数训练数据即超过最强基线全数据得分。
AI.conclusion: 线性形式支持精确分解预测表达为全局与宏状态特异性分子贡献，建立空间连贯宏状态区域与其分子程序的可解释联系。

title: Over-Personalization Is a Decision Failure: Generation-Induced Apply Bias in LLMs
summary: Personalized LLMs must decide, for each stored preference, whether the current context calls for applying or suppressing it, which we call its applicability. They frequently over-personalize, applying preferences the context rules out, yet existing benchmarks score only the final response and cannot tell where this failure arises. We decompose preference handling into three stages and measure each separately: (1) knowing whether a preference applies, (2) deciding on an explicit Apply/Suppress label, and (3) generating a response consistent with that label. Using linear probes, we first show that this applicability signal remains decodable from hidden states during generation. By making the decision explicit, we then find that in most settings wrong decisions faithfully followed outnumber correct decisions lost in generation. We thus locate the failure in the decision, which breaks once the model is also asked to answer. To determine whether this reflects lost sensitivity or a response bias, we propose ABIDE (Apply-Bias Investigation via Decision-score), which adapts signal detection theory to Apply-vs-Suppress decision scores read directly from logits. ABIDE reveals a generation-induced Apply bias: merely stating an answer-generation objective shifts the decision score toward Apply while sensitivity is largely preserved, and the shift persists under controls for prompt structure, cascades across preference slots, and prompt wording. Finally, we show that subtracting a single bias scalar, estimated on a held-out split, from the decision score at decoding time reduces leakage while largely preserving fulfillment.

AI.tldr: 该论文将个性化LLM的偏好处理分解为"判断适用性—显式Apply/Suppress决策—生成一致回复"三阶段，发现过度个性化主要源于生成目标引发的决策阶段"Apply偏差"，并提出ABIDE方法量化该偏差，通过解码时减去单一偏差标量即可在保持偏好满足的同时减少泄漏。
AI.motivation: 个性化LLM需对每条存储偏好判断当前语境是否应当应用，即"适用性"。模型常出现过度个性化（over-personalization），应用了语境已排除的偏好。然而现有基准只对最终回复打分，无法定位失败发生在哪个环节，因此需要将偏好处理分解并逐阶段测量。
AI.method: 将偏好处理分解为三阶段并分别测量：(1) 是否知道偏好适用；(2) 是否给出显式Apply/Suppress标签；(3) 是否生成与标签一致的回复。用线性探针证明适用性信号在生成过程中仍可从隐状态解码。据此把决策显式化，比较"错误决策被忠实执行"与"正确决策在生成中丢失"的数量。为区分敏感度下降与反应偏差，提出ABIDE（Apply-Bias Investigation via Decision-score），将信号检测理论适配到直接从logits读取的Apply-vs-Suppress决策分数，并设置提示结构、级联与措辞等控制实验。
AI.result: 多数设置下，被忠实执行的错误决策多于在生成中丢失的正确决策，说明失败发生在决策环节，且该决策在被要求同时作答后即失效。ABIDE揭示存在"生成诱发的Apply偏差"：仅仅引入答案生成目标就会把决策分数推向Apply，而敏感度基本保持不变；该偏移在提示结构控制下依然存在，会跨偏好槽位级联，且不受措辞影响。在留出划分上估计单一偏差标量、于解码时从决策分数中减去，可减少泄漏并大体保持偏好满足。
AI.conclusion: 过度个性化并非敏感度丧失，而是生成目标引入的系统性Apply偏差，且该偏差可被一个标量刻画。通过在解码时减去单一偏差标量，可在基本不损失偏好满足的前提下降低过度应用（泄漏），为个性化LLM的可控性提供了轻量、可解释的干预手段。

title: Dexterous Tactile World Model
summary: World models for manipulation are typically trained from video, yet the events that determine how manipulation unfolds, such as making and releasing contact, are difficult to observe visually and are often easier to sense through touch. We present the Dexterous Tactile World Model (DTWM), a video world model for future-frame prediction of egocentric manipulation from both observed video and tactile signals from a glove worn on each hand. We condition a pretrained video diffusion transformer on each hand's tactile signal through a zero-initialized residual at the corresponding hand location in the video tokens, while a causal mask prevents predicted frames from accessing future information. Compared with a vision-only model matched in architecture, parameters, and training, DTWM reduces the underestimation of hand motion from 23% to 9%, while reducing the perceptual error in the hand region by 7.4% across three training runs per model. The benefit also increases over the prediction horizon, with the improvement in the later predicted chunks being about 4.1x larger than in the first. DTWM also outperforms other visual-tactile world models under the same setting, and training with touch improves future-frame prediction even when no touch is available at inference. Ablations show that the model benefits from both the magnitude and spatial location of force: replacing the tactile signal with binary contact states, either per hand or per location, increases prediction error. The observed course of the force indicates whether the interaction will persist or change.

AI.tldr: DTWM是一种融合手部触觉信号的视频世界模型，通过零初始化残差将触觉注入预训练视频扩散Transformer，显著提升自我中心操作未来帧预测精度。
AI.motivation: 决定操作如何展开的关键事件（如接触的建立与释放）在视觉上难以观测，而通过触觉更容易感知，因此需要将触觉纳入视频世界模型。
AI.method: 在预训练视频扩散Transformer上，通过零初始化残差将每只手套的触觉信号注入到视频token中对应手部位置，并用因果掩码防止预测帧访问未来信息；与仅视觉模型在架构、参数和训练上保持一致进行对比。
AI.result: 手部运动低估率从23%降至9%，手部区域感知误差降低7.4%（每种模型三次训练）；预测时域越长收益越大，后期预测块的改进约为首块的4.1倍；优于同设定下的其他视觉-触觉世界模型；推理无触觉时训练中使用触觉仍有增益；消融表明力的大小与空间位置均有用，用二值接触状态替代触觉信号会增加预测误差。
AI.conclusion: 触觉信号可有效增强视频世界模型对未来操作帧的预测；力的大小与空间信息不可或缺，力的变化过程可指示交互将持续还是改变。

title: ReScraper: Unified Scraping and Cleaning of Web Data for Effective LLM Pretraining
summary: LLM pretraining corpora are normally cleaned by a stack of hand-written heuristics. A heuristic scraper extracts the main content from HTML, and dozens of rule-based filters then clean it, so corpus quality is capped by the coarseness and accuracy of the rules. In this work, we propose ReScraper, a unified language model of only 0.6B parameters that replaces this entire stack. To train ReScraper, we carefully curate supervised data from the outputs of three teacher models, so it learns to first extract the main content from raw data and then choose among four operations: keeping the page as extracted, editing out noisy lines and spans, deleting it entirely, or rewriting it when it is poorly written but informative. Based on the same crawled data pool, pretraining 400M, 1.4B, and 2.8B models on our curated data improves the DCLM Core score by a relative 3.8--4.7% over the strongest baseline at each scale, including the costly multi-agent curation. Our analyses show that each operation plays a distinct and complementary role, and that extracting and cleaning in one model outperforms a cascade of separate models. ReScraper also concentrates its operations on the pages that need them, raising the quality of poor pages the most while keeping the corpus diverse. These results demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of AI4AI for pretraining data curation, where a small learned model takes over an entire stage of the pipeline from hand-written heuristics. We open-source our code at https://github.com/cxcscmu/ReScraper

AI.tldr: ReScraper 用一个仅 0.6B 参数的统一语言模型取代传统"启发式抽取器+规则过滤器"的预训练语料清洗流水线，在相同数据池上使 DCLM Core 分数相对提升 3.8–4.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练语料依赖手写启发式规则堆叠（HTML 主内容抽取 + 数十条规则过滤），语料质量受规则粗糙度与准确率上限所限。作者希望用小型学习模型整体替代这一阶段，验证 AI4AI 在数据治理上的可行性。
AI.method: 提出 ReScraper，0.6B 参数的统一语言模型。从三个教师模型输出中精心构造监督数据；模型先抽取网页主内容，再在四种操作中选择：保留、编辑（去除噪声行与片段）、整页删除、或在信息有用但表达差时重写。
AI.result: 基于同一爬取数据池，用 ReScraper 处理的数据预训练 400M、1.4B、2.8B 模型，DCLM Core 分数在各规模上相对最强基线（含高成本多智能体治理）提升 3.8–4.7%。分析显示四种操作角色互补；抽取与清洗合一优于多模型级联；操作集中于真正需要的页面，对低质页面提升最大且保持语料多样性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明小型学习模型可接管整段启发式流水线，证明 AI4AI 用于预训练数据治理的可行性与有效性。代码已开源。

title: Semantic Modality Compensation for Unsupervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-identification under Unpaired Settings
comment: We find some questions in this paper
summary: Unsupervised visible-infrared person re-identification (USL-VI-ReID) learns person representations that can be compared across modalities without identity annotations. In the unpaired setting, however, identity correspondences between modalities are often incomplete, leaving many identities without an observed counterpart in the other modality. Existing unpaired methods bridge this gap by generating or mapping features for the other modality, mainly by exploiting the statistics of visual features without explicitly separating content that is discriminative for identity from style that is specific to modality. Consequently, the generated features may distort identity cues or inherit bias from the source modality, undermining the reliability of supervision across modalities. We formulate unpaired learning across modalities as a semantic compensation problem and propose Semantic Modality Compensation (SMC), a framework based on prompt composition that decouples identity semantics from modality style within a shared visual semantic space. SMC first constructs a discriminative ReID space through augmented dual contrastive learning, yielding pseudo labels, cluster prototypes, and memory banks for each modality. It then learns visible and infrared modality prompts in the CLIP semantic space and maps clusters obtained from pseudo labels to identity semantic tokens. For each cluster lacking a reliable match in the other modality, SMC combines its identity token with the prompt for the target modality to synthesize a semantic counterpart in the missing modality. The synthesized counterpart is then projected back into the ReID space and injected into a compensation memory through confidence gating. Extensive experiments under both paired and unpaired settings demonstrate that SMC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with particularly large gains when identity mismatch is severe.

AI.tldr: 本文将非配对可见光-红外行人重识别（USL-VI-ReID）建模为语义补偿问题，提出基于提示组合的语义模态补偿框架SMC，通过解耦身份语义与模态风格在共享视觉语义空间中合成缺失模态的语义对应物，在配对与非配对设置下均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 非配对场景下，跨模态的身份对应往往不完整，许多身份在另一模态中没有观测到的对应样本。现有方法主要通过生成或映射特征来弥补这一缺口，但仅利用视觉特征统计量，未显式区分对身份具有判别性的内容与模态特有的风格。因此生成的特征可能扭曲身份线索或继承源模态偏差，损害跨模态监督的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出语义模态补偿（SMC）框架，基于提示组合在共享视觉语义空间中将身份语义与模态风格解耦。首先通过增强的双重对比学习构建判别性ReID空间，为每个模态产生伪标签、聚类原型和记忆库；随后在CLIP语义空间中学习可见光与红外模态提示，并将由伪标签得到的聚类映射为身份语义令牌；对每个在另一模态缺乏可靠匹配的聚类，将其身份令牌与目标模态提示组合，合成缺失模态中的语义对应物；合成结果经投影回ReID空间后，通过置信度门控注入补偿记忆库。
AI.result: 在配对与非配对两种设置下的大量实验表明，SMC持续优于当前最先进方法，且在身份不匹配严重时提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 将非配对跨模态学习形式化为语义补偿问题是有效的；借助提示组合解耦身份语义与模态风格，可在缺失模态中合成可靠的语义对应物，从而缓解身份对应不完整带来的监督不可靠问题。

title: Dr.Credit: Rubric-Grounded Process Credit Assignment for Deep Research Agents
summary: Rubric-based tasks are increasingly addressed through reinforcement learning (RL), with rubric scores used as training rewards. However, these rewards typically supervise final answers without distinguishing the contributions of intermediate decisions. Many existing credit assignment methods rely on ground-truth answers to define process rewards, limiting their applicability to open-ended tasks without canonical solutions. To address this limitation, the proposed rubric-grounded credit uses task requirements as a shared reference for final answer evaluation and process supervision. The information returned by tools is assessed for the additional support it provides toward satisfying each rubric relative to that rubric's history of accepted support. By referencing these histories, credit distinguishes new support from evidence already present in the trajectory while recognizing partial support for each rubric. Dr.Credit uses rubric-grounded credit to supervise intermediate tool turns in an RL framework for deep research agents. The resulting process advantages are combined with GRPO outcome advantages to guide research decisions while retaining supervision of final-report quality. Evaluations on four in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks show that Dr.Credit outperforms the evaluated open deep research baselines on every primary metric and submetric. Meanwhile, with an 8B-parameter backbone, the trained agent achieves average performance competitive with the evaluated frontier proprietary models. Further analyses suggest more efficient evidence acquisition and higher-quality reports under limited research-turn budgets, motivating the extension of rubric-grounded process supervision to a broader range of rubric-based tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Dr.Credit，以评分标准（rubric）作为共享参照进行过程信用分配，在RL框架中监督深度研究智能体的中间工具调用，结合GRPO结果优势，8B模型即可比肩前沿专有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于评分标准的RL任务通常只用rubric分数监督最终答案，无法区分中间决策的贡献；已有信用分配方法依赖标准答案定义过程奖励，难以适用于无唯一解的开放式任务。
AI.method: 以任务要求（rubric）作为最终答案评估与过程监督的共享参照。对工具返回的信息，评估其相对于该rubric历史已接受支持所额外提供的支持程度：参照历史区分"新支持"与轨迹中已有的证据，并识别对每个rubric的部分支持。将所得过程优势与GRPO的结果优势结合，用于指导研究决策，同时保留对最终报告质量的监督。
AI.result: 在四个域内与域外基准上，Dr.Credit在所有主指标与子指标上均优于所评估的开源深度研究基线；以8B参数骨干训练所得智能体平均表现与所评估的前沿专有模型相当。进一步分析显示，在有限研究轮次预算下，证据获取更高效、报告质量更高。
AI.conclusion: rubric-grounded信用分配有效解决了开放式任务的过程监督难题，值得推广到更广泛的基于评分标准的任务中。

title: PSM: Dataset Distillation Based on Precise Statistical Matching by Difficulty
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) condenses a large original dataset into a small distilled dataset with high training utility. Decoupled statistical matching methods substantially reduce distillation time and memory overhead while achieving strong performance. However, they typically supervise all distilled samples using running statistics estimated from the entire original dataset. These statistics mainly capture the average feature distribution while overlooking differences in sample difficulty, limiting their ability to characterize the difficulty structure of the original data. To address this issue, we propose Precise Statistical Matching (PSM) by difficulty. After pretraining, PSM uses the Global Precision Score (GPS) to estimate image difficulty, ranks the samples within each class, and partitions each class into IPC (images per class) difficulty groups. During distillation, Statistics Updated Again (SUA) updates the teacher's batch normalization (BN) running statistics through forward passes on original samples from each group, providing difficulty-specific supervision for the corresponding distilled batch. Meanwhile, Initial Sample Screening (ISS) initializes distilled samples using original images from the corresponding difficulty group, providing an effective starting point for precise matching. Experiments across multiple datasets and model architectures demonstrate that PSM broadens the difficulty range of distilled samples and improves downstream performance in most evaluated settings. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"按难度精确统计匹配"(PSM)的数据集蒸馏方法,通过GPS难度估计、SUA统计更新与ISS初始化,使蒸馏样本获得按难度分组的特异监督,扩大难度覆盖并提升下游性能。
AI.motivation: 现有解耦统计匹配方法虽大幅降低蒸馏时间与内存开销,但通常用基于整个原始数据集估计的running statistics监督所有蒸馏样本;这些统计量只反映平均特征分布,忽略样本难度差异,难以刻画原始数据的难度结构。
AI.method: PSM包含三部分:(1)预训练后用Global Precision Score(GPS)估计图像难度,在每类内排序并将每类划分为IPC(images per class)个难度组;(2)Statistics Updated Again(SUA)通过对各组原始样本前向传播更新教师BN的running statistics,为对应蒸馏批次提供难度特异的监督;(3)Initial Sample Screening(ISS)用对应难度组的原始图像初始化蒸馏样本,提供精确匹配的良好起点。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和模型架构上的实验表明,PSM拓宽了蒸馏样本的难度范围,并在多数评测设定下提升了下游性能。
AI.conclusion: 按难度进行精确统计匹配可有效弥补平均统计量对难度结构刻画不足的问题,是一种兼顾效率与性能的数据集蒸馏改进方向,代码将开源。

title: CAT-Free: Multi-View Pedestrian Localization without Calibration, Annotations, or Target-Scene Training via Adaptive Geometric Filtering
summary: Multi-camera pedestrian localization is useful for wide-area monitoring in public and commercial spaces. However, deploying these systems often requires considerable setup for each new environment. Existing methods typically require camera calibration, position annotations, or target-scene training. CAT-Free removes all three requirements. It uses synchronized RGB video as its only scene-specific input. Camera configuration is estimated directly from the video. Pedestrian locations are then estimated by combining observations from multiple cameras. Automatic camera estimation is not always accurate. This can produce unreliable pedestrian locations. CAT-Free therefore introduces two adaptive geometric filters. They remove unreliable position estimates. Their thresholds are estimated from each input sequence. CAT-Free achieves 82.5, 84.5, and 65.7 MODA on WildTrack, MultiviewX, and GMVD. It uses no supplied calibration, position annotations, or target-scene training. Published methods using such scene-specific information report 88.2--95.0 MODA on WildTrack and 83.9--96.5 on MultiviewX under their respective protocols. CAT-Free also transfers without retuning. It reaches 74.9 MODA on four additional sequences and 78.6 on an unseen 8-camera installation. Finally, localization uncertainty predicts MODA with $r=-0.98$. This provides a label-free estimate of localization reliability.

AI.tldr: CAT-Free 是一种无需相机标定、位置标注或目标场景训练的多相机行人定位方法，仅用同步 RGB 视频估计相机配置并融合多视角观测，通过两种自适应几何滤波器剔除不可靠估计，在 WildTrack、MultiviewX、GMVD 上分别达到 82.5、84.5、65.7 MODA，并具备免微调迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多相机行人定位系统部署成本高，通常需要逐场景的相机标定、位置标注或目标场景训练；这些步骤费时费力且难以快速迁移到新环境，因此需要一种完全不依赖场景特定先验的方法。
AI.method: 仅以同步 RGB 视频作为场景特定输入：直接从视频估计相机配置，再通过多相机观测融合估计行人位置；由于自动相机估计不总是准确，引入两种自适应几何滤波器，其阈值从每条输入序列中估计，用于剔除不可靠的位置估计。
AI.result: 在 WildTrack、MultiviewX、GMVD 上分别取得 82.5、84.5、65.7 MODA，且不使用标定、位置标注或目标场景训练；使用此类场景特定信息的已发表方法在各自协议下于 WildTrack 报告 88.2–95.0 MODA、MultiviewX 报告 83.9–96.5。CAT-Free 免微调迁移至四个额外序列达 74.9 MODA，在未见过的 8 相机装置上达 78.6 MODA；定位不确定性可预测 MODA（r=-0.98），提供无标签的定位可靠性估计。
AI.conclusion: CAT-Free 在完全免除相机标定、位置标注和目标场景训练的前提下，取得了接近依赖场景特定信息方法的定位精度，并展现出良好的免微调迁移能力；其定位不确定性还能作为无标签的可靠性指标，为便捷部署与可靠性评估提供了可行路径。

title: MaLiang-Harness: A Programmable Path to Image and Video Generation
summary: Executable programs offer explicit control over how images and videos are constructed, but generating runnable code is only the beginning of visual creation. A program can execute correctly while violating the requested composition, appearance, or motion. We define this discrepancy as the Program-to-Visual (P2V) gap and introduce MaLiang-Harness, a unified framework for organizing MLLM-driven visual generation into a persistent process of construction, inspection, and revision. Its central design is to make the evolving visual program, its construction history, and its verification share a common revision reference. We define the Persistent Executable Generation (PEG) state as preserving programs and task context. Traceable Generation Process (TGP) connects edits to rendered evidence, and Revision-aware Editing and Verification (REV) supports restoration and checks the current revision before completion. Together, these mechanisms coordinate planning, execution, and visual feedback across rendering backends. We evaluate 11 powerful closed-source MLLMs on MaLiang-IBench and four on MaLiang-VBench, measuring generation success, visual quality, and computational cost. GPT-6-Astra achieves 100% generation success on both benchmarks, with 96.0% of image tasks and 76.9% of video tasks meeting all quality thresholds. The comparison also reveals a mismatch between general capability scores and visual generation performance, with similarly scored models differing substantially in their ability to satisfy visual requirements. MaLiang-Harness provides a systematic basis for studying how MLLMs translate executable code into visual outcomes, exposing both the potential of programmable generation and the limitations of general benchmarks as predictors of this ability. The project is available at https://github.com/gulucaptain/MaLiang-Harness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"程序到视觉（P2V）差距"概念，并设计MaLiang-Harness统一框架，将MLLM驱动的视觉生成组织为"构建—检查—修订"的持续过程，通过PEG、TGP、REV三项机制协调规划、执行与视觉反馈。在MaLiang-IBench与MaLiang-VBench上评估多个闭源MLLM，GPT-6-Astra实现100%生成成功率，并揭示通用能力评分与视觉生成表现之间的错配。
AI.motivation: 可执行程序虽能对图像和视频的构建方式提供显式控制，但生成可运行代码只是视觉创作的开端。程序可能正确执行，却违背所要求的构图、外观或运动，这一偏差被定义为Program-to-Visual (P2V) gap。现有工作缺乏系统化框架来组织MLLM驱动的可编程视觉生成，也缺少合适的评测基准，因此需要统一的构建、检查与修订机制及配套benchmark。
AI.method: 提出MaLiang-Harness框架，核心设计是让不断演化的视觉程序、其构建历史与验证过程共享同一修订参照。定义Persistent Executable Generation (PEG)状态以保存程序与任务上下文；Traceable Generation Process (TGP)将编辑与渲染证据关联；Revision-aware Editing and Verification (REV)支持恢复并在完成前检查当前修订。三者共同跨渲染后端协调规划、执行与视觉反馈。在MaLiang-IBench（11个闭源MLLM）和MaLiang-VBench（4个模型）上评测生成成功率、视觉质量与计算成本。
AI.result: GPT-6-Astra在两个benchmark上均达到100%生成成功率，图像任务中96.0%、视频任务中76.9%满足全部质量阈值。对比还发现通用能力评分与视觉生成表现之间存在错配，得分相近的模型在满足视觉需求的能力上差异显著。
AI.conclusion: MaLiang-Harness为研究MLLM如何将可执行代码转化为视觉结果提供了系统性基础，既展现了可编程生成的潜力，也暴露了通用benchmark作为该能力预测指标的局限性。项目已开源。

title: ControlScope: Workflow Revision and Reliability in LLM Agents
summary: How much of a running workflow should a language model agent revise? ControlScope compares continuing generated code, editing the next tool call's data arguments, and replacing the unfinished workflow from the same public execution state. The nested permissions separate available repairs from the actions an agent selects. We evaluate one-time and repeated reviews across filesystem tasks, ALFWorld, and AppWorld. Across two source programs per task and three reasoning-reviewer draws on 20 filesystem tasks, FULL completes 15-16 tasks versus 13 for KEEP; across four fast draws it completes 10-13 versus 13. Fresh student-record confirmation reproduces a batch-read repair. ALFWorld fast panels yield KEEP/ARG/FULL scores of 85/86/87 on 87 tasks across 52 scenes and 134/134/127 on 134 tasks across four scenes; reasoning on the 87-task cohort also yields 85/86/87 with substantial review cost. An AppWorld V1 official-test panel of 585 task instances from 195 scenario templates shows small net differences. Frozen replays expose viable agent-written replacements interrupted by later revision in two failed file-organization runs. An offline source-trajectory midpoint comparison shows later reviews completing an insufficient repair. Five-call protection saves 19.4% of logged model output and loses one success across 20 fresh source runs. An argument-only shortcut shows that the broader sampled policy can overlook a cheaper successful edit available in both operation sets. These outcomes tie repair access to actual choices and subsequent execution.

AI.tldr: ControlScope 是一个研究"语言模型智能体应当修订多少未完成工作流"的框架，通过在同一公开执行状态下比较继续生成代码、编辑下一次工具调用的数据参数、以及整体替换未完成工作流三种修复策略，并区分"可用的修复权限"与"智能体实际选择的操作"，在文件系统任务、ALFWorld 与 AppWorld 上进行一次性与重复评审评估。
AI.motivation: 针对语言模型智能体在工作流执行中出错后应进行多大幅度的修复这一问题，现有研究尚不清楚不同修复范围（继续、局部编辑、整体替换）之间的权衡，以及"可用修复权限"与"实际选择动作"之间的差异。作者希望将修复访问权限与实际选择及后续执行结果联系起来。
AI.method: ControlScope 在同一公开执行状态下对比三种策略：继续生成代码（KEEP）、编辑下一次工具调用的数据参数（ARG）、替换未完成工作流（FULL），并以嵌套权限区分可用修复与实际选定动作。评估覆盖文件系统任务、ALFWorld 和 AppWorld，采用一次性与重复评审、不同推理-评审抽样次数，并辅以冻结回放、离线源轨迹中点比较、五调用保护以及仅参数快捷实验。
AI.result: 在 20 个文件系统任务中，每个任务两个源程序、三次推理-评审抽样下，FULL 完成 15-16 个任务而 KEEP 完成 13 个；四次快速抽样下 FULL 为 10-13 而 KEEP 为 13。ALFWorld 快速面板在 87 个任务（52 个场景）上 KEEP/ARG/FULL 得分为 85/86/87，在 134 个任务（四个场景）上为 134/134/127；87 任务队列的推理评审同样为 85/86/87 但评审成本显著。AppWorld V1 官方测试面板（195 个场景模板的 585 个任务实例）显示净差异较小。冻结回放暴露了两次失败的文件组织运行中可行的智能体编写替换被后续修订打断；离线源轨迹中点比较显示后续评审完成了不充分的修复；五调用保护节省 19.4% 的已记录模型输出并在 20 次新鲜源运行中失去一次成功；仅参数快捷实验表明更宽泛的采样策略可能忽略两种操作集中都存在的更廉价成功编辑。
AI.conclusion: 修复访问权限应与智能体的实际选择及后续执行结果紧密关联；不同修复范围在成功率与评审成本之间存在权衡，整体替换未必总优于继续或局部编辑，且更宽泛的采样策略可能错过更廉价的可行编辑。这些发现把修复访问权限与真实决策和最终执行表现联系起来。

title: PlaylistEval: Can Video-Language Judges Be Trusted at Day Scale and Beyond?
comment: 53 pages, 15 figures, 23 tables. Project page: https://playlisteval.github.io
summary: Video-language models are increasingly used as judges of video understanding, both for evaluating model outputs and for training reward models. Whether their judgments remain reliable when the evidence is buried in day-long videos has yet to be established. Existing benchmarks cannot answer this. Their videos are typically only a few minutes long, many answer pairs can be separated from the transcript alone, and collecting human judgments does not scale to ultra-long videos. We introduce PlaylistEval, an agentic framework that builds video-language judge benchmarks over 100-hour playlist collection without human annotation. It automatically generates questions with paired answers whose differences are controlled by causal degradation, so that every pair demands retrieval across the collection. The resulting benchmark contains 630 pairs across seven domains spanning both static and dynamic knowledge, and on a stratified subset of 152 pairs it agrees with human judgments 93.0% of the time (IAA 0.781). Evaluating 17 omnimodal and multimodal models from eight families reveals that frontier judges reach only 75.4% pairwise accuracy, while open-source judge models perform far behind. We further show that both retrieval and final judgment depend on using multiple modalities, and that judge accuracy degrades as the playlist set grows. We release our pipeline, benchmark, and evaluation code at https://playlisteval.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PlaylistEval，一个无需人工标注的智能体框架，用于在100小时级播放列表视频上构建视频-语言评判基准，包含630对因果受控问答对，并揭示前沿模型在超长视频理解评判上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 视频-语言模型被日渐用作视频理解评判器（评测模型输出、训练奖励模型），但其在证据埋藏于全天级长视频时的判断可靠性尚未确立。现有基准无法回答这一问题：视频通常仅几分钟、许多答案对仅凭转录即可区分，且人工标注无法扩展到超长视频。
AI.method: 提出 PlaylistEval 智能体框架，在100小时级播放列表集合上自动构建视频-语言评判基准，无需人工标注。自动生成配对答案，其差异由因果退化（causal degradation）控制，使每一对都必须跨集合检索。基准含7个领域、630对样本，覆盖静态与动态知识；并在152对分层子集上与人类判断验证一致性。
AI.result: 在152对分层子集上与人类判断一致率93.0%（IAA 0.781）。评测8个家族17个全模态与多模态模型：前沿评判器仅达75.4%成对准确率，开源评判模型远落后。检索与最终判断均依赖多模态使用；随播放列表集合增大，评判准确率下降。
AI.conclusion: PlaylistEval 填补了超长视频评判基准的空白，证明现有模型在百小时级证据检索与评判上仍不可靠，并公开流水线、基准与评测代码。

title: Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching: A Training-Free Framework for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable generalizable robotic control but remain computationally expensive. Token caching provides a training-free, plug-and-play acceleration alternative. However, existing VLA caching does not fully exploit a key inductive bias of VLA models: text-vision synergy, wherein textual semantics guide the precise visual grounding of task-relevant regions. In particular, existing designs insufficiently account for head-wise reliability in attention aggregation and layer-wise stability in cache reuse. To address this, we propose Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching (TVCache), a training-free framework for efficient VLA inference. TVCache filters attention heads based on text-vision information focus to improve task-relevant and physically consistent visual grounding. Concurrently, we introduce a reuse-layer selection mechanism guided by text-vision entropy differences to avoid caching unstable representations and improve cache resource allocation. Extensive experiments across four representative VLA models, two simulation benchmarks, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of TVCache. At matched token-retention ratios, TVCache consistently improves task success over existing VLA caching with comparable computational cost. On OpenVLA-OFT, it improves average success by up to 14.5 percentage points over VLA-Cache at 12.5% retention while reducing FLOPs by 2.45x relative to full-token inference.

AI.tldr: TVCache：基于文本-视觉协同的无训练Token缓存框架，用于VLA模型高效推理。
AI.motivation: VLA模型可实现泛化性机器人控制，但计算开销高；现有token缓存方法未充分利用VLA模型的文本-视觉协同归纳偏置，且忽视注意力聚合中的头级可靠性与缓存复用中的层间稳定性。
AI.method: 提出TVCache无训练框架：基于文本-视觉信息聚焦度筛选注意力头，提升任务相关且物理一致的视觉定位；引入以文本-视觉熵差引导的复用层选择机制，避免缓存不稳定表征并优化缓存资源分配。
AI.result: 在4个代表性VLA模型、2个仿真基准及真实机器人任务上验证有效性；相同token保留率下任务成功率一致优于现有VLA缓存且计算成本相当；在OpenVLA-OFT上，12.5%保留率时较VLA-Cache平均成功率最高提升14.5个百分点，相比全token推理FLOPs降低2.45倍。
AI.conclusion: TVCache通过挖掘文本-视觉协同偏置与层间稳定性，实现无训练、即插即用的VLA推理加速，效果与通用性俱佳。

title: Certified Selective Automation of LLM Agent Evaluation
summary: Evaluating LLM agents still ends with a human reading trajectories, because automatic judges carry no guarantee on how often they are wrong. We ask the operational question: what fraction of agent evaluation can a judge take over, with a certificate that the error rate among auto-decided trajectories stays below a budget alpha? Agent corpora resist the standard answer: many agents attempt the same tasks, so trajectories arrive in correlated clusters, and the i.i.d. certificates of existing selective-judging methods can overstate what is safe: a naive certificate can claim 98% automation while its realized error exceeds the budget in 17.5% of task resamples. We introduce a task-level bootstrap certificate that is valid in every regime we test while matching the naive certificate's coverage; finite-sample cluster-valid alternatives certify nothing at realistic task counts. Under this certificate, a 4B logprob judge trained with SFT and reject-weighted GRPO certifies 0.30-0.59 of evaluation on tool-use and web corpora at alpha=0.1, the only judge, among strongly elicited frontier models, certifying on both headline corpora. Certified coverage is predictable before training from base rate and discrimination alone (leave-one-corpus-out R^2=0.96). Finally, the certificate doubles as a self-training filter: pseudo-labels harvested inside certified regions have contamination bounded by alpha by construction (realized 0.000-0.041 across six harvests), letting a judge enter an unseen domain at in-domain strength with zero target training labels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任务级bootstrap证书，量化LLM智能体评估中judge可接管的比例，在保证自动决策错误率低于预算α的前提下实现选择性评估。
AI.motivation: LLM agent评估仍依赖人工阅读轨迹，因为自动judge无法保证错误率。现有选择性judge方法假设i.i.d.，而agent语料中同一任务有多条相关轨迹，形成相关簇，导致证书高估安全性（如naive证书声称98%自动化，实际错误率在17.5%的任务重采样中超标）。
AI.method: 提出任务级bootstrap证书（task-level bootstrap certificate），在测试的各场景下均有效且覆盖率与naive证书相当；用SFT和reject-weighted GRPO训练4B logprob judge；证书同时作为自训练过滤器，认证区域内伪标签污染由构造限定在α内。
AI.result: 在α=0.1下，该judge在工具使用和网页语料上认证0.30-0.59的评估比例，是强elicited前沿模型中唯一在两个主语料上均认证的judge。认证覆盖率可由base rate和区分度预测（留一语料R^2=0.96）。六次harvest实现污染0.000-0.041。
