AI.conclusion: 任务级bootstrap证书在相关簇数据下提供有效的选择性judge误差保证，可实现无需目标域标签的域内强度迁移，并约束伪标签污染。

title: DORA: Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent for Token Pruning in Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) incur quadratic self-attention cost in the number of tokens. Most token-reduction methods adapt token identities within a prescribed layer-wise compression schedule, or search a static mask offline, and thus limit online adaptation of when and how much to prune. We propose DORA (Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent), which learns an input-adaptive pruning policy itself for frozen ViTs. At each eligible block, a hierarchical actor decides whether to prune, how many tokens to remove, and which tokens to remove from each image's evolving representation. Because early deletions change the states observed by later decisions, DORA formulates pruning as a finite-horizon Markov decision process. Complete-prefix shadow evaluations convert final-prediction fidelity into localized per-step credit, while closed-loop accuracy feedback adjusts the fidelity penalty toward a shared accuracy-drop target. A privileged critic and all shadow computations are training-only. Deployment retains the frozen backbone and a lightweight actor that applies hard deletion and packed variable-length FlashAttention, converting token reduction into measured speedups. On ImageNet-1K with DeiT-Base, DORA reduces FLOPs by 38.4% relative to the uncompressed backbone within one percentage point of accuracy loss. Averaged across four ViT-type backbones at matched accuracy, DORA uses 13.2% fewer FLOPs and achieves 32.4% higher throughput than the corresponding per-backbone baseline means. Under zero-shot transfer to ImageNet-A, these gains widen to 20.3% and 45.6%, respectively.

AI.tldr: DORA提出一种面向冻结ViT的动态在线强化学习剪枝代理，通过分层actor在每个可剪枝block自适应决策是否剪、剪多少、剪哪些token，将剪枝建模为有限时域MDP，在ImageNet-1K上以约1%精度损失减少38.4% FLOPs。
AI.motivation: ViT自注意力计算量随token数呈二次增长。现有token缩减方法要么在预设的逐层压缩计划内调整token身份，要么离线搜索静态掩码，无法在线自适应地决定"何时剪"和"剪多少"，限制了压缩的灵活性与效率。
AI.method: 提出DORA（Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent），为冻结ViT学习输入自适应的剪枝策略。在每个可用block，分层actor决定是否剪枝、剪除token数量以及从该图像演化表示中移除哪些token。由于早期删除会改变后续决策观测到的状态，将剪枝形式化为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程。采用完整前缀影子评估将最终预测保真度转化为逐步的局部信用，并通过闭环精度反馈将保真度惩罚调整至共享的精度下降目标。特权critic与所有影子计算仅用于训练；部署时仅保留冻结骨干与轻量actor，执行硬删除与打包变长FlashAttention，实现可测量的加速。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上以DeiT-Base为骨干，DORA相对未压缩骨干减少38.4% FLOPs，精度损失在1个百分点以内。在四个ViT类骨干上以匹配精度平均，DORA比各骨干对应基线平均少用13.2% FLOPs，吞吐量高32.4%。零样本迁移到ImageNet-A时，增益扩大至20.3%和45.6%。
AI.conclusion: DORA通过在线强化学习实现输入自适应、动态时机的token剪枝，在保持精度的同时显著降低FLOPs并提升实际吞吐，且在零样本迁移场景下增益更大，验证了动态在线剪枝策略优于静态或预设调度的压缩方案。

title: Knowing When Thinking Is Not Enough: Teaching Small Reasoning Models to Reason Beyond Their Parametric Knowledge
summary: Scaling test-time computation is a powerful way to improve language-model reasoning, and is particularly appealing for small reasoning models (sRMs) that are cheap to serve. However, is additional thinking always the right operation? By intervening at intermediate reasoning states across two model families and multiple scales, we find that self-refinement largely consolidates probability mass onto solutions already reachable from the current state, rather than making new ones reachable. These interventions reveal two failure regimes: execution bottlenecks, where the correct path is reachable and reflection can recover it, and knowledge bottlenecks, where relevant external information makes it reachable. Motivated by this distinction, we introduce FlyBy, a selective querying framework, and train 4B and 8B variants to reason first, diagnose what remains unresolved, and, at a knowledge bottleneck, query stronger models whose parametric knowledge extends beyond its own. Supervised fine-tuning bootstraps a multi-depth query action, and cost-aware reinforcement learning calibrates whether to query, what to ask, and how much to spend. On 1,158 hard problems across six benchmarks, FlyBy-4B achieves 45.96% pass@8, surpassing Qwen3-14B (41.64%) at 2.7 times lower serving cost, while also exceeding Qwen3-8B in pass@1 (16.85% vs. 15.31%). Scaling to FlyBy-8B further improves pass@8 to 51.81%.

AI.tldr: 论文指出小推理模型的额外思考主要巩固已有可达解而非拓展新解，识别出"执行瓶颈"与"知识瓶颈"两类失效模式，据此提出选择性查询框架FlyBy，在知识瓶颈时查询更强模型，实现低成本的推理性能提升。
AI.motivation: 扩展测试时计算（test-time computation）是提升语言模型推理能力的有效手段，对小推理模型（sRMs）尤其有吸引力，因为其服务成本低。但作者质疑"额外思考是否总是正确的操作"，即自我精炼是否真能带来新解。
AI.method: 通过在两个模型家族、多种规模上的中间推理状态进行干预实验，发现自我精炼主要将概率质量集中到当前状态已可达的解上。据此区分两类失效机制：执行瓶颈（正确路径可达，反思可恢复）和知识瓶颈（需外部相关知识才可达）。提出FlyBy选择性查询框架，训练4B与8B变体：先推理、诊断未解决部分，在知识瓶颈处查询参数知识更强的模型。采用监督微调引导多深度查询动作，并用成本感知强化学习校准是否查询、查询内容与开销。
AI.result: 在六个基准的1158个难题上，FlyBy-4B达到45.96% pass@8，超过Qwen3-14B（41.64%）且服务成本低2.7倍，pass@1（16.85%）也超过Qwen3-8B（15.31%）；FlyBy-8B进一步将pass@8提升至51.81%。
AI.conclusion: 自我精炼在测试时计算中主要起"巩固"而非"拓展"作用，因此针对知识瓶颈进行选择性外部查询比无差别增加思考更有效，FlyBy以更低成本实现了对更大模型的性能超越。

title: MiCo: Mutual Information Coverage Optimization through Semantic Erasure Modeling for Efficient MLLM Inference
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in multimodal understanding, but processing large numbers of visual tokens results in high computational costs. While many methods have been proposed to reduce the number of visual tokens, most of them rely on heuristics and are prone to discarding substantial visual information during pruning, leading to degradation in model performance. In this work, by using a semantic erasure model, we derive a general mutual information coverage objective from task log-loss and propose MiCo, a training-free two-stage pruning method. MiCo first uses visual signals to select a representative candidate pool before visual tokens enter the language model, then performs task-aware subset selection within it. At each stage, suitable observable proxies instantiate the derived objective as a monotone submodular coverage function, which MiCo greedily optimizes under the token budget. MiCo is evaluated on diverse MLLMs ranging from 7B to 13B parameters across a broad range of image and video benchmarks spanning general visual reasoning, fine-grained OCR and grounding, hallucination detection, and long-video understanding. MiCo consistently achieves the best performance across nearly all evaluated models under all pruning ratios. On LLaVA-NEXT-13B, MiCo uses only 5.6% visual tokens, retains 97.5% of baseline performance, and achieves a 3.8-fold inference speedup. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MiCo and our mutual information coverage objective for visual token pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练两阶段视觉token剪枝方法MiCo，从任务log-loss推导出互信息覆盖目标，利用子模覆盖函数贪心优化，在多种MLLM上实现高效高保真的剪枝效果。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型理解性能优异，但大量视觉token导致计算开销高。现有剪枝方法多依赖启发式规则，容易丢弃大量视觉信息，造成模型性能下降。
AI.method: 借助语义擦除模型，从任务log-loss推导出通用互信息覆盖目标；提出免训练两阶段剪枝方法MiCo：第一阶段在视觉token进入语言模型前用视觉信号选择代表性候选池，第二阶段在候选池内做任务感知子集选择。每阶段用合适的可观测代理将目标实例化为单调子模覆盖函数，并在token预算下贪心优化。
AI.result: 在7B到13B参数的多类MLLM及图像/视频基准（通用视觉推理、细粒度OCR与定位、幻觉检测、长视频理解）上评测。MiCo在所有剪枝比例下几乎均取得最佳性能。在LLaVA-NEXT-13B上仅用5.6%视觉token即保留97.5%基线性能，推理加速3.8倍。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了MiCo及所提出的互信息覆盖目标在视觉token剪枝上的有效性。

title: SkillPE: Creativity-Oriented Cinematic Skill Evolution for Text-to-Video Prompt Engineering
summary: Achieving high-quality, cinematic results in text-to-video generation remains challenging for non-experts, whose prompts often lack professional narrative and creative design. We propose SkillPE, a prompt engineering (PE) framework that evolves reusable cinematic skills from expert-authored seeds. SkillPE represents shot logic, composition, lighting, sound design, and other filmmaking cues in a fine-grained format, and retrieves movie references categorized as resonators (good matches), dissonants (weak matches), and divergents (creatively useful near-misses). The first two refine when and how a skill should be applied, while divergents inspire alternative cinematic realizations at different degrees of modification while preserving the user intent. Candidate skills are assessed through generated videos along prompt fidelity, cinematic quality, narrative appeal, and creativity to construct the final skill libraries. Experiments on StoryEval and VBench show improvements of up to 1.40 points over the strongest external baseline and 0.51 points over seed skills on 7-point four-dimensional evaluation, while remaining competitive on benchmark-native metrics. Overall, SkillPE offers a practical approach to balancing fidelity and creativity in cinematic text-to-video generation. Code is available at https://github.com/Ais0n/SkillPE .

AI.tldr: 提出 SkillPE 框架，通过从专家撰写的种子中演化可复用的电影化提示技能，提升非专家在文生视频中的电影质感与创意表现。
AI.motivation: 非专家用户在使用文生视频时，其提示词往往缺乏专业叙事结构与创意设计，难以获得高质量、电影级的生成结果。
AI.method: SkillPE 以细粒度格式表示镜头逻辑、构图、灯光、声音设计等电影制作线索；检索电影参考并分为 resonators（高匹配）、dissonants（弱匹配）与 divergents（具有创意价值的近似错配）。前两类用于精炼技能应用的时机与方式，divergents 在保留用户意图的前提下启发不同修改程度的替代性电影化实现；候选技能通过生成视频在提示保真度、电影质量、叙事吸引力与创造性四个维度上评估，从而构建最终技能库。
AI.result: 在 StoryEval 与 VBench 上，7 点四维评估相较最强外部基线最高提升 1.40 分，相较种子技能提升 0.51 分，同时在基准原生指标上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SkillPE 为电影化文生视频生成中保真度与创造性的平衡提供了一种实用路径，代码已开源。

title: CRISP: Cultural Reward Modeling for Implicit Situated Propriety
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across countries and regions, the ability to recognize and respond appropriately to diverse cultural contexts becomes increasingly important. However, existing research has largely focused on cultural knowledge or tasks with predefined response spaces, while open-ended culturally situated behavior remains comparatively underexplored. In this work, we introduce CRISP-RM, a culturally situated reward model that assigns rewards according to cultural appropriateness in open-ended social scenarios. During policy optimization, we further introduce Norm Grounding Supervision (NGS), providing guidance that enhances the policy's sensitivity to relevant cultural norms. To construct culturally situated data, we employ a collaborative multi-agent framework that instantiates implicit cultural norms into diverse social scenarios and further curate NormCompass as a dedicated testbed. We conduct comprehensive experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of CRISP-RM in both reward modeling and policy optimization. Best-of-\(N\) experiments show that CRISP-RM consistently outperforms strong general reward models. During GRPO policy optimization, CRISP-RM generally improves culturally situated behavior, while incorporating NGS yields further gains. Further analyses demonstrate the advantages of CRISP-RM in distinguishing culturally appropriate behavior beyond superficial fluency and politeness, while NGS provides complementary gains during policy optimization by improving norm grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRISP-RM（文化情境化奖励模型）与Norm Grounding Supervision（NGS），并构建多智能体协同数据生成框架及NormCompass测试集，用于评估开放式社交场景中的文化适切行为。实验表明CRISP-RM在Best-of-N与GRPO策略优化中优于强通用奖励模型，NGS可进一步提升文化规范落地能力。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在全球多国家、多地区部署，模型需具备识别并恰当回应多元文化语境的能力。然而现有研究多聚焦文化知识或预设响应空间的任务，对开放式、文化情境化行为的探索相对不足。
AI.method: 1) 提出CRISP-RM，一种文化情境化奖励模型，按开放式社交场景中的文化适切性分配奖励；2) 在策略优化中引入Norm Grounding Supervision（NGS），增强策略对相关文化规范的敏感度；3) 采用多智能体协同框架，将隐式文化规范实例化为多样社交场景，并构建专用测试平台NormCompass；4) 开展奖励建模与策略优化两方面的综合实验。
AI.result: Best-of-N实验显示CRISP-RM持续优于强通用奖励模型；在GRPO策略优化中，CRISP-RM总体改善文化情境化行为，结合NGS后获得进一步提升。分析表明CRISP-RM能超越表层流利度与礼貌性来区分文化适切行为，NGS则通过改善规范落地在策略优化中提供互补增益。
AI.conclusion: 面向开放式文化情境化行为，文化情境化奖励建模与规范落地监督相结合可有效提升LLM的文化适切性；CRISP-RM与NGS提供互补优势，NormCompass为相关评测提供专用基准。

title: E-WAVE: Event-based Continuous Optical Flow via Warping-Aligned Visual Encoding
summary: Temporally dense optical flow is essential for dynamic perception in immersive VR/AR systems, where rapid head, hand, and object motion must be continuously captured and tracked. Existing frame-based optical flow estimation methods are constrained by the tradeoff between temporal resolution and computational cost; while event cameras, with their high temporal resolution and energy efficiency, serve as a natural solution to the dilemma. However, event-based approaches commonly rely on correlation volumes to capture pairwise voxel correspondences, which incur substantial memory and computation overhead. We present E-WAVE, a correlation-free framework for high-temporal-resolution (HTR) optical flow estimation from event streams. Instead of constructing all-pairs correlation volumes, E-WAVE employs global attention mechanism to model long-range feature dependencies and performs trajectory guided feature warping using Bézier curve. Through iterative updates, it predicts trajectories that allow for querying at arbitrary timestamps without repeated inference. Experiments on MultiFlow and DSEC-Flow demonstrate a 25% lower trajectory error and comparable endpoint flow estimation accuracy relative to state-of-the art baselines. Additional evaluations on self-captured data using a head-mounted prototype validate that E-WAVE remains robust under challenging real-world conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出 E-WAVE，一种无相关性体（correlation-free）的事件流高时间分辨率光流估计框架，用全局注意力与贝塞尔曲线轨迹引导的特征变形替代 all-pairs 相关性体，实现任意时间戳查询，轨迹误差降低约 25%。
AI.motivation: 沉浸式 VR/AR 的动态感知需要时间稠密光流以连续捕捉头、手与物体快速运动。基于帧的方法受时间分辨率与计算成本的权衡限制；事件相机虽具高时间分辨率与能效优势，但现有事件方法依赖相关性体建模成对体素对应，带来显著的内存与计算开销。
AI.method: E-WAVE 采用无相关性的高时间分辨率光流框架：不使用 all-pairs 相关性体，而是以全局注意力机制建模长程特征依赖，并利用贝塞尔曲线进行轨迹引导的特征变形；通过迭代更新预测轨迹，从而支持在任意时间戳直接查询，无需重复推理。
AI.result: 在 MultiFlow 与 DSEC-Flow 数据集上，相较当前最优基线，轨迹误差降低约 25%，端点光流估计精度相当；在头戴式原型采集的自采数据上，E-WAVE 在挑战性真实场景中保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: E-WAVE 通过去除相关性体、结合全局注意力与贝塞尔轨迹变形，在降低内存与计算开销的同时实现高时间分辨率、可任意时间戳查询的事件光流估计，并在公开数据集与真实头戴场景中验证了精度与鲁棒性。

title: Commutator Memory: Sparse, Path-Local Reading and Steering in Language Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 44 pages, 10 figures, 25 tables
summary: Gradient updates on different data generally do not commute: training a language model on two data sources in opposite orders gives different weights, even with the same data and total exposure. Loss or benchmark deltas show that the models differ, not where. We ask whether this path dependence leaves a parametric training-history memory: a weight component that flips sign when the two sources are swapped, is localized in output space, changes the held-out loss gap between the two orders under targeted interventions, and reveals which trained model came from which order. For one small SGD step of size $η$ on each of sources $A$ and $B$, the weight difference $θ_{AB}-θ_{BA}$ is, to leading order, $η^2 b_{AB}$, where $b_{AB}=H_Bg_A-H_Ag_B$ is the Lie bracket of the two gradient fields at the base model. We define commutator memory by projecting the bracket through the logits into one score per vocabulary token; the scores sum to the bracket's prediction of the gap. The scores are localized: on three models, the same readout of the measured $θ_{AB}-θ_{BA}$, or of a bracket from disjoint batches, shares 82-99% of the original top-20 tokens, versus 35-49% for norm-matched random directions. They are causally actionable: in Qwen-3-4B SFT, downweighting the ten tokens with the largest predicted share of the gap closes a median 32% of the measured gap, while frequency-matched tokens with near-zero scores have almost no effect. The weights themselves carry the component: projecting the difference between the two trained models onto $b_{AB}$ identifies which came from which order in 92% of cases across four LLMs (chance 50%). Controlled tests also cover matched-batch DPO, a frozen-rollout GRPO-style objective, and an AdamW endpoint check. The memory is defined per source pair, not per example, and its projection on $b_{AB}$ decays with further training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"交换子记忆"(commutator memory)概念：梯度更新的非交换性使权重中留有训练历史痕迹，其方向可用两梯度场的李括号刻画，并可定位、干预、识别训练顺序。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在不同数据源上的梯度更新通常不可交换，即使数据与总曝光量相同，交换训练顺序也会得到不同权重。以往仅通过损失或基准分数差异说明模型不同，却无法指出差异位于何处。作者希望探究这种路径依赖是否在参数空间中留下了可定位、可干预、可识别的"训练历史记忆"。
AI.method: 理论上一阶近似：对两源各做一步大小 η 的 SGD，有 θ_AB−θ_BA ≈ η² b_AB，其中 b_AB = H_B g_A − H_A g_B 为基座模型处两梯度场的李括号。将括号通过 logits 投影到词表，得到每个 token 一个分数，构成"交换子记忆"，分数之和即括号对损失差的预测。实验在三个模型上检验分数的局部性（与随机方向对比 top-20 token 重合率），在 Qwen-3-4B SFT 中做因果干预（下调分数最高的十个 token 权重），并通过对 b_AB 投影识别训练顺序；另设匹配批次 DPO、冻结 rollout 的 GRPO 式目标与 AdamW 端点对照实验。
AI.result: 测量得到的 θ_AB−θ_BA 或来自不相交批次的括号，与原方向共享 82–99% 的 top-20 token，随机方向仅 35–49%。因果干预：下调预测损失差份额最大的十个 token，中位数弥合实测差距的 32%，而频率匹配但分数近零的 token 几乎无影响。将两模型权重差投影到 b_AB，可在四个 LLM 中以 92%（随机 50%）识别训练顺序。
AI.conclusion: 训练顺序在权重中留下参数化的历史记忆，该记忆以李括号方向为特征，在输出空间上局部化，具备因果作用并可识别模型来源。该记忆按源对定义而非按样本定义，且其在 b_AB 上的投影随进一步训练而衰减。

title: FORGE: Form-Optimal Routing of Grounded Evidence for Frozen LLM Agents
summary: In agentic AI systems, frozen foundation models are increasingly deployed as closed-weight API endpoints, making downstream adaptation possible only through the inputs and inference procedures surrounding the model. As a result, for each input query, two coupled decisions largely determine both answer quality and token cost: what evidence to provide and how much reasoning budget to allocate. Fixed defaults along these axes are often suboptimal, misallocating support form or reasoning depth on roughly 80% of queries in our analysis. To address this challenge, we propose FORGE, a unified framework for adapting frozen models through per-query routing over a joint action space that spans both support form and thinking depth. Under an entropy-regularized, cost-aware utility objective, we derive a closed-form Boltzmann routing target and instantiate the policy as a lightweight 269K-parameter factorized router. The routing policy is trained around the frozen host, without any weight access, through a three-stage pipeline: offline arm enumeration, supervised Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation from the Boltzmann target, and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) refinement with host feedback. Across 5 knowledge-intensive benchmarks and 8 frozen backbones ranging from 7B to 671B parameters, FORGE improves accuracy at 42-45% lower token cost on both main hosts, transfers zero-shot across hosts at lower token cost, and composes with intrinsic thinking budgets where available.

AI.tldr: FORGE 提出一种面向冻结基础模型的轻量路由框架，在“证据形式”与“思考深度”联合动作空间上做逐查询路由，用熵正则化代价感知目标导出 Boltzmann 路由目标，经三阶段训练，在多个基准与骨干上实现更高准确率且 token 成本降低 42-45%。
AI.motivation: 在 agentic AI 系统中，冻结的基础模型常以闭权重 API 形式部署，下游适配只能通过输入与推理流程实现。每个查询都涉及两个耦合决策：提供什么证据、分配多少推理预算。固定默认值往往次优，作者分析显示约 80% 的查询存在支持形式或推理深度的错配。
AI.method: 提出 FORGE，在同时涵盖支持形式与思考深度的联合动作空间上进行逐查询路由。在熵正则化、代价感知的效用目标下推导闭式 Boltzmann 路由目标，并将策略实例化为 269K 参数的轻量因子化路由器。训练无需访问宿主权重，围绕冻结宿主分三阶段进行：离线臂枚举、从 Boltzmann 目标的监督 KL 蒸馏、以及带宿主反馈的 GRPO 精调。
AI.result: 在 5 个知识密集型基准与 8 个 7B 至 671B 参数的冻结骨架上，FORGE 在两个主要宿主上以降低 42-45% 的 token 成本提升准确率，并以更低 token 成本实现跨宿主的零样本迁移，同时可与宿主自带的内在思考预算机制组合使用。
AI.conclusion: FORGE 表明，在无法访问权重的冻结模型场景下，通过轻量路由策略联合优化支持形式与推理深度，可在提升答案质量的同时显著降低推理成本，并具备良好的跨宿主泛化与组合能力。

title: SyncRA: Learning Temporal Correspondence in Omni-Modal Models
summary: Recent omni-modal models demonstrate strong perception of audio and visual inputs, yet often struggle to connect what they hear with what they see at the same moment. This weakness in temporal correspondence can cause models to associate spoken cues with the wrong visual scenes, producing plausible answers grounded in incorrect audio-visual pairings. We diagnose this problem through controlled temporal swaps, revealing that model answers do not reliably follow changes in these pairings. To address it, we propose Synchrony-Guided Representation Alignment (SyncRA), a lightweight method for strengthening temporal correspondence between audio and vision. Specifically, SyncRA contrasts intermediate audio-visual representations within each video, aligning matching moments while separating mismatched ones to capture local temporal correspondence within a shared global context. The objective derives supervision directly from existing input timing, requiring no additional annotations and leaving inference unchanged. We evaluate SyncRA across four open omni-modal models spanning different sizes and architectures on five public video benchmarks. SyncRA consistently outperforms answer-only fine-tuning across all model-benchmark combinations, while substantially improving the ability to track changing audio-visual pairings in controlled evaluations. These results demonstrate that lightweight, targeted supervision can effectively strengthen temporal correspondence and translate into broad improvements in audio-visual question answering.

AI.tldr: 提出SyncRA，一种无需额外标注的轻量表征对齐方法，通过对比视频内部音视频中间表征来强化时序对应，在四个全模态模型与五个视频基准上稳定优于仅答案微调。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态模型虽具备较强的音视频感知能力，但难以将同一时刻的听觉与视觉信息对应起来，存在时序对应缺陷。该缺陷会使模型把语音线索关联到错误的视觉场景，从而给出看似合理却基于错误音视频配对的答案。论文通过受控时序交换实验诊断该问题，发现模型答案并不能可靠地随音视频配对变化而变化。
AI.method: 提出SyncRA（Synchrony-Guided Representation Alignment）。该方法在每条视频内部对中间层音视频表征进行对比学习：拉近匹配时刻的表征，推远不匹配时刻的表征，从而在共享的全局语境中捕捉局部时序对应。监督信号直接来自现有输入的时间戳，无需额外标注，且不改变推理过程。
AI.result: 在四种不同规模与架构的开源全模态模型、五个公开视频基准上进行评估。SyncRA在所有模型-基准组合上均持续优于仅答案微调，并在受控评测中大幅提升了对动态变化音视频配对的追踪能力。
AI.conclusion: 轻量且有针对性的监督能够有效强化音视频时序对应，并转化为音视频问答任务的广泛性能提升。

title: When Harness Beats Scale, and When Reading Beats Both
comment: Accepted at the DocInsights 2026 Workshop co-located with EMNLP 2026. System description paper for the DocSem document-grounded quantitative reasoning shared task. 10 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables, 5 appendices
summary: We describe our system for DocSem, the document-grounded quantitative reasoning shared task at DocInsights 2026, and analyze why it succeeded on labeled data and failed on the test set. The pipeline pairs hybrid block retrieval with Program-of-Thoughts (PoT) generation executed in a sandboxed interpreter, self-consistency sampling, and entity enrichment from chunk-level knowledge graphs. On our held-out split, application architecture moved the metrics far more than model scale did: PoT added 0.282 joint accuracy to a compact 7B model but at most 0.005 to a 72B model, and a 27B model with the full harness matched the 72B (0.884 vs.\ 0.873) at roughly 2.7$\times$ fewer parameters and a quarter of the CO$_2$. We read this through a distinction between world knowledge, which scales steeply with parameters, and language knowledge, which scales gently, and show that structured-output training makes a compact model harness-ready rather than merely small. On the raster, watermarked test PDFs the same system collapsed to 13.58\% joint (rank 149 of 163); a controlled re-rendering of the validation set reproduces the OCR half of the collapse while bounding what the simulation misses. Auditing the physical nature of evaluation inputs precedes architecture, and the leaderboard's bimodality is consistent with reading quality, not reasoning, having separated the field.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 DocInsights 2026 DocSem 任务的参赛系统：混合块检索 + 沙箱 PoT 生成 + 自一致性采样 + 知识图谱实体增强，在验证集上以 27B 模型逼近 72B 性能，但在栅格化带水印测试 PDF 上崩塌至 13.58% joint（163 队中排 149），归因于读取质量而非推理能力。
AI.motivation: 文档接地的定量推理任务中，模型规模是否是性能主因尚不明确；同时榜单上分数呈双峰分布，需要解释系统在标注数据上成功、在测试集上失败的成因。作者试图区分"世界知识"（随参数量陡峭增长）与"语言知识"（随参数量缓慢增长），并强调评估输入的物理形态（OCR/渲染质量）应先于架构设计被审计。
AI.method: 系统流水线包含四个组件：(1) 混合块检索（hybrid block retrieval）；(2) Program-of-Thoughts 生成，在沙箱解释器中执行；(3) 自一致性采样（self-consistency sampling）；(4) 基于块级知识图谱的实体增强。此外对验证集进行受控重新渲染，以复现测试崩塌中的 OCR 部分。
AI.result: 在留出划分上，应用架构对指标的提升远大于模型规模：PoT 为紧凑 7B 模型带来 0.282 的 joint accuracy 增益，但对 72B 模型最多仅 0.005；配备完整框架的 27B 模型（0.884）匹配 72B（0.873），参数约少 2.7 倍，CO₂ 排放约为四分之一。在栅格化、带水印的测试 PDF 上，同一系统 joint 准确率跌至 13.58%，排名 149/163。受控重渲染复现了崩塌中 OCR 相关的一半，并界定了模拟未覆盖的部分。
AI.conclusion: 应用架构与结构化输出训练可让紧凑模型"适配框架"而非仅仅"变小"；评估输入的物理性质审计应先于架构选择；榜单的双峰分布与"读取质量（而非推理）区分了参赛者"的解读一致。

title: Rate-Distortion Adaptive Primitive Selection for Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting
summary: Learned image codecs (LICs) achieve high reconstruction quality, but their decoding speed is often insufficient for immersive virtual reality (VR). Gaussian splatting (GS) codecs render much faster, yet still lag in reconstruction quality and typically decide primitive allocation without considering the coding cost of each primitive. We introduce OIC-GS, an omnidirectional GS codec with a new hierarchical HEALPix primitive grid representation. Gaussian primitives are anchored at predefined spherical locations, eliminating explicit coordinate coding. Finer levels refine their coarser ancestors, naturally supporting coarse-to-fine reconstruction and layered transmission. The predefined grid also enables efficient viewport decoding by selecting only view-relevant primitives. We further introduce a lightweight entropy model for quantized primitives and optimize the codec under a spherical rate-distortion objective. Primitives with insufficient rate-distortion benefit are automatically removed when their quantized opacity becomes zero, allowing OIC-GS to adapt both primitive density and level of detail without a fixed primitive budget. A single bitstream supports full-sphere, viewport-dependent, and progressive decoding. The first viewport reaches final quality after decoding only 52% of the bitstream, and is then rendered at 1,270 FPS. On a 100-image omnidirectional benchmark, OIC-GS outperforms all evaluated GS codecs, reducing WS-PSNR BD-rate by 49.6% over GaussianImage++ and 68.6% over SGI, which uses a learned entropy model.

AI.tldr: OIC-GS：基于分层HEALPix图元网格的 omnidirectional 高斯泼溅编解码器，免坐标编码、支持粗到细与视口解码，实现高压缩比与高速渲染。
AI.motivation: 面向沉浸式VR，学习图像编解码器重建质量高但解码慢，GS编解码器渲染快但重建质量欠佳，且图元分配未考虑每个图元的编码代价。
AI.method: 提出分层HEALPix图元网格表示，将高斯基元锚定在预定义球面位置以消除显式坐标编码；细层细化粗层祖先，支持粗到细重建与分层传输；按视口选取相关图元实现高效视口解码；为量化图元引入轻量熵模型，并在球面率失真目标下优化；量化不透明度为零的低收益图元被自动移除，自适应图元密度与细节层次，无固定图元预算。
AI.result: 单一码流支持全球面、视口相关与渐进解码；首个视口仅解码52%码流即达最终质量，渲染速度1,270 FPS；在100图像 omnidirectional 基准上超越所有评估的GS编解码器，WS-PSNR BD-rate较 GaussianImage++ 降低49.6%，较使用学习熵模型的 SGI 降低68.6%。
AI.conclusion: OIC-GS通过分层球面网格锚定与率失真优化，统一了编码效率、视口自适应传输与实时渲染，显著优于现有GS编解码器。

title: From Static to Dynamic: On-Policy Distillation from Image to Video Diffusion Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) specializes pretrained video diffusion models through teacher supervision along the student's own generation trajectory. Although large video models are natural teachers, developing specialized video experts can require costly video data and training, while querying them incurs substantially higher latency than querying image experts. More readily available and cheaper to query, image experts offer a cost-effective alternative, particularly for largely temporal-agnostic capabilities such as aesthetics and OCR that admit frame-level supervision. However, heterogeneous image and video latent spaces prevent direct supervision of intermediate student states, while image experts lack cross-frame motion supervision, making temporal consistency vulnerable to frame-level improvements. In this paper, we propose MILD, a Motion-Preserving Image-to-Video Latent Distillation framework that transfers specialized image expertise while preserving pretrained video dynamics. MILD uses a learnable linear connector that aligns student latent states and predicted updates with those of image experts, enabling supervision transfer across heterogeneous latent spaces. We further constrain image-guided corrections around the pretrained student's predictions to preserve video dynamics and incorporate an optical-flow-based motion reward to improve motion quality and temporal consistency. Across specialized image experts and multiple video-student backbones, our method consistently outperforms video-teacher OPD baselines, with further studies demonstrating effective transfer across connector designs and heterogeneous architectures. These results establish image-to-video distillation as an effective route to improving video generation by drawing on the diverse and evolving capabilities of the image-generation ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 提出 MILD——一种动作保持的图像到视频隐空间蒸馏框架，利用可学习线性连接器跨异质隐空间迁移图像专家知识，并通过约束与光流动作奖励保持视频动态，性能优于视频教师 OPD 基线。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型专用化依赖教师监督，但大型视频教师需昂贵视频数据与训练，查询延迟远高于图像专家；图像专家获取容易、查询便宜，对美学、OCR 等弱时序相关能力可提供帧级监督。然而图像与视频隐空间异质，无法直接监督学生中间状态，且图像专家缺乏跨帧运动监督，帧级提升易损害时序一致性。
AI.method: MILD 采用可学习线性连接器，将学生隐状态与预测更新对齐到图像专家对应量，实现跨异质隐空间的监督迁移；同时将图像引导的修正约束在预训练学生预测附近以保持视频动态，并引入基于光流的运动奖励以提升运动质量与时间一致性。
AI.result: 在多种专用图像专家与多种视频学生主干上，该方法一致优于视频教师 OPD 基线；进一步研究显示其在不同连接器设计与异质架构间均可有效迁移。
AI.conclusion: 图像到视频蒸馏是利用图像生成生态多样且演进能力来改进视频生成的有效途径。

title: Marathoner: Ultra-Long-Horizon Autonomous Intelligence
summary: Humans naturally possess the ability to work persistently toward long-term goals. Given a challenging task, humans can continuously work for months or even years to accomplish a specific objective. In this paper, we propose Marathoner, an autonomous agentic model possessing the ability of ultra-long-horizon execution. Specifically, we propose a comprehensive post-training pipeline to instill this critical capability into base model. For Ultra-Long-Horizon Task Synthesis, we leverage major release PRs containing 1000+ lines of new code from diverse GitHub repositories as the primary source for synthesizing challenging task-level data. Additionally, we introduce Multi-Task Chaining, which chains multiple generated tasks into a single more challenging task, enabling the synthesis of tasks with frontier-level difficulty. For rejection sampling finetuning, we combine strong teacher model with diverse harnesses to generate trajectories on our synthesized tasks and conduct supervised finetuning on base model with rejection sampled trajectories. For reinforcement learning, cold-started model performs real-world execution through harnesses in independent sandboxes during rollout process, effectively facilitating the acquisition of genuine ultra-long-horizon execution capability. We further propose a novel reward strategy, Later Stage Bonus Reward, which explicitly encourages model to perform meaningful maneuvers during later stages of execution. Through extensive evaluation on 5 benchmarks containing ultra-long-horizon tasks, Marathoner achieves consistent and substantial performance improvements over base model and even surpasses performance of strong proprietary model. Further analysis shows that Marathoner can consistently work for 10+ hours and conduct 1000+ tool calls on highly challenging tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出自主智能体模型 Marathoner，通过后训练流水线赋予基座模型超长时程执行能力，可在高难任务上持续工作 10+ 小时、执行 1000+ 次工具调用。
AI.motivation: 人类能针对长期目标持续数月至数年地工作，但现有智能体模型缺乏这种超长时程（ultra-long-horizon）的持续执行能力，因此需要一种能将其注入基座模型的能力构建方法。
AI.method: 提出完整后训练流水线：1）超长时程任务合成，利用 GitHub 多仓库中新增 1000+ 行代码的重大发布 PR 作为任务级数据来源，并引入多任务链式组合（Multi-Task Chaining）生成前沿难度任务；2）拒绝采样微调，用强教师模型配合多样 harness 在合成任务上生成轨迹，对基座模型做监督微调；3）强化学习，冷启动模型在独立沙箱中通过 harness 进行真实执行 rollout；4）提出新奖励策略 Later Stage Bonus Reward，显式鼓励模型在执行的后期阶段做出有效操作。
AI.result: 在 5 个含超长时程任务的基准上，Marathoner 相对基座模型取得一致且显著的性能提升，甚至超过强闭源模型；进一步分析显示其能在高难任务上持续工作 10+ 小时并完成 1000+ 次工具调用。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务合成、拒绝采样微调与真实环境强化学习的组合，并辅以后期阶段奖励设计，可有效赋予模型超长时程自主执行能力，Marathoner 在该能力上达到优于强闭源模型的水平。

title: Joint and Cross-Modal Video-Audio Generation and Editing: A Unified Formulation and Design Taxonomy
summary: Video and audio are perceived together, yet most generative models treat them in isolation. We examine methods that model the two modalities jointly, generate one from the other, or edit them in a coupled manner, organized around a single question: how is the output kept coherent across modalities in time and semantics? A unified formulation casts joint generation, cross-modal generation, and joint editing as three problems defined on a single distribution over audio-visual pairs, and a taxonomy compares methods along five design axes. To our knowledge, this is the first overview to systematically taxonomize joint audio-visual editing, which we map as nine edit categories spanning 28 edit types. We describe methods, datasets, and metrics for each setting and close with the open problems we view as most consequential.

AI.tldr: 该论文是首个系统综述音视频联合生成与编辑的工作，以"跨模态在时间与语义上如何保持一致性"为核心问题，统一形式化并分类了联合生成、跨模态生成与联合编辑三大任务。
AI.motivation: 视频与音频在感知上是同时发生的，但多数生成模型将二者孤立处理。作者希望系统梳理能对两种模态进行联合建模、由一种模态生成另一种、或以耦合方式进行编辑的方法，填补联合音视频编辑缺乏系统分类的空白。
AI.method: 作者将联合生成、跨模态生成和联合编辑统一表述为定义在音视频对联合分布上的三类问题，并围绕"输出如何在时间与语义上跨模态保持连贯"这一主线，提出沿五个设计维度比较方法的分类体系。对联合音视频编辑，进一步映射为涵盖28种编辑类型的9个编辑类别，并逐一介绍各设定下的方法、数据集与评价指标。
AI.result: 综述给出了统一的数学形式化和五维分类框架，首次系统归纳了联合音视频编辑，形成9类编辑、28种编辑类型的映射，并汇总了各任务对应的方法、数据集与评价指标。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为这是首个系统分类联合音视频编辑的综述，并在结尾提出其认为最关键的开放问题，为后续研究指明方向。

title: RoboIRGBench: Benchmarking Implicit Referential Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks typically assume that task-relevant information is explicitly specified in the instruction. In practice, however, humans frequently refer to objects, quantities, and relations implicitly, requiring robots to recover the intended target from linguistic and perceptual context. We study this capability as Implicit Referential Grounding (IRG) and introduce RoboIRG-Bench, a manipulation benchmark designed to systematically evaluate it. Built upon RoboMME, RoboIRG-Bench contains 40 variants derived from 11 tasks and covers four challenges, including direct, reasoning-mediated, spatial, and contextual referential grounding. As IRG often requires retaining and retrieving previously established context, we evaluate representative VLAs spanning different memory mechanisms. Our evaluation reveals a noticeable referential robustness gap. Models that perform well under explicit instructions can degrade sharply when the same task-relevant information must be recovered from context. Reasoning-mediated and spatial references are particularly challenging, while models using external VLMs show greater robustness but still exhibit significant failures. Moreover, replacing the external VLM with a stronger model does not eliminate these gaps. We further validate these findings on a Franka Research 3 robot arm, where the gap persists under real-world manipulation and manifests as both incorrect referent grounding and downstream execution failures. These results establish IRG as a distinct and underexplored capability for reliable robotic instruction following and highlight the need for VLAs that can robustly integrate language, perception, reasoning, and action.

AI.tldr: 提出隐式指代落地（IRG）概念及RoboIRG-Bench基准，揭示VLA模型在隐式指令下的指代鲁棒性缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA基准假设任务相关信息在指令中被显式给出，但现实中人类常隐式指代物体、数量和关系，需要机器人从语言与感知上下文中推断目标，该能力此前缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 基于RoboMME构建RoboIRG-Bench，含40个变体、11项任务，覆盖直接、推理中介、空间、上下文四类指代挑战；评测具不同记忆机制的代表性VLA模型，并在Franka Research 3机械臂上做真实验证。
AI.result: 发现明显的指代鲁棒性缺口：显式指令下表现良好的模型在需从上下文恢复信息时显著退化；推理中介与空间指代尤其困难；使用外部VLM的模型鲁棒性较强但仍存在显著失败，且更换更强VLM并不能消除缺口；真实机械臂上缺口持续存在，表现为指代落地错误与下游执行失败。
AI.conclusion: IRG是可靠机器人指令跟随中一个独立且尚待探索的能力，亟需能够稳健整合语言、感知、推理与动作的VLA模型。

title: Just-In-Time Agent Memory with Runtime Agentic Research
summary: Memory is critical for AI agents. Many existing agent-memory systems follow an Ahead-of-Time (AOT) design, constructing memory before a specific request arrives. While this reduces online serving cost, such request-agnostic memory construction can discard fine-grained information that later becomes important. To address this limitation, we propose Just-In-Time Agent Memory (JAM), a trainable framework for query-conditioned context construction at runtime. A Memorizer preserves complete raw histories in a hierarchical page-store with compact navigational summaries, while a Researcher iteratively retrieves, inspects, and integrates evidence for each request. To train these memory-use behaviors, we introduce Memory-Gym, an evidence-grounded data synthesis pipeline covering nine task types across six domains, and optimize the Researcher through verified-trajectory supervised fine-tuning followed by Hint-guided Group Relative Policy Optimization. We demonstrate the effectiveness of JAM across a variety of benchmarks on agent memory and long-context processing, where it achieves stronger task performance than AOT-style memory systems while remaining substantially more efficient than prior trained agentic memory approaches. To support reproducibility and future research, we release our anonymized source code at https://github.com/VectorSpaceLab/general-agentic-memory.

AI.tldr: 提出JAM（即时智能体记忆）框架，通过查询条件下的运行时上下文构建，兼顾任务性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统多采用AOT（预先构建）设计，在请求到来前就构建记忆。虽然降低了在线服务成本，但这种与请求无关的记忆构建方式会丢弃后来可能变重要的细粒度信息。
AI.method: JAM包含两个组件：Memorizer以分层页面存储保留完整原始历史并配以紧凑导航摘要；Researcher针对每个请求迭代地检索、审查并整合证据。训练方面，构建Memory-Gym证据落地式数据合成流水线，覆盖6个领域9类任务，采用验证轨迹监督微调加Hint引导的组相对策略优化（GRPO）优化Researcher。
AI.result: 在多种智能体记忆与长上下文处理基准上，JAM任务性能优于AOT式记忆系统，同时比先前的可训练智能体记忆方法效率显著更高。
AI.conclusion: JAM通过查询条件下的即时记忆构建有效弥补AOT式记忆的信息丢失问题，实现性能与效率的平衡，并开源代码以支持复现与后续研究。

title: Look Before You Select: Rethinking Vocabulary Sparsification in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) uses teacher correction on student-generated responses. Full-vocabulary correction can provide important corrections even for tokens that the student assigns low probability, but backpropagating through all token logits becomes memory-intensive for long sequences. Existing memory-saving approaches estimate corrections from sampled tokens or restrict supervision to the student's TopK tokens, introducing sampling noise or changing the full-vocabulary correction. We introduce \textbf{SparseOPD}, which uses full-vocabulary teacher correction to determine which corrections matter before selecting the token logits to differentiate. SparseOPD first constructs the full-vocabulary correction without retaining its backward graph, then selects tokens by correction magnitude rather than student probability. Signed residual compensation preserves the total promoting and suppressing correction mass, while correction-aware budget allocation distributes the sparse support across positions. Finally, the update backpropagates only through the selected token logits. Across six task--scale settings spanning mathematics, chemistry QA, and multimodal reasoning, SparseOPD outperforms Sampled Token and TopK in task-average accuracy and matches or exceeds Full Vocabulary. Gradient cosine similarity reaches 99\% on 4B mathematics, while 8K full-parameter profiling shows 70.5\% lower backward memory.

AI.tldr: SparseOPD 提出一种两阶段策略：先用全词表教师修正确定哪些修正重要，再仅对选中的 token logits 反向传播，从而在保持全词表修正质量的同时显著降低显存。
AI.motivation: On-policy distillation 中，全词表修正能为学生低概率 token 提供重要监督，但对所有 token logits 反向传播在长序列下显存开销过大。现有省显存方法或从采样 token 估计修正（引入采样噪声），或仅监督学生 TopK token（改变全词表修正的本质）。因此需要一种既保留全词表修正、又降低反向显存的方法。
AI.method: SparseOPD 分两阶段：1）先构造全词表教师修正但不保留其反向计算图；2）基于修正幅度（而非学生概率）选择需要微分的 token logits。为保持稀疏近似下的修正总量，引入带符号残差补偿（signed residual compensation）以保留促进与抑制修正的总质量，并采用感知修正的预算分配（correction-aware budget allocation）在各位置间分配稀疏支撑集。最后仅在选中的 token logits 上反向传播。
AI.result: 在覆盖数学、化学问答与多模态推理的六个任务-规模设置上，SparseOPD 的任务平均准确率优于 Sampled Token 与 TopK 方法，并达到或超过 Full Vocabulary。4B 数学任务上梯度余弦相似度达 99%；8K 长度全参数微调下反向显存降低 70.5%。
AI.conclusion: SparseOPD 通过“先全词表评估修正、后按修正幅度稀疏选择”的两阶段设计，在不改变全词表修正监督信号的前提下实现显存高效的反向传播，兼顾效果与效率，为长序列 on-policy distillation 提供可行方案。

title: CAR-VLA: Complexity-Aware and Risk-Adaptive Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Existing adaptive reasoning methods for driving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models primarily focus on whether to reason, overlooking how reasoning should differ across driving situations. Our key insight is that while scene complexity informs reasoning depth, dynamic risk is equally critical for deciding how to reason in time-critical situations. We therefore propose CAR-VLA, a unified driving VLA model that jointly considers scene complexity and dynamic risk to guide reasoning depth, urgency, and focus. CAR-VLA maps four complexity--risk categories to three reasoning modes: \textit{Fast Intuition} for direct trajectory generation in simple low-risk scenes, \textit{Slow Thinking} for deliberate reasoning in complex low-risk scenes, and \textit{Reflex Response} for compact, hazard-focused reasoning in high-risk scenes regardless of complexity. Rather than merely shortening deliberation, Reflex Response centers reasoning on the most critical hazard and the immediate safe response. We train CAR-VLA through progressive supervised learning that links scene assessment, reasoning-mode selection, and trajectory generation, followed by reasoning-augmented reinforcement learning to improve driving quality and reasoning behavior. Experiments on NAVSIM v1(91.1 PDMS), NAVSIM v2(90.3 EPDMS), and Navhard(35.0 EPDMS) demonstrate competitive driving performance. Qualitative comparisons on navtest and in-house high-risk scenarios further illustrate risk-aware reasoning and hazard-responsive trajectory generation. The code for this paper will be released publicly at: https://github.com/chenxl124578/CAR-VLA.git

AI.tldr: CAR-VLA是一种统一驾驶VLA模型，同时考虑场景复杂度与动态风险来指导推理深度、紧迫性与焦点，将四类复杂度-风险情形映射为三种推理模式，并通过渐进监督学习与推理增强强化学习训练，在NAVSIM v1/v2及Navhard上取得有竞争力的驾驶性能。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶VLA自适应推理方法主要关注"是否推理"，忽略了不同驾驶情形下"如何推理"的差异。作者认为场景复杂度决定推理深度，而动态风险对时间紧迫情形下如何推理同样关键。
AI.method: 提出CAR-VLA，联合场景复杂度与动态风险指导推理深度、紧迫性和焦点。将四种复杂度-风险类别映射为三种推理模式：简单低风险的Fast Intuition（直接生成轨迹）、复杂低风险的Slow Thinking（深思熟虑推理）、高风险情形的Reflex Response（紧凑、聚焦危险的推理，无论复杂度如何）。训练采用渐进监督学习连接场景评估、推理模式选择与轨迹生成，随后用推理增强强化学习提升驾驶质量与推理行为。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1（91.1 PDMS）、NAVSIM v2（90.3 EPDMS）和Navhard（35.0 EPDMS）上展示有竞争力的驾驶性能；在navtest和自建高风险场景上的定性对比进一步展示了风险感知推理与危险响应式轨迹生成。
AI.conclusion: CAR-VLA通过复杂度-风险双因素驱动的多模式推理框架，实现了风险感知的推理与危险响应式轨迹生成，驾驶性能具有竞争力，代码将公开。

title: Reciprocal Guidance: Orchestrating Draft and Verify Budgets for Advancing the Diffusion-AR Self-Speculation Frontier
summary: Diffusion drafting with autoregressive (AR) verification has emerged as a promising paradigm for efficient speculative decoding. Recent self-speculation models, represented by Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion, further simplify the speculative pipeline by unifying drafting and verification within a shared backbone, while enabling longer acceptance lengths. However, the Pareto frontier between aggregate and per-request throughput remains underexplored. At low concurrency, sequential draft-verify execution requires two model forward passes per round, limiting the effective tokens per forward (TPF). By contrast, at high concurrency, longer drafts incur increasingly expensive computation, forcing individual requests to operate under constrained speculation budgets and preventing full exploitation of the full-backbone drafter. Our key observation indicates that drafting and verification exhibit reciprocal predictability. Draft logits can anticipate likely verification mismatches, while recent verification outcomes predict future drafting utility and suitable block sizes. Building on this observation, we introduce Reciprocal Guidance (RecGuide), a runtime draft-verify orchestration framework that adapts speculative decoding to varying serving loads. RecGuide exploits spare compute capacity through verification-overlapped drafting at low concurrency, while dynamically allocating request-specific draft block sizes as the workload becomes increasingly compute-intensive. Experiments across a wide range of concurrency levels demonstrate consistent throughput improvements over vanilla self-speculation, achieving up to $1.8\times$ speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出 RecGuide，一种运行时草稿-验证协同编排框架，通过验证重叠草稿与动态块大小分配，在高低并发下优化自推测解码吞吐。
AI.motivation: 扩散草稿+自回归验证的推测解码（以 Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion 为代表）已简化流程并延长接受长度，但聚合吞吐与单请求吞吐间的帕累托前沿未被充分探索：低并发时草稿-验证串行需两轮前向，限制了每前向有效 token 数（TPF）；高并发时过长草稿计算开销剧增，迫使请求受限于推测预算，无法充分利用全骨干草稿器。
AI.method: 基于"草稿与验证具有相互可预测性"的观察——草稿 logits 可预示验证不匹配，近期验证结果可预测草稿效用与合适块大小——提出 RecGuide 运行时编排框架：低并发时利用空闲算力做验证重叠草稿（verification-overlapped drafting），高并发计算密集时动态分配请求级草稿块大小。
AI.result: 在广泛并发水平下相比原始自推测（vanilla self-speculation）取得一致的吞吐提升，最高达 1.8 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: RecGuide 通过利用草稿-验证的相互可预测性，实现随服务负载自适应的推测解码编排，兼顾低并发下的算力利用与高并发下的预算控制。

title: VastMAT: A Large-Scale Multi-Category Benchmark for Multi-Animal Tracking
summary: Multi-animal tracking (MAT) supports the study of animal movement, behavior, and group interactions. However, general multi-object tracking (MOT) benchmarks primarily focus on pedestrians and vehicles, whereas dedicated MAT benchmarks remain limited in jointly supporting broad animal coverage, large-scale video data, and extensive within-video multi-instance association. To address this gap, we introduce VastMAT, which has four key characteristics: (1) Large scale. It comprises 2,947 videos with 1,002,562 annotated frames, totaling 27.85 hours. (2) Broad category coverage. These videos cover 337 animal categories with diverse morphologies and motion patterns. (3) Extensive instance annotations. It provides 3,663,248 bounding boxes and 22,883 identity trajectories---to our knowledge, the largest numbers of both among dedicated MAT benchmarks. (4) High-quality annotations. To ensure reliability, annotations undergo iterative expert review and correction, and quality is assessed through an independent reannotation audit. To systematically assess tracking performance and cross-category generalization, we establish Seen-category and category-disjoint Unseen-category protocols, and evaluate eight representative MOT methods under both protocols. Under these protocols, the highest baseline HOTA scores are 66.37\% and 52.90\%, respectively, highlighting the challenge of tracking unseen animals. To address the low-overlap association challenge revealed by our analysis, we propose Center-Distance-Augmented Association (CDA), a lightweight module that adaptively combines IoU with center similarity normalized by the boxes' own scales. Without additional training, CDA improves TrackTrack's HOTA by 1.58 and 1.31 percentage points under the two protocols, respectively. To facilitate further MAT research, we will publicly release our benchmark and code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大规模多动物跟踪基准 VastMAT，并针对低重叠关联难题提出轻量模块 CDA，在 Seen/Unseen 两种协议下提升了基线方法性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多目标跟踪（MOT）基准主要面向行人与车辆，专门的多动物跟踪（MAT）基准在动物类别覆盖、视频规模以及视频内多实例关联标注方面仍有不足，难以支撑动物运动、行为与群体交互研究。
AI.method: 构建 VastMAT 基准，具备四大特征：大规模（2,947 个视频、1,002,562 帧、27.85 小时）、广类别覆盖（337 个动物类别）、丰富实例标注（3,663,248 个边界框、22,883 条身份轨迹）、高质量标注（迭代专家复审与独立重标注审计）。设立 Seen-category 与类别不相交的 Unseen-category 两种评测协议，评测 8 种代表性 MOT 方法；并提出轻量模块 CDA，自适应结合 IoU 与按框自身尺度归一化的中心相似度以应对低重叠关联。
AI.result: 两种协议下最高基线 HOTA 分别为 66.37% 与 52.90%，显示跟踪未见类别动物较困难；无需额外训练，CDA 使 TrackTrack 的 HOTA 在两种协议下分别提升 1.58 与 1.31 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: VastMAT 填补了专门 MAT 基准的空白，并提供跨类别泛化评测；CDA 有效缓解低重叠关联问题，基准与代码将公开以促进后续 MAT 研究。

title: HyperDAM: Hyperspectral Distractor-Aware Memory with Amodal Expansion for SAM 3 Tracking
summary: Hyperspectral video provides material cues that can disambiguate targets with similar false-color appearance, yet foundation-model trackers update memory primarily from spatial and appearance evidence. We present HyperDAM, a DAM4SAM3-based hyperspectral tracker with three principal contributions. First, HOTC2026-Modal adds human-verified frame-wise modal masks and mask-tight boxes to all 481 organizer-provided HOTC 2026 videos. Second, a frame-zero-calibrated HSI gate rejects spectrally inconsistent updates to the distractor-resolving memory (DRM) without altering the current prediction. Third, a causal spatiotemporal expander adds outward-only amodal corrections from frozen SAM features. Static-scene recovery and empty-mask RTS smoothing address target switches and full occlusion. Model selection prioritizes cross-domain robustness over leaderboard-specific optimization. The final system ranked second in HOTC 2026, achieving 68.0093% AUC and 87.7703% DP@20 in the organizer's private evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HyperDAM，一个基于 DAM4SAM3 的高光谱视频跟踪器，通过新增模态标注数据集、帧零标定 HSI 门控与因果时空扩展器三大贡献，在 HOTC 2026 竞赛中获得第二名（68.0093% AUC，87.7703% DP@20）。
AI.motivation: 高光谱视频提供的光谱/材质线索能够区分伪彩色外观相似的目标，但现有基础模型跟踪器主要依赖空间和外观证据更新记忆，未能充分利用光谱模态信息，导致在干扰物区分与目标切换场景中易失效。
AI.method: 三项核心贡献：(1) HOTC2026-Modal，为组织方提供的全部 481 个 HOTC 2026 视频补充人工校验的逐帧模态掩码与紧贴掩码框；(2) 帧零标定的 HSI 门控，在不改变当前预测的前提下拒绝向"解干扰记忆（DRM）"写入光谱不一致的更新；(3) 因果时空扩展器，利用冻结 SAM 特征生成仅向外的非模态修正。此外采用静态场景恢复与空掩码 RTS 平滑处理目标切换与完全遮挡，模型选择以跨域鲁棒性优先于榜单特化优化。
AI.result: 最终系统在 HOTC 2026 组织方私有评测中排名第二，取得 68.0093% AUC 与 87.7703% DP@20。
AI.conclusion: 将高光谱模态线索与基础模型跟踪框架结合，并通过光谱一致性门控与因果时空扩展显著提升鲁棒性；强调跨域泛化优先于榜单优化的模型选择策略，可在真实评测中取得有竞争力的性能。

title: Unlocking Few-Step Diffusion for Faithful Previews
summary: Sampling latency compounds in diffusion workflows, where users generate and discard many candidates before keeping one. Surprisingly, the poor outputs of standard few-step samplers do not reflect a lack of reconstruction capacity: by optimizing only the initial noise, frozen 3-4-step samplers can closely reproduce their corresponding full-step outputs. Building on this finding, we learn corrections to the initial noise and denoising updates using endpoint supervision, improving correspondence with full-step outputs generated from the same noise and prompt. The resulting previews allow users to screen candidates cheaply and reserve full-step generation for promising ones. Input correction also transfers across sampling budgets without retraining. Experiments show substantial improvements in reference fidelity, including 53-78% lower reconstruction MSE than retrained LD3 on unconditional benchmarks, alongside improved ranking preservation and candidate selection on SD1.5, SDXL, and FLUX.1-dev.

AI.tldr: 少步扩散采样器输出质量差并非重建能力不足；仅优化初始噪声即可让冻结的3-4步采样器逼近全步输出。作者用端点监督学习初始噪声与去噪更新的修正，实现低成本预览，可跨采样预算迁移。
AI.motivation: 扩散工作流中用户需生成并丢弃大量候选样本，采样延迟累积严重。标准少步采样器输出质量差，通常被归因于重建能力不足，但本文发现该瓶颈并非不可克服。
AI.method: 关键观察：仅优化初始噪声，冻结的3-4步采样器即可高度复现对应的全步输出。基于此，使用端点监督（endpoint supervision）学习对初始噪声与去噪更新的修正，使少步输出与同一噪声和提示下的全步输出更好对应。输入修正无需重训练即可跨采样预算迁移。
AI.result: 在无条件基准上，重建MSE比重新训练的LD3低53-78%；在SD1.5、SDXL和FLUX.1-dev上改善了排序保持性与候选选择效果。用户可低成本筛选候选，仅对优质候选执行全步生成。
AI.conclusion: 少步采样的缺陷可通过学习初始噪声与去噪更新修正来弥补，在保持全步生成对应性的同时显著降低预览成本，并具备跨采样预算的泛化能力。

title: Distilling Visual Reasoning into Text Space
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown strong promise for multimodal reasoning, yet often struggle with tasks requiring concepts beyond what is directly observable in the input image. Existing methods generate intermediate images or latent visual tokens to guide reasoning, but these representations can introduce errors and increasingly interfere with textual reasoning as reasoning progresses. We propose Visual-to-Text Chain-of-Thought Distillation (V2T), a framework that enables LVLMs to internalize visual reasoning without generating intermediate visual representations at inference time. V2T first trains a teacher LVLM using interleaved visual and textual chains of thought, and then uses knowledge distillation to train a student LVLM using the teacher's logits and cross-entropy supervision from ground-truth textual reasoning. When reasoning images can be mapped to the original image, V2T can additionally distill the teacher's attention to corresponding regions, while ground-truth bounding boxes can further guide a subsequent reinforcement learning stage. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that V2T consistently outperforms the teacher and existing baselines, improving average accuracy by 14.3% on a held-out set and 2.7% on the broader visual evaluation suite. Moreover, lightweight SFT and substantially reduced RL make V2T up to 42x faster to train than state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出V2T框架，通过知识蒸馏让LVLM内化视觉推理能力，推理时无需生成中间视觉表征，精度更高且训练速度最高快42倍。
AI.motivation: LVLM在多模态推理上表现优异，但面对需要图像中不可直接观测概念的任务时仍显不足。已有方法通过生成中间图像或潜在视觉token来引导推理，但这些表征会引入错误，且随着推理推进对文本推理的干扰日益加剧。
AI.method: V2T分两阶段：先训练一个教师LVLM，使用交错的视觉-文本思维链；再通过知识蒸馏训练学生LVLM，利用教师logits与来自真实文本推理的交叉熵监督。当推理图像可映射到原图时，可额外蒸馏教师对相应区域的注意力；真实边界框可进一步指导后续的强化学习阶段。
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理基准上，V2T持续优于教师模型和现有基线，在留出集上平均准确率提升14.3%，在更广泛的视觉评测套件上提升2.7%；借助轻量SFT和大幅缩减的RL，训练速度比SOTA基线最高快42倍。
AI.conclusion: V2T通过蒸馏使LVLM在推理时不生成中间视觉表征即可内化视觉推理能力，兼顾了性能与训练效率，为多模态推理提供了一种高效范式。

title: Coding Agent Memory Post-training: Unlocking the Memory Potential of Pre-trained File Operations for Long-Horizon Tasks via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Language-model agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks whose interaction histories exceed the model's active context. Recent work has begun to use reinforcement learning to make memory control part of the policy, often relying on predefined memory tools within domain-specific training environments of relatively short horizons. This setup ties learned memory behavior to environment-specific interfaces that lie outside the base model's pre-training and must be learned from scratch, so even after post-training, agents struggle to use memory in long-horizon tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce Coding Agent Memory Gym (CAMG), a suite of long-horizon agentic-RL environments spanning Shop, Coding, DeepResearch, and AutoResearch. Alongside each environment's native task interface, CAMG provides executable shell access and an episode-persistent workspace, enabling agents to create, revise, search, and reuse files as memory throughout an episode. We also introduce CAMG-RL, which trains a single policy jointly across all four environments with fully asynchronous PPO, learning this file-based memory behavior directly from downstream task reward, and we train CAMG-RL-4B and CAMG-RL-9B from Qwen3.5 models of matching size. On SWE-bench Verified and MLE-bench Lite, CAMG-RL-4B and CAMG-RL-9B are competitive with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出CAMG长时程智能体RL环境与CAMG-RL异步PPO训练方法，让单一策略直接学习基于文件的记忆行为，4B/9B模型在SWE-bench Verified与MLE-bench Lite上媲美35B/122B大模型。
AI.motivation: 现有用强化学习学习记忆控制的工作依赖领域特定、短时程环境中的预定义记忆工具，导致记忆行为与环境接口绑定，而这些接口不在基座模型预训练分布内、需从零学习，因此后训练后智能体仍难以在长时程任务中有效使用记忆。
AI.method: 1) 构建CAMG环境套件，涵盖Shop、Coding、DeepResearch、AutoResearch四类长时程智能体RL任务；2) 除原生任务接口外，提供可执行shell访问与回合持久化工作区，使智能体在回合中创建、修改、检索、复用文件作为记忆；3) 提出CAMG-RL，用全异步PPO在四个环境上联合训练单一策略，直接从下游任务奖励学习基于文件的记忆行为；4) 基于Qwen3.5同规模模型训练CAMG-RL-4B与CAMG-RL-9B。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified和MLE-bench Lite上，CAMG-RL-4B与Qwen3.5-35B-A3B表现相当，CAMG-RL-9B与Qwen3.5-122B-A10B表现相当，以更小参数量取得可比性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将记忆实现为通用shell与持久化文件系统交互而非预定义工具，并结合多环境联合异步RL训练，可让较小模型习得可迁移的长时程记忆能力，显著提升长时程智能体任务性能。

title: Zero-Shot Cue-Grounded Topic Segmentation of Spoken Documents
summary: Topic segmentation structures spoken documents into coherent sections, facilitating navigation and downstream understanding. The appropriate granularity can vary substantially, ranging from broad thematic shifts to fine-grained subtopics. Existing LLM-based segmenters, however, often struggle to adapt to this variation, causing them to either merge distinct subtopics or over-segment coherent themes. To address this, we introduce Cue-Grounded Segmentation (CGS), a training-free framework that operates without any task-specific supervision. CGS first identifies phrases that explicitly signal the start of a new topic and uses their sentence positions as segment boundaries. When such cues are insufficient, it falls back to semantic segmentation, guided by the document structure inferred during cue extraction. Across six benchmarks and six LLM backbones, CGS consistently outperforms existing baselines, remains robust to noisy ASR transcripts, and achieves these gains with low API cost on proprietary models.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架CGS，利用显式话题起始线索词定位分段边界，线索不足时回退到语义分段，在六个基准和六个LLM上优于基线，对ASR噪声鲁棒且API成本低。
AI.motivation: 口语文档话题分段的合适粒度变化很大，从宽泛主题转换到细粒度子话题不等。现有基于LLM的分段器难以适应这种变化，倾向于合并不同子话题或过度切分连贯主题。论文希望在不依赖任务特定监督的情况下解决粒度自适应问题。
AI.method: 提出Cue-Grounded Segmentation（CGS），一个免训练框架，无需任务特定监督。首先识别显式标志新话题开始的短语，以其所在句子位置作为分段边界；当此类线索不足时，回退到语义分段，并由线索提取阶段推断出的文档结构进行引导。
AI.result: 在六个基准和六个LLM主干上，CGS持续优于现有基线，对带噪ASR转写保持鲁棒，并在闭源模型上以较低的API成本取得这些收益。
AI.conclusion: 通过线索驱动的边界识别与语义分段回退相结合，CGS实现了免训练且粒度自适应的话题分段，兼顾性能、鲁棒性与成本。

title: LLMs as Adaptive Meta-Solvers: Strategy-Diverse RL for Industrial-Scale Optimization
summary: Scaling LLM-based optimization from textbook-scale instances to real-world, industrial tasks remains a critical open challenge. Existing approaches are predominantly evaluated on small, self-contained textual problems and often commit to a solver-integrated paradigm, limiting their ability to handle the scale and structural diversity of practical optimization workloads. In this work, we propose a practical framework for training open-source LLMs to tackle real-world, industrial-scale optimization. We first show empirically that solver-integrated reasoning, exact combinatorial algorithm, and heuristic search exhibit complementary strengths across different problem structures and scales. Motivated by this, we introduce Strategy-Diverse Reinforcement Learning (SDRL), which trains LLMs as adaptive optimization meta-solvers. SDRL leverages this complementarity through a correctness-gated hierarchical diversity reward that promotes robust exploration across varying strategies and within each strategy, effectively preventing premature strategy collapse. We further introduce a mixed-format training scheme that jointly supports both self-contained textual problems and file-grounded instances. Across comprehensive evaluations, our framework outperforms existing fine-tuned methods and frontier models including DeepSeek-V4-Pro and GPT-5.5, both on average across benchmarks and on industrial-scale optimization tasks.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出训练开源LLM解决工业级优化任务的实用框架：先用实证证明"求解器集成推理、精确组合算法、启发式搜索"三类策略在不同问题结构与规模上互补，进而提出策略多样性强化学习SDRL，通过正确性门控的层级多样性奖励防止策略过早坍缩，并引入混合格式训练同时支持纯文本与文件型实例。在综合评测及工业级任务上均超越现有微调方法与前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的优化方法多在小规模、自包含文本问题上评测，且普遍绑定"求解器集成"范式，难以应对真实工业优化任务的规模与结构多样性。
AI.method: 1) 实证揭示求解器集成推理、精确组合算法与启发式搜索在不同问题结构和规模上互补；2) 提出SDRL，将LLM训练为自适应优化元求解器，采用正确性门控的层级多样性奖励，在策略间与策略内促进鲁棒探索；3) 混合格式训练方案，联合支持自包含文本问题与基于文件的实例。
AI.result: 在综合基准的平均表现与工业级优化任务上，该框架均优于现有微调方法及DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GPT-5.5等前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM从"绑定单一求解器范式"转向"策略多样化的元求解器"，并配合混合格式训练，是把LLM优化能力从教科书规模扩展到真实工业规模的有效路径。

title: AgentHop: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Agentic Multi-Hop Scientific Question Answering
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Evaluation and Datasets Track
summary: Agentic tasks require a large language model to interact with the world, navigating information and gathering evidence across multiple steps with restricted resources. Due to this complexity, agentic task failures arise from various sources, and pinpointing these failure causes is essential to diagnose and improve agentic systems. Existing benchmarks, however, tend to focus on a single leaderboard score, leaving the underlying failure modes opaque. To fill this gap, we introduce AgentHop, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,011 multiple-choice questions paired with a controlled seven-tool sandbox under fixed token, turn, and tool-call constraints. AgentHop reveals model vulnerabilities by dissecting a single accuracy score along four axes of agent operation: retrieval, synthesis, tool-call, and resource management. Across 19 models, we find that behavior clusters by model family, with tool-call signatures revealing distinct family fingerprints: GPT models commit early, Anthropic and GLM checkpoints verify before committing, DeepSeek and Kimi over-search, and Gemini-3 Pro stays balanced. Decomposed axes further expose within-family structure: Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 land within one accuracy point yet diverge on retrieval-versus-synthesis emphasis, with Opus retrieving more and Sonnet synthesizing better. We release the full benchmark set and the harness to support diagnostic agent benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentHop 诊断基准（1011 道多选题 + 七工具沙箱，固定 token/轮次/工具调用约束），将单一准确率分解为检索、综合、工具调用、资源管理四个维度，跨 19 个模型揭示按模型家族聚类的失败模式。
AI.motivation: Agentic 任务需在受限资源下多步交互、收集证据，失败来源多样，定位失败原因对诊断与改进智能体系统至关重要。但现有基准多聚焦单一排行榜分数，使底层失败模式不透明，缺乏细粒度诊断能力。
AI.method: 构建 AgentHop 基准：1,011 道多选题，配套可控七工具沙箱，并在 token、轮次、工具调用三方面施加固定约束。将单一准确率沿四个轴分解评估：检索（retrieval）、综合（synthesis）、工具调用（tool-call）、资源管理（resource management）；在 19 个模型上进行测试，并分析工具调用特征与家族指纹。
AI.result: 行为按模型家族聚类，工具调用特征呈现家族指纹：GPT 系提前提交，Anthropic 与 GLM 系在提交前进行验证，DeepSeek 与 Kimi 过度检索，Gemini-3 Pro 保持均衡。分解各轴还揭示家族内部结构：Claude Opus 4.6 与 Sonnet 4.6 准确率相差不到一个百分点，但侧重不同——Opus 检索更多，Sonnet 综合更好。
AI.conclusion: AgentHop 通过多维分解将智能体评估从单一分数推进到可诊断的失败模式分析，揭示模型家族及家族内部的差异化行为；公开完整基准集与评测框架（harness），支持诊断式智能体基准评测。

title: HUMAN-TCI: Hierarchical Multi-Stream Motion-Aware Network with Torso-Centered Interaction for Text-to-Motion Retrieval
summary: Accurate retrieval of human motions is a crucial first step in text-guided human motion modeling and synthesis, as it selects semantically relevant sequences from large datasets and provides grounded references for downstream tasks. Retrieving motions from natural language descriptions remains challenging because sentences can describe multiple actions, overlapping movements, and intricate dependencies between body parts. Existing methods often focus on simple, single-action descriptions and typically process body parts independently or by merely concatenating features, without explicitly modeling how torso movements influence other parts. In addition, their processing pipelines often rely on computationally heavy models, introducing considerable overhead, particularly when modeling longer or more complex motion sequences. This limits learning discriminative motion-pattern representations, reducing retrieval accuracy, interpretability, and efficiency in practical applications. To address these limitations, we propose HUMAN-TCI, a Hierarchical Multi-Stream Motion-Aware Network for text-guided human motion retrieval. HUMAN-TCI employs a three-stream architecture that separately models upper-body, lower-body, and torso motions while explicitly capturing their interactions, allowing torso-related movements to influence the positioning and dynamics of other body parts. By incorporating tailored torso attention, our model effectively recognizes complex human motion patterns, captures fine-grained motion relationships and handles complex multi-action descriptions. Our framework supports retrieval for both simple, single-action sentences and long, compositional descriptions containing sequential or overlapping actions without relying on complex models.

AI.tldr: 提出HUMAN-TCI，一种三层分级多流运动感知网络，用于文本引导的人体运动检索，可处理单动作与复杂多动作描述。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导运动检索方法多针对简单单动作描述，通常独立处理身体各部位或仅做特征拼接，未显式建模躯干对其他部位的影响；且流程依赖计算开销大的模型，难以学习判别性运动模式表示，导致检索准确率、可解释性与效率受限。
AI.method: HUMAN-TCI采用三流架构，分别建模上半身、下半身与躯干运动，并显式捕捉三者间的交互，使躯干相关运动影响其他部位的位置与动态；同时引入定制的躯干注意力机制，以识别复杂运动模式、捕捉细粒度运动关系。
AI.result: 模型能够支持简单单动作句子以及包含顺序或重叠动作的长组合描述的检索，且不依赖复杂模型，在准确率、可解释性与效率方面有所改善。
AI.conclusion: 通过三流分级建模与躯干注意力，HUMAN-TCI有效应对多动作、重叠运动与身体部位依赖等挑战，为文本引导的人体运动检索提供轻量且具判别性的方案。

title: Remember by Asking: Retrieval-Induced Memory Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory is essential for language agents to maintain coherent and effective behavior over extended, multi-session interactions. Existing memory systems mainly use retrieval at read time, while write-time memory formation still relies on direct extraction or compression. However, when future information needs are unknown, compressing an entire interaction in one pass can overlook locally important details that may matter later. To this end, we introduce RIME, a retrieval-induced memory framework that shifts memory construction from monolithic compression toward evidence-centered integration. RIME uses generic self-questions to retrieve focused dialogue evidence and grounds memory formation in both the retrieved evidence and relevant historical memories, which are jointly reconciled into an evolving memory bank with temporal and provenance information. At inference time, compressed memory serves as the primary rather than the sole source of evidence: when it cannot support an answer, RIME retrieves relevant source dialogue together with its local context to recover information omitted during memory formation, without resorting to full-history processing. Extensive experiments on LoCoMo with Qwen3-235B-A22B and GPT-5.6 Sol show that RIME consistently achieves the best performance across all three quality metrics among the compared methods, while requiring substantially fewer query-time LLM tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出RIME记忆框架，将记忆构建从单体压缩转向以证据为中心的整合，通过自提问检索对话证据并融合历史记忆形成演化记忆库，推理时以压缩记忆为主并可回退检索源对话。在LoCoMo上多模型取得全部三项指标最优，且查询期LLM token开销显著降低。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆对语言智能体在跨会话长程交互中保持连贯行为至关重要。现有记忆系统主要在读取时检索，写入时的记忆形成仍依赖一次性直接抽取或压缩。由于未来信息需求未知，对整段交互做单体压缩易遗漏局部重要细节，导致后续信息缺失。
AI.method: RIME是检索诱导的记忆框架，把记忆构建由单体压缩转为证据中心式整合：用通用自提问检索聚焦的对话证据；记忆形成同时以检索到的证据与相关历史记忆为依据，二者联合调和为带时序与溯源信息的演化记忆库。推理时压缩记忆为主要但非唯一证据来源，当其不足以支撑回答时，检索相关源对话及其局部上下文以恢复形成阶段被遗漏的信息，避免全历史处理。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo数据集上，使用Qwen3-235B-A22B与GPT-5.6 Sol模型，RIME在全部三项质量指标上一致优于对比方法，同时查询期LLM token消耗大幅减少。
AI.conclusion: RIME通过证据中心的记忆形成与压缩记忆为主、源对话回退为辅的推理机制，在不进行全历史处理的前提下兼顾记忆质量与检索效率，验证了写入时记忆构建方式改进的价值。

title: Clinical Trajectory Alignment for Medical Vision-Language Pre-training
summary: Medical vision-language pre-training largely follows a visit-level image-report matching paradigm, aligning paired images and reports at individual visits. While effective for static cross-modal correspondence, this paradigm provides limited supervision for longitudinal clinical change, such as whether abnormalities improve, remain stable, or worsen over time. Learning such change is challenging because temporal semantics are implicit in free-text reports, and different abnormalities within the same patient may evolve asynchronously or even in opposite directions. We propose MedCTA, which reframes medical vision-language pre-training from visit-level cross-modal matching to learning clinical change. Rather than compressing a patient history into a single temporal representation, MedCTA models clinical change at two complementary scopes. At the abnormality scope, clinically grounded queries construct abnormality-conditioned visual and textual trajectories to capture heterogeneous abnormality evolution. At the patient-course scope, global image and report sequences are modeled to capture overall clinical progression beyond any individual abnormality. Structured trend supervision is extracted from longitudinal reports by an offline LLM parser, removing the need for manual temporal annotations. Combined with static image-report alignment, MedCTA learns representations that preserve visit-level cross-modal correspondence while encoding longitudinal change semantics. Experiments on temporal image classification, image-text retrieval, and zero-shot classification show consistent gains over strong medical vision-language baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MedCTA，将医学视觉-语言预训练从“访视级图文匹配”重构为“临床变化学习”，在异常层面与患者病程层面双尺度建模纵向变化，并利用离线LLM解析报告获得趋势监督，在多项任务上超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉-语言预训练多采用访视级图像-报告匹配范式，仅对齐单次访视的配对图文，对纵向临床变化（异常改善、稳定或恶化）监督不足。其难点在于：时间语义隐含在自由文本报告中；同一患者不同异常可能异步甚至相反演变。
AI.method: MedCTA 将预训练目标由访视级跨模态匹配转为临床变化学习，并在两个互补尺度建模：1）异常尺度，使用临床先验查询构建“异常条件化”的视觉与文本轨迹，刻画异质异常演变；2）患者病程尺度，对全局图像与报告序列建模，捕捉超越单一异常的整体临床进展。通过离线LLM解析器从纵向报告中抽取结构化趋势监督，无需人工时间标注。最终与静态图文对齐目标联合训练。
AI.result: 在时间图像分类、图文检索与零样本分类任务上，MedCTA 相较强医学视觉-语言基线均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: MedCTA 表明将预训练目标显式转向临床变化学习是有效的：所学习表示在保留访视级跨模态对应关系的同时编码纵向变化语义，从而在多个下游任务上获益。

title: When the Score Becomes the Target: Rethinking Metric Validity in Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving benchmark scores are increasingly used not only for evaluation but also as optimization targets. This raises a fundamental question: do score gains remain reliable evidence of driving improvement once the score itself is optimized? We address this question by examining how the scoring process responds to changes in driving behavior and whether the resulting gains persist under repeated execution and replanning. We decompose the process into execution, measurement, subscore mapping, and aggregation. Controlled interventions reveal substantial behavioral changes that receive little score response because distinctions are omitted, thresholded, or attenuated between requested and executed motion. Closed-loop comparisons further show that optimization gains can reverse when the execution interface changes, demonstrating their dependence on how requests are executed and returned as feedback. Together, these findings connect the behavioral distinctions preserved by a metric to the conditions under which its gains transfer. Metric validity under optimization therefore requires examining both what the scoring process measures and how the optimized behavior is executed.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑将驾驶基准分数作为优化目标时其增益的可靠性：通过分解执行、测量、子分数映射与聚合过程，发现大量行为变化被评分忽略，且优化增益在改变执行接口后可发生逆转。
AI.motivation: 驾驶基准分数已从单纯评测工具演变为优化目标，这引出一个根本问题：当分数本身被优化时，分数提升是否仍能可靠反映驾驶能力的提升。作者希望厘清评分过程对驾驶行为变化的响应机制，以及增益能否在重复执行与重规划下保持。
AI.method: 将评分流程分解为执行、测量、子分数映射和聚合四个环节；通过受控干预（controlled interventions）观察行为变化与分数响应的对应关系；并进行闭环对比实验，验证在执行接口改变时优化增益是否可复现。
AI.result: 受控干预显示，存在显著的行为差异却几乎不引起分数变化，原因是这些差异在请求动作与实际执行动作之间被省略、阈值化或衰减；闭环对比进一步表明，当执行接口改变时优化增益可能发生逆转，说明增益依赖于请求被执行并作为反馈返回的方式。
AI.conclusion: 指标所保留的行为区分度决定了其增益在何种条件下可迁移；在优化情形下评估指标有效性，必须同时考察评分过程测什么以及被优化行为如何被执行。

title: Unbiased Top-$k$ Estimation for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is becoming an important component of large language model (LLM) post-training for transferring the reasoning capability of a strong teacher LLM to a weaker student LLM. OPD trains the student by minimizing the reverse KL divergence between the teacher and the student via rollouts generated by the student's policy. However, estimating the gradient of the reverse KL divergence in OPD remains a challenge. Using only the sampled token from the student-generated rollout is computationally cheap but provides limited distributional supervision, which will degrade accuracy. In addition, using the full vocabulary provides complete distributional supervision but is computationally expensive. Therefore, recent works propose Top-$k$ OPD (TK-OPD) that use selected top-$k$ tokens, which provides richer distributional supervision than sampled-token estimation at substantially lower computational cost than full-vocabulary estimation. Unfortunately, using only the selected top-$k$ tokens induces bias, leading to accuracy degradation, as the probability mass outside the selected top-$k$ tokens is discarded. To address the bias of TK-OPD, we propose Tail-Corrected Top-$k$ On-Policy Distillation (TT-OPD). It preserves the advantages of TK-OPD, including rich distributional supervision and low computational cost, while providing an unbiased estimator of the gradient of the reverse KL divergence. The key insight of TT-OPD is to use not only the selected top-$k$ tokens, but also the sampled token from the student-generated rollout, thereby recovering the discarded probability mass in expectation, avoiding the bias. Experimental results demonstrate that TT-OPD significantly outperforms other tested OPD variants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TT-OPD（Tail-Corrected Top-k On-Policy Distillation），通过在 Top-k 词元之外额外引入学生 rollout 采样词元，修正被丢弃的概率质量，从而为反向 KL 散度梯度提供无偏估计，在保持计算高效与丰富分布监督的同时显著优于其他 OPD 变体。
AI.motivation: 在 LLM 后训练中，on-policy distillation（OPD）通过最小化教师与学生之间的反向 KL 散度，将强教师的推理能力迁移至弱学生。但其梯度估计存在两难：仅使用学生 rollout 中采样到的单个词元虽计算开销低，却只提供有限的分布监督，导致精度下降；使用全词表则提供完整分布监督但计算代价高昂。近期提出的 Top-k OPD（TK-OPD）以选取的 top-k 词元折中，但仅使用这 k 个词元会丢弃其外的概率质量，引入偏差，进而造成精度退化。
AI.method: 提出 Tail-Corrected Top-k On-Policy Distillation（TT-OPD）。核心思想是在 TK-OPD 所选取的 top-k 词元基础上，额外纳入学生 rollout 中采样得到的词元，用以在期望意义上恢复被丢弃的尾部概率质量，从而消除 TK-OPD 的偏差，并为反向 KL 散度梯度提供无偏估计。该方法同时继承 TK-OPD 的丰富分布监督与低计算开销两个优点。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，TT-OPD 显著优于所测试的其他 OPD 变体。
AI.conclusion: TT-OPD 通过将采样词元与 top-k 词元结合，在保留 TK-OPD 计算高效与分布监督丰富优势的同时，解决了其尾部概率质量被丢弃所导致的偏差问题，实现了反向 KL 散度梯度的无偏估计，并在实验中展现出优于其他 OPD 变体的性能。

title: Modeling Whole-Slide Images as Dynamic Tumor Microenvironment Fields
summary: Due to the gigapixel-scale nature of whole-slide images (WSIs), weakly supervised WSI analysis is commonly formulated as a multiple instance learning (MIL) problem, where patch-level features are aggregated into slide-level representations. However, diagnostic and prognostic evidence often arises from spatially coherent tumor microenvironment regions and their interactions, rather than isolated patches alone. Existing patch-level or static region-based methods usually overlook how tissue regions should be adaptively formed and subsequently evolved through microenvironment interactions across heterogeneous boundaries. In this paper, we propose Concept-Guided Tumor Microenvironment Evolution (TMEvolve), a reaction-diffusion-inspired framework that models WSIs as latent tumor microenvironment fields over discrete patch graphs. TMEvolve instantiates this view as a learnable graph-discretized evolution process over patch neighborhoods. It first forms adaptive soft tissue regions as coherent microenvironment units, then performs pseudo-time evolution through two complementary local dynamics: intra-region diffusion, which stabilizes latent states within coherent tissue compartments, and concept-guided boundary flux, which propagates visual feature signals and language-derived concept signals across heterogeneous region interfaces. The evolved microenvironment regions are finally aggregated for slide-level prediction. We evaluate TMEvolve on six datasets across three weakly supervised WSI tasks: survival prediction, gene expression prediction, and histological subtype classification. TMEvolve consistently improves over representative MIL methods, pathology foundation models, and concept-guided baselines. Ablation studies and visualizations further support the effectiveness and interpretability of TMEvolve, highlighting the value of dynamic region modeling and boundary interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TMEvolve框架，将全切片图像建模为离散patch图上的潜在肿瘤微环境场，通过反应-扩散启发的图离散演化过程（区域内扩散与概念引导的边界通量）动态形成并演化微环境区域，用于切片级预测。
AI.motivation: 现有弱监督WSI方法多基于孤立patch或静态区域，忽略了组织区域应如何自适应形成以及如何通过异质边界处的微环境交互进行演化，而诊断与预后证据往往来源于空间连贯的肿瘤微环境区域及其交互。
AI.method: 提出Concept-Guided Tumor Microenvironment Evolution (TMEvolve)，一个反应-扩散启发的框架，在离散patch图上构建潜在肿瘤微环境场。其学习式图离散演化过程包含两步局部动力学：区域内扩散（稳定连贯组织区室内的潜在状态）与概念引导的边界通量（在异质区域界面传播视觉特征信号与语言衍生概念信号），最终聚合演化后的微环境区域进行切片级预测。
AI.result: 在六个数据集、三项弱监督WSI任务（生存预测、基因表达预测、组织学亚型分类）上，TMEvolve持续优于代表性MIL方法、病理基础模型及概念引导基线；消融实验与可视化进一步验证了其有效性与可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 动态区域建模与边界交互对弱监督WSI分析具有重要价值，TMEvolve通过自适应形成并演化肿瘤微环境区域，提升了预测性能与可解释性。

title: Decoding the Disaster: Multi-Task Geospatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models and Crowdsourced Imagery for Disaster Mapping
summary: Crowdsourced imagery provides timely, fine-grained, street-level observations for disaster mapping, complementing conventional remote sensing imagery (RSI) during emergency response. However, such imagery is often unstructured, spatially ambiguous, and lacks reliable geographic metadata, making manual geolocalization and interpretation labor-intensive and difficult to scale. This work proposes a multi-task Geospatial Reasoning Disaster mapping framework, namely GRDisaster, to examine the potential of vision-language models (VLMs) in understanding, geolocalizing, and reasoning over crowdsourced disaster imagery. GRDisaster is built on a newly curated benchmark dataset derived from PhotoMappers, comprising 26,340 images organized into human-validated volunteered geographic information (VGI), street-view imagery (SVI), RSI cross-view triplets covering multiple disaster events from 2018 to 2024. The framework combines deterministic and probabilistic cross-view geolocalization with multi-view fusion to associate VGI images with georeferenced SVI and RSI. It introduces two sets of spatial reasoning indicators for cross-view geolocalization validation and disaster damage assessment. These indicators use structural, environmental, and global-scene cues to validate cross-view correspondences and visually observable damage evidence with expert-verified annotations to assess disaster severity, improving the interpretability of VLM outputs. To our knowledge, this study provides the first systematic investigation and unified evaluation framework for examining how VLM-based spatial reasoning can transform crowdsourced disaster imagery into actionable geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI) through cross-view geolocalization validation, interpretable spatial reasoning, and damage-aware severity assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRDisaster框架，基于PhotoMappers构建26,340张图像的多灾种跨视角三元组基准，结合确定性与概率性跨视角地理定位、多视角融合及两套空间推理指标体系，系统评估视觉语言模型在众源灾害影像理解、定位与推理中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 救灾响应中，众源街景影像可补充传统遥感影像，提供及时、细粒度的地面观测。但此类影像结构松散、空间位置模糊、缺乏可靠地理元数据，导致人工地理定位与解译成本高、难以规模化。因此需探索视觉语言模型（VLM）在处理众源灾害影像时的理解、定位与推理能力。
AI.method: 提出多任务地理空间推理灾害制图框架GRDisaster。数据方面，基于PhotoMappers新建基准数据集，含26,340张图像，组织为经人工验证的志愿地理信息（VGI）、街景影像（SVI）与遥感影像（RSI）跨视角三元组，覆盖2018—2024年多个灾害事件。方法上融合确定性与概率性跨视角地理定位及多视角融合，将VGI影像与带地理坐标的SVI、RSI关联；并引入两套空间推理指标：用于跨视角地理定位验证和灾害损毁评估，借助结构、环境与全局场景线索验证跨视角对应关系，并结合专家核验标注的可观测损毁证据评估灾害严重程度。
AI.result: 构建了首个面向众源灾害影像的跨视角三元组基准数据集，实现VGI与SVI、RSI的跨视角关联，并通过两套空间推理指标完成跨视角定位验证与损毁严重度评估，提升了VLM输出的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了首个系统性探究与统一评估框架，考察基于VLM的空间推理如何通过跨视角地理定位验证、可解释空间推理与损毁感知的严重度评估，将众源灾害影像转化为可行动的地理空间人工智能（GeoAI）。

title: When Words Fall Short: Iterative Synergy Between Verbalized Reasoning and Hidden Features for LLM Confidence Estimation
summary: Confidence estimation is crucial for developing trustworthy large language models (LLMs), with most methods following estimator-based or verbalization-based paradigms. While recent research increasingly focuses on improving verbalized self-reports of confidence, we challenge the prevailing view that this approach surpasses independent confidence estimators. Our empirical study shows that a dedicated confidence estimator can substantially outperform verbalized confidence, indicating that LLMs' internal representations contain richer confidence signals. Building on this finding, we propose Iterative Policy-Estimator Training (IPoET), a framework that synergizes the complementary strengths of verbalized reasoning traces and informative representations. IPoET alternates policy optimization with estimator updating, integrating estimator-derived confidence feedback into policy learning and refreshing the estimator on new policy rollouts. Experiments across diverse datasets and Qwen and Llama backbones demonstrate that, by iteratively exploiting richer hidden features and adapting to the evolving policy distribution, IPoET consistently outperforms both estimator- and verbalization-based baselines in-domain and achieves superior or comparable results across all out-of-domain metrics. For more details, refer to https://github.com/xyk829/ipoet.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战"言语化置信度优于独立置信估计器"的主流观点，实证发现专用置信估计器可显著优于言语化置信度，并提出 IPoET 框架，通过策略优化与估计器更新的交替训练，融合言语化推理轨迹与内部表示的优势，在域内持续优于两类基线，域外指标表现优异或相当。
AI.motivation: 构建可信大语言模型需要准确的置信度估计。现有方法主要分为基于估计器（estimator-based）与基于言语化（verbalization-based）两类范式，近期研究日益倾向认为言语化自报告置信度优于独立置信估计器。作者对此主流观点提出质疑，试图验证 LLM 内部表示是否蕴含更丰富的置信信号，并探索如何协同利用两种范式的互补优势。
AI.method: 首先通过实证研究对比专用置信估计器与言语化置信度的性能。基于发现，提出迭代策略-估计器训练框架 IPoET（Iterative Policy-Estimator Training），该框架交替进行策略优化与估计器更新：将估计器导出的置信度反馈整合进策略学习，并在新的策略采样轨迹（rollouts）上刷新估计器，从而迭代地利用更丰富的隐藏特征并适应不断演化的策略分布。
AI.result: 在多个数据集以及 Qwen 和 Llama 主干模型上的实验表明，IPoET 通过迭代利用更丰富的隐藏特征并适应演化中的策略分布，在域内（in-domain）持续优于基于估计器和基于言语化的基线方法，并在所有域外（out-of-domain）指标上取得更优或相当的结果。代码见 https://github.com/xyk829/ipoet。
AI.conclusion: 独立的置信估计器能够显著超越言语化置信度，说明 LLM 内部表示包含更丰富的置信信号；IPoET 通过协同言语化推理轨迹与信息性表示，实现了两种范式优势的互补，为可信 LLM 的置信度估计提供了一种有效且泛化性强的方案。

title: RGDT-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning for Rule-Governed Decisions and Their Justifications
summary: We study reasoning in Rule-Governed Decision Tasks (RGDTs), where models apply external rules to case facts and justify decisions, as required in policy, contract, and compliance settings. Beyond the deductive capability emphasized by standard mathematical and logical reasoning tasks, RGDTs require interpreting rules and their applicability, assessing conditions from evidence, combining judgments under rules and exceptions, and providing checkable justifications. These demands motivate a benchmark assessing both decisions and their stated grounds. We introduce RGDT-Bench, providing 202.1K condition-level supervision slots across four task tracks and eight supported task-probe combinations that vary access to supporting information. Label-blind extraction and deterministic checks produce labels for warrant completeness: source-referenced coverage and consistency of stated decision grounds. The benchmark attributes failures to four process layers: rule use, condition, evidence, and aggregation, and checks the final outcome. Among evaluable correct responses, warrant incompleteness averages 40.2% across six evaluated LLMs and supported task-probe combinations.
