Such warrant incompleteness poses potential safety risks and remains difficult to detect: the best of seventeen existing evaluators reaches only 57.69% (random: 50%) task-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). To address this difficulty, we train a simple reward model with warrant supervision. It achieves 69.24% task-averaged AUROC among correct answers, exceeding the matched outcome-supervised baseline by 10.37 pp (percentage points) and the best existing evaluator by 11.55 pp. Beyond completeness assessment, the model outperforms both outcome-supervised baselines across nearly all response-selection comparisons, supporting RGDT-Bench's warrant supervision for RGDT reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RGDT-Bench，用于评估模型在规则治理决策任务中的推理，包括决策与依据的完整性，并训练奖励模型以检测依据不完整问题。
AI.motivation: 传统数学与逻辑推理任务主要强调演绎能力，而政策、合同与合规等场景要求模型不仅能应用外部规则作出决策，还需解释规则及其适用性、评估证据条件、结合规则与例外进行判断，并提供可核查的论证依据。现有评测缺乏对这种"决策+依据"双重能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建RGDT-Bench，包含四个任务轨道与八种支持的任务-探针组合，提供202.1K条件级监督槽位，通过标签盲提取与确定性检查生成"依据完整性"标签（来源引用覆盖与决策依据一致性），并将失败归因于规则使用、条件、证据、聚合四个过程层，同时检查最终结果。此外，训练一个带依据监督的简单奖励模型。
AI.result: 在六个评测LLM及支持的任务-探针组合中，可评估的正确响应里依据不完整平均占40.2%。十七个现有评估器中最佳者任务平均AUROC仅57.69%（随机为50%）。带依据监督的奖励模型在正确回答中达到69.24%任务平均AUROC，超过同条件结果监督基线10.37个百分点，超过最佳现有评估器11.55个百分点；在几乎所有响应选择比较中均优于结果监督基线。
AI.conclusion: 依据不完整会带来潜在安全风险且难以检测；RGDT-Bench提供的依据监督能有效提升RGDT推理评估与响应选择能力，说明对决策依据进行显式监督具有重要价值。

title: The Last Mile Is the File: OfficeEditBench for Preservation-Aware Office Editing
summary: A small Office edit creates two obligations: propagate every required update and leave protected state untouched. Updating too little leaves dependencies inconsistent; updating too much changes content the user did not authorize. We introduce OfficeEditBench, a 170-task benchmark for change-scoped maintenance of spreadsheets, presentations, and documents. Task contracts specify required updates, protected state, native structures, and applicable interaction requirements. Across 510 archived task-system outcomes from WorkBuddy, Doubao, and Codex, we distinguish file delivery, target completion, and verifier-defined acceptance. Hard package-valid delivery ranges from 92% to 100%, yet no selected output satisfies the complete contract. Case analysis highlights why local correctness is insufficient: an updated value can lose its generating formula, a revised rule can fail to reach related conclusions, and a new deadline can omit a retained prerequisite. These mechanisms connect artifact-level checks to the continued maintainability of Office files. We analyze maintenance failures while distinguishing frozen automatic verdicts from human acceptability. OfficeEditBench provides a testbed for completing required changes while preserving the logic and scope of existing work.

AI.tldr: 提出 OfficeEditBench（170 个任务）基准，用于评估 Office 文件的"变更范围受限维护"；在 510 条任务-系统结果中，包级交付率高达 92%–100%，但无一输出满足完整契约，说明局部正确性不足以保障可维护性。
AI.motivation: 一次看似微小的 Office 编辑会同时产生两项义务：传播所有必需更新，且不改动受保护状态。更新过少会导致依赖关系不一致，更新过多则会修改用户未授权的内容。现有评测多停留在文件能否正常交付，缺乏对"必需变更是否完成、既有逻辑与范围是否保留"的系统刻画，因此需要一个显式的任务契约型基准。
AI.method: 构建 OfficeEditBench：包含 170 个任务，覆盖电子表格、演示文稿与文档的变更范围受限维护。每个任务契约明确四类要素：必需更新、受保护状态、原生结构，以及适用的交互要求。基于 WorkBuddy、Doubao、Codex 收集 510 条归档的任务-系统结果，并区分三个层级：文件交付、目标完成、验证器定义的验收。通过案例分析揭示局部正确性失效的机制。
AI.result: 硬性包级有效交付率在 92%–100% 之间，但没有任何被选输出满足完整契约。案例分析给出三类典型失败：更新后的数值丢失其生成公式；修订后的规则未能传播到相关结论；新增截止日期遗漏了仍保留的前置条件。这些机制把制品级检查与 Office 文件持续可维护性联系起来。同时分析了维护失败，并区分冻结的自动判定与人工可接受性。
AI.conclusion: OfficeEditBench 为"完成必需变更、同时保留既有工作的逻辑与范围"提供了测试平台；包级可交付性并不等价于契约完备性，局部正确性不足以支撑 Office 文件的长期可维护性。

title: Precise Editing and Flexible Referencing for Interactable Worlds
summary: We present EditWorld, a video world model for precise editing and flexible referencing in interactable worlds. Existing video world models primarily focus on navigation, letting users explore generated worlds but offering limited control over how existing world content is modified. EditWorld extends world modeling from exploration to precise modification by streaming editing instructions and reference images during autoregressive generation. To support these capabilities, EditWorld introduces Gated Causal Attention for temporally varying editing conditions and reference images, together with a Sparse Context mechanism that maintains a bounded historical context for long-horizon inference. We further adopt joint autoregressive and bidirectional training with annealed self-resampling, and construct a dedicated data synthesis and annotation pipeline that provides supervision for world editing. We also present WBench-Editing to systematically evaluate streaming world editing capabilities. EditWorld achieves the best overall performance on WBench-Editing with an overall score of 73.8 and an editing score of 80.0, substantially outperforming existing methods on editing-related metrics. https://github.com/leoisufa/EditWorld

AI.tldr: EditWorld是一个视频世界模型，支持在自回归生成过程中通过流式编辑指令和参考图像对世界内容进行精确编辑与灵活引用，并提出了WBench-Editing评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型主要聚焦于导航式探索，用户可探索生成的世界，但对如何修改已有世界内容的控制能力有限。为实现从探索到精确修改的扩展，需要支持流式编辑指令与参考图像。
AI.method: 提出Gated Causal Attention以处理时间变化的编辑条件与参考图像；引入Sparse Context机制维持有界历史上下文以支持长时程推理；采用联合自回归与双向训练并配合退火自重采样；构建专门的数据合成与标注流程为世界编辑提供监督。
AI.result: 在WBench-Editing上取得最佳整体性能，总分为73.8，编辑得分为80.0，在编辑相关指标上大幅超越现有方法。
AI.conclusion: EditWorld将世界建模从探索拓展至精确修改，配合新基准WBench-Editing系统评估流式世界编辑能力，验证了方法的有效性。

title: VL-AcneSeg: A Vision-Language Framework for Region-Aware Acne Lesion Segmentation
comment: Accepted for publication in the IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
summary: Acne assessment is crucial for clinical decision-making, yet traditional grading and counting are subjective and fail to account for lesion size. While area-based assessment has emerged as a promising alternative, acne segmentation has continued to rely on general-purpose architectures. To address this gap, we propose VL-AcneSeg, a multimodal framework for acne lesion segmentation that leverages CLIP and region-level text prompts to incorporate spatial priors, enabling lesions to be localized across the whole face. Because region-level prompts indicate which facial areas contain lesions, we report a single global prompt, which requires no such information, as our primary setting. On our internal clinical dataset, VL-AcneSeg achieves a Dice score of 0.5082 and an IoU of 0.3407 under this protocol, the highest among all compared methods, including recent vision-language segmentation methods that are themselves given region-level prompts; region-level prompting raises these to 0.5296 and 0.3602. Moreover, lesion area measurements derived from our segmentation correlate with IGA scores at a level comparable to expert annotations (Pearson r = 0.719 versus 0.658). Notably, our framework maintains consistent performance across external validation datasets, performing reliably even on uncontrolled smartphone images without requiring additional training or fine-tuning. By pairing a protocol that requires no lesion-location information with area-based severity estimation, this work provides a foundation for objective acne assessment outside the clinic. Our implementation is publicly available at: https://github.com/sukjuoh/VL-AcneSeg

AI.tldr: 提出 VL-AcneSeg 多模态痤疮病灶分割框架，利用 CLIP 与区域级文本提示引入空间先验，在无病灶位置信息条件下实现全局评估与面积化严重度估计，并可零样本泛化至外部数据。
AI.motivation: 痤疮评估对临床决策至关重要，但传统分级与计数方法主观性强且忽略病灶大小；基于面积的评估虽有前景，现有痤疮分割仍沿用通用架构，未充分利用领域空间先验与多模态信息。
AI.method: 提出 VL-AcneSeg：基于 CLIP 的多模态分割框架，使用区域级文本提示编码面部区域的空间先验以定位全脸病灶；同时定义仅需单一全局提示、不依赖病灶位置信息的评估协议，并将其作为主设置，另设区域级提示作为对照。
AI.result: 内部临床数据集上，全局提示协议下 Dice 0.5082、IoU 0.3407，优于所有对比方法（包括给定区域级提示的近期视觉-语言分割方法）；区域级提示提升至 Dice 0.5296、IoU 0.3602。分割所得病灶面积与 IGA 评分相关性（Pearson r=0.719）接近专家标注（0.658）。在外部验证集及未受控手机图像上无需额外训练或微调即可保持稳定性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过“无需病灶位置信息”的协议与基于面积的严重度估计相结合，为院外客观痤疮评估奠定基础；代码已开源。

title: SentZero: An Enhanced Sentence-Centric Vision-Language Pretraining for Multi-Task Zero-Shot Chest X-Ray Analysis
summary: Vision-language (VL) pretraining using paired chest X-ray (CXR) images and radiology reports has shown strong potential for medical image understanding. However, existing methods often remain dependent on task-specific finetuning because radiology reports are lengthy, clinically dense, and difficult to align with simple zero-shot prompts. Recent sentence-level approaches partially address this limitation using clinical phrases extracted by large language models (LLMs), but they largely overlook the intrinsic characteristics of radiology discourse. In particular, limited positive-pair diversity constrains further gains, while clinically equivalent sentences frequently recur across patients, creating false negatives in contrastive learning. To address these issues, we propose SentZero, an enhanced sentence-centric VL pretraining framework for zero-shot, multi-task CXR analysis. SentZero introduces LLM-based abstract-level sentence structuring and mapping to expand positive-pair diversity, together with an additional loss term to mitigate false negatives. We further introduce sentence-conditioned residual modulation of visual embeddings, enabling visual features to adapt to the semantic characteristics of each input sentence. Across diverse downstream tasks and datasets, SentZero improves zero-shot generalization and outperforms prior multi-task zero-shot methods.

AI.tldr: SentZero：一种句子中心的视觉-语言预训练框架，通过LLM抽象级句子结构化与映射扩展正样本对多样性、引入额外损失项缓解假阴性，并采用句子条件残差调制视觉嵌入，实现零样本多任务胸部X线分析。
AI.motivation: 现有基于配对CXR图像与放射报告的VL预训练方法依赖任务特定的微调，原因是放射报告冗长、临床信息密集，难以与简单零样本提示对齐。近期句子级方法借助LLM抽取临床短语有所缓解，但忽视了放射话语的内在特性：正样本对多样性有限制约性能提升，且临床等效句子在不同患者间频繁重复，在对比学习中形成假阴性。
AI.method: SentZero提出三项关键设计：（1）基于LLM的抽象级句子结构化与映射，扩展正样本对多样性；（2）额外损失项以缓解假阴性问题；（3）句子条件残差调制视觉嵌入，使视觉特征适应每条输入句子的语义特性。
AI.result: 在多样化下游任务与数据集上，SentZero提升了零样本泛化能力，并优于先前的多任务零样本方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入句子中心的预训练框架并针对放射话语特性进行优化，SentZero有效改善了零样本多任务CXR分析的泛化性能，为医学视觉-语言预训练提供了新思路。

title: When Does an Image Determine the Answer? Benchmarking Visual Answerability across Charts and Scenes
summary: Reliable visual question answering requires correct answers when evidence is sufficient and abstention when it is not. We introduce a benchmark that connects complete-question evaluation with explicit evidence for its labels across PlotQA charts, CLEVR rendered scenes, and GQA photographs. Each question groups original and edited images, presented independently; success requires every supported answer and every required abstention to be correct. For chart missing-information labels, executable witnesses establish that admissible complete charts give different answers but identical pixels after masking. Scene labels follow source programs and edits, with a residual-cue analysis for photographs. Across 72,000 responses from six model configurations, the highest observed complete task success rates are 57.0%, 43.5%, and 33.7%, respectively. On charts, the strongest configuration achieves 96.2% per-view decision accuracy, yet 265 of its 835 groups with every decision correct still contain incorrect answers. Evaluating supported answers and necessary abstentions together exposes failures that answerability decisions alone conceal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个连接"完整问题评估"与"显式证据标注"的视觉问答基准，覆盖PlotQA图表、CLEVR渲染场景和GQA照片，要求同时做对所有支持性回答与必要弃答；在72,000条模型响应中，最高完整任务成功率分别仅为57.0%、43.5%和33.7%。
AI.motivation: 可靠的VQA不仅要在证据充分时给出正确答案，还要在证据不足时明确弃答。然而现有评估往往只关注"可回答性判定"这一单一维度，无法揭示"判定正确但回答错误"的隐性失败，因此需要一个同时考核支持性回答与必要弃答的统一基准。
AI.method: 构建跨三类数据（PlotQA图表、CLEVR渲染场景、GQA照片）的基准：每组问题配对原始图像与编辑图像并独立呈现，只有全部支持性回答和全部必要弃答均正确才算成功。标注证据方面，图表缺失信息标签通过"可执行见证"证明可接受的完整图表在掩码后像素相同却给出不同答案；场景标签依据源程序与编辑过程；照片则辅以残差线索分析。
AI.result: 在六种模型配置共72,000条响应中，三类任务最高完整成功率分别为57.0%、43.5%和33.7%。在图表上，最强配置的逐视图决策准确率达96.2%，但其835个全部决策正确的组中仍有265个包含错误回答。
AI.conclusion: 将支持性回答与必要弃答联合评估，能暴露出仅靠可回答性判定所掩盖的失败模式，说明当前模型在证据充分性与弃答的协同可靠性上仍存在显著缺口。

title: CARDAMOM: A Micro-Dialectal Arabic Speech Dataset for ASR
summary: We present Cardamom, a micro-dialectal Arabic speech dataset designed to support fine-grained evaluation and adaptation of automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. Community-curated by native speakers familiar with the represented varieties, Cardamom contains approximately 40 hours of transcribed YouTube speech spanning 21 micro-dialects across Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, Mauritania, Palestine, and Saudi Arabia. Each segment is annotated with one or more operational micro-dialect labels, code-switching information, and utterance-level perceived gender, enabling analysis of sub-country variation that is obscured by conventional country-level labels. We describe the collection and annotation process, motivate the micro-dialect inventory linguistically, and benchmark four multilingual ASR systems in zero-shot and adapted settings. The strongest zero-shot system obtains 43.47% aggregate WER, with particularly high error rates on Mauritanian and Lebanese varieties; adaptation on Cardamom reduces its WER to 35.21%. Audio-based identification experiments further show that the annotations provide a learnable prediction target, with a dedicated classifier reaching 85.57% accuracy on 21-way micro-dialect identification. Cardamom provides a resource for studying localized dialectal variation and developing Arabic speech systems with broader regional coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文发布 Cardamom——一个社区策展的微方言阿拉伯语语音数据集，含约40小时YouTube转写语音、覆盖6国21种微方言，兼具code-switching与感知性别标注，用于ASR细粒度评测与适配。
AI.motivation: 传统国别级方言标签掩盖了国家内部的语言变异，无法支撑细粒度评测与适配，因此需要微方言级别的阿拉伯语语音资源。
AI.method: 由熟悉相关变体的母语者社区策展，采集约40小时YouTube转写语音，覆盖埃及、约旦、黎巴嫩、毛里塔尼亚、巴勒斯坦和沙特的21种微方言；每段标注一个或多个可操作的微方言标签、code-switching信息及utterance级感知性别；对四种多语种ASR系统进行zero-shot与适配评测，并开展基于音频的微方言识别实验。
AI.result: 最强zero-shot系统聚合WER为43.47%，在毛里塔尼亚和黎巴嫩变体上错误率尤高；在Cardamom上适配后WER降至35.21%；专用分类器在21类微方言识别上达到85.57%准确率，表明标注构成可学习预测目标。
AI.conclusion: Cardamom为研究局部方言变异、构建区域覆盖更广的阿拉伯语语音系统提供了资源。

title: PACER: Progressive Availability-Conditioned Evidence Routing for Radiology Report Generation under Incomplete Clinical Context
summary: Radiology report generation (RRG) increasingly incorporates heterogeneous clinical evidence, such as multi-view radiographs and previous reports, whose availability varies across examinations. However, accommodating different input combinations does not ensure effective evidence use: generated reports may still omit or inaccurately describe clinically relevant findings. To address this problem, we propose PACER, a Progressive Availability-Conditioned Evidence Routing framework for structured incomplete-context RRG that follows a Refine-Calibrate-Commit pipeline. It first refines observed visual representations through endpoint-preserving patchwise routing across frozen encoder depths, incorporating complementary cues while retaining the pretrained terminal representation. It then calibrates the language-model prefix according to the observed evidence and availability state, adapting the shared generator's conditioning as the available source set changes. Finally, it generates polarity-structured clinical commitments before the report in the same autoregressive trajectory, providing structured clinical context for subsequent generation. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art clinical efficacy across all four MIMIC-RG4 settings and strong MIMIC-CXR performance, while maintaining competitive language-generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出PACER框架，通过"精炼-校准-承诺"三阶段流程，在输入证据可用性不完整条件下实现结构化放射报告生成，在MIMIC-RG4四种设定下取得最优临床效能。
AI.motivation: 放射报告生成日益整合多视角影像、既往报告等异构临床证据，但各检查中证据可用性差异大。仅支持不同输入组合并不能保证证据被有效利用，生成报告仍可能遗漏或错误描述临床相关发现。
AI.method: PACER遵循Refine-Calibrate-Commit流水线：(1)精炼阶段通过端点保持的逐块路由，在冻结编码器各深度间融合互补线索，同时保留预训练终层表征；(2)校准阶段依据观测证据与可用性状态调节语言模型前缀，使共享生成器的条件随可用来源集合变化而自适应；(3)承诺阶段在同一自回归轨迹中先生成极性结构化的临床承诺，作为后续生成的临床上下文。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-RG4全部四种可用性设定上达到最优临床效能，在MIMIC-CXR上表现强劲，同时保持有竞争力的语言生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模证据可用性状态并结构化引导生成，可有效提升不完整上下文下放射报告生成的临床准确性与证据利用率。

title: HPMD: A Historical Persian Manuscript Dataset for Word Spotting with Line-Level Annotation
summary: Large collections of historical Persian manuscripts have been digitized, but searching them is still slow and mostly manual. Historians usually want to find where a specific name, date, event, or topic appears, which is a word spotting problem. Progress on this task is limited by two things. First, there is almost no public dataset of historical Persian handwriting; the only notable resource, OpenITI MAKHZAN, contains a relatively small Persian portion. Second, word spotting models usually need word-level bounding boxes, which are very expensive to annotate. In this paper we introduce a new dataset of 223 pages, 3,678 lines, 37,631 words, and 130,630 characters, collected from diverse historical Persian books of poetry and prose and annotated at the region, line, and text level. We also propose a baseline that is trained only with line-level annotations but returns word-level locations. A fine-tuned line detector finds text lines, and a fine-tuned CRNN recognizer trained with CTC produces a frame-by-character posterior matrix for each line. Instead of decoding the most probable character at each frame, the query is scored directly against this matrix, so visually similar characters in Persian such as be and pe no longer cause hard failures. The frame alignment also gives the horizontal position of the word inside the line. On the test set, the fine-tuned line detector reaches an F1 of 0.892, and posterior-based search raises the word spotting F1 from 0.487 to 0.558 compared with exact matching on the decoded text, with the decision threshold selected on a held-out validation set. A PHOC attribute-embedding baseline that additionally receives oracle word boundaries at test time reaches an F1 of 0.449, below the proposed method. We also report a distributional analysis of the dataset, a taxonomy of retrieval errors, and a per-conditionbreakdown of performance.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了223页历史波斯语手写数据集（3,678行、37,631词、130,630字符），并提出一种仅需行级标注即可输出词级定位的词检索基线。
AI.motivation: 历史波斯语手稿已大规模数字化，但检索仍依赖人工，核心任务是词检索（word spotting）。该领域进展受限的两个原因是：缺乏公开的历史波斯语手写数据集（仅有OpenITI MAKHZAN，其波斯语部分较小），以及词检索模型通常需要昂贵的词级边界框标注。
AI.method: 数据集采集自多部历史波斯语诗歌与散文书籍，提供区域、行和文本三级标注。基线方法仅用行级标注训练：先用微调的行检测器定位文本行；再用微调并以CTC训练的CRNN识别器为每行生成帧到字符的后验矩阵。不做逐帧最可能字符解码，而是将查询直接与该后验矩阵打分，从而避免波斯语中形近字符（如be与pe）导致的硬性失败；帧对齐同时给出词在行内的水平位置。决策阈值在留出验证集上选取。
AI.result: 微调行检测器在测试集上F1为0.892；基于后验的检索将词检索F1从精确匹配的0.487提升至0.558。额外在测试时使用oracle词边界的PHOC属性嵌入基线F1仅为0.449，低于所提方法。此外还给出了数据集分布分析、检索错误分类体系及分条件性能拆解。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖行级标注的后验打分检索可有效缓解形近字符的硬失败问题，并在无词级边界框标注的前提下优于需oracle词边界的PHOC基线，同时新数据集为该任务提供了更充分的公开资源。

title: The Decision Value of Perception Compute
summary: Adaptive perception spends extra computation on inputs where perception is expected to improve. When perception feeds a downstream decision system, a better perception output need not produce a better decision. We define the decision value of perception compute as the change in downstream loss from escalating an input from a cheap to an expensive perception mode. Because this value can be negative, the allocation of perception compute should be judged against a budget-constrained decision oracle, with uniform full-fidelity inference as a baseline rather than an upper bound. We introduce DEEP (Decision Evaluation for Escalated Perception), a benchmark that scores pre-escalation allocators against this oracle under selection, latency and energy budgets, charging each allocator for its own computation. With deployed monocular geometry on KITTI and nuScenes, we find that 34--54% of the escalations that change downstream loss make it worse; harmful escalations also occur for the published PDM-Closed planner, evaluated open-loop on nuPlan with real detector outcomes. On nuScenes, perception-level gain frequently disagrees in sign with decision value. This mismatch has practical consequences: choosing among fixed deployable signals by missed-object perception gain rather than by decision value reduces realized test decision gain by 7.4% of the all-cheap loss on average. Learned allocators recover part of the oracle's value by finding beneficial escalations but select nearly as much harm as random, and once their own computation is charged at a 20% latency budget, only the lightweight routers, at about 3.5\% of a full detector pass, still beat random.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"感知计算决策价值"概念并构建DEEP基准，量化自适应感知升配在预算约束下对下游决策的影响，发现大量升配反而有害。
AI.motivation: 自适应感知通常按"感知增益"分配额外计算，但感知服务于下游决策系统时，更好的感知输出未必带来更好的决策；现有评估缺乏以决策为导向、带预算约束的衡量标准。
AI.method: 定义决策价值：输入从廉价感知模式升配到昂贵模式时下游损失的变化；以预算受限的决策Oracle为评判基准，将统一全精度推理作为基线而非上界；提出DEEP基准，在选择、时延与能耗预算下对升配前的分配器打分，并计入其自身计算开销；在KITTI、nuScenes（单目几何）及nuPlan（PDM-Closed规划器，开环，真实检测器输出）上评估。
AI.result: 34%–54%的改变下游损失的升配使结果更差；nuScenes上感知层面增益与决策价值常出现符号不一致；按漏检感知增益而非决策价值选择部署信号，使实际测试决策增益平均下降全廉价损失的7.4%；学习型分配器能找回部分Oracle价值但造成的伤害接近随机，计入自身计算后（20%时延预算），仅轻量路由（约全检测器一次前向的3.5%）仍优于随机。
AI.conclusion: 应以决策价值而非感知增益来评估与分配感知计算，且需计入分配器自身开销；感知增益与决策价值的一致性假设不成立，需面向决策的预算约束基准与更高效的分配器。

title: ConCAD: Constraint-Aware Image-to-CAD Generation with Dual-Granularity Rewards
summary: Image-to-CAD generation seeks executable parametric programs that recover both the geometry and design intent of a reference object. Existing systems are commonly evaluated by validity and shape overlap, although two solids with similar volume can encode different CAD relations. We introduce ConCAD, a constraint-aware image-to-CAD framework optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with rewards at two complementary granularities: a code-level constraint reward and an execution-level geometric reward. This complementary design disambiguates structurally distinct yet volumetrically similar shapes while ensuring valid 3D geometry. To verify that these rewards recover geometry and design intent, we introduce a B-rep geometric constraint satisfaction rate (G-CSR), which analytically extracts and evaluates geometric constraints from boundary representations. Experiments on the DeepCAD and Zero2CAD demonstrate that ConCAD achieves the best IoU and Chamfer Distance over competitive baselines, while also outperforming them on G-CSR, validating its superior recovery of both geometric fidelity and parametric design intent.

AI.tldr: 提出ConCAD，一个约束感知的图像到CAD生成框架，用GRPO结合代码级约束奖励和执行级几何奖励进行优化，并引入G-CSR指标验证设计意图恢复，在DeepCAD和Zero2CAD上取得最优IoU、Chamfer Distance和G-CSR。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到CAD生成系统通常只用有效性和形状重叠（如体积、IoU）来评估，但体积相似的两个实体可能编码不同的CAD关系，即无法区分几何保真度与参数化设计意图的恢复。
AI.method: 提出ConCAD约束感知图像到CAD框架，通过GRPO优化，采用两个互补粒度的奖励：代码级约束奖励和执行级几何奖励；同时提出B-rep几何约束满足率（G-CSR），从边界表示中解析并评估几何约束。
AI.result: 在DeepCAD和Zero2CAD数据集上，ConCAD在IoU和Chamfer Distance上优于竞争基线，同时在G-CSR上也表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 双粒度奖励设计能区分结构不同但体积相似的形状并保证3D几何有效，实验验证ConCAD在几何保真度和参数化设计意图恢复两方面均表现优越。

title: Can Attack Difficulty Be Characterized Before Optimization? A Study of Pre-optimization Difficulty in Person-Vanishing Attacks
summary: Adversarial attacks against object detectors are traditionally studied from an optimization perspective, where attack difficulty is regarded as an outcome observed only after adversarial optimization. This raises a fundamental question: \emph{can the relative attack difficulty of different inputs be characterized before optimization begins?} In this paper, we investigate this question for person-vanishing attacks by introducing the concept of pre-optimization attack difficulty, which captures intrinsic differences in optimization effort across input images. To estimate this latent difficulty before optimization, we propose Quad-CLEVER, an efficient geometry-based estimator derived from a quadratic approximation of the local person-vanishing margin along the most attack-relevant direction. Extensive experiments across multiple attack algorithms demonstrate that Quad-CLEVER consistently correlates with the observed optimization cost, providing empirical evidence that attack difficulty exhibits a predictable pre-optimization structure. Building upon this finding, we further propose a difficulty-aware attack framework that leverages the estimated difficulty to adaptively allocate optimization budgets for a base attack under a fixed computational budget. On BDD100K, the proposed framework improves the image-level attack success rate by up to 5.78$\%$ while reducing the average optimization cost by up to 11.42 iterations. On the more challenging EventPed dataset, it saves 2.25 optimization iterations while maintaining comparable attack performance. These results demonstrate that attack difficulty can be meaningfully estimated before optimization and that exploiting such estimates enables more computationally efficient adversarial attacks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"优化前攻击难度"概念，并设计Quad-CLEVER几何估计器，在优化开始前预测人消失攻击的难度，进而构建难度感知攻击框架以自适应分配优化预算，提升攻击成功率并降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 传统对抗攻击研究从优化视角出发，把攻击难度视为优化之后才能观测到的结果，无法回答"能否在优化开始前刻画不同输入的攻击难度"这一根本问题。作者希望预先估计输入图像固有的攻击难度差异，从而更高效地利用计算资源。
AI.method: 提出"优化前攻击难度"概念，度量不同图像在优化代价上的内在差异；提出Quad-CLEVER估计器，基于沿最相关攻击方向上局部"人消失边界"的二次近似进行高效几何估计；并据此构建难度感知攻击框架，在固定计算预算下为基攻击自适应分配优化预算。
AI.result: 在多种攻击算法上，Quad-CLEVER与实测优化代价持续相关，证明攻击难度具有可预测的优化前结构。在BDD100K上，图像级攻击成功率最高提升5.78%，平均优化代价最多减少11.42次迭代；在更具挑战的EventPed数据集上，节省2.25次优化迭代且攻击性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 攻击难度可在优化前被有意义地估计，利用该估计能实现更计算高效的对抗攻击，说明优化前攻击难度是提升攻击效率的有效切入点。

title: SubjectAnchor: Subject-Aware Memory-to-Video for Multi-Shot Storytelling
summary: We present SubjectAnchor, a Subject-Aware Memory-to-Video paradigm for multi-shot storytelling in which the current shot is generated by conditioning on explicit visual memories extracted from previous shots. The objective is to preserve subject identity and scene consistency across cuts while retaining the controllability of shot-wise prompting. Built on Wan2.2-I2V-A14B, SubjectAnchor contains three key components: subject-related memory construction, subject-aware temporal rotary position encoding, and memory-aware attention partition. For each target shot, the method constructs a compact memory bank by tracing each required subject to its historical appearance and retrieving the most relevant precomputed keyframes. These memory frames are encoded into the model input as explicit visual conditions, while different subjects are assigned to separated negative temporal slots to reduce identity interference. In addition, memory-aware attention partition regulates the interaction between memory tokens and generated content within a shared backbone. This formulation preserves the appearance anchoring of explicit visual memory while remaining compatible with script-driven shot-by-shot generation. Experiments show that SubjectAnchor improves cross-shot identity consistency over representative memory-based and holistic baselines while maintaining competitive visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出SubjectAnchor，一种以显式视觉记忆为条件的主体感知"记忆到视频"多镜头叙事生成范式，在保持逐镜头提示可控性的同时提升跨镜头身份与场景一致性。
AI.motivation: 多镜头叙事视频生成中，跨剪切的主体身份与场景一致性难以保持，同时又不希望牺牲逐镜头脚本提示的可控性；现有基于记忆或整体化（holistic）的方法在这两方面存在折中。
AI.method: 基于Wan2.2-I2V-A14B，包含三部分：(1) 主体相关记忆构建——将每个所需主体追溯到其历史出现，检索最相关的预计算关键帧，构建紧凑记忆库；(2) 主体感知时间旋转位置编码——将记忆帧编码为显式视觉条件，并把不同主体分配到分离的负时间槽以减少身份干扰；(3) 记忆感知注意力分区——在共享主干内调控记忆token与生成内容之间的交互。
AI.result: 在跨镜头身份一致性上优于代表性的基于记忆与整体化基线，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 显式视觉记忆锚定与脚本驱动的逐镜头生成可兼容，SubjectAnchor为多镜头叙事视频生成提供了一致性更强的方案。

title: KiT: A Foundation Model for Financial Time-Series Forecasting using DiffusionTransformers
summary: Financial candlestick forecasting is fundamental to quantitative investment, yet it remains exceptionally challenging due to extremely low signal-to-noise ratios and vast heterogeneity across markets and instruments. Existing approaches have largely attempted to introduce deep learning to capture hidden temporal features, but most adopt an auto-regressive formulation, which leads to error accumulation during inference. Meanwhile, general-purpose time-series foundation models are not tailored to the unique structure of k-line data and yield unsatisfactory performance on downstream candlestick forecasting tasks. To tackle these problems, we introduce KiT, a K-line Diffusion Transformer foundation model, and reformulate future prediction as conditional path generation via flow matching: given a historical context window, the model generates an ensemble of plausible future OHLCV trajectories. We pre-train KiT at multiple parameter scales on billions of candlestick bars spanning multiple markets and timescales. Across three markets and seven resolutions, KiT attains a mean return RankIC of 0.057 and a mean volatility RankIC of 0.66, leading at every timescale and outperforming both task-specific financial forecasters and general time-series foundation models. Code will be available at: https://github.com/Luciferbobo/KiT.

AI.tldr: 论文提出KiT，一个针对K线数据的扩散Transformer基础模型，用flow matching将未来预测重构为条件路径生成，生成未来OHLCV轨迹集合，在三个市场七个分辨率上超越专用金融预测器与通用时序基础模型。
AI.motivation: 金融K线预测信噪比极低，且市场与标的存在巨大异质性。现有方法多采用自回归形式建模，推理时会累积误差；同时通用时序基础模型未针对K线数据结构设计，在下游K线预测任务上表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出KiT（K-line Diffusion Transformer）基础模型，将未来预测重构为条件路径生成任务，采用flow matching方法：给定历史上下文窗口，生成多组合理的未来OHLCV轨迹集合。在覆盖多市场、多时间尺度的数十亿根K线数据上，按多种参数规模进行预训练。
AI.result: 在三个市场、七个时间分辨率上，KiT取得平均收益RankIC为0.057、平均波动率RankIC为0.66，在所有时间尺度上均领先，优于任务专用金融预测器和通用时序基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过扩散Transformer与flow matching的条件生成范式，KiT有效缓解了自回归误差累积问题，并适配K线数据特性，验证了金融K线基础模型的可行性与优越性，代码将开源。

title: Low-Confidence Remasking Traps Flexibility: Realizing Arbitrary-Order Potential for Diverse Rollouts in Diffusion LLMs
summary: Masked diffusion language models support arbitrary-order generation, suggesting a natural way to produce diverse outputs. However, recent work argues that this flexibility reduces diversity by delaying high-uncertainty tokens that can lead to different generation paths. We trace this diversity loss not to arbitrary-order generation itself, but largely to low-confidence remasking (LCR), a widely used decoding rule. At each step, LCR samples a token at every masked position but commits only the sampled token with the highest probability, filtering out the rest. We show that this mechanism can exponentially suppress lower-probability tokens as more positions compete, and observe the same suppression in LLaDA. In contrast, top-probability position selection (TPP), which has often been conflated with LCR under the shared label confidence-based decoding, avoids this diversity loss. TPP first selects the position whose most likely token has the highest probability, then samples directly from that position's distribution. Replacing LCR with TPP restores diversity and yields Pass@$k$ comparable to left-to-right decoding, suggesting that the reported diversity loss stems largely from LCR's filtering rather than from generating high-confidence positions first. To further exploit order flexibility, we introduce Entropy-Guided Initialization (EGI), which samples the first token at the highest-entropy position and then follows TPP. This simple modification further improves rollout diversity and solution coverage beyond left-to-right decoding, with gains extending to downstream policy optimization, highlighting the potential of arbitrary-order generation for diverse rollouts.

AI.tldr: 本文指出掩码扩散语言模型的多样性损失主要源于低置信度重掩码（LCR）解码规则，而非任意顺序生成本身；用TPP替代LCR可恢复多样性，并进一步提出EGI以提升多样性。
AI.motivation: 近期研究认为掩码扩散语言模型的任意顺序生成会因延迟高不确定性token而降低输出多样性。作者试图厘清多样性损失的真正来源。
AI.method: 分析LCR机制（每步在所有掩码位置采样，仅提交概率最高的token），指出其会随竞争位置增多而指数级抑制低概率token；将其与常被混称的TPP（先选最可能token概率最高的位置，再从该位置分布直接采样）对比，并在LLaDA上验证。进一步提出Entropy-Guided Initialization（EGI）：在最高熵位置采样首个token后再执行TPP。
AI.result: 理论分析与LLaDA实验均观察到LCR导致的多样性抑制。将LCR替换为TPP可恢复多样性，Pass@k与从左到右解码相当。EGI在前述基础上进一步提升rollout多样性与解覆盖率，效果优于从左到右解码，并将增益延伸至下游策略优化。
AI.conclusion: 报告的多样性损失主要来自LCR的过滤机制，而非先生成高置信度位置；利用顺序灵活性（TPP+EGI）可为多样化rollout带来显著收益。

title: XFlow: A Workflow Model for Instruction-Guided Lesion Segmentation in Chest X-rays
summary: Existing text-guided segmentation models in the medical domain cover only a narrow set of anatomical structures and lesions in chest X-rays (CXRs), and most of them assume that the queried target is always present in the image. Instruction-guided lesion segmentation (ILS) was introduced to overcome these limitations by segmenting diverse lesion types from simple user instructions while also recognizing when the queried lesion is absent, and ROSALIA was proposed as the first model for this task. However, the masks produced by ROSALIA remain of limited quality, often carrying scattered noise. Moreover, ROSALIA predicts the mask in a single shot, which differs fundamentally from how radiologists perceive and delineate lesions in practice. A radiologist first surveys the entire thorax, then localizes the approximate region of abnormality, and only then refines the lesion contour. Motivated by this coarse-to-fine, multi-level perception process, we present XFlow, a workflow model for ILS that combines box-based localization with multi-turn point refinement. XFlow detects the lungs, decides whether the queried finding is present in each of them, and prompts a fine-tuned SAM with the lesion box for an initial mask. It then corrects that mask through point prompts until its boundary follows the lesion, leaving every intermediate decision visible. Our experiments show that XFlow achieves the best segmentation quality on both internal and external evaluation. Notably, it surpasses ROSALIA in segmentation quality even when the two are trained on the same lesion annotations. Code and model weights will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: XFlow：面向胸片指令引导病灶分割的“由粗到细”多轮工作流模型，结合框定位与点提示细化，在多级决策可见的前提下取得最优分割质量。
AI.motivation: 现有胸片文本引导分割模型仅覆盖少量解剖结构与病灶，且默认查询目标必然存在；IL­S 任务与首个模型 ROSALIA 虽解决了多病灶分割与缺失识别问题，但其掩码质量有限、常含散乱噪声，且单次预测不符合放射科医生先整体浏览、再定位异常区域、最后精修轮廓的由粗到细感知过程。
AI.method: XFlow 采用多级、多轮工作流：先检测左右肺，并判断查询征象在各肺中是否存在；若存在，用病灶框提示微调后的 SAM 生成初始掩码；随后通过点提示进行多轮修正，直至掩码边界贴合病灶，且所有中间决策均可见。
AI.result: 在内部与外部评测中均取得最佳分割质量；即使与 ROSALIA 使用相同的病灶标注训练，XFlow 的分割质量仍优于 ROSALIA。
AI.conclusion: 受放射科医生由粗到细的多级感知过程启发，XFlow 通过框定位与多轮点细化显著提升了指令引导病灶分割质量，并保持决策可解释；代码与模型权重将公开。

title: How to Tame a Multi-Headed Hydra? Adaptive Multi-Category Safety Steering for Large Language Models
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly widespread, preventing unsafe responses to harmful prompts is essential for their safe deployment. Activation steering offers an approach to improving LLM safety by modifying internal activations during inference without updating model parameters. However, a single prompt can involve multiple harm categories, and steering toward safety in one category may leave harmful content from another unaddressed. Despite advances in adaptive steering, existing methods do not explicitly coordinate steering direction and strength when multiple harm categories co-occur within a single prompt. To address this problem, we propose CAM-Steer, a Category-Adaptive Multi-category Safety Steering framework. Specifically, it estimates the risk associated with each harm category by comparing the current hidden state with safe and unsafe prototypes. The estimated risks are then used to combine the safety directions for different harm categories into a single steering direction and to determine the strength of the intervention. Finally, it rotates the hidden state along the composed steering direction, with the rotation angle determined by the estimated risks, while preserving the hidden-state norm. Experiments across three LLM backbones and seven harm categories show that CAM-Steer outperforms the evaluated baselines in average defense success rate, including when categories co-occur. Further analyses support its component designs and informative risk scores, with negligible inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出CAM-Steer，一种类别自适应多类别安全激活引导框架，通过风险估计协调多个危害类别的引导方向与强度。
AI.motivation: LLM安全部署需要防止对有害提示的不安全响应。激活引导可在推理时修改内部激活而不更新参数。但单个提示可能涉及多个危害类别，向某一类别引导安全可能遗漏其他类别；现有自适应引导方法在多个危害类别共现时，未显式协调引导方向和强度。
AI.method: CAM-Steer通过将当前隐状态与安全、不安全原型比较，估计每个危害类别的风险；据此将不同类别的安全方向组合为单一引导方向，并确定干预强度；最后沿组合方向旋转隐状态，旋转角由估计风险决定，同时保持隐状态的范数。
AI.result: 在三个LLM骨干和七个危害类别上实验，CAM-Steer在平均防御成功率上优于所评估的基线，包括类别共现情形；进一步分析支持其组件设计和风险分数的信息性，且推理开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: CAM-Steer有效解决多危害类别共现下的激活引导协调问题，提升LLM安全性，且几乎不增加推理开销。

title: Evidence Before Accuracy: A MRI-PET Fusion Network for Alzheimer Disease Classification with Causal Regional Validation
summary: Deep learning models for Alzheimer disease (AD) classification routinely report near-perfect discrimination, yet few are shown to rest on AD-relevant neurobiology rather than on dataset artifacts, subject-level leakage, or non-brain image content. We present a fusion network combining T1 MRI and FDG PET across axial, coronal, and sagittal planes, trained on ADNI consists of 554 paired subjects. The fusion model reaches AUC 0.962, accuracy 0.909, and F1 0.891, competitive with recent 3D CNN and multimodal transformer systems at substantially lower cost. We first quantify how much modality, plane and slice geometry matter. A validation-only search over slice centres and neighbour spacings moves AUC by 0.180 for MRI and 0.078 for PET, selecting narrow spacing for MRI and wide spacing for PET, with the chosen coronal centres falling on the hippocampal body and on the posterior cingulate respectively. The contribution, however, is the evidence layer built around that number. Shortcut controls collapse the model to AUC 0.622 (silhouette), 0.608 (exterior), and 0.500 (blank), and a label-permutation null yields 0.456. Forward region-of-interest (ROI) ablation shows that masking medial temporal cortex in MRI and the posterior default-mode network (DMN) in PET produces the largest shift in the AD logit, while area-matched controls remain indistinguishable from that null. Reverse ROI ablation shows that the medial temporal lobe alone retains 89.2% of above-chance discrimination in MRI and the posterior DMN alone retains 79.0% in PET. A quantitative comparison of attribution methods shows occlusion sensitivity reaching 3.5-5.0* enrichment inside a priori AD regions against 0.10-0.43* in controls. Ablation and attribution independently establish a biologically correct double dissociation: hippocampal evidence is carried by MRI, posterior cingulate evidence by PET.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出融合T1 MRI与FDG PET（轴/冠/矢三平面）的双模态网络用于AD分类，AUC 0.962；核心贡献在于围绕该性能指标构建的"证据层"：通过捷径控制、标签置换零分布、正/反向ROI消融与归因方法比较，证明模型依赖AD相关神经生物学（MRI海马体、PET后扣带回/DMN），而非数据集伪影。
AI.motivation: AD分类的深度学习模型普遍报告近乎完美的判别性能，但少有工作证明其依据是AD相关的神经生物学基础，而非数据集伪影、受试者层面泄漏或非脑图像内容。因此需要一套系统性验证证据来支撑性能数字的可信度。
AI.method: 构建T1 MRI与FDG PET的三平面（轴、冠、矢）融合网络，基于ADNI的554名配对受试者训练；进行仅验证集上的切片中心与相邻间距搜索以量化模态、平面与切片几何的影响；构建证据层：捷径控制（轮廓、外部、空白）、标签置换零分布、正向ROI消融（掩蔽MRI内侧颞叶皮层、PET后DMN）及面积匹配对照、反向ROI消融（保留单区域）、归因方法定量比较（遮挡敏感性在AD先验区域与对照区的富集倍数）。
AI.result: 融合模型达到AUC 0.962、准确率0.909、F1 0.891，性能与近期3D CNN和多模态Transformer相当但成本显著更低。切片中心与间距搜索使AUC变动：MRI 0.180、PET 0.078，MRI优选窄间距、PET优选宽间距，所选冠状中心分别落在海马体与后扣带回。捷径控制使模型坍缩至AUC 0.622（轮廓）、0.608（外部）、0.500（空白），标签置换零分布为0.456。正向ROI消融显示掩蔽MRI内侧颞叶皮层与PET后DMN对AD logit影响最大，面积匹配对照与零分布无差别。反向ROI消融显示MRI中仅内侧颞叶即保留89.2%的超随机判别力，PET中仅后DMN保留79.0%。归因比较显示遮挡敏感性在AD先验区域富集3.5–5.0×，对照区为0.10–0.43×。
AI.conclusion: 消融与归因独立地确立了一种生物学上正确的双重分离：海马体证据由MRI承载，后扣带回证据由PET承载，表明该融合模型建立于AD相关神经生物学而非伪影之上。

title: SAGE: Subspace Alignment for Classifier-Free Guidance in Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing are a leading recipe for scaling generative models. Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is essential for generation quality, yet excessively high guidance scales trigger collapse. We identify a previously unreported failure mode in their combination: the two CFG branches route independently, so their realized activations occupy different subspaces. The unconditional write then leaves the conditional subspace, and CFG amplifies that residual linearly in the guidance scale. We propose SAGE, a training-time regularizer that aligns unconditional MoE activations to the conditional subspace without restricting routing diversity, at zero inference cost. Toy experiments show that SAGE dramatically suppresses extreme drift by 9.2x. When scaled to a 1B-parameter text-to-image model, SAGE significantly improves generation quality, delivering a 9.3% boost in peak DPG-Bench performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAGE consistently outperforms the baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别了扩散Transformer与MoE路由结合时，CFG两条分支独立路由导致激活子空间错位的失效模式，并提出训练期正则化器SAGE，在不限制路由多样性的前提与零推理成本下对齐无条件激活到条件子空间，显著提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer配合MoE路由是扩展生成模型的主流范式，而CFG对生成质量至关重要但过高引导尺度会引发崩溃。作者发现二者结合存在一个此前未被报告的失效模式：CFG两条分支独立路由，导致实现的激活占据不同子空间，无条件写入偏离条件子空间，且CFG会随引导尺度线性放大该残差。因此需要一个不牺牲路由多样性、不增加推理开销的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出SAGE，一种训练期正则化器，将无条件MoE激活对齐到条件子空间，同时不限制路由多样性，且推理阶段零额外成本。
AI.result: 玩具实验显示SAGE将极端漂移抑制9.2倍；扩展到10亿参数文生图模型后，显著提升生成质量，峰值DPG-Bench性能提升9.3%；大量实验表明SAGE持续优于基线。
AI.conclusion: SAGE通过训练期对齐无条件MoE激活至条件子空间，有效缓解CFG与MoE路由结合下的子空间错位与引导放大漂移问题，在零推理成本下持续提升扩散生成模型的质量，具备良好的可扩展性。

title: RRG-SLAM: Real-time Reflection-aware Gaussian SLAM for Indoor Scenes
summary: We introduce the first real-time reflection-aware Gaussian SLAM system for indoor scenes. The system features a reflection-aware TSDF-Gaussian hybrid representation that explicitly separates diffuse scene appearance from reflection components. The base scene is modeled by a TSDF volume and a set of base Gaussians capturing geometry and diffuse appearance, while planar reflections are represented by reflection Gaussian groups associated with detected reflective planes. The rendering is performed in three passes: TSDF raycasting first yields surface color, depth, plane IDs and reflection masks; base Gaussians are then rendered order-independently with depth culling and combined with the TSDF output to form the base image; finally, under the guidance of the plane ID map, reflection Gaussians from different reflection groups are rasterized only into their corresponding planar regions to generate the reflection image, which is subsequently composited with the base image via the reflection mask to produce the final output. For online reconstruction, our system first estimates the camera pose through reflection-aware tracking to suppress interference of reflection-dominated regions. It then identifies reflective planes using geometric, semantic, and temporal cues, and fuses the observations into the augmented TSDF volume with reflection-aware attributes. Afterwards the base and reflection Gaussians are initialized, optimized, and pruned online to maintain both reconstruction quality and efficiency. Experiments on a variety of datasets show that our method outperforms existing SLAM systems in reconstruction quality, tracking robustness, and novel-view rendering for indoor environments with reflections, while preserving real-time performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向室内场景的实时反射感知高斯SLAM系统，采用反射感知TSDF-高斯混合表示分离漫反射外观与反射分量，通过三通道渲染与在线重建流程，在重建质量、跟踪鲁棒性和新视角渲染上优于现有方法并保持实时性。
AI.motivation: 室内场景中普遍存在镜面、玻璃等反射表面，反射分量会干扰相机跟踪与几何重建，而现有SLAM系统通常无法显式区分漫反射外观与反射成分，导致重建质量和跟踪鲁棒性受限，且难以满足实时性需求。
AI.method: 提出反射感知的TSDF-高斯混合表示：TSDF体与基础高斯表示几何和漫反射外观，平面反射由关联反射平面的反射高斯组表示。渲染分三步：TSDF光线投射输出表面颜色、深度、平面ID和反射掩码；基础高斯结合深度剔除进行顺序无关渲染并与TSDF输出合成基础图像；在平面ID图引导下，将各反射高斯组仅栅格化到对应平面区域生成反射图像，再经反射掩码与基础图像合成。在线重建中先进行反射感知跟踪以抑制反射主导区域干扰，再利用几何、语义和时间线索识别反射平面，将观测融合进带反射属性的增强TSDF体，并在线初始化、优化和剪枝基础与反射高斯。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在含反射的室内环境中于重建质量、跟踪鲁棒性和新视角渲染方面均优于现有SLAM系统，同时保持实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式分离漫反射与反射分量的混合表示与三通道渲染机制，系统实现了实时反射感知的室内SLAM，验证了反射建模对提升重建、跟踪与渲染效果的有效性。

title: Preference-Guided Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation via Prompt Disagreement
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) enables pixel-level prediction over arbitrary text-specified vocabularies and has shown strong generalization on common benchmarks. However, OVSS performance often degrades in specialized domains such as medical imaging, remote sensing, and industrial inspection, where dense pixel-level masks for adaptation are costly to obtain and require domain-specific expertise. We propose a preference-guided adaptation framework that replaces dense mask supervision with binary preferences. We observe that different prompt templates produce systematically different segmentations for the same image, a phenomenon we call prompt disagreement, and we repurpose it as a built-in source of preference supervision. Building on this, we mine localized preference queries from regions of high cross-template uncertainty, and adapt the OVSS model with Region-Localized Preference Optimization (RLPO) together with consistency regularization that stabilizes updates outside the queried region. Across extensive experiments on the MESS benchmark, the proposed method achieves consistent gains across diverse OVSS backbones without any pixel-level annotation, and remains effective under noisy preferences. Our code is available at https://github.com/blue-531/pref-ovss.

AI.tldr: 提出偏好引导的开放词汇语义分割域适应框架，用二值偏好替代稠密掩码监督，利用提示不一致性挖掘局部偏好查询，在MESS基准上无需像素级标注即取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇语义分割在通用基准上泛化良好，但在医学影像、遥感、工业检测等专业领域性能下降；而这些领域获取稠密的像素级掩码成本高，且需要领域专业知识。
AI.method: 提出偏好引导的域适应框架。观察到同一图像在不同提示模板下会产生系统性不同的分割结果（"提示不一致"，prompt disagreement），将其转化为内置的偏好监督来源；从跨模板高不确定性区域挖掘局部化偏好查询，使用区域局部化偏好优化（RLPO）并结合一致性正则化，以稳定查询区域之外的更新。
AI.result: 在MESS基准上的大量实验中，该方法在多种OVSS骨干网络上均取得一致增益，且完全无需像素级标注；在偏好含噪声的情况下依然有效。
AI.conclusion: 提示不一致性可被重新利用为免费且有效的偏好监督信号，使开放词汇语义分割在缺乏稠密标注的专业领域实现无标注适应，并具备对噪声偏好的鲁棒性。

title: Papers Without Code: Availability of GitHub Repositories Linked in *CL Publications
comment: Accepted for publication in Computational Linguistics. Author's final version (pre-MIT Press publication)
summary: Source code and data published at computational linguistics (*CL) venues are increasingly being shared via GitHub. While this generally is a favourable development for the accessibility and potential reusability of research artifacts in natural language processing (NLP), the long-term availability of such repositories has not been evaluated. In this squib, we discuss the availability of repositories linked in papers published in the Computational Linguistics (CL) journal as well as at ACL and its co-located events over the past ten years. Contrary to our expectations, we find that GitHub repositories linked in more recent ACL publications are unavailable at similar rates as in older publications, in parts due to an increase in empty and placeholder repositories. Similar trends hold for other *CL venues, but not for platforms other than GitHub.

AI.tldr: 该文研究了近十年CL期刊及ACL等*CL会议论文中GitHub仓库的长期可获取性。结果显示较新ACL论文链接的仓库不可用率与较旧论文相当，部分原因是空仓库和占位仓库增多；趋势同样见于其他*CL会议，但不适用于非GitHub平台。
AI.motivation: *CL领域论文越来越多通过GitHub共享代码与数据，这有利于NLP研究资源的可获取性和可复用性，但这些仓库的长期可用性此前未被评估。作者希望检验论文发表时间与链接仓库可用性之间的关系。
AI.method: 作者以Computational Linguistics（CL）期刊以及ACL及其同期会议过去十年的论文为对象，收集论文中链接的仓库地址，统计并比较不同年份发表论文中GitHub仓库的可获取情况，并区分空仓库、占位仓库以及其他非GitHub平台。
AI.result: 与预期相反，较新的ACL论文所链接的GitHub仓库不可用率与较旧论文相近；导致这一现象的部分原因是空仓库和占位仓库增加。其他*CL会议呈现类似趋势，但GitHub之外的其他平台未表现出同样趋势。
AI.conclusion: GitHub仓库的长期可获取性并未随论文发表时间变新而改善，研究工件共享的可持续性仍需关注；不同平台的可获取性表现存在差异，提示应加强对仓库维护与归档的要求。

title: TSGate: Timestep-Aware Gated Attention for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have emerged as the dominant architecture for high-fidelity image and video generation. Recent DiT systems increasingly use structured prompts for training, improving caption quality and prompt adherence. However, their generation quality can degrade severely under out-of-domain (OOD) prompts, including the free-form descriptions supplied by users at inference time. Although LLM-based rewriting can convert these prompts into structured formats, it does not guarantee that the rewritten prompts align with the training distribution. Our analysis links this degradation to attention sinks and reduced early-step image-to-text attention and shows that sink suppression alone is insufficient to restore generation quality. Despite effective sink suppression, models trained with standard gated attention exhibit reduced early-step image-to-text attention and suboptimal generation quality. Based on these insights, we propose Timestep-Aware Gated Attention (TSGate), which injects a timestep-conditioned bias into the gate signal so that gating behavior adapts across denoising steps. Extensive experiments show that TSGate consistently outperforms both the baseline and standard gated attention across multiple benchmarks, improving the raw-prompt DPG score by 9.5% over the baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对扩散Transformer（DiT）在域外提示下生成质量下降的问题，提出时间步感知门控注意力（TSGate），通过引入时间步条件偏置使门控行为随去噪步动态调整，在多个基准上超越基线和标准门控注意力，原始提示DPG分数提升9.5%。
AI.motivation: DiT已成为高保真图像与视频生成的主流架构，近期系统越来越多采用结构化提示训练以提升caption质量与提示遵循度。但在域外（OOD）提示（包括用户推理时的自由形式描述）下生成质量严重下降。基于LLM的重写虽可将提示转为结构化格式，却无法保证重写提示与训练分布对齐。作者通过分析将退化归因于注意力汇与早期步骤图文注意力减弱，并指出仅抑制注意力汇不足以恢复生成质量。
AI.method: 作者先进行机理分析：标准门控注意力训练下，即便有效抑制注意力汇，模型仍表现出早期步骤图文注意力下降与次优生成质量。据此提出TSGate（Timestep-Aware Gated Attention），在门控信号中注入时间步条件偏置，使门控行为在去噪各步骤间自适应调整。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，TSGate持续优于基线及标准门控注意力；相较基线，原始提示（raw-prompt）的DPG分数提升9.5%。
AI.conclusion: OOD提示下DiT生成质量退化与注意力汇及早期图文注意力减弱相关，单靠抑制注意力汇不能解决问题；通过时间步感知门控设计可有效恢复早期图文注意力并提升生成质量，验证了门控行为随去噪步自适应的重要性。

title: ActionLens: Diagnosing Spatial-Temporal Binding Failures in Vision-Language Models
summary: Video-capable vision-language models score above 80\% on popular benchmarks yet struggle with spatial-temporal binding: associating the right action with the right person at the right moment. We introduce ActionLens, a diagnostic benchmark of 6,701 multiple-choice video questions spanning five targeted diagnostics: transition detection, actor-specific identification, concurrent action binding, directed interaction reasoning, and gaze detection. Ground-truth answers are derived deterministically from 1.58 million per-second, per-person annotations. Fourteen rounds of human quality engineering raised answer clarity from 53% to above 90% human accuracy. Across 20 VLMs, the full-set leader scores 68.8%; on the human-reviewed subset, it scores 65.9% versus 91.0% for the pooled human reference. Gaze detection remains near chance against 89.6% human accuracy. On actor disambiguation, reference-interface controls show that relational descriptions recover 5.55--13.25 points over static coordinates, confirming a substantial numeric-parsing penalty; yet visual boxes still lead every model by 1.15--6.50 points, exposing a residual unboxed actor-resolution gap. A binding-trap analysis shows models systematically select the wrong actor's action. ActionLens provides diagnostic measurements of these distinct failure modes across model families and scales for direct comparison. We release all data, code, and evaluation scripts at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lmms-eval-2276

AI.tldr: 提出ActionLens诊断基准，含6,701道视频多选问题，暴露20个VLM在时空绑定上的系统性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有视频视觉语言模型在流行基准上得分超80%，却在时空绑定（把正确动作关联到正确人物与正确时刻）上表现不佳，缺乏针对此类失败模式的诊断工具。
AI.method: 构建ActionLens基准：6,701道多选题，覆盖五类诊断（转换检测、特定人物识别、并发动作绑定、有向交互推理、注视检测）；答案由1.58M每秒级、每人级标注确定性推导；经14轮人工质量工程将答案清晰度从53%提升至90%以上；在20个VLM上评测，并设置参照界面控件与绑定陷阱分析。
AI.result: 全量集最佳模型仅68.8%；人工审校子集上为65.9%，而人类参考为91.0%；注视检测接近随机（人类89.6%）；人物消歧中关系性描述比静态坐标高5.55–13.25分，但视觉框仍领先各模型1.15–6.50分；模型系统性地把动作绑定到错误人物。
AI.conclusion: ActionLens可跨模型族与规模诊断时空绑定的不同失败模式并支持直接比较；数据、代码与评测脚本已公开。

title: Attention-Scoped Guidance: Training-Free Spatial Control for Image Editing
summary: Instruction-guided image editing should change what the instruction names and leave the rest of the image untouched. In dual classifier-free guidance (CFG), an editor combines two directions at every denoising step, one that pushes toward the instructed edit and one that pulls back toward the source image, using global weights. We introduce Attention-Scoped Guidance (ASG), a sampler wrapper that makes these weights spatial. It reads a soft support map from the instruction attention that the editor already computes, then weakens text guidance where support is low and strengthens image anchoring where support is high. The wrapper requires no training, no external mask, and no additional network evaluation. On the full MagicBrush and PIE-Bench++ splits, ASG improves preservation-oriented metrics, leading three of four MagicBrush metrics and PIE-Bench++ background PSNR. A dose-matched control that removes the spatial placement loses up to 0.73 CLIP on PIE-Bench++, confirming that the spatial allocation itself carries the gain.

AI.tldr: 提出 Attention-Scoped Guidance (ASG)，一种无需训练的采样器包装方法，利用指令注意力生成的软支撑图将双 CFG 的全局权重空间化，在 MagicBrush 与 PIE-Bench++ 上提升保持性指标。
AI.motivation: 指令引导的图像编辑应只改变指令所指区域，其余部分保持不变。但双 CFG 在每个去噪步中使用全局权重组合"编辑方向"与"源图锚定方向"，无法区分空间位置，导致非编辑区域被过度修改。
AI.method: ASG 作为采样器包装器：从编辑器已计算的指令注意力中读取软支撑图（soft support map），据此在支撑度低处减弱文本引导、在支撑度高（原文为 support is high，指锚定相关弱支撑区）处增强图像锚定。无需训练、无需外部掩码、无额外网络前向计算。
AI.result: 在 MagicBrush 与 PIE-Bench++ 完整划分上，ASG 提升保持导向指标，在 MagicBrush 四项指标中领先三项，并提升 PIE-Bench++ 背景 PSNR。剂量匹配对照实验（移除空间分配）在 PIE-Bench++ 上最多损失 0.73 CLIP，证明增益来自空间分配本身。
AI.conclusion: 将 CFG 权重空间化是提升指令图像编辑保持性的有效且零成本手段，增益可归因于空间分配而非引导强度总量。

title: RoPE is Dead, Long Live RoPE: Towards Scalable Data-aware Positional Encodings
summary: Transformers process tokens without any inherent notion of order, making positional encoding a fundamental requirement rather than an architectural refinement. Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) has become the default positional encoding in modern language models, yet it is heavily biased toward nearby tokens. Existing alternatives have been evaluated under different settings, leaving the literature fragmented and without a clear replacement. We bring structure to this landscape by examining a specific weakness of RoPE: its slow frequency bands, whose wavelengths exceed the training context and expose models to unseen angles during extrapolation. We therefore introduce Data aware RoPE (DaRoPE), which preserves standard RoPE on the fast bands but replaces absolute position on the slow bands with bounded coordinates learned from contextual representations. Therefore, the slow-band geometry depends on the data rather than only on positional distance. We compare representative encodings under matched conditions across synthetic tasks, symbolic music, genomics, neural signals, and language models spanning 124M to 50B parameters. Across these experiments, DaRoPE leads on non-text benchmarks, mitigates recency bias, while remaining best or on par in language modeling and length extrapolation. Moreover, the learned coordinates also make the mechanism interpretable, revealing how attention layers leverage contextual information beyond token distance. Together, these results support DaRoPE as the best overall default among the evaluated methods, when there is no domain-specific reasons to prefer another.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Data-aware RoPE（DaRoPE）：在 RoPE 的快频段保持标准处理，在慢频段用由上下文表示学习得到的有界坐标替代绝对位置，使慢频段几何依赖数据而非仅依赖位置距离；在多领域多规模实验中整体优于或持平主流位置编码。
AI.motivation: Transformer 本身不具备顺序概念，位置编码是基本需求。RoPE 已成为现代语言模型默认方案，但存在明显的"邻近 token 偏置"；替代方案因评估设置不统一，文献零散、缺乏明确替代者。作者进一步指出 RoPE 的具体缺陷：慢频段波长超过训练上下文，外推时暴露于未见过的角度。
AI.method: 提出 DaRoPE：对 RoPE 的频率带做差异化处理——快频段保留标准 RoPE（绝对位置旋转），慢频段则将绝对位置替换为从上下文表示中学习得到的有界坐标，从而让慢频段的几何结构由数据决定，而非仅由位置距离决定。
AI.result: 在匹配条件下对比多种代表性位置编码，覆盖合成任务、符号音乐、基因组学、神经信号，以及 124M 至 50B 参数的语言模型。DaRoPE 在非文本基准上领先，缓解了 recency bias（近期偏置），在语言建模与长度外推上保持最优或相当；学习到的坐标还使机制具备可解释性，揭示注意力层如何利用超出 token 距离的上下文信息。
AI.conclusion: 在没有领域特化理由偏好其他方法时，DaRoPE 是所评估方法中整体最优的默认位置编码方案。

title: ACPruner: Visual Token Pruning as Biased Attention Coverage Maximization in LVLMs
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) face significant computational inefficiencies caused by the large number of visual tokens. Existing visual token pruning methods mainly focus on either retaining individually important tokens or selecting mutually diverse ones. In this work, we revisit visual token pruning from a coverage perspective and formulate it as a biased attention coverage maximization problem. The key idea is to select a compact token subset whose encoder-side outgoing attention can jointly cover the image while assigning higher coverage priority to more informative regions. From this perspective, we propose ACPruner, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient LVLM inference. ACPruner first estimates token importance by combining intra-modal saliency and inter-modal relevance, then derives token-wise coverage from attention patterns within the vision encoder, and finally performs greedy selection to maximize the proposed coverage objective. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLM backbones, including LLaVA-1.5-7B/13B, LLaVA-NeXT-7B/13B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and LLaVA-OneVision-7B, show that ACPruner consistently achieves strong performance retention while delivering substantial end-to-end inference speedups.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ACPruner，一种免训练视觉 token 剪枝框架，将视觉 token 剪枝重新建模为“有偏注意力覆盖最大化”问题，在多个 LVLM 骨干上实现性能保持与推理加速。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）因视觉 token 数量庞大而存在显著计算低效问题。现有视觉 token 剪枝方法主要关注保留个体重要 token 或选择相互多样的 token，缺乏从覆盖视角统一考虑重要性与多样性。
AI.method: 将视觉 token 剪枝表述为有偏注意力覆盖最大化问题：选择紧凑 token 子集，使其编码器侧出射注意力能共同覆盖图像，并对信息量更高的区域赋予更高覆盖优先级。具体提出 ACPruner：先结合模态内显著性与模态间相关性估计 token 重要性，再依据视觉编码器内部注意力模式推导 token 级覆盖，最后通过贪心选择最大化覆盖目标。
AI.result: 在 LLaVA-1.5-7B/13B、LLaVA-NeXT-7B/13B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B 等多个 LVLM 骨干上的大量实验表明，ACPruner 在保持较强性能的同时，带来显著的端到端推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 从覆盖视角重新审视视觉 token 剪枝是有效且通用的，ACPruner 作为免训练框架可在多种 LVLM 上稳定实现性能与效率的权衡。

title: Rethinking Latent Visual Reasoning: Grounding Latent Reasoning in Visual Evidence
summary: Latent visual reasoning (LVR) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perform intermediate computation in continuous latent tokens rather than expressing every reasoning step in words. However, unlike textual CoT, latent reasoning is not directly observable, making it difficult to supervise what latent tokens learn. In this work, we first conduct a thorough analysis of latent-token behavior and identify a latent evidence-credit gap: latent tokens respond only weakly to image perturbations that alter the correct answer. We hypothesize that this issue stems from the lack of explicit supervision during GRPO training. These findings suggest that a final-answer reward provides too little guidance on what visual evidence to preserve or how credit should be assigned across latent tokens. To bridge this gap, we propose ReaLVR, which brings visual-evidence supervision to the model's own free-running latent trajectories. ReaLVR contrasts correct and model-generated wrong answers to determine where stronger supervision is needed, and relevant and mismatched visual evidence to specify what to preserve. Across three model families, ReaLVR consistently outperforms evaluated LVR baselines, achieving the highest five-task average of 63.7% on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Crucially, we are the first to scale visual reasoning in latent space, showing that our framework continues to deliver robust improvements at frontier model scales up to 235B. Further analyses show more question-sensitive latent-token positions, stronger alignment with relevant visual regions, and greater fixed-context dependence on the most attended latent tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文分析潜在视觉推理（LVR）中隐状态 token 的行为，发现"潜在证据—信用缺口"：隐状态 token 对改变正确答案的图像扰动响应微弱，并提出 ReaLVR 通过视觉证据监督加以缓解，在多种模型规模上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 潜在视觉推理使多模态大模型在连续隐状态 token 中进行中间计算，但不同于文本 CoT，该过程不可直接观测，难以监督隐状态 token 学到了什么。作者通过分析发现隐状态 token 对改变正确答案的图像扰动响应很弱（潜在证据—信用缺口），推测原因是 GRPO 训练中缺乏显式监督，仅靠最终答案奖励对"应保留哪些视觉证据、如何在隐状态 token 间分配信用"提供的指导不足。
AI.method: 提出 ReaLVR，将视觉证据监督引入模型自身自由运行的隐状态轨迹中。具体做法是对比正确答案与模型生成的错误答案，以确定何处需要更强监督；并对比相关视觉证据与不匹配视觉证据，以明确应保留哪些信息。
AI.result: 在三个模型家族上，ReaLVR 一致优于所评估的 LVR 基线；在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上取得五项任务平均最高 63.7%。作者首次实现潜在空间视觉推理的规模扩展，证明该框架在前沿模型规模（最高 235B）下仍持续带来稳健提升。进一步分析显示：隐状态 token 位置对问题更敏感、与相关视觉区域对齐更强、对最受关注隐状态 token 的固定上下文依赖更强。
AI.conclusion: ReaLVR 通过将视觉证据监督引入模型自身的潜在推理轨迹，弥补了仅依赖最终答案奖励造成的证据—信用缺口，在多模型家族和最高 235B 规模上均稳定提升 LVR 性能，并首次实现了潜在空间视觉推理的规模化。

title: GLF-Q: Global-Local Feature-based Quantization for Vision Transformers
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) efficiently compresses Vision Transformers (ViTs) without retraining, yet suffers severe accuracy degradation at low bit-widths. Existing optimization-based PTQ methods guide block reconstruction via either soft logits or second-order Hessian proxies. Logit supervision is prone to overfitting on limited calibration data, while Hessian approximations incur structural truncation errors. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{GLF-Q}, a novel PTQ framework guided by Global-Local Feature alignment. GLF-Q propagates quantized block outputs through downstream full-precision layers to align penultimate-layer representations under local output regularization, providing downstream feature supervision without explicitly approximating the Hessian or using a Taylor expansion. Furthermore, offline Hadamard transformations are introduced with zero runtime overhead to disperse activation outliers across channels, effectively contracting dynamic ranges and reducing quantization errors. Meanwhile, optimizing this loss via a Straight-Through Estimator (STE) achieves rapid convergence, bypassing continuous relaxation rounding formulations such as AdaRound. Extensive experiments across representative ViT architectures demonstrate that GLF-Q with standard uniform quantizers substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods under 3-bit quantization on image classification. In addition, GLF-Q exhibits strong out-of-domain calibration robustness and achieves speedups under 8-bit GPU deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出GLF-Q，一种基于全局-局部特征对齐的ViT训练后量化框架，通过下游全精度层监督与离线Hadamard变换，在3-bit下显著优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于优化的PTQ方法通过软logits或二阶Hessian代理引导block重建：logit监督在有限校准数据上易过拟合，Hessian近似存在结构性截断误差，导致ViT在低比特下精度严重下降。
AI.method: GLF-Q将量化块的输出传播通过下游全精度层，在局部输出正则下对齐倒数第二层表示，实现下游特征监督，无需显式近似Hessian或使用Taylor展开；引入零运行时开销的离线Hadamard变换分散激活离群值，压缩动态范围；通过STE优化该损失实现快速收敛，绕过AdaRound等连续松弛舍入方法。
AI.result: 在多种代表性ViT架构上，使用标准均匀量化器的GLF-Q在3-bit图像分类下大幅超越现有SOTA方法；同时展现出较强的域外校准鲁棒性，并在8-bit GPU部署下实现加速。
AI.conclusion: GLF-Q通过全局-局部特征对齐、离线Hadamard变换与STE优化，有效缓解低比特ViT量化的精度退化，兼具鲁棒性与部署效率。

title: Recent Advances in Agentic Agri-Robotic Phenotyping: A Perspective Review from Fragmented Multimodal Sensing to Unified PhenoAgent Intelligence
summary: This review examines the evolution of plant phenotyping from conventional manual trait measurement to high-throughput, robotic, and artificial intelligence-driven crop monitoring. Despite significant advances in imaging, autonomous platforms, multimodal sensing, and deep learning, current phenotyping systems remain fragmented across sensing modalities, crop traits, growth stages, environments, and management objectives. We therefore frame phenotyping as an integrated \emph{seed-soil-plant-environment-management} (SSPEM) intelligence problem, where crop performance reflects interactions among seed quality, root-zone conditions, plant development, environmental exposure, and management actions. The review synthesizes conventional, high-throughput, robotic, and AI-driven phenotyping approaches, highlighting their capabilities and persistent limitations in temporal integration, multimodal reasoning, biological interpretation, and actionable decision support. Building on this analysis, we introduce a conceptual PhenoAgent framework that extends phenotyping beyond the estimation of isolated traits to evidence-based crop-state interpretation, uncertainty-aware reasoning, and management-oriented support. The PhenoAgent concept primarily brings together scattered advances in phenotyping to deliver insights ranging from detailed to high-level, such as what is happening in the crop, why it might be occurring, what evidence is missing, and what actions or additional measurements should be considered. We also discuss challenges in dataset scarcity, annotation, benchmarking, model generalization, and explainability. By linking multimodal phenotyping with agentic AI and closed-loop decision support, this review outlines a path to interpretable, scalable, and deployment-oriented crop intelligence.

AI.tldr: 该综述将植物表型组学重新界定为"种子-土壤-植物-环境-管理"（SSPEM）一体化智能问题，梳理从人工测量到高通量表型、机器人及AI驱动监测的演进路径，并提出概念性PhenoAgent框架，以智能体式AI实现可解释、可扩展的作物状态推理与闭环决策支持。
AI.motivation: 现有表型系统在传感模态、作物性状、生育阶段、环境条件与管理目标之间高度碎片化，虽在成像、自主平台、多模态传感和深度学习方面取得进展，但在时间整合、多模态推理、生物学解释与可执行决策支持方面仍存在持续局限。作者因此需要一个整合性框架，将分散的表型进展汇聚为面向管理的作物智能。
AI.method: 采用综述与概念构建相结合的方法：系统综合传统表型、高通量表型、机器人表型与AI驱动表型四类方法，分析其能力与局限；在此基础上，将表型问题形式化为SSPEM交互问题，并提出PhenoAgent概念框架，把多模态表型与智能体式AI、闭环决策支持相衔接，进而讨论数据集稀缺、标注、基准测试、模型泛化与可解释性等挑战。
AI.result: 综述识别出四类表型方法在时间整合、多模态推理、生物学解释和决策支持方面的共性瓶颈；提出PhenoAgent可将表型输出从孤立性状估计提升为基于证据的作物状态解释、不确定性感知推理与管理导向支持，输出从微观到宏观的多层次洞见，包括作物当前状态、成因、缺失证据以及应采取的额外测量或管理措施。
AI.conclusion: 将多模态表型与智能体式AI及闭环决策支持相结合，可为实现可解释、可扩展、面向部署的作物智能提供路径；同时，数据集稀缺、标注成本、基准缺乏、模型泛化与可解释性仍是需要重点攻克的关键挑战。

title: Nudgeability: Reasoning Models Follow Confidence Signals Without Tracking Their Own Competence
summary: Reasoning language models that can call tools must decide during inference whether to answer unaided or delegate. Any self-reflection mechanism for this must answer three questions: where the reflective signal comes from (verbal reports, output distributions, hidden states, a separate predictor), how it is presented to the model (numerical prediction, confidence token, prompt injection), and whether it changes the model's subsequent action. We isolate the third question. At a fixed point in otherwise identical reasoning trajectories, we insert a single first-person sentence expressing either confidence or doubt; the model then continues reasoning and chooses whether to answer directly or call a tool. Comparing these counterfactual continuations measures the causal effect of the reflective signal on delegation. We call this behavioral response Nudgeability and measure it along two dimensions: sensitivity, how strongly confidence and doubt change delegation rates, and targeting, whether delegation increases for problems the model cannot solve unaided and decreases for those it can. Across nine small-to-medium open-weight reasoning models from three families (Qwen, Gemma, and GLM) and two tasks, models are consistently sensitive: doubt increases delegation and confidence decreases it, with a median confidence-to-doubt swing of 20.6 percentage points, and 53 to 70 points for the larger provider-served models. This responsiveness is poorly targeted: a median 42% of induced flips are well-targeted, only a +2 percentage-point lift over a random-selection baseline. Confidence language is thus a strong control surface for delegation, but current models use it only weakly in accordance with their actual competence. Nudgeability offers a simple, post-training-free way to evaluate both sensitivity and targeting as endogenous self-reflection mechanisms mature.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"Nudgeability"指标，通过在推理轨迹固定节点插入一句表达信心或怀疑的第一人称句子，以反事实续写的方式衡量反思信号对模型委派（直接作答还是调用工具）的因果影响，并从敏感性和针对性两个维度评估九个小到中等规模开源推理模型。
AI.motivation: 可调用工具的推理语言模型必须在推理中决定是直接作答还是委派给工具。任何自我反思机制都需回答三问：反思信号来源（言语报告、输出分布、隐藏状态、独立预测器）、呈现方式（数值预测、置信度token、提示注入）、以及是否改变后续动作。作者聚焦第三问，即反思信号是否对模型后续行为产生因果影响。
AI.method: 在其余条件完全相同的推理轨迹的固定节点，插入一句表达信心或怀疑的第一人称句子，令模型继续推理并选择直接作答或调用工具，通过比较这些反事实续写来度量反思信号对委派的因果效应。定义Nudgeability两个维度：敏感性（信心与怀疑对委派率影响的强度）与针对性（委派是否在模型无法独立解决的问题上增加、在能解决的问题上减少）。在来自三个家族（Qwen、Gemma、GLM）的九个小到中等规模开源权重推理模型和两个任务上评估。
AI.result: 模型普遍具有敏感性：怀疑提高委派率、信心降低委派率，中位信心—怀疑摆动幅度为20.6个百分点，较大的厂商服务模型达53至70个百分点。但该响应针对性较差：中位仅42%的诱发翻转是良好针对性的，仅比随机选择基线高2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 信心语言是委派行为的强控制面，但当前模型仅以较弱的方式依照其真实能力使用它。Nudgeability为在端到端自我反思机制成熟过程中，提供了一种简单、免训练的方式来评估敏感性与针对性。

title: GenNVS: Geometry-enhanced Novel View Synthesis via Disentangled 3D Prior
summary: Single-image novel view synthesis remains challenging because the underlying 3D geometry is highly ambiguous. Recent diffusion-based approaches produce plausible results, but they often struggle to preserve the geometric structure and spatial coherence of foreground objects. We present GenNVS, a framework for geometry-enhanced novel view synthesis via a disentangled 3D prior. Specifically, GenNVS models foreground objects and the background with 3D Gaussian Splatting and aligns them through a coarse-to-fine geometric optimization process to form a unified 3D scene. This scene conditions a video diffusion model through the proposed Dual-Stream Masking mechanism, which guides synthesis by jointly exploiting rendered validity masks and geometry-aware warping. Experimental results show that GenNVS performs favorably against recent methods in both visual quality and geometric accuracy, while naturally supporting flexible scene editing.

AI.tldr: GenNVS：通过解耦3D先验增强几何的单图新视角合成框架，将前景与背景用3D高斯泼溅建模并粗到细对齐，经双流掩码机制条件化视频扩散模型，视觉质量与几何精度优于近期方法并支持场景编辑。
AI.motivation: 单图新视角合成的核心困难在于底层3D几何高度歧义；现有扩散方法虽能生成看似合理的结果，但难以保持前景对象的几何结构与空间一致性。
AI.method: 提出GenNVS框架：(1) 使用解耦3D先验，分别以3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）建模前景对象与背景；(2) 通过粗到细的几何优化将二者对齐为统一3D场景；(3) 以该场景条件化视频扩散模型，并设计双流掩码机制（Dual-Stream Masking），联合利用渲染有效性掩码与几何感知变形（warping）引导合成。
AI.result: 实验表明，GenNVS在视觉质量与几何精度两方面均优于近期方法，同时天然支持灵活的场景编辑。
AI.conclusion: 以解耦3D先验＋几何对齐＋双流掩码条件化的扩散生成范式，可有效缓解单图新视角合成中的几何歧义问题，兼顾生成质量与几何一致性，并具备可编辑性。

title: Counterfactual Attention Policy Distillation for Temporal Video Grounding
summary: Temporal video grounding is a key capability of advanced Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for the thorough understanding of video events, which is however often limited by repeated actions and visually similar contexts in long videos. In this paper, we study this issue from the perspective of On-policy distillation (OPD) and propose a new training regime for MLLMs termed Counterfactual Attention Policy Distillation (CAPD). In particular, OPD is a viable solution for MLLMs via providing dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. But its next-token based teacher-student distillation is hard to identify the specific video segments supporting each predicted timestamp, which is critical for temporal grounding. In this case, CAPD measures how masking each temporal group changes the teacher's output distribution. The resulting counterfactual influence calibrates the teacher's attention and weights token-level distillation, allowing the student to learn the temporal evidence that affects boundary prediction. To validate CAPD, we trained it on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct using only 2,500 samples for one epoch, and evaluated it on the TimeLens and multiple general video benchmarks. Experimental results show that CAPD improves average recall by 12.0% relative to GRPO on TimeLens while preserving general video understanding, achieving comparable accuracy to the base model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反事实注意力策略蒸馏（CAPD），从在线策略蒸馏视角解决MLLM时序视频定位中重复动作与相似上下文导致的困难，通过掩码时序组衡量其对教师输出分布的影响，校准教师注意力并加权token级蒸馏，仅用2500样本训练一epoch即显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频中重复动作和视觉相似上下文严重制约MLLM的时序视频定位能力。现有时序定位中，基于下一token的师生蒸馏难以识别支撑每个预测时间戳的具体视频片段，而这恰恰是时序定位的关键。
AI.method: 从在线策略蒸馏（OPD）出发提出CAPD训练机制。CAPD通过掩码每个时序组（temporal group），度量其对教师输出分布的反事实影响；该反事实影响用于校准教师注意力并对token级蒸馏加权，使学生学习影响边界预测的时序证据。模型基于Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，仅用2500样本训练一个epoch。
AI.result: 在TimeLens及多个通用视频基准上评估。相比GRPO，CAPD在TimeLens上平均召回率相对提升12.0%；同时保持通用视频理解能力，与基座模型精度相当。
AI.conclusion: CAPD有效缓解了长视频时序定位中重复动作与相似上下文的干扰，在小样本高效训练下显著提升时序定位召回率，且不损害通用视频理解能力，验证了反事实注意力校准在OPD中的有效性。

title: In-game Toxic Detection: Bi-directional Representations with Attention Residuals
summary: In-game toxic language has emerged as a critical concern in the gaming industry and community. While several frameworks and models for online game toxicity analysis have been proposed, detecting toxicity in player chat utterances remains a formidable challenge: stemming not only from the extremely short length of such utterances but also from the heavy reliance on game slang, abbreviations, and domain-specific jargon, which generic language models are poorly suited to recognize. This paper presents a shared task for in-game toxic language detection built upon real-world in-game chat data, and proposes the best-preforming model for the toxic language slot filling: Bi-directional Representations with Attention Residuals (BRAR). Experimental results demonstrate that BRAR effectively captures the global context and outperforms the existing baselines on slot filling.

AI.tldr: 本文基于真实游戏内聊天数据构建了游戏内毒性语言检测共享任务，并提出性能最优的毒性语言槽填充模型BRAR（双向表征结合注意力残差），实验表明其能有效捕获全局上下文并超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 游戏内毒性语言已成为游戏行业与社区的关键问题，但玩家聊天话语的毒性检测极具挑战：一方面话语长度极短，另一方面大量依赖游戏俚语、缩写和领域特定术语，通用语言模型难以识别，因此需要专门的任务与模型。
AI.method: 基于真实游戏内聊天数据构建游戏内毒性语言检测共享任务，并针对毒性语言槽填充提出BRAR模型，即结合注意力残差的双向表征。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，BRAR能够有效捕获全局上下文，并在槽填充任务上优于现有基线模型。
AI.conclusion: BRAR是适用于游戏内毒性语言槽填充的最佳性能模型，验证了在短文本、强领域术语的聊天场景中结合双向表征与注意力残差的有效性。

title: Reinforcement Learning from Intermediate Renders for Image-to-Code Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning is increasingly used to post-train vision-language models for image-to-code generation, such as generating SVG code from a reference image, by optimizing rewards computed from the final rendered output. However, relying on a single terminal reward provides sparse feedback that is poorly aligned with the contribution of individual tokens. A generated program may contain operations that accurately reproduce some parts of the target image alongside others that introduce errors, yet all tokens are trained from the same final outcome. We observe that many intermediate code prefixes are not only executable, but already produce meaningful partial renders that reflect progress toward the target. This property provides a natural source of denser supervision during generation. Based on this observation, we introduce IR4RL, an RL framework with a token-level render-progress reward that turns changes between intermediate renders into localized feedback for the generated sequence. We evaluate our approach on Image-to-SVG and Image-to-TikZ generation. Across both tasks, our method improves over supervised fine-tuning and standard GRPO, yielding new state-of-the-art open-source models. This shows that intermediate rendering provides a simple and effective source of process supervision for RL post-training of image-to-code models.

AI.tldr: 提出IR4RL框架，利用中间渲染增量作为token级过程奖励，缓解image-to-code生成中的奖励稀疏问题，在Image-to-SVG/TikZ上超越SFT与GRPO。
AI.motivation: 强化学习用于image-to-code（如从参考图生成SVG）时通常依赖最终渲染结果的单一终端奖励，反馈稀疏，无法对齐各token的实际贡献：同一个程序中有些片段准确复现了目标图像的部分内容，有些片段却引入错误，但所有token都被同一最终结果训练。
AI.method: 观察到许多中间代码前缀不仅可执行，且已能生成有意义的局部渲染、体现向目标推进的进度，因此提出IR4RL：一种带token级渲染进度奖励的RL框架，将相邻中间渲染之间的变化转化为对生成序列的局部化反馈，为生成过程提供更密集的监督。
AI.result: 在Image-to-SVG与Image-to-TikZ两项任务上，方法均优于监督微调（SFT）与标准GRPO，取得了新的开源最优模型结果。
AI.conclusion: 中间渲染是一种简单而有效的过程监督来源，可用于image-to-code模型的RL后训练。

title: The Model Knows When to Stop: Training-Free Early Stopping for Long-Context Reading
summary: Language models often process long inputs sequentially in chunks, but continuing to read after sufficient evidence has been acquired wastes computation. Existing stopping mechanisms either learn sufficiency from internal activations or train an exit gate, while a simpler alternative asks the model whether it has read enough. We introduce Answer-Convergence Stopping (ACS), a training-free stopping rule that measures rather than asks. After each chunk, it probes the frozen model's current answer state and stops when that state is both confident and stable. The rule requires only output-side generation and token log probabilities, has no trained components, and uses one shared configuration across models and benchmarks. Because a stopping policy can save computation simply by stopping too early, we evaluate the stopping decision itself using evidence position where available. On the full LongBench-v2 with two frontier models, ACS is the only stopping policy that matches or exceeds full-reading accuracy. Furthermore, across 250 S-NIAH questions, the premature stopping rate for ACS across five models from two families ranges from 0% to 12%, compared to 8.4% to 45.6% for the verbalized gate. Taken together, ACS reveals that by properly utilizing the output signals of frozen models, we can achieve favorable behaviors like adaptive stopping without the need for additional training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Answer-Convergence Stopping (ACS)，一种免训练的长输入停止规则，通过测量冻结模型答案状态的置信度与稳定性来决定是否停止阅读。
AI.motivation: 语言模型处理长输入时按块顺序读取，获得足够证据后继续读取会浪费计算；现有停止机制要么从内部激活学习充分性，要么训练退出门，而更简单的方案是直接询问模型是否已读够。作者希望探索无需额外训练即可实现自适应停止的可能性。
AI.method: ACS 在每个块后探测冻结模型当前的答案状态，当该状态既置信又稳定时停止；该规则仅依赖输出端生成与 token 对数概率，无训练组件，并在不同模型与基准间使用统一配置。为评估停止决策本身，作者利用证据位置来判定是否过早停止。
AI.result: 在完整 LongBench-v2 上使用两个前沿模型，ACS 是唯一匹配或超过全读取准确率的停止策略；在 250 个 S-NIAH 问题、来自两个家族的五个模型上，ACS 的过早停止率为 0%–12%，而 verbalized gate 为 8.4%–45.6%。
AI.conclusion: 通过恰当利用冻结模型的输出信号，可在无需额外训练的情况下实现自适应停止等有利行为。

title: Temporal Modelling for Burn Scars on Sentinel-3
summary: Rapid and accurate burn scar delineation from satellite imagery is essential for post-fire damage assessment. Sentinel-3 OLCI, with daily revisit and 21 spectral bands, suits rapid mapping, yet most pipelines treat acquisitions independently, leaving the pre/post-fire change signal unexploited. We present a dataset of 246 wildfire activations (2016-2025) from the Copernicus Emergency Management Service, with Sentinel-3 OLCI temporally paired acquisitions. We benchmark spatial and temporal (ConvLSTM-augmented) variants of three backbones (U-Net, SegFormer, ConvNeXt-UPerNet) under two input modes and spectral configurations. Temporal modeling improves segmentation only when pre-fire frames are included, and a 5-band subset matches the full 21-band OLCI configuration.

AI.tldr: 该文构建了2016-2025年246个野火事件的Sentinel-3 OLCI时序配对数据集，并对比U-Net、SegFormer、ConvNeXt-UPerNet的空间与时序（ConvLSTM增强）变体，发现时序建模仅在包含火前帧时有效，且5波段子集性能可媲美全21波段。
AI.motivation: 火烧迹地快速准确制图对灾后评估至关重要。Sentinel-3 OLCI具备日重访与21个光谱波段，适合快速制图，但现有流程多将各期影像独立处理，未利用火前/火后的变化信号。
AI.method: 基于Copernicus应急管理服务构建246个野火事件（2016-2025）的Sentinel-3 OLCI时序配对数据集；在两种输入模式和多种光谱配置下，对U-Net、SegFormer、ConvNeXt-UPerNet三种骨干网络的空间变体与ConvLSTM增强的时序变体进行基准测试。
AI.result: 时序建模仅在输入包含火前帧时能提升分割性能；5波段子集即可达到与全21波段OLCI配置相当的效果。
AI.conclusion: 利用火前/火后时序变化信号可提升火烧迹地分割，且通过波段精简可降低数据与计算开销而不损失精度，为Sentinel-3 OLCI快速制图流程提供了有效范式。

title: Summarize Before Grounding: Query-Guided Chunk Condensation for Long-Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Video temporal grounding (VTG) aims to localize the video interval corresponding to a language query. Recent large vision-language models (LVLMs) show great potential in solving such a multi-modal reasoning task. However, long videos often contain large amounts of redundant information that disturbs LVLMs to mine query-relevant evidence. Instead of dense frame sampling which incurs prohibitive training memory, previous reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) works typically utilize sparse sampling, which makes training feasible but may miss critical evidence. In this paper, we propose a ``summarize before grounding'' framework (named ``SumGround'') for long-video temporal grounding. The key of SumGround is to perform query-guided chunk condensation to aggregate and retrieve query-relevant evidence. Specifically, we split the video into several chunks and perform two-level chunk condensation. First, we introduce query-guided latent summaries, which is represented as KV states of query-guided prompts, to compress redundant visual tokens into compact query-relevant chunk summaries. Furthermore, we design an associative summary retrieval scheme to rank and select chunk summaries that are most likely to contain the event interval. Both query-guided latent summary and associative summary retrieval schemes are enabled by RLVR. To reduce memory consumption, we propose a length-aware gradient gating module to selectively stop gradient back-propagated to visual tokens. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SumGround performs favorably against previous state-of-the-art methods across multiple downstream datasets, with remarkable gains on long videos.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"先摘要后定位"框架 SumGround，通过查询引导的块压缩与关联摘要检索，在 RLVR 下实现长视频时序定位，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: VTG 需定位与语言查询对应的视频区间。LVLM 在此多模态推理任务上潜力大，但长视频含大量冗余信息，干扰查询相关证据的挖掘。稠密采样内存开销过大，已有 RLVR 工作采用稀疏采样虽可训练却可能漏掉关键证据。因此需要在控制内存的同时有效聚合查询相关证据。
AI.method: 提出 SumGround 框架，核心是查询引导的块压缩。将视频切分为若干块，进行两级块压缩：(1) 查询引导的隐式摘要，用查询引导提示的 KV 状态表示，将冗余视觉 token 压缩为紧凑的查询相关块摘要；(2) 关联摘要检索方案，对块摘要排序并选出最可能含事件区间的块。两者均由 RLVR 驱动。另提出长度感知梯度门控模块，选择性阻断回传至视觉 token 的梯度以降低内存。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SumGround 在多个下游数据集上优于此前 SOTA 方法，在长视频上取得显著增益。
AI.conclusion: "先摘要后定位"的两级压缩与检索机制，配合 RLVR 和梯度门控，可在有限内存下有效缓解长视频冗余对 LVLM 的干扰，提升长视频时序定位性能。

title: After the Fix: Transfer of Corrected Agent Experience
summary: Does repairing an episode make its experience a better memory for the next task? We transfer the same failed source before and after accepted repair to a fixed target, alongside independent execution. Our 3,300 runs cover 100 ThinkingBox pairs and the same 100 APEX pairs with and without source-state inheritance, under eleven conditions.
