ThinkingBox's Full/Skill/Hybrid correction gains are 44/29/32 percentage points, with corrected performance 25/22/18 points above independence; inference weakens at the task-family level. Yet 12 of Full's 15-point larger correction gap over Skill come from worse uncorrected performance, not better corrected memory. Moreover, 22 of Full's 46 upward transitions restore observed baseline success. Neither APEX regime establishes comparable aggregate correction benefits. Action evidence connects workflow gains with reusable obligations and convention conflicts with source-local choices. Text APEX's accepted execution reaches 52% versus its summary's 40%, without robust global/group-level superiority or an estab- lished advantage over independence. Smaller handoffs reduce input but increase calls. The value of repairing experience is therefore distinct from the value of reusing it: memory updates require both a previous-version reference and a fresh-start reference.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对100个ThinkingBox任务对与100个APEX任务对进行3300次实验，检验"修复后的经验是否是更好的记忆"这一问题。结论是修复经验的价值（memory update）与复用经验的价值（reuse）并不等同，记忆更新需要同时具备"前版本参照"和"全新起点参照"。
AI.motivation: 作者试图回答一个核心问题：修复一个失败任务片段（episode）后，其经验是否在后续任务中成为更好的记忆？已有工作往往默认"修复即改进"，但缺乏对"修复带来的纠正收益"与"经验本身可复用性"的区分，也缺少同时设置前版本参照与全新起点参照的对照设计。
AI.method: 采用迁移实验设计：将同一失败源片段在"被接受修复前"与"被接受修复后"两种状态下分别迁移到固定目标任务，并设置独立执行（不发生源状态继承）作为对照基线。共3300次运行，覆盖100个ThinkingBox任务对和100个APEX任务对，在11种条件下比较有/无源状态继承的表现。对纠正机制区分Full/Skill/Hybrid三种类型，并从动作层面分析工作流收益与可复用义务、约定冲突与源局部选择之间的关系。
AI.result: ThinkingBox的Full/Skill/Hybrid纠正收益分别为44/29/32个百分点，纠正后性能分别高于独立执行25/22/18个百分点，但推理优势在任务族层面减弱。Full相对Skill多出的15个百分点纠正差距中，有12个百分点来自未纠正性能更差，而非纠正后记忆更好；Full的46次向上转移中有22次只是恢复到观察到的基线成功水平。APEX两种机制均未建立可比的总体纠正收益。文本型APEX被接受的执行达52%，而摘要仅40%，但缺乏稳健的全局/组级优势，也未确立相对独立执行的增益。更小的交接减少输入但增加调用次数。
AI.conclusion: 修复经验的收益不能被简单等同于"记忆变好"：观察到的纠正优势部分由更差的未纠正基线造成，部分只是回到基线成功。修复经验的价值与复用经验的价值是两回事，记忆更新必须同时具备前版本参照与全新起点参照，才能可靠区分"真正的改进"与"基线回退"。

title: WorldAttention: An Efficient Attention Architecture for Interactive Video World Models
summary: Leveraging the paradigm of autoregressive diffusion, text-conditioned interactive video world models aim to simulate temporally coherent environments guided by textual instructions. While enabling low-latency, long-duration generation is pivotal for embodied AI and simulation-based planning, current frameworks primarily rely on sliding-window mechanisms to bound computational complexity. However, this approach inherently sacrifices historical context, undermining the long-range interactive capabilities. Conversely, maintaining a full-history cache remains computationally prohibitive and memory-intensive: the quadratic complexity of attention leads to excessive computational overhead, while the linear growth of the KV cache inevitably leads to GPU memory saturation. To overcome these limitations, we propose WorldAttention, a system-oriented attention architecture that achieves high efficiency through the co-design of specialized attention kernels and hierarchical KV cache management. First, we introduce Hybrid Sparse Attention (HSA), which integrates linear global attention supplemented with head-adaptive sparse attention. Additionally, we design a Hierarchical KV Cache (HKV) that organizes historical KV pairs into semantically indexed pages across multi-tier memory, enabling fine-grained retrieval and controlled GPU residency. These two designs are supported by tailored kernels to effectively translate their theoretical efficiency into real-world performance. Extensive experiments on VBench-Long and InterVBench demonstrate that WorldAttention consistently surpasses prior state-of-the-art methods, achieving subject consistency scores of 0.9472 on VBench-Long and 0.9668 on InterVBench, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出WorldAttention，一种系统级注意力架构，通过混合稀疏注意力（HSA）与分层KV缓存（HKV）协同设计，突破交互式视频世界模型长时生成中滑窗机制的历史信息丢失与全历史缓存的算力/显存瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 文本条件交互式视频世界模型对具身智能与仿真规划至关重要，需支持低延迟、长时长生成。现有框架以滑窗限制计算复杂度，却牺牲历史上下文，损害长程交互能力；而保留完整历史缓存又因注意力二次复杂度导致算力开销过大、KV缓存线性增长造成显存饱和，难以兼顾效率与长程一致性。
AI.method: 提出WorldAttention系统级注意力架构，核心为两项协同设计：1）混合稀疏注意力（HSA），以线性全局注意力为基础，辅以头自适应稀疏注意力；2）分层KV缓存（HKV），将历史KV对组织为语义索引页面并分布于多级内存，实现细粒度检索与可控的GPU驻留。两项设计均配套定制化内核，将理论效率转化为实际性能。
AI.result: 在VBench-Long与InterVBench上，WorldAttention持续超越此前最优方法，主体一致性得分分别达到0.9472（VBench-Long）与0.9668（InterVBench）。
AI.conclusion: 通过注意力内核与分层KV缓存管理的协同设计，WorldAttention在保持长程交互能力的同时显著提升计算与显存效率，为长时长交互式视频世界模型提供了高效可行的注意力方案。

title: Does Native 3D Texture Generation Necessarily Require 3D Assets for Training?
summary: Native 3D texture generation synthesizes colors directly in 3D space for a given geometry, conditioned on multi-view reference images. It is generally believed that training such models requires large-scale, high-quality real 3D asset data, whose acquisition remains a long-standing and challenging problem. In this work, we propose Tex-Zero, demonstrating that a high-fidelity native 3D texture generation framework can be trained without 3D assets. Our key observation is that only high-quality and fine-grained color information is essential for 3D texture training, while the required geometric information is less critical and can be manually constructed rather than obtained from real 3D assets. This finding makes it possible to transform abundant, high-quality 2D images into effective training samples for 3D texture generation. Specifically, we convert high-quality 2D images into 3D training samples by representing each image as a plane in 3D space and applying patch-wise random rotations and aggregation to construct complex geometric structures. Using these constructed image data, we train the Tex-Zero VAE, which can reconstruct real 3D assets with high quality despite never observing them during training. Building upon the Tex-Zero VAE, we train the Tex-Zero DiT also exclusively on the constructed image data, where the conditioning 2D multi-view images are transformed into planes in 3D space and also encoded by the Tex-Zero VAE, thereby reducing the representation gap and improving generation quality. Extensive experiments show that Tex-Zero generates high-fidelity 3D textures with fine-grained details solely using images as training data, offering a promising perspective on the data paradigm for scaling 3D texture generation.

AI.tldr: 提出Tex-Zero，一种无需真实3D资产即可训练的高保真原生3D纹理生成框架，仅利用高质量2D图像构建训练样本，训练出可重建真实3D资产的VAE与DiT。
AI.motivation: 原生3D纹理生成通常被认为依赖大规模高质量真实3D资产，而这类数据获取困难且长期未解决。作者观察到3D纹理训练中关键的是高质量细粒度颜色信息，几何信息相对次要且可人为构造，因此希望用丰富的2D图像替代真实3D资产进行训练。
AI.method: 将每张高质量2D图像表示为3D空间中的一个平面，并通过patch级随机旋转与聚合构造复杂几何结构，从而把2D图像转化为3D训练样本。基于这些构造数据训练Tex-Zero VAE；再在其上训练Tex-Zero DiT，其中条件多视角2D图像同样被转为3D平面并由Tex-Zero VAE编码，以缩小表示差距。
AI.result: Tex-Zero VAE在训练中从未见过真实3D资产，却能高质量重建真实3D资产；Tex-Zero DiT亦仅在构造图像数据上训练。大量实验表明，Tex-Zero仅以图像为训练数据即可生成高保真、细粒度细节丰富的3D纹理。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明高质量原生3D纹理生成可在无3D资产条件下训练，为3D纹理生成的数据范式扩展提供了有前景的思路。

title: BMND: Direct Poisson Denoising by N-Dimensional Block Matching and Collaborative Filtering
summary: Poisson denoising of scientific data requires methods that account for signal-dependent noise while accommodating different data dimensionalities and preserving quantitative intensity information. We present BMND, a dimension-independent extension of block matching and collaborative filtering for Gaussian and Poisson observations. Building on the two-stage structure of BM3D and BM4D, BMND processes Poisson data directly, without a variance-stabilizing transform, by combining noise-aware patch matching with propagation of signal-dependent noise variances through collaborative filtering and aggregation. A dimension-independent reference-patch traversal scheme supports arrays with an arbitrary number of axes. An optional aggregation-aware mass conservation preserves the observed total intensity after weighted overlap-add. We evaluate the framework on one-dimensional physiological signals, two-dimensional images, and three-dimensional volumes, using controlled noise experiments and measured fluorescence microscopy acquisitions. The experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction quality from noise-aware matching and Wiener filtering, while low-count phantom experiments show reduced denoising-induced intensity loss through mass conservation. The framework provides a unified, non-learning-based approach to denoising across arbitrary data dimensions and is released as an open-source library.

AI.tldr: 提出BMND，一种维度无关的块匹配协同滤波框架，直接处理高斯与泊松噪声，保持定量强度信息。
AI.motivation: 科学数据去噪需应对信号相关噪声、适配不同数据维度，并保留定量强度信息，现有方法如BM3D/BM4D维度固定且需方差稳定变换。
AI.method: 在BM3D/BM4D两阶段结构上扩展：直接处理泊松数据（无需方差稳定变换），采用噪声感知块匹配、将信号相关噪声方差传播至协同滤波与聚合中；维度无关参考块遍历支持任意轴数组；可选的质量守恒聚合在加权重叠相加后保持总强度。
AI.result: 在一维生理信号、二维图像与三维体数据上评估，含受控噪声实验与实测荧光显微数据；噪声感知匹配与维纳滤波提升重建质量，低计数体模实验显示质量守恒降低去噪导致的强度损失。
AI.conclusion: BMND提供统一、非学习的任意维度去噪框架，并以开源库形式发布。

title: Long Time No See: Benchmarking VLMs for Out-of-Sight Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Egocentric Videos
summary: Real-world AI systems must reason about objects that are no longer visible: an AR assistant guiding a user back to an object used earlier, a household robot retrieving an item someone put away. This requires not just recalling where an object was last seen, but updating its state when it is moved and retaining that update once it leaves view. We refer to this as out-of-sight spatiotemporal reasoning. We introduce Beyond3D, the first VQA benchmark to isolate this ability in dynamic egocentric video: every query targets an object that has been relocated and has since left the field of view. We create our questions from HD-EPIC annotations, building a visibility track for each dynamic object from its 3D position, the camera pose, and the scene geometry to understand at each moment whether it is visible, occluded, or out of view. Beyond3D comprises 9,000 questions in eight types over 135 videos from nine participants, organized as one reasoning chain: visual grounding (is the target observable now), temporal grounding (when it was last visible and last placed), scene localization (which fixture anchors that location), and 3D spatial perception (where it lies relative to the current viewpoint or another object in the scene). We benchmark nine general-purpose and spatially specialized VLMs. The best model reaches 42.2% against 29.7% chance and text-only baselines reaching 31.9%, with the largest failures in recovering when an object was last visible, showing that tracking object movement out of sight remains far from solved for current VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Beyond3D，首个用于隔离"视野外时空推理"能力的动态第一人称视频 VQA 基准；基于 HD‑EPIC 标注与可见性轨迹构建 9000 个问题（8 类），评测 9 个通用/空间专用 VLM。最优模型仅 42.2%（随机 29.7%，纯文本 31.9%），在"最后可见时刻"恢复上失败最严重。
AI.motivation: 现实 AI 系统（AR 助手、家用机器人）需推理已不可见物体：不仅回忆其最后出现位置，还要在其被移动后更新状态，并在移出视野后保留该更新。现有基准未隔离这一能力，作者将其定义为"视野外时空推理"。
AI.method: 构建首个隔离该能力的动态第一人称 VQA 基准 Beyond3D：每条查询针对已移动且已离开视野的物体；利用 HD‑EPIC 标注，结合物体 3D 位置、相机位姿与场景几何为每个动态物体构建可见性轨迹，判定其每时刻为可见、被遮挡或视野外；含 9000 问题、8 种类型、135 视频、9 名参与者，组织为一条推理链——视觉定位、时间定位、场景定位与 3D 空间感知。
AI.result: 基准测试 9 个通用及空间专用 VLM：最佳模型 42.2%，随机基线 29.7%，纯文本基线 31.9%；最大失败集中在"恢复物体最后可见时刻"。
AI.conclusion: 追踪物体移出视野后的运动对当前 VLM 仍远未解决，Beyond3D 为评估与推动该能力提供了专门的诊断基准。

title: Do Motion Tokenizers for Co-Speech Gesture Generation Encode Gesture Semantics?
summary: Discrete motion tokenizers encode motion as atomic units and are widely used for co-speech gesture generation. It remains unclear which motion properties, especially those relevant to gesture semantics, are recoverable from these codebooks. We probe a reconstruction-trained codebook using 19 co-speech gesture descriptors spanning from raw motion to abstract communicative function. Results show that geometry and handedness are readily decodable from token embeddings, while motion category is only weakly decoded despite showing systematic differences in discrete code usage. This gap between reconstruction quality and descriptor decodability suggests that reconstruction objectives alone do not guarantee that gesture semantics are captured, and that evaluating codebooks on such properties can guide the design of more semantic motion tokenizers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过19个手势描述符探测离散动作分词器的码本，发现几何与利手信息易于解码，而动作类别仅能弱解码，揭示重建目标不足以捕捉手势语义。
AI.motivation: 离散动作分词器广泛用于协同语音手势生成，但尚不清楚其码本中哪些与手势语义相关的动作属性可被恢复。
AI.method: 使用涵盖从原始运动到抽象交际功能的19个协同语音手势描述符，对以重建目标训练的码本进行探测（probing）。
AI.result: 几何和利手（handedness）可从token嵌入中直接解码；动作类别虽然在使用离散码上呈现系统性差异，但仅能被弱解码。
AI.conclusion: 重建质量与描述符可解码性之间存在差距，表明仅靠重建目标无法保证捕捉手势语义；基于此类属性评估码本可指导更具语义化的动作分词器设计。

title: Backdoor as Probe: Test-Time Adversarial Defense for CLIP
summary: Test-time adversarial defense improves the robustness of vision-language foundation models such as CLIP without retraining. However, adversarial activation shifts are typically treated as distortions to suppress, rather than signals to exploit. We turn these shifts into defense signals by repurposing the trigger-to-target mechanism of backdoors. The key is to implant a defender-controlled backdoor as a probe that is weakly activated by clean inputs but strongly activated by adversarial shifts. Based on this insight, we propose \emph{Backdoor as Probe} (BaP), a test-time adversarial defense for CLIP. BaP constructs the probe through a closed-form model edit to a selected MLP layer. It projects the average adversarial activation shift and a defender-specified semantic direction onto the layer's low-energy input and output activation subspaces to obtain the trigger and target directions, respectively. At inference time, adversarial inputs produce measurable responses along the target direction for detection. BaP then selectively rectifies detected inputs by optimizing a small perturbation that steers their representations away from adversarial shifts and toward the clean subspace. Experiments across 16 benchmarks show that BaP improves average robust accuracy from 1.0\% to 52.3\% while retaining clean accuracy, achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods with up to a \(5.7\times\) inference speedup. BaP further shows the generalization to adversarial attacks on large vision-language models. Project page: https://robin-wzq.github.io/Backdoor-as-Probe/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Backdoor as Probe (BaP)，将后门触发器-目标机制反向利用为探测信号，实现对 CLIP 等视觉-语言模型的测试时对抗防御。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时防御通常把对抗激活偏移视为需要抑制的失真，而非可利用的信号，因此 robustness 提升有限且推理开销较大。
AI.method: 通过对选定 MLP 层进行闭式模型编辑植入防御者控制的后门探针：将平均对抗激活偏移投影到低能量输入激活子空间得到触发器方向，将防御者指定语义方向投影到输出激活子空间得到目标方向。推理时通过目标方向响应检测对抗输入，并优化小扰动将表示从对抗偏移拉回干净子空间进行选择性校正。
AI.result: 在 16 个 benchmark 上，平均鲁棒准确率从 1.0% 提升到 52.3%，同时保持干净准确率，性能与 SOTA 方法相当，并实现最高 5.7 倍推理加速；还可泛化到大型视觉-语言模型的对抗攻击。
AI.conclusion: BaP 表明对抗激活偏移可被转化为防御信号，通过后门探针的检测与选择性校正，为 CLIP 等视觉-语言基础模型提供高效、有效的测试时对抗防御。

title: When Can Attention Heads Be Statically Defined?
summary: Some attention heads learn similar patterns across inputs. Reusing these patterns could reduce training cost by avoiding repeated query-key score computation and softmax. Through controlled pretraining comparisons, we identify Selective Attention Freezing (SAF), which selects heads with low attention-pattern variance and replaces their attention weights with fitted post-softmax means halfway through training. We represent these fixed patterns with absolute-position and relative-distance preferences, reducing storage from quadratic to linear in sequence length. A fused kernel reconstructs the patterns and executes ordinary-attention and replaced heads together. At matched training-token budgets, replacing 25% of attention heads gives 1.056x faster post-replacement optimiser updates at 124M parameters and 4K context, with a 0.77% perplexity increase. At 1B and 8K context, post-replacement updates are 1.068x faster on four GPUs including communication, with a 0.51% perplexity increase. The resulting models also accelerate long-input finetuning and causal prefill. After associative-recall adaptation, the 124M model with 25% replacement generalises to more key-value pairs at a fixed length better than ordinary attention and two pruning controls.

AI.tldr: 论文提出选择性注意力冻结（SAF），识别注意力模式方差低的注意力头，用拟合的softmax后均值替换其注意力权重，从而降低训练与推理开销。
AI.motivation: 部分注意力头在多种输入上学习到相似的模式，重复计算query-key分数与softmax造成冗余，存在可复用潜力。
AI.method: 通过受控预训练对比确定SAF：在训练中途选出低注意力模式方差头，用绝对位置与相对距离偏好表示固定模式，将存储从二次降为线性；融合kernel在reconstruct模式后与普通注意力头一起执行。
AI.result: 124M/4K下替换25%头，更新提速1.056x，困惑度升0.77%；1B/8K四卡含通信提速1.068x，困惑度升0.51%；同时加速长输入微调与causal prefill；关联召回适配上泛化更佳。
AI.conclusion: 复用低方差注意力头模式可在近似保持困惑度的同时降低训练与推理成本，并提升部分长序列任务泛化。

title: DirectUV: Image-Conditioned UV Texture Generation with Surface-Aware Positional Encoding
summary: Generating high-quality UV textures for 3D meshes remains challenging. Multi-view projection pipelines suffer from occlusion and view inconsistency, and recent methods that generate textures directly in UV space still rely on auxiliary modules to supply 3D information, leaving the attention mechanism tied to UV-grid positions rather than to the underlying surface geometry. This mismatch limits coherence across seams and disconnected UV islands. We propose DirectUV, an image-conditioned UV texture diffusion framework that operates in the latent UV space of a pretrained image VAE, in which a Diffusion Transformer denoises the UV latent given a single input image and a coarse UV map. At its core, Surface-Aware Positional Encoding (SAPE) replaces the standard 2D-grid positional encoding with encodings derived from per-token 3D surface coordinates obtained via UV-to-surface correspondence. As positional encodings define the distance metric used by attention, SAPE enables tokens to interact according to 3D positional proximity derived from surface correspondence rather than UV-grid distance, restoring coherence across seams and disconnected islands. A multi-level extension further assigns different attention heads to progressively finer subdivisions of the same latent UV patch, allowing the model to reason about surface structure at multiple granularities. Experiments show that DirectUV produces sharper and more globally consistent textures than other baselines, with the largest improvements in occluded and view-unseen regions where projection-based methods leave gaps or stretched textures.

AI.tldr: 提出 DirectUV，一种在预训练图像 VAE 的潜在 UV 空间中进行扩散的纹理生成框架，用基于 3D 表面坐标的 Surface-Aware Positional Encoding 替换 2D 网格位置编码，使注意力按表面几何邻近性而非 UV 网格距离交互，从而提升接缝与不连续 UV 岛的一致性，并支持多尺度表面结构建模。
AI.motivation: 为 3D 网格生成高质量 UV 纹理仍具挑战：多视图投影流程受遮挡与视图不一致影响；直接在 UV 空间生成的方法依赖辅助模块提供 3D 信息，注意力机制仍绑定于 UV 网格位置而非底层表面几何，导致跨接缝与不连续 UV 岛的连贯性受限。
AI.method: DirectUV 是以单张图像和粗略 UV 图为条件的 UV 纹理扩散框架，在预训练图像 VAE 的潜在 UV 空间运行，由 Diffusion Transformer 去噪 UV latent。核心是 Surface-Aware Positional Encoding（SAPE）：通过 UV 到表面的对应关系获取每个 token 的 3D 表面坐标，并以之替代标准 2D 网格位置编码；由于位置编码定义注意力使用的距离度量，SAPE 使 token 按来自表面对应的 3D 位置邻近性交互。进一步引入多层级扩展，将不同注意力头分配给同一潜在 UV patch 的逐级细分，实现多粒度表面结构推理。
AI.result: 实验表明，DirectUV 相比其他基线生成更锐利、全局更一致的纹理，在遮挡区域和不可见视图区域提升最大；这些区域中基于投影的方法会出现空洞或拉伸纹理。
AI.conclusion: 通过将注意力交互的距离度量从 UV 网格位置改为 3D 表面几何邻近性，DirectUV 有效缓解了 UV 空间生成方法在接缝与不连续 UV 岛上的连贯性问题，并在遮挡与未见视图等困难区域显著优于投影式方法。

title: Revitalizing Medical Time Series with Vision-Informed Retrieval: A Vision-Language Perspective
summary: Medical time series (MedTS) underpin many clinical classification tasks, yet existing methods usually represent them only as numerical sequences and underuse the morphology that is explicit in waveform inspection. To bridge this gap, we introduce Vision-Informed Retrieval (ViRe), which uses a frozen VLM-derived waveform representation as a morphology-aware Query to guide retrieval from raw numerical MedTS features. Specifically, a Vision Query is extracted using pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) to obtain morphology-aware priors from waveform plots. A tailored attention-based cross-modal retrieval mechanism then uses the Vision Query to select morphology-relevant temporal and channel evidence from the numerical representation. ViRe demonstrates strong effectiveness against ten established baselines, yielding an overall 6.42% relative improvement over the previous state of the art across six public benchmarks. Code, training scripts, and reproducibility materials are publicly available in the GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Levi-Ackman/ViRe.

AI.tldr: 提出ViRe，用冻结VLM提取波形图表示作为形态学感知查询，通过注意力跨模态检索从数值MedTS特征中选取相关时序与通道证据，在六个公开基准上较SOTA平均相对提升6.42%。
AI.motivation: 现有医学时间序列（MedTS）分类方法通常仅将其表示为数值序列，未能充分利用波形观察中显式的形态学信息，造成信息利用不足。
AI.method: ViRe包含两步：一是用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）从波形图中提取形态学感知先验，得到Vision Query；二是设计基于注意力的跨模态检索机制，以该查询从原始数值MedTS特征中筛选与形态学相关的时序与通道证据。VLM保持冻结。
AI.result: 在六个公开基准上，ViRe优于十个既有基线，相较此前SOTA取得6.42%的整体相对提升；代码、训练脚本与复现材料已开源。
AI.conclusion: 以波形视觉表示引导数值特征检索，可有效弥补MedTS表示中形态学信息利用不足的问题，提升临床分类性能。

title: CapField-OPD: Learning Continuous Capability Fields via Joint-Anchored Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Flow Models
summary: Reward-specialized post-training produces strong experts for flow-based generative models, while multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD) consolidates their capabilities into a single student. Existing methods, however, route each prompt to a single teacher according to its semantic category, implicitly binding the desired capability to prompt content. This coupling makes capability invocation vulnerable to prompt perturbations and prevents users from explicitly adjusting the strength of the desired capability at inference time. In this work, we introduce CapField-OPD, an OPD framework that integrates multiple teachers into a continuous capability field through explicit capability coordinates. We use teacher models as anchors to construct this field, with the coordinates determining how their outputs are combined. Each capability configuration thus receives a unique supervision target, and capability control no longer depends on prompt semantics. Since the training anchors may not be optimal at inference time, we further profile the learned field on a small calibration set. The coordinate with the highest mean reward serves as the recommended default, while coordinates that are frequently optimal offer a promising candidate set for test-time scaling. Extensive experiments on compositional generation, text rendering, and visual aesthetics demonstrate that CapField-OPD consolidates multiple specialized teachers into a single student while preserving or surpassing their performance, reliably invokes the desired capabilities under semantics-preserving prompt variations, and supports continuous capability control and coordinate-based test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 提出 CapField-OPD 框架，用显式能力坐标将多个教师模型组织成连续能力场，实现与提示语义解耦的可控能力调用，支持连续能力调节与基于坐标的测试时扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有基于流的生成模型通过奖励专精后训练得到强专家，再用多教师在线策略蒸馏（OPD）合并为单一学生。但已有方法按语义类别将每个提示路由到单一教师，把期望能力隐式绑定在提示内容上：这使能力调用对提示扰动敏感，且用户无法在推理时显式调节能力强度。
AI.method: CapField-OPD 通过显式能力坐标将多个教师整合为连续能力场；以教师模型为锚点构建该场，坐标决定教师输出的组合方式，使每种能力配置获得唯一监督目标，能力控制不再依赖提示语义。此外在小规模校准集上对学到的场进行刻画：以平均奖励最高的坐标作为推荐默认值，将频繁最优的坐标作为测试时扩展的候选集。
AI.result: 在组合生成、文本渲染和视觉美学任务上的大量实验表明：CapField-OPD 能将多个专精教师整合进单一学生并保持或超越其性能，在语义保持的提示扰动下仍可靠调用期望能力，并支持连续能力控制与基于坐标的测试时扩展。
AI.conclusion: CapField-OPD 将能力调用从提示语义中解耦，用坐标化能力场统一多教师蒸馏，为流式生成模型提供了稳健、连续且可扩展的能力控制范式。

title: Rewarding Novel Deductions: Solver-guided Process Supervision for Logical Reasoning
summary: Logical reasoning remains a major challenge for large language models (LLMs), particularly on structured problems that require precise constraint tracking, consistency preservation, and multi-step deduction. This challenge is especially acute for small-scale LLMs, which are more prone to producing inconsistent, redundant, or brittle reasoning trajectories. Existing approaches for improving logical reasoning largely optimize for final-answer correctness, providing only weak supervision over the intermediate reasoning process. In this work, we propose SPRING: (Solver-guided Process Rewards for Novel LogIcal ReasoNing Step Generation). SPRING uses SMT solver as a training-time verifier of intermediate reasoning steps to provide process-level supervision. It introduces the notion of a novel reasoning step, namely, a step that is logically valid, consistent with the evolving reasoning state, and not already implied by previously accepted non-contradictory deductions. Based on this solver-based assessment, it designs process rewards that encourage novel inferential progress while penalizing contradictory and uninformative reasoning steps. Evaluation across three logical reasoning benchmarks, ZebraLogic, AR-LSAT, and Knights and Knaves, and four LLMs shows that SPRING consistently outperforms base LLMs, outcome-only reward baselines, and Logic-LM. On ZebraLogic, SPRING improves puzzle accuracy by up to 49.71 and 15.43 points over the base LLM and strongest outcome-only baseline, respectively. On AR-LSAT, it improves overall accuracy by up to 64.93 and 12.14 points, respectively. On Knights and Knaves, SPRING achieves up to 93.14 puzzle accuracy and 96.05 person accuracy.

AI.tldr: SPRING利用SMT求解器对中间推理步骤进行过程级监督，通过定义"新颖推理步骤"并设计过程奖励，引导小规模LLM生成逻辑有效、一致且非冗余的推理轨迹，在三个逻辑推理基准上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在需要精确约束跟踪、一致性保持和多步演绎的结构化逻辑推理任务上仍面临重大挑战，小规模模型尤易产生不一致、冗余或脆弱的推理轨迹。现有方法主要优化最终答案正确性，对中间推理过程仅提供弱监督，缺乏对推理步骤质量的细致指导。
AI.method: 提出SPRING框架，使用SMT求解器作为训练时的验证器，对中间推理步骤提供过程级监督。引入"新颖推理步骤"概念，即逻辑有效、与演化中的推理状态一致、且不被已接受的非矛盾演绎所蕴含的步骤。基于求解器评估设计过程奖励，鼓励新颖的推理进展，惩罚矛盾与无信息量的步骤。
AI.result: 在ZebraLogic、AR-LSAT、Knights and Knaves三个基准及四种LLM上评估，SPRING一致优于基础LLM、仅结果奖励基线及Logic-LM。ZebraLogic上谜题准确率分别提升最多49.71和15.43个百分点；AR-LSAT整体准确率分别提升最多64.93和12.14个百分点；Knights and Knaves达到最高93.14谜题准确率和96.05人物准确率。
AI.conclusion: 以SMT求解器驱动的过程级奖励监督能够有效提升LLM（尤其是小规模模型）的逻辑推理能力，验证了关注中间推理步骤质量而非仅优化最终答案的优越性。

title: Evidence-Aligned Multimodal On-Policy Self-Distillation for Fine-Grained Visual Understanding
summary: Fine-grained visual understanding requires models to recognize small details within complex images. Multimodal on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) addresses this challenge by using a teacher conditioned on evidence-centered crops to supervise a student conditioned on original images along student-generated trajectories. Ideally, teacher corrections, the distributional changes from the student toward the privileged teacher, should be driven by task-relevant visual evidence. However, the designs that make the teacher effective also introduce other interference. Using a lagged or frozen teacher improves training stability but introduces a model-state gap from the evolving student, while cropping enhances task-relevant evidence but also loses the visual context. These two sources of interference make the teacher corrections not purely rely on the visual evidence. We introduce Evidence-Aligned multimodal on-policy self-Distillation (EAD), which retains the crop-conditioned teacher as the target but constructs a separate evidence reference for weighting the corrections. To exclude the effect of lagged model-state from this reference, EAD measures prediction changes using the current student. To avoid crop-induced context changes, EAD masks the evidence region in the original image while preserving the other visual context. The change from the student's masked-image prediction to its original-image prediction provides a controlled reference for the direction in which the visual evidence shifts the student's prediction. EAD weights each teacher correction by its cosine alignment with the reference, i.e., retaining aligned corrections and downweighting the rest. Retaining only 6\% of the supervision mass of dense OPSD, EAD consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: EAD通过构建独立的证据参考来加权教师修正，仅保留6%监督量即超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 细粒度视觉理解要求模型识别复杂图像中的小细节。多模态on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）用基于证据中心裁剪的教师监督基于原图的学生，但滞后/冻结教师带来模型状态差距、裁剪虽增强任务相关证据却丢失视觉上下文，这两类干扰使教师修正并非纯粹依赖视觉证据。
AI.method: 提出EAD：保留裁剪条件教师作为目标，但构建独立证据参考来加权修正。用当前学生测量预测变化以排除滞后模型状态影响；在原图中掩蔽证据区域同时保留其他上下文，以"掩蔽图预测到原图预测"的变化作为受控参考，代表视觉证据对预测的偏移方向；用余弦对齐度对每个教师修正加权，保留对齐修正、降低其余权重。
AI.result: 仅保留dense OPSD监督量的6%，EAD仍持续优于此前SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将教师修正与受控的证据参考对齐加权，EAD有效剔除模型状态差距与裁剪上下文变化两类干扰，在极低监督量下实现细粒度视觉理解的性能提升。

title: Learning What to Recall: Adaptive Multi-Cue Episodic Memory for World Models
summary: World models predict future observations from current experience and actions, yet prediction can depend on observations seen far in the past. Episodic memory preserves past observations for later recall; however, as memory accumulates, it raises a fundamental question: which memories are useful for the current prediction, and which available retrieval cues should be trusted to find them? This is challenging because fixed criteria based on recency, pose overlap, or visual similarity can be unreliable across environments and queries. We propose Future-Aware Recall (FAR), a framework that learns episodic recall from future-aware predictive supervision and adaptive multi-cue scoring. During training, FAR measures predictive utility by the conditional log-likelihood of the realized future given recalled context, approximated by negative diffusion prediction loss, and uses it to train a retriever that remains future-blind at inference. The retriever learns cue-specific relevance and automatically determines which available retrieval cues, such as time, pose, vision, and audio, to trust for each query when selecting memories. Across three complementary settings, FAR outperforms hand-designed recall even with the same retrieval cues, automatically adapts which available cues to trust, and recalls the right history as the world changes. Together, these results establish FAR as a flexible, principled approach to episodic memory access in world models.

AI.tldr: 提出Future-Aware Recall（FAR），一种面向世界模型的情节记忆检索框架，通过未来感知的预测监督与自适应多线索打分，学习"哪些记忆有用"及"信任哪些检索线索"。
AI.motivation: 世界模型预测未来观测时，有时依赖久远过去的观测；情节记忆虽能保存历史观测以供回忆，但随着记忆累积，两个关键问题凸显：哪些记忆对当前预测有用，以及应信任哪些可用的检索线索来找到它们。基于近因性、位姿重叠或视觉相似度等固定准则在不同环境和查询下并不可靠。
AI.method: FAR在训练阶段以"给定被召回上下文时真实未来的条件对数似然"衡量预测效用，并用负扩散预测损失近似该量，以此训练检索器；该检索器在推理时对未来是"盲"的（不接触未来）。检索器学习线索特定的相关性，并针对每个查询自动决定信任哪些可用检索线索（如时间、位姿、视觉、音频）来选择记忆。
AI.result: 在三个互补设置中，FAR即使使用相同的检索线索也优于人工设计的召回策略；它能自动适应应信任哪些可用线索，并能在世界状态变化时召回正确的历史。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，FAR是世界模型中一种灵活且有原则的情节记忆访问方法。

title: Fair Fact-Checking: Closing the Cross-Lingual Gap in LLM Factual Judgement with RoSh
summary: Misinformation on social media remains a critical problem, and more and more people settle it by asking a language model instead of a fact checker. Whether models judge such claims reliably is debated; whether they judge them equally well in every language people ask in has gone almost unasked. We test eight models from five families, 3B to 70B, on 1,500 encyclopedic factual claims that exist in identical form in eight languages. English is judged better than every other language on every model, and the gap is widest on the smallest ones, where Llama-3B on Arabic is no better than guessing. Existing remedies retrain on more multilingual data or fit an unconstrained map between language representations, and neither asks whether the model already holds the answer and simply fails to say it. It largely does: a linear probe recovers the truth from the very activations the model fails to express. We propose RoSh, a per-language shift and rotation of the residual stream, computed in closed form at three layers, with no training and no weight modified. It improves every model and closes 75% of the gap on average, helping most where the model was worst: Arabic on Llama-3B goes from chance to nearly the English level, and a fifth fewer of the claims answered correctly in English are lost in translation. What remains is no longer a read-out failure: afterwards the head recovers as much of what is encoded outside English as it does in English. An unconstrained map fitted on the same pairs falls below the untouched baseline, so the orthogonality constraint is doing the work, and every model clears a scrambled-correspondence control and ten further controls. On the two benchmarks of the closest inference-time method, latent-space intervention, run with its own data and metric code, RoSh's gains are five to thirteen times larger.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了语言模型在多语言事实核查中的可靠性，发现模型在英语上表现优于其他语言，并提出了一种无需训练、不改权重的推理时干预方法RoSh，通过按语言对残差流进行闭式求解的平移和旋转，平均弥合了75%的多语言性能差距。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体虚假信息问题日益严重，越来越多人借助语言模型而非事实核查工具来判断真伪。模型判断此类主张是否可靠尚存争议，而它们在每种语言中是否判断得一样好几乎无人探究。现有补救方法要么用更多多语言数据重训练，要么在语言表示间拟合无约束映射，但都没有追问模型是否其实已经"知道答案"、只是没有表达出来。
AI.method: 作者测试了来自5个家族、参数量3B至70B的8个模型，使用1500条以8种语言完全相同形式存在的百科事实性主张。提出RoSh：一种按语言对残差流施加的平移与旋转，在三个层上以闭式解计算，无需训练、不修改任何权重。作者还使用线性探针从模型未能表达的激活中恢复真相，并进行无约束映射对照、乱序对应控制及十项额外控制实验。在潜空间干预这一最接近的推理时方法的两个基准上，使用其自有数据和度量代码进行对比。
AI.result: 每个模型上英语判断都优于其他所有语言，且在最小模型上差距最大，Llama-3B在阿拉伯语上仅相当于随机猜测。线性探针能从模型未能表达的激活中恢复真相，说明失败主要是读出失败。RoSh提升了每个模型，平均弥合75%的差距，在模型表现最差处帮助最大：Llama-3B的阿拉伯语从随机水平提升至接近英语水平，英语中答对的表述被翻译后丢失的比例减少五分之一。此后注意力头在非英语中恢复的编码信息与英语相当。无约束映射在相同数据对上拟合后低于未干预基线，说明正交约束是关键。RoSh在潜空间干预基准上的增益是其5至13倍。
AI.conclusion: 多语言事实判断的差距主要源于读出失败而非知识缺失——模型内部已编码真相但未能表达。通过无训练、闭式的按语言平移与旋转干预，可在不修改权重的情况下大幅提升多语言一致性，且正交约束是性能提升的核心。所提方法在多个对照与基准上均优于现有推理时方法。

title: V-Gym: Enhancing Agentic Visual Reasoning via Skill-Data Co-Evolution
summary: Advances in multimodal understanding, reasoning, and tool use enable agents to tackle increasingly complex visual reasoning tasks. By distilling past execution experience into reusable skills, agents can transfer lessons from both successes and failures into future reasoning, reducing repeated errors and improving capabilities. However, limited experience may produce unreliable, poorly generalizable skills, while static datasets may lack the targeted and diverse practice needed for refinement. To address this gap, we introduce V-Gym, an autonomous framework that iteratively co-evolves procedural skills and multimodal practice data from execution trajectories. During skill evolution, V-Gym analyzes trajectories to distill and refine hierarchical skills, updating procedural guidance and applicability conditions while retaining an update only if it improves validation performance. During data evolution, V-Gym selects generation seeds by balancing data utility and exploration, then translates trajectory-identified bottlenecks into diverse, targeted practice data that expand the data bank after quality checks. The resulting practice outcomes feed back into subsequent skill updates, closing the loop for continual skill refinement. Experiments across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks show substantial improvements over baselines with multiple backbone models. Its evolved skills generalize across domains and models, while evolved data support more effective skill refinement, enabling autonomous diagnosis, targeted practice, and continual self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出V-Gym框架，通过技能与数据的协同进化实现多模态推理智能体的持续自我改进。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体通过将执行经验蒸馏为可复用技能来迁移成功与失败教训、减少重复错误。但有限经验会产生不可靠、泛化差的技能，而静态数据集缺乏针对性、多样化的练习数据用于技能精炼，二者之间存在缺口。
AI.method: V-Gym是一个自主框架，迭代地协同进化程序化技能与多模态练习数据。技能进化：分析轨迹以蒸馏并精炼分层技能，更新程序化引导与适用条件，仅在验证性能提升时保留更新。数据进化：通过平衡数据效用与探索来选择生成种子，将轨迹识别的瓶颈转化为多样化、有针对性的练习数据，经质量检查后扩充数据银行。练习结果反馈至后续技能更新，形成闭环持续精炼。
AI.result: 在多种多模态推理基准上，相较于基线在多个骨干模型上取得显著提升；进化后的技能可跨领域、跨模型泛化，进化后的数据能支持更有效的技能精炼。
AI.conclusion: V-Gym实现了自主诊断、针对性练习与持续自我改进，验证了技能与数据协同进化范式的有效性。

title: Natural State-Prediction Accuracy can Hide Weak Controlled Responsiveness in VLA Readouts
summary: Accurately decoding object states from the internal representations of vision-language-action (VLA) models does not establish that the predictions respond faithfully to changes in the target physical state. In natural observations, object state, robot configuration, occlusion, and task progress vary together, allowing contextual cues to contribute to prediction. In this paper, we introduce an evaluation framework that separates prediction accuracy, target-state responsiveness, and context stability using physically validated observations that cross target coordinates with robot contexts. We demonstrate that high natural-trajectory accuracy can coexist with weak controlled target-state responsiveness in fixed representation-readout pairs. Comparisons and interventions involving representations, readouts, and training data show that the three properties provide distinct diagnostic information. Furthermore, adding responsiveness and context sensitivity to a failure predictor based on initial state error and physical variables reduces policy-failure prediction error on new initializations relative to the specified baseline while same-observation controlled MAE is also informative. These findings motivate evaluating target-state responsiveness and context stability alongside natural prediction accuracy, and examining their relationship to actual policy behavior and task outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个评估框架，将预测精度、目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性分离，证明高自然轨迹精度可能与弱受控目标状态响应性共存，并说明三者提供不同诊断信息。
AI.motivation: 从VLA模型内部表征准确解码物体状态，并不能证明预测会忠实响应目标物理状态的变化。在自然观测中，物体状态、机器人构型、遮挡和任务进度共同变化，上下文线索可能混入预测，因此需要分离这些因素进行评估。
AI.method: 提出评估框架，使用经物理验证的观测，将目标坐标与机器人上下文进行交叉组合，从而分离预测精度、目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性。并开展涉及表征、读出器（readout）和训练数据的比较与干预实验；同时将响应性与上下文敏感性加入基于初始状态误差和物理变量的失败预测器。
AI.result: 在固定表征—读出器组合下，高自然轨迹精度可与弱受控目标状态响应性共存；表征、读出器、训练数据的比较与干预表明三类属性提供各自独立的诊断信息。在新初始化条件下，为失败预测器加入响应性与上下文敏感性，相对指定基线降低了策略失败预测误差；同观测受控MAE也具有信息量。
AI.conclusion: 应在自然预测精度之外，同时评估目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性，并进一步考察它们与实际策略行为和任务结果之间的关系。

title: Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization: Diverse T2I Generation and VLA Generalization
summary: Reward-maximizing reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to post-train stochastic diffusion and flow policies for text-to-image (T2I) generation. However, reward-maximizing RL causes policy mode collapse even under reference KL or entropy regularization, reducing the policy to a single high-reward mode. In T2I, this produces similar images and reward hacking. When extended to vision-language-action (VLA) models, the same collapse removes alternative successful strategies and weakens task and scene generalization. To address this limitation, we introduce Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization (Uni-TMPO), a unified RL post-training framework for diffusion and flow policies. First, Uni-TMPO converts standardized rewards into a target distribution within each trajectory group and derives the policy distribution from trajectory log probabilities. Then, forward Kullback-Leibler optimization matches the two distributions instead of maximizing expected reward. A progress-conditioned coarse-to-fine scheduler efficiently constructs T2I trajectories. Within the unified framework, feedback-conditioned sampling uses updated observations to construct VLA trajectories. Extensive experiments show that Uni-TMPO achieves higher T2I rewards and VLA ID success rates than the strongest baselines. More importantly, it achieves the best T2I reward-diversity-efficiency trade-off and VLA generalization to held-out tasks and scenes, while real-robot evaluation demonstrates the value of multiple action strategies when the higher-reward target is blocked.

AI.tldr: 提出统一轨迹匹配策略优化（Uni-TMPO），用前向KL匹配轨迹组目标分布替代奖励最大化，缓解扩散/流策略的模式崩溃，在T2I与VLA任务上同时提升奖励、多样性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 奖励最大化式强化学习广泛用于扩散与流策略的文本到图像（T2I）后训练，但即便加入参考KL或熵正则，仍会导致策略模式崩溃，将策略坍缩到单一高奖励模式，造成图像同质化与奖励黑客；在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型上，同样会丢失其他可行策略，削弱任务与场景泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出 Uni-TMPO 统一后训练框架：1）在每个轨迹组内将标准化奖励转换为目标分布，并由轨迹对数概率导出策略分布；2）采用前向KL优化匹配两分布，而非最大化期望奖励；3）用进度条件的由粗到细调度器高效构建T2I轨迹；4）在同一框架下以反馈条件采样，利用更新后的观测构建VLA轨迹。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Uni-TMPO 在T2I奖励与VLA ID成功率上均优于最强基线；在T2I上取得最佳的奖励-多样性-效率权衡，在VLA上对留出任务与场景取得最佳泛化；真机评估显示，当较高奖励目标被阻塞时，多动作策略具有实际价值。
AI.conclusion: Uni-TMPO 通过分布匹配（前向KL）而非奖励最大化，统一支持扩散与流策略的后训练，有效缓解模式崩溃，同时兼顾奖励、多样性与泛化能力，并在真实机器人场景中验证了多策略保留的意义。

title: Using LLMs to Detect LLM-Generated Texts: A Cross-Generation Analysis
summary: Automated detection of LLM-generated texts (LGTs) is critical, yet dedicated detectors often struggle to generalize across domains and models. While general-purpose LLMs offer flexible zero-shot authorship classification with explanatory rationale, their detection behavior, especially regarding self-detection versus cross-detection across model generations, remains poorly understood. We systematically evaluate 15 LLMs spanning three model generations as both generators and detectors. Using a benchmark of 1,000 human-written texts and 15,000 LGTs (1,000 per model), we collected over 233,000 binary classifications alongside natural-language explanations. Our results reveal that detection efficacy is primarily driven by detector capability rather than generator provenance, although outputs from newer generators remain notably harder to detect. Crucially, statistical comparisons show no systematic advantage or disadvantage for self-detection across models. Error analysis further exposes generational bias shifts: first-generation detectors under-detect LGTs (high false-negative rates), second-generation detectors over-flag human texts (high false-positive rates), and the latest models achieve balanced trade-offs. Finally, we highlight significant inconsistencies in how different LLMs apply textual cues to justify their decisions. Code: https://github.com/hyyuan/detect-llm-generated-texts.

AI.tldr: 系统评估15个LLM作为生成器与检测器的表现，发现检测效果主要由检测器能力决定，自我检测无系统优势，并揭示代际偏置差异。
AI.motivation: 专用LLM生成文本检测器跨域跨模型泛化能力差；通用LLM虽可零样本作者分类并给出解释，但其检测行为（尤其自我检测与跨代检测）尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建含1000篇人类文本与15000篇LGT（每模型1000篇）的基准，让15个跨三代LLM同时充当生成器与检测器，收集超233000条二分类结果及自然语言解释，并进行统计比较与错误分析。
AI.result: 检测效能主要由检测器能力而非生成器来源驱动，但新代生成器文本更难检测；自我检测无系统性优劣；第一代检测器高假阴性，第二代高假阳性，最新模型取得平衡；不同LLM解释所用文本线索存在显著不一致。
AI.conclusion: 检测能力是泛化关键，代际偏置存在系统性差异，解释一致性不足；相关代码已开源。

title: Triangular Resampling for Long-Horizon Motion Generation
summary: We introduce Triangular Resampling (TR), a post-training method for mitigating long-horizon error accumulation in motion diffusion models. Built on FloodDiffusion's triangular denoising schedule, TR addresses the mismatch between ground-truth-derived training windows and model-generated inference states. Replacing only completed motion history leaves this mismatch unresolved in partially denoised states within the active window. TR therefore extends rollout-based training to these states, using ground-truth clamping to limit excessive drift. For each replayed sample, TR draws one denoising threshold, shared across latent positions and replay updates, and replays multi-step triangular denoising without gradient tracking. After each update, states below the threshold are replaced with noise-matched ground truth, while those at or above it retain model predictions. The resulting latent window enters the standard training update. This rollout construction supports both supervised training (TR) and distribution matching (TR-DMD). On 120-second motion generation from HumanML3D test prompts, TR and TR-DMD achieve state-of-the-art FID AUC within their respective non-DMD and DMD comparison groups. Supervised TR reduces FID AUC by 40.9% and FID degradation slope by 55.3% relative to matched post-training without replay.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Triangular Resampling (TR)，一种用于缓解运动扩散模型长时序误差累积的后训练方法，并扩展出 TR-DMD 分布匹配版本，在 120 秒运动生成任务上取得最优 FID AUC。
AI.motivation: 运动扩散模型在长时序生成时存在误差累积问题。已有基于 rollout 的后训练方法存在训练窗口（源自真值）与推理状态（模型自生成）之间的不匹配；仅替换已完成运动历史无法解决活动窗口内部分去噪状态的失配问题。
AI.method: TR 建立在 FloodDiffusion 三角去噪调度之上，将 rollout 训练扩展到活动窗口内的部分去噪状态，并用真值钳制限制过度漂移。对每个重放样本抽取一个去噪阈值，在潜在位置与重放更新间共享，在不追踪梯度的情况下重放多步三角去噪；每次更新后，低于阈值的状态替换为噪声匹配的真值，高于或等于阈值的保留模型预测。所得潜在窗口进入标准训练更新。该构造同时支持监督训练（TR）与分布匹配（TR-DMD）。
AI.result: 在 HumanML3D 测试提示上进行的 120 秒运动生成中，TR 与 TR-DMD 在各自的非 DMD 与 DMD 对比组内均达到 SOTA FID AUC。监督式 TR 相比无重放的匹配后训练，FID AUC 降低 40.9%，FID 退化斜率降低 55.3%。
AI.conclusion: TR 通过将 rollout 后训练拓展至部分去噪状态并结合真值钳制，有效缓解长时序误差累积，可作为监督训练与分布匹配的通用后训练框架。

title: From Pixel Generation to Topological Inference: Structural Dual Super-Resolution for Trustworthy Cross-Physical-Domain Trabecular Morphology Learning
summary: Clinical CT and UHRCT cannot resolve individual trabeculae, whereas synchrotron radiation microCT (SRuCT) provides high-resolution references but is not applicable for in vivo imaging. The two domains differ by a 32x resolution gap, are only coarsely paired, and exhibit severe physical differences including partial volume effects, noise, and artifacts. Existing super-resolution networks and pretrained-prior methods (GLEAN/StyleGAN2, Stable SR/LDM) underperform because they target pixel generation---diverse details and SSIM/PSNR---and do not model these physical differences. Pixel generation for a 32x resolution gap is intrinsically ill-posed. We propose a paradigm shift from pixel generation to topological inference: deterministically predicting invariant microstructures from macro-scale low-resolution inputs, evaluated by morphological parameters. The core of our 2D morphology learning lies in training on 2D slices while evaluating on 3D morphological parameters, ensuring that the learned representations capture true three-dimensional trabecular topology rather than 2D pixel statistics. We realize this paradigm via structural dual super-resolution, coupling forward physical degradation (micro-to-macro) with inverse structural inference (macro-to-micro) through structural duality constraints. The method is an end-to-end, few-shot, compact structural dual network (SDN), comprising a bidirectional modeling network, a multi-scale structural consistency discriminator, and four structural duality constraints. On the test set, SDN achieves morphological parameters largely consistent with SRuCT across six metrics, with SSIM reaching 0.8. Trained on 3.2 um SSRF data, the model generalizes well to 3.25 um isotropic BSRF data from an independent source, validating cross-source generalization and confirming trustworthy structural inference rather than pixel generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从"像素生成"转向"拓扑推断"的新范式，通过结构对偶超分辨率网络（SDN）在32倍分辨率差下从临床CT/UHRCT确定性地推断骨小梁微结构，并在六个形态学指标上达到与SRuCT一致的结果。
AI.motivation: 临床CT与UHRCT无法分辨单个骨小梁，而SRuCT虽能提供高分辨率参考却不适用于在体成像。两域间存在32倍分辨率差、配对粗糙，且伴有部分容积效应、噪声和伪影等严重物理差异。现有超分辨率网络及预训练先验方法（GLEAN/StyleGAN2、Stable SR/LDM）面向像素生成（追求多样细节与SSIM/PSNR），未建模上述物理差异，且32倍分辨率差的像素生成本质上是病态问题。
AI.method: 提出范式转变：从像素生成转向拓扑推断，即从宏观低分辨率输入确定性预测不变的微结构，并以形态学参数评估。核心思想在于"2D形态学学习"——在2D切片上训练却在3D形态学参数上评估，确保学到的表征捕获真实三维骨小梁拓扑而非2D像素统计。通过结构对偶超分辨率实现该范式，将前向物理退化（微观到宏观）与逆向结构推断（宏观到微观）通过结构对偶约束耦合。方法为端到端、少样本、紧凑的结构对偶网络（SDN），包含双向建模网络、多尺度结构一致性判别器和四个结构对偶约束。
AI.result: 在测试集上，SDN在六个形态学指标上与SRuCT基本一致，SSIM达到0.8。模型在3.2 μm SSRF数据上训练后，能良好泛化到独立来源的3.25 μm各向同性BSRF数据，验证了跨源泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 实验证实该方法实现的是可信的结构推断而非像素生成，跨源泛化能力得到验证，表明从像素生成转向拓扑推断的范式在跨越32倍分辨率差的微结构重建任务中具有可行性与优势。

title: ReMCTS: Reflection-Enhanced Monte Carlo Tree Search for Code Generation
comment: 21 pages, 2 figures. To appear in the Proceedings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) can generate function-level programs from natural-language prompts, but plausible candidates still fail on hidden semantics and repeat mistakes across repair attempts. We present ReMCTS, an execution-grounded, memory-augmented, LLM-guided MCTS-style search framework. It organizes program candidates as tree states, retains branch-local debugging context, retrieves failure experience across branches, and distinguishes failed checks from unavailable evidence. On HumanEval and MBPP-Sanitized, visible-test ReMCTS improves over direct generation in 8 of 10 model-dataset pairs under held-out evaluation, whereas proxy-only search is less stable. Controlled tree-search, sampling, repair, and memory ablations characterize the source and limits of these gains. A 30-task HumanEval-X C++ pilot further demonstrates compatibility with compiler-backed execution, but does not constitute a broad multilingual evaluation.

AI.tldr: ReMCTS：一种基于执行反馈、记忆增强并由LLM引导的MCTS式程序搜索框架，通过树状态组织候选程序、保留分支局部调试上下文并跨分支检索失败经验，在HumanEval/MBPP-Sanitized的留出评测中多数设置优于直接生成。
AI.motivation: 开放权重LLM虽能依据自然语言提示生成函数级程序，但看似合理的候选程序常在隐藏语义上失败，且在多次修复尝试中重复犯同类错误，说明仅靠代理指标或直接生成难以稳定提升正确性。
AI.method: 提出ReMCTS：以执行反馈为依据、记忆增强、LLM引导的MCTS式搜索框架；将程序候选组织为树状态，保留分支局部调试上下文，跨分支检索失败经验，并区分“失败检查”与“证据不可得”。采用受控的树搜索、采样、修复与记忆消融实验分析收益来源与边界。
AI.result: 在HumanEval与MBPP-Sanitized上，采用可见测试的ReMCTS在留出评测中于10个“模型-数据集”组合中的8个优于直接生成；仅依赖代理指标的搜索稳定性较差。30任务HumanEval-X C++试点表明其可兼容编译器支撑的执行，但不构成广泛的多语言评测。
AI.conclusion: ReMCTS通过执行落地与记忆增强的树搜索有效改善函数级程序生成与修复，但其增益受搜索、采样、修复与记忆机制影响且存在局限；C++试点仅提供初步兼容性证据，多语言泛化仍需更大规模评测。

title: Quality Determines Direction, Length Shapes Magnitude: Length Control for Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) changes not only what language models say, but also how much they say, often increasing response length at the cost of token efficiency. Controlling this length growth is particularly challenging in open-ended RL because (i) response length is entangled with quality, (ii) open-ended tasks lack a natural success boundary for deciding when efficiency should be prioritized, and (iii) dense, graded rewards often yield small within-group quality margins, making quality-induced advantages especially sensitive to reward-level length shaping, which can perturb their magnitudes and even reverse their signs. We therefore adopt an asymmetric principle: quality should determine the direction of reinforcement, while length should only shape its magnitude. We instantiate this principle with Quality-Gated Length Advantage Shaping (QGLAS), which first computes advantages from quality rewards alone, then adds bounded bonuses only to shorter positive-advantage responses, leaving all other advantages unchanged. The bonus strength is further adapted to within-group quality separation, allowing conciseness to matter more when quality-favored responses are similar and less when their quality differences are clear. Across different model families, open-ended benchmarks, and reward sources, QGLAS consistently achieves a stronger quality--length trade-off than representative baselines. At approximately 30% compression, QGLAS retains 98.4--102.0% of the macro-average quality gains achieved by quality-only RL over the base model, compared with 68.3--75.5% for these baselines at comparable compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QGLAS方法，通过"质量决定强化方向、长度仅调节幅度"的非对称原则，在保持质量收益的同时显著压缩回复长度，实现更优的质量—长度权衡。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在改变语言模型输出内容的同时，常导致回复长度增加、token效率下降。在开放式RL任务中控制长度增长尤为困难：回复长度与质量相互纠缠；开放式任务缺乏判断何时应优先效率的自然成功边界；密集分级奖励常产生较小的组内质量差距，使得质量诱导的优势对奖励层面的长度塑形极为敏感，可能扰动其幅度甚至反转其符号。
AI.method: 采用非对称原则：质量决定强化方向，长度仅调节幅度。具体实现为质量门控长度优势塑形（QGLAS）：先仅基于质量奖励计算优势，然后仅对较短且优势为正的回复添加有界奖励，其余优势保持不变。奖励强度进一步根据组内质量分离度自适应，当质量偏好回复相似时简洁性权重更高，质量差异明确时权重更低。
AI.result: 在不同模型家族、开放式基准和奖励来源上，QGLAS均持续取得比代表性基线更强的质量—长度权衡。在约30%压缩率下，QGLAS保留了仅质量RL相对基座模型所得宏观平均质量增益的98.4%–102.0%，而对比基线在相当压缩率下仅为68.3%–75.5%。
AI.conclusion: 质量门控长度优势塑形（QGLAS）通过将长度信号仅作用于正优势短回复的幅度，并自适应调整奖励强度，能在不牺牲质量增益的前提下有效压缩回复长度，优于现有代表性基线方法。

title: DBCF: Dual-Branch Complementary Fusion of Foundation Models for Generalized Deepfake Detection
summary: As image generation and editing technologies have progressed substantially, facial forgeries pose significant challenges to privacy and public safety. Due to limited ability to capture forgery cues, existing small-scale forgery detection models often struggle to generalize across various domains and unseen manipulations. To address this limitation, researchers have turned to large-scale foundation models, which can provide richer representations and better generalization. Nevertheless, relying on a single foundation model alone remains insufficient for effective forgery detection. While models like CLIP offer robust global semantic cues, they lack the capacity to capture detailed local facial features. In contrast, DINO excels at capturing local structural features of faces, but provides weaker global semantic context. To fully utilize the synergies among multiple foundation models, we propose a hierarchical multi-granular framework that integrates complementary pretrained representations. Specifically, a Global Context Branch (GCB) based on CLIP captures holistic semantic cues, while a Fine-grained Cue Branch (FCB) built on DINOv3 captures localized structural irregularities. In addition, we design a feature fusion module that enables parameter-efficient adaptation of the frozen foundation backbones by adaptively extracting and integrating complementary features from the two models. By jointly leveraging global context and fine-grained cues, our method learns more comprehensive forgery representations and achieves strong cross-manipulation performance. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the benefit of the proposed design, particularly under cross-dataset and cross-manipulation settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种分层多粒度框架，融合CLIP的全局语义表示与DINOv3的细粒度结构表示，通过特征融合模块实现冻结基础模型的参数高效适配，从而提升人脸伪造检测的跨操作泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 图像生成与编辑技术快速发展使人脸伪造对隐私和公共安全构成威胁。现有小规模伪造检测模型难以捕捉伪造线索，泛化性差，难以应对跨域和未见操作。单一基础模型亦不足：CLIP擅全局语义但缺局部细节，DINO擅局部结构但全局语义弱，故需整合多基础模型的互补表示。
AI.method: 提出分层多粒度框架，整合互补的预训练表示。包含基于CLIP的全局上下文分支（GCB）捕捉整体语义线索，基于DINOv3的细粒度线索分支（FCB）捕捉局部结构异常；并设计特征融合模块，在冻结基础骨干的前提下自适应提取与整合两模型互补特征，实现参数高效适配。
AI.result: 在多个基准上开展大量实验，验证了所提设计的有效性，尤其在跨数据集和跨操作设置下表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 联合利用全局上下文与细粒度线索可学习更全面的伪造表示，实现强跨操作性能，表明多基础模型分层融合是提升人脸伪造检测泛化性的有效途径。

title: Geometry as Address: Routing Attention to Visual Memory for Long-Horizon Camera-Controlled Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon camera-controlled video generation requires recovering previously observed content from an ever-growing visual history. Existing approaches either search historical context implicitly or reconstruct it into persistent 3D memory, facing inefficient memory access or accumulated geometric errors. Our key insight is that geometry need not explain the scene--it only needs to determine where visual memory should be read from, while attention decides what should be recovered. Based on this insight, we introduce GEAR, a Geometry-Enabled Attention Routing framework that uses geometry as an explicit token-level address for visual memory. Rather than fusing historical observations into a persistent global 3D representation, GEAR retains them as frame latents and uses per-frame geometry only to establish token-level correspondences with target views, thereby avoiding persistent error accumulation from global fusion. Guided by these correspondences, Geometric Correspondence Attention (GCA) selectively injects geometrically matched historical features into noisy target patches during denoising. We further introduce an Invisible Octree to accumulate visibility evidence and reject geometrically plausible but occluded correspondences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GEAR achieves state-of-the-art visual quality, precise camera control, and revisit consistency, enabling minute-long video generation along challenging trajectories.

AI.tldr: GEAR是一个几何使能的注意力路由框架，利用几何作为token级视觉记忆寻址依据，通过几何对应注意力（GCA）与Invisible Octree实现长时序、可控相机的视频生成，达到领先的画质、相机控制与重访一致性。
AI.motivation: 长时序且相机可控的视频生成需要从不断增长的历史视觉内容中恢复先前观测到的场景。现有方法要么隐式检索历史上下文，要么将其重建为持久3D记忆，分别面临记忆访问效率低下或几何误差累积的问题。
AI.method: 核心洞见是几何无需解释场景，只需决定从何处读取视觉记忆，而由注意力决定恢复什么。据此提出GEAR：以几何作为token级的显式视觉记忆地址。它不将历史观测融合进持久全局3D表示，而是保留为帧隐变量（frame latents），仅用逐帧几何与目标视角建立token级对应，避免全局融合带来的误差累积。在此基础上，Geometric Correspondence Attention（GCA）依据这些对应关系，在去噪过程中选择性地将几何匹配的历史特征注入带噪目标patch；并引入Invisible Octree累积可见性证据，剔除几何上合理但实际被遮挡的对应。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，GEAR实现了最先进的视觉质量、精确的相机控制以及重访一致性，能够在具有挑战性的轨迹上生成分钟级长视频。
AI.conclusion: 通过将几何定位为token级记忆寻址机制而非场景解释器，GEAR有效规避了全局3D融合的持久误差累积，兼顾记忆访问效率与几何一致性，为长时序、相机可控视频生成提供了新范式。

title: What Visual Generators Need from Teachers: Rethinking Representation Alignment
summary: Representation alignment speeds up diffusion transformer training by pulling an intermediate block of the model (student) toward features of a frozen pretrained encoder (teacher). Which teacher layer to align, and for how long, is still set by convention, and each alternative costs a training run. We find that alignment helps where the student cannot linearly recover the teacher's features, not where it already resembles them. Since a deep teacher layer is largely predictable from the one below, we isolate what each layer adds, its increment, and measure how much of it an unaligned student recovers. The student fills the teacher's hierarchy from the bottom up and stalls near the top, which we call hierarchy filling: even after 400K steps it recovers almost none of the deepest. The recoverability gap is the unrecovered share of an increment, read from one unaligned checkpoint. In short runs that each align one teacher layer at one block, the gap nearly reproduces their ranking by FID improvement, and CKA, a measure of feature similarity, largely reverses it. Representation Alignment and Recoverability Estimation (RARE) picks the teacher layer with the largest gap before training. During training, it tracks each token's remaining distance to that layer, the online counterpart of the gap, weights tokens by it, and phases out the loss once the average distance stops falling. With SiT-B/2 on ImageNet $256\times256$, RARE reaches an FID of 18.02 without guidance and 4.46 with it, ahead of seven alignment baselines including REPA, iREPA and HASTE. It also trains in 14% fewer GPU-hours than iREPA. Its FID stays below iREPA's across model scales, teachers, datasets and backbones.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RARE方法，通过度量"恢复性差距"来选择对齐的教师层并动态调控对齐损失，加速扩散Transformer训练。
AI.motivation: 表征对齐能加速扩散Transformer训练，但选择哪个教师层对齐、对齐多久通常凭经验设定，每种方案都需付出一次训练代价。
AI.method: 发现对齐只在学生无法线性恢复教师特征时有效；利用深层特征主要由下层决定，分离每层增量并度量未对齐学生的恢复程度，提出"层级填充"现象与"恢复性差距"指标。据此设计RARE：训练前选差距最大的教师层；训练中追踪每个token到该层的剩余距离，作为差距的在线对应量进行token加权，并在平均距离不再下降时逐步退火对齐损失。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，SiT-B/2达到FID 18.02（无引导）和4.46（有引导），优于REPA、iREPA、HASTE等七种对齐基线；相比iREPA节省14%的GPU小时；在多种模型规模、教师、数据集和骨干网络上FID均低于iREPA。
AI.conclusion: RARE以恢复性差距为准则自动选择教师层并调度对齐损失，无需额外训练即可确定超参数，在效果和效率上均优于现有表征对齐基线，并具备良好的泛化性。

title: SurgGMF: Fully Causal Gaussian Motion Forecasting for Anticipatory Surgical Scene Rendering
summary: Dynamic surgical scene modeling is essential for robotic perception, simulation, and decision support. Although existing neural rendering methods enable efficient reconstruction and rendering of deformable surgical scenes, they remain primarily focused on observed-frame reconstruction rather than forecasting future scene states. To this end, we present SurgGMF, a fully causal Gaussian motion forecasting framework for anticipatory surgical scene rendering. Rather than predicting future RGB images directly, SurgGMF forecasts future Gaussian motion states represented by position, scale, and rotation residuals (X/S/R) from historical Gaussian motion fields. To prevent target leakage, we introduce a full-causal-last rendering protocol, where future Gaussian states are rendered without accessing target-frame Gaussian attributes while preserving causal appearance propagation. We evaluate SurgGMF on 12 EndoNeRF and StereoMIS video slices using neural temporal learners and classical dynamics baselines under a unified forecasting protocol. Learned Gaussian motion forecasting consistently outperforms classical dynamics baselines in render space, demonstrating gains beyond hand-crafted state extrapolation. Latency analysis further reveals an accuracy--efficiency trade-off: under the current implementations, TKAN achieves the highest accuracy, whereas GRU and LSTM provide more favorable module-level latency profiles. These results establish SurgGMF as a reproducible framework for causal Gaussian motion forecasting and advance surgical Gaussian representations from retrospective reconstruction toward predictive scene modeling.

AI.tldr: SurgGMF：面向手术场景的因果高斯运动预测框架，通过预测未来高斯状态（位置/尺度/旋转残差）实现前瞻性渲染，在12段EndoNeRF与StereoMIS视频上优于经典动力学基线，并揭示了精度—效率的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有神经渲染方法虽能高效重建与渲染可变形手术场景，但主要局限于已观测帧的重建，缺乏对未来场景状态的预测能力；而机器人感知、仿真与决策支持需要动态手术场景建模的前瞻性能力。
AI.method: 提出SurgGMF全因果高斯运动预测框架：不直接预测未来RGB图像，而是从历史高斯运动场预测未来高斯运动状态（由位置、尺度、旋转残差X/S/R表示）；为防止目标泄漏，引入full-causal-last渲染协议，在渲染未来高斯状态时不访问目标帧高斯属性，同时保持因果外观传播；在统一预测协议下对比神经时序学习器与经典动力学基线。
AI.result: 在12段EndoNeRF和StereoMIS视频切片上评估：学习式高斯运动预测在渲染空间上持续优于经典动力学基线，表明其增益超出人工设计的状态外推；延迟分析显示精度—效率权衡——当前实现中TKAN精度最高，GRU与LSTM在模块级延迟上更具优势。
AI.conclusion: SurgGMF为因果高斯运动预测提供了可复现框架，推动手术高斯表示从回顾式重建迈向预测式场景建模。

title: SeLMRoute: Probabilistic Semantic Evidence for Large Language Model Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to select the most suitable model for each incoming query. Most existing routers learn this decision directly from query embeddings, model representations, preference data, or clusters of similar examples. Such approaches can be effective, yet the representation used for routing rarely states what a query actually requires. We introduce SeLMRoute, a routing framework that separates the extraction of candidate-independent semantic evidence from the learning of candidate performance and the application of deployment objectives. A decision model first evaluates a set of interpretable questions about the query, such as its reasoning requirements and use of external knowledge, with each judgment retained as a probability distribution. The resulting probabilistic semantic state is used by a lightweight supervised router to estimate candidate model performance. Routing objectives are applied after performance estimation, which allows the same semantic state to support performance-oriented and cost-aware decisions. On the LLMRouterBench (15 datasets, 20 candidate models, 11,481 queries), SeLMRoute achieves an average accuracy of $72.08\% \pm 0.45$, while grouped five-fold out-of-fold evaluation reaches $72.64\%$, compared with $69.23\%$ for the strongest fixed candidate. The representation achieves the highest mean performance among the evaluated semantic, dense, lexical, and domain-level representations. In a separate 13-model performance-cost setting, SeLMRoute improves performance in all five grouped splits, with a mean PerfGain of $2.66\%$. Our code is available at https://github.com/Indigma-Innovations/SeLMRoute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SeLMRoute，一种将"候选无关的语义证据提取"与"候选性能学习及部署目标应用"解耦的 LLM 路由框架，通过可解释问题的概率化语义状态实现性能导向与成本感知路由。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 路由器多直接从查询嵌入、模型表示、偏好数据或相似样例聚类中学习路由决策，但其所用表示很少显式刻画查询"真正需要什么"，导致表示与查询需求之间缺乏语义对齐。
AI.method: SeLMRoute 分三步：(1) 决策模型对查询回答一组可解释问题（如推理需求、是否依赖外部知识），每个判断保留为概率分布，构成与候选模型无关的概率语义状态；(2) 轻量级监督路由器基于该语义状态估计各候选模型的性能；(3) 在性能估计之后施加路由目标，使同一语义状态可同时支持性能导向与成本感知决策。
AI.result: 在 LLMRouterBench（15 个数据集、20 个候选模型、11,481 条查询）上，SeLMRoute 平均准确率为 72.08%±0.45，分组五折 out-of-fold 评估达 72.64%，优于最强固定候选模型的 69.23%；其表示在语义、稠密、词法、领域级表示中平均性能最高。在另一组 13 模型性能-成本设置中，五个分组划分性能均提升，平均 PerfGain 为 2.66%。
AI.conclusion: 显式、候选无关的概率语义表示可作为通用路由中间层，优于依赖隐式嵌入或偏好数据的表示，并便于在估计后灵活叠加成本等部署目标。

title: Beyond Token Alignment: Event Completion for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers knowledge between language models through teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. With different tokenizers, a single teacher token may require multiple student tokens to generate, creating intermediate states where the event is entered but not yet completed. Existing cross-tokenizer methods align tokens or text spans to construct comparable prediction targets. We study a complementary problem after partial generation: once the student produces a prefix of a teacher token, multiple next tokens may complete the same remaining bytes, but the teacher only specifies the required completion rather than how probability should be divided among these valid continuations. We introduce Event-Set Completion Distillation (ESCD), which complements cross-tokenizer probability alignment with completion-set supervision. ESCD aggregates prefix-related teacher events and supervises the total probability of byte-compatible one-step student completions, avoiding tokenizer-dependent probability splits among individual tokens. The method reuses student trajectories and predictions, requiring neither additional rollouts nor changes to the student vocabulary. Experiments demonstrate consistent gains in mathematics, code, and scientific reasoning across model families and tokenizers, extending to large-scale MoE distillation from a 1T teacher to a 35B student. Local analyses show that retaining completion sets better matches the reference supervision, while one-step completion covers over 99% of observed compatible teacher mass after partial event entry in the studied tokenizer pairs. These findings support event entry and event completion as complementary supervision targets for cross-tokenizer knowledge transfer. Code will be released on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出 Event-Set Completion Distillation (ESCD)，在跨分词器 on-policy 蒸馏中利用完成集监督，补足概率对齐，无需额外 rollout 或改词表，在多任务与大规模 MoE 蒸馏上稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 跨分词器 OPD 中，单个教师 token 可能需多个学生 token 生成。当学生已生成教师 token 的前缀（事件已进入但未完成）时，多个下一 token 都能补全剩余字节，而教师只规定需要完成的字节，未说明这些合法续写之间如何分配概率。现有工作聚焦 token/文本片段对齐以构造可比预测目标，未解决这一“部分生成后”的互补问题。
AI.method: ESCD 在与跨分词器概率对齐互补的层面引入完成集监督：聚合与前缀相关的教师事件，对学生所有字节兼容的一步完成项的总概率进行监督，避免在单个 token 上做分词器依赖的概率切分。方法复用学生的轨迹与预测，既不需额外 rollout，也不改动学生词表。
AI.result: 在数学、代码与科学推理任务上，跨模型族与不同分词器均取得一致提升；并扩展到 1T 教师到 35B 学生的大规模 MoE 蒸馏。局部分析表明：保留完成集更贴近参考监督；在所研究的分词器对中，一步完成覆盖了事件部分进入后观察到的兼容教师质量 99% 以上。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将“事件进入”与“事件完成”视为跨分词器知识迁移中互补的监督目标。

title: Do Emotion Concepts Generalize Across Sources, Modalities, and Architectures in Vision-Language Models?
summary: Recent studies suggest that large language models encode emotion concepts as structured internal representations, but most existing work focuses on text and a single architecture. Therefore, we ask, do emotion concepts generalize across sources, modalities, and architectures in vision--language models (VLMs)? To address this, we construct CMES (Cross-Modal Emotion Stimuli), a multi-source collection of emotion-conditioned stories, real facial expressions, synthetic portraits, and synthetic emotion-evoking scenes. For each stimulus source, we extract a separate set of six Ekman emotion vectors from each of three VLMs. We report four main findings as follows: 1) Image-derived emotion vectors form a low-dimensional geometry similar to that of text-derived vectors. Valence is relatively stable across sources, while arousal varies more. 2) Text- and image-derived emotion vectors have modest cosine similarity but still show held-out cross-modal correspondence. Text-derived vectors can also steer image interpretation. 3) Cross-architecture correspondence remains even when native cosine is near zero. Transformations estimated from generic ImageNet activations recover both correspondence and causal transfer without using the six emotion vectors or their labels. 4) After aligning representations across architectures, we construct a shared emotion subspace that preserves affective geometry and selective steering effects. The corresponding consensus emotion vectors also generalize to a held-out fourth architecture at two model sizes. These results suggest that emotion representations can share relational structure and causal effects across sources, modalities, and architectures, even when individual vector directions differ.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建CMES多源情感刺激集，在三个视觉-语言模型中抽取六类Ekman情感向量，发现情感表征在来源、模态和架构间具有共享的关系结构与因果效应，即使个体向量方向不同。
AI.motivation: 现有关于大语言模型情感概念表征的研究多集中于文本和单一架构，尚不清楚情感概念能否在来源、模态与架构间泛化，尤其缺乏对视觉-语言模型（VLM）的跨模态、跨架构系统性检验。
AI.method: 构建CMES（Cross-Modal Emotion Stimuli），包含情感条件故事（文本）、真实面部表情、合成肖像、合成情绪诱发场景四类刺激源；对每个刺激源，从三个VLM中分别提取六个Ekman情感向量；通过余弦相似度、跨模态对应、表示引导（steering）、基于ImageNet激活的变换估计以及跨架构对齐构建共享情感子空间，并在第四个模型的两种规模上验证。
AI.result: 1）图像导出的情感向量与文本向量具有相似的低维几何结构，效价在各来源间较稳定而唤醒度波动更大；2）文本与图像情感向量余弦相似度中等，但存在留出集上的跨模态对应，文本向量可引导图像解释；3）即使原生余弦相似度接近零，跨架构对应仍存在，且由通用ImageNet激活估计的变换可在不使用情感向量及标签的情况下恢复对应关系与因果迁移；4）跨架构对齐后构建的共享情感子空间保留情感几何与选择性引导效应，共识情感向量可泛化到留出的第四架构及两种模型规模。
AI.conclusion: 情感表征在来源、模态和架构间可共享关系结构与因果效应，即使个体向量方向存在差异；这支持情感概念在VLM中具有跨模态、跨架构的某种普遍性组织。

title: Optimizing and Securing the Modern Watermarking Channel for Images
summary: To comply with recent regulations requiring traceable generated content, modern watermarking has adopted multi-bit post-hoc watermarking schemes. These modern designs rest on an encoder-decoder pair implemented as deep neural networks. These models are usually treated as pure black-boxes trained end-to-end, with the noise of the watermarking channel modeled through a fixed set of geometric and valuemetric transforms applied to watermarked images. We argue that this purely empirical approach leads to unquestioned design flaws and a lack of theoretical performance guarantees. This work proposes a general theoretical model of modern post-hoc watermarking schemes grounded in a statistical analysis of the outputs of the encoder/decoder pair. We show that these deep neural networks implicitly define a watermarking channel modeled as parallel AWGN channels, with messages transmitted using BPSK modulation. This imposes a binary alphabet, greatly limiting the capacity of these watermarking systems. Another fatal flaw is their lack of a secret key, making them intrinsically insecure. We make this notion of watermarking security precise for post-hoc schemes by linking it to the possibility of estimating the secret key under a given statistical model of the decoder's output. By putting together the results from this theoretical analysis, we introduce SNW: a novel post-hoc watermarking system that significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines in terms of capacity while also providing strong security guarantees. Notably, it does not depend on a fixed codebook or binary alphabet, allowing it to reach a rate close to Shannon capacity through the use of capacity-achieving error-correcting codes.

AI.tldr: 该论文从统计角度对现代后验水印方案进行理论建模，揭示其隐式等价于BPSK调制的并行AWGN信道、容量受限且缺乏密钥安全性，并据此提出兼具高容量与强安全性的SNW系统。
AI.motivation: 现代多比特后验水印依赖端到端训练的深度神经网络编解码器，通常被当作纯黑箱处理，水印信道仅用固定的几何与值度量变换集合来建模。这种纯经验方法导致设计缺陷未被质疑，且缺乏理论性能保证。
AI.method: 作者对编解码器输出进行统计分析，建立后验水印的通用理论模型；证明该深度网络隐式定义了一个由并行AWGN信道构成、以BPSK调制传输消息的水印信道；并将后验方案的安全性精确定义为在给定解码器输出统计模型下密钥被估计的可能性。
AI.result: 理论分析指出两个致命缺陷：一是BPSK强制的二元字母表极大限制了系统容量；二是缺乏秘密密钥导致其本质不安全。由此提出的SNW系统在容量上显著优于现有最先进基线，同时提供强安全保证，且不依赖固定码本或二元字母表，借助容量可达的纠错码使速率接近香农容量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为现代后验水印提供了理论基础与安全性定义，证明SNW可在容量和安全性两方面同时超越现有方案，突破了传统黑箱设计范式的局限。

title: CoDrive: Cross-Vehicle World-Consistent Video Generation with Precise Trajectory Control for Cooperative Driving
summary: Real-world driving is inherently multi-agent, yet most existing driving world models generate observations from a single ego vehicle. Independently extending them to multiple vehicles does not ensure that different agents observe a consistent shared world. We present CoDrive, a cross-vehicle, multi-view driving video generation framework that jointly generates observations of vehicles sharing the same dynamic scene with precise camera-trajectory control. CoDrive interleaves local self-attention, which models spatiotemporal dependencies among the views of each vehicle, with global self-attention, which enables information exchange and consistency modeling across vehicles. To explicitly encode their spatial relationships, all camera trajectories are represented in a shared world coordinate system and injected into the attention layers through projective relative positional encoding. We further adopt a progressive mixed-task training strategy that combines large-scale real-world single-agent data with synthetic cross-agent interaction data, allowing the model to benefit from real-world appearance distributions while learning cross-agent consistency from simulation. For systematic evaluation, we introduce CoDrive-Bench, a benchmark covering real and synthetic multi-vehicle scenarios and evaluating trajectory controllability, scene geometry consistency, and instance-level consistency. Experiments show that CoDrive improves trajectory controllability and cross-agent geometric and instance consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出CoDrive，一个跨车辆多视角驾驶视频生成框架，联合生成共享动态场景中多车的观测，并支持精确相机轨迹控制。
AI.motivation: 现实驾驶本质是多智能体的，但现有驾驶世界模型多从单一自车视角生成观测；简单地将其扩展到多车并不能保证不同智能体观测到一致的共享世界。因此需要一种能跨车辆建模一致性且精确可控的生成框架。
AI.method: CoDrive交替使用局部自注意力（建模各车视角内的时空依赖）与全局自注意力（实现跨车辆信息交换与一致性建模）；将全部相机轨迹表示在共享世界坐标系中，并通过投影相对位置编码注入注意力层；采用渐进式混合任务训练策略，结合大规模真实单智能体数据与合成跨智能体交互数据。
AI.result: 在轨迹可控性、跨智能体几何一致性与实例级一致性上均有提升，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量；并提出覆盖真实与合成多车场景的基准CoDrive-Bench，用于评估轨迹可控性、场景几何一致性与实例级一致性。
AI.conclusion: CoDrive通过跨车辆注意力与共享世界坐标系的轨迹编码，实现了多车多视角一致的世界生成，并借助混合训练兼顾真实外观分布与仿真中的跨智能体一致性，为多智能体驾驶世界模型提供了系统性评估基准。

title: A Unifying Framework of Concept-based Explainable AI with Completeness Guarantees
summary: Concept-based explanations describe neural network predictions through human-understandable properties of inputs called concepts. The field encompasses approaches that differ in how they define and represent concepts and connect them to model predictions. We introduce a theoretical framework that describes these approaches in a common mathematical language and supports a shared analysis of their properties. For concept discovery, which identifies concepts automatically within a latent space of a trained model, we employ a concept autoencoder view. An encoder extracts concept representations from the model's latent space, and a decoder uses them to reconstruct the original latent representation. The autoencoder's reconstruction error measures how accurately its decoder recovers the original latent representation. We revisit model completeness: how well the concepts can reproduce the model's outputs. We show that model incompleteness of the concepts can be bounded by the autoencoder's reconstruction error. The autoencoder view also provides a common way to define individual concept attributions, which measure each concept's contribution to a prediction. We establish when these attributions sum to the model's prediction, and bound the discrepancy otherwise, thus providing attribution completeness guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一的理论框架，将概念解释方法用共同数学语言表述；采用概念自编码器视角定义概念发现，证明模型不完整性可由重构误差界定，并给出概念归因的完备性保证。
AI.motivation: 概念解释领域方法众多，在概念的定义、表示及与模型预测的连接方式上差异较大，缺乏统一的理论语言与共享的性质分析工具。
AI.method: 引入统一理论框架，以共同数学语言刻画概念解释方法；针对在训练模型隐空间中自动识别概念的概念发现，采用概念自编码器视角：编码器从模型隐空间提取概念表示，解码器据此重构原始隐表示，并以重构误差度量解码器恢复原始隐表示的准确程度。
AI.result: 表明概念的模型不完整性可由自编码器的重构误差界定；自编码器视角还提供定义个体概念归因的共同方式，用于度量每个概念对预测的贡献，并确立这些归因之和等于模型预测的条件，在条件不满足时界定其偏差。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为概念解释方法提供了共享的分析语言，将模型完备性与重构误差、归因完备性与归因和预测的偏差联系起来，给出相应的理论保证。

title: Draft-KV: Learning Useful Latent Communication Between Language Models
comment: 41 pages, 7 figures, 13 tables. Code: https://github.com/Svardfox/Draft-KV; Corrected an erroneous conference-publication header left by the LaTeX template; scientific content unchanged
summary: Latent communication passes internal states between language models instead of decoded text, but higher receiver accuracy does not show that the receiver used the message content. Across five method-dataset pairs, replacing each message with one from an unrelated question changes accuracy by at most 0.60 points, even when communication adds 15.44 points over the receiver alone. Thus the interface can supply the gain while making the sharer dispensable. Draft-KV instead sends the key-value states formed while the sharer drafts an answer to the current question. Linear projections place these states in a side memory read through a gated attention branch, and progressive training moves from message reconstruction to answer supervision under a guard on harm from mismatched messages. Both models remain frozen and the interface trains 1.05M parameters, 348x fewer than C2C. With a Qwen3-8B sharer, a frozen Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct receiver reaches 78.04% on MMLU-Redux, versus 37.45% alone and 36.40% with reassigned messages. At fixed interface size, scaling the sharer from 0.6B to 8B raises accuracy from 46.11% to 78.04%; communication also transfers to held-out tasks and can exceed both models when each holds different evidence.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出潜在通信中接收器精度提升并不能证明其利用了消息内容，并提出 Draft-KV 方法，将共享模型草拟答案时形成的 KV 状态经线性投影和门控注意力注入冻结接收器的侧记忆，仅训练 1.05M 参数即在 MMLU-Redux 上显著提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 潜在通信以内部状态替代解码文本在语言模型间传递信息，但已有评测中接收器精度的提升可能来自接口本身而非消息内容：将消息替换为无关问题的消息后精度几乎不变，说明共享者实际可被替代，因此需要一个能真正让接收器依赖共享信息的通信方案。
AI.method: 提出 Draft-KV：共享模型在针对当前问题草拟答案过程中生成的 key-value 状态被作为消息，通过线性投影写入接收器的侧记忆，并经由门控注意力分支读取；训练采用渐进策略，从消息重建过渡到答案监督，并加入错配消息危害的防护约束。两个模型均冻结，仅训练接口的 1.05M 参数。
AI.result: 在五个方法-数据集组合中，用无关问题的消息替换原消息造成的精度变化不超过 0.60 分，即便通信相比接收器单独表现带来 15.44 分增益，说明原有接口增益可能不依赖消息内容。Draft-KV 在 Qwen3-8B 共享者与冻结 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 接收器组合下达到 MMLU-Redux 78.04%，接收器单独为 37.45%，使用重分配消息为 36.40%；接口参数量 1.05M，比 C2C 少 348 倍。固定接口规模下，共享者从 0.6B 扩展到 8B 使精度从 46.11% 提升至 78.04%；通信还可迁移到留出任务，并在两模型各自掌握不同证据时超过任一单独模型。
AI.conclusion: 接收器精度提升不足以证明潜在通信有效利用消息内容；Draft-KV 通过传递草拟过程中的 KV 状态并配合门控侧记忆与渐进训练，以极少可训练参数实现显著且可迁移的通信增益，并支持不同规模共享者与异质证据场景。

title: PanoVLN: Towards Effective Panoramic Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced vision-and-language navigation (VLN), enabling models to predict navigation actions from visual observations and language instructions. In this work, we explore VLN with panoramic observations and introduce PanoVLN. The motivation is straightforward: more complete visual context should enable better-informed navigation decisions. For example, a panorama can reveal a passage outside a perspective camera's field of view, allowing the model to identify the intended route without additional exploration. However, we find that simply replacing perspective images with panoramas yields only limited gains. Our diagnosis suggests that fully exploiting wider visibility requires modifications to action prediction, training supervision, and visual representation. First, wider visibility supports longer-horizon action planning. We make the model predict longer action sequences, enabling larger turns and subsequent movement from a single panorama. Specifically, we introduce a confidence-guided execution (CGE) strategy that dynamically determines how many predicted actions to execute before replanning. Second, wider visibility also brings more complex route choices. We therefore construct training routes with frequent branching points and clear instructions to provide targeted supervision for route selection. Third, panoramic navigation requires understanding spatial relationships across viewing directions, beyond recognizing individual landmarks. We combine semantic and geometric features from RGB panoramas to capture both scene content and spatial layout without adding visual tokens. With a 4B backbone and RGB-only input, PanoVLN surpasses the previous SOTA by 11.9% and 8.7% in success rate on R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val-Unseen. Real-world experiments on a quadruped further demonstrate faster navigation with fewer pauses than prior VLN methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PanoVLN，面向全景观测的视觉语言导航（VLN）框架。通过置信度引导执行（CGE）、频繁分支训练路由构建，以及融合 RGB 全景语义与几何特征，在仅用 4B 骨干和 RGB 输入的条件下，R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE Val-Unseen 成功率分别超越此前 SOTA 11.9% 和 8.7%，并在四足机器人真实实验中实现更快、停顿更少的导航。
AI.motivation: 动机直观：全景观测提供比透视相机更完整的视觉上下文，可揭示视野外通道，帮助模型无需额外探索即识别目标路线，从而做出更明智的导航决策。但作者发现，简单将透视图像替换为全景图像收益有限，需针对动作预测、训练监督与视觉表征三方面进行改造才能充分发挥宽视野优势。
AI.method: 方法包含三项设计：1）动作预测上，让模型预测更长动作序列，并引入置信度引导执行（CGE）策略，动态决定重新规划前执行多少预测动作，支持大角度转向与后续移动；2）训练监督上，构建含频繁分支点且指令清晰的训练路由，为路线选择提供针对性监督；3）视觉表征上，融合 RGB 全景的语义与几何特征，在不增加视觉 token 的情况下同时捕获场景内容与空间布局。
AI.result: 在 4B 骨干、仅 RGB 输入条件下，PanoVLN 在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE Val-Unseen 上的成功率分别超越此前 SOTA 11.9% 和 8.7%。四足机器人真实世界实验表明，相比既有 VLN 方法，导航更快且停顿更少。
AI.conclusion: 全景观测对 VLN 的价值并非自动显现，需在动作预测、训练监督与视觉表征上协同设计。PanoVLN 验证了以较小模型与 RGB 输入实现全景导航的可行性与有效性，并在真实机器人上展现出实用优势。

title: Beyond Reconstruction Loss in Post-Training Quantization: Balanced Fitting for Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of large vision-language models (LVLMs), but is typically calibrated on a small set while expected to generalize across diverse downstream tasks. Although recent PTQ methods for LVLMs incorporate sensitivity signals, they still minimize reconstruction loss with respect to the full-precision model, potentially over-preserving FP behavior and calibration-specific bias. Rather than treating quantization solely as an error to be minimized, we observe that it can also provide beneficial regularization for certain layers and modalities. Motivated by this observation, we propose Balanced Fitting, a quantization effect-based framework that balances precision and regularization beyond reconstruction-based optimization. By measuring layer- and component-wise quantization effects for weights, vision activations, and text activations, Balanced Fitting combines fine-grained fitting for sensitive components with coarser fitting to exploit potential regularization benefits.
