Experiments on multiple LVLMs show that our method consistently outperforms prior PTQ approaches under both weight-only and weight-activation quantization, while lower reconstruction loss does not reliably translate into better downstream performance. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/kmc3661/BFQ

AI.tldr: 提出Balanced Fitting（BFQ），一种基于量化效应的后训练量化框架，通过平衡精度保持与正则化收益，在多种LVLM上优于现有PTQ方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM的PTQ方法通常仅在小规模校准集上校准，却需泛化到多样下游任务；它们引入敏感度信号但仍以相对于全精度模型的重建损失最小化为目标，可能过度保留FP行为与校准特定的偏差。作者发现量化对某些层和模态还能带来有益的正则化效果，因此希望超越单纯的重建式优化。
AI.method: 提出Balanced Fitting框架，基于量化效应进行优化：分别度量权重、视觉激活和文本激活在层级别与组件级别的量化效应，对敏感组件采用细粒度拟合，对其他组件采用较粗粒度拟合以利用潜在正则化收益，从而在精度与正则化之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在多个LVLM上的实验表明，该方法在仅权重量化与权重-激活量化两种设置下均持续优于先前PTQ方法；同时发现更低的重建损失并不能可靠地转化为更好的下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 量化不应仅被视为需要最小化的误差，也可为部分层与模态提供正则化收益；以量化效应为驱动的平衡拟合框架能更有效地提升LVLM的PTQ下游性能。源码已公开。

title: VehicleArena: A Realistic Urban Environment for Multi-Agent Driving
summary: Real-world embodied agents often pursue independent objectives within a shared physical environment, where their actions can alter the conditions faced by others. Existing benchmarks, however, typically assume shared goals or explicitly prescribed interaction protocols, leaving such emergent physical coupling underexplored. We introduce VehicleArena, a 3D urban-driving benchmark for studying independently operating agents in a dynamic shared world. In VehicleArena, LLM-controlled agents must fulfill evolving passenger requests while navigating complex traffic, and each agent's driving decisions can reshape traffic flow, delays, risks, and subsequent observations for surrounding agents. The benchmark provides 112 evaluation tasks spanning single-agent and multi-agent driving. Across nine evaluated models, the highest arrival rates reach only 65.0% on single-agent tasks and 65.6% on multi-agent tasks, while strong passenger-request or cabin scores do not reliably translate into successful trip completion. Moreover, in matched multi-agent runs, every tested focal policy reduces the arrival rate of surrounding vehicles relative to the simulator's native traffic controller, revealing measurable externalities beyond the focal vehicle itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VehicleArena——一个用于研究共享动态世界中独立运作智能体的3D城市驾驶基准。基于LLM控制的智能体需在复杂交通中完成不断变化的乘客请求，同时其驾驶决策会影响周围智能体的交通流、延迟、风险与观测。基准包含112个单/多智能体任务，9个模型最高到达率仅65.0%与65.6%，且强乘客请求或座舱得分并不能可靠转化为成功行程；多智能体匹配实验中，各被测策略均降低了周边车辆的到达率，揭示出可测量的外部性。
AI.motivation: 现实中的具身智能体常在共享物理环境中追求各自独立目标，其行为会改变他人所处条件。但现有基准通常假设共享目标或预先设定的交互协议，导致这种"涌现式物理耦合"研究不足。
AI.method: 构建 VehicleArena 3D城市驾驶基准，支持独立运作的LLM控制智能体；智能体需在复杂交通中完成变化的乘客请求，且各自驾驶决策会重塑交通流、延迟、风险及周围智能体的后续观测；设计112个评估任务，覆盖单智能体与多智能体驾驶场景。
AI.result: 在9个被测模型中，最高到达率仅为单智能体任务65.0%、多智能体任务65.6%；较高的乘客请求或座舱得分无法可靠转化为成功行程完成。在匹配的多智能体运行中，所有被测焦点策略相对于模拟器原生交通控制器，均降低了周边车辆的到达率。
AI.conclusion: VehicleArena 揭示了独立目标智能体在共享世界中的涌现耦合与外部性，表明当前模型在行程完成度上仍有显著不足，且局部最优策略会给周围车辆带来可测量的负面影响，为多智能体具身决策研究提供了新基准。

title: Privacy-Preserving Full-Body Meshing from mmWave Radar via Mesh Foundation Model Supervision
comment: Withdrawn by the authors: the author team is still finalizing the scope and release timing of this work, and will resubmit after internal review
summary: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving human perception, but the extreme sparsity of point clouds from commercial single-chip sensors (mean ~6.5 points/frame; ~28% empty frames) has confined prior art to body-part keypoints or discrete action classification. We present a cross-modal teacher-student framework that lifts commercial radar to full-body, per-frame, metric 3D mesh reconstruction with per-joint uncertainty. Three innovations: (1) a mesh-foundation-model teacher - SAM 3D Body produces whole-body MHR ground truth (70 joints, 18,439 mesh vertices) from a single RGB frame with zero training, slashing annotation cost by orders of magnitude; (2) StudentPoseFormer - set encoding with masked attention pooling, a temporal Transformer, and a CVAE multi-hypothesis head that outputs both the pose mean and per-joint variance, honestly reporting where the radar cannot see; and (3) a multi-stage ground-truth quality pipeline (confidence gating, depth validation, temporal smoothing, bone-length consistency, bad-frame rejection) plus systematic information-lever ablations. On the public MM-Fi benchmark (same TI IWR6843 sensor, cross-subject), our full configuration reaches 7.45 cm 12-joint MPJPE, with ablations proving the causal value of point accumulation (k = 3, -0.34 cm), Doppler (-0.85 cm; -2 cm at the wrist on fast actions), and velocity loss (-0.27 cm). On our own synchronized radar + RGB-D corpus with block-level held-out splits, the pipeline achieves 21.47 cm end-to-end (per-joint hierarchy from 4.8 cm at the hip to 34.7 cm at the wrist - matching physical information limits), could be improved to 15 cm with ~30k diverse samples, and a scaling law shows sample diversity, not volume, is the binding constraint. Deployment inference is radar-only - no camera, no image.

AI.tldr: 提出跨模态师生框架，将商用单芯片毫米波雷达提升为逐帧、全身体、公制3D网格重建，并输出逐关节不确定性；在MM-Fi达7.45 cm MPJPE，自建数据集端到端21.47 cm，推理仅用雷达。
AI.motivation: 商用单芯片毫米波雷达点云极度稀疏（平均约6.5点/帧，约28%空帧），导致既有工作只能做身体部位关键点或离散动作分类，无法实现全身体、逐帧、度量化的3D网格重建；同时高质量3D人体标注成本高昂。
AI.method: 三项创新：(1) 以网格基础模型SAM 3D Body作为教师，零训练从单张RGB帧生成全身MHR真值（70关节、18,439网格顶点），大幅降低标注成本；(2) StudentPoseFormer学生网络：集合编码+掩码注意力池化、时序Transformer、CVAE多假设头，同时输出姿态均值与逐关节方差；(3) 多阶段真值质量流水线（置信度门控、深度校验、时序平滑、骨长一致性、坏帧剔除）及系统性信息杠杆消融。
AI.result: MM-Fi基准（同款TI IWR6843，跨被试）全配置达7.45 cm 12关节MPJPE；消融证明点累积（k=3，-0.34 cm）、多普勒（-0.85 cm，快速动作下手腕-2 cm）、速度损失（-0.27 cm）的因果价值。自建同步雷达+RGB-D语料（块级留出划分）端到端21.47 cm，逐关节误差从髋部4.8 cm到手腕34.7 cm，符合物理信息极限；增加约3万多样本可提升至15 cm，缩放律显示样本多样性而非数量是瓶颈。部署时仅用雷达，无需相机与图像。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次将商用稀疏雷达点云推进到全身体逐帧公制3D网格重建并给出逐关节不确定性，验证了点累积、多普勒与速度信息的关键作用；瓶颈在于样本多样性而非数据量，具备纯雷达部署的隐私保护优势。

title: LongPuzzleBench: Evaluating GUI Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Puzzles
summary: GUI agents need long-horizon visual reasoning: they must interpret a changing interface while keeping a multi-step plan viable as earlier actions constrain later ones. Existing benchmarks evaluate grounding, computer use, and game play, but rarely test whether agents stay coherent across long chains of coupled decisions. Long-horizon visual puzzles expose this capability directly: a legal move that looks like progress can make the puzzle unsolvable, and the loss shows only several moves later. We introduce LongPuzzleBench, 114 levels in six puzzle games played through native GUI actions, where one objective can take a human over a thousand actions on persistent boards and dead ends go unannounced. With Native GUI Actions alone, the strongest agents solve most objectives, but success falls sharply on harder, longer boards: seven of ten general-purpose agents solve nothing harder than Medium, and none completes Bolt Unscrew Hard, which a human solves along with every other objective. Code Execution CUA does not close this gap, and its scores mix visual solving with algorithmic search. Controlled diagnostics trace these failures to one limitation that neither rules, state hints, nor failure memory removes: agents judge each move by the visible progress it makes, not by the future options it leaves.

AI.tldr: 提出 LongPuzzleBench（6 款原生 GUI 解谜游戏、114 关），用于评测长程耦合决策下的视觉推理；发现智能体受"局部进展"启发式支配，在长关卡上成功率骤降，代码执行并不能弥补。
AI.motivation: 现有 benchmark 多评估 grounding、电脑使用、游戏操作，较少检验智能体在长链条耦合决策中能否保持规划一致性。长程视觉解谜恰好直接暴露此能力：看似前进的一步可能使局面不可解，且失败往往在数步之后才显现。
AI.method: 构建 LongPuzzleBench：114 个关卡、6 款解谜游戏，全部通过原生 GUI 动作操作，持久化棋盘，单目标可能需要人类上千次动作，且死路无提示。在此基础上评测最强智能体，并对比"仅原生 GUI 动作"与"代码执行 CUA"两种设置；进一步通过受控诊断（加入规则、状态提示、失败记忆）定位失败原因。
AI.result: 仅用原生 GUI 动作时，最强智能体可解多数目标，但在更难更长棋盘上成功率骤降：十款通用智能体中七款在 Medium 以上难度零解，且无一完成 Bolt Unscrew Hard（人类可解该关及所有目标）。代码执行 CUA 未缩小差距，其分数混合了视觉求解与算法搜索。
AI.conclusion: 失败可归因于单一局限，且规则、状态提示与失败记忆均无法消除：智能体以"当前可见进展"而非"留下的未来可选空间"来评判每一步动作，即缺乏长程耦合决策下的前瞻性评估。

title: Reference-Grounded Data Curation for Instruction-Following Thai-English Machine Translation
summary: Instruction-following machine translation (IF-MT) requires respecting prompt-level rules on terminology, formatting, and register. Rule compliance typically trades off against translation quality, a tension that general-purpose IF data augmentation methods do not address. We propose Reference-Grounded Data Curation, a two-phase pipeline that extracts every supervised constraint from a reference translation that already satisfies it, ensuring feasibility by construction. Phase 1 applies Instruction-Following Difficulty (IFD) scoring to retain the hardest-but-learnable instances from an English-Thai parallel pool. Phase 2 extracts constraints from each reference target and keeps only generations satisfying every constraint, yielding the 1.97M-record Grounded dataset. We fine-tune open-weight bases on Grounded to produce ChindaMT, a Thai-English translation family at 4B, 2B, and 0.8B parameters. Under length-controlled pairwise judging, ChindaMT outperforms or matches every same-size baseline at every tier on both plain translation and under explicit rules, reaching up to a 68.4% win rate against the strongest baseline. The recipe transfers cleanly across Qwen generations. We release model weights, the Grounded dataset, and evaluation suites.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Reference-Grounded Data Curation两阶段数据构建流程，从已满足约束的参考译文中抽取监督约束，构建197万条Grounded数据集，并训练泰英翻译模型ChindaMT（4B/2B/0.8B），在长度控制成对评测下于纯翻译和规则约束场景中均不劣于同规模基线，最强基线胜率最高达68.4%。
AI.motivation: 指令遵循机器翻译（IF-MT）要求译文满足术语、格式和语域等提示级规则，但规则遵循通常与翻译质量存在权衡。通用指令遵循数据增强方法未针对这一矛盾，且约束的可行性难以保证。
AI.method: 提出Reference-Grounded Data Curation两阶段流程：阶段一在英泰平行语料池上使用Instruction-Following Difficulty（IFD）打分，保留"最难但可学习"的实例；阶段二从每条参考译文中抽取约束，仅保留满足全部约束的生成结果，得到197万条Grounded数据集。基于该数据微调开放权重基座模型，得到ChindaMT系列（4B、2B、0.8B）。
AI.result: 在长度控制成对评测下，ChindaMT在每个规模层级上，无论是纯翻译还是显式规则约束场景，均优于或持平同规模基线，对最强基线胜率最高达68.4%。该训练配方可跨Qwen代际干净迁移。
AI.conclusion: 从参考译文反推约束可保证约束可行性，据此构建的数据能有效缓解规则遵循与翻译质量之间的权衡；该流程可扩展至不同模型规模与代际。论文开源模型权重、Grounded数据集及评测套件。

title: When Do Model Internals Help? Exploring the Role of Representation Engineering in LLM Safety
summary: Reliable AI safeguards require both control mechanisms that reduce unsafe behavior and monitoring mechanisms that detect safety risks during model interactions. Established behavioral safeguards include alignment methods that optimize model outputs and text monitors that assess interaction text. Representation engineering instead reads or modifies internal model states, but the relative strengths of these approaches remain unclear because they are often evaluated under different settings. We present a matched evaluation across two tracks. For safety control, we compare DPO, a behavioral alignment method, with three representation steering methods across robustness, practicality, and granularity. DPO provides the strongest overall control and generally improves with increasing training data, although its safety can degrade after subsequent benign fine-tuning. Representation steering remains competitive primarily in low-data settings, particularly with high-quality contrastive data. For safety monitoring, we compare representation probes with fine-tuned and open-weight text monitors across full-response detection, early detection, and computational cost. Specialized text monitors achieve the strongest overall detection accuracy, while representation probes remain competitive at substantially lower marginal cost. Finally, monitor-guided interventions recover much of the safety lost by DPO after benign fine-tuning, with little additional over-refusal. Overall, representation engineering does not generally replace behavioral safeguards, but offers practical advantages under specific conditions and can provide complementary safety benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文通过匹配评估比较了表示工程与行为式安全防护：控制方面DPO整体最优，表示引导在低数据场景有竞争力；监控方面专用文本监控器检测最强，表示探针成本更低；监控引导的干预可恢复DPO在良性微调后损失的安全性且几乎不增加过度拒答。
AI.motivation: 可靠的AI安全防护需要既能减少不安全行为的控制机制，也能在模型交互中检测安全风险的监控机制。已确立的行为防护包括对齐方法和文本监控器，而表示工程则读取或修改模型内部状态；但这些方法常在不同设置下评估，其相对优势尚不明确。因此需要一个匹配的评估来公平比较它们。
AI.method: 采用两条匹配评估路径。安全控制：在两个轨道上对比DPO（行为对齐方法）与三种表示引导方法，评估维度为鲁棒性、实用性和粒度。安全监控：对比表示探针与微调文本监控器及开放权重文本监控器，评估维度为全响应检测、早期检测和计算成本。此外还评估监控引导干预的效果。
AI.result: 控制方面，DPO提供最强整体控制，通常随训练数据增加而改善，但在后续良性微调后安全性可能下降；表示引导主要在低数据场景具竞争力，尤其在使用高质量对比数据时。监控方面，专用文本监控器整体检测准确率最强，而表示探针在边际成本显著更低时仍具竞争力。监控引导的干预可恢复DPO在良性微调后损失的大部分安全性，且几乎不增加过度拒答。
AI.conclusion: 表示工程通常不能替代行为式安全防护，但在特定条件下具有实际优势，并可提供互补的安全收益。

title: When VLMs Trust Context: Evaluating Scene Text Recognition under Misleading Context
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can read text in natural scenes, but their predictions may be influenced by the surrounding context. When the printed text conflicts with what the scene suggests, a model may return a more plausible word instead of the shown text. We introduce SceneFaith, a benchmark of 781 generated scene images for studying this behavior. Each output is classified as Literal, Canonical, or Other, separating faithful transcription from context-consistent rewriting and ordinary recognition errors. Across 15 models from seven families, all models show rewriting on clear images, with rates ranging from 8.45\% to 58.51\%. Controlled experiments further show that surrounding context matters: removing surrounding scene information reduces rewriting and improves literal accuracy, while changing the scene around the same text patch can also change model outputs. Moreover, weakening the target text with blur increases rewriting. These results show that reliable scene-text recognition requires VLMs to balance visual character evidence with contextual information, preserving clear text while using context mainly when the visual evidence is uncertain.

AI.tldr: 提出 SceneFaith 基准（781 张生成场景图），将 VLM 场景文本识别输出分为 Literal/Canonical/Other，发现 15 个模型均存在"上下文改写"行为，且改写率受场景上下文与目标文本清晰度影响。
AI.motivation: VLM 虽能读取自然场景中的文字，但其预测会受周围场景上下文影响：当印刷文本与场景暗示冲突时，模型可能输出更"合理"的词而非图中真实文字。现有研究缺乏对该现象的专门基准与系统量化。
AI.method: 构建 SceneFaith 基准：781 张生成场景图像，每张含与场景语义冲突的文本。将模型输出细分为三类：Literal（忠实转写）、Canonical（上下文一致改写）、Other（普通识别错误），从而把忠实性与一般识别错误解耦。在来自 7 个家族的 15 个模型上进行评测，并开展控制实验：移除周围场景信息、替换同一文本块周围的场景、对目标文本施加模糊处理。
AI.result: 所有模型在清晰图像上均出现改写，改写率介于 8.45% 与 58.51% 之间。控制实验表明上下文确有影响：移除周围场景信息可降低改写率、提升字面准确率；改变同一文本块周围场景会改变模型输出；对目标文本施加模糊会提高改写率。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的场景文本识别要求 VLM 在视觉字符证据与上下文信息之间取得平衡：对清晰文本应保持忠实转写，仅在视觉证据不确定时才主要借助上下文。

title: CoHuB: A Simulation Benchmark for Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
summary: Many physical tasks in human environments require collaboration, from assisting a partner to jointly manipulating an object. Yet, existing humanoid benchmarks largely focus on single-humanoid skills and lack evaluation of multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. We introduce CoHuB (Collaborative Multi-Humanoid Benchmark), a simulation benchmark for multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. CoHuB provides 10 tasks, eight with two humanoids and two with three humanoids, spanning diverse collaboration patterns. We also provide synchronized demonstrations collected through a multi-operator VR teleoperation pipeline, in which each operator controls one humanoid from its egocentric view. Experiments with representative visuomotor policies reveal substantial challenges across different forms of coordinated perception and control. CoHuB provides a foundation for developing and evaluating multi-humanoid collaboration policies.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoHuB，一个面向第一人称视角视觉观测下多机器人协作的仿真基准，包含10个任务（8个双机器人、2个三机器人），提供多操作员VR遥操作同步演示数据，并通过代表性视觉运动策略实验揭示协作感知与控制方面的显著挑战。
AI.motivation: 现实物理任务常需协作，但现有人形机器人基准多聚焦单机器人技能，缺乏对第一人称视角下多机器人协作的评估。
AI.method: 构建仿真基准 CoHuB，设计10个涵盖多样协作模式的任务（8个双机器人、2个三机器人）；采用多操作员VR遥操作流水线，每位操作员从各自第一人称视角控制一台机器人，采集同步演示数据；并测试代表性视觉运动策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，代表性视觉运动策略在不同形式的协同感知与控制上均面临显著挑战。
AI.conclusion: CoHuB 为多机器人协作策略的开发与评估提供了基础平台。

title: TQTS-Bench: A Multi-Syntax Benchmark for Text-to-Query over Time-Series Databases
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced natural language querying over relational databases, yet their ability to query time-series databases (TSDBs) remains largely unassessed. Existing benchmarks fail to adequately capture the non-unified query syntaxes, diverse application domains, and unique time-specific query intents inherent to TSDBs. To address this gap, we introduce TQTS-BENCH, a multi-syntax benchmark for evaluating text-to-query capabilities over TSDBs. TQTS-BENCH contains 6,125 high-quality question-answering (QA) pairs spanning 97 TSDBs, 23 distinct query syntaxes, 22 application domains, and 4 types of time-specific query intents. It is constructed through a human-centric AI-assisted workflow, where all QA pairs are carefully reviewed and revised by domain experts to ensure quality and correctness. Extensive evaluations of advanced LLMs and state-of-the-art text-to-query methods reveal challenges in querying TSDBs. Even the best-performing model evaluated, Claude-Opus-5, achieves only 48.98% execution accuracy, while humans reach 87.34%. Error analysis reveals that this performance gap mainly stems from the heterogeneous query syntaxes across different TSDBs, misinterpretation of time-specific intents, and incorrect schema linking. These findings highlight new opportunities to narrow the gap between current LLM capabilities and the requirements of TSDB queries in real-world applications. The benchmark is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TQTS-Bench-00CD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TQTS-BENCH，一个面向时序数据库（TSDB）text-to-query 能力的多语法基准，包含 6,125 个 QA 对，覆盖 97 个 TSDB、23 种查询语法、22 个应用领域和 4 类时间特定查询意图，由人机协作流程构建并经专家审核。评测显示最强模型 Claude-Opus-5 仅达 48.98% 执行准确率，远低于人类的 87.34%，主要受异构查询语法、时间意图误解和模式链接错误影响。
AI.motivation: LLM 在关系数据库的自然语言查询方面已取得显著进展，但其查询时序数据库（TSDB）的能力尚未被充分评估。现有基准无法充分体现 TSDB 特有的非统一查询语法、多样应用领域以及独特的时间特定查询意图，因此需要构建专门的评测基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出 TQTS-BENCH 多语法基准，用于评估 TSDB 上的 text-to-query 能力。该基准通过以人为核心、AI 辅助的工作流构建，包含 6,125 个高质量 QA 对，覆盖 97 个 TSDB、23 种不同查询语法、22 个应用领域和 4 类时间特定查询意图，所有 QA 对均由领域专家仔细审核与修订以保证质量与正确性。随后对先进 LLM 与当前最优 text-to-query 方法进行广泛评测与错误分析。
AI.result: 评测揭示 LLM 在 TSDB 查询上面临显著挑战：表现最好的 Claude-Opus-5 仅达到 48.98% 的执行准确率，而人类达到 87.34%。错误分析表明性能差距主要源于不同 TSDB 间异构的查询语法、对时间特定意图的误解以及错误的模式链接（schema linking）。
AI.conclusion: TQTS-BENCH 填补了 TSDB text-to-query 评测的空白，揭示了当前 LLM 能力与真实世界 TSDB 查询需求之间的明显差距，指出缩小该差距的新机遇。基准已开源（https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TQTS-Bench-00CD）。

title: Projective Normal Fields: A Convex Optimization Method for Constructing Smooth UDFs
summary: Constructing a smooth approximation of an unsigned distance field (UDF) from a raw point cloud is challenging because the input provides neither surface connectivity nor consistently oriented normals. Methods that directly learn a scalar UDF must also handle its non-differentiability on the zero level set and weak supervision away from the samples, which can lead to unstable optimization and spatial artifacts. We introduce Projective Normal Fields (PNFs), an orientation-free representation and convex optimization framework for estimating bidirectional normals from point positions alone. Each normal axis is encoded by a rank-one projector, which is invariant to normal reversal. We relax the non-convex set of hard projectors to its convex hull: the symmetric positive-semidefinite matrices with unit trace. Each soft tensor defines a local quadratic distance model and retains the relative weights of candidate normal axes. We estimate a coherent PNF by combining local tangent-plane fitting, soft-PCA anchoring, and overlap regularization on a fixed neighborhood graph. With positive anchoring weights, the objective is strongly convex and admits a unique global minimizer. Principal eigenvectors provide bidirectional normals, while the corresponding eigengaps provide spectral confidence indicators. We use these indicators to select and weight directional sources for heat diffusion, followed by Poisson integration to construct a regularized UDF approximation. By separating local geometry estimation from scalar-field construction, PNF avoids directly fitting the non-differentiable UDF. Experiments demonstrate reduced sensitivity to neighborhood size, competitive reconstruction under noise and outliers, and improved accuracy near non-manifold junctions. The project page is available at https://anonymous17777367.github.io/PNF-page/

AI.tldr: 提出 Projective Normal Fields (PNF)，一种无需定向的法向估计与凸优化框架，通过秩一投影子的凸松弛从纯点位置估计双向法向，并据此构建正则化 UDF 近似。
AI.motivation: 从原始点云构建光滑的无符号距离场 (UDF) 很困难：输入既无表面连通性也无一致定向法向；直接学习标量 UDF 需处理零水平集上的不可微性以及远离样本处的弱监督，易导致优化不稳定和空间伪影。
AI.method: 用秩一投影子编码每条法向轴，其对法向反转不变；将硬投影子的非凸集合松弛为凸包，即单位迹的对称半正定矩阵。每个软张量定义局部二次距离模型并保留候选法向轴的相对权重。结合局部切平面拟合、软 PCA 锚定和固定邻域图上的重叠正则化估计相干 PNF；在正锚定权重下目标函数强凸且具唯一全局最优。主特征向量给出双向法向，特征间隙给出谱置信度指标，据此选择并加权方向源用于热扩散，再做泊松积分得到正则化 UDF 近似。
AI.result: 实验表明：对邻域尺寸的敏感性降低，在噪声与离群点下重建具竞争力，在非流形交汇处精度提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将局部几何估计与标量场构建分离，PNF 避免直接拟合不可微 UDF，为无定向点云的法向估计与 UDF 构造提供了凸优化且稳定的方案。

title: D$^2$-VLA: Dual-Memory Dual-Frequency Vision-Language-Action Model For Long Dynamic Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to remember cues that are no longer in view while responding to moving objects. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies often rely on the latest observation, and refreshing their visual context typically requires another costly vision-language model (VLM) pass. We present D$^2$-VLA, which combines dual memory and dual-frequency control at the KV-cache interface of a pretrained VLA. D$^2$-VLA uses block-wise causal KV caching to encode observations incrementally and, guided by distinct temporal attention patterns, constructs separate historical KV read views for the VLM and action expert. Between periodic VLM updates, a gated adapter incorporates fresh visual features into the latest history-conditioned KV block, while a short fast-memory queue supports action replanning. We introduce DOMINO-Long, a ten-task benchmark requiring robots to use earlier visual cues when manipulating moving objects. D$^2$-VLA achieves complete-task success rates of 29.3\% on DOMINO, compared with 9.6\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 17.2\% for PUMA, and 60.0\% on DOMINO-Long, compared with 35.4\% and 20.6\%, respectively. It improves success rates on eight real-robot tasks and reaches 97.5\% on LIBERO-Long and 74.3\% on RoboTwin 2.0.

AI.tldr: D$^2$-VLA 提出双记忆与双频控制机制，在预训练 VLA 的 KV-cache 接口上实现增量编码与历史感知，显著提升长时程操作与动态物体任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 长时程操作要求机器人在动态响应移动物体的同时，记住已不在视野内的线索。现有 VLA 策略通常只依赖最新观测，而刷新视觉上下文往往需要额外、高成本的 VLM 推理，难以兼顾历史记忆与实时响应。
AI.method: 方法基于预训练 VLA 的 KV-cache 接口，采用分块因果 KV 缓存增量编码观测；依据不同时间注意力模式，为 VLM 与动作专家构建独立的历史 KV 读取视图。在周期性 VLM 更新之间，通过门控适配器将新视觉特征注入最新的历史条件 KV 块，并以短时快记忆队列支持动作重规划。同时构建 DOMINO-Long 基准（十项任务）用于评估机器人利用早期视觉线索操作移动物体的能力。
AI.result: 在 DOMINO 上完整任务成功率达 29.3%，优于 $π_{0.5}$ 的 9.6% 与 PUMA 的 17.2%；在 DOMINO-Long 上达 60.0%，对比 35.4% 与 20.6%。在八项真实机器人任务上成功率提升，LIBERO-Long 达 97.5%，RoboTwin 2.0 达 74.3%。
AI.conclusion: 通过 KV-cache 层面的双记忆与双频控制，D$^2$-VLA 有效缓解了 VLA 策略对最新观测的依赖，在长时程动态操作及真实机器人任务上取得一致的性能提升，验证了该设计的有效性。

title: Physics-Guided Spectral Distillation for Underwater Image Enhancement on Resource-Constrained Devices
summary: Underwater image enhancement is crucial for improving visual perception in marine applications. Existing underwater image enhancement studies mainly focus on enhancement quality and visual fidelity, while rarely considering real-time deployment capability, which is essential for resource-constrained underwater robots. To this end, we introduce a physics-guided spectral distillation (PSD) method, which reduces model capacity for real-time applications while maintaining the high performance of underwater image enhancement models. To decompose the outputs of teacher and student models, PSD adopts a multilevel Haar discrete wavelet transform. It transfers low-frequency color and illumination information as well as high-frequency structural details through band-specific objectives. Moreover, the distillation process of PSD is degradation-aware. We estimate degradation-aware weights through a physical head and combine them with ground-truth-guided reliability masks to selectively retain valuable teacher guidance. Experiments on the UIEB, LSUI, and EUVP datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Furthermore, we demonstrate the benefits of enhanced images for downstream perception tasks, including object detection. Deployment on a self-developed ROV further demonstrates its practical applicability in real-world underwater scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理引导的光谱蒸馏（PSD）方法，用于水下图像增强的实时部署，通过多层Haar小波分解与退化感知权重转移教师模型的低频颜色/光照和高频结构信息，在UIEB、LSUI、EUVP数据集上验证有效性，并展示对下游检测任务及ROV实际部署的增益。
AI.motivation: 现有水下图像增强研究主要关注增强质量和视觉保真度，很少考虑资源受限水下机器人所必需的实时部署能力。因此需要一种在保持高性能的同时压缩模型容量的方法。
AI.method: 采用物理引导的光谱蒸馏（PSD）：使用多层Haar离散小波变换分解教师与学生模型的输出，通过频带特定的目标分别迁移低频颜色与光照信息和高频结构细节；蒸馏过程具有退化感知能力，通过物理头估计退化感知权重，并结合真值引导的可靠性掩码选择性保留有价值的教师指导。
AI.result: 在UIEB、LSUI和EUVP数据集上的实验验证了方法的有效性；增强图像对下游感知任务（如目标检测）有增益；在自研ROV上的部署进一步证明了在真实水下场景中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: PSD在降低模型容量的同时保持水下图像增强性能，兼顾实时部署需求，并能提升下游任务表现，具备真实水下场景的实用价值。

title: InfiMed2: A Generalist Medical Multimodal Foundation Model from Contextual Evidence and Stability-Aware Supervision
summary: Recent medical multimodal models have benefited from larger corpora, broader modality coverage, and stronger reasoning-oriented training, yet effective data design across continued pretraining (CPT) and post-training remains challenging. Medical sources vary substantially in structure, granularity, and information density, and their utility shifts as training progresses from broad knowledge acquisition to late-stage consolidation. Meanwhile, post-training is often dominated by short-form visual question answering, providing limited supervision for informative and answer-consistent explanations. We introduce InfiMed2, a family of 4B and 27B generalist medical multimodal foundation models built around stage-aware data design. We curate a 55.68B-token corpus that combines broad clinical knowledge with context-rich biomedical visual evidence through source-specific processing. Our CPT pipeline first adapts the vision encoder, then builds broad medical knowledge, and finally transitions to an evidence-focused data mixture during learning-rate decay. For supervised fine-tuning (SFT), we regenerate visual question-answering responses using answer stability, answer-masked reconstruction, and correctness-constrained selection to produce more informative and answer-consistent supervision. The 4B model is further optimized with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Across five medical multimodal benchmarks, InfiMed2-4B achieves 66.73% mean accuracy after RLVR, surpassing the larger Qwen3.5-9B, while InfiMed2-27B reaches 73.72%, the highest among the evaluated open-weight models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 InfiMed2 系列（4B 与 27B）通用医学多模态基础模型，核心是"阶段感知的数据设计"：构建 55.68B token 语料，并在 CPT、SFT、RLVR 各阶段采用差异化数据策略，在五个医学多模态基准上取得领先效果。
AI.motivation: 医学多模态模型虽受益于更大规模语料、更广模态覆盖和推理导向训练，但跨继续预训练（CPT）与后训练的有效数据设计仍具挑战：医学数据源在结构、粒度和信息密度上差异大，其价值随训练从"广谱知识获取"转向"后期巩固"而变化；同时后训练多被短答案视觉问答主导，缺乏对信息丰富且答案一致的解释的监督。
AI.method: 1) 数据：通过源特定处理，构建融合广谱临床知识与上下文丰富的生物医学视觉证据的 55.68B token 语料。2) CPT 三阶段流水线：先适配视觉编码器，再构建广谱医学知识，最后在学习率衰减期过渡到以证据为中心的数据混合。3) SFT：利用答案稳定性、答案掩码重构（answer-masked reconstruction）与正确性约束筛选来重生成视觉问答回复，提升监督的信息量与答案一致性。4) 对 4B 模型进一步使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。
AI.result: 在五个医学多模态基准上：InfiMed2-4B 经 RLVR 后平均准确率 66.73%，超过更大的 Qwen3.5-9B；InfiMed2-27B 达到 73.72%，为所评估开源权重模型中的最高水平。
AI.conclusion: 阶段感知的数据设计是构建通用医学多模态基础模型的有效路径，通过 CPT 分阶段数据混合、SFT 的重生成式监督以及 RLVR 的进一步优化，可在较小参数量下超越更大模型，并在开源权重模型中取得领先性能。

title: Pass or Fail? Evaluating LLMs on Two Greek Examination Benchmarks
summary: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) imposes a thorough evaluation of their linguistic and analytical capabilities as well as constraints, particularly for a language with limited benchmark coverage such as Greek. To address the limited availability of comprehensive benchmarks in this domain, we introduce Prot-Ex and Pan-Ex, two benchmarks consisting of questions from entrance exams for Greek Model and Experimental schools as well as the Panhellenic exams (the Greek national university entrance examinations). These benchmarks are employed to assess the performance of text-only LLMs-including the Greek-adapted KriKri-8B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-4-26B, and Qwen-3-32B-across diverse academic disciplines (Modern Greek, Mathematics, Physics, etc.) and task formats (closed, structured, and open-ended), including textualized visual context (i.e., image descriptions). Our findings indicate the localized KriKri-8B significantly outperforms its base model, successfully rivalling much larger LLMs in linguistically demanding humanities tasks. By leveraging an LLM-as-a-Judge methodology, we expose the inadequacy of traditional lexical metrics for evaluating complex reasoning. Crucially, we uncover a few-shot prompting paradox: while synthetic examples improve accuracy in closed-ended questions, they severely overload the context window of 8B models in structured tasks, causing significant performance degradation. Ultimately, this study suggests targeted linguistic adaptation offsets lower parameter counts in specialized domains, despite the fragility of smaller models to prompt verbosity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对希腊语基准匮乏的问题，构建了Prot-Ex与Pan-Ex两个考试类基准，评估文本LLM在多学科、多题型下的表现，揭示了希腊语适配的有效性、词汇指标的不足以及少样本提示悖论。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型发展迅速，但其语言与分析能力亟需充分评估，尤其对于希腊语这类基准覆盖有限的语言。现有研究缺乏覆盖全面的希腊语评测基准，难以系统衡量LLM在该语言下的真实能力与局限。
AI.method: 引入Prot-Ex与Pan-Ex两个基准，题目来自希腊Model与Experimental学校入学考试及Panhellenic全国大学入学考试；评估文本型LLM（含希腊语适配的KriKri-8B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-4-26B、Qwen-3-32B），覆盖多学科（现代希腊语、数学、物理等）与多任务格式（封闭式、结构化、开放式），并含文本化视觉上下文（图像描述）；采用LLM-as-a-Judge方法评估，并测试少样本提示的影响。
AI.result: 希腊语适配的KriKri-8B显著优于其基座模型，在语言要求高的人文学科任务上可与更大规模LLM抗衡；传统词汇指标难以评估复杂推理，LLM-as-a-Judge更能反映真实能力；发现少样本提示悖论：合成示例提升封闭式问题准确率，但在结构化任务中严重挤占8B模型的上下文窗口，导致性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 针对性的语言适配可弥补参数规模的不足，在专门领域形成竞争力；但小型模型对提示冗长较为脆弱。研究同时表明需采用更合理的评价方式，并谨慎使用少样本提示策略。

title: ControlTrace: Recovering Control Fields for Hidden-Content Recognition
summary: Spatially conditioned diffusion models can embed words and contours in natural-looking images, but vision-language models (VLMs) may fail to recognize the hidden content. Transformation-based recovery depends on parameter and view selection. To evaluate hidden-content recovery and recognition, we construct FreqBlind, a 6,000-image benchmark spanning contours, real words and non-words across three conditioning strengths. The evaluated transformation-based methods show limited recognition of contour patterns and weakly conditioned hidden content. To address this limitation, we propose ControlTrace to recover the grayscale control field used during generation. An 8.4M-parameter U-Net predicts this field from the carrier image, and a VLM then identifies its content. With Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, ControlTrace achieves 60.2% open-ended contour recognition accuracy across the three conditioning strengths, exceeding the best of the three evaluated prior methods by 26.9 percentage points. On an A100 GPU, the complete pipeline adds only 7.4 ms (5.3%) to direct VLM inference. Recovered fields have lower pixel errors and higher structural similarity than the evaluated transformation views. Across four evaluated VLMs, ControlTrace retains its overall contour recognition advantage. Recognition remains stable under the tested JPEG compression, Gaussian noise and downsampling. These results support control-field recovery for hidden-content recognition in the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 提出 FreqBlind 基准与 ControlTrace 方法，通过恢复生成时的灰度控制场来识别扩散模型隐藏内容，在轮廓识别上显著优于变换类方法。
AI.motivation: 空间条件扩散模型能将文字与轮廓嵌入自然图像，但 VLM 难以识别其中的隐藏内容；现有基于变换的恢复方法依赖参数与视角选择，效果有限，因此需要更好的隐藏内容恢复与识别方案。
AI.method: 构建 FreqBlind 基准（6000 张图像，涵盖轮廓、真实词与非词，三种条件强度）；提出 ControlTrace，用 8.4M 参数的 U-Net 从载体图像预测生成时使用的灰度控制场，再由 VLM 识别其内容。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 上，三种条件强度平均开放式轮廓识别准确率达 60.2%，比三种对比方法中最优者高 26.9 个百分点；A100 上完整流程仅增加 7.4 ms（5.3%）推理开销；恢复场的像素误差更低、结构相似度更高；在四种 VLM 上均保持轮廓识别优势，并在 JPEG 压缩、高斯噪声与下采样下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的设定下，控制场恢复可有效支持隐藏内容识别，ControlTrace 优于基于变换的恢复方法且开销小、鲁棒性较好。

title: From Perception to Integration: Revisiting the Internal Dynamics of Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer simple visual questions, but often struggle when one question requires several visual judgments. We study this gap with controlled tasks for feature binding, numerosity, spatial relations, and amodal completion, together with a Composite task that combines them. Matched counterfactual image pairs isolate changes in the visual evidence needed to answer. Across four models, direct answers, hidden-state readouts, and state interventions show that the individual judgments can be made without explicit reasoning and that intervening on the corresponding states can affect the answer. During reasoning, the Composite answer becomes decodable from hidden states and usable from shortened traces, often before the model stops on its own. We train a small detector to predict this readiness and stop reasoning at that point. On MMStar and RealWorldQA, this reduces mean reasoning tokens by 79.1% and 74.5%, while average accuracy rises by 3.13 and 3.30 percentage points, respectively. These findings connect the internal development of answer readiness to a practical rule for allocating reasoning computation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过特征绑定、数量、空间关系与补全等受控任务及复合任务，揭示视觉语言模型在多步视觉判断中的内部机制，并提出基于答案就绪检测的自适应推理停止规则。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型能回答简单视觉问题，但在需要多次视觉判断的复合问题上表现不佳。作者旨在探究这一能力差距的成因，理解模型内部何时具备回答复合问题的条件。
AI.method: 设计控制任务（特征绑定、数量、空间关系、补全）及复合任务，使用匹配的反事实图像对隔离视觉证据变化。对四个模型开展直接回答、隐状态读出与状态干预实验，并训练小型检测器预测答案就绪状态以提前停止推理。
AI.result: 各单项判断无需显式推理即可完成，干预相应状态可影响答案；推理过程中复合答案可从隐状态解码并可从缩短的推理轨迹中得出，常发生在模型自行停止前。在MMStar和RealWorldQA上，平均推理token分别减少79.1%和74.5%，准确率分别提升3.13和3.30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 答案就绪的内部发展过程可与实用的推理计算分配规则相连接，实现推理效率与准确率的双重提升。

title: ESTHER: Egocentric Stereo Hand Estimation and Reconstruction in the Wild
summary: Human dexterity is guided by two eyes watching two hands: binocular vision supplies the metric 3D structure that fine-grained manipulation consumes. Egocentric stereo is therefore the natural perceptual interface for robots, AR, and VR-yet metric 3D hand reconstruction from this very signal still has neither an end-to-end model nor an in-the-wild benchmark. We propose ESTHER, a model whose stereo geometry, temporal reasoning, and output representation are designed for wearable egocentric stereo. It is trained on pseudo-labels from a calibrated labeling pipeline and in turn assembles our benchmark ESTHER3D, an egocentric stereo hand dataset pairing a large in-the-wild training set of model-generated labels with a motion capture test set of true metric ground truth. Experiments show state-of-the-art accu?racy, superior external generalization, and robustness to the missing views, dropped frames, and lighting and motion blur extremes of real egocentric capture that break existing meth?ods. This robustness runs deeper than graceful degradation: stereo guidance teaches the model to bind apparent hand scale to metric depth, so it not only adapts to different stereo rigs and modalities with minimal fine-tuning, but more strikingly preserves true metric scale even after collapsing to a single monocular view.

AI.tldr: 提出ESTHER——首个面向可穿戴式第一人称立体视觉的端到端度量3D手势重建模型，并构建配套的野外基准ESTHER3D，在精度、泛化与鲁棒性上均达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 人类灵巧操作依赖双目视觉提供的度量3D结构，第一人称立体视觉是机器人、AR、VR的自然感知接口；然而基于该信号的度量3D手势重建既无端到端模型，也缺乏野外基准。
AI.method: ESTHER的立体几何、时序推理与输出表示均针对可穿戴第一人称立体视觉设计；首先利用标定好的标注流程生成伪标签进行训练，进而构建基准ESTHER3D——其训练集为模型生成的野外大规模标签，测试集为动作捕捉采集的真实度量真值。
AI.result: 实验显示达到当前最优精度、更强的外部泛化能力，并在真实第一人称采集中的缺失视角、丢帧、光照与运动模糊极端条件下保持鲁棒（这些条件常使现有方法失效）。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒性不止于优雅退化：立体引导使模型将表观手部尺度与度量深度绑定，因而仅需极少微调即可适配不同立体装置与模态；更显著的是，即便退化为单目视图，仍能保持真实度量尺度。

title: Generative Residual Factorization
summary: Under a shared-factor model, the conditional law of the next image patch factors into a posterior over the shared scene factor and a residual kernel given that factor. A sufficient statistic of the past replaces the raw past in the posterior and does not replace the kernel. The conditional entropy splits into residual entropy, which no observation of the factor can remove, and a posterior term, which a better representation of the past can remove. Next-embedding prediction is a directional likelihood on a shallow map, so the fiber of that map is unidentified and a constant embedding remains a minimizer. The same split is an equality in a scalar Gaussian model, evaluated in closed form.

AI.tldr: 在共享因子模型下将图像块的条件熵分解为"残差熵"与"后验项"，指出共享因子表示只能消除后验项，而下一嵌入预测本质是浅层映射上的方向似然，其纤维不可辨识。
AI.motivation: 厘清共享因子（scene factor）表示在生成建模中究竟能消除哪一部分不确定性，以及为何"下一嵌入预测"这类目标无法唯一确定表示。
AI.method: 在共享因子模型下，将下一图像块的条件分布分解为共享场景因子上的后验与给定因子后的残差核；用过去的充分统计量替代原始过去进入后验，但不替换残差核，从而得到条件熵的两项分解；并在标量高斯模型中给出闭式相等的验证。
AI.result: 条件熵分解为残差熵与后验项：残差熵无法被任何因子观测消除，后验项可通过更好的过去表示消除；下一嵌入预测是浅层映射上的方向似然，映射纤维不可辨识，常值嵌入仍是极小值；标量高斯模型下该分解为等式并有闭式解。
AI.conclusion: 表示学习所能压缩的仅是后验项而非残差熵；下一嵌入预测不足以确定表示，需额外约束以消除纤维歧义。

title: WM-VLM: Probing Internal World Models for Interleaved Visual-Textual Reasoning
summary: Humans often solve spatial problems by mentally simulating visual transformations. In contrast, conventional vision-language models (VLMs) reason primarily through language. We investigate whether VLMs can solve spatial problems by reasoning with both text and generated visual states. To this end, we introduce WM-VLM, which equips a pretrained VLM with a lightweight world model branch for generating intermediate visual states. Our two-stage training first teaches the model to generate the next visual state and then to use that state for reasoning. We programmatically construct spatial reasoning tasks with verifiable intermediate visual states. These tasks allow us to evaluate how well the model generates visual states and how much it relies on them to answer the question. On 2D and 3D mental rotation tasks, WM-VLM consistently outperforms the supervised fine-tuned backbone, with gains of up to 39.25 percentage points. Ablations suggest that these gains depend on the generated visual states, as removing or corrupting them sharply reduces performance. Together, these results suggest that internal world models offer a promising path toward VLMs that reason in both language and visual space.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出WM-VLM，为预训练视觉语言模型配备轻量级世界模型分支以生成中间视觉状态，从而在文本与视觉双空间中进行空间推理。
AI.motivation: 人类常通过心理模拟视觉变换来解决空间问题，而现有视觉语言模型（VLM）主要依赖语言进行推理。作者希望探究VLM能否结合文本与生成的视觉状态来求解空间问题。
AI.method: 提出WM-VLM，在预训练VLM上附加轻量级世界模型分支用于生成中间视觉状态；采用两阶段训练：先学习生成下一视觉状态，再学习利用该状态进行推理；并以程序化方式构建带有可验证中间视觉状态的空间推理任务。
AI.result: 在2D和3D心理旋转任务上，WM-VLM持续优于监督微调的基线模型，最高提升39.25个百分点；消融实验表明性能增益依赖于生成的视觉状态，移除或破坏这些状态会显著降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 内部世界模型为构建能够在语言与视觉空间中同时推理的VLM提供了有前景的路径。

title: From Weak Task Specifications to Scientific Extraction Agents: Optimizing Task Construction
summary: Most methods that optimize LLM prompts and agent workflows assume that task-specific output schemas, extraction instructions, and evaluation criteria are predefined. For scientific extraction agents, however, a short task goal may not fully determine these components, while specifying them manually is costly. We study the upstream problem of constructing the task-specific configuration from a weak specification containing only a short goal and unannotated reference documents. Rather than treating automatic construction as a fixed preprocessing step, our framework constructs a task-specific schema, extraction instructions, and base training rubrics, then keeps schema construction and extraction instructions editable during optimization. Failure-focused updates concentrate textual-gradient feedback on lower-scoring documents, while training-time evaluation criteria adapt to recurring failures. On a heterogeneous-catalysis literature corpus, automatic construction remains improvable, and optimizing both schema construction and extraction instructions performs best across all four judge-rubric settings, with ablations and blinded human evaluation supporting the proposed formulation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究从仅有简短目标与未标注参考文档的弱规范出发，自动构建科学抽取智能体的任务特定配置（输出模式、抽取指令与评测标准），并允许其在优化过程中持续可编辑，在非均相催化文献语料上取得最佳效果。
AI.motivation: 现有优化LLM提示与智能体工作流的方法通常假定任务特定的输出模式、抽取指令和评测标准已预先给定。但在科学抽取智能体中，简短任务目标难以完全确定这些组件，而人工指定代价高昂，因此需要研究其上游的自动构建问题。
AI.method: 将自动构建视为可优化的环节而非固定的预处理步骤：先构建任务特定模式、抽取指令与基础训练评分标准，并在优化过程中保持模式构建与抽取指令可编辑；采用面向失败的更新，将文本梯度反馈集中于得分较低的文档，同时让训练期评测标准随反复出现的失败进行自适应调整。
AI.result: 在非均相催化文献语料上，自动构建仍有提升空间；在全部四种评审评分标准设置下，同时优化模式构建与抽取指令表现最佳，消融实验与盲法人工评估均支持所提出的形式化方案。
AI.conclusion: 从弱规范出发自动构建并持续优化任务特定配置是可行且有效的，将模式构建与抽取指令联合优化优于固定预处理或仅优化单一组件，为科学抽取智能体的配置生成提供了新范式。

title: BV Loss: Block Verification-Aware Loss for Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
summary: Diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by proposing multiple tokens in parallel. Despite recent advances in speculative decoding through sequence-level drafting and verification, existing training objectives remain largely designed around token-level verification. To address this mismatch, we introduce Block Verification-aware loss (BV loss), a training objective designed to maximize the expected acceptance length of a drafted sequence. BV loss is directly derived from the block verification acceptance rule, providing a principled connection between the drafter training objective and the inference-time verification mechanism at the sequence level. Across math, code, and chat benchmarks, BV loss increases the mean number of tokens accepted per verification call under block verification by 13.0--21.0\% over cross-entropy loss training for DFlash and DSpark with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B without changing the inference procedure. BV loss also outperforms tokenwise acceptance objectives such as TV loss and LK loss, and its gains extend to token verification and greedy decoding. These results demonstrate the benefit of training block diffusion drafters with an objective aligned with sequence-level verification, rather than optimizing each token independently.

AI.tldr: 提出 Block Verification-aware loss (BV loss)，直接由块验证接受规则推导，使扩散 drafter 的训练目标与序列级验证机制对齐，从而显著提升每轮验证接受 token 数。
AI.motivation: 扩散 drafter 推理时一次性并行提出多个 token，并采用序列（块）级验证；但现有训练目标仍以 token 级验证为核心，训练与推理之间存在不匹配。
AI.method: BV loss 直接从块验证的接受规则推导，以最大化草稿序列的期望接受长度为训练目标，建立 drafter 训练目标与推理阶段序列级验证机制之间的原理性联系，且不改变推理流程。
AI.result: 在数学、代码与对话基准上，针对 DFlash、DSpark 及 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B，BV loss 使块验证下每次验证接受的 token 均值较交叉熵训练提升 13.0%–21.0%；同时优于 TV loss、LK loss 等 token 级接受目标，增益亦可迁移至 token 验证与贪心解码。
AI.conclusion: 用与序列级验证对齐的目标训练块扩散 drafter，优于逐 token 独立优化，验证了训练目标与验证机制一致性的价值。

title: Multi-Scale Semantic Mapping in Urban Environments via Observation Calibration and Policy Dependence Regularization
summary: Semantic mapping is fundamental to embodied navigation, yet existing methods are developed for indoor environments, where objects exhibit relatively limited scale variation and are observed from a restricted range of viewpoints. Urban environments pose substantially greater challenges: agents must map objects ranging from pedestrians to buildings while navigating large spaces with highly diverse viewing distances. These conditions introduce two key difficulties that existing datasets and methods fail to cover. First, object scale and observation distance can be severely mismatched. For example, small objects may be viewed from far away, whereas large objects may be observed at extremely close range, resulting in unreliable observation likelihoods. Second, objects with substantially different sizes and geometries require distinct mapping behaviors, which are difficult to capture with a single shared value estimator. To investigate these challenges, we introduce a large-scale urban semantic mapping dataset featuring realistic city layouts, high-fidelity rendering, and instance-level annotations spanning multiple object scales. We then propose a category-aware likelihood calibration policy that identifies and alleviates unreliable observations according to object category and viewing distance. Because the calibration and motion policies are optimized toward the same mapping objective, they may learn redundant shortcuts and become excessively coupled. We therefore introduce a mutual-information (MI) regularizer that penalizes their estimated representation dependence and encourages complementary behaviors. To better model heterogeneous mapping strategies across object scales, we further employ category-wise value estimators. We formulate their joint optimization as a Pareto optimization problem to mitigate conflicting gradients across categories.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向城市环境语义建图，发布大规模高保真城市语义建图数据集，并提出类别感知似然校准、互信息正则化与类别级价值估计器（以Pareto优化联合训练）来解决尺度失配与异构建图行为问题。
AI.motivation: 现有语义建图方法主要针对室内环境，室内目标尺度变化小、观测视角范围有限；而城市环境中目标从行人到建筑跨度极大、观测距离差异巨大。这带来两个关键困难：一是目标尺度与观测距离严重失配（小目标远距离观测、大目标极近距离观测），导致观测似然不可靠；二是尺度与几何差异大的目标需要不同的建图行为，单一共享价值估计器难以刻画。现有数据集与方法均未覆盖这些条件。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模城市语义建图数据集：真实城市布局、高保真渲染、跨多目标尺度的实例级标注。2) 提出类别感知似然校准策略，依据目标类别与观测距离识别并缓解不可靠观测。3) 由于校准策略与运动策略面向同一建图目标优化，易学到冗余捷径并过度耦合，故引入互信息（MI）正则项，惩罚二者估计表征间的依赖，鼓励互补行为。4) 采用类别级价值估计器以建模跨尺度的异构建图策略。5) 将联合优化形式化为Pareto优化问题，缓解类别间梯度冲突。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体定量结果；可确认的产出包括：一个大规模城市语义建图数据集（真实布局、高保真渲染、多尺度实例级标注），以及一套方法组件——类别感知似然校准、MI正则化、类别级价值估计器与Pareto联合优化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将语义建图研究从室内推广到城市尺度，指出尺度-距离失配与异构建图行为两大挑战；通过新数据集与“类别感知校准+互信息解耦+类别级价值估计+Pareto联合优化”的方法组合来应对，为城市具身导航语义建图提供了基准与解决思路。

title: Transform-Aligned Learned Features for Lossy Point Cloud Attribute Compression
summary: Transform-based methods provide an effective framework for point cloud attribute compression by representing attributes as transform coefficients. Introducing learned spatial context into this framework requires mapping spatial representations to the transform domain, but this known basis change is often left for the network to learn implicitly. We propose Transform-Aligned Learned Features (TALF) by applying the attribute transform to learned spatial representations, explicitly aligning them with the coding targets. Our analysis shows that the resulting features exactly represent the first-order prediction term of a smooth nonlinear model, with a bounded Taylor remainder. We integrate TALF into a transform-based attribute codec with explicit coefficient prediction and conditional residual entropy modeling under a unified coefficient-domain rate--distortion objective, while retaining explicit quantization-step control. Extensive experiments across three benchmark datasets and multiple transform bases demonstrate that TALF improves rate--distortion performance over conventional and learned baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出TALF方法，将属性变换应用于学习到的空间表示，显式对齐变换域编码目标，用于点云属性压缩。
AI.motivation: 基于变换的点云属性压缩框架中，引入学习到的空间上下文需要将空间表示映射到变换域，但这一已知的基变换往往被留给网络隐式学习，导致对齐不充分、效率受限。
AI.method: 提出Transform-Aligned Learned Features (TALF)，将属性变换直接作用于学习到的空间表示，显式对齐编码目标；理论上证明该特征恰好表示光滑非线性模型的一阶预测项，且Taylor余项有界。将TALF集成到基于变换的属性编解码器中，采用显式系数预测与条件残差熵建模，在统一的系数域率失真目标下优化，并保留显式量化步长控制。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集及多种变换基上的大量实验表明，TALF相较传统方法和学习基线均提升了率失真性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式对齐变换域的学习特征，TALF为变换框架下引入空间上下文提供了有效且理论可解释的途径，并在多个数据集与变换基上验证了其率失真优势。

title: DivOPD: Spread Wide, Look Close for Asynchronous On-Policy Distillation of Multi-turn Agents
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains student agents through teacher supervision on their own interactions with an environment. However, in asynchronous multi-turn training, arrival-order batching can allow a few early or long rollouts to dominate learner updates while other valid rollouts become stale before being used, wasting already-generated experience. To address this problem, we introduce DivOPD, a simple learner-side batch-selection method that spreads a fixed turn budget across more rollouts and, within each rollout, prioritizes turns with larger cumulative teacher-student disagreement. Turns without usable teacher feedback are excluded. The per-turn loss and optimizer remain fixed; selection only changes which student-visited turns receive training weight. For no-progress rollouts, an optional extension briefly hands control to the teacher before returning it to the student. Across six teacher-student settings on the simulated ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop benchmarks, with 1.5B-7B students, DivOPD raises cross-setting mean peak success rate from 77.4 to 84.4 and mean success over the last five evaluations from 71.5 to 78.6. It reaches all reported setting-specific targets with geometric-mean speedups of 1.84x in training tokens and 1.87x in learner GPU time relative to vanilla OPD. Teacher intervention further raises this last-five mean to 82.4 while retaining about 1.7x learner-GPU speedup over vanilla OPD. Code will be released at https://github.com/HanyangWang0418-oss/DivOPD.

AI.tldr: DivOPD：一种面向异步多轮on-policy蒸馏的学习者侧批次选择方法，将固定轮次预算分散到更多rollout，并优先选择教师-学生累积分歧较大的轮次，从而提升成功率与训练效率。
AI.motivation: 异步多轮on-policy蒸馏训练中，按到达顺序组批会使少数早期或长rollout主导学习者更新，而其他有效rollout在未被使用前即变为陈旧数据，导致已生成经验被浪费。
AI.method: 在学习者侧进行批次选择：将固定轮次预算分摊到更多rollout；在每个rollout内优先选择教师-学生累积分歧较大的轮次；排除无可用教师反馈的轮次。每轮损失与优化器保持不变，选择仅改变哪些学生访问过的轮次获得训练权重。针对无进展rollout，可选扩展会短暂将控制权交给教师后再交还学生。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop三个模拟基准、六种师生设置、1.5B-7B学生模型上，跨设置平均峰值成功率由77.4提升至84.4，最后五次评估平均成功率由71.5提升至78.6；在训练token上获得1.84倍几何平均加速，在学习者GPU时间上获得1.87倍加速。教师干预将最后五次均值进一步提升至82.4，同时保持约1.7倍的学习者GPU加速。
AI.conclusion: DivOPD通过批次选择有效缓解异步多轮on-policy蒸馏中的rollout陈旧与经验浪费问题，在多个基准与师生规模上一致提升成功率并显著加速训练；教师干预扩展带来额外收益。

title: OpenWhistle: A Large-Scale Longitudinal Dataset and Benchmark of Bottlenose Dolphin Vocalizations
comment: Accepted as a Spotlight at the NeurIPS 2026 Datasets & Evaluations Track
summary: Recent advances in bioacoustics have been driven by large-scale corpora and standardized benchmarks, yet existing resources are overwhelmingly bird-centric and shallow per species, limiting their use for studying the structure of a single species' communication system. This gap is particularly acute for cetaceans: despite bottlenose dolphins (Tursiops truncatus) being a compelling case of complex vocal communication among non-human mammals, existing dolphin datasets are small, fragmented, and largely closed. We introduce OpenWhistle, the largest publicly available dataset of dolphin vocalizations. It comprises approximately 180,000 whistles (114 hours) recorded over five years from a stable pod of five individuals in a semi-natural environment, paired with a curated subset of 8,354 expert-annotated whistles and reproducible evaluation protocols for whistle-type detection and classification. We further release the full processing pipeline for whistle detection, segmentation, and categorization. To demonstrate its utility, we pretrain a Wav2Vec2.0 model adapted to dolphin acoustics on the OpenWhistle corpus and show that it learns effective representations, outperforming general-purpose bioacoustic models such as AVES and BioLingual on both tasks while leaving meaningful headroom for future work. By releasing the dataset, pipeline, and evaluation protocol, we provide the first open dolphin whistle dataset tailored for training self-supervised models, laying the groundwork for advancing dolphin communication research and developing models that capture fine-grained acoustic structure within species.

AI.tldr: OpenWhistle是最大的公开海豚发声数据集，含约18万条哨声（114小时），并提供标注子集、处理流程与评测协议，用于种内精细声学研究。
AI.motivation: 现有生物声学资源以鸟类为主、每物种数据浅，海豚数据集规模小、碎片化且多为闭源，难以支撑对单一物种通讯系统结构的研究。
AI.method: 采集稳定群体五只个体、跨五年、半自然环境下的录音，构建约18万条哨声（114小时）语料；提供8,354条专家标注子集及可复现的哨声类型检测与分类评测协议；开源检测、分割、分类全流程；在其上预训练适配海豚声学的Wav2Vec2.0模型。
AI.result: 预训练模型学到有效表征，在哨声类型检测与分类两项任务上均优于AVES、BioLingual等通用生物声学模型，同时仍留有明显提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是首个面向自监督模型训练的开放海豚哨声数据集，为海豚通讯研究与种内细粒度声学结构建模奠定基础。

title: Adapt Semantics, Not Structure: Few-Instance Schema Calibration for Scientific PDF Extraction
summary: A well-designed extraction schema is not necessarily ready for reliable LLM execution. When only limited verified extractions are available, manually tuning hundreds of field definitions through trial and error is costly. We frame this problem as few-instance schema calibration: adapting the operational semantics of an existing schema from a few annotated documents while preserving its structural contract. We introduce CPSE, a contract-preserving semantic extraction framework that jointly calibrates extraction prompts and field-level semantic descriptions from a few gold annotations. CPSE decomposes the schema into an invariant structural contract and mutable field semantics, and further separates identity discovery from record completion using manifest-conditioned resolution. On expert-annotated polymer-science documents, CPSE improves extraction by 9.93 points over an execution-matched baseline, with consistent gains under an independent judge and in a blinded expert audit. These results show that CPSE enables low-resource schema execution while preserving the output structure required downstream.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CPSE框架，通过少量标注文档对已有抽取Schema进行"少样本模式校准"，在保持结构契约不变的前提下联合校准抽取提示与字段语义描述，在聚合物科学文档上较基线提升9.93个点。
AI.motivation: 精心设计的抽取Schema未必能被LLM可靠执行。当仅有少量已验证抽取结果时，通过反复试错手动调整数百个字段定义成本高昂。因此需要一种在少量标注文档下适配Schema操作语义、同时保持其结构契约的方法。
AI.method: 提出CPSE（契约保持语义抽取）框架。将Schema分解为不变的结构契约与可变的字段语义，并利用"清单条件化解析"（manifest-conditioned resolution）将身份发现与记录补全分离。基于少量金标注，联合校准抽取提示与字段级语义描述。
AI.result: 在专家标注的聚合物科学文档上，CPSE较执行匹配的基线提升9.93个点，并在独立评判模型和盲审专家评审下均取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: CPSE能够在保持下游所需输出结构的同时，实现低资源的Schema执行。

title: ORAV: Benchmarking Audio-Video Generation from Multimodal Contexts
summary: Audio-video generation using heterogeneous multimodal references has emerged as a new challenge, requiring both compositional control over generation and grounded understanding of multimodal context. In this paper, we introduce ORAV Bench for Omni Reference Audio-Video Generation, comprising 380 task instances with 2-10 references, 9 semantic roles, and 30 role compositions. Instructions specify the relationships among references; the media supply the identities, dynamics, and audio characteristics to be realized. To evaluate these open-ended outputs, we develop a reference-aware pairwise protocol that prepares visual and auditory evidence, compares the intended contribution of each reference, and checks the overall verdict in both presentation orders. On held-out instances, it achieves 86.08% effective agreement with human judgments. Across 5 frontier systems, overall rankings conceal distinct strengths across reference compositions. A recurring failure is to reproduce unintended source content in place of the requested result, despite closely resembling a reference. Reproducible pointwise diagnostics of quality, reference affinity, and speech reveal distinct dimensions of model behavior. ORAV thus offers a benchmark for tracking progress toward controllable, compositional, and reference-faithful audio-video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ORAV Bench，一个面向“全参考音视频生成”的基准，包含 380 个任务实例、2–10 个异构多模态参考、9 种语义角色与 30 种角色组合；并设计参考感知的成对评测协议，与人类判断达成 86.08% 有效一致率，揭示不同前沿系统在参考组合上的差异化表现与共性失败模式。
AI.motivation: 使用异构多模态参考进行音视频生成是新兴挑战：既要对生成过程施加组合式控制，又要对多模态上下文具备有依据的理解。现有评测缺少能同时衡量组合控制能力与参考忠实度的基准与协议。
AI.method: 构建 ORAV Bench：380 个任务实例，每个含 2–10 个参考，覆盖 9 种语义角色与 30 种角色组合。指令说明参考之间的关系，媒体提供需实现的身份、动态与音频特征。提出参考感知的成对评测协议：准备视觉与听觉证据，比较每个参考的预期贡献，并在两种呈现顺序下核验总体结论。另提供可复现的逐点诊断，覆盖质量、参考亲和度与语音维度。
AI.result: 在留出实例上，成对协议与人类判断达到 86.08% 的有效一致率。在 5 个前沿系统上，总体排名掩盖了不同参考组合下的各自优势。反复出现的失败模式是：生成结果复现了非预期的源内容，而非所请求的内容，尽管其与某参考高度相似。逐点诊断揭示出模型行为的不同维度。
AI.conclusion: ORAV 为追踪“可控、可组合、忠实于参考”的音视频生成进展提供了基准，强调需在参考组合与参考忠实度层面进行细粒度评测，而非仅依赖总体排名。

title: EviSplat: Preserving Multi-View Evidence in 3D Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding enables object localization and segmentation from free-form text queries without a fixed category vocabulary. Many recent methods build on 3D Gaussian Splatting and consolidate multi-view observations, such as masked crops from individual views, into language features or compact object descriptors before the query is known. However, observations of the same object vary across viewpoints and are not equally informative: some reveal cues relevant to a particular query, whereas others provide incomplete or misleading evidence. Pre-query consolidation can therefore suppress cues on which a later query depends. We introduce EviSplat, which preserves individual observation features as evidence for later text queries. EviSplat retains individual observation features within class-agnostic 3D instances that represent objects, object parts, or background regions. It also learns, for each Gaussian, a distribution describing which visual appearances its observations support. Given a text query, EviSplat scores each instance using its most relevant observations. It then computes a score for each Gaussian by combining instance-level relevance with locally supported evidence, weighted by how often and how unambiguously that Gaussian was observed. Different queries can thus draw on different visual cues from the same preserved evidence. Experiments across diverse datasets and evaluation protocols demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, supporting the benefit of preserving multi-view evidence until query time and aggregating it according to the query.

AI.tldr: 提出 EviSplat，将多视角观测特征作为证据保留至查询时，按文本查询动态聚合，实现开放词汇 3D 场景理解的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的开放词汇方法在查询前就把多视角观测（如掩码裁剪）合并为语言特征或紧凑物体描述子。但同一物体在不同视角下的观测信息量不等，部分对特定查询关键，部分不完整甚至误导，查询前的提前整合会抑制后续查询所依赖的线索。
AI.method: EviSplat 将单独观测特征保留在类别无关的 3D 实例内（涵盖物体、部件与背景区域）；为每个高斯学习一个描述其观测支持何种视觉外观的分布。给定文本查询时，先用最相关观测对每个实例打分，再结合实例级相关性与局部支持证据，并按该高斯被观测的频次与歧义程度加权，计算每个高斯得分。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和评估协议下均取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
AI.conclusion: 验证了将多视角证据保留至查询时并依据查询进行聚合的有效性，不同查询可从同一保留证据中提取不同视觉线索。

title: Beyond Verbalized Confidence: Calibrating Reasoners with Differentiable Readouts
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains reasoning models to produce correct answers, but does not ensure that their stated confidence is calibrated. The resulting models are systematically overconfident. Recent methods train calibration inside the RLVR loop by having the model state a numerical confidence alongside its answer, but they all obtain the confidence by sampling it as text. This choice imposes two costs: a sampled confidence introduces variance and in practice collapses to a handful of distinct values, and sampling makes the confidence non-differentiable, forcing the calibration loss through a scalar reward. We propose CREDO (Confidence REaDOut) to replace sampling with a deterministic readout. While RLVR optimizes correctness, CREDO reads the confidence from a dedicated token pair in the model's output distribution and trains it by differentiable regression. CREDO further turns the trained confidence into a signal for accuracy, weighting rollouts by how far confidence and outcome disagree, so that accuracy and calibration improve together. Across mathematical and code reasoning, CREDO attains the best accuracy and calibration, and the gains extend to abstention and selective prediction.

AI.tldr: CREDO 用确定性读出替代采样，将置信度从输出分布中专门 token 对读取并做可微回归训练，同时用置信度与结果的不一致程度加权 rollout，在数学与代码推理上同时提升准确率与校准。
AI.motivation: RLVR 只优化答案正确性，不保证模型表述的置信度被校准，导致模型系统性过度自信。近期在 RLVR 循环内训练校准的方法均通过"采样文本"获得置信度，带来两个代价：采样引入方差且实际坍缩为少数离散值；采样不可微，校准损失只能通过标量奖励传递。
AI.method: 提出 CREDO（Confidence REaDOut），以确定性读出取代采样。在 RLVR 优化正确性的同时，从模型输出分布中一个专用 token 对读出置信度，并用可微回归进行训练；进一步将训练后的置信度转化为准确率信号，按置信度与结果的不一致程度对 rollout 加权。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码推理任务上，CREDO 取得最佳准确率与校准表现，且增益可扩展到弃答（abstention）与选择性预测（selective prediction）。
AI.conclusion: 将置信度从"采样文本"改为"确定性可微读出"，可消除采样方差与离散坍缩、使校准损失可微，并通过置信度—结果不一致度加权 rollout，实现准确率与校准的协同提升。

title: When Text Matters: Design Principles for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Model
summary: Visual token pruning has been widely studied as a practical approach to reducing the computational cost of large vision-language models. However, it struggles to preserve essential visual information, which can lead to substantial performance degradation. In particular, image-based token selection can overlook task-relevant details, while text-guided token selection may fail to capture the text--visual relationships needed for complex reasoning. We find that applying textual guidance too early can limit its ability to identify answer-relevant visual regions, whereas text-to-visual attention becomes more informative at intermediate decoder depths. This finding motivates our training-free method, which separates early vision-guided pruning from deferred text-guided reselection. We first prune visual tokens using vision-encoder attention, retain additional candidates until the decoder midpoint, and then use text-to-visual attention to determine the final visual-token set. Across eight benchmarks and three models, our method outperforms the best-performing baselines by an average of 11.10 and 16.84 percentage points in performance recovery at 80% and 90% pruning, respectively, with comparable or lower LLM-prefill latency than most baselines. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/kmc3661/DeFT

AI.tldr: 提出免训练视觉token剪枝方法DeFT，将早期视觉引导剪枝与延后的文本引导重选分离，在中层解码器用text-to-visual注意力确定最终token集合，在多基准多模型上显著提升性能恢复率。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉-语言模型计算开销大，视觉token剪枝是降低成本的实用手段，但难以保留关键视觉信息，导致性能明显下降：基于图像的token选择会忽略任务相关细节，文本引导的选择又难以捕捉复杂推理所需的文本-视觉关系。作者发现文本引导应用过早会限制其识别答案相关视觉区域的能力，而text-to-visual注意力在解码器中间层更具信息量。
AI.method: 免训练方法，分两阶段：首先用视觉编码器注意力进行早期视觉引导剪枝，保留额外候选token直到解码器中点；随后利用text-to-visual注意力进行延迟的文本引导重选，确定最终视觉token集合。
AI.result: 在8个基准和3个模型上，于80%和90%剪枝率下，性能恢复平均超越最优基线11.10和16.84个百分点，且LLM-prefill延迟与多数基线相当或更低。
AI.conclusion: 过早引入文本引导会削弱答案相关视觉区域的识别，而在解码器中间层使用text-to-visual注意力更有效；将早期视觉剪枝与延迟文本重选分离的免训练策略能显著提升剪枝下的性能恢复，同时保持较低预填充延迟。

title: Revisit to Segment: Working Memory Distillation for Reasoning Segmentation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have approached image segmentation by reasoning about visual content and predicting target locations. Their generated responses contain reasoning traces and localization proposals that can serve as working memory when revisiting the same image and query. Our exploration reveals that MLLMs benefit from using this self-generated working memory as context, leading to enhanced reasoning segmentation. Motivated by this finding, we seek to strengthen the backbone model's reasoning segmentation capabilities by distilling the guidance gained from revisiting prior attempts, enabling it to benefit with or without working memory at inference time. To this end, we propose Reasoning Segmenter with Working Memory (SWiM), a working-memory distillation framework for reasoning segmentation. Specifically, SWiM selects rollouts based on segmentation quality to construct working memory and uses the memory-conditioned model as a teacher. The teacher provides token-level distributional supervision along student-generated trajectories, while the student receives only the original image and query. Joint optimization of on-policy self-distillation and outcome-based reinforcement learning combines working-memory guidance with direct feedback on segmentation quality. Extensive experiments on reasoning segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that SWiM achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating the effectiveness of working-memory distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SWiM（Reasoning Segmenter with Working Memory），一种面向推理分割的工作记忆蒸馏框架：将模型重访同一图像与查询时利用自身生成的推理轨迹与定位提议作为"工作记忆"，并将其增益蒸馏进主干模型，使其在推理时有/无工作记忆均可受益，取得推理分割SOTA。
AI.motivation: MLLM通过推理视觉内容并预测目标位置来实现图像分割，其生成的响应包含推理轨迹与定位提议，可作为重访同一图像与查询时的工作记忆。作者探索发现MLLM能借助这种自生成的工作记忆作为上下文，从而提升推理分割效果。因此希望强化主干模型自身的推理分割能力，把"重访先前尝试"所获得的指导蒸馏进模型，使其在推理阶段无论是否具备工作记忆都能获益。
AI.method: 提出SWiM工作记忆蒸馏框架：1）依据分割质量筛选rollout以构建工作记忆；2）以记忆条件化的模型（memory-conditioned model）作为教师，在由学生生成的轨迹上提供token级分布监督，而学生仅接收原始图像与查询；3）联合优化on-policy自蒸馏与基于结果（outcome-based）的强化学习，将工作记忆指导与对分割质量的直接反馈相结合。
AI.result: 在多个推理分割基准上的大量实验表明，SWiM达到state-of-the-art性能，验证了工作记忆蒸馏的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MLLM可受益于自生成的工作记忆；通过将工作记忆带来的增益蒸馏到主干模型中，SWiM在不依赖推理时工作记忆的情况下显著提升推理分割能力，为推理分割提供了一种有效范式。

title: P4Q: Co-designing Token Pruning and Quantization for Vision-Language Model Acceleration
summary: Vision language models have achieved strong performance across a wide range of multimodal applications, yet their substantial computational and memory costs hinder efficient deployment. Visual token pruning and post-training quantization reduce inference overhead along two complementary dimensions, namely sequence length and numerical precision. Existing workflows typically optimize these techniques independently or apply them sequentially. Their distinct optimization objectives leave critical interactions unaddressed and constrain the achievable compression performance. We revisit these designs and present P4Q, a practical co-design framework that jointly optimizes visual token pruning and low-bit quantization for efficient VLM inference. First, P4Q introduces a quantization-aware visual token selection strategy before the LLM. It applies fake quantization to copies of the features produced by the projector and selects visual tokens using statistics computed from these fake-quantized features, thereby conditioning the selector's feature-based decisions on simulated low-bit perturbations. Second, P4Q introduces a pruning-aware quantization calibration strategy. It uses the same selection strategy as pruning to calibrate the quantized model on the retained-token distribution, thereby aligning the calibration process with the pruned execution path used during deployment. By coupling these two components, P4Q achieves substantial inference speedups while maintaining comparable task performance, resulting in a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off than independently optimized pipelines. For instance, on LLaVA-NeXT, P4Q achieves an average end-to-end inference speedup of 2.8x across eight distinct test sets, while retaining higher accuracy than prior compression and quantization methods.

AI.tldr: 提出P4Q，将视觉token剪枝与低比特量化协同设计，通过量化感知token选择与剪枝感知量化校准，显著提升VLM推理效率并保持精度。
AI.motivation: VLM推理的计算与内存开销大，视觉token剪枝和训练后量化分别从序列长度和数值精度两个维度降低开销，但现有工作独立优化或顺序组合，二者优化目标不同、交互作用未被处理，限制了压缩性能。
AI.method: P4Q包含两个组件：(1) 量化感知视觉token选择：对projector输出特征副本施加伪量化，并基于伪量化特征的统计量选择token，使选择器的特征决策考虑模拟低比特扰动；(2) 剪枝感知量化校准：采用与剪枝相同的选择策略，在保留token分布上校准量化模型，使校准过程与部署时的剪枝执行路径对齐。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-NeXT上，P4Q在八个测试集上平均端到端推理加速2.8倍，同时精度优于先前的压缩与量化方法。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化视觉token剪枝与低比特量化可解决二者交互问题，获得比独立优化管线更优的效率-精度权衡，实现实用高效的VLM推理部署。

title: SPOC-Net: Single-Primitive Online Composition Network for GNSS Jamming Set Recognition
summary: Reliable positioning, navigation, and timing support intelligent transportation, autonomous systems, and space-air-ground integrated networks. However, global navigation satellite system (GNSS) jamming recognizers that treat each mixture as a separate class are difficult to extend to new combinations. Therefore, this paper proposes SPOC-Net, which decomposes the recognition problem into identifying a set of basic jamming components. Multi-resolution time-frequency features and learned component queries provide evidence for each component type. A high-resolution branch estimates the number of active types, and a structured decoder combines this estimate with component evidence to select a valid set. For training, measured single-component records are the only physical samples used in gradient optimization. Their associated clean in-phase and quadrature (IQ) sequences are combined on demand during training to produce labeled mixtures with different relative powers and jamming-to-noise ratios. Separate measured mixtures from ten training-listed compositions support model selection and decoder calibration; six other compositions are reserved for final testing. Evaluation on 14,220 independently generated, conductively combined, and recorded radio frequency mixtures yields 80.69% exact-set accuracy and a 92.84% micro-averaged F1 score. On combinations excluded from model development, SPOC-Net achieves 80.89% exact-set accuracy, exceeding the strongest comparison method by 18.77 percentage points under the reported protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出SPOC-Net，将GNSS干扰识别从多分类重构为“基础干扰组件集合识别”，通过多分辨率时频特征、学习式组件查询、高分辨率活动类型数估计与结构化解码器，实现对新组合干扰的泛化识别。
AI.motivation: GNSS干扰识别对智能交通、自主系统和空天地一体化网络的可靠定位导航授时至关重要。然而，传统识别器将每种混合干扰视为独立类别，难以扩展到新的干扰组合，泛化能力受限。
AI.method: SPOC-Net将识别问题分解为识别一组基础干扰组件：利用多分辨率时频特征和学习到的组件查询为各组件类型提供证据；高分辨率分支估计活跃类型数量，结构化解码器结合数量估计与组件证据选择有效集合。训练时仅使用实测单组件记录作为物理样本，其干净IQ序列按需组合，生成具有不同相对功率和干噪比的带标签混合样本。另有10种训练清单内组合的实测混合数据用于模型选择与解码器校准，6种其他组合留作最终测试。
AI.result: 在14,220个独立生成、传导合成并记录的射频混合样本上，取得80.69%的精确集合准确率和92.84%的微平均F1分数；在未参与模型开发的组合上，SPOC-Net达到80.89%的精确集合准确率，在所述协议下超过最强对比方法18.77个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SPOC-Net通过组件化分解与结构化解码，有效解决了GNSS干扰混合识别难以泛化到新组合的问题，在已知及未见干扰组合上均取得优于对比方法的性能，具有良好的扩展性。

title: One Readout, Many Repairs: Diffusion-Guided Hierarchical Search for Tool-Agent Repair
summary: Tool agents use large language models to act through external tools, yet successfully executed calls can still leave user requests unfulfilled. Tool-agent repair seeks alternative call sequences that execute successfully and fulfill the original requests. However, repair requires exploring both operation choices and their concrete realizations, making complete-sequence regeneration costly. Moreover, regeneration repeats operation selection even when failure arises from how those operations are realized. The resulting challenge is to reduce this repetition while preserving exploration of alternative operations and realizations. Therefore, we formulate repair as hierarchical search over operation supports, which we introduce as sets of permitted operation types that define reusable search regions for concrete tool-call sequences. We propose ReCommit, a training-free, diffusion-guided framework for improving tool-agent failure recovery while reducing repair computation. ReCommit amortizes operation-level proposal computation across repair trials by reusing operation-type scores from a single parallel readout of a masked diffusion language model. These scores guide search across supports, while realization search explores alternative entity bindings, arguments, and action composition within each support. Experiments on real failures across four enterprise services in the Agent-Diff benchmark show 75.9\% and 63.2\% relative recovery gains with 61.3\% and 51.3\% reductions in mean full-budget repair time at repair budgets $B=3$ and $B=13$, respectively, over the strongest evaluated 8B comparison method. ReCommit achieves a favorable recovery--cost trade-off, including in comparisons with the evaluated 32B models.

AI.tldr: 该论文将工具智能体修复形式化为对"操作支撑集"的层次化搜索，提出免训练、扩散引导的 ReCommit 框架，在降低修复计算量的同时提升恢复率。
AI.motivation: 工具智能体虽能成功执行外部工具调用，但调用成功并不意味着用户请求被满足。现有修复方法需要重新生成完整调用序列，既需探索操作选择又需探索其具体实现，代价高昂；且当失败源于操作的具体实现方式时，重新生成仍会重复操作选择过程，造成冗余计算。
AI.method: 将修复问题形式化为对操作支撑集（允许的操作类型集合，构成可复用的搜索区域）的层次化搜索，从而减少重复。提出 ReCommit：免训练、扩散引导的框架。通过对掩码扩散语言模型进行一次并行读出，复用操作类型得分，从而在多次修复尝试间摊销操作级提议计算；这些得分引导支撑集搜索，实现搜索则在每个支撑集内探索替代的实体绑定、参数与动作组合。
AI.result: 在 Agent-Diff 基准的四个企业服务真实失败案例上，相较最强评测 8B 对比方法，在修复预算 B=3 和 B=13 时分别取得 75.9% 与 63.2% 的相对恢复率提升，同时平均全预算修复时间分别减少 61.3% 与 51.3%；与评测的 32B 模型相比也呈现良好的恢复—成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: ReCommit 通过支撑集层次化搜索与得分复用，在保持对替代操作及实现探索的同时减少重复计算，实现了有利的恢复率—成本权衡，并可与更大规模模型竞争。

title: SubRot: Signed Gradient Subspace Calibration for VLM Rotation Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization reduces the deployment cost of vision-language models (VLMs), but preserving multimodal capabilities at low bit widths remains challenging. Existing methods rely on modality- or token-level gradient statistics, which are susceptible to cross-sample variations in visual-to-textual token ratios and the positions of visual information, limiting statistical stability. Moreover, overly coarse aggregation through absolute values and averaging discards gradient signs and channel-wise differences, limiting the separation of modality-specific sensitivities. In contrast, the channel space provides a shared coordinate system across samples, making it a more natural basis for capturing stable task-sensitive structures. We therefore propose SubRot, a signed gradient subspace calibration method for VLM rotation quantization. Through eigendecomposition of the empirical Fisher matrix of activation gradients, SubRot identifies a sensitive channel subspace with three properties: cross-sample stability, clear sensitivity separation, and consistent signed effects on the autoregressive loss along certain directions. Guided by a local Taylor expansion, SubRot combines signed first-order guidance along sign-stable directions with second-order constraints along the remaining sensitive directions, while retaining MSE for overall reconstruction quality. This objective steers quantization errors toward loss-decreasing directions while controlling their magnitude. Experiments on five VLMs across five benchmarks show consistent average-score improvements over FlatQuant under W4A6 and W4A4, reaching 1.4 percentage points on LLaVA-NeXT-7B. Under W4A4, average accuracy degradation from FP16 remains within 1.4 percentage points across all evaluated models, while LLaVA-v1.5-13B exceeds its FP16 average score by 0.4 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出 SubRot，一种基于符号梯度子空间校准的 VLM 旋转量化方法，通过通道空间的经验 Fisher 矩阵特征分解识别稳定且符号一致的敏感子空间，结合一阶符号引导与二阶约束优化量化误差，在五个 VLM、五个基准上优于 FlatQuant。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 训练后量化方法依赖模态级或 token 级梯度统计，易受视觉-文本 token 比例及视觉信息位置跨样本变化影响，统计稳定性差；同时采用绝对值与平均的粗粒度聚合丢弃了梯度符号与通道差异，难以分离模态特定敏感性。通道空间提供跨样本共享坐标系，更适合捕捉稳定的任务敏感结构。
AI.method: SubRot 通过对激活梯度的经验 Fisher 矩阵做特征分解，识别具有跨样本稳定性、敏感性清晰分离、对自回归损失符号效应一致三个性质的敏感通道子空间。基于局部泰勒展开，将沿符号稳定方向的符号一阶引导与其余敏感方向的二阶约束相结合，并保留 MSE 以维持整体重建质量，从而将量化误差导向降低损失的方向并控制其幅度。
AI.result: 在五个 VLM、五个基准上，W4A6 与 W4A4 设置下平均分一致优于 FlatQuant，LLaVA-NeXT-7B 提升达 1.4 个百分点。W4A4 下所有评估模型相较 FP16 的平均精度下降均在 1.4 个百分点以内，LLaVA-v1.5-13B 甚至超过其 FP16 平均分 0.4 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以通道空间为基础的符号梯度子空间校准可有效提升 VLM 低比特旋转量化的多模态能力保持，在极低位宽下仍能维持与 FP16 接近甚至更优的性能，验证了跨样本稳定敏感子空间建模的有效性。

title: ECHO: Event-Augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook for Wrist-Only Manipulation
summary: Learning-based manipulation policies relying on RGB cameras often suffer from degraded observations under extreme exposure. Event cameras mitigate this degradation by asynchronously detecting pixel-level intensity changes to offer a high dynamic range. However, their observations heavily depend on camera placement, as fixed cameras miss static scene content while wrist-mounted camera motion causes previously visited regions to leave the field of view. To address these spatial-temporal limitations, we present ECHO (Event-augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook), a wrist-only latent world action model that encodes wrist events into compact motion representations to provide temporal and spatial context for policy reasoning. Specifically, ECHO utilizes a pretrained event encoder to explain visual-feature changes between frames. Its hindsight module preserves the gripper trajectory with past event stream as addressable off-camera context. Concurrently, the outlook module introduces learnable event foresight queries supervised to anticipate the event window for future actions, enabling the policy to predict upcoming scene changes. Evaluated on wrist-only RLBench tasks, ECHO outperforms RGB and RGB+event baselines by 20.6 and 12.0 percentage points under normal lighting, and by 14.6 and 11.3 points under severe exposure drops, respectively, while also surpassing RGB references using a third-person camera. Real-world experiments with a wrist-mounted event camera validate that ECHO outperforms RGB-only and RGB+event baselines across multiple tasks under both nominal and severely dark lighting. Project page is at https://echo-wam.github.io/.

AI.tldr: ECHO是一种仅依赖腕部事件相机的潜在世界动作模型，通过"回顾"与"前瞻"模块为策略推理提供时空上下文，在极端曝光条件下显著优于RGB及RGB+事件基线。
AI.motivation: 基于RGB相机的学习型操作策略在极端曝光下观测质量严重下降。事件相机虽具高动态范围，但观测强烈依赖相机布局：固定相机遗漏静态场景内容，而腕部相机的运动会使已访问区域移出视野，造成时空局限。
AI.method: 提出ECHO（Event-augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook），一种仅腕部的潜在世界动作模型，将腕部事件流编码为紧凑运动表示。采用预训练事件编码器解释帧间视觉特征变化；回顾模块以过去事件流保留夹爪轨迹作为可寻址的离视野上下文；前瞻模块引入可学习的事件预测查询，通过监督预测未来动作对应的事件窗口，使策略能预判场景变化。
AI.result: 在仅腕部RLBench任务上，正常光照下较RGB与RGB+事件基线分别提升20.6与12.0个百分点；严重曝光下降时分别提升14.6与11.3个百分点，并超过使用第三人称相机的RGB参考。真实世界腕部事件相机实验验证其在常规与极暗光照下均优于RGB-only与RGB+事件基线。
AI.conclusion: 利用事件流的时空上下文建模可有效缓解极端曝光下的观测退化，腕部事件相机结合回顾与前瞻机制为鲁棒操作策略提供了可行方案。

title: LVMT: Video Mask Transformer for Long-term Video Segmentation
summary: Existing online video segmentation methods struggle to track objects in long, complex videos with long-term occlusions. We hypothesize that this limitation is caused by (i) the inability of their temporal propagation mechanism to adaptively select the object information that is propagated across time, and (ii) their inability to be trained on long videos due to memory requirements and vanishing gradients. To address the first limitation, we propose to use a lightweight GRU-based temporal propagation module that can learn to select which information it keeps in memory and propagates across time. Second, to allow training on long videos, we introduce Truncated Query Propagation (TQP), a training strategy in which the model processes a video in chunks of frames, where information about tracked objects is propagated between chunks but backpropagation is only conducted in individual chunks, enabling longer temporal supervision without out-of-memory issues, inference overhead, or vanishing gradients. The resulting model is called the Long-term Video Mask Transformer (LVMT). Extensive experiments on six benchmarks show that LVMT sets a new state of the art across a range of video segmentation tasks, while retaining the speed of the highly efficient model it is based on, making it 10X faster than the prior state of the art. Code: https://www.tue-mps.org/lvmt

AI.tldr: 提出LVMT，通过GRU时序传播模块与截断查询传播（TQP）训练策略解决长视频分割中的信息选择与长时序训练难题，在六个基准上取得SOTA且速度提升10倍。
AI.motivation: 现有在线视频分割方法难以在存在长期遮挡的长复杂视频中跟踪目标。作者假设该局限源于两点：(i) 时序传播机制无法自适应选择跨时间传播的目标信息；(ii) 受内存需求与梯度消失影响，无法在长视频上训练。
AI.method: 针对第一点，提出轻量级基于GRU的时序传播模块，可学习选择在内存中保留并跨时间传播的信息。针对第二点，提出截断查询传播（TQP）训练策略：模型以帧块为单位处理视频，跟踪目标信息在块间传播，但反向传播仅在单个块内进行，从而在不产生显存溢出、推理开销或梯度消失的前提下实现更长的时序监督。
AI.result: 在六个基准上的大量实验表明，LVMT在多种视频分割任务上刷新了SOTA；同时保持其高效基模型的推理速度，比此前SOTA快10倍。
AI.conclusion: LVMT通过自适应时序传播与TQP训练策略，兼顾长时序跟踪能力与计算效率，为长视频分割提供了高性能且高速度的新方案。

title: Role-Guided MOE for Encoder-Level Pathology Representation Learning in WSI Classification
summary: Whole slide image classification is a fundamental task in computational pathology, where patch representation quality directly affects downstream aggregation and slide-level discriminability. Pathology foundation models are widely adopted as frozen feature extractors for WSI classification; however, their fixed encoders may produce representations insufficiently adapted to target-specific tissue patterns and discriminative cues. Fine-tuning can improve target adaptation, but introduces a trade-off between pathology-specific representation capacity and adaptation efficiency, particularly in data-scarce settings. To address this, we propose a pathology role-guided mixture-of-experts feed-forward network (MoE-FFN) framework for efficient encoder-level representation learning. We design a two-stage training paradigm to establish and adapt pathology-aware expert specialization. In source-domain expert initialization, pathology-specific priors are distilled from a frozen Virchow2 teacher into a lightweight DINOv2-small student, while role prototypes serve as weak pathological anchors to encourage distinct expert functions. MoE-FFN blocks are introduced into selected high-level transformer layers to provide transformation diversity for heterogeneous pathological patterns. In target-domain adaptation, the initialized experts are refined through asymmetric prototype-guided optimization, enhancing task-relevant positive evidence and separating confusable hard negatives. The resulting encoder extracts offline patch representations that can be directly integrated with standard MIL aggregators. Experiments on the public BRACS dataset and a private PAROTID WSI dataset across five representative backbones demonstrate consistent improvements over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出病理角色引导的MoE-FFN框架，在冻结病理基础模型与全微调之间取得平衡，实现高效编码器级表示学习，用于全切片图像分类。
AI.motivation: WSI分类中，病理基础模型常作为冻结特征提取器，但其固定编码器难以适配目标域特定组织模式与判别线索；微调虽能提升适配性，却带来病理特异表示能力与适配效率之间的权衡，在数据稀缺场景尤为突出。
AI.method: 设计两阶段训练范式：（1）源域专家初始化，从冻结的Virchow2教师向轻量级DINOv2-small学生蒸馏病理先验，利用角色原型作为弱病理锚点促进专家功能分化，并在高层Transformer层引入MoE-FFN模块以提供异构病理模式的变换多样性；（2）目标域适配，通过非对称原型引导优化精炼专家，增强任务相关正证据并分离易混淆困难负样本。
