AI.result: 在公开BRACS数据集与私有PAROTID WSI数据集上，跨五种代表性骨干网络均取得相对最强基线的一致性提升。所得编码器可离线提取patch表示，直接接入标准MIL聚合器。
AI.conclusion: 所提MoE-FFN框架通过病理角色引导的专家专业化与两阶段适配，有效缓解冻结特征提取与微调之间的权衡，提升了WSI分类的编码器级表示质量与下游聚合可用性。

title: ColNanoVDR: Document-Free Query Distillation for Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrieval via Optimal Transport
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/Ryenhails/NanoVDR ; Models: https://huggingface.co/nanovdr
summary: Multi-vector retrievers built on vision-language models lead visual document retrieval (VDR), but they run a multi-billion-parameter query encoder on every search. Distilling this encoder into a small student that queries the teacher's existing index would remove the bottleneck. The standard recipe, however, matches the teacher's MaxSim scores and so requires encoding and caching every training page, which can reach terabytes of page tokens. NanoVDR avoids pages entirely by training on the teacher's query embeddings alone, but only for single-vector retrievers. We present ColNanoVDR, to our knowledge the first framework to bring this document-free distillation to multi-vector VDR. Its objective, OTW (Optimal Transport with Learned Weights), aligns the student's query tokens with the teacher's by entropic optimal transport, with a learned weight for each student token, and needs no correspondence between the two tokenizations. We prove that the resulting alignment cost bounds the MaxSim score difference on every page. Distilled from five state-of-the-art teachers, the 149M text-only students retain about 95% of their teachers' NDCG@5 on ViDoRe v1-v3 while encoding queries up to 26x faster. Under identical training, OTW matches score distillation while encoding no page and reading 12.6x less cached teacher data.

AI.tldr: 提出 ColNanoVDR，首个将无文档（document-free）蒸馏引入多向量视觉文档检索的框架，通过 OTW 目标对齐学生与教师的查询 token，无需训练页面。
AI.motivation: 多向量检索器依赖数十亿参数的查询编码器，每次搜索开销大。将其蒸馏为小模型可去除瓶颈，但标准方法需匹配教师 MaxSim 分数，要求编码并缓存所有训练页面，可达TB级页面 token；NanoVDR 虽避免页面但仅适用于单向量检索器。
AI.method: 提出 OTW（Optimal Transport with Learned Weights）目标：用熵最优传输将学生查询 token 与教师查询 token 对齐，并为每个学生 token 学习权重，无需两种分词间对应关系。理论上证明该对齐代价可界定任意页面上 MaxSim 分数差。
AI.result: 从五个SOTA教师蒸馏出149M纯文本学生模型，在ViDoRe v1-v3上保留约95%的NDCG@5，查询编码速度提升至26倍。相同训练下，OTW达到分数蒸馏效果，但无需编码任何页面，读取的缓存教师数据减少12.6倍。
AI.conclusion: ColNanoVDR首次实现多向量视觉文档检索的无文档蒸馏，OTW提供了有理论保证的高效对齐方式，在显著提速的同时保持检索性能。

title: FILIGREE3D: Scaling Sparse Latent Flow Matching for Ultra-High-Resolution Image-to-3D Generation
summary: Scaling image-to-3D generation to ultra-high resolutions requires controlling rapidly growing computational costs without sacrificing fine geometric detail. We present \textbf{Filigree3D}, a sparse latent flow-matching framework that generates 3D geometry from a single image at voxel resolutions up to $2048^3$, with straightforward extensibility to $4096^3$. To make training tractable, we introduce Structure-Aware Sparse Scaling, which combines spatial bounding with alternating local-global attention to constrain token growth while preserving both fine-scale details and long-range structural context. To enhance detail reconstruction, we curate training samples based on their high-resolution geometric gains and inject multi-scale image features into a sparse 3D DiT, effectively coupling structural semantics with fine-grained visual cues. Furthermore, a visibility-aware voxel regularization strategy improves robustness against sparse perturbations and facilitates the completion of unobserved geometry. Under our default configuration, Filigree3D maintains peak GPU memory consumption within practical limits for contemporary hardware, enabling the generation of highly intricate 3D geometry in approximately one minute. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method yields substantial improvements in overall geometric fidelity and fine-detail preservation compared to existing baselines, validating practical, detail-preserving 3D generation at unprecedented resolutions.

AI.tldr: Filigree3D：稀疏隐空间流匹配框架，从单张图像生成高达2048³（可扩展至4096³）体素分辨率的3D几何，兼顾细节与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 将图像到3D生成提升至超高分辨率时，计算成本急剧增长，需在不牺牲精细几何细节的前提下控制开销。
AI.method: 基于稀疏隐空间流匹配；提出Structure-Aware Sparse Scaling，结合空间边界化与交替局部-全局注意力，抑制token增长；按高分辨率几何增益筛选训练样本，并将多尺度图像特征注入稀疏3D DiT；采用可见性感知体素正则化提升稀疏扰动鲁棒性并补全未观测几何。
AI.result: 默认配置下峰值GPU显存保持在当代硬件的实用范围内，约一分钟生成复杂3D几何；相较于现有基线，在整体几何保真度与细节保持上均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 验证了在空前分辨率下进行实用、保细节的3D生成方法的可行性。

title: Evaluating Bounded Autonomy in Regulated Agentic AI: A Diagnostic Harness with Constitutional Rewards, Escalation Labels, and Runtime Governance
comment: 9 pages; ancillary evaluation artefacts. Previously submitted to NLLP 2026
summary: We propose RegLLM, a diagnostic harness for bounded autonomy in regulated agentic workflows. It instruments six trustworthiness signals: citation validity, source grounding, schema compliance, escalation correctness, constitutional alignment, and unsafe-action rate. Signals are distinguished by their source of supervision: programmatic verifiers, task-level escalation labels, or AI-judge scores. A deterministic runtime supervisor blocks ungrounded answers and forces escalation, logging interventions. The same domain constitution informs evaluation, training rewards, and serving guardrails. Task-level should-escalate labels make the act-versus-defer decision a measurable training signal. We demonstrate the harness at smoke scale. An offline reference run (n=12) lifts escalation recall from 0 to 0.67 and reduces unsafe-action rate from 0.33 to 0.08 when governance is enabled. Two single-GPU Qwen2.5-3B LoRA/DPO pilots (n=8, same seed and evaluation split) expose substantial variation: nominally identical RL-base configurations yield task success of 0.25 versus 0.12 and escalation recall of 1.0 versus 0.5. An answer-quality adapter changes recall from 1.0 to 0.5 in Run A, but from 0.5 to 1.0 in Run B. An escalation-aware variant produces no measurable change in Run B. These small pilots do not establish reliable adapter effects or production readiness. Their contribution is diagnostic: configuration variance can overwhelm apparent tuning effects on bounded-autonomy metrics, motivating larger evaluation sets and repeated runs.

AI.tldr: 提出 RegLLM 诊断框架，用于评估受监管智能体工作流中的"有界自主性"，通过六类可信度信号与确定性运行时监督器进行监测；小规模实验显示治理机制可提升升级召回率并降低不安全动作率，但配置方差可能掩盖微调效应。
AI.motivation: 受监管的智能体工作流需要在有限授权范围内运行（有界自主性），但缺乏可测量、可诊断的评估工具；尤其"行动还是升级"（act-versus-defer）这一关键决策缺少明确的可训练信号。
AI.method: 构建 RegLLM 诊断框架，监测六项可信度信号（引用有效性、来源接地、模式合规、升级正确性、宪法对齐、不安全动作率），并按监督来源分类（程序化验证器、任务级升级标签、AI 评委评分）；引入确定性运行时监督器，阻断无依据回答并强制升级，并记录干预；同一领域宪法同时用于评估、训练奖励与serving护栏；任务级"应升级"标签使决策成为可测训练信号。
AI.result: 在 smoke 规模验证：离线参照运行（n=12）在启用治理后升级召回率由 0 提升至 0.67，不安全动作率由 0.33 降至 0.08；两个单卡 Qwen2.5-3B 的 LoRA/DPO 试运行（n=8，同种子同评测划分）表现出显著差异：名义相同的 RL-base 配置任务成功率为 0.25 对 0.12，升级召回率为 1.0 对 0.5；答案质量适配器在 Run A 使召回率由 1.0 降至 0.5，在 Run B 则由 0.5 升至 1.0；升级感知变体在 Run B 无可测变化。
AI.conclusion: 小规模试运行不足以确立可靠的适配器效应或生产就绪性；核心贡献是诊断性的——配置方差可能淹没调优对有界自主性指标的表观影响，因此需要更大评测集与重复运行。

title: ReSight-SMC: Two-Stage Power Sampling via Island SMC with Visual Scouts
summary: Power sampling has emerged as a training-free approach to LLM reasoning, eliciting capabilities comparable to reinforcement learning by sharpening the model distribution over complete responses. Despite this success, power sampling remains underexplored in large vision-language models (LVLMs). We transfer Power-SMC to LVLM decoding by defining a sequence-power target conditioned on both the image and the prompt. This direct transfer provides a strong training-free baseline, but leaves two aspects of finite-particle multimodal inference unaddressed. At the particle level, global resampling can collapse genealogies, while particle-based power sampling does not diversify trajectories through distinct visual cues in multimodal decoding, limiting exploration under a finite particle budget. At the answer level, sequence-level sharpening makes distinct reasoning trajectories compete even when they support the same answer. We introduce ReSight-SMC, a verifier-free two-stage power sampler for LVLM inference. Its first stage uses ancestry-isolated SMC islands to preserve independent trajectory families and routes a bounded set of prefix-conditioned visual scouts to prefix-relevant image regions while discouraging redundant overlap. Each scout temporarily increases attention to the image tokens and emphasizes its routed region. Exact importance correction preserves the base LVLM sequence-power target. The second stage aggregates terminal importance mass by canonical answer, powers the answer marginal, and samples an answer together with a supporting trajectory. Across four LVLM backbones and five benchmarks, ReSight-SMC achieves stronger aggregate performance than Power-SMC over both the reasoning and perception benchmark groups. Without post-training, it remains competitive in aggregate with backbone-matched models trained using reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ReSight-SMC，一种面向大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）推理的无验证器两阶段幂采样方法，将 Power-SMC 迁移至多模态解码，并在粒子级与答案级分别改进，在多个模型与基准上优于 Power-SMC，且无需后训练即可与强化学习训练的模型竞争。
AI.motivation: 幂采样作为一种免训练方法，在 LLM 推理中已能达到与强化学习相当的效果，但在 LVLM 中研究不足。直接迁移 Power-SMC 虽提供了强基线，却未解决有限粒子多模态推理的两个问题：粒子层面，全局重采样会导致谱系坍缩，且粒子采样未利用不同视觉线索来多样化轨迹，限制了有限粒子预算下的探索；答案层面，序列级锐化使支持同一答案的不同推理轨迹相互竞争。
AI.method: 提出 ReSight-SMC，一个无验证器的两阶段幂采样器。第一阶段使用谱系隔离的 SMC 岛屿以保留独立的轨迹族，并将有界的、前缀条件化的视觉侦察粒子路由至与前缀相关的图像区域，同时抑制冗余重叠；每个侦察粒子临时增强对图像 token 的注意力并强调其所路由的区域；通过精确的重要性校正保持基础 LVLM 的序列幂目标。第二阶段按规范答案聚合终端重要性质量，对答案边缘分布进行幂运算，并采样一个答案及其支撑轨迹。
AI.result: 在四个 LVLM 骨干和五个基准上，ReSight-SMC 在推理与感知两组基准上的总体表现均优于 Power-SMC；在无后训练的情况下，其总体表现与骨干匹配的、使用强化学习训练的模型相比仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: ReSight-SMC 通过粒子级谱系隔离与视觉侦察路由、答案级重要性质量聚合，有效解决了有限粒子多模态幂采样的探索退化和轨迹竞争问题，为 LVLM 推理提供了一种免训练且可媲美强化学习的高效方案。

title: Don't Throw Away the Tail: Action Upcycling for Policy Acceleration
summary: Modern robot policies predict a chunk of future actions from a single observation, execute only a prefix, and discard the rest before replanning. Choosing the length of this prefix, the execution horizon, poses a trade-off between reactivity and efficiency. A short horizon keeps the policy reactive to the environment, but requires frequent policy calls. Recent test-time methods adaptively select the horizon for each chunk, but they either read model internals, where the signal must be chosen for each architecture, or draw extra samples, which adds cost. We propose Action Upcycling, a training-free algorithm that reuses actions the policy would otherwise discard, without accessing model internals or drawing extra samples. We find that discarded actions stay close to their replanned versions as long as the action velocity remains smooth. Action Upcycling therefore extends the execution horizon up to the point where the velocity begins to fluctuate. Extensive experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that Action Upcycling reduces policy calls by 1.2-1.7x with no loss in success rate, across multiple Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) and even a World Action Model (WAM). It applies to any chunked policy at negligible cost and is orthogonal to other policy acceleration methods such as few-step sampling and streaming action decoding, opening a new axis for policy acceleration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Action Upcycling，一种免训练、无需访问模型内部或额外采样的方法，通过复用被丢弃的动作来动态延长执行视界，在保持成功率的同时减少 1.2-1.7 倍策略调用。
AI.motivation: 现有 chunked 策略在执行 horizon 选择上存在反应性与效率的权衡：短 horizon 反应性好但需频繁调用，长 horizon 高效但反应差。近期 test-time 自适应方法要么依赖模型内部信号（需针对不同架构单独设计），要么需要额外采样，增加成本。因此需要一种通用、低成本且不依赖模型内部信息的方法。
AI.method: Action Upcycling 是一种免训练算法，核心观察是：只要动作速度（action velocity）保持平滑，被丢弃的动作与重规划后的版本很接近。因此它复用原本会被丢弃的动作，将执行 horizon 延长至速度开始波动的位置，无需访问模型内部，也无需额外采样，可用于任何 chunked 策略。可与少步采样、流式动作解码等加速方法正交组合。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界操作任务上，跨多种 Vision-Language-Action 模型（VLA）乃至 World Action Model（WAM）的实验表明，Action Upcycling 将策略调用减少 1.2-1.7 倍，且成功率无损失。
AI.conclusion: Action Upcycling 以近乎可忽略的成本适用于任意 chunked 策略，为策略加速开辟了新的方向（复用而非丢弃动作），并与现有加速技术正交。

title: Almost Human, Except When It Matters: VoxParity and the Decisions a Voice Should Change
comment: 38 pages, 11 figures, 15 tables. Code, scorer and development-split data at https://github.com/bhavik-mangla/voxparity-bench and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23008159
summary: A voice agent can handle almost every call on the words alone and still fail the few its sector's rules were written for. Emergency-call standards, fraud guidance, radio phraseology and vulnerability rules recognise that how a caller sounds, or what else is audible, can change the right action. VoxParity tests whether agents act on it. In 183 scenarios from 14 sectors, one transcript stays fixed while the audio changes (a coaching voice, a medical monitor beeping, a mayday under a radio check, noise over a drug name, a child's voice placing a bet, a frightened whisper), and with it the correct typed tool call. A words-only null test credits a system only if hearing the call moves its actions more than it moves a pipeline that only reads the words. Only 11 of the 23 systems that can also be run on the transcript pass. Descriptively, errors run toward the words: when the audio calls for protection, all 28 systems carry out the routine request more often than they over-react on clean calls (41% against 12% pooled; the words-only pipeline, 58% against 15%). Exploratory analyses place most of the leading systems' misses on cues they heard; systems beat the null almost entirely on items that state the rule; the leading systems overrule heard resignation or confusion far more often than acute alarm; and, in the models tested, describing the voice and stating the rule each recover part of the shortfall, leaving a gap on emotion.

AI.tldr: 提出VoxParity基准，检验语音智能体是否在文本不变时依据音频线索改变行动，结果显示多数系统未能通过纯文本对照检验。
AI.motivation: 语音智能体仅凭文字即可处理绝大多数来电，但应急呼叫、反欺诈、无线电通信用语与弱势群体保护等领域的规则明确要求：说话人的声音特征及其他可闻信息可能改变正确处置方式。现有评测缺乏对此类"听感依赖性"的检验。
AI.method: 构建VoxParity基准，覆盖14个行业、183个场景。每个场景保持转写文本固定，仅改变音频（如教练口吻、医疗监护仪报警声、无线电检查中插入的求救信号、药品名称上的噪声、儿童声音下注、惊恐低语），对应的正确工具调用也随之改变。设计"纯文字零假设检验"：只有当听到音频后系统行动的变化显著大于仅读文字流水线的变化时，才判定其通过。
AI.result: 在23个可同时以转写文本运行的系统中有11个通过。描述性统计显示错误偏向文字：当音频提示需要保护性处置时，28个系统执行常规请求的比例高于在干净呼叫上的过度反应（合并后41%对12%；纯文字流水线为58%对15%）。探索性分析表明：领先系统的大多数失误落在其已听到的线索上；系统几乎只在明确陈述规则的条目上优于零假设；领先系统推翻听到的顺从或困惑语气远多于急性惊恐；在被测模型中，描述声音与陈述规则各自能弥合部分差距，但在情绪维度仍存在缺口。
AI.conclusion: 语音智能体普遍未真正依据音频线索调整行动，错误系统性地偏向文本内容；仅在规则被显式陈述时表现较好，对情绪类线索存在持续短板，说明"听懂声音"与"依声行事"之间仍有明显差距。

title: Sample What You Say: Aligning Language Models to Sample the Distributions They State
summary: Language models are increasingly used to sample from a specified distribution, for instance, to simulate survey respondents or generate synthetic data. Instruction-tuned models can state such a distribution correctly and still fail to sample from it. Prompting and changes to decoding reduce this mismatch only partly, which motivates training with policy optimization. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) is a natural fit for this problem because it already samples a group of rollouts per prompt, and the group's empirical distribution can be compared with the target. However, scoring the group as a whole gives every rollout the same reward. Group-relative centering then sets all advantages to zero, and the model receives no learning signal. To give each rollout its own signal, we introduce the witness advantage, a per-rollout advantage derived from maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). It trains a model to match a target distribution over a finite set of outcomes. The MMD between the model's distribution and the target has a witness function that measures how over- or under-produced each outcome is. Each rollout's advantage estimates the negative witness at its outcome, so a rollout is rewarded for an outcome the group under-produces and penalized for one it over-produces. The witness advantage is computed in closed form from the group's outcome counts, and we use it as the reward in GRPO. On unseen target distributions, training with the witness advantage substantially reduces the total variation distance to the target while largely preserving the model's general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"witness advantage"（见证优势），将最大均值差异（MMD）的见证函数引入GRPO，为组内每个rollout赋予独立优势信号，从而训练语言模型匹配指定目标分布，在未见分布上显著降低总变差距离。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多被要求从指定分布中采样（如模拟受访者、生成合成数据）。指令微调模型虽能正确描述分布，却无法真正从中采样；提示工程与解码策略调整只能部分缓解该不匹配，因此需要基于策略优化进行训练。GRPO天然适合此问题，因为它已对每个提示采样一组rollout，组内经验分布可与目标比较。但若把整组作为整体打分，所有rollout获得相同奖励，组相对中心化后优势全为零，模型得不到学习信号。
AI.method: 提出witness advantage：基于最大均值差异（MMD）的逐rollout优势。模型分布与目标分布之间的MMD具有见证函数，可衡量每个结果被过度或不足生成的程度。每个rollout的优势估计其对应结果处的负见证值：若某结果在组内被生成不足则给予奖励，被过度生成则给予惩罚。该优势可由组内结果计数以闭式形式计算，并直接用作GRPO中的奖励。
AI.result: 在未见过的目标分布上，使用witness advantage训练可大幅降低模型输出分布与目标分布之间的总变差距离，同时基本保持模型的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将MMD见证函数转化为逐rollout优势，witness advantage解决了GRPO在分布匹配任务中优势全零、缺乏学习信号的问题，是一种有效且对模型通用能力友好的分布匹配训练方法。

title: Don't Forget! Decomposing the Training Dynamics of Memorization in Language Models
summary: Memorization has been proposed as a mechanism to explain how language models fit the tail of their training distributions, but its training dynamics are not understood well. In this work, we take a fine-grained look at memorization by decomposing the loss trajectory of memorized sequences over training and model parameters. Across the Pythia family, we study memorization of duplicated training sequences (recitation) and rare ones (recollection). We find that memorization in both cases is characterized by sequence-level gradient alignment, though recitation suffers from misalignment with other training influences which causes forgetting, explaining the necessity for higher duplication of these examples. We further show that the lower model layers are the most involved in memorization and forgetting. Predicting memorization, our decomposition improves over a cross-entropy baseline, especially in larger models and early in training. Intervening on a small set of highly influential parameters we are able to ablate memorization in the final model. Together, these findings advance our understanding of how memorization develops during training and offer insights for predicting and intervening on it.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分解记忆序列在训练过程中的损失轨迹与模型参数，研究语言模型记忆的训练动态，发现记忆与"序列级梯度对齐"相关，且下层参数最为关键，并可据此预测和干预记忆。
AI.motivation: 记忆机制被用来解释语言模型如何拟合训练分布的尾部，但其训练动态尚不清楚，需要更细粒度的理解。
AI.method: 在Pythia模型家族上，将记忆序列的损失轨迹按训练过程和模型参数进行分解，研究重复训练序列（recitation，背诵）与稀有序列（recollection，回忆）两类记忆，分析梯度对齐、参数层级分布，并进行预测与干预实验。
AI.result: 两类记忆均表现为序列级梯度对齐；背诵因与其他训练影响失配而导致遗忘，故需更高重复次数。下层参数最参与记忆与遗忘。该分解在预测记忆上优于交叉熵基线，尤其在大模型和训练早期；干预少量高影响参数可消融最终模型的记忆。
AI.conclusion: 研究推进了对记忆在训练中如何发展的理解，并为预测和干预记忆提供了思路。

title: TaoTex: Boosting Texture Detail Fidelity for Native 3D Material Generation
summary: Recent 3D generation models can produce accurate geometries while still struggling to reconstruct detailed textures. We propose a diffusion-based native 3D material generation model TaoTex, which faithfully recovers intricate textures through tailored strategies and improvements. First, we develop a data construction agent to create high-frequency textured 3D assets to bridge the data gap in public datasets. Training with these data significantly enhances the ability of TaoTex to recover challenging details such as text and patterns. Second, we design a multi-level feature fusion (MLFF) module to adaptively integrate local and global features of the conditional input, providing more complete texture cues for the diffusion model and thereby enhancing reconstruction fidelity. To alleviate VAE reconstruction errors, we adopt a latent-to-pixel space loss transition, further improving the pixel-level details and generation quality. Finally, we scale TaoTex to multi-view inputs by incorporating learnable viewpoint embeddings, achieving accurate and consistent material reconstruction across views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in preserving texture details in both single- and multi-view settings.

AI.tldr: 提出基于扩散的原生3D材质生成模型TaoTex，通过数据构建、特征融合与损失空间转换等策略，高保真恢复3D纹理细节。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成模型能重建准确几何，但在纹理细节的重建上仍有不足，且公开数据集缺少高频纹理的3D资产，导致模型难以恢复文字、图案等挑战性细节。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建智能体生成高频纹理3D资产以弥补数据缺口；2) 多层级特征融合（MLFF）模块自适应整合条件输入的局部与全局特征，提供完整纹理线索；3) 采用潜空间到像素空间的损失转换以缓解VAE重建误差；4) 引入可学习视角嵌入，将模型扩展至多视角输入。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在单视角与多视角设置下，在保留纹理细节方面均显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据、特征融合、损失设计与多视角扩展的协同改进，TaoTex实现了原生3D材质的高保真生成，验证了各策略对纹理细节恢复的有效性。

title: Neural Language Models Learn the Contextual Distributions of Dependency Structures: a statistical learning theory to compositionality
summary: It is unclear how Neural Language Models (NLMs) acquire the structural meaning encoded by grammatical structures that is independent of lexical semantics. We propose a statistical learning process in which learned dependency structures themselves become new distributional units for subsequent statistical learning. Under this account, once a dependency structure is acquired, the model tracks its contextual distributions. These contextual features reflect the semantic properties of a composite structure. To test this hypothesis, we design a synthetic grammar in which each grammatical structure has distinct contextual distributions that cannot be recovered from the distributional statistics of their component tokens alone. We train a series of BERT-style masked language models on this grammar and examine their developmental trajectory. The results show that models can successfully learn the contextual distributions of composite dependency structures even though they cannot be inferred from token statistics alone. Developmental analysis further reveals a clear developmental trajectory. The learning of the dependency relations that define a grammatical structure consistently precedes the learning of its contextual features. These findings suggest that statistical learning in NLMs is not merely the accumulation of token co-occurrence statistics, but a process in which learned dependency structures become new units of distributional learning. We argue that this process provides a statistical-learning account of how NLMs solve the compositionality problem in language. Finally, we discuss the possibility that this statistical learning process provides an explanatory theory on how language cognition could emerge from pure distributional statistics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出，神经语言模型通过"将已习得的依存结构本身作为新的分布单元"的统计学习过程，获得独立于词汇语义的结构意义，并用合成语法实验验证了该假设。
AI.motivation: 神经语言模型如何习得独立于词汇语义、由语法结构编码的结构性意义，此前尚不清楚。核心问题在于：组合结构的意义无法仅从其组成词元的共现统计中还原，即组合性难题在纯分布统计框架下缺乏解释。
AI.method: 提出两阶段统计学习假设：一旦依存结构被习得，模型便将其作为新的分布单元，继续追踪其语境分布；这些语境特征反映复合结构的语义属性。为此设计一种合成语法，使每个语法结构具有独特的语境分布，且该分布无法由组成词元单独的分布统计推断。随后训练一系列BERT式掩码语言模型，并考察其发展轨迹。
AI.result: 模型能够成功习得复合依存结构的语境分布，尽管这些分布无法从词元统计中推断。发展性分析显示清晰的学习轨迹：定义某一语法结构的依存关系的学习，始终先于该结构语境特征的学习。
AI.conclusion: NLMs中的统计学习并非仅是词元共现统计的累积，而是已习得依存结构成为新的分布学习单元的过程。该过程为NLMs如何解决组合性问题提供了统计学习解释，并可能为语言认知如何从纯分布统计中涌现提供一种解释性理论。

title: Resolution as a First-Class Decision: Task-Conditioned Routing for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: The inference efficiency of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is severely constrained by massive visual token sequences induced by high-resolution inputs, with computational cost scaling quadratically. Existing approaches primarily focus on downstream token compression, while overlooking a fundamental upstream inefficiency: input resolution is treated as a static, task-agnostic hyperparameter. We propose Task-Conditioned Resolution Routing (TCRR), which formulates visual compression as a task-conditioned decision and employs a lightweight cross-modal router that conditions backbone visual representations on textual semantics via feature-wise modulation and cross-attention to predict the minimal sufficient compression level per query. To support this, we curate a dataset of 500k samples across 12 task categories, labeled via a teacher-oracle pipeline to approximate Pareto-optimal compression scales. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures show that TCRR achieves a superior efficiency frontier, specifically reducing visual FLOPs by 40.9% and latency by 53.7% on Qwen3-VL-8B while preserving competitive performance. Further analysis of scaling behavior confirms that dynamically routing visual compression enables optimal resource allocation without modifying the MLLM backbone.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出任务条件化分辨率路由（TCRR），将视觉压缩从下游令牌压缩转变为任务条件的上游决策，用轻量跨模态路由器为每个查询预测最小充分压缩级别，在Qwen3-VL-8B上减少40.9%视觉FLOPs和53.7%延迟，同时保持竞争力性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）因高分辨率输入产生的海量视觉令牌序列导致推理效率严重受限，计算成本随令牌数呈二次增长。现有方法主要关注下游令牌压缩，却忽视了上游根本性低效：输入分辨率被当作静态、与任务无关的超参数，未根据具体查询需求自适应调整。因此需要一种任务条件化的视觉压缩决策机制，在保证性能的前提下降低计算开销。
AI.method: 提出任务条件化分辨率路由（TCRR），将视觉压缩建模为任务条件决策。采用轻量跨模态路由器，通过特征级调制（feature-wise modulation）和交叉注意力（cross-attention）将骨干视觉表示条件化于文本语义，从而为每个查询预测最小充分压缩级别。为支持训练，构建了涵盖12个任务类别、50万样本的数据集，通过教师oracle流水线标注以近似帕累托最优压缩尺度。
AI.result: 在多种架构上的大量实验表明，TCRR实现了更优的效率前沿：在Qwen3-VL-8B上视觉FLOPs降低40.9%，延迟降低53.7%，同时保持有竞争力的性能。进一步的扩展行为分析证实，动态路由视觉压缩可在不修改MLLM骨干网络的情况下实现最优资源分配。
AI.conclusion: TCRR通过将输入分辨率的静态超参数设定转变为任务条件化的动态路由决策，有效解决了MLLMs上游视觉压缩的效率瓶颈。该方法在不改动骨干网络的前提下实现了更优的效率-性能权衡，验证了动态视觉压缩路由在资源分配上的有效性，为多模态推理加速提供了新思路。

title: Adjoint Guidance Flow: Amortized Critic Guidance for VLA Policies
summary: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically trained by behavior cloning and thus do not explicitly optimize long-term task return. Critic guidance steers generation toward higher-value actions, but existing methods differentiate the critic through a one-step surrogate of the sampler and back-propagate a critic ensemble at every flow step. In contrast, here we propose Adjoint Guidance Flow (AGF), which amortizes trajectory-aware critic guidance into a lightweight guidance network while preserving the pretrained VLA policy. Specifically, we formulate critic-guided flow generation as a deterministic optimal control problem, whose optimal guidance is a costate that carries the terminal critic gradient back through the remaining flow, and regress the guidance network onto this costate while keeping both the VLA and critic frozen. This design provides favorable memory and throughput scaling during training, and inference needs one guidance-network forward pass per step, without the critic ensemble, back-propagation, or adjoint computation. Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and LIBERO-Pro, AGF consistently improves pretrained VLAs, remains competitive with critic-guidance and policy-fine-tuning baselines, and is the most robust method when a single guidance strength is deployed across tasks. Compared with QGF, AGF runs $3.6\times$ faster per guidance step with $7.0\times$ fewer parameters, with comparable and even better performance, showing that critic guidance can be trajectory-aware and lightweight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Adjoint Guidance Flow (AGF)，将轨迹感知的 critic 引导摊销进一个轻量引导网络，在保持预训练 VLA 与 critic 冻结的情况下实现高效、低成本的价值引导流生成。
AI.motivation: 基于流的 VLA 策略通常通过行为克隆训练，未显式优化长期任务回报；现有 critic 引导方法用采样器的一步代理来微分 critic，并在每个流步骤反向传播 critic 集成，导致计算与内存开销大。
AI.method: 将 critic 引导的流生成建模为确定性最优控制问题，其最优引导为携带终端 critic 梯度沿剩余流回传的协态（costate）；在冻结 VLA 与 critic 的前提下，用轻量引导网络回归该协态，从而摊销轨迹感知的 critic 引导。推理时每步仅需一次引导网络前向，无需 critic 集成、反向传播或伴随计算。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、RoboCasa 和 LIBERO-Pro 上，AGF 稳定提升预训练 VLA 性能，与 critic 引导及策略微调基线相当，并且在跨任务使用单一引导强度时最为鲁棒；相比 QGF，每引导步快 3.6 倍、参数少 7.0 倍，性能相当甚至更优。
AI.conclusion: critic 引导可以是轨迹感知且轻量的，AGF 在训练时具备良好的内存与吞吐扩展性，推理时高效，证明了将轨迹级引导摊销进轻量网络的可行性与优越性。

title: Semantic Uncertainty Quantification Needs Factual Equivalence
summary: Semantic uncertainty quantification for large language models rests on a common template: sample several answers, measure how much they agree, and treat disagreement as uncertainty. We first formalize this template as two separate roles: an operator that compares two answers, and an aggregator that combines all pairwise comparisons into a scalar. Existing methods differ almost entirely in how they aggregate, while taking the operator off the shelf, typically an NLI model or a generic sentence encoder. We show that this reliance on off-the-shelf operators is the primary bottleneck of semantic UQ: they do not accurately measure factual equivalence of multiple answers to the same question. We resolve this with a deliberately simple recipe: a single encoder trained contrastively to isolate the targeted fact, utilizing synthetic data generated by an LLM and dataset both disjoint from all evaluation settings. Integrating the resulting operator into existing methods improves performance on 120 of 126 evaluation settings (95%) spanning 18 model dataset combinations across language and vision-language models. The best variant reaches 0.76 mean AUROC against 0.68 for the strongest baseline, while replacing the quadratic cross-encoder comparisons of entailment-based operators with one encoder pass per answer. The uniformity of the improvement supports the view that the operator, not the aggregator, is the limiting factor. The same operator also improves single generation token-level estimators: the norm it assigns to each token measures how much that token bears on the answer, and reweighting token log-likelihoods accordingly sharpens the estimate.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出语义不确定性量化（UQ）的瓶颈在于“算子”而非“聚合器”，并训练了一个对比学习编码器作为算子，在126个评测设置中的120个（95%）上提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 现有语义UQ方法沿用“采样多个答案—衡量一致性—以不一致度作为不确定性”的模板，并把它拆解为两个角色：比较两个答案的算子，以及将成对比较聚合成标量的聚合器。既有方法几乎只在聚合方式上做区分，算子则直接采用现成的NLI模型或通用句编码器。作者认为这种对现成算子的依赖是语义UQ的主要瓶颈，因为它们无法准确衡量同一问题多个答案之间的事实等价性。
AI.method: 作者将该模板形式化为算子与聚合器两个角色，并设计了一个刻意简单的方案：训练单个编码器，用对比学习方式隔离目标事实。训练数据由LLM生成的合成数据构成，且所用数据与评测设置完全不相交。将得到的算子集成进现有UQ方法中。
AI.result: 在18个模型-数据集组合、共126个评测设置中，有120个（95%）性能得到提升，覆盖语言模型与视觉语言模型。最佳变体达到0.76平均AUROC，而最强基线为0.68；同时用每个答案一次编码器前向替代了基于蕴含的算子所需的二次方级交叉编码器比较。该算子还能改进单次生成的token级估计器：它为每个token赋予的范数衡量该token对答案的贡献程度，据此对token对数似然加权可提升估计精度。
AI.conclusion: 提升的普遍性支持“限制因素是算子而非聚合器”这一观点。通过对比学习训练一个轻量、专门化的算子，即可在广泛设置下稳定提升语义UQ性能，并兼具计算效率优势，同时对token级不确定性估计也有增益。

title: See it, Say it, Sorted: Mechanistic Diagnosis and Parameter-Space Mitigation of Emergent Misalignment in LLMs
summary: Safety-aligned LLMs can exhibit emergent misalignment (EM): narrow domain adaptation unexpectedly triggers catastrophic safety failures across unrelated domains. Prior static analyses leave training dynamics unmapped, while existing defenses rely on heuristics that degrade utility. We present a dynamic, second-order geometric study of EM. Tracking training trajectories reveals that directional Hessian curvature concentrates sharply on semantic pivot tokens. Grassmannian projections show that, in most settings, harmful-safe gap widens mainly because safe-gradient overlap declines. Leveraging these insights, we introduce a parameter-level Geometric Mitigation Framework that orthogonally projects empirical harmful gradient subspace out of parameter updates. On Qwen2.5-14B-IT, our defense suppresses free-generation EM by up to 80.0%; across the other three of four open-weight instruction-based model families (3B--20B), where single-layer behavioral EM is already near zero, teacher-forced evaluation shows same harmful subspace controls the conditional support of frozen EM responses. Crucially, these diagnostics unmask the illusion of behavioral safety: the same subspace remains measurable and steerable in models where behavioral EM is near zero. Code: https://github.com/WeiqiaoQUE/mechanistic-emergent-misalignment.

AI.tldr: 该文对安全对齐大模型的涌现失配（EM）进行二阶几何动力学研究，发现方向Hessian曲率集中于语义枢纽token，安全梯度重叠下降导致有害-安全间隔扩大，并提出参数级几何缓解框架，在Qwen2.5-14B-IT上将自由生成EM抑制最高达80.0%。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐LLM存在涌现失配（EM）：狭窄领域适配会意外触发跨无关领域的灾难性安全失效。已有静态分析未刻画训练动力学，现有防御依赖启发式方法且损害模型效用。因此需要从训练动力学角度理解EM机制，并据此设计低效用损失的防御方案。
AI.method: 提出动态二阶几何研究：追踪训练轨迹，分析方向Hessian曲率在语义枢纽token上的集中现象；利用Grassmannian投影分析有害-安全间隔变化来源。基于此提出参数级几何缓解框架（Geometric Mitigation Framework），将经验有害梯度子空间从参数更新中正交投影剔除。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-14B-IT上，防御将自由生成EM抑制最高达80.0%。在四个开放权重指令模型家族中的另外三个（3B–20B，单层行为EM已接近零），教师强制评估显示同一有害子空间控制冻结EM响应的条件支持。诊断进一步揭示：在行为EM接近零的模型中，该子空间仍可测量、可操控，即行为安全存在"安全假象"。
AI.conclusion: EM具有可解释的二阶几何结构：曲率集中于语义枢纽token，失配扩大主要源于安全梯度重叠下降。参数级正交投影可有效抑制EM且保持效用，同时揭示了行为安全指标掩盖潜在可操控有害子空间的风险，为更可靠的机制级安全评估与防御提供依据。

title: Just MLPs: Efficient Visual State Reconstruction for Multimodal Language Models
summary: Long visual token sequences often account for a substantial fraction of the computational overhead in multimodal large language models~(MLLMs). Existing approaches reduce this cost by pruning redundant visual tokens, but permanently discard visual evidence that may become useful in subsequent layers. We instead ask whether all visual tokens can be preserved while reducing the cost of repeatedly evolving the representations through the Transformer. To answer this question, we perform low-rank interventions on visual-to-text information flow. We find that, after visual-to-text attention is blocked, restoring only a few directions recovers most of the lost accuracy, suggesting the relevant visual influence is concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace. We further observe strong predictability in layer-specific visual states: lightweight MLPs approximate them with high cosine similarity and low reconstruction error. Motivated by these findings, we propose $δ$-Vision, which replaces repeated Transformer evolution of visual tokens with lightweight low-rank adapters that construct layer-wise visual memories while preserving all visual tokens for text retrieval. Across image and video benchmarks, $δ$-Vision achieves higher accuracy than visual token pruning baselines at comparable or lower computation, while delivering competitive inference efficiency without discarding visual tokens.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出δ-Vision:不删除任何视觉token,而是用轻量低秩适配器构建逐层视觉记忆,替代Transformer对视觉token的重复演化,在图像与视频任务上以相当或更低算力超过视觉token剪枝基线,同时保持推理效率。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)中长视觉token序列占据大量计算开销。现有方法通过剪枝冗余视觉token降低成本,但会永久丢弃后续层可能仍然有用的视觉证据。作者希望在不丢弃任何视觉token的前提下,降低"反复通过Transformer演化视觉表示"的成本。
AI.method: 作者对"视觉→文本"信息流进行低秩干预分析:(1)阻断视觉到文本的注意力后,仅恢复少数方向即可找回大部分丢失的准确率,说明有效视觉影响集中于低维子空间;(2)发现逐层视觉状态具有强可预测性,轻量MLP即可高余弦相似度、低重构误差地逼近。据此提出δ-Vision:保留全部视觉token供文本检索,用轻量低秩适配器构建逐层视觉记忆,替代视觉token在Transformer中的重复演化。
AI.result: 在图像与视频基准上,δ-Vision在相当或更低的计算量下取得高于视觉token剪枝基线的准确率,并在不丢弃视觉token的情况下提供有竞争力的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 视觉信息流可由低维子空间承载,且逐层视觉状态可被轻量预测,因此无需剪枝视觉token;用低秩适配器构造视觉记忆是一种兼顾精度与效率的MLLM加速范式。

title: Inspector: Conversational and Lightweight Analyzer of Analog Circuit Layouts Using LLM and CNNs
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables, to be published in ICLAD 2026
summary: The integration of artificial intelligence into computer-aided design frameworks has sparked a shift in the design of analog integrated circuits (ICs), transitioning the field from using manual and algorithmic-based solutions to adopting automated and intelligent paradigms. In this scenario, the GDSII file represents the industry-standard database containing the ultimate and most accurate source of information of the analog circuit, encapsulating the complex physical geometries and parasitic realities that define tape out performance. This paper proposes a novel framework that combines fine-tuned LLMs and CNNs to analyze GDSII files of analog circuits, enabling a conversational interface between the tool and the designers. Experimental results using thousands of analog designs across four realistic tasks demonstrate that the proposed solution outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose massive VLMs by a significant margin (up to 81%), thus providing a lightweight solution to the problem of GDSII analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结合微调LLM与CNN的框架，用于分析模拟集成电路的GDSII文件，并实现与设计者的对话式交互，在四项真实任务上显著优于通用大规模VLM（最高提升81%）。
AI.motivation: AI融入计算机辅助设计使模拟IC设计从手工与算法方案转向自动化、智能化范式；GDSII作为行业标准数据库，包含模拟电路最精确的物理几何与寄生信息，直接决定流片性能，但缺乏轻量、有效的分析手段与交互方式。
AI.method: 将微调后的大语言模型（LLM）与卷积神经网络（CNN）相结合，构建新颖框架来解析模拟电路的GDSII文件，并在工具与设计者之间建立对话式交互界面。
AI.result: 在覆盖四项真实任务的数千个模拟设计上进行实验，所提方案相比最先进的通用大规模视觉语言模型（VLM）取得显著优势，性能提升最高达81%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为GDSII分析提供了一种轻量化解决方案，验证了专用微调模型在模拟IC设计自动化与智能交互中的有效性与优越性。

title: SPIDER: Multi-Layer Semantic Token Pruning and Adaptive Sub-Layer Skipping in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models face significant efficiency challenges that stem from two distinct yet coupled sources: data redundancy and computational redundancy. While most methods focus on data redundancy by pruning visual tokens from the output of the visual encoder or computing redundancy in LLM decoders using blockwise importance, the finer-grained inter-layer representation shifts and the distribution differences within the layers themselves have not been fully explored. In this work, we comprehensively investigate this dual-level inefficiency. We posit that intermediate layer tokens from vision encoders should be considered for effective visual token pruning, as semantic focus shifts across layers, with middle-layer tokens capturing more detailed object-centric information that deeper layers may abstract away. Furthermore, we reveal the differential contributions of Attention and FFNs across distinct LLM decoder layers. Building upon these discoveries, we propose \textbf{SPIDER}, a training-free framework that integrates multi-layer \underline{\textbf{S}}emantic visual token \underline{\textbf{P}}run\underline{\textbf{I}}ng with an a\underline{\textbf{D}}aptive sub-lay\underline{\textbf{ER}} skipping mechanism. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that SPIDER consistently maintains strong performance across various MLLM architectures and reduction ratios. For instance, on LLaVA-NeXT-7B, SPIDER reduces FLOPs by $79\%$ while maintaining 96$\%$ of the baseline performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPIDER——一种免训练框架，通过多层语义视觉token剪枝与自适应子层跳过机制，同时解决多模态大模型中的数据冗余和计算冗余问题，在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上减少79% FLOPs并保持96%基线性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型存在两类耦合的效率瓶颈：数据冗余与计算冗余。现有方法多聚焦于视觉编码器输出的token剪枝，或在LLM解码器中使用块级重要性评估计算冗余，但尚未充分探究层间表示漂移（inter-layer representation shifts）以及层内分布差异这两个更细粒度的问题。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架SPIDER，融合两种机制：（1）多层语义视觉token剪枝——基于视觉编码器中间层token应被纳入剪枝的观察，因语义焦点随层数迁移，中间层token包含更细粒度的物体中心信息，而深层可能将其抽象化；（2）自适应子层跳过机制——依据注意力模块与前馈网络在不同LLM解码器层中的差异化贡献进行子层级跳过。
AI.result: 在多种MLLM架构和不同压缩比下，SPIDER均能稳定保持较强性能。例如在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上，FLOPs降低79%的同时保留了96%的基线性能。
AI.conclusion: SPIDER通过同时处理数据冗余与计算冗余的双层低效问题，验证了中间层视觉token在剪枝中的价值以及注意力/FFN的层间差异贡献，为MLLM高效推理提供了一种免训练、可泛化的解决方案。

title: One Sensor, Whole Body - 3D Body Pose from a Single Consumer Earbud IMU
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 6th International Workshop on Human-centric Multimedia Analysis (HUMA '26), ACM Multimedia 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Code: https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/one-sensor-whole-body
summary: Consumer earbuds already stream inertial motion data from the head, one of the most widely worn sensor locations on the body. We ask how much of the 3D body pose a single such head IMU can recover, and whether adding more consumer sensors actually helps. We build a multimodal capture pipeline that records four-view RGB-D video together with an AirPods head IMU and two Striv insole IMUs, synchronize the streams post-hoc, and generate pseudo-ground-truth with SAM 3D Body, yielding a 35-take single-subject benchmark spanning gait, turning, vertical, everyday, and clinically inspired motions. Adapting two recurrent model families (IMUPoser and MobilePoser), we show that one head IMU recovers lower-body pose at 79.0 mm rigid-MPJPE and per-foot ground contact at 0.809 macro-F1, and that a causal variant retains most of this accuracy at streaming latency. In paired per-take significance tests across both families, adding the consumer foot IMUs never significantly improves pose and significantly degrades it in two of four model-split combinations; a mounting-bias probe and feet-only ablation identify insole orientation quality, not foot placement, as the mechanism. Extending the output to a 20-joint full-body skeleton maps the boundary: gross distal-arm motion is partially recoverable from the head alone, proximal upper-body pose is not, and staged fine-tuning recovers the leg accuracy that naive joint training sacrifices to multi-task dilution. For learned pose from consumer wearables, sensor reliability, not sensor count, is the binding constraint here. For the devices tested, the earbud is its sweet spot. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/one-sensor-whole-body.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究单个消费级耳机头戴IMU能恢复多少3D全身姿态，并检验增加消费级传感器是否真正有益。
AI.motivation: 消费级耳机（如AirPods）已能采集头部惯性运动数据，头部是人体最常佩戴传感器的位置之一。作者希望探究单个头部IMU对3D人体姿态的恢复能力边界，以及增加更多消费级传感器（如鞋垫IMU）是否真能提升性能，从而明确消费级可穿戴设备做姿态估计的关键约束。
AI.method: 构建多模态采集管线：同步记录四视角RGB-D视频、AirPods头部IMU和两个Striv鞋垫IMU，事后对齐数据流，并用SAM 3D Body生成伪真值，得到涵盖步态、转身、垂直、日常及临床启发动作的35段单被试基准。适配两个循环模型家族（IMUPoser和MobilePoser），并加入因果变体以支持流式低延迟。通过逐段配对显著性检验、佩戴偏差探针及仅脚部消融，分析增加脚部IMU的影响机制。进一步扩展到20关节全身骨架，采用分阶段微调。
AI.result: 单个头部IMU可恢复下半身姿态，刚体MPJPE为79.0 mm，每只脚接地检测macro-F1为0.809，因果变体在流式延迟下保留大部分精度。在配对逐段显著性检验中，增加消费级脚部IMU从未显著提升姿态，且在四种模型-划分组合中有两种显著变差；佩戴偏差探针和仅脚部消融表明机制在于鞋垫朝向质量而非脚部位置。扩展到20关节全身骨架后发现：仅凭头部可部分恢复远端手臂的粗略运动，但无法恢复近端上半身姿态；分阶段微调可挽回朴素联合训练因多任务稀释而损失的腿部精度。
AI.conclusion: 对于基于消费级可穿戴设备的姿态学习，传感器可靠性而非传感器数量才是此处的约束瓶颈。在所测试的设备中，耳机是性能的"最佳平衡点"（sweet spot）。

title: What Makes World Action Models Generalize? An Empirical Study of Test-Time Future Modeling
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict the future alongside actions during training. Due to the heavy computation cost of video denoising, whether the future must still be generated during inference is disputed: Explicit WAMs denoise it into clean frames along with every action chunk, whereas Latent WAMs discard it entirely for acceleration. We find that latent WAMs, despite matching explicit ones on in-distribution tasks, fail to retain the generalization benefits that originally motivated WAMs. To demonstrate this, we evaluate generalization along three axes: environmental perturbation, data efficiency, and task generalization. Controlled comparisons with a matched backbone, training data, and budget reveal consistent degradation across all three axes when the action expert no longer conditions on future representations. Further analysis shows that the gap arises almost entirely from the first denoising step: the benefit comes from preparing the future, not generating it. We therefore propose Simple-WAM, which simplifies future modeling into a single forward pass of fully noised video tokens and adapts the training-time noise schedule to this inference behavior. Across simulation and real-world tasks, Simple-WAM achieves the best of both worlds, leading explicit WAMs in generalization performance with efficiency comparable to Latent WAMs. Project Page: https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web/

AI.tldr: 该论文发现隐式世界动作模型（Latent WAM）虽然高效，但丢失了显式WAM的泛化优势；分析表明该优势几乎全部来自首个去噪步，据此提出Simple-WAM，在泛化性与效率上兼得。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）在训练时同时预测未来与动作。由于视频去噪计算开销大，推理时是否仍需生成未来存在争议：显式WAM（Explicit WAM）为每个动作块去噪出清晰帧，而隐式WAM（Latent WAM）为加速完全丢弃未来。作者质疑隐式WAM是否仍保留WAM最初被提出时的泛化收益。
AI.method: 沿三条泛化轴进行评估：环境扰动、数据效率、任务泛化。在匹配的主干网络、训练数据与预算下进行受控对比。进一步分析泛化差距的来源，定位到第一个去噪步。据此提出Simple-WAM：将未来建模简化为对完全加噪视频 token 的单次前向传播，并使训练时噪声调度适配该推理行为。
AI.result: 受控对比显示，当动作专家不再以未来表示作为条件时，三条泛化轴均出现一致的性能退化。分析表明差距几乎完全源于第一个去噪步——收益来自“准备未来”，而非“生成未来”。在仿真与真实任务中，Simple-WAM取得两者兼得的效果：泛化性能领先显式WAM，效率与隐式WAM相当。
AI.conclusion: 推理时无需完整生成未来视频；关键在于首个去噪步对未来表示的“准备”。Simple-WAM以单次前向传播与适配的噪声调度实现泛化与效率的最佳折中，兼顾显式WAM的泛化优势与隐式WAM的计算效率。

title: ActionUNet: Improving Robustness of VLA Models with Efficient Multi-scale Fine-tuning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown great promise for robotic manipulation by mapping multi-modal semantics to physical actions. However, this mapping inherently struggles to align these coarse-grained semantics with fine-grained temporal execution. It leaves VLA models with limited generalization and insufficient robustness in cluttered environments. To overcome this issue, we propose ActionUNet, an efficient multi-scale fine-tuning framework that enhances pre-trained VLA models with minimal computational cost. ActionUNet first constructs a lightweight temporal U-Net within the temporal-aligned action feature space to fuse hierarchical structural priors, effectively bridging the scale gap between semantics and temporal executions. Recognizing that multi-scale modeling can disrupt microscopic temporal continuity and cause mechanical oscillations, ActionUNet then employs a conditional SIREN as a continuous action decoder. Equipped with explicit second-order smoothness constraints, this decoder guarantees temporal continuity and reduces high-frequency motion jitter. By smoothing temporal discontinuities from multi-scale fusion, this continuous formulation reduces mechanical execution failures while preserving the base VLA model's generalization and manipulation robustness. Extensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks, together with real-world hard evaluations, demonstrate that ActionUNet significantly improves π0.5 success rates by absolute 9.8%, 6.1%, and 11.4%, respectively, while also generalizing to the regression-based OpenVLA-OFT backbone, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency as a fine-tuning strategy. Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/Di-Zhu123/ActionUNet.

AI.tldr: 提出 ActionUNet 多尺度微调框架，在不改动预训练 VLA 主干的前提下，用时序 U-Net 融合层次结构先验、用条件 SIREN 解码器保证动作时序连续，显著提升 π0.5 在多个基准上的成功率并具跨主干泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型将多模态语义映射为物理动作时，难以把粗粒度语义与细粒度时序执行对齐，导致在杂乱环境中的泛化能力有限、鲁棒性不足；同时在多尺度建模中容易破坏微观时序连续性，引发机械振荡。
AI.method: ActionUNet 是一个高效多尺度微调框架：1) 在时序对齐的动作特征空间内构建轻量级时序 U-Net，融合层次化结构先验，弥合语义与执行之间的尺度鸿沟；2) 采用条件 SIREN 作为连续动作解码器，并引入显式二阶平滑约束，保证时序连续性、抑制高频抖动；3) 通过连续化建模平滑多尺度融合带来的时序不连续，仅在微调层面增强预训练 VLA，计算开销极小。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-Plus 及真实世界困难评测中，ActionUNet 将 π0.5 成功率分别绝对提升 9.8%、6.1%、11.4%；并同样适用于基于回归的 OpenVLA-OFT 主干，验证了其作为微调策略的有效性与高效性。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度时序结构先验与连续动作解码相结合，可在极低计算成本下缓解 VLA 语义-执行尺度不对齐问题，在保持主干泛化与操作鲁棒性的同时提升执行成功率，具有跨主干通用性。

title: ORPG: Reconciling Multiple Reward Objectives through Objective-wise Policy Gradients
summary: Multi-reward policy optimization requires a joint update that reflects both the learning signals and the intended relationships among objectives. We introduce Objective-wise Reconciled Policy Gradient (ORPG), which constructs a separate clipped policy objective for each reward and reconciles the resulting gradients into one policy update. For compatible gradients, a cosine-dependent interpolation coordinates their contributions through a partially normalized reference while preserving the norm of their sum. We characterize this update as the unique solution of a spherical directional compromise. For conflicting gradients, projection follows the task's priorities. We evaluate the same compatible rule in helpfulness--safety alignment and correctness--cost optimization for mathematical reasoning. ORPG substantially improves average Useful and Harmless scores over the strongest external baseline on each axis. In mathematics, it achieves the highest average full-budget accuracy and three-budget hypervolume among the compared methods, with more accurate and shorter responses than the initial policy. Component comparisons and training dynamics show the larger contribution of compatible coordination and a complementary benefit from conflict handling. These results support gradient reconciliation for objectives with equal standing and for objectives with an explicit priority.

AI.tldr: 本文提出目标级调和策略梯度（ORPG），为每个奖励构建独立的裁剪策略目标，并将梯度调和为单一策略更新：兼容梯度用余弦相关的插值协调，冲突梯度按任务优先级投影。
AI.motivation: 多奖励策略优化需要同时反映各目标的学习信号及其预期关系，而现有方法难以在联合更新中兼顾兼容与冲突梯度的不同处理需求。
AI.method: ORPG 为每个奖励分别构造裁剪策略目标，再将其梯度调和为一次策略更新。对兼容梯度，采用余弦相关插值，通过部分归一化参考协调各贡献并保持其和的范数，该更新被刻画为球面方向折衷的唯一解；对冲突梯度，按任务优先级进行投影。
AI.result: 在有用性—安全性对齐与数学推理的正确性—成本优化中评估同一兼容规则。ORPG 在两个轴向上的平均 Useful 与 Harmless 分数均显著优于最强外部基线；在数学任务上取得最高平均全预算准确率与三预算超体积，且相比初始策略响应更准确、更简短。
AI.conclusion: 组件对比与训练动态表明兼容协调贡献更大，冲突处理提供互补收益，结果支持对地位平等目标及具有明确优先级目标进行梯度调和。

title: Nürnberg NLP at ChildSafeAds 2026: Structurally Dissimilar Voter Ensembles under Four Levels of Data Access
comment: Accepted at the ChildSafeAds 2026 Shared Task @ NLLP Workshop, EMNLP 2026 (1st place in 2 of 3 subtasks)
summary: We describe the Nürnberg NLP system for ChildSafeAds 2026. The shared task asks what a monitoring system for commercial content in child-facing YouTube videos can achieve at a given level of data access. We answer with per-subtask ensembles of nine voters, organised into three branches that differ in backbone, adaptation method and class scope. Selection rests on channel-disjoint cross-validation, with the development set as a transfer check. The system wins two of the three subtasks. Its product-category score (ST2, 0.8243) and its compliance-flag score (ST3, 0.6530) are the best of the 22 final entries, and it places third on the task mean (0.7079). We further compare four access levels and report the cost at test-set scale.

AI.tldr: 本文描述了用于ChildSafeAds 2026共享任务的Nürnberg NLP系统，该系统通过九投票者集成和三分支架构，在三个子任务中的两个上获胜。
AI.motivation: 共享任务探讨在特定数据访问水平下，面向儿童的YouTube视频中商业内容监测系统能够达到什么效果。
AI.method: 采用每子任务九个投票者的集成方法，组织为三个分支，在骨干模型、适配方法和类别范围上有所不同；选择基于频道不相交的交叉验证，并使用开发集作为迁移检查。
AI.result: 系统在三个子任务中的两个上获胜；产品类别得分（ST2, 0.8243）和合规标志得分（ST3, 0.6530）在22个最终参赛作品中最佳，任务平均分为0.7079，排名第三；此外比较了四种访问级别并报告了测试集规模下的成本。
AI.conclusion: 该系统在ChildSafeAds 2026共享任务中表现优异，验证了集成方法在商业内容监测中的有效性。

title: The Right Lesson at the Right Step: Deriving Control Updates for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents improve future behavior by reusing past experience, typically as global prompts, memories, or reflections. Yet these mechanisms rarely control where experience takes effect. In long tool-use workflows, the same lesson may correct one decision but distract another, making experience reuse a problem of localized control rather than memory alone. We introduce EvoCUE (Evolution through Control Updates from Evidence), a framework for learning reusable control-program updates from completed agent executions. EvoCUE represents the agent as an explicit state-machine controller, whose nodes perform model or tool calls and whose edges define where control passes next. This makes the workflow editable at precise locations, so each learned update can specify what to add, where it acts, and when it applies. From completed trajectories, EvoCUE uses residual goals and observed execution traces to propose localized instruction or skill edits. Each candidate is evaluated at the point where it would act by resuming the parent and edited controllers from the same checkpoint and comparing their final outcomes. Accepted edits are compiled with applicability rules, confirmed on held-out tasks, and inherited by later executions. We evaluate EvoCUE on long tool-use environments where learned conventions must reach the right execution step. From a minimal AppWorld controller without benchmark-specific onboarding instructions, EvoCUE learns the missing task-completion convention and substantially improves success on Test-Normal and Test-Challenge. On PAST-Bench office workflows, EvoCUE transfers organizational requirements from prior episodes to later tasks, improving task-execution quality. These results show that self-evolving agents should place experience inside the control flow, rather than only store it as text.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoCUE 框架，将自进化智能体的经验复用从"文本记忆"转变为"控制流中的局部编辑"，在长工具调用工作流中显著提升任务成功率与执行质量。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化智能体通常把过去经验以全局提示、记忆或反思的形式复用，但这类机制几乎无法控制经验在何处生效。在长工具调用工作流中，同一条经验可能在某个决策点纠正错误，却在另一个决策点造成干扰。因此，经验复用本质上不是单纯的记忆问题，而是"局部化控制"问题——需要精确决定经验作用于哪一步、何时生效。
AI.method: EvoCUE 将智能体显式建模为状态机控制器：节点执行模型调用或工具调用，边定义控制转移路径，从而使工作流可在精确位置被编辑。基于已完成轨迹，利用残差目标与执行轨迹提出局部化的指令或技能修改候选；对每个候选，在父控制器与编辑后控制器的同一检查点恢复执行并比较最终结果，以在其实际作用点进行评估。被接受的编辑附带适用性规则进行编译，并在留出任务上确认后由后续执行继承。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 上，从一个不含基准特定引导指令的最小控制器出发，EvoCUE 学习到缺失的任务完成约定，在 Test-Normal 与 Test-Challenge 上大幅提升成功率。在 PAST-Bench 办公工作流上，EvoCUE 将组织性要求从先前回合迁移到后续任务，提升了任务执行质量。
AI.conclusion: 自进化智能体应把经验置于控制流内部，而非仅作为文本存储。通过将经验转化为带位置与适用条件的控制程序更新，可实现更精确、可迁移、可验证的经验复用。

title: Still There, No Longer Seen: Exposing Compression-Induced Risk in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Visual token compression reduces the inference cost of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). However, aggregate robustness measures do not reveal whether a particular adversarial failure is induced by compression or inherited from the underlying model. We define a compression-specific failure (CSF) as an adversarial input that remains correct under full-token inference but fails after compression, casting compression-induced risk as a paired failure attribution problem. Within a controlled diagnostic cohort, counterfactuals show that retained-set allocation causally changes compressed correctness and reveal a negative association between recovery and representation drift in displaced evidence. Motivated by these findings, we propose CIRA, a Compression-Induced Risk Attack for Large Vision-Language Models. Under a vision-encoder white-box setting, CIRA optimizes image perturbations through encoder-side objectives that manipulate token priorities across candidate compression budgets while preserving displaced evidence. CIRA uses no downstream questions or labels and requires no access to the language model, deployed compressor, or exact compression budget. Across 12 dataset-compressor settings evaluated at four budgets, CIRA achieves a mean CSFR of 20.35% while limiting full-token attack success to 6.92%, with similar behavior on additional LVLM families. A cross-view selection-stabilization defense substantially suppresses CIRA, although Adaptive CIRA partially restores its effectiveness. These results show that compression-specific failures persist under restricted access and support paired evaluation of full-token and compressed inference for attributing risk to visual-token compression.

AI.tldr: 本文将视觉token压缩引发的对抗风险建模为“配对失败归因”问题，提出压缩特异性失败（CSF）定义及CIRA攻击与防御评估。
AI.motivation: 现有聚合鲁棒性指标无法区分对抗失败是由压缩引起还是源于底层模型本身，缺乏对压缩诱发风险的精确归因，因此需要配对评估全token与压缩推理。
AI.method: 定义CSF（全token正确、压缩后失败）；在受控诊断队列中用反事实分析保留集分配与表征漂移；在视觉编码器白盒设定下提出CIRA，通过编码器侧目标优化图像扰动，操控候选压缩预算下的token优先级并保留被位移证据，不需下游问题/标签、语言模型、部署压缩器或精确预算；并设计跨视图选择-稳定化防御。
AI.result: 在12个数据集-压缩器设置、4种预算下，CIRA平均CSFR达20.35%，同时全token攻击成功率仅6.92%；在其他LVLM家族表现类似。跨视图防御显著抑制CIRA，但自适应CIRA可部分恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: 压缩特异性失败在受限访问条件下依然存在，支持用全token与压缩推理的配对评估来将风险归因于视觉token压缩，并凸显压缩环节自身的安全隐患。

title: Verifying the Linear Representation Hypothesis: How Interpretable Are Vision SAEs?
comment: 28 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables, preprint under review
summary: Vision Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have become a popular tool in Mechanistic Interpretability due to their presumed ability to disentangle complex features learned by a model into monosemantic concepts. Despite their growing popularity, evaluating their interpretability remains an active topic of research. The bedrock motivating the adoption of SAEs is the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which claims that polysemantic features can be projected onto a (near) orthogonal basis of sparse, human-understandable representations. Yet, most current frameworks evaluate proxies such as the sparsity of SAE features or the coherence of the inferred dictionary, implicitly assuming that these reflect alignment with human perception. In this paper, we provide empirical evidence that measuring the interpretability of SAE concepts is more difficult than these proxies suggest. To this end, we adapt the Autointerpretability Score (AIS) - previously shown to align with human judgments in Natural Language Processing - to vision tasks and validate our approach in a dedicated user study. We evaluate SAE concept quality using both standard metrics and our adapted AIS. We find that established interpretability metrics for SAEs correlate neither with one another nor with AIS, indicating that no single reference-free metric, whether grounded in the LRH or not, is sufficient for verifying the interpretability of vision SAEs. We argue these findings support recent calls for more verifiable, ground-truth-anchored design and evaluation of explanation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文实证表明，视觉SAE的可解释性评估比现有代理指标所暗示的更为困难：常用指标之间以及与适配后的自动可解释性评分（AIS）之间均不相关，单一无参考指标不足以验证视觉SAE的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 视觉稀疏自编码器（SAE）因被假定能将模型学到的复杂特征解耦为单义概念而在机制可解释性中流行，其理论基础是线性表征假设（LRH）。然而当前多数评估框架衡量的是稀疏性或字典一致性等代理指标，隐含假设这些指标能反映与人类感知的对齐。本文质疑该假设，旨在检验视觉SAE概念可解释性评估的可靠性。
AI.method: 作者将原本在自然语言处理中已被证明与人类判断一致的自动可解释性评分（AIS）适配到视觉任务，并通过专门的用户研究验证该适配方法。随后，他们同时使用标准指标与适配后的AIS评估SAE概念质量。
AI.result: 实验发现，既有的SAE可解释性指标彼此之间不相关，且与AIS也不相关，说明无论是基于LRH还是非基于LRH的单一无参考指标，都不足以验证视觉SAE的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现支持近期关于解释方法应更具可验证性、并以真实标注（ground-truth）为锚进行设计与评估的呼吁。

title: Detection of Adversarial Attacks on Super-Resolvers Using Spectral Features
comment: To be published in the 2026 Asilomar Conference on Signals, Systems, and Computers
summary: The integration of deep learning models into image preprocessing pipelines such as super-resolution introduces a largely unexplored attack vector for adversaries targeting downstream tasks. To ensure trustworthiness of critical imaging pipelines, we must be able to detect adversarial behavior within preprocessing models. In this paper, we propose a spectral-based detection method for identifying adversarial attacks embedded in super-resolution model weights. More specifically, we use the radially-averaged power spectral density as a discriminative feature to train an extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) detector, demonstrating detectability of model-level threats in super-resolution networks. We further benchmark our detector against magnitude- and phase-based Fourier spectrum detectors, evaluating each method across a range of training and cross-architecture scenarios. Our proposed detector out-performs the comparison detectors in most of these scenarios and indicates that high-frequency features are most informative for detecting AdvSR attacks across SR architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于频谱的检测方法，利用径向平均功率谱密度作为判别特征训练XGBoost检测器，用于识别超分辨率模型权重中嵌入的对抗攻击。
AI.motivation: 将深度学习模型（如超分辨率）集成到图像预处理流水线中，给针对下游任务的对抗攻击引入了尚少被探索的攻击面。为了保证关键成像流水线的可信性，需要能够检测预处理模型中的对抗行为。
AI.method: 采用径向平均功率谱密度（RAPS）作为判别特征，训练极端梯度提升（XGBoost）检测器，用于检测超分辨率网络权重中的模型级对抗威胁（AdvSR攻击）。同时与基于幅度和相位的傅里叶频谱检测器进行对比，在多种训练与跨架构场景下评估各方法性能。
AI.result: 所提出的检测器在大多数场景下优于对比检测器，并表明高频特征在跨SR架构检测AdvSR攻击时最具信息量。
AI.conclusion: 基于RAPS谱特征的XGBoost检测器能够有效识别超分辨率模型权重中的对抗攻击，验证了模型级威胁在SR网络中的可检测性，并说明高频频谱特征是该检测任务的关键信息来源。

title: Proxy2World: Learning to Generate Worlds From Lightweight Proxies without Seeing Them
summary: Lightweight scene proxies let creators control scene layout and motion while leaving room for imagination in appearance, lighting, and visual effects. However, a suitable proxy is not uniquely defined, making paired proxy-video data difficult to construct automatically at scale. We present Proxy2World, a controllable world model that learns these complementary capabilities from ordinary posed RGBD videos, without training on authored proxy-video pairs. The model jointly learns depth-conditioned RGB generation and joint RGBD generation through cross-modal flow matching. Learning both tasks enables proxy-camera hybrid denoising at inference to follow the proxy structure while producing natural, detailed visuals. We further introduce ProxyBench to evaluate this capability across a diverse set of scenes, camera trajectories, and subject motions. Experiments on ProxyBench show that Proxy2World achieves a better balance between structural adherence and visual quality than camera-controlled and geometry-conditioned methods, supported by quantitative metrics, VLM assessments, human evaluations and diverse qualitative results.

AI.tldr: 提出 Proxy2World：一种可控世界模型，仅用普通 posed RGBD 视频训练，通过跨模态流匹配联合学习深度条件 RGB 生成与联合 RGBD 生成，并引入 ProxyBench 基准。
AI.motivation: 轻量级场景代理便于创作者控制布局与运动，但"合适代理"并非唯一，导致成对的代理-视频数据难以大规模自动构建；因此需要一种不依赖人工标注代理-视频配对、却能从普通 posed RGBD 视频中学会代理控制能力的世界模型。
AI.method: 跨模态流匹配（cross-modal flow matching），联合学习两项任务：深度条件 RGB 生成与联合 RGBD 生成；推理时采用代理-相机混合去噪（proxy-camera hybrid denoising），在遵循代理结构的同时生成自然、细节丰富的视觉内容。
AI.result: 在 ProxyBench 上，Proxy2World 在结构遵循度与视觉质量之间取得比相机控制方法与几何条件方法更好的平衡，并获得定量指标、VLM 评估、人类评测及多样定性结果的支持。
AI.conclusion: 无需人工构建代理-视频配对，即可从 posed RGBD 视频中学习代理可控的世界生成能力，实现结构遵循与视觉真实感的更优权衡。

title: WebPageBench: Event-Level Verification and Controlled UI-Variant Generation for Web Agents
summary: We present WebPageBench, an open framework for evaluating web agents in which every task is verified from the interface's own event log. Six instrumented mock sites with brand identifiers removed (a marketplace, a bookstore, a grocery service, rail ticketing, hotel search and a document cabinet) emit typed events with parameters as a user or an agent acts. A task declares the events it requires, and success is decided by matching them, with no judge model and no scraping of rendered pages. The same instrumentation supports controlled UI variation: one configuration switch re-renders a task through a different implementation of a single control while the prompt and the success conditions stay completely identical, so sensitivity to interface form can be measured under a fixed task specification. The WebPageBench release consists of three components: 152 tasks, divided into 65 canonical scenarios and 87 control variants across light/dark UI-modes; a common runner evaluated with six browser/DOM harness configurations and five screenshot-only GUI-agent families; and a public leaderboard of 24 model-harness pairs. On the public 152-task leaderboard the gap between what agents declare finished and what the log confirms reaches 41 points (one configuration declares every task finished and satisfies the conditions on 59%).

AI.tldr: WebPageBench是一个基于界面事件日志验证任务的web agent评测框架，含152个任务、可控UI变体、统一runner与公开排行榜，揭示了agent自报完成与日志确认之间的41分差距。
AI.motivation: 现有web agent评测多依赖裁判模型或对渲染页面进行抓取判定，既引入主观性与噪声，也难以在任务规格完全不变的前提下测量agent对界面形式（如表单控件实现方式）的敏感度。因此需要一个客观、可复现且支持受控UI变体的评测框架。
AI.method: 构建六个去除品牌标识的插桩mock站点（市场、书店、生鲜服务、铁路票务、酒店搜索、文档柜），在用户或agent操作时发出带参数的带类型事件；任务声明其所需事件，成功与否由事件匹配决定，不使用裁判模型、不抓取渲染页面。同一插桩支持受控UI变体：单一配置开关通过不同实现方式重渲染同一控件的任务，而提示词与成功条件保持完全一致。发布包含三部分：152个任务（65个规范场景+87个跨明/暗UI模式的控制变体）、在6种浏览器/DOM harness配置与5类仅截图GUI-agent家族上评测的通用runner、含24个模型-harness组合的公开排行榜。
AI.result: 公开152任务排行榜上，agent自称完成的任务与日志确认满足条件的任务之间存在最高41个百分点的差距；其中一种配置声称完成了所有任务，但仅在59%的任务上实际满足成功条件。
AI.conclusion: 基于界面自身事件日志的验证可提供无需裁判模型、不受渲染页面抓取干扰的客观评测，并能在固定任务规格下度量界面形式敏感性；结果显示agent的自我完成声明与真实成功之间存在显著偏差，凸显了以日志为准的评测必要性。

title: VEX-Bench: Benchmarking Verification Complexity of LLM-Generated Misinformation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have made misinformation inexpensive to produce but not to verify, creating a growing asymmetry in the information ecosystem. Under tight time, labor, and budget constraints, media organizations, platforms, and fact-checkers rely on screening to prioritize which content to verify. We introduce VEX-Bench, a unified benchmark for evaluating the verification complexity of LLM-generated misinformation, as perceived during screening, across models and generation methods. Verification complexity is assessed along multiple dimensions derived from journalistic and fact-checking practices, capturing checkability, harm potential, source credibility signals, imposter legitimacy, and expected verification effort. We define the VEX score as an integrated measure combining elicitation yield and verification complexity to quantify how generated content consumes limited verification capacity. We construct a benchmark spanning two misinformation categories, 6 high-stakes domains, and 60 real-world topics, and evaluate 7 frontier LLMs and 7 generation methods, yielding 5{,}880 articles. We employ an LLM-as-judge for scalable evaluation and validate it using content-analysis methodology, including ordinal Krippendorff $α$ for inter-annotator reliability, complemented by fact-checking agents for verification. Our findings show that no single method dominates all dimensions, underscoring the need for multi-dimensional evaluation. LLMs can generate high-VEX misinformation at 3$\times$ to 169$\times$ lower cost than agent-based verification. Such content is often prioritized during screening, consuming scarce verification resources and introducing a systematic risk of misallocation in resource-constrained verification systems. The code is publicly available in our \href{https://github.com/HanxunH/VEX-Bench}{GitHub repository}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VEX-Bench，一个统一基准，用于从筛查阶段视角评估 LLM 生成虚假信息的"核查复杂度"，并提出 VEX 分数度量其消耗核查资源的能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 使虚假信息的生产成本极低，但核查成本依然高昂，导致信息生态中"生产便宜、验证昂贵"的不对称。媒体、平台与事实核查机构在时间、人力和预算受限下只能依赖筛查来排定核查优先级，因此亟需量化生成内容的核查复杂度与资源消耗代价。
AI.method: 构建 VEX-Bench：核查复杂度沿多个源自新闻与事实核查实践的维度评估，包括可核查性、潜在危害、来源可信度信号、冒充合法性、预期核查投入；定义 VEX 分数为"诱导产出率"与"核查复杂度"的综合度量。基准覆盖 2 类虚假信息、6 个高风险领域、60 个真实议题，评估 7 个前沿 LLM 与 7 种生成方法，共 5,880 篇文章。采用 LLM-as-judge 进行可扩展评估，并用内容分析法验证，包括序数 Krippendorff α 检验标注者间信度，辅以事实核查智能体进行核查。
AI.result: 没有任何单一生成方法在所有维度上占优，说明多维度评估的必要性。LLM 生成高 VEX 虚假信息的成本比基于智能体的核查低 3× 至 169×。此类内容在筛查中常被优先处理，消耗稀缺核查资源，带来资源受限核查系统中系统性错配的风险。
AI.conclusion: VEX-Bench 提供了跨模型与生成方法评估 LLM 虚假信息核查复杂度的统一框架，揭示了生产与核查间的成本不对称及核查资源错配风险，代码已公开。

title: JRDB-AVR: An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark for Embodied Agents in Real-World Environments
summary: In complex embodied visual reasoning scenarios, an agent often has only a limited field of view, and the evidence needed to answer a question may be distributed across time, viewpoint, and interacting objects. A model may therefore give a plausible answer without ever observing the relevant object, time, or view that supports it. Current visual reasoning benchmarks largely evaluate passive observations and final answers, overlooking settings that require active reasoning and evidence acquisition. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark derived from existing real-world JRDB robotics data through a structured question-generation engine that turns this gap into an explicit evaluation: an embodied agentic system receives a visual reasoning question, requests bounded observations by timestamp and viewing angle, and is evaluated on both the final answer and the grounded visual evidence supporting it. The benchmark contains diverse questions over multiple real-world environments involving temporal search, viewpoint selection, and human-oriented compositional reasoning. We also introduce JRDB-AVR-Agent, a reference active reasoning agentic method that maintains an explicit observation-grounded graph-based world model and answers through solving. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between answer accuracy and evidence accuracy in current baselines, showing that current VLMs can produce unsupported correct answers and that active evidence-aware evaluation is necessary for embodied visual reasoning. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR.

AI.tldr: 提出JRDB-AVR基准与JRDB-AVR-Agent方法，面向具身主动视觉推理，要求智能体按时间戳与视角请求观测，并同时评估最终答案与支撑答案的视觉证据，揭示了现有VLM"答案对、证据错"的问题。
AI.motivation: 在复杂具身视觉推理场景中，智能体视野有限，回答问题所需的证据分散在时间、视角和交互物体之间。模型可能从未观察到相关物体、时刻或视角，却给出看似合理的答案。而现有视觉推理基准多评估被动观测与最终答案，忽视了需要主动推理与证据获取的设置。
AI.method: 基于真实世界JRDB机器人数据，通过结构化问题生成引擎构建JRDB-AVR基准：具身智能体系统接收视觉推理问题，按时间戳和视角请求有界观测，评估最终答案及其所依据的视觉证据。基准涵盖多个真实环境，涉及时间搜索、视角选择和以人为中心的组合推理等多样问题。同时提出参考性主动推理智能体方法JRDB-AVR-Agent，维护显式的、以观测为根基的图结构世界模型，并通过求解作答。
AI.result: 实验显示当前基线在答案准确率与证据准确率之间存在显著差距，表明现有视觉语言模型能够生成缺乏证据支撑的正确答案。
AI.conclusion: 具身视觉推理需要主动的、证据感知的评估范式；JRDB-AVR为弥合被动观测评测与主动证据获取之间的鸿沟提供了基准与方法参考。代码与基准已开源。

title: Mixed-Prior Decision Risk for Open-Set Recognition
summary: In open-set recognition (OSR), a probe must either be identified as one of the known gallery classes or rejected as unknown, so three error types coexist: false acceptance, false rejection, and misidentification. An uncertainty score for selective recognition should rank probes by the risk of the decision the system has made. Bayesian gallery-aware models such as Holistic Uncertainty Estimation (HolUE) summarize the posterior over known and unknown classes by Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence components and map them to an uncertainty score with a supervised nonlinear calibrator. We show that the KL summary is not generally monotone in decision risk: linear fusion of the KL components tuned on validation data yields negative filtering quality on several benchmarks. We propose MPRisk, a mixed-prior posterior decision-risk score that keeps the same Bayesian posterior but directly scores the error events associated with the selected decision: false-acceptance, misidentification, and false-rejection risks, plus a non-specificity penalty for rejections, enabled by modeling unknown identities as a continuous component. Four nonnegative weights tuned on a validation set suffice for ranking; no nonlinear supervised model is required. Across nine image, audio, and text benchmarks, MPRisk achieves the best or tied-best Prediction Rejection Ratio at every operating point on the image and audio benchmarks and on most text operating points, with bootstrap-confirmed gains over HolUE on five benchmarks (up to $+0.19$ PRR) at comparable or lower runtime.

AI.tldr: 现有贝叶斯开放集识别不确定性评分（如HolUE）的KL散度摘要对决策风险并非单调，线性融合甚至出现负筛选质量。本文提出MPRisk，直接对所选决策的错误事件（误接受、误识别、误拒绝及拒绝的非特异性惩罚）建模打分，仅需4个非负权重，无需非线性监督校准。在9个图像/音频/文本基准上，MPRisk在图像与音频全部操作点及多数文本操作点取得最佳或并列最佳PRR，5个基准上显著优于HolUE（最高+0.19 PRR），运行时间相当或更低。
AI.motivation: 开放集识别中同时存在误接受、误拒绝和误识别三类错误，选择性识别的不确定性分数本应按系统所做决策的风险排序。但Bayesian gallery-aware模型（如HolUE）用KL散度分量总结后验并经监督非线性校准映射为不确定性分数，该KL摘要在决策风险上并不普遍单调，在若干基准上线性融合调参后甚至出现负的筛选质量。
AI.method: 提出MPRisk，一种混合先验的后验决策风险分数：保留相同的贝叶斯后验，但直接对所选决策相关的错误事件打分——误接受风险、误识别风险、误拒绝风险，外加对拒绝的非特异性惩罚；通过将未知身份建模为连续分量实现。仅需在验证集上调优4个非负权重即可完成排序，无需非线性监督模型。
AI.result: 在9个图像、音频和文本基准上，MPRisk在图像与音频基准的所有操作点以及多数文本操作点取得最佳或并列最佳的Prediction Rejection Ratio（PRR）；在5个基准上bootstrap确认优于HolUE（最高+0.19 PRR），且运行时间相当或更低。
AI.conclusion: KL散度摘要并非一般性地对决策风险单调，直接对决策错误事件建模的混合先验后验风险分数是更有效的选择性识别不确定性度量，简单、无需非线性校准，并在多模态基准上稳定优于现有方法。

title: LEGAU: Learning Semantic Gaussian Priors for Scalable Category-level Pose Estimation
summary: Category-level 6D pose estimation from a single RGB-D observation is inherently under-constrained, since partial visible geometry must be interpreted together with a canonical object structure before a stable pose can be determined. We present LEGAU, a unified framework that jointly predicts NOCS correspondence, object pose and size, and a canonical Semantic Gaussian Field. Rather than treating reconstruction as a detached auxiliary task, LEGAU uses the Gaussian field as a category-conditioned structural prior that participates in multimodal feature fusion and provides global guidance for local pose reasoning. Conditioned on a categorical text embedding, LEGAU processes RGB-D observations through a transformer-based fusion module that integrates visual, geometric, and category-level cues, decoding the NOCS map, pose and size information and the Gaussian-based object representation. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that this coupled pose-shape formulation achieves strong performance in a single-model multi-category setting, with up to 22\% on SOPE and competitive transfer to real-world data. These results highlight the benefit of jointly learning canonical correspondence, object shape, and pose alignment within a unified representation.

AI.tldr: LEGAU是一个统一框架，联合预测NOCS对应、物体位姿与尺寸以及规范语义高斯场，将高斯场作为类别条件结构先验参与多模态融合并引导局部位姿推理，在单模型多类别设置下取得显著性能。
AI.motivation: 单张RGB-D观测下的类别级6D位姿估计本质上是欠约束问题：需要将部分可见几何与物体的规范结构结合起来才能确定稳定位姿。现有方法通常将重建视为独立的辅助任务，未充分利用形状结构信息来辅助位姿推理。
AI.method: 提出LEGAU统一框架，以类别文本嵌入为条件，通过基于Transformer的融合模块整合RGB-D观测中的视觉、几何与类别级线索，联合解码NOCS图、位姿与尺寸信息以及基于高斯的物体表示。关键在于将高斯场作为类别条件的结构先验，参与多模态特征融合并为局部位姿推理提供全局引导。
AI.result: 在合成与真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，这种位姿-形状耦合的建模方式在单模型多类别设置下表现优异，SOPE提升最高达22%，并能较好地迁移到真实数据。
AI.conclusion: 在统一表示中联合学习规范对应关系、物体形状与位姿对齐具有明显优势，验证了将重建作为结构先验而非独立辅助任务的有效性。

title: OPIS: An Input-Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Object Memory in Video World Models
summary: Video world models must preserve the visual state of the world over time, but existing evaluation protocols often rely on generated histories, video reference, or selected revisit viewpoints that can confound the assessment of a model's true memory capability. To address this, we introduce OPIS, an input-grounded benchmark that strictly anchors the assessment to a fixed set of object instances from the initial observation for evaluating multi-object memory in video world models. The OPIS dataset comprises 500 cases across real-world, embodied-robotic, and game-world domains, providing dense object-level annotations for 12,672 rigid, articulated, and deformable instances. Our object-centric evaluator combines association and explicit visibility reasoning to hierarchically measure Object (O) Presence (P), Identity (I), and Structure (S), utilizing static or dynamic evaluation tracks based on object kinematics. Across eight image-to-video or camera-conditioned world models, our proposed OPIS scores range from 48.65 to 56.01. As the reference inventory grows from less than 20 to more than 40 objects, the Presence, Identity, and Structure scores show an overall decline, with the average Identity score falling from 40.22 to 23.11. The results demonstrate that preserving the particular object instances in the input is considerably harder than generating plausible visual elements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OPIS 基准，以初始观测中的固定物体实例为锚点，从物体级 Presence、Identity、Structure 三个层次评估视频世界模型的多物体记忆能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型记忆评估常依赖生成历史、视频参考或选定重访视角，这些设置会混淆对模型真实记忆能力的判断，因此需要一个严格锚定输入观测的评估协议。
AI.method: 构建 OPIS 数据集，包含真实世界、具身机器人和游戏世界三个领域的 500 个案例，为 12,672 个刚性、关节和可变形实例提供密集物体级标注；设计以物体为中心的评估器，结合关联与显式可见性推理，按物体运动学采用静态或动态评估轨道，分层测量 Presence、Identity 和 Structure。
AI.result: 在八个图像到视频或相机条件世界模型上，OPIS 得分为 48.65 至 56.01；当参考清单从少于 20 个物体增至超过 40 个时，三项得分整体下降，平均 Identity 得分从 40.22 降至 23.11。
AI.conclusion: 保持输入中的特定物体实例比生成看似合理的视觉元素困难得多，OPIS 为视频世界模型的多物体记忆评估提供了可复现且严格输入锚定的基准。

title: Towards Generalizable 3D Anomaly Detection via Relational Inconsistency Modeling
summary: 3D anomaly detection (3DAD) aims to identify defective regions in point cloud data, serving as a critical component in industrial inspection systems. Existing methods are normality-centered -- learning the distribution of normal samples and treating deviations as anomalies -- without explicitly modeling what constitutes a defect. This leads to ambiguous decision boundaries with increased false positives and negatives, particularly in unified and cross-domain settings where diverse normal distributions further blur the boundaries. We propose a relational inconsistency modeling framework that characterizes defects as violations of geometric consistency among neighboring structures. Our approach learns category-agnostic defect cues through pseudo-anomalies designed as controlled relational violations, instantiated by two key modules: Edge-aware Graph Refinement (EGR) for encoding geometric relationships among local regions, and Cluster-Deviation Modeling (CDM) for identifying regions that are relationally incompatible within their structural peer group. Extensive experiments on Anomaly-ShapeNet and Real3D-AD demonstrate consistent improvements over prior state-of-the-art methods in both in-domain and cross-domain settings, validating the effectiveness of learning an explicit, relation-based defect criterion for 3D anomaly detection. Project page: https://visualsciencelab-khu.github.io/GRIM_project/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出关系不一致性建模框架GRIM，将3D点云异常定义为邻域几何一致性的违背，通过伪异常学习类别无关的缺陷线索，在Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有3D异常检测方法以正常性为中心，仅学习正常样本分布并将偏移视为异常，未显式建模缺陷本身，导致决策边界模糊、假阳性与假阴性增多，在统一设定和跨域设定下问题更严重。
AI.method: 提出以关系不一致性为核心的框架，将缺陷刻画为邻域结构间几何一致性的违背；通过受控的关系违背构造伪异常以学习类别无关的缺陷线索，并实例化为两个模块：边感知图细化（EGR）编码局部区域间的几何关系，聚类偏差建模（CDM）识别在结构同类群中关系不兼容的区域。
AI.result: 在Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD上的大量实验表明，该方法在同域与跨域设定下均持续优于先前的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 学习显式的、基于关系的缺陷判据对3D异常检测有效，验证了关系不一致性建模框架的优越性。

title: Echoes of Deeds: Moral History Can Shape and Steer LLM Behavioral Choices
summary: Evaluations of Large Language Models (LLMs) morality typically consider decisions in isolation, thus overlooking whether an individual's unrelated prior conduct influences the model's subsequent choices. This leaves open the question of whether, and to what extent, moral history shapes LLM decisional behaviors. Prior work on human moral decision-making shows that past behavior can influence subsequent moral choices. Building on this observation, we investigate whether analogous effects emerge in LLMs in two complementary ways: at the behavioral level, through the model's observable responses, and at the representation level, through its latent internal representations. We introduce MoralLedger, a framework for studying how an actor's moral history shapes actions for LLMs' behaviors under a fixed decision context. At the behavioral level, we find that prior moral histories systematically alter subsequent choices as a function of their valence and intensity. At the internal representation level, these histories induce a linearly recoverable direction in the residual stream that generalizes to held-out examples. Intervening along this direction on neutral-history prompts produces two-sided intensity-dependent changes in subsequent choices, with effects that are stronger than those induced by prompting alone or by favorable-nonmoral direction. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that a latent representation of an actor's prior moral conduct can provide signed inference-time control over a moral decision. Our MoralLedger extends moral evaluation beyond static dilemmas, establishing moral history as both a source of behavioral sensitivity and a causal target for auditing and controlling moral behavior in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MoralLedger框架，首次研究"道德历史"如何塑造大语言模型的后续道德决策，并在行为层与表示层证明其可被线性提取、并可因果干预控制。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM道德评估多考察孤立情境下的决策，忽视了行为主体此前的无关行为是否会影响模型后续选择，因此"道德历史是否以及多大程度上塑造LLM决策行为"这一问题尚未被解答。人类道德决策研究表明过去行为会影响后续道德选择，论文据此探究LLM中是否存在类似效应。
AI.method: 在固定决策情境下构建MoralLedger框架，从两个互补层面展开：行为层面观察模型可观测回答，表示层面分析其潜在内部表征。通过构造不同效价与强度的先前道德历史，检验其对后续选择的影响；并在残差流中提取可线性恢复的方向，在"中性历史"提示上进行沿该方向的干预实验，与提示工程及"道德中性但积极"方向作对照。
AI.result: 行为层面，先前道德历史会依其效价与强度系统性地改变后续选择。表示层面，这些历史在残差流中诱导出一个可线性恢复且能泛化到留出样本的方向；沿该方向对中性历史提示进行干预，会引发双向、强度依赖的选择变化，且效果强于单纯提示或非道德性的积极方向干预。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个证明"行为主体先前道德操守的潜在表征"可对道德决策提供有符号的推理时控制的研究。MoralLedger将道德评估从静态困境扩展到道德历史，确立道德历史既是行为敏感性的来源，也是审计与控制LLM道德行为的因果靶点。

title: When Confidence Rises Too Early: Detecting Shortcut Reasoning via Premature Answer Commitment
summary: The reasoning trajectory of a Large Language Model (LLM) is often treated as a verbalized description of its internal reasoning. However, such trajectories can be unfaithful: a model may rely on shortcuts to reach an answer and then post-rationalize the decision with a seemingly coherent chain of thought. Detecting this shortcut reasoning is challenging because existing monitors and verifiers mainly inspect textual traces or final outcomes, rather than how the model's belief in its answer develops during generation. We introduce ConfLens, a framework that tracks the evolution of confidence in the final answer throughout reasoning. Across three shortcut reasoning settings, we observe a common pattern of premature confidence, where shortcut samples become highly confident in the final answer at early reasoning stages. Existing confidence estimation methods, however, show limited generalizability, reliability, or efficiency for detecting this behavior. We therefore propose the Distributional Answer Commitment Score (DACS), a distributional confidence estimator that measures the entropy of the model's probability distribution over answer commitment at each reasoning step. DACS captures how concentrated the model's answer belief is without requiring ground-truth answers or task-specific verifiers. We further convert ConfLens detection results into interpretable signals for reward models to reduce their preference for shortcut reasoning. Experiments on mathematical and code reasoning tasks show that ConfLens with DACS improves shortcut reasoning detection by over 4.3% F1 compared with strong baselines and reduces the mismatch between faithfulness and correctness in reward model preferences.

AI.tldr: 提出ConfLens框架追踪LLM推理过程中对最终答案置信度的演化，发现捷径推理存在"过早自信"模式；提出分布式置信估计器DACS以检测该现象，并可转化为奖励模型的可解释信号抑制捷径偏好。
AI.motivation: LLM的推理轨迹常被视为其内部推理的语言化描述，但轨迹可能不忠实：模型先靠捷径得到答案，再事后编造看似连贯的思维链进行合理化。现有监控器与验证器主要检查文本痕迹或最终结果，无法观察模型对答案信念在生成过程中的演化，因此难以检测此类捷径推理。
AI.method: 1) 提出ConfLens框架，在推理全程追踪模型对最终答案置信度的演化；2) 在三种捷径推理设定下观察，发现共性的"过早自信"模式；3) 指出已有置信度估计方法在泛化性、可靠性与效率上的不足；4) 提出分布式答案承诺分数DACS，通过测量每一步推理中模型对答案承诺概率分布的熵来刻画答案信念的集中程度，无需真值答案或任务专用验证器；5) 将ConfLens的检测结果转化为奖励模型可解释信号，以降低其对捷径推理的偏好。
