AI.result: 在数学与代码推理任务上，ConfLens结合DACS相比强基线在捷径推理检测上F1提升超过4.3%，并降低了奖励模型偏好中忠实性与正确性之间的错配。
AI.conclusion: 置信度在推理过程中的动态演化可作为检测捷径推理的有效信号；DACS提供了一种无需真值和专用验证器的分布式置信估计手段，且检测结果可反哺奖励模型，缓解其对捷径的偏好及忠实性—正确性错配问题。

title: RefineDrive: Reliable Failure-Guided Learning for Vision-Language-Action Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving rely heavily on successful expert demonstrations, leaving model-specific failures underexploited. Learning from these failures is hindered by unreliable diagnoses, poorly matched correction targets, and coarse rewards. We propose RefineDrive, a failure-guided post-training framework that learns from self-generated failures through targeted supervision and safety-aware reinforcement learning. Reliable Diagnosis derives structured, verifiable feedback on collisions and drivable-area violations directly from simulator states. Minimum-Correction Target Retrieval searches a clustered human trajectory bank for nearby corrections that satisfy hard-safety constraints in the current scene, prioritizing preservation of the failed prediction's motion pattern. Conditioned on the driving context and failed trajectory, Correction SFT learns to generate the diagnosis followed by the retrieved correction as a training-only auxiliary task. We then apply GRPO with a Safety-Layered Reward that strictly prioritizes hard-safe trajectories, retains continuous safety feedback for both unsafe and hard-safe trajectories, and rewards driving progress only after hard safety is satisfied. At inference, the policy directly predicts trajectories from the driving context without an explicit diagnosis or repair stage. On NAVSIM v1, RefineDrive improves the 4B base SFT policy from 87.7 to 91.7 PDMS. Using the same checkpoint without additional training, RefineDrive achieves 89.4 EPDMS on the original NAVTEST scenes evaluated with NAVSIM v2 extended metrics. Controlled ablations support the benefits of structured diagnosis supervision, retrieved corrections, and safety-layered optimization for direct planning.

AI.tldr: RefineDrive: 一种从自生成失败中学习的后训练框架，通过可靠诊断、最小修正目标检索与安全分层强化学习提升VLA自动驾驶规划性能。
AI.motivation: Vision-Language-Action（VLA）自动驾驶模型高度依赖成功的专家示范，而模型自身的失败案例利用不足。从失败中学习面临三大障碍：诊断不可靠、修正目标不匹配、奖励过于粗糙。
AI.method: 框架包含四个部分：（1）可靠诊断（Reliable Diagnosis）：直接从仿真器状态生成关于碰撞与可行驶区域违规的结构化、可验证反馈；（2）最小修正目标检索（Minimum-Correction Target Retrieval）：在聚类的人类轨迹库中检索满足当前场景硬安全约束的邻近修正，优先保留失败预测的运动模式；（3）修正SFT（Correction SFT）：以驾驶上下文与失败轨迹为条件，将"诊断+检索修正"作为仅训练用的辅助任务进行学习；（4）安全分层奖励的GRPO：严格优先硬安全轨迹，对不安全与硬安全轨迹均保留连续安全反馈，仅在硬安全满足后才奖励行驶进展。推理时策略直接由驾驶上下文预测轨迹，无需显式诊断或修复阶段。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1上，RefineDrive将4B基础SFT策略的PDMS从87.7提升至91.7。使用相同checkpoint且不额外训练，在NAVSIM v2扩展指标评估的原始NAVTEST场景上达到89.4 EPDMS。受控消融实验验证了结构化诊断监督、检索式修正与安全分层优化对直接规划的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化失败诊断、检索式最小修正监督与安全分层强化学习后训练，可在不增加推理开销的前提下显著提升VLA自动驾驶模型的规划安全性与性能，且失败学习策略各组件均有独立贡献。

title: Advancing Video-Text Pretraining with Multi-View Captions
summary: Video-text pretraining has achieved remarkable progress through the scaling of models and datasets, yet the quality of language supervision remains underexplored. Existing web-scale datasets often provide only a single sparse caption per video that fails to capture rich spatiotemporal semantics, while directly using captioning models can generate noisy descriptions. We propose a large-scale multimodal large language model-based supervision generation framework that improves supervision diversity, fidelity, and semantic coverage. Starting from 10 million videos, our approach generates multi-view captions (MVC) through complementary summary and detailed captions, reasoning-based refinement, and semantic positive caption generation. To effectively exploit supervision at different granularities, we further introduce a granularity-aware text representation with separate CLS tokens for summary and detailed views. We pretrain video-text models using the resulting supervision corpus and evaluate them across standard, fine-grained and detailed text-to-video retrieval benchmarks. Our approach consistently improves both zero-shot and fine-tuned performance while using smaller pretraining corpora than existing methods, demonstrating the importance of rich and complementary textual supervision for video-text pretraining. Project page: https://rvandeghen.github.io/mvc/

AI.tldr: 提出基于多模态大模型的多视角字幕（MVC）监督生成框架，并引入粒度感知文本表示，用更小语料提升视频-文本预训练性能。
AI.motivation: 现有网络规模视频-文本数据集通常每个视频仅有单条稀疏字幕，难以覆盖丰富的时空语义；而直接用字幕模型生成又会引入噪声描述。语言监督质量这一维度尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 从1000万视频出发，利用多模态大语言模型生成多视角字幕：互补的摘要式字幕与细节式字幕、基于推理的精炼、以及语义正样本字幕生成。为利用不同粒度监督，设计粒度感知文本表示，为摘要视图与细节视图分别设置独立的CLS token。
AI.result: 在所构建监督语料上预训练视频-文本模型，并在标准、细粒度与细节化文本到视频检索基准上评测；零样本与微调性能均持续提升，且所用预训练语料规模小于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 丰富且互补的文本监督对视频-文本预训练至关重要，多视角字幕生成与粒度感知表示可显著提升检索性能。

title: DF-CBM: Region-Aware Concept Bottleneck Models for Deepfake Detection
summary: Deepfake detection methods have become increasingly effective yet most provide limited insight into the evidence behind their predictions. However, in forensic settings users also need to know which manipulation cues support the decision and where they appear. Existing explainability methods only partially address this need since localization-based approaches lack semantic descriptions while language-based explanation methods are only weakly grounded in visual evidence. In this work, we propose DF-CBM, a region-aware concept bottleneck model for explainable deepfake detection. DF-CBM builds a compact vocabulary of manipulation-related concepts from textual artifact annotations and links each concept to plausible facial and boundary regions. It then predicts these concepts from visual features using a concept-specific masked attention mechanism guided by parsed facial masks and the final real/fake decision is made from the predicted concept bottleneck. Our experiments show that DF-CBM outperforms concept-based baselines in concept prediction and deepfake classification while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art black-box detectors. Finally, qualitative results and intervention analyses demonstrate that DF-CBM provides spatially grounded concept evidence and enables counterfactual explanations of how individual manipulation concepts influence the final prediction. Our code is available at: https://github.com/GeorgeTsoumplekas/DF-CBM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DF-CBM——一种区域感知的概念瓶颈模型，用于可解释的深度伪造检测。它从文本伪影标注构建操作相关概念词表，并将概念关联到面部及边界区域，通过概念特定的掩码注意力从视觉特征预测概念，再由概念瓶颈做出真假判别。实验表明其在概念预测与分类上优于概念基线，且具备空间定位的概念证据与反事实解释能力。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法虽检测效果不断提升，但对其预测依据的证据揭示有限。在取证场景中，用户不仅需要真假结论，还需了解哪些操作线索支持该判断以及这些线索出现的具体位置。已有的可解释性方法仅部分满足此需求：基于定位的方法缺乏语义描述，而基于语言的解释方法又难以与视觉证据紧密对应。
AI.method: 提出DF-CBM，一种区域感知的概念瓶颈模型。首先从文本伪影标注中构建紧凑的操作相关概念词表，并将每个概念关联到合理的面部与边界区域；随后利用由解析的人脸掩码引导的概念特定掩码注意力机制，从视觉特征中预测这些概念；最终基于预测的概念瓶颈完成真/假判定。
AI.result: 在概念预测与深度伪造分类任务上，DF-CBM优于基于概念的基线方法，并与当前最先进的黑盒检测器保持竞争力。定性结果与干预分析表明，DF-CBM能够提供具有空间定位的概念证据，并支持反事实解释，说明各个操作概念如何影响最终预测。
AI.conclusion: DF-CBM通过将操作概念与区域空间关联并引入概念瓶颈结构，在保持检测性能竞争力的同时，实现了兼具语义描述与空间定位的可解释深度伪造检测，并支持反事实分析。代码已开源。

title: A mechanistic study of language model introspection
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can sometimes report perturbations to their internal activations---even when the input provides no evidence that an intervention occurred. How do models detect and localize such internal changes? We study this question using a controlled task that keeps the input text fixed. We either inject a concept vector into the hidden state at one of ten token positions or apply no intervention. The model is asked to identify the perturbed position or report that no intervention occurred. Across three model families, we identify two small groups of attention heads with distinct roles in introspective reporting. Middle-layer gate heads influence whether the model reports a change, while router heads in a later layer help select the position to report. Interventions on gate heads can suppress position reports even when router heads supply location information. We further examine why reporting accuracy varies across concepts. Concept vectors that are localized more accurately produce stronger attention-score and output responses in gate heads, which is associated with better alignment of the induced key and value changes in their QK and OV computations. Together, these findings identify attention-head mechanisms supporting introspective detection and localization.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过固定输入文本、在十个token位置之一注入概念向量（或不注入）的受控任务，研究LLM如何检测并定位内部激活扰动，发现两类注意力头分别负责"是否报告变化"与"定位报告"。
AI.motivation: LLM有时能在输入没有任何干预证据的情况下报告其内部激活的扰动。模型如何检测并定位这类内部变化尚不清楚，本文旨在揭示支撑这一内省式检测与定位的机制。
AI.method: 采用保持输入文本固定的受控任务：在十个token位置之一向隐状态注入概念向量，或不施加任何干预；要求模型识别被扰动的位置或报告无干预发生。对三个模型家族进行分析，识别注意力头的作用，并考察概念向量定位精度与注意力分数、输出响应及QK/OV计算中key与value变化对齐程度的关系。
AI.result: 识别出两组作用不同的注意力头：中间层的门控头（gate heads）影响模型是否报告变化，较后层的路由头（router heads）帮助选择要报告的位置。对门控头的干预即使路由头已提供位置信息，也能抑制位置报告。定位更准确的概念向量在门控头中产生更强的注意力分数与输出响应，这与QK和OV计算中诱导的key与value变化对齐更好相关。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现识别出支撑内省式检测与定位的注意力头机制：门控头负责报告与否的决策，路由头负责位置选择，且概念向量的可定位性通过影响门控头的注意力与输出响应来决定报告准确率。

title: Sol-H3: Recursive Self-Improvement for MiniMax-H3 Inference Acceleration on Sol-Engine across Cloud and Edge
summary: Video diffusion models are rapidly scaling and exhibiting enhanced generation capabilities. Among these recent advancements, MiniMax-H3 stands out as a highly capable, production-level open-source model. However, its 33-billion parameters and multi-step iterative denoising process introduce substantial computational overhead. Consequently, their practical production is hindered by generation latency in the cloud deployment like NVIDIA-GB200, alongside strict memory limits that pose further challenges at the edge device like DGX-Spark. To address these diverse hardware bottlenecks from cloud to edge device, we present a full-stack inference pipeline that integrates efficient algorithmic design with optimized operator implementations. Algorithmically, we introduce a cross-resolution two-stage generation scheduler that exploits the step-wise nature of diffusion: early low-resolution steps rapidly establish the global layout, while later high-resolution steps focus refinements of local and perceptual details. These stages are connected by a learned latent-to-latent mapping module, completely eliminating the computationally expensive VAE decode-reencode cycle for resolution transferring cross different resolutions. For operator implementation, we deploy a Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) loop that searches kernel fusions and memory layouts, evaluating latency together with numerical agreement. Together, these optimizations deliver up to 30x end-to-end speedup and 20% lower memory: a 5-second 1344x768 video with audio is generated 3.5x faster than real time on an 8xGB200 node, and in under a minute fully memory-resident on a single DGX Spark.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出面向MiniMax-H3视频扩散模型的全栈推理流水线，通过跨分辨率两阶段生成调度器（含学习的latent-to-latent映射，避免VAE解码-重编码）与递归自改进（RSI）算子搜索，实现端到端最高30倍加速、内存降低20%。
AI.motivation: MiniMax-H3为330亿参数的生产级开源视频扩散模型，其多步迭代去噪带来巨大计算开销：云端部署（如NVIDIA GB200）受生成延迟制约，边缘设备（如DGX Spark）受严格内存限制制约，需要同时应对从云到端的多样化硬件瓶颈。
AI.method: 算法层面：设计跨分辨率两阶段生成调度器，利用扩散的逐步特性——早期低分辨率步骤快速建立全局布局，后期高分辨率步骤专注于局部与感知细节的精细化；两阶段之间由学习得到的latent-to-latent映射模块连接，彻底消除跨分辨率转换中昂贵的VAE解码-重编码循环。算子层面：部署递归自改进（RSI）循环，自动搜索核融合与内存布局，并同时以延迟和数值一致性作为评价指标。
AI.result: 综合优化带来最高30倍端到端加速和20%的内存降低：在8×GB200节点上生成含音频的5秒1344×768视频比实时快3.5倍，在单台DGX Spark上可在一分钟内完全驻留内存完成生成。
AI.conclusion: 将高效的算法设计与优化算子实现相结合的全栈推理流水线，能够有效缓解从云端到边缘设备的多样硬件瓶颈，使大规模视频扩散模型在延迟与内存双重约束下具备实用化部署能力。

title: Style-Driven Data Synthesis and Degradation-Aware Enhancement for Ultrasound Image Restoration
summary: Low-cost handheld ultrasound devices can be widely deployed compared to professional hospital ultrasound machines. However, their images suffer from compound degradation that can mislead clinical judgment. Motivated by this observation, mapping handheld low-quality (LQ) to hospital high-quality (HQ) images has been considered a valuable research question. Conventionally, the mapping requires pixel-aligned LQ-HQ pairs. This requirement is unsatisfactory in practical scenarios because real scans at different times are never pixel-aligned. This paper addresses the challenge with a two-stage framework. The first stage generates pixel-aligned LQ-HQ datasets, and the second stage trains an enhancement model that improves LQ images. The first stage trains a cycle-consistent style-transfer model on unaligned real LQ-HQ pairs to learn a HQ-to-LQ model. Then, the model transforms real HQ images into pixel-aligned LQ images. Based on the dataset generated by the first stage, the second stage uses the Dual Degradation-Guided (DDG) Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) method to fine-tune an LQ-to-HQ model based on aligned pairs. In this stage, the model is based on the well known PiSA-SR framework but inserts a degradation-conditioned correction matrix. Experimental results on the USenhance2023 dataset show that the FID metric is improved by 16.7% over the strongest baseline while other metrics indicate that our enhanced outputs are well aligned with the real HQ distribution. The source code of our method is available at https://github.com/Jason0411202/DDG_LoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段框架，用非对齐真实LQ-HQ数据生成像素对齐数据集并训练增强模型，FID较最强基线提升16.7%。
AI.motivation: 低成本手持超声设备图像存在复合退化，易误导临床判断；传统LQ到HQ映射需要像素对齐的LQ-HQ配对，而实际不同时间扫描的图像无法像素对齐，需求难以满足。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段在非对齐真实LQ-HQ对上训练循环一致风格迁移模型，学习HQ-to-LQ映射，将真实HQ转为像素对齐LQ，生成对齐数据集；第二阶段基于该数据集，用双退化引导低秩适配（DDG LoRA）微调LQ-to-HQ模型，模型基于PiSA-SR框架并插入退化条件校正矩阵。
AI.result: 在USenhance2023数据集上，FID指标较最强基线提升16.7%，其他指标表明增强输出与真实HQ分布良好对齐。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 该两阶段方案无需像素对齐LQ-HQ配对即可实现手持超声图像增强，生成结果贴近真实HQ分布。

title: VideoPhysEdit: Physical Counterfactual Video Editing via Rigid-Body Physical Scene Reconstruction
summary: Video editing has advanced substantially in recent years, with methods increasingly accounting for the visual consequences of edits, such as changes to shadows and occlusions. However, the physical consequences of edits, including changes to subsequent motion and interactions, remain less explored. We formulate this problem as physical counterfactual video editing (PCVE), which aims to generate a counterfactual video depicting the resulting motion and interactions given a source video, a physical edit, and its execution frame. PCVE is challenging because it requires understanding scene physics and inferring the downstream motion and interactions induced by a physical intervention, while paired factual and counterfactual data and dedicated evaluation metrics are lacking. We introduce VideoPhysEdit, a new training-free pipeline for PCVE in rigid-body scenes. It makes physical reasoning explicit through a novel physical scene reconstruction method that recovers a scene reproducing the observed motion and interactions under simulation, enabling the pipeline to apply physical edits as interventions and use the resulting trajectories to guide counterfactual video generation. We further construct PCVE-RigidBench, a synthetic benchmark with paired source and counterfactual target videos and physical ground truth, and introduce the Physical Edit Score. VideoPhysEdit achieves substantially higher physical edit accuracy than open-source methods and commercial models while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. Its Physical Edit Score is 0.376, the only positive score among the compared methods. Qualitative comparisons on real videos further show that VideoPhysEdit applies to real-world scenes and better depicts the downstream motion and interactions induced by the edits than the compared methods. Code: https://github.com/Hammour-steak/VideoPhysEdit

AI.tldr: 提出物理反事实视频编辑（PCVE）任务与免训练流水线VideoPhysEdit，通过物理场景重建实现物理编辑干预并生成反事实视频。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑方法多关注阴影、遮挡等视觉后果，却忽视了编辑引发的物理后果（后续运动与交互的变化），且缺乏配对数据与评测指标。
AI.method: VideoPhysEdit为免训练流水线，面向刚体场景，通过新颖的物理场景重建方法显式进行物理推理，恢复能在仿真中重现观测运动与交互的场景，从而施加物理编辑为干预，用生成的轨迹引导反事实视频生成；同时构建PCVE-RigidBench合成基准（含配对源/反事实视频与物理真值）并提出Physical Edit Score。
AI.result: 物理编辑准确率显著高于开源方法与商业模型，同时保持有竞争力的视觉保真度；Physical Edit Score为0.376，是对比方法中唯一正值；真实视频定性对比显示其能更好刻画编辑引发的后续运动与交互。
AI.conclusion: VideoPhysEdit有效解决PCVE问题，可泛化至真实场景，为物理感知视频编辑提供了新任务、方法与评测基准。

title: Timeline-Bench: Evaluating Agents on Realistic Video-Editing Tasks, from Raw Footage to Final Cut
comment: Preprint, under review. 9 pages main text, 27 pages total; 9 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://timelinebench.tensortest.com
summary: AI agents increasingly carry out long-horizon professional work, but their evaluations rarely require a finished creative deliverable. To this end, we introduce Timeline-Bench, a benchmark of 56 real video-editing tasks, each asking an agent to turn raw production material into a finished video. Tasks range from selecting dialog takes and shaping interview footage into a story to cutting commercials from product shots, voiceovers and graphics. Every task provides a brief, source assets, a container and a set of tests. A task is resolved when the output passes every test. The tests check the delivery format, the content and the brief's explicit requirements, and include a quality test calibrated on 2,582 blind judgments by 43 video editors. We evaluate 16 agents that pair frontier models with coding-agent harnesses such as Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode. The best, GPT-6 Astra in Codex with curated editorial guidance, resolves only 15 of the 56 tasks (26.8%), and the average agent resolves 14.0%. Human editors prefer the reference edit in 83.5% of judgments. Most unresolved runs (562 of 771) fail only the quality test: agents perceive footage through stills and transcripts and check their renders for defects, not craft. We release the tasks, verifier and per-run results at https://timelinebench.tensortest.com.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Timeline-Bench，一个包含 56 个真实视频剪辑任务的基准，用于评估 AI 智能体将原始素材制作成完整视频的能力；最强智能体仅解决 26.8% 的任务，且失败多集中在质量测试环节。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评估多为短程、可验证的任务，缺乏对"长周期专业工作并交付成品创意作品"的评测。视频剪辑是典型的长周期创意交付场景，因此需要一个端到端、有明确验证标准的新基准来暴露智能体在真实创意工作流中的能力缺口。
AI.method: 构建 Timeline-Bench：56 个真实视频剪辑任务，涵盖从对白选段、访谈叙事化到产品广告剪辑等。每个任务提供简介、源素材、容器和测试集，须通过全部测试才算解决。测试涵盖交付格式、内容与简介显式要求，并包含一个基于 43 位剪辑师 2,582 次盲评校准的质量测试。评估 16 个智能体，将前沿模型与 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等编码智能体框架配对。
AI.result: 表现最佳者为 Codex 中的 GPT-6 Astra 配合人工整理剪辑指南，仅解决 56 个任务中的 15 个（26.8%）；所有智能体平均解决率仅 14.0%。人工剪辑师在 83.5% 的评判中更偏好参考剪辑。未解决运行共 771 次，其中 562 次仅未通过质量测试。
AI.conclusion: 智能体普遍通过静态画面和转录文本感知素材，并仅检查渲染缺陷，而非真正评估剪辑技艺，因此在创意质量维度上系统性失败。基准揭示了当前智能体在长周期创意交付上的根本短板。任务、验证器与逐次运行结果已公开。

title: Toward a Culturally Adapted Chinese Language Agent: A Wizard-of-Oz Study of Nonverbal Behavior in Chinese-German Intercultural Interaction
comment: Accepted to ICMI Companion '26. 7 pages, 4 figure
summary: Successful intercultural communication requires more than grammatical competence. It demands sensitivity to culturally embedded social norms whose violation triggers subtle but meaningful nonverbal responses. For German learners of Mandarin Chinese, acquiring this sensitivity is critical yet poorly supported by existing language-learning agents. We present a Wizard-of-Oz (WoZ) study design and supporting real-time system for collecting multimodal behavioral data from native Chinese speakers reacting to social norm violations by German learners. The system features a photorealistic MetaHuman avatar driven by Live Link face capture and MediaPipe upper-body tracking, a wizard console for real-time behavior selection, and synchronized multimodal logging across agent and learner streams. A layered annotation framework, based on psychological theory and covering non-observable socioemotional reactions, norm interpretation, verbal, and observable behavior thereof, and future supervision targets enables the corpus to support training of future automated cultural interpretation and behavior generation models. Four ecologically valid interaction scenarios, developed with cultural and pedagogical experts, provide the methodological and technical foundation for a culturally adapted conversational agent for Chinese language learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套Wizard-of-Oz（WoZ）研究设计及实时系统，用于采集汉语母语者对德语母语者违反汉语社交规范时的多模态行为反应，以支撑未来文化适配型中文学习对话智能体的训练。
AI.motivation: 成功的跨文化交际不仅需要语法能力，还要求对文化内嵌社交规范的敏感性；规范被违反时会产生细微但有意义的非言语反应。对学习汉语的德语母语者而言，获得这种敏感性至关重要，但现有语言学习智能体对此支持不足，且缺乏相应的高质量多模态行为数据。
AI.method: 采用Wizard-of-Oz实验范式，构建支持实时交互与数据采集的系统：由Live Link面部捕捉驱动的写实MetaHuman虚拟人化身、MediaPipe上半身追踪、供实验操控者在实时状态下选择行为（"巫师"）的控制台，以及对智能体流与学习者流进行同步的多模态日志记录。配套设计分层标注框架，依据心理学理论，覆盖不可观测的社会情绪反应、规范解读、言语及可观测行为，以及未来监督目标。与文化和教学专家共同开发四个具有生态效度的互动场景。
AI.result: 搭建了可运行的实时WoZ系统，实现面部与上半身动作驱动及多流同步多模态日志；形成四类生态效度较高的跨文化互动场景；并建立可支持自动文化解读与行为生成模型训练的多层标注语料框架。
AI.conclusion: 该研究与系统为面向汉语学习的文化适配型对话智能体奠定了方法论与技术基础，并使语料库可用于训练未来的自动化文化解读与行为生成模型。

title: 5W1H+Which: Context-Valid Semantic Indexing with Progressive Ontology Binding
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Preprint of a proposed indexing method with falsifiable hypotheses; not empirically validated
summary: Transforming raw data into queryable knowledge requires both early extraction of reusable information and explicit types, relations, and applicability conditions for particular tasks. If indexing selects content too early around a single business schema, later tasks may be unable to use information that was omitted. If the index retains only open-ended text, however, rule-based reasoning lacks checkable premises. We propose 5W1H+Which, a semantic indexing design that separates content extraction from ontology binding. The 5W1H questions organize source-grounded content units; Which points to versioned ontology elements and records mapping relations, scope, and validation status. Time, location, system environment, and participant roles are not merely retrieval labels: together, they constrain the contexts in which facts, bindings, and rules apply. Unbound content remains searchable, while bound content enters a formal reasoning path only after premise checks. The method further distinguishes business valid time, system knowledge time, and operational traces, and uses dependency records to support binding revalidation and the maintenance of derived conclusions. A worked example of migration from an on-premises server to a cloud environment illustrates the different treatment of world-state changes, ontology-version changes, and changes in rule applicability. We formulate three groups of falsifiable hypotheses concerning cross-task evidence coverage, control of contextual misuse, and incremental update cost. The planned evaluation includes a strong typed fact-graph baseline with the same evidence, temporal information, and budget, to test whether benefits arise from 5W1H organization, deferred binding, or additional information and engineering effort. The contribution is a testable indexing mechanism, not a claim to a new universal ontology or a demonstrated performance advantage.

AI.tldr: 提出5W1H+Which语义索引机制，将内容抽取与本体绑定解耦，通过可证伪假设检验其对跨任务证据覆盖、语境误用控制与增量更新成本的效果。
AI.motivation: 原始数据转化为可查询知识面临两难：过早按单一业务模式索引会导致后续任务无法使用被丢弃的信息；而仅保留开放式文本又使规则推理缺乏可核验前提。需要一种既能保留可复用信息、又能提供显式类型、关系与适用条件索引设计。
AI.method: 提出5W1H+Which索引设计，将内容抽取与本体绑定分离：以5W1H问题组织来源可溯源的内容单元，Which指向带版本的本体元素并记录映射关系、作用域与验证状态。时间、地点、系统环境与参与者角色被用作约束事实、绑定与规则适用语境的维度。未绑定内容保持可检索，已绑定内容经前提检验后进入形式化推理路径。方法区分业务有效时间、系统知识时间与操作痕迹，并用依赖记录支持绑定再验证与派生结论维护。
AI.result: 以本地服务器迁移至云环境为实例，展示世界状态变化、本体版本变化与规则适用性变化的不同处理方式；提出三组可证伪假设，分别涉及跨任务证据覆盖、语境误用控制与增量更新成本。计划评估包含使用相同证据、时间信息与预算的强类型事实图基线，以判定收益来自5W1H组织、延迟绑定还是额外信息与工程投入。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于一种可检验的索引机制，而非宣称新的通用本体或已证实的性能优势。

title: G$^3$-LoRA: Organizing Reward-Weighted Video Data with Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA
summary: Post-training foundation video models on heterogeneous reward-weighted data usually assume that all data categories induce compatible updates. This assumption is fragile when categories correspond to different skills, domains, or evaluation dimensions. We study this problem in text-to-video post-training, where VBench2.0 dimensions define data buckets and an external multimodal reward pipeline assigns sample weights. We propose G$^3$-LoRA (Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA), a data organization procedure that probes category-level gradients induced by reward-weighted video samples, removes the shared global update direction, clusters categories by residual gradient compatibility, trains group-specific LoRA experts, and consolidates them into one adapter by weight merging followed by on-policy distillation from the experts. We motivate this procedure by viewing reward-weighted flow matching as velocity-field regression: incompatible reward dimensions may prefer different denoising directions in overlapping noisy latent regions, causing shared LoRA training to average capabilities. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers, the merged grouped adapter improves the matched VBench2.0 evaluation over the base model, a joint reward-weighted LoRA baseline, and random, semantic, and raw-gradient partitions trained with the same pipeline; an independent evaluator agrees, and on CogVideoX-2B grouping avoids the negative transfer of joint training. The gain is not uniform: merging compresses the largest specialist gains, distillation recovers part of this loss, and camera motion and several local-quality dimensions remain challenging. Together, these results suggest that gradient compatibility can serve as a practical diagnostic for organizing reward-weighted video post-training data.

AI.tldr: 提出 G³-LoRA，通过类别级梯度探测与残差梯度聚类组织奖励加权视频后训练数据，训练分组 LoRA 专家并合并蒸馏为单一适配器，在 VBench2.0 文本到视频后训练中优于联合训练等基线。
AI.motivation: 异构奖励加权数据后训练通常假设各数据类别产生兼容更新，但当类别对应不同技能、领域或评测维度时该假设不成立，共享 LoRA 训练会平均化不同能力。论文基于"奖励加权流匹配即速度场回归"的视角，指出不兼容奖励维度在重叠噪声潜空间区域偏好不同去噪方向，因此需要按梯度兼容性组织数据。
AI.method: G³-LoRA：以 VBench2.0 维度划分数据桶，外部多模态奖励管线赋样本权重；先探测奖励加权样本诱导的类别级梯度，减去共享全局更新方向，再按残差梯度兼容性聚类类别；为每组训练专用 LoRA 专家，最后通过权重合并与对专家的 on-policy 蒸馏整合为单一适配器。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers 上，合并后的分组适配器在匹配的 VBench2.0 评测中优于基座模型、联合奖励加权 LoRA 基线，以及采用相同流程的随机、语义和原始梯度划分；独立评测者结论一致。在 CogVideoX-2B 上分组避免了联合训练的负迁移。增益不均匀：合并压缩了最大专家增益，蒸馏挽回部分损失，相机运动与若干局部质量维度仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 梯度兼容性可作为组织奖励加权视频后训练数据的实用诊断指标。

title: CarveMix-RC: Addressing Rare-Class Imbalance Through Lesion-Aware Synthetic Augmentation for Brain Metastasis Segmentation
summary: Accurate segmentation of post-treatment brain metastases is essential for treatment planning, longitudinal disease monitoring, and quantitative assessment of therapeutic response. The BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1 challenge introduces a clinically relevant segmentation problem involving four anatomically distinct tumor subregions: non-enhancing tumor core (NETC), surrounding non-enhancing FLAIR hyperintensity (SNFH), enhancing tumor (ET), and the resection cavity (RC). Among these, RC segmentation is particularly challenging because of its low prevalence, heterogeneous postoperative appearance, and lesion-wise evaluation protocol, leading conventional segmentation networks to prioritize dominant tumor classes during optimization. The proposed nnU-Net-based framework explicitly addresses RC segmentation through four complementary components: (i) RC-weighted Dice and Cross-Entropy optimization to alleviate class imbalance, (ii) anatomically consistent cavity augmentation to increase the diversity of postoperative cavity appearances, (iii) a residual encoder architecture for enhanced multi-scale feature learning, and (iv) lesion-aware morphological post-processing to suppress false-positive cavity predictions while preserving anatomically plausible structures. The framework is evaluated on the BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1 online validation benchmark. Among the evaluated configurations, the ensemble model (Residual Encoder nnU-Net + nnU-Net + RC-aware CarveMix) achieves the best performance, with lesion-wise Dice scores of 0.732, 0.752, 0.708, and 0.575 and corresponding NSD scores of 0.794, 0.798, 0.727, and 0.474 for ET, TC, WT, and RC, respectively. These experimental results show that integrating RC-aware optimization, anatomically consistent augmentation, and lesion-aware post-processing provides an effective strategy for improving rare resection cavity segmentation in post-treatment brain metastases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于nnU-Net的框架，通过RC加权损失、解剖一致的腔体增强、残差编码器与病灶感知后处理，提升治疗后脑转移瘤（尤其切除腔RC）的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 治疗后脑转移瘤的精准分割对治疗规划、纵向监测与疗效定量评估至关重要。BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1 需分割四个亚区（NETC、SNFH、ET、RC），其中RC分割因低发病率、术后形态异质及病灶级评价协议，使常规网络在优化中偏向主导类别而被忽视。
AI.method: 采用nnU-Net基框架并引入四个互补组件：(i) RC加权Dice与交叉熵优化以缓解类别不平衡；(ii) 解剖一致的腔体增强提升术后腔体外观多样性；(iii) 残差编码器架构增强多尺度特征学习；(iv) 病灶感知形态学后处理，抑制假阳性腔体预测并保留解剖合理结构。
AI.result: 在BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1在线验证基准上评估，集成模型（Residual Encoder nnU-Net + nnU-Net + RC-aware CarveMix）表现最佳：ET、TC、WT、RC的病灶级Dice分别为0.732、0.752、0.708、0.575，对应NSD为0.794、0.798、0.727、0.474。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，融合RC感知优化、解剖一致增强与病灶感知后处理，是提升治疗后脑转移瘤中稀有切除腔分割的有效策略。

title: From Normative Frameworks to Alignment Data: Constructing and Evaluating SFT and Preference Data
summary: Aligning language models with a specified normative framework requires translating abstract principles into concrete examples and preference signals from which models can learn. We present an expert-driven methodology for constructing such alignment data and apply it to a normative framework grounded in Islamic ethical, theological, and jurisprudential traditions. Over approximately one year, seven domain experts systematically probed language models to identify alignment deficiencies, curated desired responses, and constructed preference pairs from model outputs and expert judgments. The resulting Arabic-English datasets contain approximately 2.8K supervised fine-tuning (SFT) examples and 5.4K preference pairs spanning a broad range of normative domains. We evaluate the datasets through controlled post-training experiments comparing a Baseline model with models incorporating the curated SFT data alone and both the SFT and preference data. In blind expert evaluation on 150 separately constructed prompts, the model trained with the curated SFT data was preferred over the Baseline in 51.3% of assessor judgments, compared with 14.4% in the opposite direction (p < .001 at the prompt level). Adding the preference data resulted in a smaller difference, with the model trained with both datasets preferred over the SFT model in 28.0% of judgments versus 20.9% in the opposite direction; this difference was not statistically significant at the prompt level (p = .166). Standard Arabic and English benchmarks show no broad degradation in general-purpose capabilities. These results demonstrate how expert-defined normative principles can be systematically operationalized into alignment data and evaluated through controlled model training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套专家驱动的对齐数据构建方法，将伊斯兰伦理、神学与法理学规范框架转化为约2.8K条SFT样本和5.4K对偏好数据（阿拉伯语-英语），并通过受控后训练实验验证其对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 将语言模型对齐到特定规范框架，需要把抽象原则转译为具体示例与偏好信号。现有研究缺乏针对特定规范传统、由领域专家系统构建对齐数据的可操作方法论，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 由七位领域专家历时约一年，系统性地探查语言模型的对齐缺陷，整理理想回复，并基于模型输出与专家判断构建偏好对。最终形成约2.8K条SFT样本与5.4K对偏好数据，覆盖广泛的规范领域。采用受控后训练实验，对比基线模型、仅使用SFT数据的模型，以及同时使用SFT与偏好数据的模型。
AI.result: 在针对150个独立构建提示的盲评中，仅用SFT数据的模型在51.3%的评估者判断中优于基线模型，反向偏好为14.4%（提示层面p<.001）。加入偏好数据后差异缩小：同时使用两类数据的模型在28.0%的判断中优于SFT模型，反向为20.9%，提示层面不显著（p=.166）。标准阿拉伯语与英语基准显示通用能力未出现明显退化。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，专家定义的规范原则可被系统性地操作化为对齐数据，并通过受控模型训练加以评估。该框架为面向特定规范传统的对齐数据构建与验证提供了可复现的方法论示例。

title: ReCAT: Remember, Count, and Time: Structured Recurrent Memory for Robot Manipulation
summary: Memory-dependent manipulation requires robots to make decisions using information that is no longer available to their current sensors, such as recalling an earlier visual cue, tracking task progress, counting repeated events, or estimating elapsed time. We present ReCAT, a language-conditioned policy with structured recurrent memory. An instruction-conditioned encoder forms features from the current observation. A recurrent memory integrates the observation stream through Mamba-2 layers and one causal attention layer. A flow-matching Transformer decoder reads the current and the historical representation through separate cross-attention in every block. ReCAT reaches 95.3\% average success on LIBERO and 62.4\% on RMBench, with the best or tied-best result on six of nine tasks. On three real-robot tasks probing spatial recall, event counting, and interval timing, the best ReCAT variant reaches 66.7\% average success, against 8.3\% for the strongest short-history baseline. Controlled comparisons within ReCAT show that the observation encoder and every-block memory conditioning are needed for this performance. They also show that update rules developed for efficient sequence modeling behave differently as robot memory: additive updates have the highest observed success on counting and timing, and delta-rule updates on spatial recall. Project website is at https://intuitive-robots.github.io/ReCAT

AI.tldr: ReCAT：一种带结构化循环记忆的语言条件机器人策略，通过指令条件编码器、Mamba-2+因果注意力的循环记忆与逐块交叉注意力的流匹配解码器，解决记忆依赖操作任务。
AI.motivation: 记忆依赖型操作要求机器人利用当前传感器已无法获取的信息做决策，如回忆先前视觉线索、跟踪任务进度、计数重复事件或估计经过时间。现有短历史策略难以胜任此类任务。
AI.method: 1) 指令条件编码器从当前观测提取特征；2) 循环记忆通过Mamba-2层与一层因果注意力整合观测流；3) 流匹配Transformer解码器在每个块中分别用交叉注意力读取当前与历史表征；4) 对比不同记忆更新规则（加法更新、delta规则更新）及消融编码器与逐块记忆条件。
AI.result: LIBERO平均成功率95.3%，RMBench 62.4%，九项任务中六项最优或并列最优；三项真实机器人任务（空间回忆、事件计数、间隔计时）最佳变体平均成功率66.7%，最强短历史基线仅8.3%。消融显示观测编码器与逐块记忆条件为性能必需；加法更新在计数与计时上成功率最高，delta规则更新在空间回忆上更优。
AI.conclusion: 结构化循环记忆结合语言条件策略能有效支撑记忆依赖操作；记忆更新规则的选择需按任务类型（计数/计时 vs. 空间回忆）权衡。

title: From UNI2-h to ConvNeXt-T: Lightweight Nuclei Instance Segmentation via Knowledge Distillation
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI 2027)
summary: Nuclei instance segmentation is a core task in digital pathology, yet high-accuracy models rely on large vision transformer (ViT) encoders whose inference speed cannot meet real-time clinical demands. We propose a lightweight scheme that distills the UNI2-h pathology foundation model into a ConvNeXt-Tiny student (Ours-T, 34.7M parameters, 1/20 of the teacher) via output-level knowledge distillation. Ours-T achieves an mPQ of 0.519 on PanNuke (98.8% of the teacher), a zero-shot bPQ of 0.668 on MoNuSeg, and an inference speed of 634.3 img/s, requiring only 0.045 s for full-resolution 1024^2 analysis (21.8x speedup). Experiments further show that multi-scale gated convolution (MALA) yields no gain under ViT encoders, and output-level distillation alone suffices for efficient knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 将UNI2-h病理基础模型通过输出级知识蒸馏压缩至ConvNeXt-Tiny学生模型，实现接近教师精度且21.8倍加速的轻量核实例分割方案。
AI.motivation: 数字病理中核实例分割依赖大型ViT编码器，推理速度无法满足实时临床需求，需在保持高精度的前提下实现轻量化。
AI.method: 提出轻量方案：以输出级知识蒸馏将UNI2-h病理基础模型蒸馏至ConvNeXt-Tiny学生模型（Ours-T，34.7M参数，为教师的1/20）；并考察多尺度门控卷积（MALA）在不同编码器下的效果。
AI.result: Ours-T在PanNuke上mPQ为0.519（教师的98.8%）；MoNuSeg零样本bPQ为0.668；推理速度634.3 img/s，1024²全分辨率分析仅需0.045 s，加速21.8倍。实验显示MALA在ViT编码器下无增益，仅输出级蒸馏即可完成高效知识迁移。
AI.conclusion: 输出级知识蒸馏足以实现高效知识迁移，可在显著提速的同时保持接近基础模型的核实例分割精度，适用于实时临床场景。

title: Understanding On-Policy Distillation: A Mechanistic Interpretability Perspective via Sparse Crosscoders
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a widely adopted post-training technique for LLM reasoning. It is commonly believed to transfer knowledge from a stronger teacher, yet what OPD actually distills into the student's internal representations remains unclear. We study this question with sparse crosscoders, which learn one feature dictionary shared by the student before and after OPD and the teacher. Standard crosscoder analyses, however, identify model-specific features but cannot tell how a model's use of its features changes, since all models are encoded into one set of feature activations. We therefore propose the swap readout, which reads each student checkpoint's feature activations on its own, measuring how training changes the student's use of each feature, even for checkpoints unseen by the crosscoder. Across three OPD settings, we find that OPD neither creates features nor passes on the teacher's own, and leaves the firing rates of over 98% of the student's frequently used features within 20%. We further examine the SFT warm-up on the teacher's rollouts that commonly precedes OPD and makes it more effective. Rather than adding features, the warm-up reweights the shared ones in two ways. First, it already raises and lowers many of the features that OPD later raises and lowers, doing part of OPD's work in advance. Second, it changes features that OPD alone would not, notably those for conversation format, reasoning style, and mathematical notation, and these changes persist through OPD. Imposing this reweighting on a directly distilled student's features, without changing its weights, brings its accuracy close to that of the warmed-up student, whereas the same change on shuffled features does not. Together, these findings suggest that OPD reweights existing features rather than acquiring new ones: the student learns from the teacher how to use the features they already share.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用稀疏 crosscoder 与提出的 swap readout 方法，研究 on-policy distillation（OPD）究竟在学生模型内部表征中蒸馏了什么，发现 OPD 并不创造新特征，也不传递教师自身特征，而是重新加权学生已有的共享特征。
AI.motivation: OPD 被广泛用于 LLM 推理的后训练，通常被认为是从更强教师向学生传递知识，但 OPD 实际蒸馏进学生内部表征的内容尚不明确。标准 crosscoder 分析只能识别模型特有特征，无法刻画模型对特征使用方式的变化，因此需要新方法来追踪训练如何改变学生对每个特征的使用。
AI.method: 采用稀疏 crosscoder，学习一套由 OPD 前后学生以及教师共享的特征字典；针对标准 crosscoder 无法度量特征使用变化的问题，提出 swap readout，对每个学生 checkpoint 单独读取其特征激活，从而测量训练如何改变学生对每个特征的使用，即使该 checkpoint 未被 crosscoder 见过。在三种 OPD 设置下进行分析，并进一步考察常见于 OPD 之前、能提升 OPD 效果的 SFT warm-up（基于教师 rollout）。
AI.result: 在三种 OPD 设置中，OPD 既不创建特征，也不传递教师自身特征，学生频繁使用特征中超过 98% 的激活率变化在 20% 以内。SFT warm-up 并非增加特征，而是以两种方式重加权共享特征：一是提前升高或降低许多 OPD 后续也会升高或降低的特征，预先完成部分 OPD 工作；二是改变 OPD 单独不会改变的特征，尤其是对话格式、推理风格和数学符号相关特征，且这些变化会贯穿 OPD。将这种重加权施加到直接蒸馏学生的特征上（不改变其权重），可使其准确率接近经过 warm-up 的学生，而对打乱特征施加同样改变则无此效果。
AI.conclusion: OPD 主要是重新加权已有特征，而非获取新特征：学生从教师处学到的是如何使用它们已经共享的特征。

title: Layer-Informed Fine-Tuning via Three-Stage Functional Segmentation of LLMs
summary: In recent years, the performance of large language models (LLMs) on reasoning tasks has been remarkable, even surpassing human capabilities on various benchmarks. However, there remains a lack of clear understanding in the academic community regarding how the structure and internal parameters of LLMs progressively solve complex reasoning problems. In this study, we investigate the inference process of LLMs on cross-linguistic materials and propose the hypothesis that LLM layers exhibit a structured division of labor across conceptualization, reasoning, and textualization. Based on this hypothesis, we introduce a bottleneck identification mechanism using sensitivity analysis to pinpoint the most critical functional stage for a specific task. Leveraging this insight, we propose a novel approach, Layer-Informed Fine-Tuning (LIFT), which achieves efficient and effective fine-tuning by selectively updating only these functionally critical layers. We then conduct extensive experiments to show that the LIFT method not only accelerates the training process but also significantly improves model performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究探究LLM推理的层级分工机制，提出"概念化—推理—文本化"假设，借助敏感性分析的瓶颈识别机制定位关键功能层，并提出仅更新关键层的LIFT微调方法，实验表明其能加速训练并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM在推理任务上表现优异甚至超越人类，但学界对其结构与内部参数如何逐步求解复杂推理问题仍缺乏清晰理解，尤其缺少对层级功能分工与关键层的系统认识。
AI.method: 在跨语言材料上考察LLM的推理过程，提出LLM层在概念化、推理、文本化三个阶段呈结构化分工的假设；基于该假设引入敏感性分析的瓶颈识别机制，用以定位特定任务最关键的功能阶段；据此提出LIFT（Layer-Informed Fine-Tuning），选择性仅更新功能关键层实现高效微调。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，LIFT方法不仅加快训练过程，还显著提升模型性能。
AI.conclusion: LLM层级存在概念化、推理、文本化的结构化分工，可通过瓶颈识别定位关键层；仅微调关键层的LIFT是一种高效且有效的微调范式，为理解与优化LLM推理提供新视角。

title: TANGO: Watermarking Masked Diffusion Language Models in Token Pairs
summary: Masked-diffusion language models fill in masked positions in parallel and in no fixed order. Most practical text watermarks assume left-to-right generation. They key each token to the tokens before it, and in a diffusion model those tokens may still be masked. A fixed green list needs no such context, but it favors the same tokens at every position, so these tokens appear more often in watermarked text. An attacker who compares token frequencies in watermarked and unwatermarked text can recover the list and forge text that the provider's own detector accepts. We present TANGO, a watermark for masked-diffusion language models that keys each new token to a nearby token that is already unmasked. A secret key splits the vocabulary into color classes, and TANGO biases the new token toward a color determined by the key and the nearby token's color. The watermark is therefore embedded in pairs of tokens. Because the favored color changes from position to position, token frequencies stay much closer to those of unwatermarked text than under a fixed green list. Detection needs only the text and the key, and it does not assume any unmasking order. On two masked-diffusion models, TANGO detects nearly all unedited watermarked texts and most edited ones, and frequency attacks that forge the fixed green list fail against it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TANGO，一种针对掩码扩散语言模型的水印方案，通过将新token与邻近已解掩token的关联进行嵌入，避免了固定绿名单易受频率攻击的缺陷，并在检测与抗攻击能力上均取得良好效果。
AI.motivation: 多数实用文本水印假设从左到右生成，将每个token与之前的token关联，但扩散模型中之前的token可能仍处于掩码状态。固定绿名单虽不依赖上下文，却在每个位置偏好相同token，导致词频异常，攻击者可通过比较有无水印文本的词频恢复绿名单并伪造可通过检测的文本。因此需要一种既适应扩散模型并行动态解掩特性、又能抵抗频率攻击的水印方法。
AI.method: TANGO将每个新生成的token与一个邻近的、已经解掩的token关联。利用秘密密钥将词表划分为颜色类别，并根据密钥和邻近token的颜色，将新token偏向某一颜色，从而把水印嵌入到token对中。由于偏好颜色随位置变化，token频率比固定绿名单更接近无水印文本。检测仅需文本和密钥，且不假设任何解掩顺序。
AI.result: 在两个掩码扩散模型上，TANGO几乎能检测出所有未编辑的水印文本以及大多数经过编辑的文本；针对固定绿名单的频率攻击在TANGO上失效。
AI.conclusion: TANGO是一种适用于掩码扩散语言模型的水印方法，通过token对关联和动态颜色偏好，兼顾了检测有效性、顺序无关性与抗频率攻击能力。

title: SignFLIP: A Unified Model for Sign Language Translation and Generation via Stage-wise Alignment at Scale
summary: Sign language translation and generation share the goal of bidirectional alignment between text and sign representations. However, existing approaches either treat them as isolated tasks or are only verified on limited datasets, limiting effective modeling between modalities. In this paper, we propose SignFLIP, a unified LLM-centered framework for translation and generation. To enable bidirectional mapping between text and sign, SignFLIP adopts a symmetric architecture together with a stage-wise training strategy built on large-scale data. The shared sign--text representation is progressively refined: pre-alignment facilitates subsequent SLT, while the SLT-adapted representation further benefits SLG. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that SignFLIP shows competitive performance compared with task-specific models on both translation and generation tasks, as well as strong transferability to sign language recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出SignFLIP，一个以LLM为中心的统一框架，实现手语翻译与生成的双向对齐，并通过分阶段训练与对称架构提升跨模态建模能力。
AI.motivation: 现有手语翻译与生成方法要么将二者视为孤立任务，要么仅在有限数据集上验证，限制了模态间有效建模。
AI.method: SignFLIP采用对称架构与基于大规模数据的分阶段训练策略，构建文本与手语间的双向映射；共享的手语-文本表示被逐步精炼：预对齐促进后续SLT，SLT适配后的表示进一步利于SLG。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，SignFLIP在翻译与生成任务上均与任务专用模型相比具有竞争力，并对手语识别展现出强迁移性。
AI.conclusion: SignFLIP验证了以LLM为中心的统一框架在手语翻译与生成双向任务中的有效性及泛化潜力。

title: Generative AI-Based Data Augmentation for Oral Lesion Classification: The PhotoMOCI Dataset and Benchmark
summary: Early detection of oral cancer via photographic imaging presents a promising avenue for large-scale oral cavity screening. However, the development of robust deep learning models is frequently hampered by the scarcity of high-quality, annotated datasets. To address this limitation, a novel and well-curated resource, the Photographic Multi-purpose Oral Cancer Imaging (PhotoMOCI) dataset, is introduced for developing models across multiple diagnostic tasks in oral oncology. Then, a comprehensive benchmark study was conducted to investigate how various data augmentation strategies influence the performance of image classifiers. Our analysis spans different generative AI frameworks, evaluating the efficacy of traditional methods against advanced generative approaches, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Diffusion Models (DMs). Additionally, we propose the Synthetic Image Filter (SIF), a mechanism to select specific samples based on two auxiliary models: Synthetic Proxy Classifier to ensure samples are representative of the target class and Synthetic Image Detector to verify they appear realistic, thereby selecting only the high-utility images that contribute to improving downstream performance. Across the evaluated datasets and classifiers, the best SIF-filtered setup improves accuracy over traditional augmentation in all cases, with gains of +1.73% and +2.35% on PhotoMOCI and +2.38% and +2.08% on KOCD for ResNet50 and ViT, respectively. Our findings reveal that while the direct application of generative data augmentation may yield performance drops, the integration of SIF, considering (i) how synthetic data looks real and (ii) how it reflects the discriminative features of the belonging class, provides a simple yet effective mechanism to filter out synthetic samples that confuse the classifier during training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhotoMOCI口腔癌影像数据集与Synthetic Image Filter (SIF)过滤机制，系统评估了传统与生成式数据增强在口腔癌图像分类中的效果。SIF通过合成代理分类器与合成图像检测器筛选高质量合成样本，在PhotoMOCI与KOCD数据集及ResNet50、ViT分类器上均稳定优于传统增强。
AI.motivation: 口腔癌摄影成像筛查具有大规模应用前景，但高质量标注数据稀缺，限制了深度学习模型的鲁棒性；同时生成式数据增强的直接应用可能导致性能下降，缺乏有效的合成样本筛选手段。
AI.method: 引入精心构建的PhotoMOCI多用途口腔癌影像数据集，涵盖口腔肿瘤学多项诊断任务；开展基准研究，比较传统增强与基于GAN、扩散模型等生成式AI框架的增强策略；提出SIF机制，借助合成代理分类器（保证样本对目标类具代表性）与合成图像检测器（验证图像真实性）双重辅助模型筛选高可用合成图像。
AI.result: 在所有评估数据集与分类器上，经SIF筛选的最佳配置均优于传统增强：在PhotoMOCI上ResNet50与ViT分别提升+1.73%与+2.35%，在KOCD上分别提升+2.38%与+2.08%。
AI.conclusion: 直接使用生成式数据增强可能导致性能下降，而结合合成数据的真实感与其对所属类别判别特征的体现进行筛选的SIF机制，是一种简单有效的方案，可剔除在训练中混淆分类器的合成样本，从而提升下游性能。

title: Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Latent test-time scaling improves reasoning by refining hidden states during inference, but existing methods typically apply a single scalar reward to all editable latent tokens. For multimodal large language models, this global update ignores that generated tokens play different roles: some are sensitive to visual evidence, while others correspond to uncertain reasoning decisions. We present Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling, an inference-time framework that makes latent refinement token-role-aware. Starting from an initial generated trajectory, we optimize a short hidden-state prefix while routing perception-side visual feedback to image-sensitive tokens and reasoning feedback to high-entropy tokens. Tokens selected by neither route are constrained by an anchor regularizer. Across both perception and reasoning benchmarks on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, our method lifts macro accuracy over CoT by +2.57 and +1.51 respectively, and outperforms strong output-space test-time scaling baselines under matched decoded-candidate budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/TD-LTTS.

AI.tldr: 提出Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling（TD-LTTS）框架，将潜在测试时缩放从全局单一奖励改为token角色感知的差异化反馈，在多模态大模型上显著提升推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在测试时缩放方法对所有可编辑隐状态施加单一标量奖励，但在多模态大模型中，生成token角色不同：部分对视觉证据敏感，部分对应不确定的推理决策，全局统一更新忽略了这种差异。
AI.method: 从初始生成轨迹出发，优化一段短隐状态前缀；将感知侧视觉反馈路由到图像敏感token，将推理反馈路由到高熵token；未被两条路径选中的token由锚点正则项约束。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B与InternVL3.5-8B上，于感知与推理基准测试中，宏观准确率相比CoT分别提升+2.57与+1.51，并在匹配解码候选预算下优于强输出空间测试时缩放基线。
AI.conclusion: token角色感知的潜在精炼是提升多模态大模型推理的有效方向；TD-LTTS在感知与推理任务上均取得一致增益，且效率优于输出空间测试时缩放方法。

title: Beyond Selection: Token Parameterization for Extreme Visual Token Compression
summary: Visual-token compression is effective for improving the efficiency of vision-language models, but under extreme compression budgets, token pruning can break visual grounding while learned resamplers increase parameter count, attention cost, and training complexity. We revisit compression through a token parameterization lens, separating (i) basis transformation and structured truncation (retained subspace/compressibility) from (ii) coordinate organization (optimization and cross-modal alignment). This view yields two coupled objectives, compressibility and learnability, which we formalize as unified functionals. Guided by these objectives, we design Braco, a lightweight four-step coder that combines transform-basis truncation, input-independent basis-coordinate embeddings, budget-dependent orthogonal re-parameterization, and learned spatial residual tokens from lightweight pooling. Experiments show that Braco forms the favorable empirical accuracy-efficiency frontier under $23\times$--$64\times$ compression and remains competitive at $144\times$, reaching 95.2% accuracy while reducing prefill FLOPs by 84.2%--86.7% relative to the uncompressed upper bound. Against prior methods, Braco matches or improves accuracy while achieving up to approximately 36% end-to-end speedup and using $16.6\times$/$78.8\times$ lower compressor latency/FLOPs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视觉token压缩新视角，并设计轻量级四步编码器Braco，在高压缩率下实现更优精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 提升视觉-语言模型效率的视觉token压缩在极端压缩预算下存在问题：token剪枝会破坏视觉定位，而学习式重采样器会增加参数量、注意力开销和训练复杂度。
AI.method: 从token参数化视角重新审视压缩，将(i)基变换与结构化截断（保留子空间/可压缩性）与(ii)坐标组织（优化与跨模态对齐）分离，形式化可压缩性与可学习性两个耦合目标为统一泛函。据此设计Braco四步编码器：变换基截断、输入无关的基坐标嵌入、预算相关的正交重参数化、来自轻量池化的可学习空间残差token。
AI.result: 在23×–64×压缩下形成有利的经验精度-效率前沿，144×下仍具竞争力；达到95.2%准确率，同时相对未压缩上界减少84.2%–86.7%的prefill FLOPs。与先前方法相比，在匹配或提升准确率的同时实现最高约36%端到端加速，压缩器延迟/FLOPs低16.6×/78.8×。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离基变换与坐标组织的token参数化视角及可压缩性/可学习性统一目标，Braco以轻量结构在高压缩率下实现优越的精度-效率权衡。

title: DrawingsDreamer: A Unified Multi-View Engineering Drawings Generation Model
summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) are essential for modern industrial Computer-Aided Design (CAD). However, existing autoregressive SVG generation models are predominantly tailored for artistic creation and struggle to maintain the rigorous geometric fidelity and cross-view spatial alignment required for engineering drawings. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{DrawingsDreamer}, a unified Large Language Model (LLM)-driven framework for multi-view vector-based engineering drawings generation. By formulating the generation of multi-view engineering drawings purely as a sequence modeling task, we eliminate the need of raster image encoders. We propose a Streamlined Representation utilizing hierarchical postfix tokenization, which guides the model to establish local geometric coordinates before assigning semantic boundaries. Optimized via a progressive task-aware curriculum schedule, \textbf{DrawingsDreamer} effectively transitions from localized structural repair to macroscopic generation in a unified model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our unified model achieves strong performance in both geometric fidelity and syntactic accuracy across diverse conditional and unconditional generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 DrawingsDreamer——一个由 LLM 驱动的统一框架，将多视角矢量工程图纸生成建模为纯序列任务，无需栅格图像编码器，并在几何保真度与语法准确性上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归 SVG 生成模型主要面向艺术创作，难以满足工程图纸所需的严格几何保真度与跨视角空间对齐要求，亟需面向工业 CAD 的矢量图纸生成方案。
AI.method: 将多视角工程图纸生成纯视为序列建模任务，去除栅格图像编码器；提出采用层次化后缀分词（hierarchical postfix tokenization）的简化表示，引导模型先建立局部几何坐标再分配语义边界；通过渐进式任务感知课程调度优化，使统一模型从局部结构修复过渡到宏观生成。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该统一模型在多种条件与无条件生成任务上，于几何保真度和语法准确性方面均取得强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: DrawingsDreamer 有效弥合了自回归矢量生成与工业工程制图需求之间的差距，验证了纯序列建模范式在多视角矢量工程图纸生成中的可行性与有效性。

title: AnswerMap: Faithful Spatial Interpretability of VLMs from Answer Posteriors
summary: When a VLM answers a visual query, current interpretability tools rely on text rationales, which use a mismatched modality, or on internal read-outs, which originate too early to reflect the final output and require white-box access to the model. We introduce AnswerMap, a training-free, task-agnostic, black-box visual rationale constructed from the output head. The image is cut into K row and K column bands, each shown alone to the frozen model along with the query in the format of a yes/no relevance question. The outer product of the row and column ``yes'' posteriors gives the query-conditioned spatial map. Crucially, by defining a fixed read-out R (e.g., expectation, maximum) on top of AnswerMap, we can derive continuous outputs like location natively. This bypasses the reliance on discrete text tokens for continuous-output tasks and guarantees an image-dependent answer by construction. However, a rationale can be confabulated, so we validate AnswerMap across four models and three query distributions with two tests: (a) agreement with the model's own generated point and (b) deletion of the map's region. The map lands where the model points (AUC 0.85 against 0.38 for attention), and deleting its region flips 53% of correct answers (against 19% for attention's). Beyond establishing faithfulness, we demonstrate the map's task-agnostic utility through three distinct read-outs: its maximum flags hallucinated objects without generation, its expectation localizes correctly when the model's own pointing fails, and its top-mass region, fed back as a crop, fixes half of the model's wrong answers. AnswerMap thus offers a new lens on VLM interpretability and, through its read-outs, a new output interface for visual tasks beyond text tokens.

AI.tldr: AnswerMap：一种从VLM输出头构建的免训练、任务无关、黑盒视觉理据——通过对图像行列条带做是/否相关性询问并取外积得到查询条件空间图，并在其上定义读出（如期望、最大值）实现连续输出（如定位），同时验证其忠实性并提供多种读出接口。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM可解释性工具依赖文本理据（模态不匹配）或内部读数（出现过早、无法反映最终输出，且需白盒访问）。作者希望构建一种既忠实于模型最终输出、又无需训练与白盒权限的视觉理据，并能原生支持连续输出任务（如定位），避免依赖离散文本token。
AI.method: 提出AnswerMap：将图像切分为K个行条带与K个列条带，分别单独与查询一起以是/否相关性问题的形式输入冻结模型；对行、列“yes”后验取外积，得到查询条件的空间图。在AnswerMap上定义固定读出R（如期望、最大值）以导出连续输出（如位置），构造上保证答案依赖图像。用四种模型、三种查询分布，通过两项测试验证：(a)与模型自身生成的指向点一致性；(b)删除图中区域的影响。
AI.result: AnswerMap落在模型指向处（AUC 0.85，注意力为0.38）；删除其区域使53%的正确回答翻转（注意力为19%）。三种读出展示任务无关效用：最大值可在不生成的情况下标记幻觉对象；期望在模型自身指向失败时仍能正确定位；其最高质量区域作为裁剪反馈可修正模型一半的错误答案。
AI.conclusion: AnswerMap为VLM可解释性提供新视角，并通过其读出为视觉任务提供超越文本token的新输出接口。

title: Spatial Grafting: Grounding 3D Features for Flow-Matching Robot Policies
summary: Pretrained robot manipulation policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) or world-action models (WAMs) leave interaction-relevant metric geometry implicit. Recent breakthroughs in spatial reconstruction can supply the necessary geometry reliably, but their features describe local shape without stating where it lies with respect to the robot. How best to deliver these features to a pretrained policy remains unresolved. We propose Spatial Grafting, a versatile, lightweight spatial module that binds frozen reconstruction features to metric, robot-relative geometry. Spatial Grafting constructs metric-grounded spatial tokens and injects them into the flow-matching action expert through cross-attention, without modifying the host's perceptual pathway, so the host retains the full benefit of its pretraining. We evaluate it more broadly than any geometry-aware policy we compare against: one graft architecture, with no per-host redesign, on two VLAs and two WAMs, across four simulation benchmarks that span short-horizon manipulation, visual robustness, clutter and long-horizon mobile manipulation, and on three real-robot platforms with single- and dual-arm configurations. On RoboTwin 2.0, a dual-arm manipulation benchmark, the graft improves every host across VLAs and WAMs. Grafted $π_{0.5}$ gains 11.3% and 15.6% on clean and randomized scenes, reaching 94.0% and 92.4%, above the strongest published 3D-conditioned policy, WAM4D (93.8% and 89.9%). The margin widens as the horizon lengthens: on tasks from BEHAVIOR-1K, a dual-arm mobile manipulation challenge scored by average task progress, it surpasses the 2025 challenge winner on five of six tasks,by up to 0.47 Q-score, and exceeds a map-conditioned spatial policy on average across the three tasks both report.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spatial Grafting，一种轻量空间模块，将冻结的3D重建特征绑定至机器人相对的度量几何，并通过交叉注意力注入流匹配动作专家；在两款VLA、两款WAM、四个仿真基准与三个真实平台上验证，RoboTwin 2.0上π₀.₅提升11.3%/15.6%达94.0%/92.4%。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人操作策略（VLA、WAM）将交互相关的度量几何隐式化；近期空间重建虽能可靠提供几何，但其特征仅描述局部形状，未说明其相对机器人的位置。如何把这些特征有效传递给预训练策略仍未解决。
AI.method: Spatial Grafting 构建度量接地的空间token，通过交叉注意力注入流匹配动作专家，不修改宿主感知通路，从而保留预训练收益；单一嫁接架构无需针对各宿主重新设计。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0上所有宿主均有提升：嫁接的π₀.₅在干净/随机场景提升11.3%/15.6%，达94.0%/92.4%，超过最强已发表3D条件策略WAM4D（93.8%/89.9%）。在BEHAVIOR-1K上六项任务中五项超越2025挑战赛冠军，最高领先0.47 Q-score；在双方均报告的三项任务上平均超越地图条件空间策略。
AI.conclusion: Spatial Grafting 是一种通用、轻量的空间模块，以统一架构适配多种宿主与场景，随任务时域延长优势扩大，在仿真与真实平台上均验证有效。

title: SCBO: Semantically Coherent Batching and Ordering for LLM-Based Social Surveys
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a scalable way to simulate survey respondents using demographic profiles and observed reference responses. However, the conventional approach of predicting one question per prompt repeatedly encodes the same context, limits each target to a narrow set of reference responses, and prevents later predictions from using information in earlier answers. Predicting multiple questions in one prompt can reduce these costs, share a broader pool of references, and let later predictions build on earlier ones. This requires forming coherent batches, selecting shared references, and ordering questions and references effectively. We propose Semantically Coherent Batching and Ordering (SCBO), a training-free framework that addresses these challenges. SCBO first uses an LLM to extract compact semantic representations from survey items and filter out template noise. It then groups related questions into batches and builds a shared reference bank using target-specific retrieval and centroid-based completion. Finally, it orders target questions from easy to hard and arranges references according to their semantic alignment with those questions. Experiments on four large-scale survey datasets and four LLMs show that SCBO substantially reduces token consumption and inference time while generally improving prediction accuracy over a non-batched baseline. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SCBO-41D8.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架SCBO，通过语义连贯的批处理与排序，在多问题提示下模拟问卷受访者，降低token消耗与推理时间并提升预测精度。
AI.motivation: 传统逐题预测方式重复编码相同上下文、每题参考样本池狭窄，且后续预测无法利用前面已生成答案的信息，成本高且浪费信息。
AI.method: SCBO包含三步：用LLM从问卷题目中提取紧凑语义表示并过滤模板噪声；将相关问题分组为批次，通过目标特定检索与基于质心的补全构建共享参考库；将目标问题按易到难排序，并按与问题的语义对齐度排列参考。
AI.result: 在四个大规模问卷数据集和四种LLM上，SCBO显著降低token消耗与推理时间，且在多数情况下预测精度优于非批处理基线。
AI.conclusion: 批量预测结合语义连贯的分组与排序，可在提升效率的同时保持或提升问卷模拟精度，为LLM模拟受访者提供了一种免训练的可扩展方案。

title: Rubric-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Personalization
summary: LLM personalization aims to generate responses aligned with individual users' preferences and needs. User-specific rubrics make these expectations explicit, providing direct supervision on what a satisfactory answer should cover. Existing rubric-guided approaches, however, exploit such guidance only at a coarse granularity, either by using rubrics to supervise the prediction of relevant aspects for subsequent generation or by reducing aspect coverage to a single response-level reward for reinforcement learning. This leaves a gap between specifying what a personalized answer should contain and teaching the model how to generate it. To bridge this gap, we propose GRASP, a rubric-aware on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM personalization that turns user-specific rubric aspects into fine-grained, token-level supervision. Specifically, GRASP pairs a rubric-free student with a rubric-informed teacher that additionally receives the target user-specific rubrics. By aligning their next-token distributions along on-policy trajectories generated by the student, GRASP transfers the teacher's rubric-conditioned guidance into the student, translating user-specific semantic requirements into dense token-level supervision. Since rubric-informed teachers can still produce inadequate supervision, we further introduce Rubric-based Teacher Validation (RTV), which retains only instances where the teacher sufficiently covers the target aspects, improving both supervision quality and training efficiency. Experiments on the LaMP-QA benchmark for personalized question answering demonstrate that GRASP achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple backbones, supporting the effectiveness of rubric-guided token-level supervision for personalization. To ensure reproducibility, our code is available at https://github.com/SnowCharmQ/GRASP.

AI.tldr: 提出GRASP，一种基于评分标准感知的在线策略自蒸馏框架，将用户特定评分标准转化为细粒度token级监督，在LaMP-QA基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于评分标准（rubric）的LLM个性化方法仅以粗粒度方式利用评分标准：或用于监督相关方面的预测，或将其压缩为单一响应级奖励用于强化学习。这导致"明确个性化回答应包含什么"与"教会模型如何生成"之间存在鸿沟，缺乏从语义要求到生成过程的细粒度监督。
AI.method: GRASP将无评分标准的学生模型与额外接收目标用户特定评分标准的教师模型配对，在由学生模型生成的在线策略（on-policy）轨迹上对齐二者的下一token分布，从而将教师的评分标准条件化指导迁移给学生，实现token级密集监督。此外提出Rubric-based Teacher Validation (RTV)，仅保留教师充分覆盖目标方面的实例，以提升监督质量与训练效率。
AI.result: 在个性化问答基准LaMP-QA上，GRASP在多个骨干模型上均取得SOTA性能，验证了评分标准引导的token级监督对个性化任务的有效性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 评分标准引导的token级监督能有效弥合个性化需求描述与生成教学之间的鸿沟，为LLM个性化提供了一种细粒度、可复现的有效方案。

title: eval-unlearn: Benchmarking unlearning in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: The rising number of concept unlearning techniques for text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models has produced a fragmented evaluation landscape. Methods are assessed under heterogeneous experimental conditions making principled cross-method comparison difficult. We present eval-unlearn, an open-source Python library providing a unified, reproducible benchmarking framework for concept unlearning in T2I Diffusion models. eval-unlearn integrates twelve published unlearning techniques spanning fine-tuning, closed-form model editing, and inference-time intervention, alongside nine complementary evaluation metrics covering erasure efficacy, adversarial robustness, generative quality, and concept retention. Its plugin architecture lets third-party techniques and metrics self-register without modifying the core framework, and its streaming, batched pipeline supports efficient evaluation of both standard NSFW concepts and arbitrary general concepts. As a further contribution, we release a public leaderboard on HuggingFace along with an interactive tool for real-time evaluation of unlearning techniques. The leaderboard compares nudity concept erasure case study across all twelve techniques, exposing significant accuracy-quality trade-offs that are obscured by heterogeneous evaluation. eval-unlearn is released under the MIT license; the package, code, leaderboard, and documentation are all available at https://eval-unlearn.readthedocs.io.

AI.tldr: 提出eval-unlearn，一个面向T2I扩散模型概念遗忘的开源统一基准测试框架，集成12种遗忘技术与9项评估指标，并提供HuggingFace公开排行榜与交互式工具。
AI.motivation: T2I扩散模型的概念遗忘技术日益增多，但评估环境异质、碎片化，缺乏统一实验条件，导致方法间难以进行有原则的横向比较。
AI.method: 构建eval-unlearn开源Python库：整合12种已发表遗忘技术（涵盖微调、闭式模型编辑、推理时干预）；集成9项互补评估指标（擦除有效性、对抗鲁棒性、生成质量、概念保留）；采用插件架构支持第三方技术与指标自注册而无需修改核心；使用流式批处理流水线，支持NSFW概念与任意通用概念的高效评估。
AI.result: 在HuggingFace发布公开排行榜及实时评估交互工具；排行榜对全部12种技术进行裸体概念擦除案例研究，揭示在异质评估下被掩盖的显著准确率—质量权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: eval-unlearn以MIT许可开源，包、代码、排行榜与文档均可在项目官网获取，为T2I概念遗忘提供统一、可复现的基准测试基础设施。

title: When Words Speak Louder than Images: Towards Understanding Language Bias in Vision-Language Models
summary: Despite substantial progress across downstream applications, vision-language models (VLMs) remain susceptible to language bias, often prioritizing linguistic cues over visual evidence and consequently producing incorrect predictions. Prior studies have proposed various approaches to understanding and mitigating language bias in VLMs, yet their findings often conflict due to the difficulty of tracing how language bias propagates within black-box VLMs. Building on the word completion task, we trace how language bias propagates through VLM inference by (1) proposing a diagnostic framework that decomposes the inference process into four distinct yet interdependent stages to trace the propagation of language bias; and (2) examining how two key factors underlying language bias, i.e., linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage, evolve across these stages and ultimately give rise to incorrect predictions. The linguistic prior captures the strength of statistical bias induced by the language model component of a VLM and represents the origin of language bias, whereas cross-modal coverage measures the extent to which linguistic cues cover the visual content. By decomposing inference into four stages and characterizing the interplay between linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage across these stages, we propose a systematic framework for tracing the propagation of language bias throughout the inference process; and uncover the underlying mechanism of language bias by revealing the interplay between linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个将VLM推理分解为四个相互依赖阶段的诊断框架，通过追踪“语言先验”与“跨模态覆盖度”两个因素在各阶段的演变，揭示语言偏置在视觉语言模型推理过程中的传播机制。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在下游任务上取得显著进展，但仍易受语言偏置影响，倾向于优先使用语言线索而忽视视觉证据，导致预测错误。已有研究虽提出多种理解与缓解语言偏置的方法，但由于黑箱VLM内部语言偏置的传播路径难以追踪，结论常相互矛盾，因此亟需一种能够系统追踪偏置传播过程的诊断方法。
AI.method: 基于词语补全任务，构建诊断框架，将VLM推理过程分解为四个不同但相互依赖的阶段，以追踪语言偏置的传播。同时考察两个关键因素——语言先验（由VLM语言模型组件诱发的统计偏置强度，是语言偏置的来源）与跨模态覆盖度（语言线索对视觉内容的覆盖程度）——在各阶段如何演变并最终导致错误预测。
AI.result: 通过将推理分解为四个阶段并刻画语言先验与跨模态覆盖度在这些阶段中的相互作用，提出了一套追踪语言偏置在整个推理过程中传播的系统性框架，并揭示了语言偏置的底层机制。
AI.conclusion: 语言偏置源于语言先验，并通过与跨模态覆盖度的动态交互在推理各阶段逐步传播，最终引发错误预测；该框架为理解与缓解VLM语言偏置提供了系统性的诊断视角。

title: Evaluating Hierarchy-Aware Deep Learning for the Recognition of Tironian Notes
comment: Accepted at the 2026 ICDAR Workshop on Computational Paleography (IWCP). 25 pages, including supplementary material
summary: Tironian notes are generally regarded as the first Latin shorthand system and are notable for their large, fine-grained symbol inventory. Their high visual similarity and large class set make manual reading time-consuming, leaving manuscripts that contain Tironian notes inaccessible to many researchers. Automatic recognition is also challenging because models must distinguish subtle differences in stroke shape and sign structure while realistic training data remain scarce. However, standard flat classifiers do not explicitly use visual or structural relations between related signs. This paper investigates whether structural relationships between Tironian notes can support automatic recognition. We use the Supertextus Notarum Tironianarum (SNT) by Martin Hellmann, which provides idealized sign forms and a hierarchical organization of Tironian notes. We compare flat ResNet18, ConvNeXt, Shifted Window Transformer (Swin), and Vision Transformer (ViT) classifiers with Hierarchical Deep Convolutional Neural Network (HD-CNN)-style coarse-to-fine models and hierarchy-aware routing models based on visual class cleaning and similarity-based re-clustering. The models are evaluated on handwritten samples and manuscript-domain samples from Vergilius Turonensis, both with and without limited few-shot adaptation to the manuscript domain. The results show that the relative performance of flat and hierarchical models depends on adaptation. On Vergilius Turonensis, HD-CNN achieves the best non-adapted Top-1 result with 45.43%, while flat classification reaches the best Top-1 result after few-shot adaptation with 82.09%. Overall, the results indicate that hierarchical structure can support Tironian note recognition, especially under non-adapted conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究提罗符号（Tironian notes）的自动识别问题，比较扁平分类器与层级模型在手写样本和手稿域样本上的表现，发现层级结构在无自适应条件下有优势，而扁平分类在少样本自适应后表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 提罗符号作为首个拉丁速记系统，符号数量庞大且视觉高度相似，人工阅读耗时，导致含此类符号的手稿难以被研究者利用。自动识别面临两难：模型需区分细微的笔画形状和符号结构差异，而真实训练数据稀缺。此外，标准扁平分类器未显式利用相关符号间的视觉或结构关系，因此本文探究提罗符号间的结构关系能否支持自动识别。
AI.method: 采用 Martin Hellmann 的 Supertextus Notarum Tironianarum（SNT），该资源提供理想化符号形式及提罗符号的层级组织。对比扁平 ResNet18、ConvNeXt、Swin、ViT 分类器与 HD-CNN 式由粗到细模型及基于视觉类别清洗和相似性重聚类的层级感知路由模型。在 Vergilius Turonensis 的手写样本和手稿域样本上评估，分别在有/无有限少样本自适应到该手稿域的条件下测试。
AI.result: 在 Vergilius Turonensis 上，HD-CNN 取得最佳无自适应 Top-1 结果 45.43%；而扁平分类在少样本自适应后取得最佳 Top-1 结果 82.09%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明层级结构能够支持提罗符号识别，尤其在无自适应条件下效果显著；扁平与层级模型的相对性能取决于是否进行域自适应。

title: Measuring Collapse and Correction in Homogeneous-Panel LLM Debate
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). Project page: https://lixin.ai/DebateLedger. Code: https://github.com/LiXin97/DebateLedger
summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) debate is often evaluated by whether final answers improve, but movement is not necessarily improvement: the same discussion can rescue an initially wrong majority or destroy an initially correct one. Standard final-accuracy evaluations conflate these opposing mechanisms. We introduce an auditable protocol for homogeneous debate on multiple-choice questions (MCQs) that records each run as a transition ledger over collapse, correction, onset, and signed intervention utility. On 6,925 MMLU-Pro debates, the protocol identifies 253 collapses and a parallel correction ledger that changes how interventions should be judged. Replay experiments reveal the central tradeoff: a leave-one-model-out probe-gated freeze prevents 29 collapses but loses 108 corrections under equal weights, so collapse prevention alone can recommend the wrong policy. A compact pre-debate 8-probe screen is a triage signal: its unadjusted family-level association with conditional-collapse risk is high (G=7, Spearman rho=0.893, exact two-sided p=0.0123), but initial-majority accuracy is a close comparator (rho=0.821; family partial rho=0.767, p=0.0877), so we do not treat it as calibrated or capability-adjusted prediction. Round-level traces localize many collapses to the first debate round, where early disagreement can precede both harmful cascades and useful recovery. We release replayable schemas, coders, audits, cost cards, and zero-API rebuild scripts so future model-scaffold rows can be compared under the same denominators and signed utility ledger.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种可审计的同质多智能体LLM辩论协议，用"崩坏/纠错/诱发/带符号干预效用"转变台账替代单一最终准确率评测，揭示"防崩坏"与"保纠错"之间的核心权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM辩论多以最终答案是否改善来评价，但"变动"不等于"改进"：同一场讨论既可能挽救原本错误的多数，也可能摧毁原本正确的多数。标准最终准确率指标把这两种方向相反的机制混为一谈，导致对干预策略的评判失真。
AI.method: 在MMLU-Pro多选题上设计同质辩论的可审计协议，将每次运行记录为转变台账（崩坏、纠错、诱发、带符号干预效用）；通过重放实验检验干预策略，如留一模型外探针门控冻结、辩论前8探针筛查，并做家族层级关联分析与轮级轨迹定位。
AI.result: 在6,925场MMLU-Pro辩论中识别出253次崩坏及相应的纠错台账。重放显示：留一模型外探针门控冻结可阻止29次崩坏，但在等权重下损失108次纠错，说明仅以防崩坏为目标会推荐错误策略。辩论前8探针筛查与条件崩坏风险的未调整家族关联较强（G=7，Spearman rho=0.893，双侧精确p=0.0123），但初始多数准确率是接近的对照（rho=0.821；家族偏相关rho=0.767，p=0.0877），故不将其视为已校准或已做能力校正的预测。轮级轨迹将许多崩坏定位在首轮，早期分歧既可先于有害级联，也可先于有效恢复。
AI.conclusion: 以最终准确率为中心的评价会掩盖辩论的双向机制，应采用带符号干预效用的转变台账作为统一分母来评判辩论与干预。作者释放可重放模式、编码器、审计、成本卡与零API重建脚本，以便未来模型-脚手架组合在同一口径下比较。

title: $λ$-JEPA Spectral Anti-Collapse Regularization for Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Joint-embedding self-supervised learning typically combines an invariance objective across augmented views with additional mechanisms to prevent representational collapse. These objectives are often applied after a projection head, while downstream tasks use the backbone representation before the projector. We find that this mismatch does not necessarily prevent dimensional collapse in the backbone, which can retain low effective rank and potentially limit downstream transfer. To address this, we introduce SACReg, a spectral anti-collapse regularizer motivated by an analysis of $λ$-balance, which captures the relative scale of weight matrices across layers. In a two-layer linear network, we show that (i) $λ$-balance prevents collapse, and (ii) our regularizer applied to the backbone induces $λ$-balance. In the nonlinear case, this regularizer leads to anti-collapse as well and, in realistic architectures on ImageNet100, it empirically increases the representations' ranks. We apply SACReg to JEPA and propose $λ$-JEPA, which improves over LeJEPA and VISReg on ImageNet-1k classification and in average linear-probe transfer performance across eight downstream image datasets. On video self-supervised learning, $λ$-JEPA improves over LeVJEPA and V-JEPA 2 on the Something-Something-v2 and Kinetics-400 benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/berkerdemirel/lambda-jepa.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现联合嵌入自监督学习中,投影头后施加的不变性目标与骨干网络表示之间存在错配,可能导致骨干网络的维度坍缩。为此提出SACReg(谱反坍缩正则化器),通过对λ-平衡的理论分析证明其能诱导反坍缩,并据此构建λ-JEPA,在图像与视频下游任务上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入自监督学习通常是在投影头之后施加不变性目标并配合防坍缩机制,但下游任务使用投影头之前的骨干表示。这种"目标施加位置"与"下游使用位置"的错配,未必能防止骨干网络出现维度坍缩,骨干可能保持较低的有效秩,从而限制下游迁移性能。
AI.method: 提出SACReg,一种谱反坍缩正则化器,其动机来自对λ-平衡的分析——λ-平衡刻画了各层权重矩阵的相对尺度。作者在两层线性网络中证明:(i) λ-平衡可防止坍缩;(ii) 将SACReg施加于骨干网络可诱导出λ-平衡。在非线性情形下该正则化器同样带来反坍缩效果。作者将SACReg应用于JEPA框架,提出λ-JEPA。
AI.result: 在ImageNet100的真实架构上,该正则化器经验性地提升了表示秩。λ-JEPA在ImageNet-1k分类以及八个下游图像数据集上的平均线性探针迁移性能上优于LeJEPA和VISReg。在视频自监督学习方面,λ-JEPA在Something-Something-v2和Kinetics-400基准上优于LeVJEPA和V-JEPA 2。
AI.conclusion: 投影头与骨干表示的错配会引发骨干维度坍缩并限制迁移能力;通过λ-平衡启发的谱正则化器SACReg可有效缓解该问题,并在图像与视频自监督学习任务上取得一致的性能提升。代码已开源。

title: Domain-adaptive Zero-Shot Image Enhancement via Locality-Constrained Diffusion Guidance
comment: Accepted manuscript. The final version is published in Computers & Graphics
summary: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models have shown remarkable performance in unconditional image generation. In order to generate images with desired semantics, recent works have restricted the solution space by using guidance constraints in the diffusion sampling process. However, for image enhancement across different domains, these methods struggle to balance two main requirements: looking realistic in the target domain (photorealistic images) and preserving relevant features of the source domain, e.g., low-quality renderings or art paintings. Here, small local changes can alter the fidelity of the image completely, while large changes in other regions might be insignificant. We introduce LocDiff, a locality-constrained guidance method for image enhancement, which serves as a zero-shot extension to pre-trained diffusion models, ensuring the preservation of critical features during domain adaptation. In this way, we retain important local features, while allowing less critical regions to remain unconstrained and not interfere with the guidance process for relevant regions. We evaluate our method on two different domain-shift tasks: For art-to-photo translation, we apply the method in a fully zero-shot setting, preserving facial identity from paintings while generating photorealistic details. For enhancing low-quality fetal ultrasound renderings, we demonstrate zero-shot inference with auxiliary prior alignment. Here, the objective is to artificially add high-resolution characteristics and produce photorealistic ultrasound renderings, a target domain for which no ground truth distribution exists. Our experimental results demonstrate that LocDiff achieves favorable realism-faithfulness trade-offs compared to state-of-the-art methods, enabling controllable cross-domain enhancement.

AI.tldr: LocDiff：一种基于局部性约束的扩散模型引导方法，实现零样本跨域图像增强，在真实感与保真度之间取得良好权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在无条件图像生成上表现优异，但为指导其生成符合目标语义的图像，现有方法在采样过程中加入引导约束，限制了求解空间。然而在跨域图像增强任务中，这些方法难以同时满足两个核心需求：在目标域中看起来真实（照片级真实），以及保留源域的相关特征（如低质量渲染图或艺术画作）。此问题在于局部小变化可能彻底改变图像保真度，而其他区域的大变化却可能无关紧要。
AI.method: 提出 LocDiff，一种面向图像增强的局部性约束引导方法，作为预训练扩散模型的零样本扩展，在域适应过程中确保关键特征得以保留。通过对关键局部区域施加约束、对不重要区域不加约束，避免其干扰相关区域的引导过程，从而实现局部特征保留。
AI.result: 在两个域偏移任务上评估：艺术画到照片的转换，在完全零样本设置下保留画作中的人脸身份并生成照片级细节；低质量胎儿超声渲染图增强，采用带辅助先验对齐的零样本推理，人工添加高分辨率特征并生成照片级超声渲染图（该目标域不存在真实分布）。实验表明 LocDiff 相比当前最优方法实现了更优的真实感—保真度权衡。
AI.conclusion: LocDiff 通过局部性约束引导，实现了可控的跨域图像增强，在无需目标域真实分布的情况下兼顾真实感与源域特征保真度，优于现有方法。

title: EvoIn: Bridging Evolution and Internalization for Agent Fine-Tuning
summary: Recent work has explored improving agents by jointly evolving their harnesses and models, but often takes a ''potpourri'' approach that bundles together new tools, new decision-making procedures, and model adaptation to the evolved harness under a single notion of agent improvement. In this paper, we instead investigate how agents can improve their decision-making procedures. In particular, we propose EvoIn, an agent fine-tuning framework that bridges evolution and internalization. EvoIn first analyzes agent execution traces to evolve and validate new decision-making procedures by temporarily instantiating them in the harness. The validated procedures guide the agent to generate improved reasoning traces. These traces are then rewritten into self-contained reasoning traces, removing explicit references to harness instructions while expressing the induced decision logic as the model's own reasoning. Finally, EvoIn fine-tunes the model on the rewritten traces, internalizing these procedures so that the improved decision-making persists without the evolved harness at inference time. We evaluate EvoIn on diverse benchmarks and find that it consistently enables agents to learn stronger decision-making procedures, raising the pass rate by 10.9 points in-domain and by 9.2 points out-of-domain. Results further show that the internalized decision procedures generalize to unseen tasks. Case studies show that agents can learn to decide how to solve a task before solving it, for example by checking a document's length to choose between reading it in full and searching it. EvoIn is also broadly applicable, showing consistent improvements on another model family.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoIn 框架，通过"演化—内化"桥接，使智能体改进其决策流程并将之固化到模型参数中。
AI.motivation: 现有工作常以"大杂烩"方式联合演化智能体的执行框架（harness）与模型，把新工具、新决策流程和模型适配混在一起，难以厘清智能体改进的真正来源。本文聚焦于一个更具体的问题：智能体如何改进自身的决策流程。
AI.method: EvoIn 分三步：1) 分析智能体执行轨迹，演化并验证新的决策流程，做法是在 harness 中临时实例化这些流程；2) 用验证通过的流程引导智能体生成改进的推理轨迹，并将其改写为自包含推理轨迹，去除对 harness 指令的显式引用，把诱导出的决策逻辑表达为模型自身的推理；3) 在改写后的轨迹上微调模型，将决策流程内化，使推理时无需演化后的 harness 也能保持改进的决策能力。
AI.result: 在多类基准上，EvoIn 持续使智能体学到更强的决策流程，域内通过率提升 10.9 个百分点，域外提升 9.2 个百分点；内化的决策流程可泛化到未见任务。案例显示智能体学会"先判断如何解题再解题"，例如先检查文档长度，再决定全文阅读还是检索。该框架在另一模型家族上同样取得一致提升，具有较好通用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将演化出的决策流程内化进模型参数，EvoIn 实现了脱离 harness 仍可持续的决策能力提升，验证了"演化—内化"这一路径在智能体决策流程改进上的有效性与可迁移性。

title: Narrow Multimodal Fine-Tuning Can Induce Emergent Misalignment
summary: Modern AI models are aligned through post-training to adapt them to downstream tasks. Recent work shows that fine-tuning language models on narrow tasks can induce emergent misalignment (EM), causing broadly harmful behaviors beyond the training task. However, EM has been studied almost entirely in text-only tasks, leaving its manifestation in multimodal models unclear. In this paper, we define and analyze EM in the context of vision-language models. We first induce EM via fine-tuning on narrow multimodal tasks targeting vulnerable code, careless household-object use, and conspiratorial interpretations of ordinary scenes. Across fifteen commercial and open-source models with different scales, we find that narrow multimodal fine-tuning can induce coherent and broadly misaligned behavior that transfers to unrelated tasks, including misaligned opinions, visual factual dishonesty, unsafe image generation, vulnerability to visual jailbreaks, and risky agentic actions. We further find that multimodal EM does not depend on the apparent harmfulness of training data but is sensitive to training-evaluation modality alignment. EM can arise under both supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization and can propagate through intermediate reasoning. Finally, we explore several mitigation strategies, including prompt inoculation, benign continued training, and activation-level steering, which can partially reduce EM. Overall, our findings suggest that multimodal EM reflects a behavioral shift rather than a general loss of capability, extending beyond text to the visual modality.

AI.tldr: 本文定义并研究了视觉语言模型（VLM）中的涌现性失准（EM）：通过对脆弱代码、粗心家用物品使用和阴谋论式场景解读等窄域多模态任务进行微调即可诱发。在15个不同规模的商业与开源模型上，这种窄域微调会产生连贯且广泛传播的失准行为，包括失准观点、视觉事实不诚实、不安全图像生成、视觉越狱脆弱性及高风险智能体行为。EM不依赖训练数据的表面有害性，但对训练—评估模态对齐敏感，可在SFT与偏好优化下出现，并通过中间推理传播；提示接种、良性持续训练与激活层引导可部分缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有关于涌现性失准（EM）的研究几乎完全局限于纯文本任务，多模态模型中的EM表现尚不明确，因此本文旨在定义并系统分析视觉语言模型中的EM现象。
AI.method: 通过在三类窄域多模态任务（脆弱代码、粗心家用物品使用、对普通场景的阴谋论式解读）上微调模型以诱发EM；在15个不同规模的商业与开源模型上评估EM的跨任务迁移；检验EM对训练数据表面有害性、训练—评估模态对齐的敏感性；测试SFT与偏好优化两种训练范式及中间推理的传播路径；并尝试提示接种、良性持续训练和激活层引导等缓解策略。
AI.result: 窄域多模态微调可诱发连贯且广泛的失准行为，并迁移至无关任务，表现为失准观点、视觉事实不诚实、不安全图像生成、视觉越狱脆弱性和高风险智能体行为。EM不取决于训练数据的表面有害性，但对训练—评估模态对齐敏感；在SFT和偏好优化下均可出现，并能通过中间推理传播。提示接种、良性持续训练和激活层引导可部分降低EM。
AI.conclusion: 多模态EM体现的是一种行为层面的转变，而非通用能力的整体丧失，且该现象从文本模态延伸至视觉模态。

title: Scaffold Then Internalize: Representation Injection for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Recent representation alignment (REPA) methods accelerate diffusion transformer training by aligning projections of the transformer's hidden states with representations from pretrained visual encoders.
