In this work, we explore a reverse and complementary direction to REPA: rather than projecting diffusion representations into the encoder's space, we inject encoder representations into the diffusion transformer, allowing them to actively participate in the denoising process. To this end, we introduce \textit{REPresentation Injection} (REPI), a training framework based on a scaffold-to-internalization strategy, in which projected encoder representations initially serve as a temporary scaffold and are then progressively internalized by the diffusion transformer. REPI outperforms REPA across a wide range of backbones and is highly complementary to it: combining the two yields substantial gains over either alone. Notably, with only 160K training steps, REPI + REPA matches vanilla SiT trained for 7M steps, a speedup of over $43.5\times$. Code will be available at https://jeneveuxpas.github.io/REPI

AI.tldr: 本文提出REPI，一种与REPA反向互补的表征注入框架，通过"支架-内化"策略将编码器表征注入扩散Transformer并参与去噪，性能优于REPA且可与之叠加。
AI.motivation: REPA类方法通过将扩散Transformer的隐状态投影对齐到预训练视觉编码器表征来加速训练，但仅是单向的"扩散→编码器"投影对齐，编码器表征没有真正参与去噪过程，方向单一且互补性未被挖掘。
AI.method: 提出表征注入REPI，采取反向互补思路：不再把扩散表征投影到编码器空间，而是将编码器表征注入扩散Transformer中，使其主动参与去噪。训练采用"支架-内化"（scaffold-to-internalization）策略：投影后的编码器表征先作为临时支架，随后被扩散Transformer逐步内化。
AI.result: REPI在多种骨干网络上均优于REPA，且与REPA高度互补，二者结合相比单独使用均获得显著提升；仅用160K训练步，REPI+REPA即可达到vanilla SiT训练7M步的效果，加速超过43.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 表征注入是与表征对齐互补的有效方向，通过支架-内化策略让编码器表征参与去噪，可大幅加速扩散Transformer训练，并与REPA协同取得更优效果。代码将开源。

title: Decide, Don't Generate: Competitive Dimensional ABSA with Jev's Typed Decisions
summary: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) has largely turned to text generation. We show that competitive dimensional ABSA does not need it. Using Jev, a frozen model that answers typed questions with rubric scores, label probabilities, and yes/no judgments, we decompose all three tasks of SemEval-2026 Task III Track A into such decisions and align them with the annotation scheme through 488 coefficients fitted on CPU, with no text generation and no backbone tuning. On valence-arousal regression over ten corpora in six languages, the system reaches 1.0645 RMSE, the lowest aggregate error of any participating system. On triplet and quadruplet extraction, it reaches 52.09 and 44.06 continuous F1, above fine-tuned Llama-3.3-70B and GPT-OSS-120B baselines. Analyses and ablations show where the accuracy comes from: supervised calibration roughly halves the raw regression error, exact valence-arousal would add only 4.5 F1 to extraction, and the learned combination of span-boundary evidence, not any single signal, carries the extraction systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无需文本生成的维度化ABSA方法：用冻结模型Jev回答类型化问题（评分、标签概率、是非判断），通过CPU上拟合的488个系数对齐标注方案，在SemEval-2026 Task III Track A三个任务上取得竞争性或最优结果。
AI.motivation: 近年来ABSA研究大量转向文本生成范式，但作者质疑维度化ABSA是否真的需要生成式建模，并希望探索一种更轻量、无需微调主干模型、无需文本生成的替代方案。
AI.method: 使用冻结模型Jev，将SemEval-2026 Task III Track A的三个任务（valence-arousal回归、三元组抽取、四元组抽取）分解为类型化决策：评分、标签概率和是非判断；通过488个在CPU上拟合的系数与标注方案对齐；不进行文本生成，也不微调主干模型。
AI.result: 在六种语言、十个语料库的valence-arousal回归上达到1.0645 RMSE，为所有参赛系统中最低聚合误差；三元组和四元组抽取分别达到52.09和44.06连续F1，高于微调Llama-3.3-70B和GPT-OSS-120B基线。消融分析表明：监督校准约将原始回归误差减半；即使valence-arousal完全正确，抽取F1也仅提升4.5；抽取系统的性能来源于span边界证据的学习组合，而非任何单一信号。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性的维度化ABSA并不依赖文本生成或主干微调；将任务分解为类型化决策并经轻量校准即可达到甚至超越大型微调模型的效果，且性能关键来自多信号的组合而非单一特征。

title: Beyond Saying Less: Fine-Grained Alignment for Informative and Faithful Vision-Language Models
summary: Object hallucination remains a major challenge for large vision-language models. While off-policy preference optimization proves to be an effective solution, on-policy reinforcement learning provides a more promising direction as it directly targets a model's current failure modes. However, we find that without fine-grained reward formulation and allocation, on-policy optimization often falls into an easy shortcut: reducing hallucinations merely by saying less---making fewer valid claims. To comprehensively resolve this, we propose a fine-grained alignment framework that couples dense reward signals at the data level with precise credit assignment at the algorithmic level. Specifically, we first construct the Dense Object Presence and Absence (DOPA) dataset to address sparse annotations that prevent valid object claims from being verified and rewarded. DOPA exhaustively annotates the deterministic presence and absence of every concept across an expanded vocabulary, significantly increasing the density of reliable reward signals during on-policy rollouts. Second, we propose Subsentence-level Credit Assignment for on-Policy Optimization (SCAPO) to prevent response-level shared advantages from allowing local hallucinations to compromise all other valid outputs within the same response. By assigning credit to each subsentence independently based on its object claims, SCAPO can precisely reinforce faithful generations and penalize hallucinations. Furthermore, we leverage the resulting faithful image descriptions as auxiliary context to transfer generative gains to discriminative tasks. Experiments demonstrate that our method produces highly informative, faithful descriptions in generative tasks while yielding clear performance gains on discriminative evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出细粒度对齐框架，结合数据层密集奖励信号与算法层精确信用分配，缓解大视觉语言模型的对象幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 大视觉语言模型仍存在严重的对象幻觉问题。off-policy偏好优化虽有效，但on-policy强化学习更能直接针对模型当前失败模式。然而，若不进行细粒度奖励设计与分配，on-policy优化易陷入"少说少错"的捷径，即通过减少有效断言来降低幻觉。
AI.method: 提出细粒度对齐框架，包含两部分：（1）构建DOPA数据集，对扩展词表中每个概念的确定性存在与缺失进行穷尽标注，解决稀疏标注导致有效对象断言无法被验证和奖励的问题，提升on-policy rollout中可靠奖励信号的密度；（2）提出SCAPO（子句级on-policy优化信用分配），独立地为每个子句基于其对象断言分配信用，避免响应级共享优势使局部幻觉损害同一响应中其他有效输出，从而精确强化忠实生成并惩罚幻觉。此外，利用生成的忠实图像描述作为辅助上下文，将生成任务的收益迁移到判别任务。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在生成任务中产生高信息量、忠实的描述，同时在判别评估上取得明显性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据层密集奖励与算法层精确信用分配的耦合，可有效解决on-policy优化中的"少说少错"捷径，缓解对象幻觉，并实现生成与判别任务的性能双赢。

title: PIVOT: Pivot-Aware On Policy Self Distillation for Multi-Turn VLM Agents
comment: 11 pages for the main paper, 20 pages for the supplementary
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) via Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used for multi-turn VLM agent training, yet it suffers from zero-gradient silence on uniform failures and coarse episode-level credit assignment. While On-Policy Distillation (OPD) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) mitigate sparse rewards using hindsight information, their underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Through controlled counterfactual rollback probes across five multi-turn VLM agent benchmarks, we reveal that performance gains in OPSD/OPD are largely driven by physical state rollback at the pivot step, defined as the first unrecoverable action without remaining step budget. However, physical state rollbacks are computationally prohibitive and infeasible in real-world environments. To bridge this gap, we present Pivot-Aware Internalized Visual On-Policy Training (PIVOT), an RL framework that internalizes pivot localization and state restoration directly into token-level parameter updates, eliminating environment rollbacks during RL training and additional skill hints at test time. PIVOT unifies three functional roles within a single architecture: a failure Analyzer non-invasively localizes the pivot step and diagnoses failure modes from visual trajectory collages and action logs; a detached Teacher re-scores failed tokens under this privileged diagnostic context; and a Student optimizes joint GRPO and confidence-gated OPD objectives. At test time, both Teacher and Analyzer branches are stripped. Evaluated on five multi-turn VLM agent tasks across cognitive grid puzzles, 3D embodied control and navigation, and generative reasoning, PIVOT achieves 0.90 overall accuracy on Qwen2.5-VL-3B (+8% over SFT+GRPO baseline and +5% over previous SOTA) and scales to 0.92 on Qwen3-VL-2B (+12% over SFT+GRPO baseline).

AI.tldr: 本文揭示OPSD/OPD多轮VLM智能体训练的性能增益主要来源于关键步（pivot step）的物理状态回滚，并提出PIVOT框架，将关键步定位与状态恢复内化到token级参数更新中，无需环境回滚，在五个多轮VLM智能体任务上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR，经GRPO实现）广泛用于多轮VLM智能体训练，但存在两大缺陷：一是当轨迹奖励均匀失败时出现零梯度静默，二是信用分配仅停留在粗糙的回合级。On-Policy Distillation（OPD）与On-Policy Self-Distillation（OPSD）虽借助后见信息缓解稀疏奖励，但其内在机制尚不清晰，且其增益所依赖的物理状态回滚在真实环境中计算代价高昂甚至不可行。
AI.method: 作者首先通过跨五个多轮VLM智能体基准的受控反事实回滚探针，定位性能增益来源。基于此提出PIVOT框架，将关键步定位与状态恢复内化到token级参数更新中，从而消除RL训练中的环境回滚与测试时的额外技能提示。PIVOT在单一架构内统一三种角色：（1）失败分析器（Analyzer），非侵入式地从视觉轨迹拼图与动作日志中定位关键步并诊断失败模式；（2）分离教师（detached Teacher），在该特权诊断上下文下对失败token重新打分；（3）学生（Student），联合优化GRPO与置信度门控的OPD目标。测试时教师与分析器分支均被移除。
AI.result: 在涵盖认知网格谜题、3D具身控制与导航、生成式推理的五类多轮VLM智能体任务上，PIVOT在Qwen2.5-VL-3B上取得0.90的总体准确率（较SFT+GRPO基线提升8%，较此前SOTA提升5%），并在Qwen3-VL-2B上扩展至0.92（较SFT+GRPO基线提升12%）。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明OPSD/OPD的性能增益主要由关键步处的物理状态回滚驱动，而PIVOT通过将该机制内化为token级参数更新，在不依赖环境回滚与测试时技能提示的前提下实现了更优的多轮VLM智能体训练效果，兼具机制可解释性与实用可扩展性。

title: Epistemic Policy Divergence in Multi-Turn LLM Contamination: A Protocol-Gradient Investigation
comment: 9 figures, 19 tables. Benchmark, code, and protocol definitions: https://github.com/fahrellgiovanny/epistemic-policy-divergence
summary: Large language models treat conversation history as unverified context, so false premises injected into earlier turns can be adopted as fact later, a failure mode we call session-level contamination. We introduce five contamination protocols along a source-authority gradient, each holding the false premise constant while varying how it is presented, from self-attributed falsehood to explicit instruction override. We evaluated three architecturally diverse models, GPT-5.4 Mini, Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite, and GLM-4.5-Air, on ten cases spanning five knowledge fields at temperature zero over 22,500 turns, using a dual-track judge checked against a 120-turn human-annotated sample (Cohen's kappa = 1.000 for binary adoption, a ceiling on this sample, and 0.92 linear-weighted for collapse severity). The three models implemented structurally different epistemic policies. GPT-5.4 Mini recorded zero adoptions across all 500 sessions; token-level probing of the GPT-5.4 base model left the correct token as the argmax in eight of ten conditions. Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite showed a steep framing-dependent policy: 0.1 percent for self-attributed falsehoods, 23.5 percent for user-cited sources, 68.2 percent for system-injected authority, and 94.0 percent for instruction override. GLM-4.5-Air showed a shallower gradient (15.8 and 84.2 percent for those two vectors). This 68-percentage-point dissociation is consistent with authority deference and instruction compliance engaging distinct mechanisms within a single architecture. Recovery also differed: GLM recovered in 94.5 percent of affected sessions, whereas 26.1 percent of affected Gemini sessions did not return to factual accuracy within the window (40.0 percent under instruction override). We release the evaluation framework and taxonomy for reproducible testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"会话级污染"这一失效模式：大语言模型将对话历史视为未经验证的上下文，导致早期轮次注入的虚假前提被后续采纳为事实。作者设计五种沿"来源权威性"梯度的污染协议，在三个架构各异的模型（GPT-5.4 Mini、Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite、GLM-4.5-Air）上进行22,500轮、温度为零的测试，发现三者呈现出结构上截然不同的认知策略。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注单轮提示注入或越狱，但忽视了多轮对话中"历史上下文被默认为可信"这一结构性漏洞。作者希望系统刻画：当虚假前提以不同权威性来源呈现时，模型采纳该前提的概率如何变化，以及不同模型是否采用同一套认知政策。
AI.method: 提出五种污染协议，构成从"自我归属的虚假陈述"到"显式指令覆盖"的来源权威性梯度，保持虚假前提内容不变、仅改变呈现方式。选取GPT-5.4 Mini、Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite、GLM-4.5-Air三个架构不同的模型，覆盖五个知识领域的十个案例，温度为零，共22,500轮。评判采用双轨裁判，并以120轮人工标注样本校验（二元采纳的Cohen's kappa = 1.000，为一个样本上限值；崩溃严重度为0.92线性加权kappa）。此外对GPT-5.4基座模型做token级探测。
AI.result: 三模型表现出结构不同的认知策略：(1) GPT-5.4 Mini在全部500个会话中零采纳，token级探测显示在10种条件中有8种正确token仍为argmax；(2) Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite呈陡峭的框架依赖策略——自我归属虚假陈述0.1%、用户引用来源23.5%、系统注入权威68.2%、指令覆盖94.0%；(3) GLM-4.5-Air梯度更平缓，后两个向量分别为15.8%和84.2%。Gemini在该两向量上的68个百分点差异暗示"权威顺从"与"指令遵循"在同一架构内可能由不同机制驱动。恢复能力亦不同：GLM在94.5%的受影响会话中恢复，而Gemini有26.1%受影响会话未能在窗口内回到事实准确（指令覆盖下为40.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 会话级污染是架构相关的、可量化的失效模式，其严重程度强烈依赖虚假前提的呈现权威性；"权威顺从"与"指令遵循"可能对应不同机制。作者公开评估框架与分类法，供可复现测试使用。

title: RoGSW4RLD: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Lifting for Robot World Model Rollouts
summary: Action-conditioned video world models predict future robot interactions from multiple cameras, yet their outputs remain disparate video collections rather than a shared metric scene queryable across viewpoints and time. While existing 4D reconstruction methods offer a path to spatialize these predictions, independently reconstructing and merging each camera stream fails to enforce cross-view consistency. This limitation is particularly detrimental when combining moving robot-mounted cameras with fixed external views. To address this, we introduce RoGSW4RLD, a feed-forward framework that lifts synchronized multi-camera rollouts into a unified, time-queryable metric 4D Gaussian field. Rather than learning a separate geometric transition model, RoGSW4RLD directly reconstructs the visual future generated by existing world models. Its core innovation is a two-stage architecture: Stage 1 jointly forms the metric 4D field by fusing cross-view evidence with robot-specific articulated geometry and kinematics, while Stage 2 refines the field's geometry and appearance while strictly preserving the initial temporal displacements. Evaluated on 256 held-out DROID episodes, RoGSW4RLD significantly outperforms camera-wise reconstruction with calibrated merging, improving novel-view PSNR by 2.15 dB, reducing depth AbsRel by 47%, and lowering robot displacement error by 61%. These robust gains extend to action-conditioned Cosmos 3 rollouts, demonstrating that predicted video futures can be successfully translated into consistent, spatially queryable 4D metric representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoGSW4RLD，一个前馈框架，将同步多相机机器人交互视频提升为统一、可随时间查询的度量 4D 高斯场，实现跨视角一致的空间化预测。
AI.motivation: 动作条件视频世界模型能从多相机预测未来机器人交互，但输出仅是分散的视频集合，而非跨视角、跨时间可查询的共享度量场景。现有 4D 重建方法虽可空间化这些预测，但独立重建并合并各相机流无法保证跨视角一致性，尤其在移动的机器人搭载相机与固定外部视角结合时问题尤为严重。
AI.method: RoGSW4RLD 为前馈框架，不作单独几何转移建模，而是直接重建世界模型生成的视觉未来。采用两阶段架构：阶段1 通过融合跨视角证据与机器人专用的铰接几何及运动学，联合构建度量 4D 场；阶段2 在严格保持初始时间位移的前提下，细化场的几何与外观。
AI.result: 在 256 个留出的 DROID 回合上评估，较逐相机重建加校准合并：新视角 PSNR 提升 2.15 dB，深度 AbsRel 降低 47%，机器人位移误差降低 61%。增益同样扩展至动作条件 Cosmos 3 推演。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，预测的视频未来可成功转化为一致、可空间查询的 4D 度量表示。

title: MemoReason: Evaluating the Effect of Parametric Memory on Contextual Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on reasoning benchmarks, but it remains unclear whether this reflects genuine contextual reasoning or reliance on facts memorized in their parameters. We investigate this by distinguishing two possibilities: a broad \textit{memorization bias}, where familiar content improves reasoning performance, and the \textit{Strong Parametric Shortcut Hypothesis}, where models skip reasoning entirely and recall stored answers. To test these effects, we introduce \textbf{MemoReason}, a human-curated benchmark that pairs factual reasoning tasks with structurally identical \fictitiousterm{} versions where real entities like people, companies, or dates are systematically replaced by \fictitiousterm{} ones of the same type. This \scorerevision{preserves task structure and specified reasoning operations} while varying the familiarity of the context, allowing controlled measurement of how the parametric memory affects reasoning. \revision{Our evaluation of recent LLMs reveals consistent and statistically significant performance drops of up to 15.7\% in the fictitious setting, demonstrating a clear memorization bias.} However, a targeted analysis of \revision{questions failed in the fictitious setting} shows that models rarely respond with the corresponding factual answer, indicating that direct parametric shortcuts are not the dominant failure mode. These findings suggest that parametric memory influences reasoning through mechanisms more complex than simple factual recall. \textbf{MemoReason} provides a controlled framework for studying these mechanisms and for extending paired factual-fictitious{} evaluation to broader reasoning settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MemoReason 基准，通过将事实推理任务中的真实实体替换为同类型的虚构实体来构造配对对照，从而区分"记忆偏置"与"强参数捷径"两种机制。实验发现模型在虚构情境下性能显著下降（最高 15.7%），证实存在记忆偏置，但模型很少直接输出对应事实答案，说明参数记忆的影响机制比简单的事实回忆更复杂。
AI.motivation: LLM 在推理基准上表现良好，但无法确定这是真正的上下文推理，还是依赖参数中记忆的事实。已有研究无法区分两种可能：一是广泛存在的记忆偏置（熟悉内容提升推理表现），二是强参数捷径假设（模型完全跳过推理、直接回忆存储答案）。需要一种可控方法来分离这两种效应。
AI.method: 提出人工构建的 MemoReason 基准：将事实推理任务与其结构完全相同的虚构版本配对，在虚构版本中用同类型的虚构实体（人物、公司、日期等）系统替换真实实体。该设计在保持任务结构与指定推理操作不变的前提下，仅改变上下文的熟悉度，从而可控地测量参数记忆对推理的影响。随后对近期 LLM 进行评估，并针对虚构情境下失败的题目进行定向分析，检验模型是否输出对应的真实答案。
AI.result: 近期 LLM 在虚构设定下出现一致且统计显著的最大 15.7% 性能下降，表明存在明显的记忆偏置。但在虚构设定中失败的题目上，模型很少给出对应的真实事实答案，说明直接的参数捷径并非主要失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 参数记忆并非通过简单的事实回忆来影响推理，其作用机制更为复杂，表现为一种记忆偏置。MemoReason 为研究这些机制提供了可控框架，并可将成对的事实—虚构评估扩展到更广泛的推理场景。

title: TMCS: Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving
summary: Despite the promise of Large Language Models (LLMs) in computational chemistry, rigorous combinatorial chemistry problems remain difficult because they require quantitatively constrained molecular modification, candidate validation, and systematic revision after failed attempts. Existing tool-augmented chemical agents demonstrate useful planning and tool use, but they rarely provide a unified loop for property-driven molecular optimization and workflow-level composition. To bridge this gap, we propose Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving (TMCS), a step-by-step multi-agent framework that formalizes chemical problem solving as an interpretable, tool-augmented workflow. At the task level, specialized agents leverage external tools, few-shot trajectory memory, and structured reflection to iteratively refine solutions. At the workflow level, TMCS chains generation, understanding, editing, description, and optimization into a closed-loop pipeline. Evaluations across multiple chemical tasks demonstrate that TMCS consistently enhances chemical reasoning across both open- and closed-source base models, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出TMCS——一种工具接地的多智能体推理框架，将组合化学问题求解形式化为可解释、工具增强的工作流，在任务级与工作流级形成闭环，显著提升化学推理性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在计算化学中虽有潜力，但严格的组合化学问题仍具挑战，因其需要定量约束的分子修饰、候选验证及失败后的系统性修正。现有工具增强化学智能体虽具备规划与工具调用能力，却缺乏统一的属性驱动分子优化与工作流级组合闭环。
AI.method: 提出TMCS（Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving），一个逐步多智能体框架。任务级：专用智能体利用外部工具、少样本轨迹记忆与结构化反思，迭代精化解。工作流级：将生成、理解、编辑、描述与优化串联为闭环流水线。
AI.result: 在多个化学任务上的评估表明，TMCS在开源与闭源基础模型上均持续增强化学推理能力，取得当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: TMCS通过工具接地的多智能体推理与闭环工作流，有效弥补了现有化学智能体在属性驱动优化与工作流组合方面的不足，具备良好的通用性与性能优势。

title: Your Benchmark Is Not Saturated: Reviving Multiple-Choice Evaluation with Answer Pooling
summary: Multiple-choice benchmarks are cheap to grade and are running out of room, and the standard remedy, writing harder items, is slow and repeated for every benchmark. A saturated benchmark still holds a harder task. Each question's wrong options are written for that question alone, so a model can score by eliminating a few options. We propose AnswerPool: take $N$ questions that share a context, pool all their options into one list, and ask the model to assign every question its answer. No item is written and no label changes. The chance of guessing a group right falls from $10^{-3}$ to $5\times10^{-7}$ for five four-option questions, and a model that recognizes its answers keeps its multiple-choice score, so the accuracy lost to pooling measures the credit the format gave for elimination. Deleting answers from the pool makes questions unanswerable with exact ground truth, so abstention is scored in the same pass. Across eight text, image, and video benchmarks and eighteen models, pooling is harder for every model, the elimination credit is largest for the weakest models, and seven of eight open-weight models answer 87 to 100% of unanswerable questions.

AI.tldr: 提出 AnswerPool：将共享上下文的 N 个问题的所有选项合并为一个选项池，要求模型为每个问题分配答案，从而在不新写题目、不改标签的前提下提高基准难度并测量"排除法"带来的虚高分数。
AI.motivation: 多项选择基准易评分但已趋于饱和；标准补救方式是不断编写更难的题目，成本高且每个基准都要重复进行。作者认为饱和基准中仍隐藏着更难的任务：由于每题的错误选项是为该题单独设计的，模型可通过排除少数选项来得分，从而高估了真实能力。因此需要一个低成本、可复用的方法来暴露这部分被"格式红利"掩盖的难度。
AI.method: AnswerPool 不新增题目、不改变标签：选取共享同一上下文的 N 个问题，将其全部选项汇总为一个统一选项列表，让模型为每个问题分配答案。由此可计算答题准确率与"排除法信用"（即多选题格式所提供的、非真实理解所得的分数）。同时，从选项池中删除正确答案会使问题变得无法回答且无精确真值，从而在同一次评测中对弃答（abstention）进行计分。
AI.result: 对五个四选项问题，随机猜对一组的概率从 10^{-3} 降至 5×10^{-7}；能识别自身答案的模型可保持其多选题成绩，因此因合并而损失的准确率即衡量了格式所给予的排除法信用。在八个文本、图像和视频基准及十八个模型上，合并对所有模型都更难，且排除法信用对最弱模型最大；八个开源权重模型中有七个对 87%–100% 的不可答问题仍给出了答案。
AI.conclusion: AnswerPool 是一种零标注成本、无需新题目的基准加固与诊断方法：它提升区分度、量化多选题格式的排除法红利，并揭示模型在缺乏精确真值时是否具备弃答能力。结果表明现有多选题分数存在系统性高估，尤其对弱模型，且当前多数开源模型缺乏弃答意识。

title: Generative Uncertainty as a Self-supervised Signal for Semantic Similarity Learning
summary: Evaluating semantic similarity between videos is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, essential for tasks ranging from out-of-distribution (OOD) detection to video retrieval. However, defining and labeling video similarity is notoriously difficult and expensive due to the complex spatio-temporal nature. In this paper, we propose a novel self-supervised approach that leverages generative uncertainty from text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models to learn semantic similarity without human annotations. Our method is based on the observation that T2V models produce consistent outputs for familiar concepts but exhibit high variance and uncertainty when prompted with specialized concepts. We utilize this behavior to identify stable semantic features within existing pretrained representations, such as VideoMAE and V-JEPA. Specifically, we learn a mask over these embeddings using purely generated data, encouraging the model to retain features that remain consistent across generations of general concepts while discarding those associated with generative noise or uncertainty. Experimental results across three key tasks demonstrate that our learned feature subspaces consistently outperform original pretrained features and baseline feature selection methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自监督方法，利用文本到视频扩散模型的生成不确定性来学习视频语义相似度，无需人工标注。
AI.motivation: 视频语义相似度对OOD检测和视频检索等任务至关重要，但由于视频复杂的时空特性，定义和标注视频相似度既困难又昂贵。
AI.method: 基于T2V模型对熟悉概念输出一致、对专门概念输出高方差的观察，利用这种不确定性在现有预训练表示（如VideoMAE和V-JEPA）中识别稳定语义特征。具体地，使用纯生成数据学习一个作用于这些嵌入的掩码，使模型保留在一般概念生成中保持一致的特征，同时丢弃与生成噪声或不确定性相关的特征。
AI.result: 在三个关键任务上的实验结果表明，所学到的特征子空间持续优于原始预训练特征和基线特征选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用T2V扩散模型的生成不确定性学习稳定语义特征子空间，是一种有效且无需人工标注的视频语义相似度学习方法。

title: Jailbreaks for Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification in Large Reasoning Models
summary: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel at complex reasoning, alignment through reinforcement learning often induces systemic overconfidence. In production environments, where logits may be unavailable, robust black-box uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for trustworthiness and safety. Focusing on question-answering for LRMs, we show that existing black-box methods, such as paraphrase-based self-consistency and confidence verbalization, offer little to no improvement over simple repeated sampling, suggesting that alignment suppresses useful output variability. We introduce prompt-level relaxation operators that broaden the model's effective output distribution by approximating the effect of an optimal policy obtained with a stronger KL-regularization parameter, hence closer to the reference model. Theoretically, we demonstrate that relaxation improves calibration. We propose Jailbreak for Uncertainty (J4U), a jailbreak-derived technique for UQ that empirically reproduces the behavioral signatures predicted by our relaxation theory. Across 3 datasets and 4 LRMs, including a closed-source production model, J4U's improvement over repeated sampling achieves statistical significance in up to 6 times more LRM-dataset-metric settings than the strongest black-box UQ state-of-the-art baseline we evaluate, with average ECE reductions up to 5 times larger. These results provide a practical tool for UQ in black-box LRM deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大型推理模型（LRM）在黑盒场景下的不确定性量化（UQ）。作者指出强化学习对齐会导致系统性过度自信，使现有黑盒方法（如复述自洽、置信度口头表达）相较简单重复采样几乎没有增益。为此提出提示级松弛算子（prompt-level relaxation operators），从理论上证明其能改善校准，并据此设计J4U（Jailbreak for Uncertainty）方法。在3个数据集和4个LRM上，J4U相较重复采样的显著性提升最多达最强基线的6倍，ECE平均降低幅度最多达其5倍。
AI.motivation: 在生产环境中，LRM的logits往往不可获取，因此需要稳健的黑盒不确定性量化以保证可信与安全。然而强化学习对齐会使模型系统性过度自信，抑制有用的输出多样性，导致基于复述自洽、置信度口头表达等现有黑盒UQ方法相比简单重复采样几乎没有改进。因此需要一种能够恢复输出多样性、从而改善校准的黑盒UQ方法。
AI.method: 1）识别现有黑盒UQ方法的不足，指出对齐抑制了输出变异性；2）提出提示级松弛算子（prompt-level relaxation operators），通过近似更强KL正则化参数下最优策略的效果，拓宽模型有效输出分布，使其更接近参考模型；3）理论上证明松弛能改善校准；4）提出J4U（Jailbreak for Uncertainty），一种由越狱技术衍生的UQ方法，用以经验性地复现松弛理论所预测的行为特征。
AI.result: 在3个数据集和4个LRM（含一个闭源生产模型）上进行评估。J4U相较重复采样，在LRM-数据集-指标组合上达到统计显著性的数量最多为所评估最强黑盒UQ基线的6倍，平均ECE降低幅度最多达其5倍。
AI.conclusion: J4U为黑盒LRM部署中的不确定性量化提供了实用工具，能够在logits不可获取的生产环境下有效改善校准，验证了松弛理论对校准提升的预测。

title: Do Coding Agents Reuse Existing Code or Reinvent the Wheel?
summary: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for iterative development on real repositories, yet existing evaluation barely answers a basic question: \emph{do coding agents reuse existing code or reinvent the wheel?} The question matters: every duplicated implementation is a fix applied twice and agents produce code far faster than humans can audit, so redundancy accumulates unsupervised. Thus, we present \textbf{RepoReuse}, a multi-turn benchmark for auditing code reuse in real repositories, where requirements are revealed turn by turn and the workspace accumulates across turns. It is built by a fully automated pipeline combining AST-based dependency graphs, guided evidence collection, and execution-verified task synthesis, and scales readily to new repositories. Beyond pass rates, we measure the reuse rate together with recall and cross-turn structural redundancy. An audit over 3{,}000 turns shows that agents progressively stop exploring relevant repository code, reuse their own history less even when it is fully in the workspace, and leave duplicated logic in 50.8\% of task chains by turn~5---all while pass rates barely move. Such deficiencies are invisible to pass rates, underscoring the need to evaluate code generation beyond functional correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RepoReuse——一个多轮基准，用于审计真实代码仓库中编码智能体的代码复用行为，揭示通过率无法反映的复用缺陷。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体被广泛用于真实仓库的迭代开发，但现有评测几乎无法回答"智能体是复用已有代码还是重复造轮子"这一基本问题。由于智能体产码速度远超人工审计，重复实现会无人监管地累积——每次重复相当于同一修复做两遍。
AI.method: 构建全自动流水线生成多轮基准：需求逐轮揭示、工作区跨轮累积；结合基于AST的依赖图、引导式证据收集与执行验证的任务合成，可便捷扩展至新仓库。评测指标除通过率外，还测量复用率、复用召回率及跨轮结构冗余度。
AI.result: 对3,000轮交互的审计显示：智能体逐渐停止探索相关仓库代码，即使自身历史完整存在于工作区中也很少复用，到第5轮时50.8%的任务链中残留重复逻辑，而通过率几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 这些缺陷对通过率不可见，说明有必要在功能正确性之外评测代码生成过程，尤其是代码复用质量。

title: From Input to Output: A Flexible Agent for Dual-End Interpretation of Sparse Autoencoder Features
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are an important tool for mechanistic interpretability, but interpreting their many features remains challenging. Existing methods characterize input-side activation patterns and output-side intervention effects, yet often leave their functional connection implicit, while input-side evidence collection typically relies on costly large-corpus scans. We introduce functional interpretation, which characterizes an SAE feature as a mapping from its activating input semantics to its output effects under intervention, and present Dual-End Agentic Feature Interpretation (DAFI), an agent that actively gathers evidence and refines input-side, output-side, and functional interpretations through component-specific feedback. Its short-context token probing enables on-demand activation evidence collection without a full corpus scan. On GemmaScope, DAFI improves Input score by 13.1 percentage points over SAGE and Output score by 38.9 points over Token Change, while being substantially more token-efficient than a general-purpose coding agent. Skills distilled from successful refinements raise the held-out joint pass rate from 58.0% to 92.0% and improve both interpretation quality and efficiency when transferred to a new model-SAE setting. Across features with reliable endpoint interpretations, 70.7% exhibit non-equivalent input and output semantics. On AxBench, DAFI also improves steering-feature selection over output-score filtering. Code is available at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/DAFI.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"功能性解释"（functional interpretation）概念，并设计了双端智能体式特征解释框架DAFI，通过主动收集证据并迭代优化输入侧、输出侧与功能性解释，在GemmaScope显著超越SAGE与Token Change，并展现出良好的迁移与效率优势。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）是机制可解释性的重要工具，但其大量特征难以解释。现有方法分别刻画输入侧激活模式或输出侧干预效果，往往使二者之间的功能联系保持隐含；同时输入侧证据采集依赖昂贵的大规模语料扫描。因此需要一种能够显式连接输入语义与输出效应、且证据采集更高效的解释方法。
AI.method: 提出功能性解释，将SAE特征刻画为"从激活输入语义到干预下输出效应"的映射；并构建双端智能体式特征解释框架DAFI，该智能体主动收集证据，并通过组件特定反馈迭代优化输入侧、输出侧和功能性解释。其短上下文token探测支持按需采集激活证据，无需全语料扫描。
AI.result: 在GemmaScope上，DAFI的Input分数较SAGE提升13.1个百分点，Output分数较Token Change提升38.9个百分点，同时比通用编码智能体显著更省token。从成功优化中蒸馏的技能将留出集联合通过率从58.0%提升至92.0%，并在迁移到新的模型-SAE设定时同时改善解释质量与效率。在具有可靠端点解释的特征中，70.7%呈现输入与输出语义不等价。在AxBench上，DAFI相较输出分数过滤也提升了引导特征选择效果。
AI.conclusion: DAFI通过显式建模输入语义到输出效应的功能映射，并借助智能体式迭代优化与高效证据采集，实现了更优且更省资源的SAE特征解释，且其蒸馏技能具备可迁移性；同时揭示了大量特征在输入与输出语义上并不等价，对机制可解释性及引导特征选择具有实际价值。

title: Ego-Forge: Text and Geometric-Attention Free Exo-to-Egocentric Video Generation
summary: Exo-to-egocentric video generation aims to synthesize what a person sees from their own viewpoint given third-person footage and a target head trajectory. The task requires transferring appearance and semantics across large viewpoint changes while hallucinating content never observed by the exocentric camera. Existing approaches either impose additional input requirements, such as a ground-truth initial egocentric frame or multiple synchronized exocentric views, or remain limited to category-specific settings. EgoX is the first to address cross-activity and in-the-wild generalization, but requires a human-provided caption of the non-existent egocentric view at inference and introduces a computationally expensive geometry-guided attention bias that can propagate reconstruction errors and suppress textual and visual context. We therefore propose \textbf{Ego-Forge}, a caption-free and bias-free framework for exo-to-egocentric generation. It introduces \textit{Dynamic Captioning}, which derives conditioning tokens directly from the model's hidden states and adapts them to the diffusion timestep and network depth, replacing external text conditioning. By scaling training by an order of magnitude and using all available exocentric viewpoints, Ego-Forge learns cross-view correspondence implicitly and eliminates the need for geometry-guided attention, requiring only a lightweight depth prior. Ego-Forge achieves state-of-the-art performance on Ego-Exo4D, runs faster end-to-end, requires no external annotation at inference, and generalizes to in-the-wild scenes, including cases where over-reliance on geometry blocks appearance inference. Our model and source code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出Ego-Forge，一个无需caption、无需几何偏置的exo-to-egocentric视频生成框架，通过动态caption与大规模训练隐式学习跨视角对应。
AI.motivation: exo-to-egocentric生成需在剧烈视角变化下迁移外观与语义，并幻觉出第三人称相机未观测到的内容。现有方法要么依赖额外输入（真值首帧、多同步视角），要么局限于特定类别；EgoX虽实现跨活动与野外泛化，但推理时需人工caption，且几何引导注意力偏置计算昂贵、易传播重建误差并抑制文本与视觉上下文。
AI.method: 提出Ego-Forge，caption-free且bias-free。核心为Dynamic Captioning：从模型隐状态直接导出条件token，并使其适配扩散时间步与网络深度，替代外部文本条件。通过将训练规模扩大一个数量级并利用所有可用exocentric视角，隐式学习跨视角对应关系，从而去除几何引导注意力，仅保留轻量深度先验。
AI.result: 在Ego-Exo4D上达到SOTA性能，端到端运行更快，推理时无需外部标注，并泛化至野外场景，包括过度依赖几何会阻碍外观推断的情形。
AI.conclusion: Ego-Forge证明无需人工caption与几何偏置也能实现强泛化的exo-to-egocentric生成，模型与源码将公开发布。

title: Deep Learning Methods in Neuroscience: From Modeling Molecular Mechanisms to Classifying States of Consciousness
summary: A critical analysis of contemporary approaches to the study of conscious states. The review focuses on methods of classification, clustering, modeling of brain states under anesthesia and identification of measurable neurobiological characteristics of brain function. A comparative analysis was conducted in the following three major areas: automatic detection of states of consciousness using neural networks based on EEG and fMRI data; modeling of the structural-functional dynamics of the brain under the effects of anesthetics; and detection of neurophysiological indicators which correlate with the level of consciousness. The obtained conclusions demonstrate the growing effectiveness of deep neural models in the classification and prediction of brain states and the analysis of dynamic structural-functional connectivity. Nonetheless, significant limitations were also identified, including the limited interpretability of the models, the lack of standardized metrics, and the problem of the specificity of consciousness markers. Our findings support the need for developing hybrid, generalizible, physiologically grounded architectures. Furthermore, such approaches may improve the translational potential of computational models in clinical neuroscience. Diverse methods of machine and computational modeling have demonstrated their effectiveness in tasks of automatic clustering and classification of brain states, the development of multilevel models and the identification of connectivity patterns correlated with levels of consciousness. A larger-scale analysis and a larger dataset, as well as the implementation of model interpretability approaches are required for the practical application of the analyzed models. The models based on EEG and LFP are the most promising for clinical application due to their availability and the possibility of real-time monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了意识状态研究的当代计算方法，围绕麻醉下脑状态的分类、聚类与建模，以及意识神经生物学标志物的识别展开批判性分析。
AI.motivation: 意识状态的客观刻画与临床监测需求推动了对计算方法的研究；现有方法在可解释性、标准化指标和意识标志物特异性方面存在明显不足，亟需系统梳理与评估。
AI.method: 采用批判性文献综述与比较分析，聚焦三大方向：基于EEG与fMRI数据、利用神经网络自动检测意识状态；麻醉作用下脑结构-功能动力学建模；与意识水平相关的神经生理指标检测。
AI.result: 深度神经模型在脑状态分类、预测及动态结构-功能连接分析中效果不断提升；但存在模型可解释性有限、缺乏标准化评价指标、意识标志物特异性不足等显著局限。
AI.conclusion: 需发展混合式、可泛化、具生理基础的架构以提升计算模型在临床神经科学中的转化潜力；实际应用仍依赖更大规模数据与可解释性方法；基于EEG和LFP的模型因易获取、可实时监测而最具临床前景。

title: How Well Can LLMs Simulate Real Learner Evaluations of Educational Feedback?
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: While recent studies have explored human behavior and preference simulation using large language models (LLMs), it remains unclear how well LLMs can simulate subjective evaluations from real learners in educational settings. We investigate this question using real learner evaluation data on feedback for high-school biology questions at both the group and individual levels. We compare performance with and without learner-specific information, such as personality traits and evaluation examples, across six models. Our results show that LLMs still have a limited ability to simulate learner evaluations. Providing learner profiles and examples improves score calibration and individual-level simulation, but more often fails to improve group-level consistency. These findings highlight the need to investigate which learner information and adaptation strategies are effective for learner preference simulation.

AI.tldr: 研究检验LLM能否模拟真实学习者的主观评价，发现其能力仍有限：提供学习者画像与示例可改善分数校准与个体层面模拟，但常无法提升群体层面一致性。
AI.motivation: 已有研究探索用大语言模型模拟人类行为与偏好，但在教育场景中，LLM能否复现真实学习者的主观评价尚不清楚。作者希望厘清该能力边界，并明确何种学习者信息与适配策略有用。
AI.method: 使用高中生物问题反馈的真实学习者评价数据，在群体与个体两个层面开展模拟；对比六种模型在有无学习者特定信息（如人格特质、评价示例）条件下的表现。
AI.result: LLM模拟学习者评价的能力仍有限。引入学习者画像和示例可改善分数校准和个体层面模拟，但在多数情况下未能提升群体层面的一致性。
AI.conclusion: LLM尚不能可靠替代真实学习者的主观评价；未来需研究哪些学习者信息与适配策略对学习者偏好模拟真正有效。

title: Multilinguality in Hybrid Attention LLMs
summary: In response to the growing demand for long sequences in agentic and reasoning use cases, many state-of-the-art LLMs combine multiple variants of attention to mitigate the quadratic complexity of traditional softmax attention. These hybrid attention LLMs aim to balance the strengths and limitations of full attention and alternatives based on recurrence. This work presents a first study of how hybrid attention impacts the multilinguality of LLMs. Beyond the impact on long sequences in poorly tokenized languages, our study is motivated by the possibility that the inductive biases of the recurrent state alter linguistic processing. Our interpretability analysis confirms this, showing that cross-lingual representations in hybrid models develop in patterns tied to the ordering of recurrent and full-attention layers. Across diverse models, we notably observe a pronounced spike in cross-lingual alignment around the first full-attention layer. These findings lead us to question the conventional ordering of attention layers. In distillation experiments on multilingual data, all alternative layer orderings outperform the standard throughout training, learning up to 2.5X faster. These stark, replicable results prompt our theory that multilingual models would benefit from starting with a full-attention layer rather than recurrent layers.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次探讨混合注意力（full attention + 循环注意力）对LLM多语言性的影响，发现跨语言表征的发展与循环层/全注意力层的排布顺序强相关，并据此提出应让多语言模型以全注意力层开头的层次排序理论。
AI.motivation: 为应对agentic与推理场景对长序列的需求，当前先进LLM普遍组合多种注意力变体以缓解softmax注意力的二次复杂度。本文的动机不仅在于长序列在分词较差语言中的影响，更在于怀疑循环状态的归纳偏置会改变语言处理方式，从而首次系统研究混合注意力对LLM多语言性的作用。
AI.method: 结合可解释性分析与蒸馏实验：通过可解释性分析考察跨语言表征在混合注意力模型中如何随循环层与全注意力层的顺序演变；并在多语言数据上进行不同层排序的蒸馏实验进行验证。
AI.result: 跨语言表征的形成模式与循环层、全注意力层的排布顺序相关，且在不同模型中一致观察到第一个全注意力层附近出现显著的跨语言对齐峰值。多语言蒸馏实验中，所有替代层排序在整个训练过程中均优于标准排序，学习速度快至约2.5倍，结果稳定可复现。
AI.conclusion: 这些显著且可复现的结果支持本文提出的理论：多语言模型更宜以全注意力层开头，而非以循环层开头，从而对传统注意力层排序提出质疑。

title: TRACE: Single-Pass Decoding-Trace Risk Localization for Generation Calibration
summary: Reliable confidence estimation is essential for large language model deployment. However, answer-level calibration remains challenging because generation errors are often localized: a response may be fluent and high-probability overall while still failing at a critical number, entity, or factual claim. Existing estimators compress token probabilities, sequence likelihoods, entropy, or beam statistics into a global score, which can dilute such local risk signals. We propose TRACE, a single-pass, decoded-answer-preserving confidence estimator that treats decoding-time uncertainty as a trajectory through three steps: (i) recording token-level surprisal and predictive entropy during decoding, (ii) applying local risk operators to preserve uncertainty spikes, and (iii) converting localized trace risk into answer-level confidence. TRACE produces a label-free risk score, while TRACE+ calibrates trace-only features into probabilities using a held-out split, without extra generations or external verifiers. We evaluate four tasks against 19 calibration baselines, and TRACE+ reduces Brier from 0.149 to 0.137 and improves AUROC from 0.758 to 0.792 over the strongest likelihood baseline. Across seven LLMs, TRACE+ improves over the best non-TRACE baseline pool from 0.136 to 0.120 Brier and from 0.764 to 0.817 AUROC. Results show that localizing decoding-time risk provides a general approach to calibration.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE/TRACE+，一种单次解码、保留答案的置信度估计方法，通过局部化解码期风险轨迹改进大模型答案级校准。
AI.motivation: 大模型答案级校准困难，因为生成错误往往是局部化的：整体流畅且高概率的回答，仍可能在关键数字、实体或事实断言上出错。现有方法将token概率、序列似然、熵或beam统计压缩为全局分数，会稀释这些局部风险信号。
AI.method: TRACE将解码期不确定性视为轨迹，分三步：(i)解码中记录token级surprisal与预测熵；(ii)用局部风险算子保留不确定性尖峰；(iii)将局部化轨迹风险转化为答案级置信度。TRACE输出无标签风险分数；TRACE+利用留出集将纯轨迹特征校准为概率，无需额外生成或外部验证器。
AI.result: 在四个任务、19个校准基线上，TRACE+相对最强似然基线将Brier从0.149降至0.137，AUROC从0.758升至0.792。跨七个LLM，TRACE+相对最佳非TRACE基线池将Brier从0.136降至0.120，AUROC从0.764升至0.817。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，局部化解码期风险为校准提供了一种通用且有效的方法。

title: Rethinking Visual Token Compression for Video Large Language Models: A Simple Yet Strong Baseline
summary: Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, but their inference efficiency is constrained by the large number of visual tokens produced by long videos. Recent video token compression methods increasingly introduce sophisticated strategies for token selection, pruning, and merging. This raises a fundamental question: how much of compression performance can be obtained by simply preserving the structure encoded in the visual representations? We investigate this question with SimpleCluster, a simple and training-free baseline that performs position-aware cross-frame clustering in the visual feature space and represents each cluster using the mean of its original visual features. Extensive experiments across four video understanding benchmarks and three representative Video LLMs show that SimpleCluster achieves competitive or superior performance over recent compression methods across a wide range of token retention ratios, with particularly strong robustness under extremely low retention rates (e.g., 1%). To understand this behavior, we analyze the feature space preserved by different compression methods in terms of local approximation fidelity and global coverage. The results show that stronger downstream performance is consistently associated with better preservation of the original visual feature distribution, especially its global coverage. These findings highlight feature-space preservation as an important consideration for video token compression under highly constrained token budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/xiaozhang79/SimpleCluster.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SimpleCluster——一种简单且免训练的视频 token 压缩基线，通过在视觉特征空间进行位置感知的跨帧聚类，并用簇内原始特征的均值代表每个簇，从而在保留视觉表征结构的同时大幅压缩 token。
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型（Video LLMs）推理效率受长视频产生的大量视觉 token 制约。现有视频 token 压缩方法日益引入复杂的 token 选择、剪枝与合并策略，但一个根本问题尚未被充分回答：仅通过保留视觉表征中编码的结构，能获得多少压缩性能？作者希望探究这一问题。
AI.method: 提出 SimpleCluster：无需训练，在视觉特征空间进行位置感知的跨帧聚类（position-aware cross-frame clustering），并以每个簇内原始视觉特征的均值作为该簇的表征，替代复杂的 token 选择、剪枝与合并机制。
AI.result: 在四个视频理解基准和三个代表性 Video LLM 上，SimpleCluster 在广泛的 token 保留率范围内取得与近期压缩方法相当或更优的性能，且在极低保留率（如 1%）下鲁棒性尤为突出；并进一步从局部逼近保真度与全局覆盖度两方面分析不同方法保留的特征空间，发现更强的下游性能与更好地保留原始视觉特征分布（尤其是全局覆盖度）一致相关。
AI.conclusion: 在高度受限的 token 预算下，特征空间保留（feature-space preservation）应被视为视频 token 压缩的重要考量因素；简单、免训练的聚类基线即可在压缩率与性能之间实现有竞争力的权衡。

title: Reduce, Then Encode: Multiscale Volumetric Reduction for 2D Foundation Models in Brain MRI
summary: Pretrained 2D foundation models offer a practical alternative to dedicated 3D pretraining for brain structural magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI), but their use on volumetric data requires bridging the mismatch between a 2D encoder and a 3D volume input. Existing methods typically encode slices independently and integrate their features afterwards. We introduce Multiscale Volumetric Reduction (MVR), a reduce-then-encode approach that compresses each anatomical view from (D) slices into (M << D) complementary 2D components before foundation-model encoding. MVR combines an uncentered-PCA base component derived from the original through-plane intensities with residual detail components constructed from multiscale spatial descriptors. The reduction is estimated from the training volumes without diagnostic labels or gradient-based optimization and remains fixed thereafter. The resulting components are independently processed by a shared frozen 2D foundation model and concatenated for linear probing. Under this frozen-encoder setting, MVR achieves strong overall performance across ADNI, OASIS, and ABIDE relative to the evaluated 2D-to-3D adaptation methods and simple input-reduction baselines, while also generalizing strongly from ADNI to AIBL.

AI.tldr: 提出多尺度体数据降维(MVR)，一种"先降维后编码"策略，将3D脑sMRI的D层切片压缩为M(远小于D)个2D互补成分，再用冻结的2D基础模型编码并进行线性探测。
AI.motivation: 预训练的2D基础模型可为脑结构MRI提供实用的3D预训练替代方案，但2D编码器与3D体数据输入之间存在维度不匹配。现有方法通常独立编码各切片，事后融合特征，未能有效桥接这一差距。
AI.method: MVR针对每个解剖视图，在基础模型编码前先将D层切片压缩为M个互补2D成分。其组合方式为：以原始穿平面强度构建的无中心PCA基成分，加上由多尺度空间描述子构造的残差细节成分。该降维基于训练体数据估计，无需诊断标签，也不依赖梯度优化，且此后保持固定。所得各成分由同一冻结的2D基础模型独立处理，拼接后进行线性探测。
AI.result: 在冻结编码器设定下，MVR在ADNI、OASIS和ABIDE上相对所评估的2D-to-3D适配方法与简单输入降维基线均取得较强的整体性能，并具备从ADNI到AIBL的良好泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MVR通过免训练、免标签的降维方式有效弥合2D编码器与3D体数据间的差距，在多个数据集上优于现有适配方法，并展现出跨数据集泛化潜力。

title: BiMoGen: Bidirectional Motion-Text Generation via Unified Masked Discrete Diffusion
summary: Text-to-motion generation and motion-to-text captioning are two fundamental tasks in human motion modeling, both grounded in the same underlying motion-text correspondence. Existing unified approaches mostly rely on autoregressive modeling, which imposes a fixed generation order and is therefore poorly suited to the bidirectional dependencies between language and motion, allowing early prediction errors to persist as fixed context and degrade both temporal coherence and cross-modal consistency. Masked discrete diffusion, which models sequences through iterative bidirectional prediction, offers a natural remedy. We therefore propose BiMoGen (Bidirectional Motion-text Generation), a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. To stabilize training, we design Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training, in which masked pretraining first establishes cross-modal correspondence on paired motion-text sequences, after which supervised fine-tuning specializes the model for bidirectional generation. Masked diffusion nonetheless introduces its own source of error, as the model is trained on clean ground-truth context yet encounters self-generated and potentially erroneous context at inference, with errors committed under heavily masked states propagating through subsequent steps. We further introduce Generation-Aware Self-Correction that exposes the model to its own predictions during training and applies correction passes at early sampling steps to revise unreliably committed tokens. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate competitive performance on both tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed two-stage training and self-correction designs. The project page is available at https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BiMoGen-Page.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BiMoGen，一种基于掩码离散扩散的双向运动-文本统一生成框架。
AI.motivation: 现有统一的文本-运动生成与运动-文本描述方法多依赖自回归建模，强加固定生成顺序，难以适配语言与运动之间的双向依赖，早期预测错误会作为固定上下文持续存在，损害时序连贯性与跨模态一致性。掩码离散扩散通过迭代式双向预测建模序列，可自然缓解该问题。
AI.method: 提出BiMoGen统一掩码离散扩散框架；设计解耦的单模态与跨模态训练策略，先通过掩码预训练在配对运动-文本序列上建立跨模态对应，再用监督微调专门化双向生成能力；进一步引入生成感知自校正，训练时让模型接触自身预测，并在采样早期步骤执行校正，修正不可靠的已提交token。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D与KIT-ML数据集上的大量实验表明，该模型在两项任务上均取得有竞争力的性能，验证了两阶段训练与自校正设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 掩码离散扩散为双向运动-文本建模提供了有效范式，解耦训练与生成感知自校正可缓解训练-推理上下文不一致导致的误差累积。

title: AwarenessBench: Assessing Cognitive Capabilities of Language Models
summary: As language models (LMs) exhibit increasingly consciousness-like behaviors, evaluating their cognitive abilities becomes essential. We introduce AwarenessBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for assessing the cognitive abilities of LMs in four dimensions: metacognition, self-awareness, social awareness, and situational awareness, covering 15 cognitive functions and 14,381 samples. Evaluating 18 state-of-the-art LMs, we find that all consistently surpass random baselines, with more advanced models performing better. We further compare LMs with human performance across three demographic groups, where the best-performing model surpasses human averages overall, but most still fall markedly short in metacognition and self-awareness. Finally, we show that awareness is a distinct capability: progress in language modeling or reasoning does not necessarily translate into improved cognition.

AI.tldr: 提出 AwarenessBench，首个从元认知、自我意识、社会意识、情境意识四个维度评测语言模型认知能力的综合基准，含15项认知功能、14,381个样本；评测18个SOTA模型并与三组人类对比，发现意识是独立能力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型表现出越来越多类意识行为，因此亟需系统评估其认知能力，然而此前缺乏覆盖多维度、多功能的综合性评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 AwarenessBench 基准，涵盖元认知、自我意识、社会意识、情境意识四个维度，共15项认知功能、14,381个样本；对18个最先进语言模型进行评测，并与三个统计人群组的人类表现进行对比，同时分析语言建模与推理能力进步同认知能力之间的关系。
AI.result: 所有模型均稳定优于随机基线，且模型越先进表现越好；最佳模型在总体上超过人类平均，但多数模型在元认知与自我意识方面仍明显落后；语言建模或推理能力的提升并不必然带来认知能力改善。
AI.conclusion: AwarenessBench 为语言模型认知能力提供了系统评测工具；意识是一种独立能力，不能由语言建模或推理能力的进步所替代，元认知与自我意识是当前模型的主要短板。

title: Spectral Super-Resolution using Spatial-Spectral Residual Operator Networks
comment: IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026
summary: Spectral super-resolution of multispectral satellite images can enable high temporal- and spatial-resolution hyperspectral satellite imagery at a modest cost, significantly increasing the applicability of hyperspectral remote sensing. This task is inherently ill-posed, making it well-suited for deep learning-based methods. In this study, the spectral super-resolution task is framed as an operator learning problem, and SSRON is proposed as a Deep Operator Network that effectively learns function-to-function mappings from downsampled spectra to continuous spectra. The model is trained to super-resolve Sentinel-2A-like multispectral imagery to EMIT images. Compared to baseline models, SSRON achieves superior performance across all metrics. The model also demonstrates zero-shot spectral super-resolution capability by predicting bands unseen during training. Furthermore, its continuous-output formulation suggests the potential to estimate spectra at finer wavelength intervals than the native sensor. These results suggest the potential of SSRON and establishes operator learning as a promising direction for spectral super-resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文将光谱超分辨任务建模为算子学习问题，提出深度算子网络 SSRON，实现从低分辨率多光谱到连续光谱的函数到函数映射，在 Sentinel-2A 到 EMIT 的任务上性能优于基线，并具备零样本预测未见波段的能力。
AI.motivation: 多光谱卫星图像的光谱超分辨能以较低成本获得高时空分辨率的高光谱影像，显著扩展高光谱遥感的适用性。该任务本质上是病态问题，适合用深度学习方法求解，因此作者希望引入算子学习框架来更好地学习光谱的连续映射关系。
AI.method: 将光谱超分辨任务框定为算子学习问题，提出深度算子网络 SSRON，学习从降采样光谱到连续光谱的函数到函数映射（function-to-function mapping）。模型以 Sentinel-2A 类多光谱影像为输入，训练其超分辨生成 EMIT 影像，输出为连续光谱形式。
AI.result: 与基线模型相比，SSRON 在所有指标上均取得更优表现；模型展现出零样本光谱超分辨能力，能预测训练中未见的波段；其连续输出形式表明有潜力在比原生传感器更细的波长间隔上估计光谱。
AI.conclusion: SSRON 在光谱超分辨上具有良好潜力，表明算子学习是光谱超分辨任务的一个有前景的方向。

title: Self-Adapting Group of Experts for Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Multi-agent systems bring together language model agents with different roles to propose, review, and refine solutions. Each agent's response depends on its model's capabilities, the reasoning strategy defined by its system prompt, and the information in its input context. Existing frameworks often adapt communication by changing this context while leaving individual prompts fixed, even when a problem calls for different skills. We study whether agents' initial responses can identify a strategy better suited to the current problem and guide its transfer to other agents. To address this, we introduce SAGE (Self-Adapting Group of Experts), a training-free framework that uses answer agreement, prefix consistency, and reciprocal peer review to select a strategy donor. SAGE transfers the selected donor's reasoning strategy to the other agents while preserving their original roles. This transfer uses only the agents' original system prompts, without access to the problem or generated solutions. After strategy adaptation, agents exchange responses through a dynamic, sparse directed acyclic graph that routes information from higher-scoring agents to lower-scoring agents. Experiments across multiple agent backbones and reasoning benchmarks show that SAGE achieves higher average accuracy than the evaluated baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/atifquamar07/sage.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 SAGE，通过答案一致性、前缀一致性与互评选择“策略提供者”，将其推理策略迁移给其他智能体，并借助动态稀疏 DAG 路由信息，在多骨干与推理基准上取得更高平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体框架通常通过修改共享上下文来适配协作，却固定各智能体的提示，难以为不同问题匹配所需技能；作者希望探索智能体的初始回答能否识别更适合当前问题的策略，并将其迁移给其他智能体。
AI.method: SAGE 为免训练框架：利用答案一致性、前缀一致性和互评机制选出策略提供者；仅用各智能体原始系统提示，在不接触问题与已生成解的情况下，将提供者的推理策略迁移给其他智能体，同时保留其原始角色；策略适配后，智能体通过动态稀疏有向无环图交换回答，将信息从高分智能体路由至低分智能体。
AI.result: 在多种智能体骨干模型与多个推理基准上的实验表明，SAGE 的平均准确率高于所评估的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 智能体的初始回答可用于识别并迁移更适配当前问题的推理策略；免训练的 SAGE 通过策略迁移与动态稀疏 DAG 通信，有效提升多智能体系统的整体推理性能。

title: Adaptive Safety Filtering for Frozen ACC Policies via Conformal Residual Calibration
summary: Frozen adaptive cruise control (ACC) policies can violate constraints when deployment dynamics differ from their training conditions. We propose residual-aware conformal action filtering (RACF), which calibrates residuals of a fixed nominal predictor and converts their quantile into an operating margin for finite-model action projection. Completed transitions update margins and candidate selection without retraining the policy. In a registered comparison over 2,400 controller-trial units, Adaptive RACF achieves 94.3% episode safety, improving by 19.9 percentage points over the evaluated nominal CBF-QP baseline while reducing projection frequency from 8.11% to 6.63%. A controlled study isolates a 4.54-point improvement from residual-margin injection. In a separate matched-hardware evaluation, Adaptive reduces mean amortized rollout time by 21.2% relative to Robust CBF-QP, with 161/180 versus 170/180 safe episodes. We characterize conditions linking one-step residual coverage to constraint satisfaction and quantify the observed safety-computation trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 提出残差感知保形动作滤波(RACF),用固定标称预测器的残差分位数作为运行裕度做有限模型动作投影,无需重训策略即可在线更新;2400个控制器-试验单元上安全率达94.3%,较CBF-QP基线提升19.9个百分点,投影频率由8.11%降至6.63%;匹配硬件上摊销部署时间较Robust CBF-QP降低21.2%。
AI.motivation: 冻结的ACC策略在部署动态偏离训练条件时易违反约束,现有CBF-QP类基线要么安全裕度不足,要么投影过于频繁导致计算开销大,需要在无需重训练的前提下兼顾安全性与计算效率。
AI.method: RACF:对固定标称预测器的残差进行保形校准,将残差分位数转换为运行裕度,用于有限模型的动作投影;已完成转场用于更新裕度与候选动作选择,全程不重训练策略;并通过消融与对照实验分离残差-裕度注入的贡献,理论刻画单步残差覆盖与约束满足的联系。
AI.result: 2,400个控制器-试验单元注册比较中,Adaptive RACF情节安全率94.3%,较标称CBF-QP提升19.9个百分点,投影频率从8.11%降至6.63%;对照实验分离出残差-裕度注入带来4.54个百分点提升;匹配硬件评估中摊销 rollout 平均时间较Robust CBF-QP减少21.2%,安全情节161/180对170/180。
AI.conclusion: RACF可在不重训练的前提下显著提升ACC部署安全性并降低投影频率与计算开销,但存在明确的安全-计算权衡:硬件评估中其安全情节数少于Robust CBF-QP,论文给出了单步残差覆盖到约束满足的条件刻画与量化权衡。

title: When Should the Count Change? Learning State Maintenance for Causal Video Counting
summary: Continuous video counting requires distinguishing new observations from new objects or completed events. We introduce StaMina (State Maintenance), which learns to maintain counting state through state-conditioned updates. Recurrent visual context supports recognition; learned transitions maintain visibility, persistent identities, and completed-event records. A differentiable recurrence trains event transitions over legal paths constrained by count endpoints; visibility and association objectives train the object branch. A multi-source pipeline organizes 39.8K spatial queries and complementary event annotations into counting trajectories. On SVCBench, we evaluate counting adaptation with partial video overlap and held-out groups of linked annotations. Under prefix replay (Full) and persistent streaming (Stream), 4B and 8B models reach 41.9/36.4 and 44.9/38.2 Gaussian Precision Accuracy, respectively. The 8B model gains 10.9/3.2 points over Counting-SFT on the same queries. Matched-graph comparisons isolate phase conditioning and trajectory supervision, assessing training objectives alongside hard decisions. Online video benchmarks and count-conditioned decisions assess online understanding and task eligibility. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/StaMina/

AI.tldr: StaMina 通过状态条件更新维护计数状态，实现连续视频计数中的新观测与新物体/已完成事件的区分。
AI.motivation: 连续视频计数需区分新观测与新物体或已完成事件，现有方法难以持续维护计数状态。
AI.method: 采用状态条件更新与循环视觉上下文；可微循环在计数端点约束的合法路径上训练事件转移，可见性与关联目标训练物体分支；多源流水线组织39.8K空间查询与事件标注为计数轨迹。
AI.result: 在SVCBench上，Prefix Replay(Full)与Streaming(Stream)下，4B和8B模型分别达41.9/36.4与44.9/38.2 Gaussian Precision Accuracy；8B较Counting-SFT提升10.9/3.2分。
AI.conclusion: 匹配图比较分离相位条件与轨迹监督，评估训练目标与硬决策；在线视频基准与计数条件决策验证在线理解与任务资格。

title: Automated Species Identification in Camera Trap Images for Wildlife Conservation
comment: 52 pages. B.Sc. thesis, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Brac University, June 2025
summary: Wildlife conservation involves protecting, preserving, and managing wildlife species and their habitats. With today's rapid pace of human development, climate change, and other unsustainable practices, the need for wildlife conservation has heightened. Despite significant progress in species identification using deep-learning models, significant challenges still remain in effectively detecting small animals in low-contrast trap images due to limited feature extraction capabilities. This thesis presents a novel end-to-end framework integrating a self-attention mechanism to address these limitations. The proposed architecture involves a Swin-BiFPN backbone integrated in a Faster RCNN detection network, coupled with a visual semantic extraction module driven by the LLaVA v1.5 (13B) multimodal large language model. The detection framework, capable of extracting crucial features in challenging trap images, demonstrates consistently high results and robust generalization capabilities. Furthermore, the visual semantic extraction module provides zero-shot detection capability, as well as providing valuable insights and emergent cues of the animal's behavior, further supporting the conservation effort. The MLLM evaluation was conducted using both traditional NLP metrics (precision, recall, F1, and SBERT similarity) and subjective scoring by LLM-based judges (GPT-4.1 and GROK 3.0), across five MLLMs, demonstrating the model's strong performance in visual description generation. The proposed framework improves detection accuracy across low-contrast trap images and small animals while also demonstrating zero-shot detection capability leveraging the MLLM.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个端到端野生动物保护框架：以Swin-BiFPN为骨干集成于Faster R-CNN检测网络，并耦合由LLaVA v1.5(13B)驱动的视觉语义提取模块，在低对比度红外陷阱图像及小型动物检测上提升精度，并借助多模态大模型实现零样本检测与动物行为语义描述。
AI.motivation: 野生动物保护需保护与管理物种及其栖息地，而人类开发、气候变化与不可持续实践加剧了保护需求。尽管深度学习在物种识别上进展显著，但在低对比度陷阱图像中检测小型动物仍受限于特征提取能力不足，效果欠佳。
AI.method: 构建端到端框架：检测部分在Faster R-CNN中引入Swin-BiFPN骨干并集成自注意力机制以增强特征提取；语义部分为基于LLaVA v1.5(13B)多模态大语言模型的视觉语义提取模块。评估上，对五个MLLM采用传统NLP指标（精确率、召回率、F1、SBERT相似度）与LLM裁判（GPT-4.1、GROK 3.0）主观打分相结合的方式。
AI.result: 检测框架在困难陷阱图像上取得稳定且较高的检测结果，具备良好泛化能力；视觉语义提取模块实现零样本检测能力，并输出有价值的动物行为洞察与涌现线索；在五个MLLM的视觉描述生成评测中表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架同时提升了低对比度陷阱图像与小型动物的检测精度，并借助MLLM实现零样本检测，可为野生动物保护工作提供支持。

title: Semantic Prefix Oracles for LLM Decoding: Contracts and Differential Validation
summary: Constrained decoding can enforce regular or context-free output formats, but many program-generation failures are semantic: scope, typing, and declaration effects depend on context. We present semantic grammar specifications, a declarative formalism that attaches such constraints to a context-free surface and executes them during Earley descent. Our implementation enforces \emph{safe pruning}: it rejects only prefixes whose semantic contradictions cannot be repaired by any continuation. A separate, grammar-dependent, \emph{dead-end freedom} property guarantees the existence of a realizable witness for each remaining branch. We give simple sufficient conditions based on surface productivity, type coverage, and left-to-right constraint flow. Our finite-lambda, core ML, and C-like fragments satisfy them, while the STLC instance used in our experiments does not: plain STLC can violate type coverage, and we show how restricting its type universe recovers it. A tokenizer-lifting lemma carries character-level witnesses to token sequences under an explicit vocabulary-coverage hypothesis. We validate the implementation differentially against production compilers (\texttt{ocamlc}, \texttt{cc}). Across every prefix of 65 compiler-valid programs we observe zero false prunes. The semantic oracle localizes 25/30 invalid programs mid-stream, against 0/30 for a syntax-only oracle, and agrees on 42/42 recursion probes. A twelve-model generation study, including a matched semantic-versus-syntactic ablation for nine models, finds nonnegative observed semantic-minus-syntactic point estimates for every model-language pair, with maxima of $+15.2$ points on STLC task correctness and $+14.3$ points on ML validity.

AI.tldr: 提出"语义文法规范"(semantic grammar specifications),将作用域、类型、声明等语义约束挂载到上下文无关表层文法上,并在Earley下降过程中执行;实现保证安全剪枝(只拒绝不可修复的语义矛盾前缀),给出死胡同自由的充分条件,并在编译器和生成实验中验证。
AI.motivation: 受约束解码能强制正则或上下文无关的输出格式,但许多程序生成失败是语义性的:作用域、类型与声明效果依赖上下文,仅靠句法约束无法排除这类错误。
AI.method: 提出语义文法规范这一声明式形式化,把语义约束附加到上下文无关表层并在Earley下降中执行。实现强制"安全剪枝",仅拒绝无法由任何续接修复的语义矛盾前缀;另设依赖文法的"死胡同自由"性质,保证剩余分支存在可实现见证。给出基于表层可产生性、类型覆盖与从左到右约束流的充分条件;有限lambda、核心ML与类C片段满足之,而实验所用STLC实例因违反类型覆盖而不满足,通过限制其类型论域恢复。另有tokenizer提升引理,在显式词表覆盖假设下把字符级见证提升为token序列。
AI.result: 与生产编译器(ocamlc、cc)做差分验证:在65个编译器有效程序的每个前缀上零误剪枝。语义oracle在25/30个无效程序中流中定位错误,句法oracle为0/30;递归探针42/42一致。12模型生成研究(含9个模型的语义对句法匹配消融)显示所有模型-语言对的语义减句法点估计非负,最大提升为STLC任务正确率+15.2点、ML有效率+14.3点。
AI.conclusion: 语义约束可在解码时安全执行而不损失有效性,显著优于纯句法oracle与纯句法约束解码,为语义感知的程序生成提供了可证明安全性与实证收益兼备的框架。

title: Frontier Learning: Training LLM Reasoners at the Edge of Capability
summary: Reinforcement Learning-based post-training of Large Language Models (LLM) has been successfully applied to improve their reasoning capabilities. Existing pipelines primarily finetune LLMs on a fixed pool of problems specified prior to training using the GRPO loss. This is fundamentally limiting, as learning signal arises only when policy rollouts mix successes and failures, causing the useful portion of any fixed pool to quickly become stale as the model improves. To address this, we propose frontier learning, an open-ended post-training approach in which procedural generators are used online to continually produce informative training problems. It treats the generator's task-specific parameters as a search space and uses a regret signal to prioritize and explore frontier difficulty levels in order to focus training at the edge of the model's evolving reasoning capabilities. Across several reasoning tasks and model families, our approach consistently achieves higher relative gains over fixed-pool baselines, demonstrating that effective post-training requires not only selecting useful problems, but continually generating them at the edge of capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"前沿学习"（frontier learning），一种开放式后训练方法，利用程序化生成器在线持续生成有信息量的训练问题，并通过遗憾信号优先探索模型能力边缘的难度水平，从而在多项推理任务上稳定超越固定问题池基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习（如GRPO损失）的大模型后训练主要依赖训练前固定的问题池进行微调。这一做法存在根本局限：学习信号仅在策略采样（rollout）同时出现成功与失败时才产生，因此随着模型能力提升，固定问题池中有效部分会迅速"过时"（stale），难以持续提供有用训练信号。
AI.method: 提出frontier learning的开放式后训练范式：在线使用程序化生成器（procedural generators）持续产生有信息量的问题。将生成器的任务特定参数视为搜索空间，并引入遗憾（regret）信号来优先排序与探索处于"前沿"（frontier）的难度水平，从而将训练聚焦于模型当前推理能力边缘。
AI.result: 在多种推理任务与多个模型家族上，该方法相较于固定问题池基线，一致性地取得更高的相对增益（relative gains）。
AI.conclusion: 有效的后训练不仅需要"选择"有用问题，还需在模型能力边缘"持续生成"问题，验证了开放式在线生成范式的必要性。

title: LLMs are General Asynchronous Agents
summary: Modern LLMs are increasingly capable as autonomous agents, but they follow sequential interaction cycles: read, think, reply or call tools, repeat. Many real-world use cases are not sequential: voice assistants, embodied agents, and monitoring systems receive new inputs while they think or perform another task. Modern LLMs address this with specialized architectures for voice interaction and video streams, VLAs for robot control, asynchronous tool calling for API usage, and others. In this work, we generalize from different asynchronous tasks to general asynchronous agents that can adapt to different types of concurrency. To achieve this, we develop an asynchronous LLM framework that lets users (or the agents themselves) define inference coroutines with overlapping memory states. We showcase that Qwen 3.x models are capable of asynchronous operation for streaming video understanding, videogames, and monitoring, without task-specific training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出通用异步LLM智能体框架，让用户或智能体自定义具有重叠内存状态的推理协程，使Qwen 3.x模型无需任务特定训练即可处理流式视频理解、电子游戏和监控等异步任务。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体遵循“读取—思考—回复或调用工具”的串行交互循环，难以应对语音助手、具身智能、监控系统等新输入在思考或执行任务时到达的真实场景。当前虽有面向语音、视频流、机器人控制、异步API调用等的专用架构，但缺乏能适应多种并发类型的通用异步智能体方案。
AI.method: 从不同异步任务中抽象出通用异步智能体，构建异步LLM框架，允许用户或智能体自身定义带有重叠内存状态（overlapping memory states）的推理协程（inference coroutines），以支持不同类型的并发。
AI.result: 实验表明，Qwen 3.x模型在无需任务特定训练的情况下，能够完成流式视频理解、电子游戏和监控等场景的异步操作。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将专用异步架构推广为通用异步智能体框架，验证了通用LLM具备原生异步并发能力，为面向连续输入的智能体设计提供了统一路径。

title: An integrated geometric quantification and shape analysis framework for axillary lymph node metastasis in breast cancer patients
summary: Quantitative characterization of lymph node morphology is important for assessing axillary lymph node metastasis in breast cancer. However, surfaces reconstructed from computed tomography (CT) segmentation may contain geometric and topological defects that compromise subsequent analysis, while conventional shape descriptors predominantly characterize global morphology. To address these issues, we developed an integrated framework combining topology-aware surface processing with multi-resolution spherical harmonic (SH) analysis of CT-derived axillary lymph nodes. The processing pipeline produced topology-valid genus-0 surfaces with improved mesh quality, which were then represented at multiple SH degrees and characterized using 20 predefined geometric feature families. Geometric fidelity increased with SH degree, whereas predictive performance peaked at intermediate resolutions. Preferred SH degree also differed across feature families. A family-specific mixed-resolution model achieved an AUC of 0.918, compared with 0.884 for the conventional PyRadiomics Shape14 baseline, corresponding to an improvement of 0.0344. Controlled perturbation experiments showed that higher SH degrees transmitted more fine-scale geometric variation and yielded lower stability of curvature-based predictions. Representative geometric descriptors provided interpretable characterization of metastasis-associated surface morphology. Independent validation further supported the framework's transportability: label-free replication in a multicenter lymph node cohort reproduced the family-specific resolution effects, while a labeled LIDC-IDRI lung-nodule experiment reproduced the resolution-dependent relationship between SH degree and predictive performance. Altogether, the framework provides a topology-valid basis for quantitative characterization of lymph node morphology and metastasis-associated imaging phenotypes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结合拓扑感知表面处理与多分辨率球谐（SH）分析的框架，用于CT衍生的腋窝淋巴结形态定量刻画及转移预测。
AI.motivation: CT分割重建的淋巴结表面常存在几何与拓扑缺陷，影响后续分析；而传统形状描述子多仅刻画整体形态，难以捕捉多尺度几何信息。
AI.method: 构建集成框架：先对CT分割表面进行拓扑感知处理，生成拓扑有效、属（genus）为0且网格质量更优的表面；再在多档SH阶数下表示表面，并用20类预定义几何特征族进行刻画；进一步构建按特征族分配分辨率的混合分辨率模型，并通过受控扰动实验、无标签多中心淋巴结队列复现及LIDC-IDRI肺结节实验进行验证。
AI.result: SH阶数升高时几何保真度提升，但预测性能在中等分辨率达到峰值；不同特征族的偏好SH阶数不同。特征族混合分辨率模型AUC达0.918，优于PyRadiomics Shape14基线（0.884），提升0.0344。更高SH阶数传递更多细尺度几何变化，但基于曲率的预测稳定性下降。代表性几何描述子可解释转移相关表面形态；独立验证支持框架可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为淋巴结形态与转移相关影像表型的定量刻画提供了拓扑有效的基础。

title: Revision, Not Restart: Revisable Visual Plans for Closed-Loop World-Action Models
summary: World-action models use predicted visual futures to condition robot actions, yet execution feedback can invalidate parts of a prediction while leaving its task structure useful. We propose Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP), which maintains the visual future as a persistent action condition and revises it after feedback. Its central mechanism is a learned revision bridge: it resumes an intermediate state saved during visual generation and adapts its continuation to current observations. Visual and action supervision connect this revision to subsequent control. Time-aware history supplies observed evidence, and an adaptive policy selects retention, bridge revision, or fresh replanning from new noise before decoding the next action. On RoboMME and RMBench, RTP achieves task-averaged success rates of 48.6% and 84.8%, respectively. Matched comparisons support learned continuation; estimated checkpoint-source and action-prefix effects are positive but less precisely resolved. These results connect feedback-driven visual-plan revision to closed-loop task performance. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/RTP/

AI.tldr: 提出可修订时序规划（RTP），将预测的视觉未来作为持续的动作条件，并通过学习式"修订桥"在反馈后对预测进行中途续写与修正；在 RoboMME 和 RMBench 上分别取得 48.6% 和 84.8% 的平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型依赖预测的视觉未来来约束机器人动作，但执行反馈往往会使部分预测失效，然而预测中的任务结构仍然有用。现有方法缺乏在保留有用任务结构的同时、依据反馈对视觉未来进行局部修订的机制。
AI.method: RTP 把视觉未来维持为持久的动作条件，并在获得反馈后修订。核心机制是学习式修订桥：从视觉生成过程中保存的中间状态恢复，并将其后续生成适配当前观测；通过视觉与动作监督将修订与后续控制相连；引入时间感知历史提供观测证据；由自适应策略根据新的噪声在"保留、桥接修订、重新规划"三者间选择，再解码下一步动作。
AI.result: 在 RoboMME 与 RMBench 上任务平均成功率分别为 48.6% 与 84.8%；匹配对比实验支持学习式续写的有效性；对检查点来源与动作前缀效应的估计为正，但精度较低、置信度不足。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将反馈驱动的视觉规划修订与闭环任务性能联系起来，证明在保留任务结构的基础上进行局部修订优于完全重规划或完全沿用，为世界-动作模型提供了可修订的时序规划范式。

title: DiMoP: Diffusion-Driven Motion Representation Learning With Frame-Level Pseudo-Classification for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
comment: Accepted to IEEE TRANSACTIONS ON BIOMETRICS, BEHAVIOR, AND IDENTITY SCIENCE
summary: Robust skeleton-based action recognition requires representations that capture a wide spectrum of motions, from subtle to moderate and strong ones. Existing methods often focus on strong motions. This paper introduces DiMoP, a masking- and diffusion-driven motion representation learning method with frame-level pseudo-classification to explicitly learn the distribution of joint motions rather than regressing deterministic coordinates, as existing methods often do. By diffusing masked joints with progressive noise and denoising them conditioned on visible joints, DiMoP learns through controllable noising and denoising processes, enabling uniform learning of weak, moderate, and strong dynamics. To enable the masking-based generative diffusion learning with a discriminative capability, a pseudo-frame classifier is proposed that enforces the learning towards sequence-consistent and temporally coherent pseudo-labels without manual annotations. Together, these strategies provide a principled mechanism for joint generative and discriminative motion modeling. DiMoP achieves state-of-the-art performance across NTU RGB+D 60/120, and PKUMMD, including a 1.1 percentage point gain over prior works on NTU RGB+D 120 with the cross-subject protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DiMoP，一种基于掩码与扩散驱动的骨架动作表示学习方法，通过帧级伪分类显式建模关节运动分布而非回归确定性坐标，在 NTU RGB+D 60/120 和 PKUMMD 上取得 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒的骨架动作识别需要能够刻画从细微、中等到剧烈各类运动的表示；而现有方法往往只关注剧烈运动，且倾向于回归确定性坐标，难以均匀覆盖整个运动谱系。
AI.method: DiMoP 对掩码关节施加渐进噪声进行扩散，并以可见关节为条件进行去噪，通过可控的加噪与去噪过程实现生成式建模；同时引入伪帧分类器，在无人工标注下构造序列一致、时间连贯的伪标签，从而在生成式扩散学习中融入判别能力，实现关节的生成式与判别式运动建模。
AI.result: 在 NTU RGB+D 60/120 与 PKUMMD 上均达到 SOTA；在 NTU RGB+D 120 的跨被试协议下相较此前工作提升 1.1 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过在掩码扩散框架中联合生成式与判别式建模，DiMoP 能够统一学习弱、中、强动态，为骨架动作识别提供了一种原则性的运动表示学习机制。

title: From internal representations to model improvement through prediction errors
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Supplementary Information is provided as an ancillary file
summary: With limited annotation budgets, choosing which images to label determines how much a model improves. Data-selection methods that use features from a separately trained model, or scene descriptions written by vision-language models, have been successful, but those signals do not directly capture changes in the model being improved. The target model's own internal features reflect what it has learned so far and change with retraining, making them a natural cue for choosing the next training data. However, feature rarity alone does not reveal the errors that matter for performance. Here we link internal features to prediction errors and their expected impact on performance and select images for labeling and retraining without using labels for candidate images. We evaluated the method with an object detector on two datasets and two pairs of random seeds. Adding internal features improved the identification of prediction errors in 15 of 16 conditions. When performance was averaged over successive labeling rounds, the method outperformed selection based only on feature rarity in all four evaluation settings and ranked among the top two of six methods. With other conditions held fixed, performance after retraining was again higher than with rarity-based selection, even though the latter collected more errors. With longer retraining, the proposed method ranked first among six methods. These results suggest that linking a model's internal features to its errors and their effects on performance may help select training images that improve performance, thereby allowing the model's current state to guide which images are labeled next.

AI.tldr: 提出将目标模型内部特征与预测误差及其对性能的预期影响相链接的数据选择方法，在无候选图像标签的条件下挑选标注样本，实验表明其优于仅基于特征稀有度的选择。
AI.motivation: 在有限标注预算下，选择哪些图像进行标注决定模型提升幅度。既有方法依赖单独训练模型的特征或视觉语言模型的场景描述，这些信号不能直接反映被改进模型自身的变化；而目标模型内部特征随再训练变化，是自然的选样线索，但仅凭特征稀有度无法揭示对性能重要的错误。
AI.method: 将模型内部特征与预测误差及其对性能的预期影响相链接，在候选图像不使用标签的情况下完成图像选择与再训练。
AI.result: 在目标检测器、两个数据集和两对随机种子上评估：内部特征在16种条件中的15种提升了预测误差识别；连续标注轮次平均性能在全部4种设置下优于仅基于特征稀有度的方法，并在6种方法中位列前二；固定其他条件时再训练后性能仍更高，尽管稀有度方法收集到更多错误；更长的再训练下，所提方法在6种方法中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 将模型内部特征与其误差及误差对性能的影响相链接，有助于选择能提升性能的训练图像，从而让模型当前状态指导下一批图像的标注。

title: How Far Are We from Removing the Visual Encoder? Scaling Laws for Encoder-Free Multimodal Pretraining
summary: Most modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) build on a pretrained visual encoder that provides a strong visual prior. Encoder-free MLLMs instead learn visual representations directly from raw pixels, offering a simple and unified architecture, but their scaling behavior has not been systematically characterized. To fill this gap, we compare scaling laws for encoder-free and encoder-based MLLMs and report three main findings: (1) Removing the visual encoder shifts the compute-optimal allocation for the multimodal objective toward larger models, while leaving that for text nearly unchanged. (2) The two architectures exhibit nearly overlapping loss--compute frontiers on the text objective, but diverge on the multimodal objective: encoder-free models underperform at small scales yet are predicted to catch up at around $10^{22}$ FLOPs, well within practical pretraining budgets. (3) Without a visual encoder, the language model learns to take over its role via vision-specific adaptation: bidirectional interactions among visual tokens become increasingly beneficial as training compute grows, visual processing shifts toward earlier layers, and expert routing for visual tokens becomes more concentrated. Overall, our results indicate that the advantage of the visual prior provided by a pretrained encoder diminishes with scale, positioning encoder-free architectures as a promising direction for multimodal pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文系统对比了无编码器（encoder-free）与基于编码器（encoder-based）多模态大模型的缩放规律，发现视觉先验的优势随规模增长而减弱。
AI.motivation: 无编码器MLLM直接从原始像素学习视觉表示，架构简单统一，但其缩放行为尚未被系统刻画。本文旨在填补这一空白，厘清两者在缩放规律上的差异。
AI.method: 对比无编码器与基于编码器MLLM的缩放规律，从计算最优分配、损失-计算前沿（loss-compute frontier）以及语言模型对视觉编码器角色的接管机制（视觉token双向交互、视觉处理层位置、专家路由集中度）等角度进行分析。
AI.result: (1) 移除视觉编码器使多模态目标的计算最优分配转向更大模型，而对文本目标几乎无影响；(2) 两者在文本目标上损失-计算前沿几乎重合，但在多模态目标上分化——无编码器模型在小规模下表现较弱，但预计在约10^22 FLOPs处追平；(3) 无编码器时语言模型通过视觉特异性适应接管其角色：随计算增长，视觉token间双向交互愈发有益，视觉处理前移至更早层，视觉token的专家路由更集中。
AI.conclusion: 预训练编码器所提供的视觉先验优势随规模增长而减弱，无编码器架构是多模态预训练的一个有前景的方向。

title: AraDynFact: Dynamic Evaluation of Factual Knowledge in Arabic
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to scale both in size and capabilities, their proficiency in the Arabic Language has seen significant advancement. However, a critical gap remains: the extent of their factual knowledge and cultural sensitivity to the diverse Arabic-speaking world remains largely underexplored. Current evaluation metrics often focus on translation or generic reasoning, failing to capture the rich historical, social, and regional nuances inherent to Arabic culture. In addition, most benchmarks rely on heavy work, with human intervention in some steps, making the evaluation of knowledge coverage expensive and slow. To address this deficiency, we introduce AraDynFact, a novel dynamic evaluation framework designed to rigorously assess the factual Arabic knowledge embedded in LLMs. Unlike static benchmarks, AraDynFact employs a dynamic approach to extract factual information and generate rich and answerable questions in a fast and automatic way. We apply AraDynFact to Arabic Wikipedia and audit the performance of several state-of-the-art models, ranging from Arabic-centric specialized LLMs to high-resource general purpose LLMs. In addition we found a high degree of correlation with existing, hand-crafted Arabic-centric benchmarks, confirming the potential of our dynamic approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AraDynFact——一个动态、自动化的阿拉伯语事实知识评估框架，用于弥补现有大模型阿拉伯语文化知识评测的不足。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型规模与能力提升，其阿拉伯语水平显著进步，但对其在阿拉伯世界多样文化下的事实知识与文化敏感度的评测仍严重不足。现有指标多聚焦翻译或通用推理，难以捕捉阿拉伯文化中历史、社会与区域细节；同时基准多依赖人工干预，导致知识覆盖评测昂贵且缓慢。
AI.method: 提出 AraDynFact 动态评估框架：不同于静态基准，它采用动态方式自动、快速地抽取事实信息并生成丰富且可回答的问题，并将其应用于阿拉伯语维基百科进行评测。
AI.result: 在阿拉伯语维基百科上对多种先进模型（从阿拉伯语专用模型到高资源通用模型）进行评测，发现与现有手工构建的阿拉伯语基准具有高度相关性，验证了动态方法的潜力。
AI.conclusion: AraDynFact 为阿拉伯语事实知识评测提供了一种高效、自动且可扩展的动态方案，并显示出替代或补充手工基准的潜力。

title: CLIMB: A Clinical Multimorbidity Benchmark for Diagnosing Co-occurring Conditions through Multiturn Conversations
comment: 52 pages (9 main text), 23 figures, 22 tables. Preprint
summary: Patients often have several co-occurring clinical conditions, and the findings needed to identify and disambiguate them emerge over the course of a consultation. Evaluating clinical reasoning in this setting requires both multi-turn interaction and multi-label diagnosis. We introduce CLIMB, a benchmark in which a doctor model interviews a simulated patient to recover a ground truth set of co-occurring clinical conditions. Cases are synthesized from clinical decision algorithms and diagnostic datasets, grounding multimorbid presentations in structured clinical knowledge. Across six frontier and open models, none recovers the exact set of conditions in more than 10% of interactive cases. Diagnostic performance declines when conditions co-occur, even when models receive the full clinical record and the true number of conditions. Interaction reduces performance further. In controlled experiments, models behave like single-hypothesis trackers: they anchor on the diagnosis suggested by the opening findings, keep questioning around it, and recover a second condition mainly when a finding in view points to it. Questioning them further does not complete the set but adds mostly wrong diagnoses. We formalise this pattern with a theoretical reference model of single-hypothesis tracking. The benchmark, generator, and evaluation code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CLIMB-8340.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CLIMB 基准，用于评估多轮问诊与多标签诊断下的临床推理能力。基于临床决策算法与诊断数据集合成共病病例，测试六个前沿与开源模型，发现无模型能在超过 10% 的交互病例中完整还原真实共病集合，交互与共病均会进一步降低诊断性能，模型表现为单假设追踪模式。
AI.motivation: 真实临床场景中患者常同时患有多种共病，且识别与区分这些病症所需的信息是随问诊过程逐步显现的。现有评估缺少同时考察多轮交互与多标签诊断的基准，难以衡量模型在共病情境下的临床推理能力。
AI.method: 构建 CLIMB 基准：由医生模型与模拟患者进行多轮问诊，以还原真实共病集合。病例由临床决策算法与诊断数据集合成，将共病表现建立在结构化临床知识之上。对六个前沿及开源模型进行评估，并设计受控实验，提出单假设追踪的理论参考模型来形式化观察到的行为模式。
AI.result: 六个模型中，没有一个能在超过 10% 的交互病例中完整还原真实共病集合。共病共存时诊断性能下降，即便模型获得完整病历与真实病症数量亦如此；引入交互后性能进一步降低。受控实验中，模型表现为单假设追踪：锚定于初始发现提示的诊断，围绕其持续提问，主要当当前所见发现指向第二种病症时才能发现它；继续追问不会补全诊断集合，反而引入更多错误诊断。
AI.conclusion: 多轮交互与多标签共病诊断对现有模型构成显著挑战，模型普遍呈现单假设追踪而非多假设并行推理。作者提出的理论参考模型可刻画该模式，基准、生成器与评估代码已开源。

title: W2Rep: Learning Visual Representations by Watching the World Change
summary: Images capture the world at one moment, whereas video reveals how it changes. Image self-supervision learns spatial structure from a single moment, while video methods commonly learn temporal relationships inside a representation computed jointly from several frames. We ask whether watching a scene change can instead improve features available from one image without sacrificing the ability to represent video. We introduce W2Rep, a masked feature-prediction framework in which an independently encoded source image participates in prediction at the same or another moment. The predictor is conditioned on visible video context, the queried location, and the signed time interval between source and target. This gives the cross-frame objective two complementary roles: the image path learns features that remain useful across time, while the video path must gather evidence that is missing from the source image. Across model scales and downstream tasks, W2Rep improves frozen and fine-tuned recognition under our comparison protocol, while joint video encoding provides further gains over frame-wise aggregation. Controlled experiments show that these gains depend on directly updating the source-image features and on using both video context and temporal displacement.
