Across nine LLMs, plot premises are recovered more reliably than event-complete synopses; cross-lingual consistency varies substantially across models and languages; national rating systems expose distinct calibration patterns; and strong profanity is far easier to ground than mild obscenity. CineSubBench establishes film as a long-context LLM evaluation domain and provides a unified benchmark for measuring narrative, multilingual, cultural, and evidence-grounding capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CineSubBench，一个基于多语言电影字幕的长上下文理解基准，包含1,012部电影、6种语言、6,072条字幕轨和813万条时间戳字幕条目，设置七项多任务多语言多文化评测，评估九个LLM的叙事重建、跨语言一致性、国家分级校准及语言安全性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型已在法律、医学、软件工程、网络安全等专业领域被广泛评测，但电影领域相对未被充分探索。电影理解需要长篇叙事整合、多语言解释以及文化情境化的受众判断，字幕轨道以数千条短小、按时间排序的话语呈现电影，模型需在缺乏显式场景与事件结构的情况下重建角色、关系、事件、因果进程与主题，因此亟需专门基准。
AI.method: 构建CineSubBench基准：收录1,012部电影，具备六种语言的完整字幕覆盖，共6,072条字幕轨、8.13M条带时间戳字幕条目。设计匹配的多任务、多语言、多文化（MultiX）评测设置，七项任务涵盖叙事重建与抽象、类型预测、年龄适宜性、跨十国国家电影分级系统的国别分级预测，以及基于字幕的语言安全性。
AI.result: 在九个LLM上评测发现：剧情概要（plot premises）的恢复比事件完整的梗概更可靠；跨语言一致性在不同模型和语言间差异显著；各国分级系统暴露出不同的校准模式；强烈粗俗语比轻度淫秽内容更易被证据定位（grounding）。
AI.conclusion: CineSubBench确立了电影作为长上下文LLM评测领域，并提供统一基准以衡量叙事、多语言、文化及证据定位能力。

title: LeRF: Learning Reference Coordinate Frames for Perspective Taking Reasoning
summary: Perspective taking is a fundamental component of spatial intelligence, requiring models interpret spatial relations from a specified viewpoint, such as that of another entity or an imagined observer. Despite the increasing spatial reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), they still struggle with perspective taking, often defaulting to the camera viewpoint when a query requires reasoning from a different perspective. We introduce Learning Reference Coordinate Frames for Perspective Taking (LeRF), a framework that trains VLMs to construct and use explicit reference frames for viewpoint-dependent reasoning. Given an image and a query, LeRF decides whether a coordinate frame is necessary. If so, it grounds the reference entity and predicts the frame's origin and entity-centered reference frame. A lightweight renderer overlays the frame onto the image, enabling subsequent reasoning over these visual cues without external perception models or explicit 3D reconstruction. To learn this process, we first perform supervised fine-tuning to teach selective tool invocation and reference coordinate frame prediction, followed by reinforcement learning on spatial VQA pairs to improve frame-guided reasoning. Across diverse perspective-taking benchmarks, LeRF consistently improves over its backbone and achieves strong performance against existing open-source methods. Further evaluations also show improved reference-frame grounding and orientation estimation, supporting the effectiveness of learned reference frames for viewpoint-dependent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出LeRF框架，训练VLM构建并使用显式参考坐标系来完成视角采择推理，通过监督微调与强化学习两阶段训练，在多个基准上超越骨干模型及开源方法。
AI.motivation: 视角采择是空间智能的核心能力，要求模型从指定视角（如其他实体或想象观察者）解读空间关系。然而现有视觉语言模型（VLM）在视角采择任务上仍表现不佳，当查询需要从非相机视角推理时，模型往往默认采用相机视角，缺乏显式的坐标系来支撑视角依赖的推理。
AI.method: 提出LeRF（Learning Reference Coordinate Frames for Perspective Taking）框架。给定图像和查询，模型首先判断是否需要坐标系；若需要，则定位参考实体，并预测该坐标系的原点及以实体为中心的参考坐标系。随后由一个轻量级渲染器将该坐标系叠加到图像上，使后续推理可基于这些视觉线索进行，无需外部感知模型或显式3D重建。训练上采用两阶段：先监督微调，教会模型选择性调用工具并预测参考坐标系；再基于空间VQA对进行强化学习，提升由坐标系引导的推理能力。
AI.result: 在多个视角采择基准上，LeRF相较其骨干模型稳定提升，并在与现有开源方法的对比中取得较强表现。进一步评估显示，模型在参考坐标系定位和朝向估计方面也有所改善，验证了学习到的参考坐标系对视角依赖推理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LeRF通过让VLM显式构建并使用实体中心的参考坐标系，有效缓解了模型默认采用相机视角的问题，为视角采择及视角依赖的空间推理提供了一种无需3D重建、可端到端学习的可行方案。

title: Mutually Adversarial Self-Training with Evolving Data for Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) combine image generation and visual understanding in a shared backbone. Since generation and understanding are inverse tasks, recent studies self-train UMMs by letting the two branches cooperatively supervise each other. We introduce MATE (Mutually Adversarial self-Training with Evolving data), a reinforcement-learning-based post-training framework in which the two branches instead challenge each other, and the challenges evolve as the model trains. MATE lets generation and understanding take turns to be challenger and solver. Given an image, the understanding branch proposes several candidate descriptions that the generation branch must turn back into similar images, and vice versa. The candidates are screened for consistency with the image or prompt they were proposed from, and the solver is trained on the candidate it handles worst. The adversary thus comes from the model's own outputs, and no separate adversary is trained. Moreover, the candidates that defeat one branch become the sources of the next challenges to the other in the next epoch, which keeps the challenges evolving with the model and turns the training into self-play in data space. On Janus-Pro-1B, MATE improves GenEval by 2.4 points, DPG-Bench by 1.7 points, and the average over nine understanding benchmarks by 0.7 points, while strengthening consistency across repeated image-text cycles.

AI.tldr: MATE是一种基于强化学习的统一多模态模型后训练框架，让生成与理解两个分支互相对抗、轮流充当挑战者与解题者，并借助自产出的候选样本形成数据空间自博弈，从而同步提升生成与理解性能。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）将图像生成与视觉理解置于共享主干中，二者本质互为逆任务。既有工作多让两分支"协作式"相互监督以自训练，但缺乏对抗性张力，挑战不会随训练演化。本文动机在于把协作监督改为互相对抗，并让挑战随模型能力动态进化，从而获得更有效的后训练信号，且无需额外训练独立对抗者。
AI.method: 提出MATE（Mutually Adversarial self-Training with Evolving data）强化学习后训练框架。生成和理解分支轮流充当挑战者（challenger）与解题者（solver）：给定图像，理解分支提出若干候选描述，生成分支须据此还原出相似图像；反向亦然。候选需先经过一致性筛选（与所依据的图像或提示词保持一致），解题者仅在最难处理的候选上接受训练。对抗信号来源于模型自身输出，不训练单独对抗者。被击败分支所产生的候选成为下一轮对另一分支的挑战源，形成数据空间自博弈，使挑战随模型演化。
AI.result: 在Janus-Pro-1B上，MATE使GenEval提升2.4分，DPG-Bench提升1.7分，九个理解基准的平均分提升0.7分，同时增强了重复图像—文本循环中的一致性。
AI.conclusion: MATE表明，将UMM中生成与理解两分支的协作式自监督改造为随训练演化的对抗式自博弈，可在不引入独立对抗模块的前提下同时改善图像生成与视觉理解，并提升跨轮次循环一致性，为统一多模态模型后训练提供了一种有效范式。

title: One-Step Next-Latent Prediction Is Not a World Model
summary: Next-latent prediction fits a map from the current embedding to the next one. LeNEPA carries this objective to time series, replacing the stop-gradient of next-embedding prediction with the isotropy penalty of LeJEPA. A world model is a transition kernel that can be rolled out. The one-step regression identifies a conditional mean, and a mean is a kernel only in special cases. For a linear-Gaussian Markov latent, the mean transition and the innovation covariance are fixed by the one-step problem, and the open-loop squared error at horizon $K$ equals the trace of the sum of the pushed-forward innovation covariances. That error grows with $K$ after the one-step fit is exact. If the conditional mean is nonlinear, composing it is not the multi-step conditional mean. If the observation is a non-injective function of a Markov state, a memoryless one-step map does not determine future observations, while a short window can. An isotropy penalty is a function of the embedding marginal, so its partial derivative in the transition weights is zero. On a scalar autoregression with coefficient $0.9$, the one-step mean squared error is $0.998$ and the $16$-step open-loop error is $5.10$. On a hidden rotation, an eight-step window reaches $16$-step error $0.056$, while the current scalar alone reaches $0.778$. Raising the isotropy weight from $0.1$ to $10$ leaves eight-step latent error inside $[0.78,0.85]$ on three seeds.

AI.tldr: 本文分析LeNEPA（将LeJEPA的各向同性惩罚用于时间序列的下一隐变量预测）的理论缺陷，指出单步条件均值回归不能推广为可滚动的世界模型，并给出理论论证与实验结果。
AI.motivation: 下一隐变量预测将当前嵌入映射到下一嵌入，LeNEPA把该目标搬到时间序列并用以色列各向同性惩罚替代stop-gradient。但"世界模型"需要能够多步滚动（rollout），而单步回归只识别条件均值，条件均值仅在特殊情形下才是转移核。作者旨在澄清该目标在多步外推、非线性条件均值、非单射观测等情形下的局限性。
AI.method: 理论分析结合实验：(1) 线性-高斯马尔可夫隐变量下，单步问题固定了均值转移与新生协方差，推导K步开环平方误差等于推送前新生协方差之和的迹；(2) 分析非线性条件均值复合不等于多步条件均值；(3) 讨论非单射观测下无记忆单步映射无法确定未来观测；(4) 论证各向同性惩罚仅依赖嵌入边缘分布，其对转移权重的偏导为零。实验：系数0.9的标量自回归、隐旋转任务（8步窗口vs单标量），以及将各向同性权重从0.1提升到10的多随机种子验证。
AI.result: 标量自回归（系数0.9）：单步MSE为0.998，16步开环误差达5.10，误差随K增长。隐旋转任务：8步窗口的16步误差为0.056，而仅用当前标量为0.778。各向同性权重从0.1增至10时，三个随机种子下8步隐变量误差保持在[0.78,0.85]内，几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 单步条件均值回归不足以构成可滚动的世界模型：其一，开环误差随预测步数增长；其二，非线性条件均值复合不产生正确的多步均值；其三，非单射观测下需短窗口而非无记忆单步映射。各向同性惩罚对转移权重梯度为零，表明其不能有效约束转移动力学，对多步预测几乎无影响。

title: Cognitive Expert Language Models Better Align with the Corresponding Brain Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can predict human brain activity across a variety of brain regions during natural language comprehension. Typically, however, LLM-brain alignment is measured using one model for different regions of the brain, and then model performance is summarized across regions. This one-model-fits-all approach ignores the functional specialization of brain regions. In this study, we assess whether a model oriented toward a particular cognitive domain aligns better with the brain system dedicated to that domain. Through prompting and fine-tuning, we first build expert LLM variants for six domains: sensory, spatial, numerical, reasoning, social, and abstract processing. We then examine whether each expert best predicts activity in the brain region associated with the corresponding cognitive domain. Consistent with our hypotheses, each expert's representations align more closely with the brain system most associated with the matching domain than do other experts. This holds under both prompting and fine-tuning, across three base models and three fMRI datasets. In a series of control analyses, we show that this model-brain alignment is specific to cognitive domain interventions; non-cognitive and surface-level interventions do not result in comparable alignment. Specializing models shifts regional alignment while leaving aggregate prediction accuracy largely unchanged, suggesting that summarizing alignment across regions may obscure regional differences in performance for specific models.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过提示与微调构建六个认知领域的专家LLM，发现各领域专家模型与其对应脑区的神经活动对齐更佳，而这种区域特异的对齐在整体预测精度上被掩盖。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-大脑对齐研究普遍采用"一个模型适配所有脑区"的策略，忽视了脑区的功能专门化，因而可能遗漏模型在不同区域上的性能差异。
AI.method: 通过提示（prompting）与微调（fine-tuning），针对感觉、空间、数值、推理、社会、抽象六个认知领域构建专家LLM变体；随后检验各专家模型是否对其对应认知域相关的脑区活动预测最佳。实验覆盖三个基础模型与三个fMRI数据集，并设置对照分析（非认知及表层干预）。
AI.result: 与假设一致，每个专家模型的表征与匹配认知域对应脑系统的对齐程度高于其他专家；该效应在提示与微调两种方式、三个基础模型及三个fMRI数据集下均成立。非认知与表层干预未产生可比的对齐。模型专门化改变了区域对齐，但整体预测精度基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 脑区存在功能专门化，专门化模型会产生区域特异的对齐偏移；仅汇总跨区域的对齐指标可能掩盖特定模型在不同脑区的性能差异，未来评估应关注区域层面的模型-大脑对齐。

title: Think Before You Restore: Risk-Aware Manchu Manuscript Restoration with Stroke-Guided Attention
summary: Full-page blind restoration of historical Manchu manuscripts is challenging due to scarce annotations, unknown degradation regions, and fragile connected strokes. Generic restoration models may improve visual quality but often modify intact content, leading to over-restoration. We propose SAGE-Restore (Stroke-Aware Gated rEstoration), a selective restoration framework that first assesses where restoration is needed and then uses this assessment to guide restoration candidate generation and pixel-level selection. Its encoder predicts patch-level repair probabilities from complementary appearance and stroke-structural cues to condition restoration candidate generation, while the corresponding repair logits are refined into a pixel-level soft gate that selectively controls where the restoration candidate is applied. We further introduce a fidelity-aware evaluation protocol that jointly measures degraded-region recovery, intact-content preservation, and their balance. SAGE-Restore achieves the highest R-Recovery (0.463) and RFS (0.626), while maintaining high U-Fidelity (0.968), demonstrating an effective balance between restoration and content preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAGE-Restore 选择性修复框架，通过块级修复概率与像素级软门控引导修复候选的生成与应用，并结合保真度评估协议，在满文档案整页盲修复中兼顾退化区域恢复与完整内容保留。
AI.motivation: 历史满文手稿整页盲修复面临标注稀缺、退化区域未知以及连笔笔画脆弱等困难；通用修复模型虽能提升视觉质量，却常改动未退化内容，造成过度修复。
AI.method: SAGE-Restore 先评估何处需要修复，再据此引导修复候选生成与像素级选择。编码器从外观与笔画结构互补线索预测块级修复概率，用于条件化修复候选生成；相应修复 logits 被细化为像素级软门控，选择性控制修复候选的应用位置。同时提出保真度感知评估协议，联合度量退化区域恢复、完整内容保留及二者平衡。
AI.result: SAGE-Restore 取得最高 R-Recovery（0.463）与 RFS（0.626），同时保持高 U-Fidelity（0.968），表明在修复与内容保留之间实现了有效平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该选择性修复范式通过“先定位、后修复”的门控机制，缓解了通用模型过度修复问题，为标注稀缺、退化区域未知的历史文档盲修复提供了兼顾恢复与保真的有效方案。

title: Learning from Teacher Continuations at Student States
comment: HW and DZ contributed equally and share the first-authorship. Dylan Zhang is project lead
summary: We present OLIVE (OnLine InterVEntion). At each iteration, the evolving student policy generates a new prefix, the teacher continues it autoregressively, and the student is updated using cross-entropy computed on the teacher-generated tokens. Each design choice targets a corresponding limitation of existing distillation methods: (1) sequential covariate shift in offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on fixed teacher trajectories, (2) fragmented supervision under prefix failure in token-level on-policy distillation (OPD), and (3) the need for access to teacher token probabilities in distribution-matching distillation. OLIVE achieves higher reasoning performance than OPD (with a top-16 KL approximation) at comparable GPU-hour cost. Our asynchronous implementation further reduces OLIVE's total training time by 23.8\%. We evaluate OLIVE on both hard reasoning tasks and agentic tasks which reflects modern post-training scenarios, and it consistently outperforms existing distillation methods under the same training budget. By regenerating prefixes from the evolving student, OLIVE continues improving after offline distillation plateaus while better preserving the general capabilities and plasticity of the student. Using only text from GPT-5.4-mini, continuously training with OLIVE outperforms offline SFT from the same teacher by 13\% on ScienceWorld. These results support OLIVE as an effective and efficient approach to online language-model distillation.

AI.tldr: OLIVE是一种在线蒸馏方法：每轮由学生策略生成前缀，教师自回归续写，学生用教师生成token的交叉熵更新，针对性解决离线SFT的序列协变量偏移、token级OPD的前缀失败监督碎片化以及分布匹配蒸馏需教师token概率三大问题。
AI.motivation: 现有蒸馏方法存在三类局限：(1) 离线SFT在固定教师轨迹上存在序列协变量偏移；(2) token级在线策略蒸馏(OPD)在前缀失败时监督碎片化；(3) 分布匹配蒸馏需访问教师token概率，适用性受限。作者希望提出一种兼顾在线交互优势、且不依赖教师概率的蒸馏范式。
AI.method: OLIVE(OnLine InterVEntion)在每次迭代中由演化中的学生策略生成新前缀，教师对该前缀进行自回归续写，学生随后用教师生成token上的交叉熵损失更新。该方法不依赖教师token概率分布，仅利用教师生成的文本。作者还实现了异步版本以缩短训练时间。
AI.result: OLIVE推理性能高于采用top-16 KL近似的OPD，且GPU小时成本相当；异步实现进一步将总训练时间降低23.8%。在难题推理任务和agentic任务上，相同训练预算下OLIVE持续优于现有蒸馏方法。学生重新生成前缀使其在离线蒸馏平台期后仍能提升，并更好保留通用能力与可塑性。仅用GPT-5.4-mini的文本，在ScienceWorld上持续OLIVE训练比同教师离线SFT高出13%。
AI.conclusion: OLIVE是一种有效且高效的在线语言模型蒸馏方法，通过演化学生生成前缀、教师续写、学生交叉熵更新的循环机制，克服离线SFT与OPD的固有缺陷，在推理与agentic任务上均具优势，并具备更长的持续改进潜力。

title: Population Fidelity: Evaluating Population Representativeness in LLMs
comment: 37 pages, 16 figures, 14 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/CriticalMaking/LLM-population-fidelity
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show considerable potential in simulating human attitudes and preferences. Prior work finds that LLM-generated responses can compress the range of attitudes found within populations and misrepresent particular subgroups in ways that vary across models and topics. We introduce Population Fidelity, an evaluation framework that distinguishes key conditions required for a set of LLM-generated responses to represent a population. It incorporates three dimensions: group-level accuracy, the amount of between-group variation, and the structure of that variation. We demonstrate the framework's utility in two ways. First, we reproduce a prior study of "machine bias" in LLM survey responses and apply the framework to its models and more recent ones, showing that poor representation reflects not only insufficient between-group variation but also variation assigned to the wrong groups. Second, we evaluate one proposed approach to improving models' population representativeness: cultural fine-tuning. We find that cultural fine-tuning can improve alignment with the survey center without improving the representation of within-population differences, a distinction that measures of aggregate agreement do not capture. We argue that representing a population requires models to reproduce several features of human attitudinal variation simultaneously. Our framework organizes these features and provides reusable code, data, and trained models for evaluating population fidelity across substantive domains and assessing proposed alignment methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Population Fidelity"评估框架，从群体均值准确性、组间变异量、变异结构三个维度衡量LLM生成回答对人群态度的表征能力，并通过复现"机器偏见"研究和评估文化微调两种方式展示其价值。
AI.motivation: 已有研究发现LLM生成的回答会压缩人群内部态度分布范围，并会错误表征特定子群体，且这种偏差随模型和主题而变化。现有指标（如聚合一致性）无法说明模型究竟在哪些条件上失败，因此需要一个能区分"人口表征"所需关键条件的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出Population Fidelity框架，包含三个维度：群体层面的准确性（group-level accuracy）、组间变异量（between-group variation）、变异的结构（structure of that variation）。并做两项应用：（1）复现此前的LLM调查回答"机器偏见"研究，将该框架应用于原模型及更新的模型；（2）评估文化微调这一旨在提升模型人口代表性方法的效果。
AI.result: （1）差劲的人口表征不仅源于组间变异不足，还在于变异被分配给了错误的群体；（2）文化微调能提升模型与调查中心的总体对齐程度，但并未改善对人群内部差异的刻画——这一区分是聚合一致性指标无法捕捉的。
AI.conclusion: 表征一个群体要求模型同时复现人类态度变异的多个特征；该框架对这些特征进行了系统组织，并提供可复用的代码、数据和训练好的模型，用于跨实质性领域评估人口保真度及检验各类对齐方法。

title: OTROPE: Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-policy Evaluation for Large Language Models
summary: Reliable evaluation of large language models (LLMs) is essential for their development and deployment, yet is often costly, risky, and difficult to perform safely online. We study off-policy evaluation for LLMs, where limited human-labeled data from a behavior model are used to evaluate a newer target LLM. This setting is challenging because labels are scarce, behavior--target distribution shift is common, and response likelihoods are often unavailable for black-box LLMs. We propose the Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-Policy Evaluation (OTROPE), a likelihood-free evaluation that performs distributional correction in a semantic space via optimal transport to align labeled behavior-policy samples with unlabeled target-policy samples. OTROPE combines corrected human-labeled residuals with proxy predictors, yielding a doubly robust-style evaluation without behavior-policy modeling or density-ratio estimation. We theoretically characterize why baseline evaluators fail under LLM distribution shift, and establish consistency and convergence rates for OTROPE when either the reweighted behavior distribution or the proxy predictor converges. Experiments on synthetic and real LLM evaluation tasks show that OTROPE consistently outperforms baselines while enabling ensembles of weaker LLM evaluators to approach and sometimes surpass stronger evaluators. Code is available at https://github.com/LinerXiang/OTROPE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OTROPE——一种基于最优传输的、无需似然的鲁棒离策略评估方法，用于在标签稀缺、行为-目标分布偏移且黑盒模型似然不可得的情况下评估新一代LLM。
AI.motivation: LLM的可靠评估对其开发与部署至关重要，但在线评估成本高、风险大、难以安全执行。现有离策略评估面临三大挑战：人工标注数据稀缺、行为模型与目标模型的分布偏移普遍、黑盒LLM的响应似然不可得。
AI.method: 提出OTROPE，在语义空间中通过最优传输进行分布校正，将带标注的行为策略样本与无标注的目标策略样本对齐，从而无需似然、无需行为策略建模或密度比估计。方法将校正后的人工标注残差与代理预测器结合，形成双重稳健式评估。
AI.result: 理论上刻画了基线评估器在LLM分布偏移下失效的原因，并在加权行为分布或代理预测器任一方收敛时证明了OTROPE的一致性与收敛速率；在合成与真实LLM评估任务上，OTROPE持续优于基线，且能使较弱LLM评估器的集成逼近甚至超越更强的单一评估器。
AI.conclusion: OTROPE为黑盒LLM提供了实用、鲁棒且无需似然的离策略评估框架，在分布偏移与标签稀缺场景下兼具理论保证与实证优势。

title: In-Context Learning Amplifies a Latent Symbolic Circuit
comment: Accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: Large language models can learn abstract rules from just a few in-context examples, but how their internal mechanisms activate as examples accumulate is not well understood. We trace a three-stage symbolic reasoning circuit (abstraction, induction, retrieval) across shot counts in three model families and find it is detectable and functional well before the model achieves high accuracy. Per-head causal contribution grows up to 8x from 1- to 10-shot, and cross-shot activation patching raises accuracy from 1% to 56% at 0-shot and 17% to 88% at 1-shot. Function vectors scaled and injected at 0-shot rescue accuracy up to 86%, largely substituting for the induction stage but depending critically on an intact downstream retrieval stage. The infrastructure for abstract rule-following is present in the weights before any demonstrations; in-context examples, function vectors, and related interventions appear to supply input to the same latent circuit.

AI.tldr: 该研究追踪了三模型家族中"抽象-归纳-检索"三阶段符号推理电路随示例数量（shot数）的变化，发现该电路在高准确率出现之前即已可检测且具功能性，并可通过激活补丁与功能向量注入显著提升few-shot/zero-shot准确率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能仅凭少量上下文示例学习抽象规则，但其内部机制随示例累积如何被激活尚不清楚，作者希望揭示这一机制。
AI.method: 在三个模型家族中跨shot数追踪一个三阶段符号推理电路（抽象、归纳、检索）；进行逐头因果贡献分析、跨shot激活补丁（activation patching）实验，以及功能向量缩放注入实验。
AI.result: 该电路在模型达到高准确率之前即可被检测且具功能性；逐头因果贡献从1-shot到10-shot增长达8倍；跨shot激活补丁使0-shot准确率从1%升至56%，1-shot从17%升至88%；在0-shot注入缩放功能向量可将准确率恢复至86%，很大程度上替代归纳阶段，但关键依赖下游检索阶段的完整性。
AI.conclusion: 抽象规则遵循的基础设施在无任何示例前即已存在于权重中；上下文示例、功能向量及相关干预似乎都为同一潜在电路提供输入。

title: The Surge of Anti-Semitism in German Social Media following the October 7 Attacks
comment: 8 pages; 5 figures; accepted at 22st Conference on Natural Language Processing (KONVENS 2026), Hamburg, Germany
summary: We investigate the extent to which the Hamas attacks on Israel of October 7, 2023, have affected German social media debates about Judaism and Israel. For this, we develop an approach to detect 26 anti-Semitic categories in user postings via large language models (LLMs). The approach is applied to Facebook and Telegram posts (N=125,718) from three months before and after the event. Methodically, we test different open-weight models in two setups---with and without user information as additional context to the post text. The best setup achieves up to 83 % F1-score for binary anti-Semitism detection on our manually coded validation set. User context provides valuable information for most LLMs and drastically reduces false positives, for example, when (critically) reporting on anti-Semitic incidents. Concerning our topic, we find that anti-Semitism is surging significantly on both platforms, while being about ten times more prevalent on Telegram compared to Facebook. Facebook users express anti-Semitic views most likely in posts about an alleged genocide in Gaza carried out by the Israeli army, whereas classic anti-Semitic stereotypes related to power and conspiracy theories are dominant on Telegram. After the attack, the discourse patterns on both platforms show signs of convergence, as classic anti-Semitism increases on Facebook, whereas Israel-related categories surge on Telegram.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法，检测德国社交媒体上26类反犹太主义内容，并应用于2023年10月7日前后Facebook与Telegram共125,718条帖子，发现两平台反犹内容显著上升且话语模式出现趋同。
AI.motivation: 探究2023年10月7日哈马斯袭击以色列事件对德国社交媒体中关于犹太教与以色列讨论的影响，并填补大规模、细粒度反犹太主义检测方法的空白。
AI.method: 开发通过LLM检测26类反犹太主义类别的方法，应用于事件前后各三个月的Facebook与Telegram用户帖子（N=125,718）；方法上测试不同开放权重模型，并比较将用户信息作为附加上下文与不加入用户信息两种设置。
AI.result: 最佳设置在人工资编码验证集上的二分类反犹太主义检测达到最高83%的F1分数；用户上下文对多数LLM有价值，可大幅降低假阳性（如对反犹事件的客观报道）。两平台反犹内容均显著上升，Telegram上约为Facebook的十倍。Facebook反犹言论多出现在关于所谓以色列军队在加沙实施种族灭绝的帖子中，Telegram则以涉及权力与阴谋论的经典反犹刻板印象为主导。袭击后，Facebook的经典反犹内容增加，Telegram的以色列相关类别激增，两平台话语模式出现趋同迹象。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM并结合用户上下文的检测方法可有效识别多类别反犹太主义内容；10月7日事件后德国社交媒体反犹话语显著上升，且Facebook与Telegram在话语模式上呈现趋同，暗示跨平台舆论动态的相互影响。

title: When Trees Are Not Enough: Learning Mixed-Topology Feature Graphs with Adaptive Graph Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) expose interpretable features in large language model activations, yet existing structured SAEs impose single-parent trees or forests, while post-hoc graphs permit multiple parents but neither guide feature learning nor ensure reliable relation recovery. We introduce the Adaptive Graph Sparse Autoencoder (AG-SAE), a structure-guided training paradigm that treats each feature's complete parent set as an atomic structural hypothesis and lets evidence select zero, one, or multiple parents. By competing complete parent sets against null, subset, and alternative explanations, AG-SAE identifies jointly necessary multi-parent relations while rejecting redundant or spurious alternatives and verifying that each child contributes beyond its parents. The induced topology over SAE features then defines a differentiable structural loss that guides SAE training, while topology-guided refinement mitigates feature absorption and uses persistent reconstruction gaps exposed by the learned structure to initialize new features. The entire graph is then induced again from the revised dictionary by reassessing every feature's complete parent set, closing the dictionary-graph self-consistency cycle. Experiments demonstrate exact mixed-topology recovery in a controlled toy model, greater relational reliability and semantic validity than structured and post-hoc baselines on real LLM activations, and stronger feature-level causal interventions than conventional SAE features. AG-SAE thereby turns recovered mixed-topology feature structure into an unsupervised training signal that improves the dictionary, enables reliable feature organization beyond the topological limitations of trees, and exhibits stronger causal control beyond reconstruction.

AI.tldr: AG-SAE 将每个特征的完整父集作为原子结构假设，通过证据选择零个、一个或多个父节点，合成了可微结构损失与拓扑引导的词典-图自洽优化范式。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化 SAE 仅支持单父树/森林，事后图方法虽支持多父但不指导特征学习，也无法保证关系恢复的可靠性；因此需要一种既能学习多父关系、又能反哺特征学习的结构引导式 SAE 训练范式。
AI.method: 核心为"完整父集作为原子假设"：在空集、子集与替代解释之间竞争，识别联合必要的多父关系并剔除冗余/伪相关；由诱导拓扑定义可微结构损失以指导训练；拓扑引导精修缓解特征吸收，并用结构暴露的持续重构残差初始化新特征；随后从修订词典重新诱导整图，形成词典-图自洽闭环。
AI.result: 在受控玩具模型上实现精确的混合拓扑恢复；在真实大模型激活上关系可靠性与语义有效性优于结构化与事后基线；特征级因果干预强度强于常规 SAE 特征。
AI.conclusion: AG-SAE 将恢复出的混合拓扑特征结构转化为无监督训练信号，既改进词典质量，又在超越树形拓扑局限的前提下实现可靠的特征组织，并带来超出重构目标的更强因果可控性。

title: MoRE: Scaling mixture of experts with hardware-aware low-rank routing
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers are central to frontier language models, and recent architectures push toward more and smaller experts. In this regime, the standard linear router becomes a bottleneck: with $M$ experts and hidden dimension $h$, its per-token cost $Θ(Mh)$ dominates the MoE layer once $M$ is large. We introduce MoRE (Mixture of Rank-reduced-routed Experts), which factorizes the router weight matrix at rank $r$ and reduces the routing cost to $O((h + M)r)$. We prove that rank logarithmic in $M$ suffices for routing expressivity when the number of active experts is fixed, and is necessary up to precision factors. We also prove that logarithmic rank preserves load balance in a Gaussian memorization model, and training on a synthetic phonebook task shows that low rank does not hurt memorization. At matched active FLOPs, the factorization allows a factor of $Θ(h/r)$ more experts. To realize this gain in wall-clock time, we design a fused Triton kernel at inference that avoids expensive memory operations on HBM. Empirically, MoRE improves memorization on the phonebook task and performance on knowledge-intensive Q\&A benchmarks after pretraining, while matching reasoning ability. Code available at https://github.com/Matheart/MoRE_code.

AI.tldr: 提出MoRE，将MoE路由器权重矩阵做秩r分解，把路由成本从Θ(Mh)降至O((h+M)r)，并证明对数级秩足以保持路由表达能力与负载均衡，配合融合Triton内核实现在相同激活FLOPs下专家数增加Θ(h/r)倍，在phonebook记忆任务和知识密集型问答上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 前沿语言模型倾向使用更多、更小的专家，此时标准线性路由器的每token成本Θ(Mh)随专家数M增大而成为MoE层的瓶颈，限制了该架构方向的扩展性。作者希望在几乎不损失路由表达能力和负载均衡的前提下大幅降低路由开销。
AI.method: 提出MoRE（Mixture of Rank-reduced-routed Experts）：对路由器权重矩阵进行秩r分解，将路由成本降为O((h+M)r)。理论上证明在激活专家数固定时，秩为M的对数即可保证路由表达性，且该条件在精度因子意义下是必要的；并在高斯记忆模型下证明对数秩可保持负载均衡。工程上设计推理阶段的融合Triton内核，避免HBM上昂贵的显存访问。
AI.result: 在合成phonebook任务上验证低秩不损害记忆能力；因式分解在匹配激活FLOPs时允许专家数增加Θ(h/r)倍。实验显示MoRE在phonebook记忆任务和预训练后的知识密集型问答基准上均有提升，同时推理能力持平，且通过融合内核在墙钟时间上兑现了效率收益。
AI.conclusion: MoRE通过低秩路由分解有效缓解了大规模细粒度MoE的路由瓶颈，理论上证明了表达性与负载均衡的对数秩充分性，实践上结合融合内核实现了效率与性能的同步提升，为扩展专家数量提供了可行路径。

title: HeurEvo: Agentic Evolution of Hybrid Solver-Augmented Heuristics for Time-Critical Mathematical Optimization
summary: Recent advances in agentic heuristic design use AI agents and execution feedback to automate algorithm discovery for challenging optimization problems. In many practical settings, high-quality solutions must be obtained under strict runtime constraints, motivating hybrid approaches that combine problem-specific heuristics with powerful mathematical programming solvers. However, existing approaches typically improve heuristic components within predefined procedures or tune solver configurations in isolation. This limits holistic adaptation of where to allocate computation, how to leverage solvers, and how to refine the overall algorithmic structure. To address these limitations, we propose HeurEvo, an automated plan--code--component co-evolution framework that jointly evolves the high-level algorithmic structures, their implementations, and a shared pool of reusable components. A planner determines which algorithmic components to use, how to combine them, and how to allocate runtime across stages, a coder realizes the resulting plan as executable code, while a component evolver updates the shared component pool. Within an island-based evolutionary framework, plans and implementations co-evolve with feedback from an interpreter agent that analyzes execution results and identifies opportunities for improvement. Across diverse combinatorial optimization benchmarks and challenging MIPLIB instances, HeurEvo finds high-quality solutions within tight runtime budgets, often matching or surpassing state-of-the-art optimization solvers given hours or days of computation. On several nonlinear geometry problems such as hexagon packing, it also improves upon the best previously reported results. These results highlight the value of jointly searching over algorithmic structure and implementation for agentic heuristic design.

AI.tldr: 提出HeurEvo框架，通过plan-code-component协同进化自动设计混合启发式算法，在组合优化与MIPLIB基准的严格时限内取得高质量解，部分非线性几何问题（如六边形填充）超越已有最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于AI智能体与执行反馈的启发式自动发现方法存在局限：通常只在预定义流程内改进启发式组件，或孤立地调优求解器配置，无法整体性地决定计算资源如何分配、如何利用数学规划求解器以及如何优化整体算法结构。实际场景要求严格运行时限下获得高质量解，因此需要启发式与求解器相结合的混合方法，但缺乏对算法结构与实现的联合自适应。
AI.method: HeurEvo是一个自动化的plan-code-component协同进化框架，联合演化高层算法结构、其具体实现以及可复用组件共享池。其中：planner决定使用哪些算法组件、如何组合它们以及如何在各阶段分配运行时间；coder将规划转化为可执行代码；component evolver更新共享组件池。框架采用岛屿式进化机制，规划与实现依据interpreter agent对执行结果的分析反馈共同进化，该agent识别改进机会。
AI.result: 在多种组合优化基准和具有挑战性的MIPLIB实例上，HeurEvo在紧凑运行预算内找到高质量解，常常匹敌甚至超越给予数小时或数天计算时间的先进优化求解器。在若干非线性几何问题（如六边形填充）上，还改进了此前报告的最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在智能体启发式设计中，对算法结构与实现进行联合搜索具有重要价值。

title: Fractional State Space Transition for Long Sequence Modeling
summary: State Space Models (SSMs) compress sequence history into a bounded recurrent state, making the resulting memory law a central architectural choice for long-context performance. Most modern SSMs rely on ODE-based dynamics that lead to exponential forgetting, limiting their ability to retain information over broad temporal ranges. We introduce FRAC, a selective SSM architecture derived from fractional dynamics that replaces this exponential decay with power-law long memory. To make fractional dynamics practical, FRAC approximates the heavy-tailed target kernel with a finite-state, log-spaced sum of exponential modes. This construction turns fractional memory into an efficient recurrent module with parallel training and prefill, while retaining bounded-state autoregressive decoding. Extensive experiments, including 1.3B-parameter language modeling, demonstrate that FRAC consistently improves long-context performance over state-of-the-art SSM baselines while staying competitive on short-context. These results show that fractional dynamics provide a practical and effective prior for long-context SSMs.

AI.tldr: FRAC 提出一种基于分数阶动力学（fractional dynamics）的选择性状态空间模型（SSM）架构，用幂律长记忆替代传统 SSM 的指数遗忘，并通过对数间隔指数模态的有限状态近似实现高效并行训练与自回归解码，在长上下文建模上优于现有 SSM 基线。
AI.motivation: 状态空间模型将序列历史压缩进有界循环状态，其记忆规律决定长上下文性能。现代 SSM 多依赖 ODE 动力学，导致指数遗忘，难以在宽广的时间范围内保留信息，因此需要一个能提供长记忆特性的新先验。
AI.method: FRAC 从分数阶动力学推导而来，用幂律长记忆取代指数衰减。为使分数阶动力学实用化，FRAC 用有限状态、对数间隔的指数模态之和对重尾目标核进行近似，从而将分数阶记忆转化为高效循环模块，支持并行训练和 prefill，同时保留有界状态的自回归解码。
AI.result: 大量实验（包括 13 亿参数语言建模）表明，FRAC 在长上下文性能上持续优于最先进的 SSM 基线，同时在短上下文上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，分数阶动力学为长上下文 SSM 提供了一种实用且有效的先验。

title: PyroStack: A Multi-Band Spatio-Temporal Sub-Daily Dataset for Wildfires in the United States
summary: Wildfires are an increasing hazard to ecosystems, air quality, and human systems, creating a growing need for datasets that support systematic development and evaluation of models for predicting fire spread across diverse landscapes. Effective prediction requires integrating meteorological conditions, fuels, vegetation, and topography at spatial and temporal resolutions suitable for both physical simulation and data-driven approaches. However, existing datasets often lack the resolution and coverage needed to capture these interacting controls. The PyroStack dataset addresses this gap by providing a harmonized, event-based collection of wildfire and environmental data across the contiguous United States and Alaska. It integrates satellite-derived fire observations with atmospheric reanalysis, vegetation, fuel characteristics, and topographic information into a unified framework spanning 6994 wildfires that occurred between 2012 and 2024 across a wide range of ecosystems and climate conditions. PyroStack offers spatial resolutions ranging from 30 m to 9 km and hourly temporal resolution, along with fire progression data at 12-hour intervals to support model initialization and evaluation. By combining broad spatial coverage with fine spatial and temporal detail, the dataset enables systematic analysis of wildfire dynamics and supports both physics-based and machine learning approaches, providing a foundation for benchmarking and improving fire spread models, with future extensions aimed at incorporating additional regions and fire suppression data streams to further advance wildfire prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍PyroStack数据集：一个覆盖美国本土及阿拉斯加、基于事件组织的野火与环境 harmonized 数据集，整合卫星火观测、大气再分析、植被、燃料与地形数据，涵盖2012–2024年6994场野火，空间分辨率30 m–9 km、时间分辨率小时级、火势进展12小时间隔，旨在支持野火蔓延模型的开发、基准测试与改进。
AI.motivation: 野火对生态系统、空气质量和人类系统构成日益严重的威胁，亟需能够支撑跨多样景观的火灾蔓延预测模型开发与评估的数据集。有效预测需在适合物理模拟与数据驱动方法的时空分辨率上整合气象条件、燃料、植被与地形。然而现有数据集常缺乏捕捉这些交互控制因素所需的分辨率与覆盖范围。
AI.method: 构建PyroStack数据集：采用基于事件的统一框架，覆盖美国本土与阿拉斯加，将卫星遥感火观测与大气再分析、植被、燃料特征及地形信息进行协调整合；提供30 m至9 km的空间分辨率、小时级时间分辨率，以及12小时间隔的火势进展数据，以支持模型初始化与评估。
AI.result: 数据集涵盖2012至2024年间发生的6994场野火，覆盖广泛生态系统与气候条件，兼具广阔空间覆盖与精细时空细节。
AI.conclusion: PyroStack支持野火动态的系统分析，兼容物理机理与机器学习两类方法，为火灾蔓延模型的基准测试与改进提供基础；未来将扩展至更多区域并纳入灭火数据流，以进一步推进野火预测。

title: Training LLMs to Verbalize Evaluation Awareness
summary: Evaluation awareness (EA) can cause large language models (LLMs) to behave differently during audits than in deployment, yet measuring and accounting for EA remains challenging. We introduce verbalization training (VT), a method for making LLMs less reticent about verbalizing evaluation awareness while avoiding to supervise the latent belief itself. VT uses a model's spontaneous verbalizations as evidence that awareness is present and truncates each rollout immediately before the verbalization, producing training prefixes at which the model is presumed to be aware. The model is then trained with an RL objective designed to increase verbalization in a calibrated way. Across Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Kimi K2.6, and Inkling, VT increases verbalized EA by 2.4-2.9 times and transfers to held-out agentic settings, while measured latent EA and behavior remain largely stable. In a causal experiment, we independently implant meta-knowledge about evaluations through synthetic-document fine-tuning and show that VT-induced verbalizations reflect the richer knowledge acquired by the model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"言语化训练"(VT)，通过仅强化模型自发表达评估意识、而不监督其潜在信念本身，使大模型更愿意说出评估意识，同时让潜在意识与行为保持稳定。
AI.motivation: 评估意识（EA）会使大模型在审计时表现得与部署时不同，从而干扰审计的有效性；然而测量并处理EA仍然困难，核心难点在于如何在不直接监督模型潜在信念的前提下调节其表达。
AI.method: VT利用模型自发产生的言语化内容作为"意识存在"的证据，在每个rollout中于该言语化出现之前立即截断，从而得到被假定为"已有意识"的训练前缀；随后用强化学习目标在这些前缀上训练模型，以校准的方式提高言语化倾向。此外，作者通过合成文档微调独立植入关于评估的元知识，做因果实验以验证言语化的来源。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Kimi K2.6和Inkling三个模型上，VT使言语化EA提升约2.4至2.9倍，并能迁移到未见过的智能体场景；同时测得的潜在EA与行为基本保持稳定。因果实验显示，经合成文档微调植入元知识后，VT诱导的言语化会反映模型新获得的更丰富知识。
AI.conclusion: VT能够在不改变模型潜在评估意识和外部行为的前提下，显著提升其评估意识的言语化程度，为审计中测量与处理EA提供了可行手段。

title: DeepRewind: Predicting and Repairing Premature Commitments in Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep-research agents conduct long-horizon investigations through iterative search, evidence evaluation, belief revision, and synthesis. However, they may commit to claims before sufficient evidence is available, causing later reasoning to reinforce an incorrect interpretation. We introduce DeepRewind, an additive control layer for reversible deep research that represents the agent's evolving epistemic state as a typed graph of sources, evidence, claims, hypotheses, assumptions, commitments, plans, and drafts. Before accepting an intermediate conclusion, a prompt-based world model predicts its impact and estimates reversibility based on hypothesis narrowing, information loss, recovery cost, and contradiction-trigger coverage. A binary controller blocks risky commitments, while a consistency monitor performs dependency-aware rollback when later evidence invalidates them. Across DRBench and LiveDRBench, DeepRewind improves insight recall by 3.6 percentage points and reduces premature commitments by 59.1% relative to Open Deep Research.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepRewind，一种面向深度研究智能体的可逆控制层，通过类型化认知状态图、提示式世界模型、二元控制器与一致性监控器，抑制过早承诺并支持依赖感知回滚。在DRBench和LiveDRBench上，洞察召回率提升3.6个百分点，过早承诺减少59.1%。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体通过迭代搜索、证据评估、信念修正与综合开展长时程调研，但往往在证据不足时就对结论作出承诺，导致后续推理不断强化错误解读，缺乏对中间结论风险与可逆性的控制机制。
AI.method: 将智能体演化的认知状态表示为类型化图，节点涵盖来源、证据、主张、假设、前提、承诺、计划与草稿。在接受中间结论前，由基于提示的世界模型预测其影响并估计可逆性，指标包括假设收窄、信息损失、恢复成本与矛盾触发覆盖度。二元控制器阻断高风险承诺；一致性监控器在后续证据证伪时执行依赖感知回滚。该方法为可加性控制层，可叠加于现有深度研究智能体之上。
AI.result: 在DRBench与LiveDRBench上，相较Open Deep Research，洞察召回率提升3.6个百分点，过早承诺减少59.1%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模认知状态的可逆性并主动阻断高风险承诺，可有效减少深度研究中的过早承诺并提升洞察召回，表明可逆控制是提升长时程研究可靠性的可行方向。

title: Representation by Design in Generation: Cross-View Class-Token Alignment in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Generative and representation learning remain asymmetrically connected: semantic representations are used to improve diffusion generation, whereas the models' own representations are often treated as a by-product of synthesis. We ask whether diffusion models can instead be trained to learn substantially stronger semantic representations without sacrificing generation quality. SelfFlow takes a step in this direction by introducing self-supervised patch alignment into flow matching, but its main gains remain in faster convergence and improved generation. Inspired by DINO and iBOT, we extend this framework with cross-view class-token alignment to further strengthen semantic representations. Specifically, we form two independently noised, dual-timestep observations of each image and align each student class-token representation with the stop-gradient EMA-teacher target from the other observation. This objective is optimized jointly with the inherited flow-matching and local patch objectives. Notably, although the additional objective acts only on the class token, it strengthens both class-token and patch representations. Compared with a matched two-view baseline, ImageNet linear-probing accuracy improves by 9.4\% using the class token and 10.1\% using mean-pooled patch tokens, while frozen-backbone VOC2012 segmentation improves by 3.6 mIoU. These representation gains are achieved while maintaining comparable ImageNet generation FID. In text-to-image training, the same objective also improves generation FID, reducing it from 2.52 to 2.37 at matched checkpoints. Our results show that representation need not remain a by-product of generation or merely a tool for improving it: it can be directly optimized as a first-class capability of diffusion pretraining alongside generation.

AI.tldr: 通过在流匹配中引入跨视角类别令牌对齐，扩散模型可在不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著增强语义表征。
AI.motivation: 生成与表征学习长期处于不对称状态：语义表征被用于改进扩散生成，而模型自身的表征往往被视为合成的副产物。作者追问扩散模型能否在不牺牲生成质量的前提下学到远更强的语义表征。SelfFlow 通过自监督块对齐朝此方向迈进，但其主要收益仍集中在加速收敛与提升生成，因此需要进一步增强语义表征。
AI.method: 受 DINO 与 iBOT 启发，在 SelfFlow 框架上扩展跨视角类别令牌对齐：对每张图像构造两个独立加噪的双时间步观测，将学生类别令牌表征与另一观测的 stop-gradient EMA 教师目标对齐；该目标与继承的流匹配目标及局部块目标联合优化。尽管额外目标仅作用于类别令牌，却同时强化了类别令牌与块表征。
AI.result: 与匹配的双视角基线相比，ImageNet 线性探测准确率在类别令牌上提升 9.4%、在均值池化块令牌上提升 10.1%，冻结主干 VOC2012 分割提升 3.6 mIoU，同时保持可比的 ImageNet 生成 FID。在文本到图像训练中，同一目标还改善生成 FID，在匹配检查点由 2.52 降至 2.37。
AI.conclusion: 表征不必是生成的副产物，也不必仅作为改进生成的工具：它可以作为扩散预训练中与生成并列的一等能力被直接优化。

title: StructRL: Online Structured Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Tasks
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models perform well on shorter-horizon manipulation tasks but still struggle with long-horizon tasks that require multiple dependent manipulations from a single command. Online reinforcement learning (RL) can improve these policies through environment interaction, yet many existing methods provide reward only after the complete task succeeds. However, such terminal supervision is sparse and does not distinguish early failures from rollouts that make substantial partial progress. We propose StructRL, an online RL framework that constructs structured intermediate supervision from verifiable subtask completions. StructRL decomposes each task into verifiable subtasks, grants intermediate rewards only after the prerequisite subtasks have been completed, and scales each reward according to completion pace. Across RoboCasa365 and LIBERO-Long with GR00T-N1.5 and pi 0.5, StructRL consistently outperforms evaluated online RL baselines. These results show that verifiable, structured intermediate rewards improve long-horizon VLA post-training. Code is available at https://github.com/amazon-science/StructRL.

AI.tldr: 提出StructRL在线强化学习框架，通过可验证子任务构建结构化中间监督，提升长时程VLA操作任务的微调效果。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在短时程操作任务上表现良好，但在需要单条指令完成多个依赖操作的长时程任务上仍存在困难。在线RL可通过环境交互改进策略，但许多方法仅在任务完全成功后给出奖励，这种终局监督稀疏，无法区分早期失败与取得实质部分进展的轨迹。
AI.method: StructRL将每个任务分解为可验证的子任务，仅当前置子任务完成后才给予中间奖励，并按完成速度对每个奖励进行缩放。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa365和LIBERO-Long上，结合GR00T-N1.5与pi 0.5模型，StructRL持续优于所评估的在线RL基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 可验证的结构化中间奖励能够改善长时程VLA后训练效果。

title: Compress to Remember: Learning Compact Memory via On-Policy Distillation for Long Video Generation
summary: Standard video generators do not natively compact historical context into reusable memory tokens. As generation continues, the growing history makes it increasingly difficult to retain information from earlier frames due to long-context degradation. Key-frame-based approaches address this challenge by retaining selected past frames, but can discard information needed for future generation. Rather than relying on frame selection alone, we study whether a frozen video generator can supply the supervision needed to learn a compact representation of the history. We propose Prediction-Aligned Context Compaction (PACC), which uses a learned compressor to aggregate information across past frames into compact memory tokens. We train the compressor through on-policy distillation, using the same frozen generator both as a student when conditioned on compressed memory and as a teacher when conditioned on the full history. The student generates continuations, while the teacher provides targets for the same noisy inputs at each denoising step. Only the compressor is updated to align the student's predictions with these targets. We evaluate PACC on MBench, which jointly measures memory-event coverage and consistency. PACC outperforms the strongest baseline by 6.63 points on Causal-rCM and 3.19 points on Causal Forcing. Evaluation on VBench-Long using MovieGen prompts further shows that PACC produces minute-long videos with generation quality competitive with baselines. Together, these results show that learning to compact historical context can improve long-video memory without modifying the underlying generator.

AI.tldr: 提出PACC，用可学习压缩器将历史帧聚合为紧凑记忆token，通过on-policy蒸馏（同一冻结生成器兼任学生与教师）训练压缩器，在不修改生成器的情况下提升长视频生成的记忆保持能力。
AI.motivation: 标准视频生成器无法原生将历史上下文压缩为可复用的记忆token，随生成推进历史不断增长，导致长上下文退化，难以保留早期帧信息；关键帧方法虽保留部分历史帧，但可能丢弃未来生成所需的信息。因此本文探索：冻结的视频生成器能否为学习历史的紧凑表示提供监督信号。
AI.method: 提出Prediction-Aligned Context Compaction (PACC)：用学习到的压缩器跨历史帧聚合成紧凑记忆token；通过on-policy蒸馏训练压缩器，同一冻结生成器在条件为压缩记忆时充当学生、在条件为完整历史时充当教师；学生在各去噪步生成续帧，教师对相同的噪声输入提供目标，仅更新压缩器以对齐学生预测与教师目标。
AI.result: 在同时衡量记忆事件覆盖率与一致性的MBench上，PACC在Causal-rCM上超过最强基线6.63分，在Causal Forcing上超过3.19分；在VBench-Long上使用MovieGen提示词，可生成长达一分钟的视频，生成质量与基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 学习压缩历史上下文可在不修改底层生成器的前提下提升长视频记忆能力，说明用冻结生成器提供监督、训练紧凑记忆表示是一条有效路径。

title: AdaKerNet: Neural Kernel Decoding for Task-Adaptive Prediction with Multimodal Large Models
summary: Large foundation models have been introduced with the promise of efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. Yet, under limited supervision, MLLMs, an important class of large foundation models, remain challenging to adapt to various downstream tasks. Adaptation typically relies either on MLLM parameter fine-tuning or on training neural-based decoders. Both approaches struggle under limited supervision, while fine-tuning additionally requires access to model parameters, which is often unavailable for closed-source models. We introduce AdaKerNet, a novel learnable task-adaptive neural kernel decoder. AdaKerNet is fully agnostic to the parameters of the underlying MLLM and operates solely on its (frozen) rich representations obtained from the diverse available modalities. AdaKerNet relies on (i) a set of learnable, Lipschitz-controlled multimodal features derived from these MLLM representations; (ii) a reference kernel that provides a soft structural prior on those features; and (iii) a lightweight nonlinear neural predictor that adaptively deforms that structure. Learning the kernel representation and the neural predictor jointly within a unified optimization framework allows AdaKerNet to capture features and geometric relationships relevant to the downstream task. Numerical tests across four MLLMs: BLIP-2, LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, and Gemini Embedding 2, and multimodal inputs spanning text, audio, images, and tabular measurements demonstrate significant and consistent improvements over direct MLP, attention-, autoencoder- and kernel-based decoders, across a range of scarce-label budgets, with average error reduction of up to 41% across baselines. These results establish AdaKerNet as an effective approach for prediction from frozen multimodal representations in the scarce label regime. Additional structural ablations highlight the complementary contributions of AdaKerNet's components.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaKerNet，一种与MLLM参数无关的可学习任务自适应神经核解码器，在稀缺标注下从冻结多模态表征中预测，平均误差最高降低41%。
AI.motivation: MLLM适配下游任务通常依赖参数微调或训练神经解码器，但在有限监督下二者表现不佳，且微调需模型参数，对闭源模型不可得，因此需要一种无需参数访问、适用于稀缺标注的适配方法。
AI.method: AdaKerNet完全不可知底层MLLM参数，仅使用其冻结的丰富多模态表征，包含三部分：(i)从MLLM表征导出的可学习、Lipschitz控制的多模态特征；(ii)提供软结构先验的参考核；(iii)自适应变形该结构的轻量非线性神经预测器；二者在统一优化框架内联合学习。
AI.result: 在BLIP-2、LLaVA-1.5、Qwen2.5-VL、Gemini Embedding 2四个MLLM及文本、音频、图像、表格多模态输入上测试，在多种稀缺标注预算下一致显著优于MLP、注意力、自编码器和核基解码器，平均误差最高降低41%；消融验证各组件互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: AdaKerNet是在稀缺标注下从冻结多模态表征进行预测的有效方法。

title: TTMark: Pairwise Distortion-Free Watermarking Beyond Single-Token Entropy
summary: Distortion-free watermarking enables reliable attribution of machine-generated text while preserving output distribution. However, existing methods operate independently on each generated token, making their detection capability fundamentally constrained by the entropy of the next-token distribution. We present Tandem Token WaterMark (TTMARK), a general pairwise watermarking framework that extends distortion-free watermarking from individual tokens to adjacent token pairs. By watermarking the joint distribution of consecutive tokens, TTMARK enlarges the effective watermarking alphabet from V to $V^2$, allowing the detector to exploit both token entropy and conditional entropy while preserving distortion-freeness over the joint distribution. We further introduce a branch-isolating concatenated tandem generation algorithm that efficiently constructs the joint distribution in a single forward pass. Theoretically, we show that pairwise watermarking achieves better expected detection strength in low-entropy regimes. Extensive experiments across multiple language models, datasets, and three representative distortion-free watermarking schemes demonstrate that TTMARK consistently improves detectability without degrading generation quality, while also improving robustness to edits and substantially enhancing localized watermark detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TTMARK，一种将无失真水印从单token扩展到相邻token对的通用成对水印框架，通过水印连续token的联合分布将有效水印字母表从V扩大到V²，从而在保持分布无失真的同时提升可检测性。
AI.motivation: 现有无失真水印方法独立地对每个生成token进行处理，其检测能力本质上受限于下一token分布的熵，尤其在低熵场景下检测强度不足。
AI.method: 提出TTMARK成对水印框架，对连续token的联合分布进行水印，将有效字母表从V扩展到V²，使检测器能同时利用token熵和条件熵；引入分支隔离的级联串联生成算法，在单次前向传播中高效构建联合分布。
AI.result: 理论上证明成对水印在低熵场景下具有更优的期望检测强度；在多个语言模型、数据集及三种代表性无失真水印方案上的大量实验表明，TTMARK在不降低生成质量的前提下持续提升可检测性，同时改善抗编辑鲁棒性并显著增强局部水印检测能力。
AI.conclusion: TTMARK通过将无失真水印从单token扩展到相邻token对，有效突破单token熵对检测能力的限制，是一种通用且高效的成对水印框架。

title: OTT3R: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Fast Dataset Generation at 1% Compute
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have achieved impressive performance by scaling model and dataset size, but their cost excludes most research groups and precludes edge deployment. Additionally, generating 3D supervision without sensors still relies on slow, unreliable Structure-from-Motion, as the community lacks a COLMAP-like system for neural 3D pseudo-label generation. We present OTT3R (RGB-Only Tiny Transformer for 3D Reconstruction), a knowledge distillation framework that addresses both problems on a single workstation equipped with 2 GPUs. Distilling $π^3$ (959M parameters) into a 102M-parameter student yields 9.4$\times$ compression and up to 7$\times$ faster inference, trained at 1.6% of VGGT's training compute. An integrated pseudo-label pipeline offers a reliable, high-throughput alternative to COLMAP, generating dense per-pixel point maps and SE(3) camera poses for a 667K-image corpus in 3.5 hours on two commodity GPUs and succeeding on every sequence we tested, including those where COLMAP fails. The general student tracks the teacher on in-distribution monocular depth and, zero-shot, outperforms COLMAP on 7-Scenes and on DTU completion, but it does not replace the teacher on out-of-distribution multi-view geometry. The deployable artifact is the domain-specialized student: after specialization at 0.2% compute, it is 4$\times$ more accurate than COLMAP on 7-Scenes at 980$\times$ throughput, with near-teacher completion. Code is available at https://github.com/TheFourthKaramazov/OTT3R

AI.tldr: OTT3R 提出一个知识蒸馏框架，将 959M 参数的 π³ 教师模型蒸馏为 102M 学生模型（9.4×压缩、最高 7×加速），并配套一个可替代 COLMAP 的高吞吐神经伪标签流水线，在单机双 GPU 上即可完成训练与部署。
AI.motivation: 前馈式 3D 重建模型虽性能优异，但依赖大规模模型与数据，训练成本将多数研究团队和边缘部署排除在外；同时，无传感器的 3D 监督仍依赖缓慢且不可靠的 Structure-from-Motion，社区缺乏类似 COLMAP 的神经 3D 伪标签生成系统。
AI.method: 提出 OTT3R（RGB-Only Tiny Transformer for 3D Reconstruction）知识蒸馏框架：把 959M 参数的 π³ 教师蒸馏到 102M 学生模型，仅用 1.6% 的 VGGT 训练算力，在双商用 GPU 工作站上训练；并集成伪标签流水线，生成稠密逐像素点图与 SE(3) 相机位姿，另提供 0.2% 算力的领域特化学生模型。
AI.result: 学生模型实现 9.4× 压缩与最高 7× 推理加速；伪标签流水线在两张消费级 GPU 上 3.5 小时处理 667K 图像语料，所有测试序列均成功（含 COLMAP 失败者）。通用学生在同分布单目深度上追平教师，零样本下在 7-Scenes 与 DTU 补全上超过 COLMAP，但在分布外多视图几何上无法取代教师。特化学生在 7-Scenes 上比 COLMAP 精确 4×、吞吐 980×，补全性能接近教师。
AI.conclusion: OTT3R 以极低算力把大规模前馈 3D 重建模型压缩为可在单机双 GPU 训练与部署的紧凑学生网络，并提供高吞吐、可靠的神经伪标签系统作为 COLMAP 替代方案；其可部署产物为领域特化学生模型。

title: LEGO-Anything: Coding Agents for 3D Scene Reconstruction
summary: A 3D scene reconstructed from a single image is most useful when represented not as a rendering or a fixed 3D output, but as an explicit scene program whose execution yields a scene that can be inspected, edited, and queried. We present LEGO-Anything, an Image-to-Code framework in which a coding agent iteratively writes and executes Blender code, inspects scenes and renderings, and revises the program. To evaluate end-to-end scene recovery, we introduce LEGO-Bench, a simulator-grounded benchmark with 208 images from 104 diverse indoor and outdoor scenes. LEGO-Bench separately scores artifact validity, visible-surface geometry, and rendered appearance. Its simulator-grounded design enables extensibility and precise automatic evaluation. Among evaluated agents, GPT-6-astra achieves the strongest overall results, with 53.4% indoor and 39.6% outdoor scores, yet substantial gaps remain between delivering valid scene artifacts and faithfully recovering scene geometry and appearance. Analysis of agent construction trajectories reveals three recurring issues: weak scene initialization, regressive edits during iteration, and unreliable self-evaluation. These findings motivate LEGO-Plugin, a training-free harness plugin for more controlled iterative scene construction, which improves all six evaluated models, with relative gains of up to 62.7% in overall score. Finally, we test whether reconstructed scenes can represent natural images and support vision tasks. In LEGO-World, we derive object detections, instance masks, and relative depth as deterministic queries on scenes reconstructed by GPT-6-astra. These readouts show non-trivial performance across all three tasks but fall well short of specialized vision models, suggesting that program-constructed scenes from current coding agents are a promising but not yet sufficiently precise representation of natural images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LEGO-Anything：以编码智能体迭代编写并执行Blender代码，将单图重建为可执行、可检查、可编辑的场景程序；并构建LEGO-Bench基准与训练无关插件LEGO-Plugin，验证其有效性及在视觉任务中的潜力与不足。
AI.motivation: 单图三维场景重建的价值不在于渲染结果或固定三维输出，而在于显式"场景程序"：可执行、可检查、可编辑、可查询。然而当前缺乏端到端场景恢复的评测基准，也缺乏对编码智能体迭代构建过程问题的系统性分析。
AI.method: 1) LEGO-Anything：Image-to-Code框架，编码智能体迭代编写并执行Blender代码，检查场景与渲染并修订程序。2) LEGO-Bench：基于仿真器构建的基准，含104个室内外场景的208张图像，分别评分工件有效性、可见表面几何与渲染外观，支持精确自动评测与扩展。3) LEGO-Plugin：训练无关的测试框架插件，实现更可控的迭代场景构建。4) LEGO-World：在重建场景上以确定性查询方式导出目标检测、实例掩码与相对深度。
AI.result: GPT-6-astra综合表现最强，室内53.4%、室外39.6%，但"生成有效场景工件"与"忠实恢复几何与外观"之间仍有明显差距。轨迹分析揭示三类反复出现的问题：场景初始化薄弱、迭代中的退化性编辑、自评估不可靠。LEGO-Plugin使全部六个被评模型均有提升，综合分数相对增益最高达62.7%。LEGO-World的三种读出任务均取得非平凡性能，但明显落后于专用视觉模型。
AI.conclusion: 由当前编码智能体程序化构建的场景是自然图像的一种有前景但尚不够精确的表示；显式场景程序范式在可编辑性与可查询性上具优势，后续需解决初始化、迭代稳定性与自评估可靠性等问题。

title: Stealth Is a Relation, Not a Property: How Event Representations Create Blind Spots for Timing Attacks in Event-Based Perception
summary: An event camera produces an asynchronous stream, but what is visible in that stream depends on how a downstream consumer, such as a model or detector, processes time. The same timestamp change may leave a coarse temporal representation unchanged while changing the response of a model that preserves finer timing. We characterize this dependence as observer-relative stealth. For recorded event streams, retiming an event within its protected accumulation window leaves the accumulated integer tensor exactly unchanged. We use this exact blind space to construct Null, a gradient-guided timestamp-retiming attack, and define SC-ASR_A(tau) to measure attack success while bounding the change visible to observer A. On DVS Gesture at a 10% event budget, Null reaches 81.56 +/- 5.81% ASR on ConvSNN and 98.67 +/- 0.45% on a GRU while preserving the protected tensor exactly. On DailyDVS-200, a protocol-scale Multi-View Fusion Network variant reaches 99.28 +/- 0.11% exact-null ASR, compared with 9.70 +/- 1.06% for its matched control. In a five-attack comparison, Null is the only method with nonzero attack success at exact observer equality, reaching 81.4% on DVS Gesture and 87.35% on DailyDVS-200. We also search the same exact blind space with an independently implemented constrained projected-gradient optimizer, C-PGD. At matched victim-gradient evaluations, C-PGD reaches 84.50 +/- 2.89% ASR on DVS Gesture and 89.55 +/- 4.39% on DailyDVS-200, again with exact protected equality. Perturbations that are exactly hidden from the protected observer become visible under shifted, finer, overlapping, and randomized temporal views. Adding observer constraints reduces the real-valued blind-space fraction from 87.5% to 75.0% to 62.5%, while DVS ConvSNN ASR falls from 74.9% to 61.9% to 37.2%. These results show that stealth is not a property of the perturbation alone.

AI.tldr: 本文将事件相机中的攻击隐蔽性刻画为"观察者相对的隐蔽性"（observer-relative stealth），利用"受保护累加窗口内重定时不改变整数张量"这一精确盲空间，提出梯度引导的时间戳重定时攻击 Null 及约束投影梯度优化器 C-PGD，在精确保持受保护观察者输出的条件下实现高攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 事件相机输出异步事件流，其可见内容取决于下游消费者（模型/检测器）如何处理时间。同一时间戳改动可能对粗粒度时间表示无影响，却改变保留精细时序的模型响应。作者希望揭示：隐蔽性并非扰动自身的固有属性，而是取决于观察者的时间表征粒度，从而定义并量化这种"观察者相对"的攻击面。
AI.method: 1) 定义"观察者相对的隐蔽性"，将受保护观察者 A 的累加整数张量作为不可见盲空间；2) 利用该精确盲空间构造梯度引导的时间戳重定时攻击 Null；3) 定义 SC-ASR_A(tau) 指标，在限定观察者 A 可见变化的同时度量攻击成功率；4) 用独立实现的约束投影梯度优化器 C-PGD 在同一盲空间搜索；5) 在 DVS Gesture 与 DailyDVS-200 上，对 ConvSNN、GRU、多视角融合网络及视图偏移/更细/重叠/随机化等不同观察者进行评测与五攻击对比。
AI.result: DVS Gesture 上 10% 事件预算时，Null 对 ConvSNN 达 81.56±5.81% ASR、对 GRU 达 98.67±0.45%，且精确保留受保护张量；DailyDVS-200 上多视角融合网络变体达 99.28±0.11% 精确零扰动 ASR，对照仅 9.70±1.06%。五攻击对比中，Null 是唯一在观察者精确相等下仍有非零成功的方法（DVS Gesture 81.4%、DailyDVS-200 87.35%）。C-PGD 在匹配受害者梯度评估下分别达 84.50±2.89% 与 89.55±4.39%，同样保持精确相等。对受保护观察者完全隐藏的扰动在偏移、更细、重叠及随机时间视图下会显现；加入观察者约束使实值盲空间比例从 87.5% 降至 75.0% 再到 62.5%，DVS ConvSNN ASR 相应从 74.9% 降至 61.9% 再到 37.2%。
AI.conclusion: 隐蔽性不是扰动单独的性质，而由观察者的时间处理方式相对决定。时间戳重定时攻击可在对受保护观察者精确不可见的前提下保持高攻击成功率，证明必须从观察者相对视角评估事件流安全性与时序表征的鲁棒性。

title: Calibrated to Whom? Persona and Language Effects on Cultural Values in JEV
summary: Decision-only language models return a probability for every answer option instead of generating text, which makes them attractive as survey respondents and as judges. We audit the cultural values of one such model, TypeSafe's JEV, with the Values Survey Module 2013. We asked it the 24 items as 12 matched Saudi and 12 matched American personas and without a persona, in English and Arabic, under eight ways of formulating the request (288,000 answers). JEV's answers were highly repeatable (ICC 0.997), and without a persona they resembled those of its own American personas. When the persona was Saudi rather than American, the answers moved in the direction of the human Saudi-US difference, reproducing 87% of its size in English but 62% in Arabic, with long-term orientation reversed. A language cross shows that the smaller difference in Arabic comes from the language of the items, not from the language of the persona description. Age shifted the profiles about as much as nationality, gender shifted them more for Saudi than for American personas, and JEV was less confident in Arabic and for Saudi personas. These patterns held in every request design, although the model never generates text.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了决策型语言模型 TypeSafe JEV 的文化价值观。研究者用 VSM 2013 的 24 个题项，以 12 组沙特与 12 组美国匹配人格、以及无人格设定，在英语和阿拉伯语下用 8 种请求表述方式提问，共得 288,000 个答案。结果显示 JEV 答案高度可重复（ICC 0.997），无人格时接近其美国人格；切换为沙特人格时答案向人类沙特—美国差异方向移动，英语中复现该差异的 87%，阿拉伯语中仅 62%，且长期取向反转。语言交叉实验表明阿拉伯语差异缩小源于题项语言而非人格描述语言。年龄对剖面的影响与国籍相当，性别对沙特人格影响大于美国人格，JEV 在阿拉伯语和沙特人格下置信度更低。这些模式在每种请求设计下均成立。
AI.motivation: 决策型语言模型对每个选项返回概率而不生成文本，因此适合作为问卷受访者和评判者。但这类模型是否编码、以及在多大程度上可被激发出一致且可迁移的文化价值观，尚缺乏系统审计，尤其是在多语言、多人格条件下其答案的稳定性与偏差来源不明。
AI.method: 采用 Values Survey Module 2013（VSM 2013）的 24 个题项，设置 12 组匹配的沙特人格与 12 组匹配的美国人格，并设无人格条件；在英语与阿拉伯语两种语言下，使用 8 种请求表述方式提问，共收集 288,000 个答案。通过 ICC 评估可重复性，并以人类沙特—美国差异为基准衡量人格激发效应，另设语言交叉实验分离题项语言与人格描述语言的作用。
AI.result: JEV 答案高度可重复（ICC 0.997）；无人格时接近其美国人格的答案。人格设为沙特而非美国时，答案朝人类沙特—美国差异方向移动，英语中复现该差异规模的 87%，阿拉伯语中仅 62%，且长期取向出现反转。语言交叉证实阿拉伯语下差异缩小由题项语言而非人格描述语言导致。年龄对价值观剖面的影响与国籍相当；性别对沙特人格的影响大于对美国人格；JEV 在阿拉伯语和沙特人格下置信度更低。上述模式在所有请求设计下一致。
AI.conclusion: 决策型语言模型即使不生成文本，也表现出可重复且可被提示激发的文化价值观剖面，其激发的沙特—美国差异与人类差异方向一致，但幅度受题项语言显著调节（阿拉伯语下减弱并出现长期取向反转）。因此以该类模型作为问卷受访者或评判者时，需谨慎对待语言和人格设定带来的系统性偏差，模型置信度也随语言与人格变化。

title: CAMEO: A Class-Activation-Mapped Equitable Overlay Framework for Fair and Robust Deep Learning-based Skin Condition Diagnosis
summary: Deep learning classifiers for dermoscopic skin lesions often reach high in-distribution accuracy while quietly relying on spurious background cues such as skin tone, device vignetting, and embedded rulers, rather than on lesion morphology. This undermines robustness and fairness across skin tones. This work asks whether Explainable AI (XAI), typically used only to audit a finished model, can instead be repurposed as an active training signal that corrects this shortcut without sacrificing diagnostic accuracy. We introduce CAMEO (Class Activation Mapped Equitable Overlay), a framework that improves skin-lesion classification by selecting stable model explanations and using them to separate lesions from their backgrounds. It then replaces the background with realistic synthetic skin while keeping the lesion unchanged. On HAM10000 and dark-skin ISIC images, CAMEO maintained accuracy while reducing background-driven errors by nearly four times. It also made the model's attention more consistent when backgrounds changed. Results across multiple tests show that reducing reliance on background information improves robustness, with Fitzpatrick-based backgrounds providing a realistic and interpretable approach. Results show that XAI-guided augmentation can make dermoscopic classifiers measurably more robust and fair at no cost to accuracy. They also clarify that it is the mechanism and not the specific tone palette that matters, and that the lasting contribution of XAI here lies in stability-screened, annotation-free lesion localisation rather than in the robustness number itself.

AI.tldr: CAMEO 将 XAI 从"事后审计工具"改造为"主动训练信号"：通过筛选稳定的类激活图定位并分离皮肤镜病变前景，再用合成皮肤替换背景，在 HAM10000 与深肤色 ISIC 上保持精度的同时将背景驱动错误减少近四倍。
AI.motivation: 皮肤镜深度学习分类器虽在分布内精度很高，却常依赖肤色、设备暗角、图像中嵌入的标尺等虚假背景线索，而非病变形态，导致跨肤色的鲁棒性与公平性受损。作者希望验证 XAI 能否不止用于审计已完成模型，而能作为训练信号主动纠正这种捷径，且不牺牲诊断精度。
AI.method: 提出 CAMEO（Class Activation Mapped Equitable Overlay）框架：先筛选稳定（stability-screened）的模型解释（类激活图），据此在无需标注的情况下定位病变区域，将病变与其背景分离；随后保持病变不变，用逼真的合成皮肤（含基于 Fitzpatrick 肤色的背景）替换原背景，构成 XAI 引导的数据增强，从而切断模型对背景线索的依赖。
AI.result: 在 HAM10000 和深肤色 ISIC 图像上，CAMEO 在维持诊断精度的同时将背景驱动错误减少近四倍，并使模型注意力在背景变化时更加一致；多项测试表明，降低对背景信息的依赖可提升鲁棒性，且基于 Fitzpatrick 的背景提供了真实且可解释的实现途径。
AI.conclusion: XAI 引导的数据增强能在不损失精度的前提下，使皮肤镜分类器在鲁棒性与公平性上获得可测量的提升。起作用的是机制本身而非特定色调调色板；该工作中 XAI 的持久贡献在于"经稳定性筛选、无需标注的病变定位"，而非鲁棒性指标上的具体数值。
